# Article 1. Introductory Provisions

## Div. 1.1. General Municipal Code Provisions

See [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1. (General Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107492) of this Code.

## Div. 1.2. Municipal Code Administrative Citations

See [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1.2. (Administrative Citations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225704) of this Code.

## Div. 1.3. Orientation

This Division (Orientation) provides an overview of the structure of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 1.3.1. Zone String

The combination of zoning districts applied to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) including, [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B), [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), and [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B).

1. ##### Zone String Brackets


1. A zone is comprised of the following districts, as established in [Sec. 1.5.2. (Zoning Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2):
       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/1.3.1.1.png.webp?itok=YAwQhUrU)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/1.3.1.1.png?itok=RXefvDOn)
2. In order to regulate the built environment and activities allowed on a property, as provided for in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), land is designated with the districts listed in [Sec. 1.3.1.B. (Zoning Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.3.1) for zoning purposes. The zone of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is separated into two or more bracket sets \[ \] in order to reinforce the separation of the built environment from the types of activities as two distinct permissions on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The first bracket set contains the zoning districts that determine the built environment, and the second bracket set contains the zoning districts that determine the types of activities allowed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). Although the districts that make up the [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may refer, or have standards that are tied, to other districts in the [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), each district in the string is independent, and the various districts are combined in response to the variety of planning needs found throughout the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
2. ##### Zoning Districts


All zoning districts that compose a [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) including [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B), [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), and [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B).
    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/1.3.1.3.png.webp?itok=RQe-uih4)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/1.3.1.3.png?itok=cwJHWhe-)
1. [Article 2. (Form)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2) regulates the placement, scale, and intensity of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to ensure [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) forms are compatible with their context and to promote [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that support community goals.

2. [Article 3. (Frontage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3) regulates the portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and exterior [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that impact the public realm. [Frontage Districts (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) help ensure that [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s respond to the public realm in a contextually appropriate manner. The regulations in [Frontage Districts (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) range from minimal standards for Warehouse Frontages to a robust set of standards for Shopfront Frontages which require [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s to support a high-quality public realm that is active, comfortable, safe, and visually interesting, with strong connections between the public realm and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s inside [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

3. [Article 4. (Development Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4) regulates site design, including location and characteristics of [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), parking, landscape, and other site features. [Development Standards Districts (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) consist of regulations that are appropriate to a variety of contexts such as city centers, suburban neighborhoods, and rural hillsides.

4. [Article 5. (Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5) establishes [Use Districts (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), [Use Standards (Part 5C.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C), and [Use Definitions (Part 5D.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D) that regulate the activities on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and to mitigate any potential impacts within a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and on surrounding property as a result of those activities.

5. [Article 6. (Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6) establishes [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), which regulate the number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s permitted on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), otherwise known as density. [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) allow for a wide variety of zoning approaches to housing.
3. ##### Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts


[Article 8. (Supplemental & Special Zoning)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8) establishes additional regulations that may be applied through the use of [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s. These are represented in a third bracket set of the [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and separated by a hyphen (-) when more than one is applied. For further details, see [Sec. 1.5.2.A.3. (Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2).

4. ##### Special Zones


[Article 8. (Supplemental & Special Zoning)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8) also establishes unique zone designations called [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that, where applied, serve in lieu of [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s. [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s respond to unique conditions that do not lend themselves to the regulations established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). For further details, see [Sec. 1.5.2.A.4. (Special Zoning)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2).


### Sec. 1.3.2. Non-Zone String Articles

In addition to the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) articles, other articles in the Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) include:

1. [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7), governs instances where the desired physical form for development on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is prohibited by the applied zoning. The [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) recognize that, in general, the physical form of development need not be determined by its [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). There are certain cases, however, in which the physical form that development takes is directly tied to a specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or activity. In those cases, [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) outlines a series of regulatory solutions that override specific regulations otherwise addressed by [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s applied to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) establishes eligibility criteria for each Alternate Typology, and what regulations are superseded from the applicable [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

2. [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9) details procedures for implementing state [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) provisions to increase the production of affordable housing, as well as other programs to facilitate the provision of public benefits to communities in the vicinity of new development in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and other housing-related policies.

3. [Article 10. (Streets & Parks)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10) provides standards for the development of streets and parks.

4. [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) governs the division of land in accordance with the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

5. [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) provides relief from the requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that conformed to the zoning regulations at the time they were lawfully established, but do not conform to current district standards or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) permissions.

6. [Article 13. (Administration)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13) provides the procedures for various approvals under this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code. This is the only Article in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) that applies to both Chapters.

7. [Article 14. (General Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14), includes general rules that apply to development, as well as defining glossary terms with specific meaning in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

8. [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) details the fees required for various approvals.


### Sec. 1.3.3. Relief

Throughout this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), relief statements specify the only relief options available for the standards or rules to which the statements apply. If a relief option is not specified for a particular standard or rule, that relief option is not available, unless otherwise stated by the [City of Los Angeles Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

## Div. 1.4. Introductory Provisions

### Sec. 1.4.1. General Rules

1. ##### Title


This Chapter of the Los Angeles Municipal Code ( [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)) is the City of Los Angeles Zoning Code, and is referred to or cited as "this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A)" or "this Chapter" throughout the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

2. ##### Intent


This Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) regulates the development and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of property to achieve the following objectives:

01. Preserve, protect, and promote the public health, safety, and general welfare of residents and businesses in the City of Los Angeles.

02. Implement the goals and policies of officially adopted plans and policy documents, including the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)'s [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), Community Plans, and any other policy documents pertaining to planning, land use, and urban design.

03. Provide zoning options that realize a wide variety of community visions established in plans throughout the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

04. Provide clear standards and consistent procedures for appropriate and effective public involvement in land use and development decisions.

05. Ensure transparency and fairness through consistent interpretation of development regulations.

06. Promote equitably, environmentally, and economically sustainable construction and land development practices.

07. Ensure compatible transitions of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) scale, and height between existing and new development.

08. Provide [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) form and site design standards that address the public aspects of private development and how [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) form, placement, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s contribute to the safety and quality of the public realm.

09. Promote sustainable building, site, and landscape design practices that advance the livability, function, and beauty of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

10. Provide opportunities for a diverse range of housing options.

11. Provide standards for a variety of development patterns that emphasize connectivity between mobility networks.

### Sec. 1.4.2. Applicability of this Zoning Code

1. ##### Territorial Applicability


1. This Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) refers only to the omission or commission of acts within the territorial limits of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and that territory outside of this [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) over which the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has jurisdiction or control by virtue of the Constitution, Charter or any law, or by reason of ownership or control of property.

2. With the exception of [Article 13. (Administration)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13), this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) applies only to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s located on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s with zone designations established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and does not apply to those [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s zoned with districts established in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code.

3. [Article 13. (Administration)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13) applies to all land use and development in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), including [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s zoned with districts established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s where [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code is still in effect.

4. [4.Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code does not apply to those areas in which this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) is applicable, unless expressly stated in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
2. ##### Required Conformance


1. All [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, or land, in whole or in part, shall be [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) d or occupied in conformance with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

2. Any [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), as outlined in [Sec. 14.2.15. (Project Activities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.15), in whole or in part, shall be done so in conformance with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. The provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) apply to all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, or land owned, operated or controlled by any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), corporation, or to the extent permitted by law, governmental agency.

4. In the event that any provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) conflicts with [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Article 7. (Fire Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-339601) of this Code, then [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Article 7. (Fire Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-339601) of this Code shall prevail.
3. ##### Certificate Of Occupancy


No vacant land shall be occupied or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) d, except for [agricultural use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s as established in [Sec. 5D.10. (Agricultural Uses)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10) and as permitted by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), and no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) erected or structurally altered shall be occupied or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) d, until a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has been issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

1. ###### Certificate of Occupancy for a Building


      1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), renovation, or modification of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) must be made coincidentally with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be issued after written request for the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has been made to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and after the erection, [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or modification of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or part of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has been completed in conformity with the provisions of these regulations. Pending the issuance of a regular [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), a temporary [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may be issued by the Superintendent of Building for a period not to exceed six months during the completion of modifications or during partial occupancy of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) pending its completion. A temporary certificate shall not be construed as in any way altering the respective rights, duties, or obligations of the owners or of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) relating to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or occupancy of the premises or any other matter covered by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and such temporary certificate shall not be issued except under such restrictions and provisions as will adequately ensure the safety of the occupants.

      2. No excavation for any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be started before application has been made for a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
2. ###### Certificate of Occupancy for Off-Site Parking, Alleys, Loading Zones, & Residential Planned Developments


      1. Whenever the [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s which are required for a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) by the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), are provided on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) other than the one on which the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is located, the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for said [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be valid only while such parking stalls are maintained and shall bear a notation to that effect. The certificate shall be kept posted in a conspicuous place in the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The Superintendent of Building shall keep a record of each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on which required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are provided for a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) located on another [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and whenever the Superintendent of Building finds that such [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are no longer so maintained, the Superintendent of Building shall notify the persons having custody of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of that fact. If the required automobile parking stalls are not maintained, the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall become void and the building shall not thereafter be occupied or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) d until the required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are again provided and a new certificate is issued.

      2. Whenever a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) a public [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) in a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5) is developed and used solely for [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) purposes with no more than 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and no [loading space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is provided, the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) thereon shall be valid only while all the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on said [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) are maintained for said [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and the certificate shall bear a notation to that effect. If at any time any of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on said [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) are structurally altered or enlarged, or the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) thereof is changed to a hospital, hotel, institution, commercial or industrial purposes, or a [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) so as to exceed 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the certificate shall become void and none of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on said [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall thereafter be occupied or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) d until the required [loading space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is provided and a new [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is issued.

      3. Wherever authority is granted to permit the sale of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) in a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) planned development contingent upon the possession of an interest in common areas and facilities which are appurtenant to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) including through shares of stock or voting membership in an owners association, the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be valid only while the interest is held by the owner.
3. ###### Certificate of Occupancy for Land


      An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of vacant land or a change in the character of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of land, including the construction of tennis or paddle tennis courts, shall be made before any such land shall be occupied or used for any purpose except that of tilling the soil for the purposes of [plant cultivation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), as established in [Sec. 5D.10.2. (Plant Cultivation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.2). A [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be issued after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has been made, provided such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is in conformity with the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

4. ###### Certificate of Occupancy — Contents


      The [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall state that the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or land conforms to the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). A record of all certificates shall be kept on file in the office of the Superintendent of Building, and copies shall be furnished, on request, to any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) having a proprietary or tenancy interest in the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or land affected.

5. ###### Plats


      All [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s for a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be made on a form to be furnished by the Superintendent of Building, and shall contain accurate information and dimensions as to the size and location of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the size and location of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the dimensions of all [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and open spaces, and such other information as may be necessary to provide for the enforcement of these regulations. Where complete and accurate information is not readily available from existing records, the Superintendent of Building may require the applicant to furnish a survey of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) prepared by a licensed [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and plats shall be kept by the office of the Superintendent of Building, and the duplicate copy shall be kept at the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) at all times during construction.

6. ###### Recorded Agreements


      Whenever a recorded agreement(s) is required as part of the approval of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on a lot(s) as a prerequisite to the issuance of the required [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the owner(s) of said [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)(s) shall record an agreement with the Los Angeles County Recorder as a covenant running with the land for the benefit of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), providing that such owner or owners shall continue to maintain conformance with such agreement(s) so long as the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) they are intended to serve is maintained.
4. ##### Interpretation


1. ###### Control Over Less Restrictive Laws & Regulations


      Unless otherwise stated, if any condition or requirement imposed by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) is more restrictive than a condition or requirement imposed by any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) law, rule or regulation of any kind, the more restrictive condition or requirement governs.

2. ###### State & Federal Law


      This Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall comply with state and federal law.

3. ###### Text & Graphics


      Illustrations, graphics, and photographs are included in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) only to assist users in understanding the intent and requirement of the text. In the event that a conflict occurs between the text of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and any illustrations, graphics, or photographs, the text shall prevail.

4. ###### Effect of Heading

5. ###### References to Other Laws, Requirements, Chapters, & Codes

(Effect of Renumbering or Redesignation of Provisions or Sections in Statutes or Codes of the State of California Which are Referenced to in the Los Angeles Municipal Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107615), any references to State or Federal statutes or regulations in this Chapter 1A shall be to those statutes or regulations as written and in effect on the date the ordinance adding those references is adopted. This general rule is intended to control over a specific rule to the contrary and shall not be subject to the rule of statutory construction that where there is a conflict, a specific statute controls over a general statute.

      2. References within this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to requirements of other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or government agencies or Chapters of the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), as well as other local, state, and federal codes are provided for informational purposes and are not intended to be comprehensive or to provide exemption from any additional applicable regulations from other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or government agencies or Sections of the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) not explicitly referenced in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
6. ###### Defined Terms


      Defined terms within this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) are underlined with a dotted line and their definitions are located in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3).

7. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      This Subsection (Interpretation) prevails over any other contrary provision in this Chapter.

See [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.00.(d) (Effect of Code on Past Actions and Obligations Previously Accrued)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107510) of this Code.

## Div. 1.5. Zoning Code Maps

### Sec. 1.5.1. General

1. ##### Intent


The land use and development regulations outlined in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) provide responsive zoning solutions to many planning policy objectives. Typically, these provisions apply in a geographically-specific manner through mapped [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, Special Zones, and other types of land designations. This collection of [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)-specific maps is referred to as the Zoning Code Maps. Zoning Code Maps enable the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to effectively coordinate the application of regulations by establishing zoning districts, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, or other land designations through which geographic planning objectives can be addressed and further enhance the regulatory tools provided by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

2. ##### Maintenance and Access


1. ###### Adoption & Maintenance of Zoning Code Maps


      Zoning Code Maps shall be created pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3) and amended as established for each Zoning Code Map.

      1. ###### Zoning Code Maps


         The maps established in this Division (Zoning Code Maps), maintained by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), published as layers of digital files that are part of its Geographic Information Systems database, shall:

         1. Delineate the boundaries of the various [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and other types of land designations through which regulations in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) are made applicable.

         2. Include all matters, notations, and representations.

         3. When adopted and approved, are incorporated and made a part hereof, as if fully set forth herein, and collectively constitute the official Zoning Code Maps.
      2. ###### Record of Changes


         All changes to Zoning Code Maps shall be made by updating the digital file for each change with the date of the change. All amendments to official Zoning Code Maps shall be maintained by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and made available to the public. Zoning Code Maps shall be marked pursuant to a system of identification established by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      3. ###### Scale of Map


         Zoning Code Maps shall be maintained in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s adopted datum, maintained by the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering. Where a boundary is not a street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), or where property indicated on the Zoning Code Map is not subdivided into [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, the boundary on the Zoning Code Map is determined by the scale and projection contained on the map and any metadata included as part of the Geographic Information Systems database file.

      4. ###### Land Base Dataset


         The Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering is responsible for reviewing identifying, and updating the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)'s public and private land records, and establishes and maintains the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)'s land base dataset used by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall make the necessary adjustment to the Zoning Code Maps as updates to the land base dataset are issued.

      5. ###### Annexations


         If the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)'s jurisdiction is amended, changes in the Zoning Code Map shall be identified by updating the Geographic Information Systems database file with the date of the change.
2. ###### Accessing Zoning Code Maps


      Zoning Code Maps can be accessed electronically through the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s Zoning Information and Map Access System (ZIMAS), or on the Zoning Code Maps in the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s Map Gallery on the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) website. Hard copies of Zoning Code Maps can be made available by visiting one of the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s Development Services Centers and making a reproduction request with payment of any applicable fees.

### Sec. 1.5.2. Zoning Map

1. ##### Purpose


1. ###### Zoning Districts


      In order to regulate the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and development of property, as provided for in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), land is designated with the following districts for zoning purposes. The zone of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is separated into two or more bracket sets \[ \] in order to reinforce the separation of the built environment from the types of activities as two distinct permissions on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The first bracket set contains the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that determine the built environment, and the second bracket set contains the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that determine the types of activities on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). Although the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s may refer, or have standards that are tied, to other districts, each is independent and are combined in response to the variety of planning needs found throughout the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      \[Form – Frontage – Standards\] \[Use – Density\]

      1. Form Districts are outlined in [Article 2. (Form)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2).

      2. Frontage Districts are outlined in [Article 3. (Frontage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3).

      3. Development Standards Districts are outlined in [Article 4. (Development Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4).

      4. Use Districts are outlined in [Article 5. (Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5).

      5. Density Districts are outlined in [Article 6. (Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6).
2. ###### Alternate Typologies


      The [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) recognize that, in general, the physical form of development need not be determined by its [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). There are certain cases, however, in which the physical form that development takes is directly tied to a specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or activity. In those cases, [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) outlines a series of regulatory solutions that overrides specific regulations otherwise addressed by [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s applied to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). Each Alternate Typology establishes eligibility parameters for each option, and what metrics it supersedes from the applicable [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

3. ###### Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts


      In addition to the provisions of Paragraph 1. (Zoning Districts) above, additional regulations may be applied as outlined in [Div. 8.1. (Specific Plans (SP))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.1) and [Div. 8.2. (Supplemental Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.2). These are represented in a third bracket set of the zoning using the acronym "SP" for [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or the acronyms established for the respective [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The third bracket set may include multiple [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s separated by a hyphen (-).

4. ###### Special Zoning


      1. In order to achieve specific planning objectives in designated areas having unique characteristics, [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s may replace the zoning in [Sec. 1.5.2.A.1. (Zoning Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2) and [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s in [Sec. 1.5.2.A.3. (Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2) established above. [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s respond to unique conditions and stipulate land use and development requirements or incentives tailored to distinctive qualities that may not lend themselves to the regulations established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), except as outlined within each [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      2. The [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s outlined in [Div. 8.3. (Special Zoning)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.3) shall serve as the designated zone, in lieu of [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, where applied.

      3. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s zoned with [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s shall have a maximum of two bracket sets \[ \]. The first bracket set shall state the name of the [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The second bracket set may include multiple [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s separated by a hyphen (-). In instances in which a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is zoned only with a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), only one bracket set shall be included.
5. ###### Zoning of Annexed or Unzoned Land


      1. All land or territory annexed to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) after the effective date of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), where applied, is automatically classified \[LF2-WH1-5\] \[A1-1L\] unless the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) specifically determines otherwise.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may establish specific zoning by ordinance for land or territory to be annexed. The zoning ordinance may be adopted concurrently with the annexation. Unless the specific zoning is established by ordinance, the Zoning Map shall be amended to indicate the land or territory annexed as \[LF2-WH1-5\] \[A1-1L\] without additional proceedings.

      3. Any land or territory in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) not indicated on the Zoning Map as being in any zone shall be construed as being classified in the same zone that exists on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on the opposite side of the street or highway of the subject land or territory, and the Zoning Map shall be amended to indicate that zone without additional proceedings.
2. ##### Boundaries


1. ###### Street, Alley or Lot Lines


      Zone boundaries occur at street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s unless otherwise shown on the Zoning Map, using the land base dataset, and where the indicated boundaries on the Zoning Map are approximately a street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) are the boundaries of the zone.

2. ###### Street or Public Right-of-Way


      1. A street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), railroad or railway [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), watercourse, channel, or body of water included on the Zoning Map shall, unless otherwise indicated, be included within the zone boundaries of the [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) property on either side of the street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), railroad or railway [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), watercourse, channel or body of water.

      2. Where the street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), watercourse, channel, or body of water serves as a boundary between two or more different zones, a line midway in the street, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), watercourse, channel, or body of water, and extending in the general direction of its longest dimension is the boundary between zones.
3. ###### Vacated Street or Alley


      1. In the event a dedicated street or alley shown on the Zoning Map is vacated, the property formerly in the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be included within the zone of the adjoining property on either side of the vacated street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      2. In the event the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) was a zone boundary between two or more different zones, the new zone boundary is the former centerline of the vacated street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
3. ##### Amendments


1. ###### Zone Changes


      1. ###### Process


         The Zoning Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4). For zone changes involving [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, the Zoning Map may only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.2. (Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.2).
2. ###### Zone Boundary Adjustments


      1. ###### Process


         Whenever public necessity, convenience, general welfare or good zoning practice justifies the action, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may approve, conditionally approve, or deny a zone boundary adjustment, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2), and make minor adjustments to the location of a zone boundary to carry out the intent of this Section (Zoning Map) when:

         1. Property as shown on the Zoning Map has been divided or approved for division into [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s by a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and the [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) arrangement does not conform to that anticipated when the zone boundaries were established;

         2. Property was redivided or approved for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) by a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) action into a different arrangement of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and blocks than indicated on the Zoning Map; or

         3. Where uncertainty exists in applying the provisions of this Subsection B. (Boundaries) or where revision is necessary to correct dimensional or mapping errors, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may determine the location of the zone boundary.
      2. ###### Limitation


         Zone boundary adjustments permitted pursuant to this Subsection B. (Boundaries) are limited to a distance of no more than 50 feet. When the adjustment is requested prior to recordation, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s decision does not become effective until after the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has been recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

      3. ###### Dedications


         The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may require that the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, or highways be dedicated and improved in conformance with the standards for improvement of streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and highways, if it is determined that traffic on the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or highways would be increased or impeded as a result of the zone boundary adjustment. An offer to dedicate or filing of a bond in conformance with [Sec. 10.1.4. (Dedication Procedure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.4) and [Sec. 10.1.5. (Improvement Procedure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.5) may be construed as compliance with these requirements.

      4. ###### Zoning Map


         The Zoning Map shall conform with the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s decision after the conditions are imposed, if any.

### Sec. 1.5.3. Primary Street Map

1. ##### Purpose


Each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall have at least one [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) based on a set of criteria established in [Sec. 14.2.12.C.1. (Primary Street Lot Line)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12). However, a [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may be re-designated into a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) when the adjacent [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has been established as a [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on the Primary Street Map.

2. ##### Boundaries


The Primary Street Map is composed of street segments made up of a line midway in the [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and extending in the general direction of its longest dimension between each intersection.

3. ##### Amendments


The Primary Street Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.4. Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are eligible to participate in the Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program established in [Sec. 9.3.2. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2), as well as which Local Incentive Program Set the individual lots are required to utilize.

2. ##### Boundaries


Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, as eligible for the Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program pursuant to [Sec. 9.3.2. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2) by providing [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s as required by the applied Local Incentive Program Set. The Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map shall establish the automobile parking incentive for which a [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is eligible.

1. ###### Local Incentive Program Set


      An eligible [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be designated with one of the Local Incentive Program Sets established in [Sec. 9.3.2.B.1. (Local Incentive Program Sets)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2).

2. ###### Automobile Parking Incentive


      An eligible [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be designated with one of the Automobile Parking Incentives established in [Sec. 9.3.2.C.4. (Automobile Parking Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2).
3. ##### Amendments


The Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


[notes](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)

### Sec. 1.5.5. Targeted Planting Map

1. ##### Purpose


[Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s identified in an identified [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), as established in [Sec. 1.5.5.B. (Boundaries)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.5), on the Targeted Planting Map shall comply with the corresponding planting requirements in a separate regulatory document named "Department of City Planning - Targeted Planting Lists" ( [Targeted Planting List](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)) as established by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of Planning.

2. ##### Boundaries


Any land designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, as any of the following [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) designations in the Targeted Planting Map.

1. ###### River Planting Area


      Plants in these areas, and outlined in this category in the [Targeted Planting List](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), shall be limited to:

      1. [Native plant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that occur naturally in a given geographic area, which can be trees, flowers, grasses, or any other plants, included in the [California Native Plant Library](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      2. Species included in the [Watershed Wise Plant List](https://www.watershedhealth.org/_files/ugd/ceb944_c895c3a8ffad4f1185671ff50aa32526.pdf) published by the Council for Watershed Health.

      3. Species included in the [Los Angeles County River Master Plan's Landscaping Guidelines](https://ladpw.org/wmd/watershed/la/lar_planting_guidelines_webversion.pdf) and plant palettes comprised primarily of [native plant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s suitable for a riparian habitat.
2. ###### Filtration Planting Area


      Trees planted in these areas, and outlined in this category in the [Targeted Planting List](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), shall be low in water use, low in biogenic emissions, high in carbon and particulate matter filtration qualities and retain foliage for more than six months of the year.
3. ##### Amendments


The Targeted Planting Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.6. Hillside Area Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Hillside Area Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s with topographical features subject to additional regulations intended to address the specific nature of hillside development. These additional regulations are outlined in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and are applicable by reference to this Zoning Code Map.

2. ##### Boundaries


Any land designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, as [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) as shown in the shaded portion of the Hillside Area Map.

3. ##### Amendments


The Hillside Area Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.7. Coastal Zone Map

\[Reserved\]

### Sec. 1.5.8. Special Lot Line Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Special Lot Line Map identifies any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s subject to [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) provisions that apply to [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that require specific identification, as established in [Sec. 14.2.12.C.3. (Special Lot Line)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12).

2. ##### Boundaries


The Special Lot Line Map is composed of line segments, based on [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s established in the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, designated as any of the following types of [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

1. ###### River Special Lot Line


      A [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) which is [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to, or in the general vicinity of, a river, where [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s need to provide a strong and active presence along the river.

2. ###### Alley Special Lot Line


      An [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) where [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s need to provide a strong and active presence along the alley.
3. ##### Amendments


The Special Lot Line Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.9. Alcohol Permission Area Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Alcohol Permission Area Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are subject to [Sec. 5C.3.3. (Alcohol Sales Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.3), which establishes permission levels and standards for [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s involving the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages.

2. ##### Boundaries


Any land designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, as any of the following Alcohol Permission Area designations in the Alcohol Permission Area Map.

1\. Alcohol Sensitive Sales Area

2\. Restaurant Beverage Area

3\. Limited Restaurant Beverage Area

4\. Restaurant & Bar Nightlife Area

3. ##### Amendments


The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall have the ability to establish and subsequently modify the Alcohol Permission Area Map, pursuant to an adopted City Council Resolution. In adopting the resolution, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) must find that the establishment or modification is in conformity with public necessity, convenience, general welfare and good zoning practice. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is authorized to revise the Alcohol Permission Area Map as established in the adopted resolution. The Alcohol Permission Area Map shall not be altered or modified by an unauthorized person.


### Sec. 1.5.10. Inclusionary Housing Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Inclusionary Housing Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that require [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s to provide [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1). Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) not included on this map shall not be subject to those provisions.

2. ##### Boundaries


Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, with the following designations.

1. ###### Inclusionary Housing Areas


      [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are subject to the [Inclusionary Housing Program (Sec. 5C.3.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1) shall be designated with one of the following options.

      1. ###### Inclusionary Rental (IR)


         An Inclusionary Rental (IR) designation shall mean that a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) involving the construction of an [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) that includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are for-rent shall be subject to the applicable provisions in [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1).

      2. ###### Inclusionary Rental & For-Sale (IRF)


         An Inclusionary Rental & For-Sale (IRF) designation shall mean that a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) involving the construction of an [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) that includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s which are for-rent and/or for-sale shall be subject to the applicable provisions in [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1).

      3. ###### Community Plan Implementation Overlay (CPIO)


         A Community Plan Implementation Overlay (CPIO) designation shall mean that a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) involving the construction of an [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be subject to the provisions in [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1) and as further modified by an applied [Community Plan Implementation Overlay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
2. ###### Affordability Requirement Set


      [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s shall also be designated with one of the Affordability Requirement Sets as established in [Sec. 5C.3.1.C.3. (Inclusionary Program Set Designations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1).
3. ##### Amendments


The Inclusionary Housing Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.11. Public Access Easement Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Public Access Easement Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) that are affected by the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) standards established in [Sec. 14.2.17. (Public Access Easements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).

2. ##### Boundaries


The Public Access Easement Map is composed of line segments, based on [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) lines established in the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, designated as a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

3. ##### Amendments


The Public Access Easement Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.12. Public Benifits Incentive Map

1. ##### Purpose


    The Public Benefits Incentive Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are eligible to utilize the Public Benefits Menu established in [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4), as well as which Public Benefits Incentive Set the individual [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are eligible to utilize.

2. ##### Boundaries


1. The Public Benefits Incentive Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, as eligible for the Public Benefits Menu in [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4) if a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on an eligible [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) utilizes an applicable incentive program in [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9) and meets all requirements of the incentive program and [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4). An eligible [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be designated with one of the Public Benefits Incentive Sets established in [Sec. 9.3.4.C.3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4).

2. Where the Public Benefits Incentive Map shows “CPIO” or “SP” on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the applicable Public Benefits Incentive Set for that [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be established by or otherwise modified or replaced by the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

3. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be eligible for any additional Public Benefits Incentive Sets other than the incentive set designated on the Public Benefits Incentive Map if specified in an incentive program in [Div. 9.2. (Citywide Housing Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2).
3. ##### Amendments


The Public Benefits Incentive Map shall only be revised pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).


### Sec. 1.5.13. Inventory of Housing Elements Sites Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Inventory of Housing Element Sites Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s listed in the inventory of land suitable for residential development developed pursuant to California Government Code Sec.65583.

2. ##### Boundaries


Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, that is listed on the Inventory of Housing Element Sites established in Appendix 4.1, Appendix 4.2, Appendix 4.3 of the current 2021-2029 Housing Element, any candidate sites for rezoning to address a shortfall, until those candidate sites are replaced through adoption of a rezoning program adopted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to implement the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s program to rezone for adequate sites pursuant to California Government Code Sec. 65583(c)(1), and any sites rezoned through such program.

3. ##### Amendments


The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall establish and amend the Inventory of Housing Element Sites Map pursuant to an adopted City Council Resolution.


### Sec. 1.5.14. Prior Housing Element Sites Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Prior Housing Element Sites Map identifies sites that have been listed in a previous Housing Element cycle as suitable for residential development and are included in the current 2021-2029 Housing Element. Sites listed in the Prior Housing Element Sites Map are eligible for streamlined review established in [Sec. 9.2.6. (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6).

2. ##### Boundaries


Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) designated, using the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering land base dataset, that is listed as a Prior Housing Element Site in Appendix 4.1 of the current 2021-2029 Housing Element.

3. ##### Amendments


The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall establish and amend the Prior Housing Element Sites Map pursuant to an adopted City Council Resolution.


### Sec. 1.5.15. Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map

1. ##### Purpose


1. The Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are eligible for streamlined review in [Sec. 9.2.6. (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6) for the application of the minimum density requirements established in [Sec. 6C.2.1. (Minimum Dwelling Units Per Lot Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.2.1).

2. The Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s rezoned as part of a rezoning program to meet the Housing Element need for [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s allocated pursuant to California Government Code Sec. 65584. ### Sec. 1.5.16. Transit Oriented Incentive Map

1. ##### Purpose


The Transit Oriented Incentive Map identifies [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that are eligible to participate in the Transit Oriented Incentive Program established in [Sec. 9.2.5. (Transit Oriented Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5).

2. ##### Boundaries

Transit Oriented Incentive Sets shall not be mapped on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s located within a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), or a [Sea Level Rise Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
