## Div. 1.6. Emergency Provisions

### Sec. 1.6.1. Local Emergency Temporary Regulations

1. ##### Declaration of Intent


It is the intent and objective of this Division (Emergency Provisions) is to establish reasonable and uniform regulations to protect the public welfare and to provide a streamlined method for consideration of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s for [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) approvals and other land use approvals in an emergency, such as fire, storm, severe earthquake, civil disturbance, or other disaster declared by the Governor.

2. ##### Long-Term Temporary Uses


01. ###### Authority of the Zoning Administrator


       1. Regardless of any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) has the authority to approve the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) in any zone for the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of property which will aid in the immediate restoration of an area adversely impacted by a severe fire, storm, earthquake, similar natural disaster, or a civil or military disturbance, and declared by the Governor as an emergency area if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) finds:

          1. That the nature and short duration of the proposed [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) assures that the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) will not be materially detrimental to the character of development in the immediate neighborhood;

          2. That the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) will not adversely affect the implementation of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#); and

          3. That the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) will contribute in a positive fashion to the reconstruction and recovery of areas adversely impacted during the emergency.
       2. In making a determination pursuant to this Section (Local Emergency Temporary Regulations), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall balance the public interest and benefit to be derived from the proposed [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) against the degree, significance of, and temporary nature of the inconvenience to be caused in the area where the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is located. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may promulgate regulations and guidelines as are necessary and proper to administer the provisions of this Division (Emergency Provisions).
02. ###### Conditions of Approval


       1. In approving the location of any [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may impose conditions as the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) deems necessary to protect the peaceful and quiet enjoyment of nearby properties. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall require the posting of a completion bond, or other guarantee satisfactory to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), to cover the cost of the removal of any improvements made to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or cleaning of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) after termination of the temporary authorized [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

       2. Furthermore, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall require termination of the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) within one year from the date of the approval of the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the removal of all temporary improvements on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and the restoration of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to a permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) within a reasonable period of time determined by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). Approval of any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) does not result in any vested or [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) rights to carry on the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) after the term authorized.

       3. The automobile parking design and improvement provisions of [Sec. 4C.4.3. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3) and [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4) and the [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) do not apply to temporary permits for public parking in the [Residential Use Districts (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3). However, in approving permits, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may impose those conditions as the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) deems necessary to protect the peaceful and quiet enjoyment of the subject and nearby properties.
03. ###### Revocation


       1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may suspend or revoke any [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) approval, if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) determines that the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) bears no significant relation to the reconstruction and recovery of areas adversely impacted by the emergency, or that the conditions imposed on any [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) approval have not been complied with, or that an unreasonable level of interference with the peaceful enjoyment of neighboring properties is created by the conduct of any authorized activity.

       2. Prior to the revocation of a [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) approval, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall give written notice to the record owner or lessee to appear within five days, or less if justified by a threat to public health and safety, at a time and place fixed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and show cause why the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) approval should not be revoked or why further conditions should not be imposed.

       3. A determination of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) pursuant to this Subsection B. (Long-Term Temporary Uses) may be appealed to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on a form prescribed by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) in accordance with the procedures described in this Section (Local Emergency Temporary Regulations).
04. ###### Other Permits and Licenses


       This Division (Emergency Provisions) does not, except as stated here, modify or affect in any way the duty of any applicant to obtain any other permit or license which may be required under any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or state law.

05. ###### Application


       1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to allow any [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) referred to in this Division (Emergency Provisions) shall be filed with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) upon forms and accompanied by data as the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may require.

       2. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may be filed by an owner or a lessee and shall be verified by the applicant attesting to the truth and correctness of all facts and information presented with, or contained in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and shall also be signed by the owner of record of any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) where the proposed [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) will be located.

       3. A copy of any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) so filed shall be transmitted by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to the Councilmember of the district in which the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) would be located and to the Department of Transportation for their information.
06. ###### Notice & Hearing


       1. Upon the filing of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall set the matter for public hearing. Notice of the time, place, and intent of the hearing shall be given by mailing a written notice at least 14 days prior to the date of the hearing to the applicant, to the owner of the subject property, to [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) property owners, and to property owners directly across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) from the subject property.

       2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be set for public hearing unless the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) makes written findings, attached to the file involved, that the requested [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#):

          1. Will not have a significant effect on [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) properties or on the immediate neighborhood; or

          2. Is not likely to evoke public controversy.
07. ###### Time Limit


       The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall make a determination within 30 days from the filing of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). This time limit may be extended by mutual written consent of the applicant and [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

08. ###### Fee


       An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for an approval pursuant to this Section (Local Emergency Temporary Regulations) does not require any filing fee.

09. ###### Decisions by the Zoning Administrator


       Decisions by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be supported by written findings of fact based upon written or oral statements and documents presented to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), which may include photographs, maps and plans, together with the results of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s investigations. Upon making a decision, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall mail a copy of the written findings and decisions to the applicant, and to the other [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s who were required to be notified under Paragraph 6. (Notice & Hearing) above.

10. ###### Decision Effective & Appeal


       The decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is final, unless appealed, after an elapsed period of 10 days from the date of mailing a copy of the written findings and decision to the applicant. During this period, any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) aggrieved by the decision may file a written appeal to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The appeals shall set forth specifically the points at issue, the reasons for the appeal, and how the appellant believes there was an error or abuse of discretion by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). No fee will be charged for this appeal.

11. ###### Failure to Act


       If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) fails to make a decision on a temporary land [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) within the time limit specified in Paragraph 7. (Time Limit) above, then the applicant may file a request in the Office of Zoning Administration for a transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and for a decision by the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on the original [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). In that case, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall lose jurisdiction and the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall assume jurisdiction, provided, however, that the matter may be remanded to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may accept the applicant’s request for withdrawal of the transfer of jurisdiction. In either case, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) will regain jurisdiction for the time and purpose specified by the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

12. ###### Transfer of Jurisdiction


       When considering any matter transferred to its jurisdiction pursuant to Subsection C. (Special Provisions for Other Proceedings) below because of the failure of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to act, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall make its decision within 30 days after the request to transfer jurisdiction is filed. All decisions become final on the date of mailing a copy of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s decision to the applicant.

13. ###### Record on Appeal


       Within five days of receipt of the filing of an appeal, the case file of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) appealed, and the appeal shall be delivered to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). At any time prior to the action by the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on the appeal, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may submit supplementary pertinent information as the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) deems necessary or as may be requested by the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

14. ###### Appeal Hearing Date-Notice


       Upon receipt of the appeal, the matter shall be set for an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) hearing and notice shall be given by mail of the time, place and purpose of the hearing to the appellant, to the applicant, to the owner or owners of the property involved, to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and to any other interested party who has requested in writing to be notified. This notice shall be in writing and mailed at least five days prior to the hearing.

15. ###### Appeal Hearing Date-Continuance


       Upon the date set for the hearing, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) will hear the appeal, unless, for cause, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall on that date continue the matter. No notice of continuance need be given if the order to continue is announced at the time for which the hearing was set.

16. ###### Area Planning Commission Decision


       1. When considering an appeal from an action by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall make its decision within 15 days (in the case of a revocation, within 10 days) after the expiration of the appeal period, or within an extended period of time as may be mutually agreed upon in writing by the applicant and the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall base its decision only upon:

          1. Evidence introduced at the hearing, or hearings, if any, before the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), on the issue;

          2. The record, findings and determination of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#); and

          3. The consideration of arguments, if any, presented to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) orally or in writing.
       2. If an applicant or aggrieved person wishes to offer into the proceedings any new evidence in connection with the matter, a written summary of that evidence, together with a statement as to why that evidence could not reasonably have been presented to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be filed with the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) prior to the hearing. If the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) fails to act on any appeal within the time limit specified in the Subsection, the determination of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is final.

       3. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may modify or reverse the ruling, decision or determination appealed from only upon making findings indicating how the action of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) was in error or constituted an abuse of discretion and shall make specific findings supporting any modification or reversal. The decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is final as of the date of its determination on the matter. After making a decision, a copy of the findings and determination shall be placed on file in the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and a copy of the determination shall be furnished to the applicant, the appellant, and the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
3. ##### Special Provisions For Other Proceedings


1. Regardless of any provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or any other ordinance to the contrary, with respect to those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or damaged in connection with a declared emergency, and in the area covered by the declaration of emergency, the following exceptions apply:

      1. Payment of all [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) fees may be deferred until the applicant seeks any [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      2. For [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s relating to new actions pursuant to [Div. 13B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2), [Sec. 13B.4.5. (Project Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5), [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12), and [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3), any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) permits pursuant to moratorium ordinances or interim control ordinances, and any revocation or modification proceedings:

         1. If the law otherwise requires or authorizes a public hearing, the matter shall be set for public hearing unless the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of Planning makes written findings, attached to the file involved, that the matter:

            1. Will not have a significant effect on [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) properties or on the immediate neighborhood; or

            2. Is not likely to evoke public controversy.
         2. Provided, however, that no hearing will be waived in any proceeding involving:

            1. Eating & drinking: alcohol service

            2. [Retail: alcohol](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)

            3. [Retail: merchant market](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)

            4. [Retail: firearms](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)

            5. [Financial services: alternative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)

            6. [Motor vehicle services: light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)

            7. [Motor vehicle services: heavy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)
         3. When a matter is set for public hearing, written notice of the hearing shall be given to the applicant, the owner or owners of the property involved, and to the owners of all property within and outside of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) within 500 feet of the property involved.
      3. Payment of the Affordable Housing Linkage Fee pursuant to [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3).
4. ##### Restoration of Damaged or Destroyed Buildings


1. ###### Nonconforming


      1. Regardless of any other provisions of this Division (Emergency Provisions) to the contrary, a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) as to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, height, number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), density, [loading space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), parking, off-site signs, or other [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), which is damaged or [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) as a result of the declared emergency may be repaired or reconstructed with the same [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, height, number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), density, [loading space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), parking, or off-site signs as the original [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#). Provided, however, that repair or reconstruction shall be commenced within two years of the date of damage or destruction and completed within two years of obtaining a permit for reconstruction. Provided, further, that neither the footing nor any portion of the replacement [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) encroaches into any area planned for widening or extension of existing or future streets as determined by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) upon the recommendation of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

      2. The provisions of this Section (Local Emergency Temporary Regulations) supersede any interim control ordinances, interim plan revision ordinances, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s (excluding the [South Central Alcohol Beverage Specific Plan, Ord. No. 171,681)](https://planning.lacity.gov/plans-policies/overlays/conditional-use-approval-sale-alcoholic-beverages), [Sec. 4C.14.1. (Development Review Threshold Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14.1), and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s hillside regulations under [Article 4. (Development Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4), except for [fire protection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and street [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) standards. Regardless of any provision in this Section (Local Emergency Temporary Regulations) to the contrary, any existing provision of law regulating the issuance of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) permits for [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s currently with historical or cultural designations on the federal, state, and [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) lists remain in full force and effect. All [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) regulations continue in full force and effect with respect to the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), maintenance & repair, and [reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of damaged or [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

      3. For purposes of this Subsection D. (Restoration of Damaged or Destroyed Buildings), a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may only be demolished and rebuilt to its [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) status, relative to the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), any interim control ordinances, interim plan revision ordinances, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s (excluding the [South Central Alcohol Beverage Specific Plan, Ord. No. 171,681)](https://planning.lacity.gov/plans-policies/overlays/conditional-use-approval-sale-alcoholic-beverages), and [Sec. 4C.14.1.(Development Review Threshold Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14.1), and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s hillside regulations under [Article 4. (Development Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4), except for those [fire protection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and street [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) standards), if the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is either [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or damaged in the following manner:

         1. Any portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is damaged by earthquake, wind, flood, fire, or other disaster, in such a manner that the structural strength or stability of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is appreciably less than it was before the catastrophe and is less than the minimum requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for a new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of similar structure, purpose or location, as determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#); and

         2. The cost of repair would exceed 50 percent of the replacement cost of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), not including the value of the foundation system, as determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
      4. Nothing here shall be interpreted as authorizing the continuation of a [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) beyond the time limits set forth in [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) that were applicable to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) prior to the events which necessitated the declaration of the emergency.

      5. If issues of interpretation relating to the above provisions arise, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is hereby authorized to resolve those issues in light of the scope and purposes of this Subsection D. (Restoration of Damaged or Destroyed Buildings).
2. ###### Conditional Uses & Uses that Benefit the Public


      1. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s authorized by a Conditional Use Permit pursuant [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), or [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), or other procedure in effect at the time of authorization of the approved Conditional Use Permit, are deemed exempt from the requirements of [Sec. 13B.5.4. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4), provided that the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s containing these [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are rebuilt as they lawfully existed prior to their destruction, with the same [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and height.

      2. The following [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are considered to be of such importance and their expeditious replacement is of such value to the health and safety of the community that they are deemed exempt from the requirements of [Sec. 13B.5.4. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4), provided that the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s containing these [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are rebuilt as they lawfully existed prior to their destruction, with the same [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and height.

         1. All [Public & Institutional Uses (Div. 5D.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3)

(Restoration of Damaged or Destroyed Buildings).

(Nonconforming) above, the following [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s are not exempt from the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), interim control ordinances, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and interim plan revision ordinances:

         7. [Motor vehicle services: heavy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)
3. ###### Boulevard, Avenue, & Collector Street Dedication & Improvement


      1. For any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) identified by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) as having sustained damage during and as a result of the situation causing the declared emergency, the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a new development on that [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) does not require improvement of frontage for [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, and [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s widening purposes under [Article 10. (Streets & Parks)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10).

      2. Nothing here prevents a property owner from, obtaining necessary permits, voluntarily improving the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and undertaking public improvements which conform to the applicable sections of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
4. ###### Zoning Administrator Adjustments


      1. Regardless of any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may grant deviations of no more than 10 percent from the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), height, [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), parking, and [loading space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) requirements for [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s damaged or [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) in an emergency declared by the Governor when the deviations are necessary to accommodate the requirements of the [Americans With Disabilities Act](https://www.ada.gov/), [Federal Fair Housing Amendments Act of 1988](https://www.congress.gov/bill/100th-congress/house-bill/1158), or the [California Code of Regulations, Title 24. (Building Standards Code)](https://codes.iccsafe.org/codes/california), provided the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) finds:

         1. That the deviations are not likely to cause an undue burden on nearby streets or neighboring properties;

         2. That the grant is not likely to evoke public controversy; and

         3. That the development cannot feasibly be designed to meet the requisite disabled access standards without the deviations.
      2. Prior to acting on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for a deviation, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall give notice to all [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) property owners and hold a public hearing. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may waive the public hearing if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) makes the findings in Subsection C. (Special Provisions for Other Proceedings) above. The notice and procedures provided above in Subsection B. (Long-Term Temporary Uses) shall be followed for granting any deviation.
5. ##### Critical Response Facilities


1. ###### Authority of the Department of Building and Safety


      Regardless of any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall, during the first six months following the declaration of an emergency, have the authority to issue a temporary permit for the duration of the emergency, on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), regardless of zone, for any police, fire, emergency medical or emergency communications facility which will aid in the immediate restoration of an area adversely impacted by a severe fire, storm, earthquake, similar natural disaster, or a civil or military disturbance, and declared by the Governor as an emergency area, provided that the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) maintains records of all temporary permits.
6. ##### Short-Term Temporary Uses


1. ###### Authority of the Department of Building and Safety


      Regardless of any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall, during the first six months following the declaration of an emergency, have the authority to issue a temporary 90-day permit on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), regardless of zone, for any [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) which will aid in the immediate restoration of an area adversely impacted by a severe fire, storm, earthquake, similar natural disaster, or a civil or military disturbance, and declared by the Governor as an emergency area, provided that the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) maintains records of all temporary permits.
7. ##### Activation & Termination


The provisions of this Division (Emergency Provisions) are applicable to a particular area upon the declaration of an emergency by the Governor relating to that area, pursuant to [California Government Code, Title 2. (Government of the State of California), Div. 1. (General), Chapter 7. (California Emergency Services Act)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayexpandedbranch.xhtml?tocCode=GOV&division=1.&title=2.&part=&chapter=7.&article=). The provisions of this Division (Emergency Provisions) cease to be applicable to a particular area two years following the date of declaration of emergency, and for one additional year if an extension is approved by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), provided, however, that the provisions of this Division (Emergency Provisions) are considered as still remaining in full force and effect thereafter for the intent of maintaining or defending any civil or criminal proceeding with respect to any right, liability or offense that may have arisen under the provisions of this Division (Emergency Provisions) during its operative period, or with respect to enforcing any condition of approval of the temporary permit. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may also extend by resolution any other time limits in this Division (Emergency Provisions) for one additional year.


### Sec. 1.6.2. Emergency Homeless Shelters — City Owned & Leased Property

1. Regardless of any provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, during any period for which the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) have declared a shelter crisis within the meaning of [California Government Code, Sec. 8698. (Shelter Crisis), et seq.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=8698.&lawCode=GOV), a transitional shelter may be established and operated on property owned or leased by the City of Los Angeles in any zone as a matter of right regardless of the number of beds or number of persons served.

2. Facilities used as a transitional shelter under this Section (Emergency Homeless Shelters — City Owned & Leased Property) shall comply with the minimum [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) regulations set forth in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.8605. (Emergency Homeless Shelters)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-180230) of this Code, as it is currently written or as it may be amended in the future, and are exempt from the requirements of the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

3. If the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on which any such shelter is located does not have sufficient area to provide the number of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s required by [Sec. 4C.4.1. (Automobile Parking Stalls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.1), then the number of spaces required shall be the number for which adequate area exists. If insufficient area for any [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s exists on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), no spaces shall be required.


### Sec. 1.6.3. Emergency Homeless Shelters — Charitable Organizations

1. Regardless of any provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, during any period for which the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) have declared a shelter crisis within the meaning of [California Government Code, Sec. 8698. (Shelter Crisis), et seq.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=8698.&lawCode=GOV), a transitional shelter may be established and operated on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) zoned with a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) with a [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of FA to 8, [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4) with a [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of FA to 8, [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use District (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) regardless of the number of beds or number of persons served, or any applicable [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) or [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) standards, if the transitional shelter is operated by a religious institution or a non-profit charitable organization and the transitional shelter is located on property owned or leased by that institution or organization.

2. Facilities used as a transitional shelter under this Section (Emergency Homeless Shelters — Charitable Organizations) shall comply with the minimum [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) regulations set forth in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.8605. (Emergency Homeless Shelters)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-180230), as it is currently written or as it may be amended in the future, and are exempt from the requirements of the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

3. If the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) on which any such transitional shelter is located does not have sufficient area to provide the number of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s required by [Sec. 4C.4.1. (Automobile Parking Stalls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.1), then the number of spaces required shall be the number for which adequate area exists. If insufficient area for any [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s exists on the lot, no spaces shall be required.

4. Unreinforced masonry or non-ductile concrete [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s shall not be used as shelters for the homeless.

5. Any provider establishing and operating a transitional shelter shall also comply with the following requirements:

1. Providers shall register with the City of Los Angeles by submitting a Cold/Wet Weather Temporary Shelter Application online via the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)'s website ( [www.lacity.gov](http://www.lacity.gov/)); and

2. Providers shall comply with the Cold/Wet Weather Temporary Shelter requirements promulgated by the Los Angeles Fire Department's Fire Prevention and Public Safety Bureau;

3. Providers shall provide written notification to the owners of properties [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) the subject property, as well as to any [school](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) located within 500 feet of the subject property, prior to operating a transitional shelter on the subject property; and

4. Providers shall comply with all local, state, and federal requirements that apply to the permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) of their property while operating a transitional shelter pursuant to this Section (Emergency Homeless Shelters — Charitable Organizations).

### Sec. 1.6.4. Temporary Residency in Residential Vehicle Pending Reconstruction of Disaster-Destroyed Dwelling

1. ##### Use of Land Permit


Regardless of any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may issue a use of land permit to any resident-owner of a single-unit [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) by disaster to temporarily place and reside in a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) upon the subject property. Such use of land permit shall be limited to a period of one year from the date of the subject disaster, during which period a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for the reconstruction of the subject [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be obtained. When such a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is obtained, the use of land permit shall be valid for an additional period to total no more than two years from the date of the subject disaster or until the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is complete, whichever occurs first. No other extension of time shall be granted for such use of land permit.

2. ##### Fence Requirement


Where a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is placed within a required [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), such [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be screened from public view by a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) constructed to the specifications of [California Existing Building Code Chapter 15., Sec. 3306. (Protection of Pedestrians)](https://codes.iccsafe.org/content/CABC2022P2/chapter-33-safeguards-during-construction#CABC2022P2_Ch33_Sec3306), pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.2.1500. (Basic Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-294272) of this Code; on [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s, the restrictions of [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.200. (Street Intersections - Obstructions to Visibility)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158888) of this Code shall also apply. Such [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be maintained in good condition and appearance.

3. ##### Yard Area Requirements


Such [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall observe five foot front, side, and rear setbacks and adequate [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall be assured to permit the removal of the [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) after reconstruction of the disaster- [destroyed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

4. ##### Site Restoration


Within 30 days of the removal of the [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), all equipment and utilities accessory to such [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and any [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) constructed pursuant to this Section (Temporary Residency in Residential Vehicle Pending Reconstruction of Disaster-Destroyed Dwelling) shall be removed and the site restored to permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) and condition.


### Sec. 1.6.5. Temporary Regulatory Relief During A Local Emergency

1. ##### Intent


The intent of this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During a Local Emergency) is to provide land use regulatory relief from certain Zoning Code provisions during a declared local emergency. The regulatory relief, upon activation by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), provides flexibility for businesses and property owners in the recovery from a local emergency by extending the time limitations for certain land use approvals and providing relief from certain automobile parking standards.

2. ##### Applicability


The provisions of this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During a Local Emergency) may be invoked upon the adoption of a [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) resolution following the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s declaration of emergency pursuant to local and state law, provided the resolution does not conflict with any Mayoral orders issued in relation to the declared local emergency.

1. ###### State Law & City Charter


      The provisions of this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During a Local Emergency) do not supersede state law or the Mayor’s authority under the City of Los Angeles Charter and Los Angeles Administrative Code.

2. ###### Effective Dates


      Regardless of any other provisions of this Article (Introductory Provisions) to the contrary, the regulatory relief provided by this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During a Local Emergency) shall automatically terminate 12 months after the expiration or termination date of the relevant emergency declaration, or upon [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s action by resolution to terminate earlier than that date. However, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) may, by resolution, extend the regulatory relief provided by this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During a Local Emergency) for up to an additional 24 months, thereby allowing the provisions to apply for a total of 36 months after the termination or expiration of the local emergency order. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) retains the discretion to terminate these provisions by resolution at any time after the expiration or termination of the local emergency order.
3. ##### Regulatory Relief


Regardless of any provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) Interpretation of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), ordinance, or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) to the contrary, the following regulatory relief shall be granted to a qualifying [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

1. ###### Time Limitations


      1. ###### Extension of Time Limitations


         Regardless of the expiration periods set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.7.A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7), the expiration of a Conditional Use Permit that was either approved or valid during the application of these provisions, shall be calculated by adding the term of the local emergency, plus up to an additional 12 months when the eligibility criteria in Subparagraph c. (Eligibility Criteria) below are met, to the term prescribed in [Sec. 13A.2.7.A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

         1. ###### Multiple Approvals


            Regardless of the expiration periods set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.7.A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7), if an eligible conditional use or other [quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is part of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) that requires multiple legislative and/or [quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10), then the expiration period set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.7.A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7) is extended by a term equivalent to the time period of the local emergency, plus up to an additional 12 months from the expiration of the local emergency for all approvals concurrently granted.
      2. ###### Extension of Term-Limited Grants


         Regardless of any condition of approval that specifies an expiration date or term limit for a Conditional Use Permit, where the expiration date occurs during the local emergency, that expiration date is automatically extended for the term of the local emergency, plus up to an additional 12 months when the criteria in Subparagraph c. (Eligibility Criteria) below are met.

         1. ###### Multiple Approvals


            Regardless of any provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, if an eligible Conditional Use Permit is part of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) that requires multiple legislative and/or [quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) and any of the approvals include a condition with a separate expiration date or term limit, the expiration date shall be extended concurrently with the Conditional Use Permit that meets the criteria in Subparagraph c. (Eligibility Criteria) below.
      3. ###### Eligibility Criteria


         1. ###### Eligible Conditional Use Approvals


            All [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s approved by Conditional Use Permit per the applicable [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) are eligible for the time extension, except for the following:

            1. Conditional Use Permits related to mineral & ore extraction, manufacturing, heavy: petroleum & coal products, or [waste facility: hazardous waste](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) as defined in [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D) are not eligible for the time extension within this Paragraph 1. (Time Limitations).

            2. Businesses or properties that are or have been the subject of revocation proceedings, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2), that resulted in corrective conditions or revocation are not eligible for a time extension.
         2. ###### Application


            The relief provided by this Subsection C. (Regulatory Relief) is subject to the procedures in [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), and fee(s) under [Sec. 15.3.16. (Time Extension)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.16) shall be paid in accordance with procedures set forth by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

         3. ###### Original Approval


            The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall verify that the prior discretionary approval and existing environmental documentation under [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is adequate for the issuance of the extension.

         4. ###### Notification


            In accordance with the procedures set forth by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), the applicant shall notify the Los Angeles Police Department, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), and the Councilmember whose district includes any portion of the property as part of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) process for the extension of the time limits.
2. ###### Automobile Parking Relief


      1. ###### Use Modifications


         A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall not trigger additional required automobile parking beyond that required by the existing approved [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) if all the following requirements are met. However, if the total parking required by [Div. 4C.4. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4) for the new [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is less than the number of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s that exist on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), then the number of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s may be reduced to the number of required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.

         1. ###### Requirements


            1. The [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is limited to a non-residential [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) allowed by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

            2. The [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) where the [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) is proposed has one of the following: a valid [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#); temporary [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#); or a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) if the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) predates the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) requirement. Those documents must have been issued prior to the declaration of the local emergency related to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#)’s resolution invoking this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During A Local Emergency).

            3. The automobile parking relief only applies to the first 5,000 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) for any tenant space. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) in excess of 5,000 square feet for the tenant space shall conform to the automobile parking requirements in [Div. 4C.4. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4), and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), inclusive of any aggregate [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), including [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) sectioned from a separate tenant space that may have been previously eligible or approved for the automobile parking reduction allowed by this Paragraph 2. (Automobile Parking Relief).

            4. The creation of new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) within the subject building, occurring during the period this Section is activated by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) resolution, is limited to the area within the existing [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s and existing roofline of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

            5. The [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall not result in a net loss of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s.
         2. ###### Consistency


            The relief provided in this Paragraph 2. (Automobile Parking Relief) is limited to the automobile parking provisions established in this Paragraph 2. (Automobile Parking Relief), and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) shall otherwise be consistent with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
      2. ###### Outdoor Dining


         Any new or expanded [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), shall not require any automobile parking, and the maintenance of existing automobile parking shall not be required for any portion of the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) utilized for an approved [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) during the effective dates of this Section if the following requirements are met.

         1. ###### Eligibility


            Only permitted eating & drinking establishments with verifiable indoor seating for on-premises dining are eligible for the relief provided within this Subparagraph b. (Outdoor Dining).

         2. ###### Consistency


            The relief provided in this Subparagraph b. (Outdoor Dining) is limited to the automobile parking provisions enumerated herein, and the project shall otherwise be consistent with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).

         3. ###### Termination


            Whenever the provisions of this Paragraph 2. (Automobile Parking Relief) cease to apply, the automobile parking requirements that existed prior to the declaration of the local emergency shall apply, and any [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#) s shall comply with the applicable requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#).
      3. ###### Existing Conditions of Approval


         Any existing condition of approval that requires valet automobile parking or off-site automobile parking is suspended and shall not be enforced during the effective dates of this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During A Local Emergency), if all the following requirements are met.

         1. ###### Eligibility


            Only the following entitlement approvals are eligible for this relief, and only if they were approved or active during the period that these provisions are invoked.




            | Eligible Entitlement Approvals |
            | --- |
            | Entitlement | Reference |
            | --- | --- |
            | Zone Change | [Sec. 13B.1.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) |
            | Class 1 Conditional Use Permit | [Sec. 13B.2.1.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1) |
            | Class 2 Conditional Use Permit | [Sec. 13B.2.2.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) |
            | Class 3 Conditional Use Permit | [Sec. 13B.2.3.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) |
            | Project Adjustment | [Sec. 13B.4.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.4) |
            | Project Exception | [Sec. 13B.4.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5) |
            | Adjustment | [Sec. 13B.5.2.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2) |
            | Variance | [Sec. 13B.5.3.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3) |

         2. ###### Existing Covenant


            The suspension of enforcement activity as a result of the invocation of the provisions of this Paragraph 2. (Automobile Parking Relief) shall not be construed to terminate or void any recorded covenant documenting valet or off-site parking requirements.

         3. ###### Termination


            Whenever the provisions of this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During A Local Emergency) cease to apply, all conditions of approval and associated covenants shall be enforced and, if the conditions were never met, the applicant shall provide verification of compliance with the conditions of approval to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), in accordance with procedures set forth by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#), within 90 days of the termination of the provisions of this Section (Temporary Regulatory Relief During A Local Emergency).

# Article 2. Form

## Part 2A. Introduction

### Div. 2A.1. Orientation

#### Sec. 2A.1.1. Relationship to Zone String

A [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is composed of the following districts:

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=oZJ06cdj)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.1.1.png?itok=nbfgrNMg)

The Form District is a separate and independent component of each zone.

#### Sec. 2A.1.2. How to Use Article 2. (Form)

1. ##### Identify the Applicable Form District


The first component in a [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is the Form District applied to a property.

2. ##### Determine Applicable Form District Standards


1. Form Districts standards are outlined in [Part 2B. (Form Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B). Each Form District page identifies the standards specific to that Form District.

2. Each standard on a Form District page in [Part 2B. (Form Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) provides a reference to [Part 2C. (Form Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C) where the standard is explained in detail. Text in italics below a heading provides a definition of that heading.
       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=RVCcFv-c)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.2.1.png?itok=QKPiizF-)

#### Sec. 2A.1.3. Form District Diagrams

1. ##### General


Diagrams and illustrations within this Article (Form) are provided to assist users in understanding the intent and requirements of the text. In the event a conflict occurs between the text of this Article (Form) and any illustration or graphic, the text prevails.

2. ##### Lot Parameter Diagrams


[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.3.1.png.webp?itok=MlhU6vpj)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.3.1.png?itok=tJ7qmYIt)

1. ###### Lot Boundary


      This line represents the perimeter of the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), serving as a reference for both [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. ###### Buildable Area


      This shape represents the area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) where [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s are allowed, reduced by required [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, or the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) boundary when no setback is required.

3. ###### Building Setbacks


      The area between a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) boundary and the minimum required setback, represented with a dotted white line and bounded by the buildable area.

4. ###### Building Coverage


      This shape represents the total [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allowed in proportion to the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), but does not reflect any requirement as to the location or configuration of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

5. ###### Lot Amenity Space


      This shape represents the total [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) required in proportion to the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), but does not reflect any requirement as to the location or configuration of any amenity space.
3. ##### Bulk and Mass Diagrams


1. ###### General


      1. Bulk and mass diagrams represent the volume where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is allowed to be located by showing the maximum height allowed for the entire buildable area. The volume does not represent the massing of an allowed [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). Other standards, such as maximum [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) ( [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#)), may limit the ability for a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to fill the full volume.

      2. [Form Districts (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) that include a maximum height standard and those that do not include a height limit are represented differently in the bulk and mass diagram.
2. ###### Districts with a Maximum Height Standard


      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.3.3.png.webp?itok=etshXKfs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.3.3.png?itok=NJS-VK-M)

      1. ###### Maximum Bonus Height


         Maximum [bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) represents the maximum number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allowed beyond the number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allowed by the maximum base height in [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      2. ###### Maximum Base Height


         Maximum base height represents the number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allowed without providing public benefits in trade for additional height according to [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9).

      3. ###### Minimum Height


         Minimum height represents the lowest number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) required.
3. ###### Districts with no Maximum Height Standard


      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.3.5.png.webp?itok=hJ2xPbL7)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2A.1.3.5.png?itok=9cnui8cH)

      1. ###### Unlimited Height


         This volume represents the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) height allowed, in addition to the likely height of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) based on maximum Base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      2. ###### Likely Height Based on Bonus FAR


         This volume represents the likely [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) height based on the maximum allowed [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), in addition to the likely height of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) based on maximum base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      3. ###### Likely Height Based on Base FAR


         This volume represents the likely [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) height based on the maximum allowed base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), in addition to the minimum required height of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      4. ###### Minimum Height


         This volume represents the minimum number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) required.

#### Sec. 2A.1.4. Form District Naming Convention

There are three different types of naming conventions for [Form Districts (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B). Each Form District name is composed of a variety of components that are specific to that district.

1. ##### Rural & Estate Form Districts


\[Reserved\]

2. ##### House Form Districts


\[Reserved\]

3. ##### All Other Form Districts


All other Form District names are composed of three components:

1. ###### FAR Category


      The first component of each Form District name is a [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) ( [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#)) category. [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) categories group all districts within a range of maximum allowed [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) categories are organized as follows:

      1. Very Low-Rise (>0.65-1.5 [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#))

      2. Low-Rise (>1.5-4.0 [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#))

      3. Mid-Rise (>4.0-6.0 [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#))

      4. Moderate-Rise (>6.0-8.5 [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#))

      5. High-Rise (>8.5-13.0 [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#))
2. ###### Building Width Category


      The second component of each Form District name is a [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) category. [Building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) categories group all districts within a range of maximum allowed [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). Each [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) category is organized as follows:

      1. Narrow (25 feet - 75 feet)

      2. Medium (100 feet - 210 feet)

      3. Broad (280 feet - 490 feet)

      4. Full (no [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) maximum)
3. ###### Variation Number


      The last component of each Form District is a variation number. All Form Districts are numbered in the order they fall within this Article (Form).

4. ###### Example Form District


      Potential Form District categories are shown below to illustrate the naming convention that would be applied to new Form Districts that may be added to this Article (Form) through future code amendments.

### Div. 2A.2. General Rules

#### Sec. 2A.2.1. Form

This Article (Form) regulates the placement, scale, and intensity of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in order to ensure [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) forms are compatible with their context and promote [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that support community goals.

#### Sec. 2A.2.2. Form Applicability

1. ##### General


All [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s filed after the effective date of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall comply with the Form District standards in this Article (Form), as further specified in the applicability statement of each Section in [Part 2C. (Form Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C). Form District standards only apply to the [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) listed in each Section's applicability statement in [Part 2C. (Form Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C). For vested rights, see [Sec. 1.4.5. (Vested Rights)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.4.5), and for continuance of existing development, see [Sec. 1.4.6. (Continuance of Existing Development)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.4.6).

2. ##### Applicable Components of Lots, Buildings, & Structures


Unless otherwise provided, [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) standards apply to all portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Nonconformities


[Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) may provide relief from the requirements of this Article (Form) for existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, site improvements, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that conformed to the zoning regulations, at the time they were established, but do not conform to current district standards or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) permissions. All [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall conform with [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) standards unless otherwise specified by [Div. 12.2. (Form Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.2).
