## Part 2C. Form Rules

### Div. 2C.1. Lot Size

#### Sec. 2C.1.1. Lot Area

Lot area is defined as the total area within the boundaries of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Lot Area) is to ensure that newly established [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s are consistent in size with surrounding [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


[Lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to any [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). When [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply, they apply to all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s subject to the [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Standards


No [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may have an area less than the minimum specified in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

4. ##### Measurement


1. [Lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is measured as the total area within the boundary of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. [Lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) includes all portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allocated for required [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

3. For measurement on portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) required for land dedication, see [Sec. 14.2.11. (Lot)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.11).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=FCGwTUTj)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.1.1.1.png?itok=nIAwjoke)-
5. ##### Relief


1. A reduction in required [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in required [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 2C.1.2. Lot Width

Lot width is defined as the length of [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s bounding a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Lot Width) is to ensure that newly established [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s are consistent in width with surrounding [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


[Lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to any [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). When [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply, they apply to all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s subject to the [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Standards


1. No [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall have a width less than the minimum specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

2. For the purpose of meeting minimum [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards, multiple [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s may be grouped together as a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) when a [lot tie](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) affidavit is filed and approved by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is measured following the geometry of all [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that bound the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) has two or more [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) different streets, both [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s shall meet the minimum [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standard.

3. For measurement on portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) required for [dedication of land](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 14.2.11. (Lot)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.11).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=hgcPYHlf)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.1.2.1.png?itok=YpkZTju6)
5. ##### Relief


1. A reduction in required [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in required [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 2C.2. Coverage

#### Sec. 2C.2.1. Building Coverage

Building coverage is defined as the percentage of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) covered by [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Building Coverage) is to preserve open area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by limiting the amount of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that may cover a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). When building coverage standards apply, the standards apply to all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Standards


[Covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall not have a cumulative area in excess of the maximum [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B)

4. ##### Measurement


1. [Building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is measured by dividing the cumulative area of the [structure footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s of all [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.1.png.webp?itok=fbM17q_V)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.1.png?itok=TXbAmIHS)

2. [Structure footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s include all [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s but do not include [flatwork](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.3.png.webp?itok=3CIMKPkF)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.3.png?itok=h9ZI3vQ4)

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.5.png.webp?itok=c4jZ2DqB)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.5.png?itok=2u8q-1iU)

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.7.png.webp?itok=X8nSFuMh)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.7.png?itok=seM-Qokd)

3. For [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, see [Sec. 14.2.2.A.1. (Covered)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2).

4. For [structure footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) determination, see [Sec. 14.2.1. (Building Footprint)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.1).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. [Covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s or portions of [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s less than six feet in height, as measured from [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), are not included in the calculation of [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s with two or fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, having a [House Form District (Div. 2B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B.3) applied, a maximum of 400 square feet per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is exempt from the calculation of [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), provided the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is:

      1. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) d for required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#);

      2. Detached from the primary [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by a minimum of 10 feet; and

      3. Located a minimum of 40 feet from a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.9.png.webp?itok=UwmTGZY6)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.1.9.png?itok=zca_73xU)
6. ##### Relief


1. Up to a 20 percent increase to the total allowed area of [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Increased [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 2C.2.2. Building Setbacks

Building setback is defined as the area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) not intended for [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s. Building setbacks include [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) setbacks, side street setbacks, side setbacks, rear setbacks, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) setbacks, and [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) setbacks.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Building Setbacks) is to provide open areas on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and help reduce the impact of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) sidewalks and neighboring development.

2. ##### Applicability


[Building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). When the [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply, the standards apply to all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Standards


All [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be located on or behind a minimum [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), except where allowed in Subsection E. (Exceptions) below.

4. ##### Measurement


All [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s are measured perpendicular to the applicable [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#):

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.2.1.png.webp?itok=7GXE4O-y)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.2.2.1.png?itok=WuFjNG9A)

1. A [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) setback is measured from the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. A side street setback is measured from the [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. A side setback is measured from the [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

4. A rear setback is measured from the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

5. An [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) setback is measured from the [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

6. A special setback is measured from the [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

      1. Where a special setback is specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) as "Special: All", the setback is measured from all [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

      2. Where a special setback is specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) as "Special: River" or "Special: Alley", the setback is measured from the [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) as designated according to [Sec. 14.2.12.C.3. (Special Lot Line)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12).

      3. Where a special setback is specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) as "Special: Other", the setback is measured from all [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that are not otherwise specified.
7. For measurement on portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) required for [dedication of land](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 14.2.11. (Lot)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.11).

8. For measurement on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.1. (Building Setback)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).

6. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from a required setback along a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s a [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or public open space may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1). In addition to the finding otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall also consider:

      1. That the granting of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) will improve a site's connection with the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or public open space.

      2. Where a deviation from a required setback from a special river [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is granted, the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) will improve a site’s connection with the river or will improve river access.
2. A reduction in required setback of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2), provided the resulting setback is at least three feet.

3. A setback reduction may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 2C.3. Amenity

#### Sec. 2C.3.1. Lot Amenity Space

Lot amenity space is defined as an area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) designated to be [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) d for active or passive recreation, including [common outdoor amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), and [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Lot Amenity Space) is to provide adequate recreation and open space areas for all tenants of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), regardless of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), and to ensure such spaces are accessible, usable, and safe.

2. ##### Applicability


[Lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that results in an increase of 20 percent or more [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or to any [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

3. ##### Standards


01. The cumulative area of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provided on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall not be less than that specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

02. Each area provided to meet a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirement shall comply with the standards for one or more of the following eligible amenity space types.



       |     |     |
       | --- | --- |
       | Eligible Amenity Space Types |
       | Amenity Space Type | Eligible |
       | Common Outdoor Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.1.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Pedestrian Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.2.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Public Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Private Outdoor Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | No |
       | Common Indoor Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | No |

03. A maximum of 25 percent of the total required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be privately accessible to individual tenant spaces, provided it meets the design standards in [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.2. (Pedestrian Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3).

04. [Lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) which is privately accessible pursuant to Paragraph 3. above shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and provide [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to the assigned tenant space.

05. All required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that is not private shall be made available to all tenants of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), at no cost, from sunrise to sunset daily or during the hours of operation of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), whichever results in a longer period of time.

06. [Lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provided in accordance with [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3. (Public Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3) may be eligible for credit toward the fee and dedication requirements in [Div. 10.4. (Park Fees & Dedications)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.4), according to [Sec. 10.4.8.B. (Privately Owned Park & Recreational Facilities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.4.8).

07. [Lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) located above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be required to set back from the roof edge, see [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Sec. 57.317. (Rooftop Gardens and Landscaped Roofs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-345545) of this Code.

08. [Mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and [utility equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall not be located within a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or between a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

09. All [mechanical exhaust outlet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s shall be located a minimum horizontal distance of 10 feet and a minimum vertical distance of 15 feet from a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

10. At least 20 percent of any outdoor [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be shaded by using shade trees or shade [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s. Any area that is [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by a shade [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or a shade tree canopy [spread at maturity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be considered as being shaded.
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is a percentage calculated by dividing the cumulative area of all [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s by the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. The minimum required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is calculated by multiplying the minimum lot amenity percentage specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) by the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. As a bonus for providing public space, outdoor amenity space area meeting [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3. (Public Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3) counts as 1.25 square feet of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) for every one square foot of provided outdoor amenity space area.

4. Shade is calculated as the shadow cast on the [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) open space measured at noon (12:00 p.m.) on the summer solstice.

5. For calculation of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.2. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. Where the calculation of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requires less than 400 square feet, no [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is required.

2. When a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) involves an [air space lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), the [air space lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) area is not used in the calculation for required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. Where the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) identifies an eligible lot amenity alternative, in lieu of the otherwise required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in this Section (Lot Amenity Space), a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may provide a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meeting the requirements established for that listed lot amenity alternative type, as provided in [Sec. 2C.3.5. (Lot Amenity Alternatives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.5).

4. Where the applied Form District (Part 2B.) identifies an eligible lot amenity alternative, in lieu of the otherwise required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in this Section (Lot Amenity Space), a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may provide a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meeting the requirements established for that listed lot amenity alternative type, as provided in [Sec. 2C.3.5. (Lot Amenity Alternatives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.5).
6. ##### Relief


1. Up to a 10 percent reduction to the total required area of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 2C.3.2. Residential Amenity Space

Residential amenity space is defined as an area which is designed and intended to be used by occupants of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s for recreational, domestic, or vocational purposes.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Residential Amenity Space) is to ensure [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that include housing provide [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) tenants of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) with adequate [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to open space, recreation, and shared amenities where the [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is insufficient, and to ensure such spaces are accessible, usable, and safe.

2. ##### Applicability


[Residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that includes five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and involves any of the following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#): [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Standards


01. The cumulative area of [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provided on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall not be less than that specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

02. Each area provided to meet a [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirement shall comply with the standards for one or more of the following eligible amenity space types.



       |     |     |
       | --- | --- |
       | Eligible Amenity Space Types |
       | Amenity Space Type | Eligible |
       | Common Outdoor Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.1.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Pedestrian Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.2.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Public Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Private Outdoor Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |
       | Common Indoor Amenity Space ( [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3)) | Yes |

03. At least 75 percent of the required [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be outdoors and meet the design standards of either [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.1. (Common Outdoor Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3) or [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.4. (Private Outdoor Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3).

04. A maximum of 65 square feet of required [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be private, provided that not more than 50 percent of the total required [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is private, and the private [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meets the design standards in [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.4. (Private Outdoor Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3).

05. Private [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and provide [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to the assigned tenant space.

       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.2.1.png.webp?itok=PGXUEGU4)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.2.1.png?itok=mqZfwQL_)

06. All required [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that is not private shall be made available to all tenants of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), at no cost, from sunrise to sunset daily or during the hours of operation of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), whichever results in a longer period of time.

07. [Residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provided in accordance with [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3. (Public Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3) may be eligible for credit towards the fee and dedication requirements outlined in [Div. 10.4. (Park Fees & Dedications)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.4), according to [Sec. 10.4.8.B. (Privately Owned Park & Recreational Facilities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.4.8).

08. [Residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) located above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be required to set back from the roof edge, see [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Sec. 57.317. (Rooftop Gardens and Landscaped Roofs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-345545) of this Code.

09. [Mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and [utility equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall not be located within a [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or between a [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

10. All [mechanical exhaust outlet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s shall be located a minimum horizontal distance of 10 feet and a minimum vertical distance of 15 feet from a [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

11. At least 20 percent of any outdoor [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be shaded by shade trees or shade [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is a percentage calculated by dividing the cumulative area of all [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s by the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allocated to [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

2. The minimum required [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is calculated by multiplying the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allocated to [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s by the minimum percentage specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

3. All [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provided may be credited toward the [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirement.

4. As a bonus for providing public space, [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meeting [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3. (Public Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3) counts at a rate of 1.25 square feet for every one square foot of [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provided.

5. Any area that is [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by a shade [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or a shade tree canopy (as measured by [spread at maturity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#)) shall be considered as being shaded.
5. ##### Relief


1. Up to a 10 percent reduction to the total required area of [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in required [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 2C.3.3. Amenity Space Types

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Amenity Space Types) is to ensure that amenity spaces provided by [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s are sufficient enough to provide spaces which are accessible, usable, and safe, and provide adequate [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to open space, recreation, and shared amenities.

2. ##### Applicability


Amenity space types are established in [Sec. 2C.3.1. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1) and [Sec. 2C.3.2. (Residential Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.2).

3. ##### Standards


The following standards apply by type of amenity space.

1. ###### Common Outdoor Amenity Space

      Public amenity space is defined as a type of amenity space that is outdoors and, although privately owned, is open to the public, and meets the following standards:



      |     |     |     |

      | Public Amenity Space |

      2. For an amenity space type to be considered above [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), it shall be located on a [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that is above the first [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. A deviation from any amenity space standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 2C.3.4. Amenity Design Standards

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Amenity Design Standards) is to ensure that amenity spaces provide sufficient recreational area in a manner that is visually interesting, connects the development to its users or the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), promotes environmental sensitivity, and creates opportunities for the congregation of individuals at the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or upper-stories of a development.

2. ##### Applicability


Amenity space design standards are determined by the amenity space types in [Sec. 2C.3.1. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1) and [Sec. 2C.3.2. (Residential Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.2), and as established by [Sec. 2C.3.3. (Amenity Space Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3).

3. ##### Standards


01. ###### Outdoor Space


       1. Where the amenity space is [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), it shall not be [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). Where the amenity space is [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), it shall not be [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

       2. No portion of an outdoor space may have a [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of less than seven feet.

       3. Portions of an outdoor space that are [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall have a minimum [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of 1.5 times the depth of the [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.4.2.png.webp?itok=TnTKcK9Q)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.4.2.png?itok=6QaeTKU-)

       4. The following [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s are exempt from the outdoor space standards above, provided all exempted [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s have a cumulative area no greater than 20 percent of the contiguous amenity space area.

          1. [Unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s having a [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of at least seven feet; and

          2. An [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), providing goods or services to tenants of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or the public, having an area of no more than 25 square feet.

             [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.4.3.png.webp?itok=pbP6SX59)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.4.3.png?itok=-7MWo6O7)
02. ###### Amenity Area


       Each amenity space shall provide an area of no less than the minimum amenity area required by the amenity space type.

03. ###### Horizontal Dimension


       Each amenity space shall have the minimum horizontal dimension set by the amenity space type.

04. ###### Adjacent Building Transparency


       [Building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to the amenity space shall provide at least the minimum transparency percentage required by the amenity space type for each [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.4.5.png.webp?itok=9xymjTx_)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/2C.3.4.5.png?itok=tZT3mOmT)

05. ###### Planting Area


       1. When an amenity space type satisfies its minimum [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirement at the [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), the amenity space shall meet all other standards of the amenity space type within the minimum and maximum [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) as specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B). For other applicable standards, see [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

       2. An amenity space shall provide at least the required minimum percentage of the total area of the amenity space as [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).
06. ###### Seating


       1. Permanent or movable seats shall be provided at the specified ratio based on the area in square feet of amenity space.

       2. Each permanent or movable seat provided within the amenity space shall count as one.

       3. Two linear feet of bench or seat wall provided within the amenity space shall be counted as one seat.
07. ###### Ground Floor Elevation


       1. The finished floor or ground surface of the amenity space shall be located within the minimum and maximum [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

       2. For measurement of [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 3C.6.2. (Ground Floor Elevation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.6.2).
08. ###### Public Sidewalk/Way Adjacent


       1. The amenity space shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) for a minimum width of 15 feet.

       2. A [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) having a minimum width of four feet shall connect the amenity space to the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). No fixed [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall separate the amenity space from the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) for the minimum [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) width.

       3. The space shall not be separated from the [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by any [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or landscaping, with the exception of a Type A1 or Type A2 frontage yard fence & wall type as specified in [Sec. 3C.3.2. (Frontage Yard Fence & Wall)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.2).
09. ###### Pedestrian-Oriented Lighting


       The amenity space shall comply with the requirements of [Sec. 4C.10.1.C.3. (Pedestrian-Oriented Lighting)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).

10. ###### Publicly Accessible


       1. The amenity space shall be made permanently available to the general public, at no cost, at minimum between sunrise and sunset daily.

       2. Signs shall be posted at every public entrance to the amenity space in accordance with the [Public Amenity Space Sign Standards](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/3b3df482-ec19-458d-ada0-2bc8280dc9c8/public_amenity_space_sign_standards.pdf) as established by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), and in accordance with [Div. 4C.11. (Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11). Standards include, but are not limited to, the following:

          1. Minimum sign dimension, no less than 16 inches by 20 inches;

          2. Sign location requirements;

          3. Required posting of the hours of operation; and

          4. Mandatory language regarding public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).
11. ###### Amenity Features


       1. The amenity space shall provide at least the minimum number of amenity features required by the amenity space type by providing from the list of options in the [Amenity Features Menu](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/655d5032-b8cd-4461-933b-7b18d79e93ad/amenity_feature_menu.pdf) as established by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), and shall be made permanently available to the tenants of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

       2. The location and number of amenity features shall be identified on the proposed plans submitted to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), with the accompanying dimensions called out as required by the selected options.
4. ##### Measurement


1. Minimum amenity area is measured as an area in square feet calculated for each contiguous amenity space located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). The area of the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is not included in the total minimum amenity area.

2. The horizontal dimension shall be measured as the shortest horizontal distance along the boundaries of the amenity space, perpendicular to any boundary of the amenity space.

3. For measurement of transparency, see [Div. 3C.4. (Transparency)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4).

4. For measurement of [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 3C.6.2. (Ground Floor Elevation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.6.2).

5. The minimum width an amenity space is required to [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be measured following the geometry of the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) the applicable [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

6. The minimum [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) width shall be measured along the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) the applicable [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) from one edge of the accessway perpendicularly to the opposite edge.

7. For measurement of pedestrian-oriented lighting, see [Sec. 4C.10.1.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).
5. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from any amenity design dimensional standard of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A deviation from any amenity design standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 2C.3.5. Lot Amenity Alternatives

Lot amenity alternatives are defined as space types with a predetermined set of design standards that may be used as an allowable alternative to the standard [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirements of a [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Lot Amenity Alternatives) is to provide alternative options for the design of spaces for recreation and open space for the tenants of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). [Lot amenity alternatives](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) establish design criteria for common and desirable open space typologies that both incentivize certain kinds of open spaces and potentially improve the feasibility of achieving required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) on constrained [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s, while maintaining high-quality and contextually appropriate design.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Lot amenity alternatives](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s with a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirement, as established in [Sec. 2C.3.1. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) with an applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) that lists one or more eligible lot amenity alternative types.

2. [Lot amenity alternatives](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) are optional alternatives to the [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirements in [Sec. 2C.3.1. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1), except [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s utilizing the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program in [Sec. 9.2.4. (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4) shall utilize a Lot Amenity Alternative Type.
3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      1. Where the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) lists one or more lot amenity alternative types, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may provide a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) that meets the standards established in Paragraph 2. (Lot Amenity Alternative Types), below for any one of the lot amenity alternative types listed in the [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

      2. The provided lot amenity alternative shall be considered to meet the [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirement for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), even if providing an eligible lot amenity alternative type results in providing less total [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) than would otherwise be required pursuant to [Sec. 2C.3.1. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1).

      3. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s providing a lot amenity alternative are still subject to any required [Residential Amenity Space (Sec. 2C.3.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.2).
2. ###### Lot Amenity Alternative Types


      1. Courtyard

         1. Width

            The width of the courtyard shall be a minimum of 30 percent of the [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or a minimum of 15 feet, whichever is greater, measured parallel to the applicable [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

         2. Depth

            The depth of the courtyard shall be a minimum of 40 percent of the lot depth, measured perpendicular to the applicable [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#)

         3. Outdoor Space

            The entirety of the courtyard space shall meet the requirements of [Sec. 2C.3.4.C.1. (Outdoor Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.4).

         4. Location

            The courtyard shall be placed in one of the following locations on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#):

            1. [Abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) the front yard on a lot, so as to create a courtyard that extends backward into the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) starting from the [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or a courtyard that connects the [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to another outdoor space meeting the standards of [Sec. 4C.3.4.C.1. (Outdoor Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3.4) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

            2. An internal courtyard, surrounded on all sides by [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and contained entirely within a single [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

            3. [Abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) an [at-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) on an abutting lot, so as to create the effect of one large open space across multiple [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.
      2. Paseo

         1. Width

            The width of the paseo shall be a minimum of 10 percent of the [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or a minimum of 10 feet, whichever is greater, measured parallel to the applicable primary street lot line.

         2. Depth

            The depth shall be a minimum of 60 percent of the lot depth, measured perpendicular to the applicable [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

         3. Covered Area

            The entirety of the paseo space shall meet the requirements of [Sec. 2C.3.4.C.1. (Outdoor Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.4).

         4. Pedestrian Pathway

            An unobstructed pathway with [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall be provided with a minimum width of four feet along the entire depth of the paseo space.

         5. Location

            The paseo space shall be located between one or more [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).
      3. Rear Yard

         1. Width

            The width of the rear yard shall be a minimum of 50 percent of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) width, measured parallel to the applicable [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#)

         2. Depth

            The depth shall be a minimum of 10 percent of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) depth, or a minimum of 15 feet, whichever is greater, measured perpendicular to the applicable [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

         3. Covered Area

            The entirety of the rear yard space shall meet the requirements of [Sec. 2C.3.4.C.1. (Outdoor Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.4), with the exception of portions of the rear yard space located within the required rear setback, which shall be open to the sky except for the encroachments allowed pursuant to Subsection E. (Exceptions) of [Sec. 2C.2.2. (Building Setbacks)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2).

         4. Location

            The rear yard shall be located [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) the rear lot line.
4. ##### Measurement


1. General

      A lot amenity alternative is measured as provided or not provided based on whether the design of a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meets the standards of an eligible lot amenity alternative type specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

2. Width

      The width of a lot amenity alternative type shall be measured parallel to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and the minimum width shall be maintained along the entire required depth of the space.

3. Depth

      The depth of a lot amenity alternative type shall be measured perpendicular to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) and the minimum depth shall be maintained along the entire required width of the space.

4. Covered Area

      For the measurement of an [uncovered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) space, see [Sec. 14.2.2. (Covered Area (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2).
5. ##### Relief


No relief from the design standards established in Paragraph 2. (Lot Amenity Alternative Types) of Subsection C. (Standards), above, shall be permitted. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s may instead defer to the standard [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) requirements, pursuant to [Sec. 2C.3.1. (Lot Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1), including any relief allowed pursuant to that Section.

### Div. 2C.4. Floor Area Ratio & Height

#### Sec. 2C.4.1. Floor Area Ratio (FAR)

Floor area ratio or FAR is defined as the measurement of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in relation to the size of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Floor Area Ratio (FAR)) is to regulate the bulk and massing of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). When the [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply, they apply to all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Base


      A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall not exceed the maximum base [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) without meeting the requirements of [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9), or an applicable Specific Plan, Supplemental District, or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. ###### Tier 1 Bonus


      1. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may exceed the base [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) up to the maximum [tier 1 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) as allowed in [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3) if the participating [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provides the required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

      2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s participating in incentive programs intended to implement State law, including the [State Density Bonus Program (Sec. 9.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), the [Corridor Transitions Incentive Program (Sec 9.2.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4), [Transit Oriented Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), the [Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.4.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.1), or the [Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program (Div. 9.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), may exceed the maximum [tier 1 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).
3. ###### Tier 2 Bonus


      1. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may exceed the base [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) up to the maximum [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) as allowed in [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3), or an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), if the participating [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provides the required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and additional public benefits.

      2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s participating in incentive programs intended to implement State law, including the [State Density Bonus Program (Sec. 9.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Corridor Transitions Incentive Program (Sec 9.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), [Transit Oriented Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4), the [Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.4.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.1), or the [Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program (Div. 9.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), may exceed the maximum [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).
4. ##### Measurement


1. [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is calculated by dividing the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) by the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).

2. For the measurement of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

3. For the purpose of calculating [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) designated for [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s may be counted as [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#). For the measurement of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), see [Sec. 2C.1.1. (Lot Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.1.1).

4. For the purpose of calculating [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is the same as buildable area referred to in the [City of Los Angeles Charter, Article I. (Incorporation and Powers), Sec. 104. (e) (Floor Area Restriction)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-103#JD_Ch104.).

5. The [Downtown Community Plan Implementation Overlay](https://planning.lacity.gov/plans-policies/overlays/downtown-cpio) may define and measure buildable area differently than outlined in Paragraph 4. above for the purpose of calculating the maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) using [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#).
5. ##### Exceptions


For existing [nonconforming building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) exceptions, see [Sec. 12.2.2. (Floor Area Ratio & Height Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.2.2).

6. ##### Relief


1. Additional [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

2. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s that include multiple [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s having different applied [Form Districts (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) averaging across the development site may be granted, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

      1. ###### Supplemental Findings


         In addition to the findings in [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) shall also find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meets the following conditions:

         1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) meets the definition of [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#),

         2. All [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s included in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) have a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use District (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) applied, or the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is located entirely in the [Downtown Community Plan Area](https://planning.lacity.gov/plans-policies/community-plan-area/downtown-community-plan) and all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s included in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) have a [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use District (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) applied.

         3. The total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of all [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s on an individual [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) may only exceed the [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) allowed pursuant to the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) if the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) across all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s in the [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) does not exceed the sum of the maximum [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) calculated based on the maximum [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) specified by each applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).
      2. ###### Supplemental Procedures


         If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) approves [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) averaging, then prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s the property owner shall file with the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) a covenant running with the land that specifies the following:

         1. The operation and maintenance of the development as a [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is continued into perpetuity;

         2. The [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) used and the remaining unbuilt [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), if any, is allocated to each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#);

         3. The unifying design elements are maintained and continued into perpetuity;

         4. The covenant is binding on all assigns and successors in interest; and

         5. An individual or entity is specified to be responsible and accountable for compliance and the fee for the annual inspection of compliance by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), required pursuant to [Sec. 15.3.12. (Annual Inspection of FAR Averaging & Density Transfer Covenants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.12).

#### Sec. 2C.4.2. Height in Feet

Height in feet is defined as the vertical dimension of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) measured in feet.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Height In Feet) is to provide adequate light, air, safety, and to protect the character of an area and the interests of the general public.

2. ##### Applicability


[Height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standards apply to all [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) where the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) specifies a maximum [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) standard.

3. ##### Standards


1. Buildings and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s shall not exceed the base maximum [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) without meeting [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3), or an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#)

2. ###### Tier 1 Bonus


      1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s may exceed the base maximum [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) up to the tier 1 [bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) as allowed in [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3), if the participating project provides the required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s.

      2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s participating in incentive programs intended to implement State law, including the [State Density Bonus Program (Sec. 9.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), the [Corridor Transitions Incentive Program (Sec 9.2.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4), [Transit Oriented Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), the [Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.4.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.1), or the [Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program (Div. 9.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), may exceed the maximum [tier 1 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).
3. ###### Tier 2 Bonus


      1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s may exceed the maximum [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) up to the maximum [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) if allowed pursuant to [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3), or an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), if the participating [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) provides the required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s and additional public benefits.

      2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s participating in incentive programs intended to implement State law, including the [State Density Bonus Program (Sec. 9.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), the [Corridor Transitions Incentive Program (Sec 9.2.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4), [Transit Oriented Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5)), the [Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.4.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.1), or the [Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program (Div. 9.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), may exceed the maximum [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).
4. ##### Measurement


1. Maximum [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) is measured as the vertical distance from [grade plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) to the top of the roof structure. One or more [grade plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) [module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#) s may be established for each [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#), as shown below.
