## Part 3C. General Frontage Rules

### Div. 3C.1. Build-To

#### Sec. 3C.1.1. Applicable Stories

Applicable stories is defined as the number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that are required to meet build-to standards.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Applicable Stories) is to ensure that ground stories of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, and upper stories where appropriate, are located in a consistent manner along the street.

2. ##### Applicability


[Applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of any portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), or a whole [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When the [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the standards apply to any part of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that is required to meet the standards of [Sec. 3C.1.2. (Build-To Depth)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.2) and the standards of [Sec. 3C.1.3. (Build-To Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.3).

3. ##### Standards


Where minimum [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) are required, build-to standards apply to the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and any additional [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) provided on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), up to, and including, the minimum build-to [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=w2YnYwuL)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.1.1.png?itok=q8fI2o-b)

4. ##### Measurement


For measuring [height in stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 2C.4.3. (Height in Stories)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.3).

5. ##### Relief


1. A reduction of one [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from the number of [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in number of [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.1.2. Build-To Depth

Build-to depth is defined as the depth of the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) starting at the minimum [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and continuing inward for the maximum [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for the full width of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Build-To-Depth) is to regulate [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s along the public realm and to create a consistent [street wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, they apply to all portions of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s required to satisfy the standards of [Sec. 3C.1.3. (Build-To Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.3) and the standards of [Sec. 3C.1.1. (Applicable Stories)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.1).

3. ##### Standards


1. The [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be no deeper than the maximum [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall occupy the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for at least the minimum required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

3. Once the minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard has been satisfied, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may occupy the area behind the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

4. On a corner [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) where intersecting [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s have build-to requirements, a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall occupy the portion of the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) where the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s of the two intersecting [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s overlap, as described below:

      1. The [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall occupy the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s for both [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s for a minimum of 30 feet from the corner. This [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) counts toward the required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for both [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s.

      2. This standard does not apply when a [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) occupies some portion of the [area of overlap](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and is being used as a [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). See [Sec. 3C.1.4. (Pedestrian Amenity Allowance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.4).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=6HG7TM30)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.2.1.png?itok=IaO1Tss3)
4. ##### Measurement


1. The [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured perpendicular to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) starting from the minimum [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and continuing inward away from the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) includes an [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is deeper than the minimum [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), the applicant may choose to measure the required [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from the interior edge of the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) rather than the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.2.3.png.webp?itok=e1nl6t5B)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.2.3.png?itok=fH24_H0S)

3. For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.3. (Build-To Depth)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. See [Sec. 3C.1.4. (Pedestrian Amenity Allowance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.4).

2. To preserve existing trees that meet minimum size requirements for a [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may increase the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) beyond the maximum allowed by the applied Frontage District to the minimum depth necessary to protect the tree, but by no more than 30 feet pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

3. See [Sec. 12.3.1. (Build-To Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.3.1).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.2.5.png.webp?itok=U3uSYJqR)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.2.5.png?itok=YFeKip3e)
6. ##### Relief


1. An increase in [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of 20 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A deviation from maximum [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.1.3. Build-To Width

Build-to width is defined as the cumulative [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that shall occupy the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), relative to the width of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) at the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Build-To-Width) is to ensure that [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s enclose the public realm with a legible and consistent [street wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), spatially defining an outdoor room, and to promote a strong visual and physical connection between [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s inside [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


[Build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and are subject to the following:

1. Where a minimum height is specified in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to all [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) stories up to the minimum [height in stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard in accordance with [Sec. 2C.4.3. (Height in Stories)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.3). [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.2.png.webp?itok=wDDLvk-S)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.2.png?itok=5G8Huik_)

2. Where an [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard exists, [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to all stories located [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to the [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.4.png.webp?itok=nO7FcNJC)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.4.png?itok=alNNZ2vl)

3. Where both an [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard and a minimum height standard are specified, [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to whichever standard requires the greatest number of stories located in the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

4. Where no [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard is specified in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) and no minimum height standard is specified in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply only to the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
3. ##### Standards


1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#)(s) shall occupy the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for a cumulative width no less than that specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. On a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [chamfered corner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) no more than 20 feet in width along both [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s qualifies as [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for all [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) even where it extends outside of the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). [Chamfered corner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width is measured parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.5.png.webp?itok=Uo4kXNpp)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.5.png?itok=Sh2fNr1p)

3. Portions of [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) providing [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to a [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) through the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) do not qualify as [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.7.png.webp?itok=qVv06ev0)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.7.png?itok=QxC-eQC2)
4. ##### Measurement


The [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is a percentage measured as the sum of the widths of all portions of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s occupying the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by the total [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.9.png.webp?itok=oDMuxveZ)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.9.png?itok=YSYFRHOj)

1. [Building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). For measuring [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with a curved or irregular [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot Lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).

2. [Lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured along the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). For measuring width of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with a curved or irregular [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot Lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. [Pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) counts toward required minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in accordance with [Sec.3C.1.4. (Pedestrian Amenity Allowance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.4).

2. A [building break](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that includes an open space meeting the design standards for [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.2. (Pedestrian Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3) counts toward the minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) according to [Sec. 3C.1.4. (Pedestrian Amenity Allowance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.4).

3. Where [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is taken through the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) based on the [automobile access package](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in [Sec. 4C.2.1. (Automobile Access Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.1) as specified by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), and providing vehicle access prevents a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from achieving the required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a reduced [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be allowed. However, the portion of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) used for vehicle access shall be no wider than the minimum required [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width plus an additional four feet of width for clearance. See [Div. 4C.2. (Automobile Access)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2).

4. See [Sec. 12.3.1. (Build-To Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.3.1).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.11.png.webp?itok=2uYIvA7R)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.3.11.png?itok=Mi2sa5JW)
6. ##### Relief


1. Up to a 10 percent reduction to the total required width of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) occupying the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduced minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.1.4. Pedestrian Amenity Allowance

Pedestrian amenity allowance is defined as the width of [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that can be counted toward the [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) requirement.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Pedestrian Amenity Allowance) is to promote the creation of active, human-scale outdoor spaces as an extension of the sidewalk, providing visual interest and vitality to the amenity space as well as the public realm. The [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) provides flexibility to [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and site design while maintaining standards essential for ensuring all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s contribute to defining a consistent and legible [street wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) subject to a [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) maximum in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      1. [Pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to all portions of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) required to meet the standards of [Sec. 3C.1.3. (Build-To Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.3) and [Sec. 14.2.6.C. (Pedestrian Amenity & Public Amenity-Facing Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.6), and portions of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) between the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for the width of the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) provided.
3. ##### Standards


Where the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) specifies a [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may be provided as a substitute for a portion of the required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to the maximum percentage specified, provided they meet the following standards:

1. Meets the standards of [Sec. 2C.3.3.C. (Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3).

2. [Pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may be wider than the maximum allowed [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), however, any part of the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width that exceeds the allowed [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) does not count toward the required [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

3. At least 85 percent of the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) perimeter shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards of the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) as specified for the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). Where the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s multiple [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, the standards specified for the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for the greatest length apply.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.4.1.png.webp?itok=_3m8NZs6)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.4.1.png?itok=tKuTupti)
4. ##### Measurement


[Pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the cumulative width of [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s occupying the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by the required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.4.3.png.webp?itok=saQ9hOC7)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.1.4.3.png?itok=EZZ3GvWL)

1. [Pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width is measured parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). For measuring [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width along a curved or irregular [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot Lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).

2. For measuring the required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 3C.1.3. (Build-To Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.3).

3. For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.4. (Pedestrian Amenity Allowance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
5. ##### Relief


1. Up to a 10 percent increase in the allowed total width of [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A deviation from any [pedestrian amenity allowance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) dimensional standard of up to 10 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A reduced minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3C.2. Parking

#### Sec. 3C.2.1. Parking Setback

Parking setback is defined as an area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) where [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are prohibited, including [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, side street [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, and [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Parking Setback) is to minimize the impact of [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) dominated areas on the public realm and to promote a comfortable, safe, engaging, and attractive streetscape with active uses and landscaping along the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


[Parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the standards apply to any areas of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) designed and designated for a [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

3. ##### Standards


All applicable areas designated for [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be located at or behind the required [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) unless specifically stated as an exception in Subsection E. (Exceptions) below.

4. ##### Measurement


All [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are measured perpendicular to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. A [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured from the minimum [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) setback and continues inward away from the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. A side street [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured from the minimum side street setback and continues inward away from the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

3. A special [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured from the minimum setback associated with a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and continues inward away from the [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.2.1.1.png.webp?itok=fAKsp0n0)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.2.1.1.png?itok=XuqNNyzI)

4. For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.5. (Parking Setback)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
5. ##### Exceptions


A [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may provide access through a [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) if:

1. The [automobile access package](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) allows automobile access through the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) associated with a [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), then a [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be permitted in the [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), and

2. The [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is no wider than the minimum required width. See [Div. 4C.2. (Automobile Access)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2).
6. ##### Relief


1. A reduction in the required [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to 20 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in the required [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3C.3. Landscaping

#### Sec. 3C.3.1. Frontage Planting Area

Frontage planting area is defined as the area in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) designated and designed for plants.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Frontage Planting Area) is to support a comfortable, attractive, and contextually appropriate streetscape along the public realm, while promoting infiltration, slowing stormwater runoff, and offsetting urban heat island effect.

2. ##### Applicability


[Frontage planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) possessing [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

3. ##### Standards


1. Each [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall provide a cumulative area at least the size of the [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B)

2. All required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall meet [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

3. All provided plants shall meet [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Frontage planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is a percentage calculated as the cumulative [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by the total [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) area.

2. For [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) designation, see [Sec. 14.2.16. (Yards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.16).

3. For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.6.(Frontage Planting Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
5. ##### Exceptions


Where there is less than three feet between the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards are not applicable.

6. ##### Relief


1. [Frontage planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. Up to a 20 percent reduction to the total required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A reduction in the required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.3.2. Frontage Yard Fence & Wall

Frontage yard fence & wall is defined as [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, and hedges that are allowed in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Frontage Yard Fence & Wall) is to balance the needs for human-scale activation and visual interest along the public realm, and to provide security and privacy for private [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s in a manner appropriate to context.

2. ##### Applicability


Frontage yard fence & wall standards apply to a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) involving construction or installation of [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, or hedges, in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      1. Allowed frontage yard fence & wall types are hierarchical. Where a frontage yard fence & wall type with a higher number designator (e.g. Type A2) is allowed by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B), all frontage yard fence & wall types having a lower number designator (e.g. Type A1) are also allowed.

      2. No frontage yard fence & wall type with a greater number designator (e.g. Type A4) than the allowed frontage yard fence & wall type (e.g. Type A3) may be located in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      3. If a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) includes a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), then the required [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be located in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) if the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) complies with the allowed frontage yard fence & wall standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      4. All [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s including their sub-grade elements, such as footings or foundation, shall be located on-site.

      5. All [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s provided shall include the necessary gates or openings to comply with the applicable [pedestrian access package](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards in [Sec. 4C.1.1. (Pedestrian Access Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.1.1).

      6. Pools, ponds, and other bodies of water requiring [protective barrier](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s according to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.6109. (Swimming Pools and Other Bodies of Water - Protective Devices Required)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-176594) of this Code, are only allowed in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) where the required [protective barrier](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) can be designed to conform with the frontage yard fence & wall standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      7. All [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s provided shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).

      8. All hedges provided shall comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      9. [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s provided within the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall not include barbed wire or concertina.
2. ###### Frontage Yard Fence & Wall Types


      A package of standards, specified by the applied Frontage District (Part 3B), that applies to [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, and hedges located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

4. ##### Measurement


1. ###### Frontage Yard


      For [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) designations and their measurement see [Sec. 14.2.16. (Yards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.16).

2. ###### Fence & Wall Height


      1. Where a public sidewalk is located within five feet of a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), height is measured vertically from the topmost point of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.3.2.11.png.webp?itok=oSDkZyoX)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.3.2.11.png?itok=ZuzlXPT1)

      2. Where no sidewalk exists within five feet of a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), height is measured vertically from the topmost point of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) at the base of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) on the side that [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) outward from the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      3. To measure [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s see [Sec. 4C.9.2. (Retaining Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.9.2).

      4. Fence/wall height maximums listed as "Prohibited" allow no [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
3. ###### Hedge Height


      1. Hedge height is measured according to [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.11. (Height at Maturity)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      2. Hedge height maximums listed as "Prohibited" allow no hedge within the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
4. ###### Opacity


      To measure [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).

5. ###### Public Access Easement


      For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.7. (Frontage Yard Fence & Wall)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
5. ##### Exceptions


[Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may integrate outdoor lighting, entry arbors, and other accessory encroaching elements that exceed the maximum fence/wall height specified by the applicable frontage yard fence & wall type, provided all of the following are met:

1. The cumulative length of [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that includes encroaching elements is no more than 10 percent of the total [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) length located in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#),

2. No individual encroaching element may be wider than six feet, measured along the length of the [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#),

3. One encroaching element for each 40 feet of [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) length may exceed the maximum [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height by up to 40 inches. All other encroaching elements shall only exceed the maximum [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height up to 18 inches.
6. ##### Relief


1. A deviation up to 15 percent from any allowed frontage yard fence & wall type dimensional standard may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A deviation from any allowed frontage yard fence & wall type standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3C.4. Transparency

#### Sec. 3C.4.1. Transparent Area

Transparent area is defined as the amount of transparent area on a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Transparent Area) is to provide visual interest along the public realm by encouraging visual connections between the public realm and the [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to the following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when " [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#)" is required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B): [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), and an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the standards apply pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2) and [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.4. (Frontage Applicable Building Depth)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


1. Each applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall provide at least the minimum transparency specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. [Window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and door openings meeting the following requirements count toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#):

      1. No [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, shelving, facade screens, or other interior or exterior [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be located within five feet of any [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with the exception of [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s allowed in subparagraph d below.

      2. Exterior [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall not be located within five feet of any [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with the exception of [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s allowed in subparagraph d below.

      3. [Visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may be located five feet or greater from a [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) counting toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.1.png.webp?itok=aamG0zxH)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.1.png?itok=GlbgdG2L)
      4. The following [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may be located less than five feet from [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) counting toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#):

         1. [Window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s obscured by [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) security gates and [window display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may count toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), provided no more than 25 percent of the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of any individual [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is visually obstructed for any individual [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) counting toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). For measuring [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).
             [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.3.png.webp?itok=wNTFp1_B)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.3.png?itok=P0h9bh2d)
         2. [Window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s obscured by fixed exterior [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) screens may count toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), provided no more than 25 percent of the total [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is visually obstructed for any individual [window opening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) counting toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). Percentage of [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         3. [Transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) covered by [window sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s may count toward [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) provided the [window sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are permitted by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

         4. Areas of transparency may be made temporarily opaque by operable window treatments, such as curtains or blinds.
      5. Distance from [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured perpendicular to the [exterior face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      6. To be considered transparent, [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and door glazing shall meet the following requirements:



         |     |     |     |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Transparent Area Standards |
         |  | Visible Light <br>Transmittance | External <br>Reflectance |
         | Ground story | More than 60% | Less than 20% |
         | Upper stories | More than 30% | Less than 40% |

      7. Muntins, mullions, [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) sashes, [window frame](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, and door frames, no more than three inches wide may be considered [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when contained within a [window opening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or door opening occupied by a [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or glazed door assembly where all included glazing meets the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) requirements above.
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.5.png.webp?itok=nt-OCwTB)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.5.png?itok=mRFt8III)
4. ##### Measurement


1. ###### Ground Story


      1. [Ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) transparency is a percentage, calculated as the sum of all [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards for [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by the total [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      2. In calculating [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) transparency, [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured in the following ways:

         1. [Ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) between zero and 12 feet above the top of the finished floor of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.7.png.webp?itok=W52-Od7p)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.7.png?itok=9Jql0XnT)

         2. If the [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is less than 12 feet, the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the total [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) portion of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) between the top of the finished floor of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and the top of the finished floor above. When there is no [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above, [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured to the top of the uppermost surface of the ceiling structure above.

         3. No portion of a [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located below [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is included in [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.9.png.webp?itok=kAxza627)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.9.png?itok=Pujsnyrm)
2. ###### Upper Stories


      1. The [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along each [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the required transparency standard. .

      2. [Upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) transparency is a percentage, calculated as the sum of all [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards for [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by the total [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for each [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      3. In calculating [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) transparency, the [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the portion of a [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) between the top of the finished floor for that [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the top of the finished floor above, regardless of [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height. When there is no [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above, it is measured to the top of the uppermost surface of the ceiling structure above.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.11.png.webp?itok=JKgmkz6R)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.1.11.png?itok=q4BO-fCS)
5. ##### Exceptions


[Transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards do not apply to portions of [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that enclose a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) except where [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are required to be wrapped by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

6. ##### Relief


1. Up to a 10 percent reduction from the total required [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A deviation from required [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.4.2. Active Wall Spacing

Active wall spacing is defined as the horizontal distance between widths of [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or door openings.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Active Wall Spacing) is to provide visual interest and activation along the public realm by limiting areas without visual or physical connections between the public realm and the [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. [Active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to the following [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s:

      1. All portions of [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2) located between three feet and eight feet from the [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) measured vertically.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.1.png.webp?itok=d5y5Vc26)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.1.png?itok=ble6H5NG)

      2. All portions of [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2) that are exposed four feet in height or greater above [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). If [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are set back more than 10 feet from a sidewalk, exposed height is measured from the lowest [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within five feet, measured from and perpendicular to the [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.3.png.webp?itok=WCMkd9ky)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.3.png?itok=dNm2ab0p)
3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Active Wall Spacing on Ground Story Facade


      [Window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and door openings meeting [Sec. 3C.4.1. (Transparent Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4.1) on [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be separated by a distance no greater than the maximum [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). For exceptions to this standard, see Subsection E. (Exceptions) below.

2. ###### Active Wall Spacing on Foundation Wall


      Applicable portions of [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be no wider than the maximum [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B). For exceptions to this standard, see Subsection E. (Exceptions) below.
4. ##### Measurement


1. ###### Active Wall Spacing on Ground Story Facade


      [Active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured horizontally and parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from edge of [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to edge of [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), and edge of [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to edge of [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.5.png.webp?itok=S7LqJlCE)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.5.png?itok=dDmgxIfe)
2. ###### Active Wall Spacing on Foundation Wall


      [Active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured horizontally for any individual width of applicable [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that does not include [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.7.png.webp?itok=0zfQWDxk)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.4.2.7.png?itok=UtZucIEd)
5. ##### Exceptions


1. ###### Inapplicable Facades


      1. [Active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards do not apply to upper story facades.

      2. [Active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards do not apply to portions of [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s enclosing a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) except where [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are required to be wrapped or fenestrated by the applied Development Standards District (Part 4B).
2. ###### Inactive Wall Treatment Alternatives


      1. [Ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that exceed the maximum allowed [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may apply one or more [ground story inactive wall treatment alternatives](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the applicable [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) between door or [window opening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and increase the [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) by 50 percent per Paragraph 3. (Ground Story Inactive Wall Treatment Alternatives) below.

      2. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s designed with [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that exceed the maximum allowed [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may apply one or more [foundation inactive wall treatment alternatives](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) between active [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and double the allowed [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) per Paragraph 4. (Foundation Inactive Wall Treatment Alternatives) below.

      3. Plants provided to meet the requirements of Paragraph 3. (Ground Story Inactive Wall Treatment Alternatives) and Paragraph 4. (Foundation Inactive Wall Treatment Alternatives) below shall also comply with [Div. 4C.6. (Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6).

5. ###### Inactive Wall Treatment Measurement


      01. ###### Treatment Width


          Minimum treatment width percentage is calculated as the cumulative width of the provided inactive wall treatments divided by the total width of the provided [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      02. ###### Treatment Area


          Minimum treatment area percentage is calculated as the cumulative area of the provided inactive wall treatments divided by the total applicable [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within the provided [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      03. ###### Tree type


          Tree type is measured as small or large species according to [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.a.ii. (Tree Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      04. ###### Plant type


          Plant type is measured as [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), groundcover, and turf plants, hedges, [living wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, or climbing plants according to [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      05. ###### Plant Coverage


          Minimum plant coverage is measured according to [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.2. (Plant Coverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      06. ###### Planting Frequency


          Planting frequency is a ratio of the minimum number of plants required over a specified width of [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). A minimum of one plant of the required plant type shall be provided regardless of the width of inactive wall treatment.

      07. ###### Column Frequency


          Minimum column frequency is a ratio of the minimum number of columns required over a specified width of treated inactive wall treatment. A minimum of two columns shall be provided regardless of the inactive wall treatment width.

      08. ###### Planting Area Depth


          Minimum [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) depth is measured as the horizontal dimension of growing medium at the narrowest point, measured perpendicular to the applicable [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). The [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be [open to the sky](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for at least the required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) depth.

      09. ###### Clear Depth


          Minimum [clear depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the horizontal dimension of the [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) portion of an [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) at the narrowest point.

      10. ###### Height Above Sidewalk


          1. Height above sidewalk is measured vertically from adjacent [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the topmost point of the inactive wall treatment.

          2. For [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s located more than 10 feet from a sidewalk, maximum height above sidewalk is measured from the lowest [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within five feet, measured from and perpendicular to the [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), to the topmost point of the inactive wall treatment.
      11. ###### Foundation Wall Reveal


          [Foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) reveal is measured vertically from the top of an inactive wall treatment to the [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along the entire treated portion of an inactive [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      12. ###### Seat Depth


          Minimum seat depth is measured as the narrowest horizontal dimension of the area designed for public seating.

      13. ###### Enclosure


          Maximum [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured according to [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).
6. ##### Relief


1. Deviation from inactive wall treatment standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. An increase in allowed [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to 20 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. An increase in allowed [active wall spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and inactive wall treatment standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3C.5. Entrances

#### Sec. 3C.5.1. Street-Facing Entrance

Street-facing entrance is defined as a door providing [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from the public realm to the [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Street-Facing Entrance) is to provide visual interest along the public realm, orient [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s to the public realm, and promote greater use and activation of the [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) by limiting the width of frontage without physical connections between the public realm and the interior of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When the [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the standards apply to those portions of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s where frontage standards apply pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B. (Applicable Components of Lots, Buildings, & Structures)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      1. Where a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is required by the applied Frontage District, [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be provided at a rate based on the maximum [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified in the applied Frontage District. A minimum of one [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall always be provided.

      2. To qualify as a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [building entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall meet the following standards:

         1. Be located on the [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         2. Provide both ingress and egress [pedestrian access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         3. Remain operable at all times. [Access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be controlled and limited to [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s or tenants.

         4. Provide no [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) directly to [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, [utility area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s or fire stairs.

         5. The exterior door surface shall be angled between zero to 60 degrees, measured parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or the door shall have [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from an [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) allowed by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) having a [pedestrian access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) point which [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.1.1.png.webp?itok=sGYBzNfZ)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.1.1.png?itok=Uu25jbm3)
      3. On a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with a [Dual Frontage District (Div. 3B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.8) applied, having intersecting [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, an entrance [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) both intersecting [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s and angled between 30 to 60 degrees, measured parallel to each of those frontage lot lines, may be used to meet the requirement for a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along both frontages.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.1.3.png.webp?itok=7zGfuRGH)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.1.3.png?itok=GHeel7ou)

      4. Non-required entrances are allowed in addition to required entrances.
2. ###### Entrance Spacing


      The distance between [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s meeting the standards of [Sec. 3C.5.1.C. (Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.5.1).

      1. ###### Measurement


         1. The minimum number of [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s required for each frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is the frontage-applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width divided by the maximum entry spacing requirement.

         2. Maximum [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is the greatest horizontal distance from edge of door to edge of door, and edge of door to edge of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), measured parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
      2. ###### Standards


         1. [Street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall not be separated by a distance greater than the maximum allowed [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         2. The maximum [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) requirements shall be met for each [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) individually, but are not applicable to [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s.

         3. When the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) specifies that a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is 'not required' but does specify a maximum [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall only be required if the [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along the indicated [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is greater than the specified [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). [Street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall then be required in accordance with the maximum [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) requirement specified.

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.1.5.png.webp?itok=3Un8eLLX)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.1.5.png?itok=zLFkOhqT)
4. ##### Measurement


[Street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as "provided" or "not provided" based on the presence of entrances meeting [Sec. 3C.5.1.C. (Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.5.1).

5. ##### Relief


1. Deviation from [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. An increase in [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to 20 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and [entrance spacing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.5.2. Entry Feature

Entry features are improved design standards applied to each entrance along the public realm.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Entry Feature) is to provide architectural embellishment of entrances that promote inconspicuous wayfinding in the public realm, provide greater shelter and comfort to users, promote visual interest along the public realm, and highlight the connection between the public and private realm to improve walkability.

2. ##### Applicability


[Entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to all required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s where [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      1. Each required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall include an [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that meet the standards for one of the allowed [entry feature option](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      2. Required [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and provide [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      3. Required [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall provide [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from the public realm associated with the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      4. For [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) encroachment regulations, see [Sec. 2C.2.2.E. (Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2).

      5. For encroachments into the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.32 (Encroachments into the Public Right-of-Way)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-176204) of this Code.

      6. In complying with [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards, outdoor spaces such as landings and [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s required by an [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) count as [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
