4. ##### Measurement


01. ###### General


       1. [Entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as "provided" or "not provided" for each required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) based on whether the design of a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meets the standards of an allowed [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

       2. In complying with [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards, outdoor spaces such as landings and [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s required by an [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) count as [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
02. ###### Clear Depth


       [Clear depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the shallowest horizontal dimension of the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) immediately [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or surrounding each required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), measured perpendicular to the applicable [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the interior of the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

03. ###### Clear Width


       [Clear width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the narrowest horizontal dimension of the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) immediately [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or surrounding each required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), measured parallel to the applicable street lot line.

04. ###### Clear Height


       1. [Clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured vertically at the shortest point between the [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or the [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) immediately [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or surrounding each required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the bottom of the surface of any solid overhead structure creating [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) space within the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

       2. Where a minimum [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is specified as 'open to sky', the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) immediately [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) each required [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be [uncovered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
05. ###### Covered Entrance


       1. When required as part of an [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a canopy, roof or other [sheltering structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), the [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) entrance shall cover the [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) exterior area immediately [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) the associated [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

       2. The minimum depth of the [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be the [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by three.

       3. The minimum width of the [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be the [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) divided by two.

          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.2.13.png.webp?itok=sElXZZRF)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.5.2.13.png?itok=wMH1XI8P)
06. ###### Covered Area


       [Covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of an [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that is [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) by a canopy, roof or other [sheltering structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), divided by the total [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) area.

07. ###### Finished Floor Elevation


       [Finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured from the average [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along the adjacent sidewalk to the top of the finished floor surface or [ground surface](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). Where no sidewalk exists within 10 feet of the [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured perpendicular from the average [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within five feet of the [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), to the [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) area.

08. ###### Transparency


       1. Transparency is the percentage of area meeting the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards of [Sec. 3C.4.1.C. (Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4.1) provided for each [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), divided by the required [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

       2. Required [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is calculated by multiplying the specified [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height by [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width. For the measurement of [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) transparency, see [Sec. 3C.4.1.D.1. (Ground Story)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4.1).
09. ###### Transparent Area Height


       [Transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height is measured vertically from the top of the finished floor of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the shortest height of the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) provided.

10. ###### Transparent Area Width


       [Transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width is measured horizontally from the outer edges of the [transparent area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) provided along the narrowest width.

11. ###### Enclosure


       For the measurement of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

12. ###### Fence or Wall Height


       [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height is measured according to [Sec. 3C.3.2.D.2. (Fence & Wall Height)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.2).
5. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) dimensional standard up to 15 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from any [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3C.6. Ground Story

#### Sec. 3C.6.1. Ground Story Height

Ground story height is defined as the floor-to-floor height of the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) having its [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) nearest to the [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Ground Story Height) is to promote active [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that are directly connected to the public realm, and ensure high-quality [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) spaces that are adaptable and appropriate to their context.

2. ##### Applicability


[Ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When the [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the standards apply to all portions of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), within the first 15 feet of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


All [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located in applicable portions of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall have floor-to-floor height of no less than the [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) minimum.

4. ##### Measurement


1. [Ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured vertically from the top of the finished [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the top of the finished floor above.

2. Where no [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) exists above, [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is the shortest vertical distance from the top of the [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the top of the ceiling or [roof structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above.

3. For determining the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Sec. 14.2.10.A. (Ground Story)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.10).
5. ##### Relief


1. A reduction in required [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to one foot may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3C.6.2. Ground Floor Elevation

Ground floor elevation is defined as the finished floor height associated with the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) having its [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) nearest to the [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Ground Floor Elevation) is to promote high-quality [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) spaces with direct connection and visual interplay with the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) subject to the following:

      1. For [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s located less than 20 feet from the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), all portions of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located within the first 15 feet of a frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2), measured inward and perpendicular to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), shall comply with [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards.
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.6.2.1.png.webp?itok=_SwBp70Z)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.6.2.1.png?itok=tMlAYYzY)
3. ##### Standards


1. All [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located in applicable portions of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall have a [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) no higher than the maximum [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. All [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located in applicable portions of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall have a [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) no lower than the minimum [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).
4. ##### Measurement


1. Where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is located greater than 10 feet from a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured vertically from the average [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within five feet of the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

2. Where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is located 10 feet or less from a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured vertically from the average [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). Average [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the average of the highest and lowest sidewalk [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for the portion of the sidewalk located in front of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.6.2.3.png.webp?itok=ap2vg2xC)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.6.2.3.png?itok=AQU6-MXu)

3. [Ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be measured independently for different [module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s of the [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). The [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for each [module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be measured from either average [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for the portion of the sidewalk in front of the [module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or from average [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) within five feet of the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) based on the distance of the [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) according to Paragraph 1. and Paragraph 2. above.

      1. For sloped [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s, average [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) along the sidewalk shall be measured individually for each [module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and calculated as the average of the highest and lowest sidewalk [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for the portion of the sidewalk located in front of the [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.6.2.5.png.webp?itok=3JTpDWk0)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3C.6.2.5.png?itok=R4Lq1H-g)
5. ##### Exceptions


[Ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards do not apply to [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s located 20 feet or greater from the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

6. ##### Relief


1. A deviation in minimum or maximum [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up to 10 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

## Part 3D. Character Frontage Rules

### Div. 3D.1. Build-To

See [Div. 3C.1. (Build-To)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1).

### Div. 3D.2. Parking

See [Div. 3C.2. (Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.2).

### Div. 3D.3. Landscaping

See [Div. 3C.3. (Landscaping)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3).

### Div. 3D.4. Ground Floor Elevation

See [Sec. 3C.6.2. (Ground Floor Elevation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.6.2).

### Div. 3D.5. Story Height

#### Sec. 3D.5.1. Ground Story Height

For the intent, applicability, standards, measurement, and relief of [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) see [Sec. 3C.6.1. (Ground Story Height)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.6.1).

#### Sec. 3D.5.2. Upper Story Height

Upper story height is defined as the floor-to-floor height of any [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Upper Story Height) is to ensure [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) spaces and their [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are scaled and proportioned to contribute to the established architectural character of surrounding neighborhoods or districts.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of [multi-story building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s. When [upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the standards apply to each [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and all build-to applicable stories specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).
3. ##### Standards


All [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located in applicable portions of upper stories shall have a floor-to-floor height of no less than the [upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) minimum.

4. ##### Measurement


1. [Upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured vertically from the top of the finished floor to the top of the finished floor above.

2. Where no [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) exists above an [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is the shortest vertical distance from the top of the finished floor to the top of the ceiling or [roof structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above.
5. ##### Exceptions


Portions of upper stories located beyond the first 15 feet of a frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), measured inward and perpendicular to the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) are not required to meet [upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards.

6. ##### Relief


1. A reduction in required [upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of up to one foot may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviations from [upper story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3D.6. Articulation

#### Sec. 3D.6.1. Base, Middle & Top Articulation

The base, middle & top articulation requirement is composed of three separate and coordinated [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s designed to visually break a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up into three separately legible layers.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Base, Middle & Top Articulation) is to visually break a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up into three separately legible building layers.

2. ##### Applicability


Base, middle & top articulation standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or any [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when the applied [Character Frontage District (Div. 3B.9.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9) requires base, middle & top articulation on [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      One [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) option shall be provided for each building layer in accordance with the building layer standards below.

2. ###### Building Layers


      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3D.6.1.1.png.webp?itok=uMkUw7MW)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3D.6.1.1.png?itok=-x1---gW)

      1. ###### Base


         1. The base building layer shall include at least one and no more than three contiguous [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) starting with the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and continuing upward.

         2. At least one of the following [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be applied along the top of the base layer, creating a transition between the base and middle layers:

            1. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.1. (Material Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5);

            2. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.2. (Belt Course)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5); or

            3. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.3. (Shopfront Cornice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).
         3. The [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located no higher than the top of the uppermost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the layer.
      2. ###### Middle


         1. The middle building layer shall include at least twice as many contiguous stories than the base building layer, starting at the top of the base layer and continuing upward.

         2. At least one of the following [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be applied along the top of the middle layer, creating a transition between the middle and top layers:

            1. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.1. (Material Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5);or

            2. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.2. (Belt Course)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).
         3. The [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located no higher than the top of the uppermost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the layer.
      3. ###### Top


         1. The top building layer shall include at least one [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and shall not include more stories than the base building layer.

         2. All stories located in the top building layer shall be contiguous and include, at minimum, all stories between the top of the middle layer and the top of the highest of the build-to [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         3. A [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be applied to the top building layer when the top building layer is the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) before a [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). See [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.4. (Roofline Cornice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).

         4. The [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located along the top of the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the building layer.

         5. When the top building layer does not include the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) before a [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), at least one of the following [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be applied along the top of the top layer, creating a transition between the top building layer and any [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above:

            1. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.1. (Material Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5); or

            2. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.2. (Belt Course)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).
         6. The [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located along the top of the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the building layer.
4. ##### Measurement


For measurement of stories see [Sec. 2C.4.3. (Height in Stories)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.3).

5. ##### Exceptions


1. Where the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) requires a [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) depth of 10 feet or greater, the top building layer may terminate at the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) below the [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). No [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is required above the top building layer.

2. When a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is less than five [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), the standards of this Section (Base, Middle & Top Articulation) do not apply, and the standards of [Sec. 3D.6.2. (Base-Top Articulation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.2) apply.
6. ##### Relief


1. Base, middle & top articulation standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in building layers of one [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any base, middle & top articulation standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3D.6.2. Base-Top Articulation

The base-top articulation requirement is composed of two separate and coordinated [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s designed to visually break a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up into two separately legible layers.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Base-Top Articulation) is to visually break a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) up into two separately legible building layers.

2. ##### Applicability


[Base-top articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and any [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) possessing five [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or fewer when the applied [Character Frontage District (Div. 3B.9.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9) requires [base-top articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) on all [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      One [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) option shall be provided for each building layer in accordance with the building layer standards below. See [Sec. 3D.6.5. (Articulating Elements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).

2. ###### Building Layers


      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3D.6.2.1.png.webp?itok=om3jl4xK)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/3D.6.2.1.png?itok=l6GtiyrN)

      1. ###### Base


         1. The base building layer shall include between one and three contiguous [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) starting with the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and continuing upward.

         2. At least one of the following [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be applied along the top of the base layer, creating a transition between the base and top layers:

            1. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.1. (Material Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5);

            2. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.2. (Belt Course)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5); or

            3. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.3. (Shopfront Cornice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).
         3. The [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located no higher than the top of the uppermost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the layer.
      2. ###### Top


         1. The top building layer shall include at least twice as many [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) as the base building layer and include all remaining [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) not included in the base building layer.

         2. A [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be applied to the top building layer that is the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) before a [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). See [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.4. (Roofline Cornice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).

         3. The [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located along the top of the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the building layer.

         4. When the top building layer does not include the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) before a [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), at least one of the following [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall be applied along the top of the top layer, creating a transition between the top building layer and any [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above:

            1. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.1. (Material Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5); or

            2. [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.2. (Belt Course)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5).
         5. The [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall extend for the full width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and be located along the top of the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) included in the building layer.
4. ##### Measurement


For measurement of stories see [Sec. 2C.4.3. (Height in Stories)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.3).

5. ##### Exceptions


Where the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) requires a [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) depth of 10 feet or greater, the top building layer may terminate at the topmost [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) below the [street step-back](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). No [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is required above the top building layer.

6. ##### Relief


1. [Base-top articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in building layers of one [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any [base-top articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3D.6.3. Horizontal Band Articulation

Horizontal band articulation is a continuous band of material running horizontally across a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Horizontal Band Articulation) is to separate and align [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in a way that contributes to the established architectural character of surrounding neighborhoods or districts.

2. ##### Applicability


[Horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when the applied [Character Frontage District (Div. 3B.9.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9) requires [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


[Horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the following standards:

1. Be no less than eight inches in height,

2. Extend for the full width of the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), interrupted only by required [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s or [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s. [Architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that interrupt either required [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or required [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall cover cumulatively no more than 30 percent of the total [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). A maximum of five [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that interrupt required [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) are allowed on the [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of any individual [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height is measured vertically from the lowest point to the highest point of a [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards above.

2. The [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) covered by an [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that interrupts [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the area of the smallest rectangle that fully circumscribes the [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
5. ##### Relief


1. [Horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) dimensional standards up to 15 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3D.6.4. Vertical Band Articulation

Vertical band articulation is a continuous band of material running vertically up a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Vertical Band Articulation) is to separate and align [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) in a way that contributes to the established architectural character of surrounding neighborhoods or districts.

2. ##### Applicability


[Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when the applied [CharacterFrontage District (Div 3B.9.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9) requires [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


[Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the following standards:

1. Be no less than eight inches in width, and

2. Extend uninterrupted for the full height of all build-to [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), only interrupted by [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), required [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s or [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s. [Architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that interrupt either required [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or required [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall cover cumulatively no more than 30 percent of the total [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). A maximum of five [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that interrupt required [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or required [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) are allowed on the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of any individual [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
4. ##### Spacing


1. [Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be applied across the full width of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) separated by no more than the maximum spacing and no less than the minimum spacing specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. [Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall also be located at each corner of a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
5. ##### Measurement


1. [Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) width is measured parallel to the applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and horizontally from one end of a vertical band meeting the standards above to the opposite end.

2. [Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) spacing is measured horizontally and perpendicular to the applicable [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) from edge of vertical band to edge of vertical band.

3. The [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) covered by an [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that interrupts [horizontal band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is measured as the area of the smallest rectangle that fully circumscribes the [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
6. ##### Relief


1. [Vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) dimensional standards up to 15 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any [vertical band articulation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 3D.6.5. Articulating Elements

Articulating elements are permanent [architectural detail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s used to embellish a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) design to accentuate an articulation technique or [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) composition.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Articulating Elements) is to provide visual interest to the public realm and break up a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) with visually separate [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) layers in a way that contributes to the established architectural character of surrounding neighborhoods or districts.

2. ##### Applicability


[Articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when the applied [Character Frontage District (Div. 3B.9.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9) requires [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3 (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Articulating Element Options


1. ###### Material Change


      1. ###### Standards


         1. The principal exterior material applied to the building layer shall be different from the principal siding treatment applied to the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) building layers.

         2. The principal exterior material shall be limited to those allowed by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         3. One of the following [architectural detail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s must be provided between building layers applying the material change [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#):

            1. A [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located at the transition from one principal exterior material to the next. See Paragraph 2. (Belt Course) below; or

            2. The building layer applying a material change [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall be recessed or project from the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) building layers at least three inches.
      2. ###### Measurement


         1. In measuring material change, principal exterior materials are considered different if they are entirely different materials or products having the same base material where the unit size or finish surface texture is visibly contrasting.

         2. Recessed building layers are measured horizontally from and perpendicular to the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the outermost point of the recessed building layer [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         3. Projecting building layers are measured horizontally and perpendicular from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the innermost point of the projecting building layer [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).
2. ###### Belt Course


      A horizontal course projecting beyond the face of the surrounding [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) often shaped to mark a division in the facade wall.

      1. ###### Standards


         A [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Extend uninterrupted for the full width of the building layer.

         2. Have a consistent profile across the width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

         3. Project a minimum of two inches from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for some portion of the top two inches and the bottom two inches of the [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) profile,

         4. Have a height of no less than 12 inches if located on the first [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). An additional two inches in height are required for each [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) that the [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is located about the first [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). The greatest required minimum height is 48 inches.
      2. ###### Measurement


         1. [Belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height is measured vertically from the lowest point to the highest point of the [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) profile meeting the standards in subparagraph a above.

         2. Projection is measured perpendicularly from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the outermost point of a [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards in the subparagraph a above.
3. ###### Shopfront Cornice


      A continuous molded projection located above a series of display [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s on the [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      1. ###### Standards


         A [shopfront cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Extend uninterrupted for the width of the building layer.

         2. Project a minimum of four inches from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for some portion of the top four inches and the bottom four inches of the cornice profile.

         3. Have a height of no less than 12 inches.
      2. ###### Measurement


         1. [Shopfront cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height is measured vertically from the lowest point to the highest point of the cornice profile meeting the standards in subparagraph a above.

         2. Projection is measured perpendicularly from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) horizontally to the outermost point of a [shopfront cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards in the subparagraph a above.
4. ###### Roofline Cornice


      A continuous molded projection that crowns a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), often as part of a parapet.

      1. ###### Standards


         A [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Extend uninterrupted for the full width of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) layer.

         2. Project a minimum of four inches from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) for some portion of the top four inches of the cornice profile if located on the first, second or third stories. An additional two inches of projection are required for each story the [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is located above the third story. A minimum projection of at least 36 inches is required.

         3. Have a height of no less than 12 inches if located on the first, second or third story. An additional two inches in height are required for each story the [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is located above the third story. A minimum height of at least 48 inches is required.
      2. ###### Measurement


         1. [Roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) height is measured vertically from the lowest point to the highest point of the cornice profile meeting the standards above.

         2. Projection is measured perpendicularly from the immediately surrounding [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) horizontally to the outermost point of a [roofline cornice](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards in the subparagraph a above.
4. ##### Measurement


[Articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are measured as "provided" or "not provided" based on whether the applicable building layer [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) applies an [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) meeting the standards above.

5. ##### Relief


1. [Articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s dimensional standards up to 10 percent may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2)

3. Deviation from any [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s standard may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3D.7. Features

#### Sec. 3D.7.1. Restricted Features

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Restricted Features) is to ensure [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s are built in a way that contributes to the established architectural character of surrounding neighborhoods or districts by limiting the use of [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s that are inappropriate to the historic or desired context.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Restricted Features) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) when the applied [CharacterFrontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) restricts features on any [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

3. ##### Standards


Where the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) lists a feature as "prohibited", no applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) located on a build-to applicable story specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) may include any variety of listed feature.

4. ##### Projecting Balcony


An [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) platform, located at an elevation above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), that is fixed to or integrated with an exterior [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and projects beyond the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) of the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) immediately below. Balconies include [protective barrier](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s such as railings or parapets and may be [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) or [uncovered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

1. ###### Standards


      Where the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) lists [projecting balcony](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) as "prohibited":

      1. No feature meeting the definition for [projecting balcony](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) above may be included on an applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      2. Roof terraces that meet the definition of balcony may be allowed provided they are [uncovered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and do not project beyond the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) immediately below.
2. ###### Measurement


      Projecting balconies are identified as present or absent based on whether an applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) includes a [projecting balcony](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) as described above.
5. ##### Relief


1. Deviation from "restricted features" standards may be met through alternative compliance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. Deviation from any "restricted features" standards may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 3D.8. Entrances

#### Sec. 3D.8.1. Street-Facing Entrance

For the intent, applicability, standards, measurement, and relief of [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) see [Sec. 3C.5.1. (Street-Facing Entrance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.5.1).

#### Sec. 3D.8.2. Entry Feature

For the intent, applicability, standards, measurement, and relief of [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s see [Sec. 3C.5.2. (Entry Feature)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.5.2).

#### Sec. 3D.8.3. Focal Entry Feature

Focal entry feature are improved design standards applied to the primary entrance along the public realm.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Focal Entry Feature) is to establish a hierarchy of entrances on a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) where a [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) is the visually dominant entrance supported by secondary entrances designed with [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


[Focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), when the applied [Character Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) requires a [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#). When the [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply, the [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) standards apply to [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s.

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### General


      1. Each [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall provide at least the minimum number of [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      2. Each required [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) shall meet the standards for one of the [focal entry feature option](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s. See [Sec. 3D.8.1.C.2. (Focal Entry Feature Options)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.8.1).

      3. Required [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) and provide [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      4. Required [focal entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) s shall provide [direct access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) to the public realm associated with the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#).

      5. For [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#) encroachment regulations, see [Sec. 2C.2.2.E. (Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2).

      6. For encroachments into the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#), see [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.32. (Encroachments into the Public Right-of-Way)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-176204) of this Code.
2. ###### Focal Entry Feature Options


      Packages of design standards applied to the primary entrance along the public realm.
