4. ##### Measurement


1. ##### Parking Stalls Per 1,000 Square Feet


      When determining [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements specified as a ratio having a denominator of "1,000 SF" the method for determining the total number of required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be executed as follows:

      1. Divide the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the subject [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by 1,000. For determining [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see Paragraph 3. (Square Feet) of this Subsection (Measurement).

      2. Multiply the result by the numerator in the specified [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ratio. If the result is a fraction, round in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Fractional Spaces) of this Subsection (Measurement).

      3. The result shall be the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
2. ##### Parking Stalls Per Acre


      When determining [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements specified as a ratio having a denominator of "acre" the method for determining the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be executed as follows:

      1. Divide the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the subject [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by 43,560. For determining [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see Paragraph 3. (Square Feet) below.

      2. Multiply the result by the numerator in the specified [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ratio. If the result is a fraction, round in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Fractional Spaces) below.

      3. The result shall be the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
3. ##### Square Feet


      For the purpose of calculating required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in this Section (Automobile Parking Stalls), square feet refers to the total on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to a subject [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), measured in square feet. The total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. For the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

4. ##### Habitable Rooms


      For the purpose of applying the [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements of this Section (Automobile Parking Stalls), any [kitchen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not be considered a [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

5. ##### Fractional Space


      When the application of these regulations results in the requirement of a fractional [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), any fraction up to and including 1/2 may be disregarded, and any fraction over 1/2 is construed as requiring one automobile parking space. Rounding shall occur after taking the sum of automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) required across all proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
5. ##### Exceptions


01. ##### Accessible Parking


       The number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be reduced by the number of stalls deemed necessary in order to provide accessible parking stalls as required by state, federal and local laws.

02. ##### Amenity Space


       [Floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided as [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be exempt from [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements.

03. ##### Use Modification


       No additional [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be required for [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) project activities that only modify the following uses:

       1. [Indoor recreation: public](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#),

       2. [Indoor recreation: commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or

       3. All [general commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
04. ##### Electric Vehicle Charging Stations


       1. Each [electric vehicle charging station](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided above the minimum required by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Article 9. (Green Building Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-214608) of this Code may be substituted for two required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for the purpose of complying with any applicable minimum [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements of this Section (Automobile Parking Stalls).

          1. Measurement. Where a multiport electric [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) charger can simultaneously charge more than one [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the number of [electric vehicle charging station](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be considered equivalent to the number of electric [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that can be simultaneously charged.
       2. An accessible [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) served by electric [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) supply equipment or an accessible [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with an aisle designated as a future electric [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) charging space shall count as two required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for the purpose of complying with any applicable minimum [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements of this Section (Automobile Parking Stalls).
05. ##### Fire Pump Rooms


       The number of required automobile [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be reduced by the number of stalls deemed necessary in order to install a water storage tank to enlarge an existing fire pump room, or to install a new fire pump room.

06. ##### Historic Buildings and Buildings That Are At Least 25 Years Old


       No additional [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required for [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s occupying a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that meets one of the following criteria:

       1. The [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. The [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is a [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       3. The [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) was constructed conforming to [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and zoning codes in effect at the time it was built and is at least 25 years old. A [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or other suitable documentation may be submitted as evidence to verify the date of construction.
07. ##### Office Mixed-Use


       1. Any [indoor recreation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [personal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) sharing a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with an [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may provide [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the same rate required for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s subject to the following requirements:

          1. The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes a total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 50,000 square feet or greater.

          2. The [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall occupy a minimum of 75 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

          3. The cumulative [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to any combination of [indoor recreation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [personal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that may provide [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the same rate required for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not exceed five percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

          4. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to any combination of [indoor recreation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [personal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that exceeds five percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall provide [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the rate specified for the subject [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in the applicable parking package assigned by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).
       2. Any [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s sharing a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a wholesale trade & warehousing [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may provide [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the same rate required for wholesale trade & warehousing [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s when the following criteria are met:

          1. The cumulative [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that may provide [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the same rate required for wholesale trade & warehousing [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not exceed 10 percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated for wholesale trade & warehousing [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

          2. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that exceeds 10 percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated for wholesale trade & warehousing [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall provide [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the rate specified for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in the applicable parking package assigned by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).
08. ##### Public Benefit Projects


       [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s participating in an Affordable Housing Incentive Program, Community Benefits Program, or a General Incentive Program included in [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9), may qualify for reduced required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) as deemed eligible.

09. ##### Small Business Tenant Space


       Non-residential tenant spaces designated for commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s having a [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 1,500 square feet or less shall be exempt from requirements to provide [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. This exemption is limited to two tenant spaces per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

10. ##### Substituting Required Automobile Parking with Bicycle Parking


       1. Required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be substituted with bicycle parking at a ratio of one [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for every four bicycle parking spaces provided the bicycle parking spaces meet the applicable requirements of [Sec. 4C.3.1. (Bicycle Parking Spaces)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3.1).

       2. Non-residential [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may substitute up to 20 percent of the required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with bicycle [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When a non-residential [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is located within 1,500 feet of a [passenger transit facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), up to 30 percent of the required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be substituted with bicycle [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       3. [Residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may substitute up to 10 percent of the required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with bicycle [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is located within 1,500 feet of a [major transit stop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), up to 15 percent of the required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be substituted with bicycle [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       4. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s participating in an Affordable Housing Incentive Program, Community Benefits Program, or a General Incentive Program included in [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9), may substitute up to 30 percent of the required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with bicycle [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), as deemed eligible.
11. ##### Conversion of Existing One-Unit Dwellings


       Only one [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required for each [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that results from the conversion of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that contains only one [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided that the conversion meets the following requirements:

       1. The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is not in a 1L [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B);

       2. The conversion is limited to the structural alteration of the [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of not more than 250 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) thereto;

       3. The conversion results in a total of two or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s; and

       4. All newly created [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
12. ##### Outdoor Dining Area Parking Exception


       1. [Outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may replace otherwise required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, provided that at least one [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is provided for the associated eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), subject to the following exceptions where no automobile parking is required:

          1. On a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) where no parking is required for the associated eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

          2. Where the associated eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) has a total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 3,000 square feet or less.

          3. Where the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) has a total area of 1,000 square feet or less.
       2. Establishments that have been the subject of a wage claim under [Chapter XVIII. (Employee Wages and Protections), Article 8. (Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards Ordinance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-287786#JD_C18A8) of this Code, on or after January 1, 2024, are not eligible for the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) parking exception.
6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 4C.4.3. (Alternative Parking Strategies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3).

2. A reduction in required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustments)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation in required automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.4.2. Alternative Parking Strategies

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Alternative Parking Strategies) is to provide opportunities for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to reduce the number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s through alternative methods of accommodating arrival to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and reduce demand for automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      1. A reduction in required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s through the provision of one or more [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be authorized in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5). Applicants that wish to provide an [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) as a means of reducing the total number of required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall submit a report which provides the following:

         1. Detailed description of all [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s involved in the [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including location, [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), seating capacity if applicable, and hours of operations.

         2. Anticipated [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) demand generated by employees, tenants, [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and visitors on an hourly basis, 24 hours per day, for seven consecutive days.

         3. Description of how an [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will alleviate the demand for a specified number of the total required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

         4. Supplemental maps and plot plans deemed necessary for depicting all relevant components of an [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         5. Supplemental market study detailing the complementary relationship between a mix of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s as deemed necessary for understanding the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) strategy.
      2. Additional documents, covenants, deed restrictions, or other agreements shall be executed and recorded as deemed necessary, in order to assure the continued maintenance, operation and viability of an approved [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), under the conditions set forth in the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s Determination. Revisions to the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) strategy shall be submitted to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in a report documenting the revised manner in which the new [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) strategy achieves the same intention and level of service as the originally approved [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) strategy.
2. ##### Mixed Use


      When a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) combines [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [general commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that may serve the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or employees, the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be reduced when an applicant demonstrates that the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s will cater to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or employees. The total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be reduced provided the mixed-use [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets all of the following criteria:

      1. Contains 50 or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or 50,000 square feet or more dedicated to [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) use.

      2. [General commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are limited to [indoor recreation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [personal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. The [general commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be limited to 25 percent of total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. The mix of uses sufficiently alleviates the demand for the specified number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
3. ##### Shared Parking


      In order to take advantage of different peak periods of [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) demand among nearby [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be reduced when an applicant demonstrates that [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s can be shared among multiple [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. A parking facility may be shared among multiple [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s within the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), as well as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located on separate [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. The [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet all of the following criteria:

      1. A shared parking facility shall be located within a 750-foot [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of each participating [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Participating [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have mutually exclusive periods of peak [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) demand.

      3. The shared [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) strategy sufficiently alleviates the demand for the specified number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
4. ##### Proximity to Public Transportation


      [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s within [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a public transit facility may take advantage of increased transit ridership among employees, tenants and visitors and a decreased demand for automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be reduced provided the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) strategy meets all of the following criteria:

      1. A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located within a 1,500-foot [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of public transit. For this purpose, public transit means a location, including, but not limited to, a bus stop or train station, where the public may [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) buses, trains, subways, and other forms of transportation that charge set fares, run on fixed routes, and are available to the public. A public transit stop or station that is in development may also apply if the anticipated operating date is within three years.

      2. The nearby public transit facility sufficiently alleviates the demand for the specified number of required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
5. ##### Shuttle Service


      [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s generating travel patterns whereby a majority of employees or visitors arrive and depart within the same time periods may operate a viable shuttle service that decreases the demand for automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and may decrease the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, based on the decreased demand, provided the following criteria are met:

      1. A shuttle shall provide scheduled service between the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and a location that can accommodate the arrival of shuttle users, such as a park and ride facility or public [passenger transit facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or stop.

      2. A majority of shuttle users arrive and depart roughly within the same three hour period.

      3. The planned shuttle service sufficiently alleviates the demand for the specified number of required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
6. ##### Designated Passenger Loading Areas


      [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that can accommodate a high share of arrivals and departures through dynamic ridesharing or taxi services when providing a safe and efficient [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may have a decreased demand for automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and may decrease the total number of required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, based on the decreased demand, provided the following criteria are met:

      1. A designated [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located within a 300-foot [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a street-facing entrance to the use it serves. Travel between a designated [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) being served shall not require pedestrians to cross streets.

      2. The [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not be placed within 75 feet of an intersection.

      3. The [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall provide sufficient space for a [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to pull out of [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) traffic and safely load and unload passengers without interfering with traffic flow.

      4. The [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not decrease sidewalk space for pedestrians or impede pedestrian movement.

      5. [Passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be clearly indicated with signage.

      6. The designated [passenger loading area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) sufficiently alleviates the demand for the specified number of required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
4. ##### Measurement


1. For measurement of [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.3.A.2. (Walking Distance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.3).

2. Peak period demand is determined based on the following:

      1. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that have obtained a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), this analysis shall be conducted on an hourly basis, 24 hours per day, for seven consecutive days to identify the maximum average number of automobiles on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) per hour.

      2. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that have not yet obtained a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), this analysis shall be conducted on an hourly basis, 24 hours per day, for seven consecutive days to identify the maximum average number of automobiles per hour on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) serving a similar [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in the vicinity.
5. ##### Relief


A deviation from any [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).


#### Sec. 4C.4.3. Parking Area Design

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Parking Area Design) is to ensure [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provide sufficient accommodation for automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), affecting any [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containing [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. ##### Standards


01. ##### Automobile Circulation


       All portions of a [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including public [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, shall be accessible by automobile to all other portions of a [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) without requiring the use of any public street, unless [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) determines that [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will not be detrimental to the flow of traffic. [Alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be used for circulation between [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

02. ##### Location of Parking Stalls


       1. All required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be located in an off-street [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. The required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be provided either on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) as the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) they are intended to serve or on another [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) not more than a 750-foot [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) intended to be served by the required parking. An [alternative parking strategy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be approved to exceed this [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       3. Automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is not permitted within the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, side street [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and any [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s established by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) in accordance with [Sec. 3C.2.1. (Parking Setback)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.2.1).

       4. Automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is not permitted within any portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designated to be used as [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Div. 2C.3. (Amenity)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3).
03. ##### Automobile Maneuvering


       1. Each [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be so located that no automobile is required to reverse onto any public street or sidewalk to leave the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [parking bay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), except where the automobile [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) facility serves four [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or less and where the driveway access is to a street other than a [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). An [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be used for maneuvering in reverse.

       2. Each [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be so located that parking maneuvers can be accomplished without driving into a [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
04. ##### Parking Stall Striping


       Each [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be clearly marked with striping for the entire required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) depth with the exception of [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that contain less than five [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, which are not required to mark [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with striping.

05. ##### Paving


       All [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be paved with a material treatment meeting either the basic or alternative paving material standards below.

       1. ##### Basic Paving Material


          Automobile parking areas shall be paved with either hard, durable asphaltic paving which has been mixed at a plant and is at least two inches thick after compaction or with portland cement paving at least three inches thick.

       2. ##### Alternate Paving Materials


          1. Alternative to the basic paving material in Subparagraph a. (Basic Paving Material) above, automobile parking areas may be paved with the following alternative paving materials: porous asphalt, porous concrete, permeable interlocking concrete pavers, permeable pavers, decomposed granite, crushed rock, gravel, or restrained systems (a plastic or concrete grid system confined on all sides to restrict lateral movement, and filled with gravel or grass in the voids).

          2. Alternate paving materials are subject to the following standards:

             1. Paving materials located in a designated fire lane must be approved by the Los Angeles Fire Department.

             2. Permeable interlocking concrete pavers and permeable pavers shall have a minimum thickness of 80 millimeters (3.14 inches).

             3. If plants are an element of the alternate paving material, the irrigation system shall not utilize potable water except for during plant establishment.

             4. Products and underlying drainage material shall be installed per manufacturers' specifications. Sub-grade soils shall be compacted as required per the product installation specifications.

             5. Decomposed granite, crushed rock and gravel shall only be allowed for [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s serving one or two [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
06. ##### Lighting


       [Parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be illuminated in accordance with [Sec. 4C.10.1. (Outdoor Lighting)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).

07. ##### Parking Stall Obstructions


       A [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), partition, column, post or similar obstruction shall not be located within 10 inches of a [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) along its longest dimension unless the obstruction is located a minimum of 14 feet from the [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measured parallel to the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). [Parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided in 1L or 2L [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) are exempt from this standard.

08. ##### Parking Lots


       For additional [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards, see [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4).

09. ##### Structured Parking


       For additional [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards, see [Sec. 4C.4.5. (Parking Structure Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5).

11. ##### Compact Parking


       1. The following [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be compact:

          1. Any [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in excess of the required number of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in [Sec. 4C.4.1. (Automobile Parking Stalls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.1),

          2. [Parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in excess of one parking stall per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be compact [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and

          3. In a [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containing 10 or more parking stalls, a maximum of 40 percent of the required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
       2. All compact [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be clearly and visibly striped and labeled for compact car use only.
12. ##### Tandem Parking


       Automobiles may be parked in tandem in a private [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) serving a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), where the tandem parking is not more than two cars in depth. Tandem parking is not allowed for [recreational vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or guest [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided as part of a private [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) serving a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

13. ##### Parking Bay Dimensions


       1. The minimum width of each [parking bay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is determined by the stall width and angle of the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided in accordance with the table below:

14. ##### Mechanical Automobile Lifts & Robotic Parking Structures


       1. The stacking of two or more automobiles using a mechanical car lift or computerized [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is permitted.

       2. Mechanical and robotic automobile parking lifts must maintain the following dimensions between vertical supports or any obstructions:

(Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4).
