4. ##### Measurement


1. ##### Parking Stall Width


      The [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width shall be measured as the narrowest horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between opposite edges of a [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

2. ##### Parking Stall Depth


      The [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) depth shall be measured as the horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measured perpendicular to the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width from one edge of a [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the opposite edge. A minimum [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) depth shall be met for all portions of the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width.

3. ##### Parking Bay Width


      The [parking bay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width shall be measured by the horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between opposite edges of a [parking bay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measured perpendicular to the [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

4. ##### Parking Angle


      The parking angle shall be measured from the long edge of a [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

5. ##### Clear Height


      Minimum [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the vertical dimension of a [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the lowest point, from [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or floor [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the ceiling or other fixed obstruction, whichever is lower, for the full width and depth of the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

6. ##### Clear Width


      Minimum [clear width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the horizontal dimension of a [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the narrowest point between [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or other fixed obstructions for the full depth of the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
5. ##### Exceptions


A [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) providing attendants to park the [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s at all times when the [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is open for use does not have to meet the requirements of [Sec. 4C.4.3.C.10. (Parking Stall Dimensions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3) and [Sec. 4C.4.3.C.13. (Parking Bay Dimensions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3).

6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance from [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. Compact [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided in lieu of 10 percent of the required standard parking stalls may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustments)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2)

3. A deviation in required [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensions or [parking bay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensions may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.4.4. Parking Lot Design

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Parking Lot Design) is to ensure [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are designed to create safe, comfortable and attractive environments for users and pedestrians along the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), while also mitigating heat island effects, absorbing noise pollution, managing stormwater runoff, sequestering carbon emissions and supporting urban biodiversity through [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and surface design.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), subject to the following:

      1. [Parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards apply to all [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s not contained within a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. [Parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) landscaping standards apply to all [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s containing five or more [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Surfacing


      1. All automobile [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be graded and drained to collect, retain and infiltrate surface water on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by applying [Low Impact Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) practices and standards.

      2. [Parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be surfaced with hard, durable asphaltic paving which has been mixed at a plant and is at least two inches thick after compaction, with portland cement paving at least three inches thick or with an alternative paving material described below.

         1. Alternative paving materials include the following: porous asphalt, porous concrete, permeable interlocking concrete pavers, permeable pavers, decomposed granite, crushed rock, gravel, and restrained systems (a plastic or concrete grid system confined on all sides to restrict lateral movement, and filled with gravel or plants in the voids.)

         2. Alternative paving materials are permitted for use in every [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), subject to the following standards:

            1. Any product installed within areas designated by the Fire Department as a fire lane must be approved by the Fire Department.

            2. Permeable interlocking concrete pavers and permeable pavers shall have a minimum thickness of 80 millimeters (3.14 inches).

            3. If plants are an element of the alternative paving material, the irrigation system shall not utilize potable water except for plant establishment.

            4. Products and underlying drainage material shall be installed per manufacturers' specifications. Sub-grade soils shall be compacted as required per the product installation specifications.

            5. Decomposed granite, crushed rock and gravel shall only be allowed for [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s serving a maximum of two [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
2. ##### Parking Lot Landscaping


      1. ##### General


         1. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with either Subparagraph b. (Option 1: Prescriptive Standard) or Subparagraph c. (Option 2: Performance-Based Standard) below to meet the requirements of this Section (Parking Lot Design).

         2. The required stall length of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may overhang the [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required by the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards by two feet or less.

         3. All [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) in addition to any [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements of the chosen [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) option.
      2. ##### Option 1: Prescriptive Standard


         1. Trees planted within a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located along a single row of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be provided at a rate of one [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or two [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for every four [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

         2. Trees planted between two rows of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be provided at a rate of one [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or two [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for every eight [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

         3. Required trees shall be spaced evenly along the entire length of the required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.4.2.png.webp?itok=RigLsXyQ)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.4.2.png?itok=_bpk7iUI)

         4. When calculating the total number of trees results in a fraction of a tree, any fraction less than 1/2 may be disregarded and any fraction of 1/2 or more will require one additional tree.
      3. ##### Option 2: Performance-Based Standard


         Trees shall be planted so that at least 50 percent of all [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s within the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will be shaded by tree canopy after 10 years of planting.
3. ##### Screening


      1. Where a [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or an [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) the entire length of the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be screened as follows:

         1. An [F-Screen 2 (Sec. 4C.8.1.C.2.b.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2) or an [F-Screen 3 (Sec. 4C.8.1.C.2.c.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3) is required between the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for any portion of the length of the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. A [T-Screen 1 (Sec. 4C.8.2.C.2.a.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1) is required between the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shared with [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s zoned with a 1L, 2L, 3L or 4L [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) for any portion of the length of the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         3. A [T-Screen 1 (Sec. 4C.8.2.C.2.a.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1) is required between the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for any portion of the length of the [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) an [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) where [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s zoned with a 1L, 2L, 3L or 4L [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) the opposite side of the [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      2. The required stall length of [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may overhang the [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by two feet or less.

      3. Screens may only be located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) where they comply with frontage yard fence & wall standards in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).
4. ##### Containment Perimeter


      [Parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall include a containment perimeter that obstructs [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s from leaving the designated [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The containment perimeter shall be providing using one or more of the following containment methods around the entire perimeter except for crossings and [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) points required for [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, or [pedestrian passageway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s:

      1. Continuous curbs of no less than four inches in height.

      2. Permanent [bollard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, raised planters, or a similar containment method having a height no less than 30 inches and having a [clear width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of no more than 66 inches.

      3. A [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) with no horizontal dimension less than five feet.
5. ##### Lighting


      [Parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be illuminated in accordance with [Sec. 4C.10.1. (Outdoor Lighting)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measurement determination see [Sec. 14.2.12. (Lot Line Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12).

2. For [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designation measurements see [Sec. 14.2.16.C.1. (Frontage yard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.16).

3. For [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measurements see [Sec. 3C.2.1. (Parking Setback)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.2.1).

4. For the length that a [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.6. (Facing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.6).

5. To measure [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.1. (Planting Area Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
5. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from any [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A deviation from any [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.4.5. Parking Structure Design

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Parking Structure Design) is to limit the visual and environmental impact of [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on the public realm to the extent appropriate to the mobility context.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) subject to the following:

      1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards apply to [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s possessing a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designation.

      2. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards apply to both standalone and integrated [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s as a part of a broader development, and to all levels of [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design treatments are hierarchical according to the following order listed lowest to highest:

         1. Screened Parking

         2. Concealed Parking

         3. Adaptable Parking

         4. Wrapped Parking
      2. If a treatment listed lower in the hierarchy in Subparagraph a. above is specified by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), the applicant may choose to meet the standards of a treatment with any a higher listed treatment.

      3. [Ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located in a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall also meet any [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).
2. ##### Lighting


      All [luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located in [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall meet the following standards:

      1. [Luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall meet the standards of [Sec. 4C.10.1. (Outdoor Lighting)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).

      2. Beam spread and glare zone from [luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be contained within the [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.1.png.webp?itok=bAjrJoS-)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.1.png?itok=-zTswgfG)
3. ##### Parking Structure Design Treatments


      1. ##### Screened Parking


         Screened parking is intended to limit the visual and environmental impact of [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on the public realm.
         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.3.png.webp?itok=kJVIM7vz)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.3.png?itok=7rmqS3jK)
         1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required to be screened shall meet any frontage standards required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         2. All [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required to be "screened" shall be screened with a permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that meets the following standards:

            1. Any individual level of parking measured in [elevation projection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall have at least 60 percent [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.5.png.webp?itok=k_lb5ph1)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.5.png?itok=QL2UCc3A)

            2. Openings in screens shall be four inches or less in at least one dimension except for openings provided for pedestrian or [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) access.

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.7.png.webp?itok=gJd2FKQ7)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.7.png?itok=XA3M8fLg)

            3. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen openings accommodating automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are allowed for a width no greater than the maximum allowed [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width allowed by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

            4. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen openings accommodating [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are allowed for a width no greater than eight feet in width for each individual [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Where an opening in the [parking garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) accommodates both pedestrian and automobile access, the maximum allowable opening width is eight feet greater than the maximum allowed [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width.

            5. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen openings shall have a height no greater than one [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
         3. In addition to the [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) above, an F-Screen 1 or F-Screen 2 pursuant to [Frontage Screen Types (Sec. 4C.8.1.C.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.1) is required between [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and all [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
      2. ##### Concealed Parking


         Concealed parking is intended to entirely block views of cars, people and direct light from inside [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to the public realm.
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.9.png.webp?itok=tZaQtqQ7)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.9.png?itok=27XQpSqr)
         1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required to be concealed shall meet any frontage standards required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         2. All [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required to be "concealed" shall be screened with a permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting the following standards:

            1. The [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) material shall have an [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 100 percent.

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.11.png.webp?itok=INRrjE2C)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.11.png?itok=sX7kTUIA)

            2. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not include perforated metal [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) products.

            3. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen openings accommodating automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are allowed for a width no greater than the maximum allowed [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width allowed by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

            4. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen openings accommodating [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are allowed for a width no greater than eight feet in width for each individual [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Where an opening in the [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) accommodates both pedestrian and automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the maximum allowable opening width is eight feet greater than the maximum allowed [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width.

            5. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen openings shall have a height no greater than one [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
         3. In addition to the [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) above, an F-Screen 1 or F-Screen 2 pursuant to [Frontage Screen Types (Sec. 4C.8.1.C.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.1) is required between [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and all [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
      3. ##### Adaptable Parking


         Adaptable parking is intended to ensure floors used for [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are built in a way that allows [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to change to active [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in the future without significant structural [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.13.png.webp?itok=YeTqVVr_)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.13.png?itok=WP5I0l_G)
         1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required to be adaptable shall meet any frontage standards required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         2. Where required to be adaptable by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall meet the following standards for a minimum depth of 30 feet from the applicable [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#):

            1. Floor plates shall be level except to the minimum extent required for drainage.

            2. The [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be constructed to accommodate loads associated with office [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) corridors above the first floor under [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code.

            3. Floor to floor heights shall be a minimum of 11 feet.
         3. All [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) required to be adaptable shall also meet the standards for concealed parking pursuant to Subparagraph b. (Concealed Parking) above.
      4. ##### Wrapped Parking


         Wrapped parking is intended to ensure active [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s along the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in order to provide a human-scale and visual interest to [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s along streets and sidewalks, contributing to public safety, walkability and social engagement.
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.15.png.webp?itok=KEiwvecc)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.15.png?itok=PiTyIFGd)
         1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required to be wrapped shall meet any frontage standards required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         2. Where [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are required to be wrapped by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B); [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall meet the following standards for the portion of the [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) required to meet the minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) specified in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

            1. Parking and other [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be separated from the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by indoor active [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, as defined below, for a minimum depth of 15 feet measured from the applicable street-facing [building face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            2. For the purpose of wrapped parking, indoor active [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall mean indoor [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s designed and intended for tenants, [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or guests. Areas for circulation, storage, [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [utilities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), and waste collection shall not account for more than 15 percent of an area designated as an active [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on any [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.18.png.webp?itok=em-7CqEy)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.18.png?itok=gJ9RJpCv)
         3. The portion of the [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) not required to meet the minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) may meet either the standards for wrapped parking or concealed parking pursuant to Subparagraph b. (Concealed Parking) above.
4. ##### Measurement

    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.19.png.webp?itok=ZaGt37IB)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.4.5.19.png?itok=9zmKckgD)
1. ##### Opacity


      The following rules apply to measuring [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#):

      1. [Opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is calculated separately for each level of parking on each [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is a percentage calculated as the sum of all [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on a [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) level divided by the total [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) projected horizontally and perpendicular to the [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Also see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).

      3. When a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) level uses more than one [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) treatment with varying opacities, the [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for the entire level is calculated as a weighted average of the opacities of all the treatments used on the level. The [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of each [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) treatment is weighted by the percent of the total parking screen [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by that [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) treatment.

      4. [Above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) portions of underground and [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) using a green [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting the standards of [Sec. 3C.4.2.E.3.c. (Living Wall)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4.2) are considered to have an [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 60 percent.
2. ##### Parking Structure Screen Openings


      1. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen opening width is measured as the maximum horizontal dimension of the area not including the [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) treatment required by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B). [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen opening width is measured parallel to the [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. [Parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen opening height is measured as the maximum vertical dimension of the area on a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that does not include the [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) treatment required by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B)
5. ##### Exceptions


1. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that have a total [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of less than 30,000 square feet and contain [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s where upper stories are required to comply with [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.d. (Wrapped Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) above, may design [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) portions of [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to comply with the following standards rather than with [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.d. (Wrapped Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) above:

      1. [Upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.c. (Adaptable Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5); and

      2. The [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall meet all standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).
2. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that are required to comply with [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.c. (Adaptable Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) above, are exempted from all Adaptable Parking standards when the standalone or integrated [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is existing.

3. When a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is adding [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to an existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) but does not add additional [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is not required to comply with the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.c. (Adaptable Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) or [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.d. (Wrapped Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) regardless of the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), and shall follow the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.a. (Screened Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5).

4. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s adding additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) above an existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) where adaptable parking is required for applicable [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be exempt from the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.c. (Adaptable Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) for all portions of the existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and shall comply with all of the following:

      1. Existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be improved to comply with the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.d. (Wrapped Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) along the [ground floor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the existing street-facing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.a. (Screened Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) shall apply to the upper [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Any interior portions of the existing [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to existing ramps are exempt from the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.5.C.3.d. (Wrapped Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5) up until there is sufficient space to accommodate a minimum floor-to-ceiling height of nine feet beneath the ramp.
6. ##### Relief


1. An Alternative Compliance to any [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) design standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 4C.5. Transportation Demand Management

#### Sec. 4C.5.1. Small Projects

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Small Projects) is to alter travel behavior through programs of incentives, services, and policies appropriate for small [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including encouraging the use of alternatives to single-occupancy [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s such as public transit, cycling, walking, [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing and changes in work-schedule that move single occupancy [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips out of the peak period or eliminates them altogether.

2. ##### Applicability


Small Projects [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) adding more than 25,000 square feet and less than 50,000 square feet of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


Applicants shall provide and continually maintain in a state of good repair a bulletin board, display case, or kiosk meeting the following standards listed below and shall execute and record a covenant to the satisfaction of [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to ensure compliance.

1. The bulletin board, display case or kiosk display shall be located where the greatest number of employees are likely to see it.

2. The required bulletin board, display case or kiosk display shall include, but is not limited to, the following:

      1. Current routes and schedules for public transit serving the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

      2. Telephone numbers for referrals on transportation information including numbers for the regional ridesharing agency and local transit operations;

      3. Ridesharing promotion material supplied by commuter-oriented organizations, if any;

      4. Regional/local bicycle route and facility information; and

      5. A listing of on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) services or facilities which are available for [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), bicycle, and transit riders.
4. ##### Measurement


\[None\]

5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to Small Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1). In addition to the findings otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall find that the applicant has committed to provide equivalent alternative measures to reduce [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips.

2. A deviation from any Small Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any Small Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.5.2. Medium Projects

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Medium Projects) is to alter travel behavior through programs of incentives, services, and policies appropriate for medium [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including encouraging the use of alternatives to single-occupancy [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s such as public transit, cycling, walking, [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing and changes in work-schedule that move single-occupancy [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips out of the peak period or eliminates them altogether.

2. ##### Applicability


Medium Projects [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) adding more than 50,000 square feet and less than 100,000 square feet of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


Applicants shall provide and continually maintain in a state of good repair the [trip reduction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) features listed below, and execute and record a covenant to the satisfaction of [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to ensure compliance:

1. All [trip reduction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) features required for [Small Projects (Sec. 4C.5.1.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.5.1));

2. A designated [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for employee [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s as close as practical to the main pedestrian entrance(s) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)(s). This area shall include at least ten percent of the [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The spaces shall be [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ed and striped sufficient to meet the employee demand for such spaces. The [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be identified on the [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and circulation plan upon [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

3. One permanent, clearly identified (signed and striped) [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for the first 50,000 to 100,000 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and one additional permanent, clearly identified (signed and striped) [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) parking stall for any development over 100,000 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

4. [Parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s clearly identified (signed and striped) shall be provided in the designated [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at any time during the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s occupancy sufficient to meet employee demand for such spaces. Absent such demand, [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s within the designated [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be used by other [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s;

5. No signed and striped [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) parking shall displace any handicapped parking;

6. A statement that preferential [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) spaces are available on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and a description of the method for obtaining permission to use such spaces shall be included on the required transportation information board;

7. Additional [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) spaces within the designated preferential area shall be signed and striped for the use of ridesharing employees based on demand for such spaces;

8. A minimum vertical clearance of seven feet two inches shall be provided for all [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and accessways used by [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) vehicles when located within a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

9. Bicycle parking shall be provided in conformance with [Div. 4C.3. (Bicycle Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3).
4. ##### Measurement


\[None\]

5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to Medium Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1). In addition to the findings otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall find that the applicant has committed to provide equivalent alternative measures to reduce [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips.

2. A deviation from any Medium Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any Medium Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.5.3. Large Projects

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Large Projects) is to alter travel behavior through programs of incentives, services, and policies appropriate for large [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including encouraging the use of alternatives to single-occupancy [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s such as public transit, cycling, walking, [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing and changes in work-schedule that move single-occupancy [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips out of the peak period or eliminates them altogether.

2. ##### Applicability


Large Projects [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) adding more than 100,000 square feet of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


Applicants shall provide and continually maintain in a state of good repair the following [trip reduction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) features list below, and shall execute and record a covenant to the satisfaction of [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to ensure compliance:

1. All [trip reduction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) features required for [Small Projects (Sec. 4C.5.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.5.1);

2. All [trip reduction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) features required for [Medium Projects (Sec. 4C.5.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.5.2);

3. A safe and convenient area in which [carpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/ [vanpool](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may load and unload passengers other than in their assigned [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

4. Sidewalks or other designated passageways following direct and safe routes from the external pedestrian circulation system to each [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in the development;

5. If determined necessary by the [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to mitigate the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) impact, bus stop improvements shall be provided. [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall consult with the local bus service providers in determining appropriate improvements. When locating bus stops or planning [building entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, entrances shall be designed to provide safe and efficient [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to nearby [passenger transit facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)/stops; and

6. Safe and convenient [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) from the external circulation system to bicycle parking facilities on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
4. ##### Measurement


\[Reserved\]

5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to Large Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1). In addition to the findings otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall find that the applicant has committed to provide equivalent alternative measures to reduce [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips.

2. A deviation from any Large Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any Large Project [transportation demand management](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

4. In cases of extreme hardship, duly established to its satisfaction, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), acting in its legislative capacity, and by resolution, may grant an exemption from any/or all the provisions of this Section (Large Projects). In granting such an exemption, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall make the following findings:

      1. Specific features of the development make it infeasible to satisfy all of the provisions of this Section (Large Projects); and

      2. The applicant has committed to provide equivalent alternative measures to reduce [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) trips.

#### Sec. 4C.5.4. Monitoring

[LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be responsible for monitoring the owner/applicant’s continual implementation and maintenance of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [trip reduction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) features required by this Division (Transportation Demand Management).

### Div. 4C.6. Plants

#### Sec. 4C.6.1. Protected Vegetation

Provisions for [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are outlined in [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 46.02. (Requirements for Public Works Permits to Relocate or Remove Protected Trees and Shrubs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132276) of this Code and in [Sec. 11.1.3.P. (Protected Vegetation Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) of this Chapter 1A.

#### Sec. 4C.6.2. Required Trees

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Required Trees) is to maintain and increase the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)'s tree canopy, reduce consumption of electricity, improve air quality, promote infiltration of stormwater runoff, offset urban heat island effect, mitigate noise pollution, sequester carbon and support urban biodiversity.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Required Trees) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), which involves the removal and replacement of trees, or requires trees per the scope of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Trees Required Based on Floor Area


      1. One [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or two [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s per [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3. (Plant Type)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) shall be planted for every 4,000 square feet of total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) constructed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. In meeting the requirements of this Paragraph (Trees Required Based on Floor Area), one [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) planted in a [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is permitted in lieu of two small trees. One large tree planted in a [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is permitted in lieu of two large trees.
2. ##### Trees Required Based on Planting Area


      1. In addition to the requirements of the Paragraph above, one [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or two [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be planted for each 500 square feet of total required on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. If less than 500 square feet of on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required, at least one [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or two [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s per [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3. (Plant Type)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) shall be planted on every [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
3. ##### Allowable locations for Required Trees


      1. Required trees shall be planted either on-site, in a common area accessible to multiple [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s from a shared [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or in the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Trees planted in the [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) require approval from the Board of Public Works or its designee per [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.169 (Permit Required to Plant in Streets)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158842) of this Code.
4. ##### Relationship to Other Zoning Code Standards


      1. Trees provided to comply with other standards, including [Sec. 4C.4.3. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3), [Div. 4C.8. (Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8), [Sec. 3C.4.2.E.2. (Ground Story Inactive Wall Treatment Options), Sec. 3C.4.2.E.3. (Foundation Inactive Wall Treatment Options)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4.2), and [Sec. 8.3.2.B.3. (Freeway Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.3.2), may be counted toward compliance with the required trees standards in this Section (Required Trees). Additional trees beyond the minimum number required to comply with this Section (Required Trees), may be required to comply with other standards.

      2. All required trees shall be planted in accordance with the plant design and installation standards outlined in [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
4. ##### Measurements


1. When calculating the total number of required trees results in the requirement of a fraction of a tree, any fraction up to one-half may be disregarded and any fraction including and over one-half shall require one additional [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or two additional [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. For measuring [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

3. For large tree measurements see [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.a.ii. (Tree Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

4. For small tree measurements see [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.a.ii. (Tree Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

5. For measurement of [caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.10. (Caliper)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

6. For measurement of container size see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.9. (Container Size)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to tree planting standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)'s Determination may be granted to plant a required tree off- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on private property (with prior approval of the property owner) or along public streets (with the prior approval of the Board of Public Works or its designee) within one mile of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or pay an in-lieu fee in accordance with [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.177. (Establishment of Tree Replacement and Planting In-Lieu Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-316092) of this Code instead of planting a required tree. In order to approve the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)'s Determination, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall make the supplemental finding that required trees cannot feasibly be planted on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or in the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. A deviation from any tree requirement standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).
