#### Sec. 4C.6.4. Plant Design & Installation

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Plant Design & Installation) is to provide the necessary elements to support a healthy urban ecological system.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Plant Design & Installation) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      1. No invasive species may be planted in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Any plant listed by the [California Invasive Plant Inventory](https://www.cal-ipc.org/plants/inventory/) maintained by the California Invasive Plant Council (Cal-IPC) as an invasive or watch plant (including the ratings of "limited", "moderate", "high" or "watch") is considered an invasive species.

      2. Plants shall not interfere with visibility at intersections and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s per [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.200. (Street Intersections - Obstructions to Visibility)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158888) of this Code.

      3. No plant identified by the Los Angeles Fire Department as a prohibited flammable plant species is allowed in a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. No artificial plants, trees, or other plants may be installed as required planting.

      5. Required planting located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) identified as being within a " [Targeted Planting Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)" established by the [Targeted Planting Map (Sec. 1.5.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.5) shall meet the requirements outlined in the [targeted planting list](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for the applicable [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designation.

      6. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be subject to water efficiency standards according to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 99.04.304. (Outdoor Water Use)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-214998) or [Sec. 99.05.304. (Outdoor Water Use)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-215283#JD_99.05.304.) of this Code.

      7. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be subject to [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 64.72. (Stormwater and Urban Runoff Pollution Control Measures for Development Planning and Construction Activities)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-162923) of this Code.
2. ##### Planting Areas


      A planting area is defined as an area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designated and designed for plants.

      1. ##### General


         1. Areas that includes [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, footings or [flatwork](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not count toward any [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirement with the following exceptions:

            1. Planters located within 10 feet of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that are used to meet [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 64.72. (Stormwater and Urban Runoff Pollution Control Measures for Development Planning and Construction Activities)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-162923) of this Code may count toward required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            2. Planters located on or above a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) (examples include: roofs, terraces, bridges, balconies, and above or below ground [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s) may count toward required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
         2. Where planters are allowed to count toward [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) per this Subparagraph. (General), planters shall not be more than four feet in height, measured from [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         3. Where planters are allowed to count toward [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) per this Subparagraph. (General), planters located within five feet of the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), and located entirely below the top of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), shall not have drainage or weep holes [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         4. [Planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall include an automatic irrigation system in compliance with [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 99.04.304. (Outdoor Water Use)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-214998) of this Code.

         5. [Planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have no horizontal dimension less than three feet.

         6. [Planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have a minimum plant coverage of 75 percent measured pursuant to [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.2. (Plant Coverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) below.

         7. All plants used to meet the minimum plant coverage standard, measured pursuant to [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.2. (Plant Coverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) below, shall meet the applicable plant type planting specification standards in Paragraph 3. (Plant Type) below. When [rooftop planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply and conflict with the plant type planting specifications, [rooftop planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards supersede.

         8. [Planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall cumulatively include at least the minimum number of trees as specified in [Sec. 4C.6.2.C.2. (Trees Required Based on Planting Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.2).
      2. ##### Rooftop Planting Areas


         Rooftop planting areas are areas where plants are provided on or over a built [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including but not limited to, a roof, a bridge, a balcony or a [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Rooftop planting areas shall comply with the following standards:

         1. Where [rooftop planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards conflict with planting specifications within Paragraph 3. (Plant Type) below, [rooftop planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards supersede.

         2. Minimum [soil depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [soil volume](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for required plants, is as follows:



            |     |     |     |     |     |     |
            | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
            | Trees |  | Other Plants |
            | Height at Maturity | Soil Volume (min) | Soil Depth (min) |  | Height at Maturity | Soil Depth (min) |
            | 15' to 19' | 220 ft3 | 36" |  | <5.9" | 12" |
            | 20' to 24' | 400 ft3 | 36" |  | 6" to 11" | 18" |
            | 25' to 29' | 620 ft3 | 42" |  | 1' to 7' | 24" |
            | 30' to 34' | 900 ft3 | 42" |  | 8' to 14' | 30" |
            | 35' to 39' | 1,200 ft3 | 42" |  | 15' to 24' | 36" |
            | 40' or more | 1,600 ft3 | 48" |  | 25' or more | 42" |

         3. All [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be setback from the edge of the roof a minimum of 2/3 the mature height of the tree measured perpendicularly from the edge of the roof to the center of the tree trunk. The required setback may be reduced by an amount equivalent to the height of a guard rail or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is provided along the perimeter of the roof edge. The guard rail or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height is measured vertically from the top of the [root flare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the topmost point of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or guardrail.

         4. All rooftop gardens and landscapes shall comply with [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Sec. 57.317. (Rooftop Gardens and Landscaped Roofs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-345545) of this Code.
3. ##### Plant Type


      1. ##### Trees


         1. ##### General


            1. Palms and bamboo do not count as required trees, with the exception of existing palm trees located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) identified as being within a " [Targeted Planting Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)" established by the [Targeted Planting Map (Sec. 1.5.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.5). In these " [Targeted Planting Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s", existing palms may count as a required tree provided that the specific palm tree species meets the requirements outlined in the [targeted planting list](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for the applicable " [Targeted Planting Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)".

            2. Existing trees count toward the minimum tree requirement based on tree type pursuant to Sub-subparagraph ii. (Tree Types) below (large species or small species), provided each tree is healthy and has a minimum one inch [caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), and meets all other applicable standards. An existing [significant tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is permitted in lieu of two [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or four [small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
         2. ##### Tree Types


            1. [Large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have a minimum height of 30 feet at maturity.

            2. [Small species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have a height at maturity between 15 and 30 feet.
         3. ##### Planting Specifications


            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.1.png.webp?itok=aDG87CFA)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.1.png?itok=WZM_x2tA)

            All trees that are provided in order to comply with a standard in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and their [planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall meet the following standards:

            01. Located within a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting Paragraph 2. (Planting Areas) above.

            02. For trees located in surface [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be a minimum width of two times the width of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            03. For all other trees, [planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be a minimum width of three times the width of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            04. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be no deeper than the height of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            05. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be backfilled with Class A top soil or native variety.

            06. Backfill soil shall be compacted to no more than 70 percent.

            07. Soil beneath the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be compacted to at least 90 percent.

            08. No other plants may be planted within two feet of a tree, measured from the center of the tree trunk.

            09. All required trees, shall have a minimum 15 gallon container size and a minimum [caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of one inch at the time of planting or as specified by the [American Standard for Nursery Stock](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            10. Required trees planted in a [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), per [Sec. 4C.6.2.C.3. (Allowable Locations for Required Trees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.2), in which the sidewalk is eight feet in width or greater shall have a minimum 36-inch box.
      2. ##### Screening Plants


         1. ##### General


            1. Required [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be perennial including, shrubs, vines, succulents, grasses and ferns.

            2. Required [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall have a minimum height at maturity of three feet.
         2. ##### Planting Specifications


            All [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and their [planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided to meet a [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirement shall meet the following standards:

            1. Located within a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting Paragraph 2. (Planting Areas) above.

            2. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have a minimum width of two times the width of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            3. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be no deeper than the height of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            4. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be backfilled with Class A top soil or native variety.

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.3.png.webp?itok=No8TI4ro)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.3.png?itok=CVNzWZS_)

            5. Required [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall have a minimum height of 18 inches at time of planting.
      3. ##### Groundcover & Turf Plants


         Turf plants such as sodded or seeded grass areas provided to meet a planting requirement shall meet the following standards:

         1. Located within a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting Paragraph 2. (Planting Areas) above.

         2. Minimum top [soil depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of six inches.

         3. Top soil shall be Class A top soil or native variety.

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.5.png.webp?itok=O7i7yDI_)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.5.png?itok=xtOlFvsJ)
      4. ##### Hedges


         1. ##### General


            1. Hedges include all shrubs planted closer than half of their height at maturity from another shrub or tree and all trees planted closer than half of their canopy diameter at maturity from another tree.

            2. Trees planted at least three feet apart having no branches a minimum of six feet from surrounding [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are not considered a hedge and are not regulated by maximum hedge standards.
         2. ##### Planting Specifications


            Shrubs and their [planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided as part of a hedge shall meet the following standards:

            1. Located within a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting Paragraph 2. (Planting Areas) above.

            2. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have a minimum width of two times the width of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            3. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be no deeper than the height of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

            4. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be backfilled with Class A top soil or native variety.

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.7.png.webp?itok=oslGNV9c)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.6.4.7.png?itok=20KRde9p)
      5. ##### Living Walls


         [Living wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided to meet a requirement shall meet the following standards:

         1. Permanently attached to the exterior of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. Automatic irrigation system permanently integrated into the assembly in compliance with [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec 99.04.304. (Outdoor Water Use)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-214998) of this Code.

         3. Growing medium shall be permanently integrated into the assembly while retaining the ability to remove, replace and maintain the plants and growing medium.

         4. Minimum [soil depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of four inches of Class A top soil or native variety

         5. Minimum 75 percent plant coverage at maturity, measured vertically.

         6. For [living wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), plants shall be maintained so as not to obstruct the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      6. ##### All Other Plants


         All plants, other than [living wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, hedges, groundcover and turf plants, [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and trees provided to meet a planting requirement shall meet the following standards:

         1. Located within a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting Paragraph 2. (Planting Areas) above.

         2. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have a minimum width of two times the width of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         3. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be no deeper than the height of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         4. [Planting hole](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be backfilled with Class A top soil or native variety.
4. ##### Maintenance


      1. All required plants shall be maintained in good and healthy condition.

      2. All required plants shall be allowed to reach and be maintained at no less than the anticipated spread at maturity or canopy diameter and the anticipated height at maturity.

      3. Landscape and [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) areas shall be kept free of weeds and trash.

      4. “Topping,” defined as removal of more than 1/3 of the leaves and branches of a tree as measured from the lowest branch on the trunk of the tree to the top of the tree, is prohibited, except as required by a [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) department, utility, or other government agency.
4. ##### Measurement


01. ##### Planting Area Width


       [Planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width is measured as the narrowest horizontal dimension from one edge of an area complying with [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) above to the opposite edge.

02. ##### Plant Coverage


       Plant coverage is measured as the cumulative area of a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) covered by plants divided by the total [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       1. Trees count as plant coverage only for the portion of a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) within two feet of a tree, measured as a circle, centered on the trunk of the tree, with a radius of two feet.

       2. All other plants count as plant coverage for 70 percent of the plant's anticipated canopy diameter or [spread at maturity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) pursuant to Paragraph 3. (Canopy Diameter, Spread, & Height at Maturity) below.
03. ##### Canopy Diameter, Spread, & Height at Maturity


       Canopy diameter at maturity, spread at maturity and height at maturity shall be specified in "Landscape Plants for California Gardens", or other locally calibrated and professionally recognized source.

04. ##### Soil Depth


       [Soil depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the shortest vertical dimension of growing medium provided, for all portions of a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

05. ##### Soil Volume


       [Soil volume](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the total volume of growing medium provided. Drainage layers and other elements located within a container or planter that are not growing medium are not included in the calculation of [soil volume](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

06. ##### Root ball Depth


       Depth of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured from the [root flare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the bottom of the [root mass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or bottom of the container.

07. ##### Root ball Width


       Width of the [root ball](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the shortest horizontal dimension of the [root mass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or container from one end to the opposite end.

08. ##### Height at Planting


       1. Height at planting is measured from the [root flare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. For evergreens, height at planting is measured vertically to the midpoint of the [leader](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between the uppermost [whorl](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) (branch) and the top of the [leader](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       3. For deciduous shrubs, height at planting is measured vertically to the top of the shortest of all [canes](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       4. For all other plants, height at planting is measured vertically to the highest point of the plant.
09. ##### Container Size


       1. Container size is measured in accordance with the [American Standard for Nursery Stock](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. When a minimum container size is indicated by a standard, all equivalent or greater container sizes are also requested in accordance with [American Standard for Nursery Stock](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) container class volume ranges.
10. ##### Caliper


       1. For fruit trees, small fruits, understock and seedling trees and shrubs, [caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measurement shall be taken at the [root collar](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or at the other points expressly described in the applicable sections of the [American Standard for Nursery Stock](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. [Caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for trees with multiple stems is measured as one-half the sum of the [caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of the three largest trunks.

       3. For all other plants, [caliper](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) measurement shall be taken six inches above the [root collar](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
11. ##### Height at Maturity


       1. Height at maturity is measured from the [root flare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. For evergreens, height at maturity is measured vertically to the midpoint of the [leader](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between the uppermost [whorl](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) (branch) and the top of the [leader](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       3. For deciduous shrubs, height at maturity is measured vertically to the top of the shortest of all [canes](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       4. For all other plants, height at maturity is measured vertically to the highest point of the plant.
5. ##### Exceptions


Plant design and installation standards do not apply to plants which are not required by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to plant design and installation standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any plant design and installation dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any plant design and installation standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 4C.7. Fences & Walls

#### Sec. 4C.7.1. Frontage Yard Fences & Walls

For [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and hedges allowed in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 3C.3.2. (Frontage Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.2).

#### Sec. 4C.7.2. Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls) is to provide security and privacy for private [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in a manner appropriate to context.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) involving [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s within the [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


1. [Side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and hedges shall be no taller than specified for the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) in the following table:




      | Side/Rear Yard Fence, Wall Height |
      | --- |
      | Use Districts | Height (Max) |
      | --- | --- |
      | Open Space (OS) | 8' |
      | Agricultural (A) | 8' |
      | Residential (RG) | 8' |
      | Residential-Mixed (RX) | 8' |
      | Commercial-Mixed (CX) | 8' |
      | Industrial-Mixed (IX) | 8' |
      | Industrial (I) | None\* |
      | Public (P) | None\* |
      | \\* A [Class 1 Conditional Use Permit (Sec. 13B.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1) is required for [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s exceeding eight feet in height or the maximum height established by [Sec. 4C.7.2.E.1. (Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2) below where they are [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) zoned with a [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) other than a [Industrial Use District (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7), or [Public Use District (Div. 5B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.8). |

2. All [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).

3. All hedges provided shall comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
4. ##### Measurement


1. Where the difference in [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on either side of a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is less than two feet, height is measured from [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at the base of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on the side with the highest [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). [Finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on either side of a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the highest and lowest [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) within three feet of the [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.7.2.1.png.webp?itok=aICn_JVl)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.7.2.1.png?itok=Gmr4BSnU)

2. Where the difference in [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on either side of a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is two feet or greater, height is measured from the top of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the average of the [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on either side of the [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), (referred to as the midpoint of the [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in the image below). [Finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on either side of a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured as the highest and lowest [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) within three feet of the [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.7.2.3.png.webp?itok=zEtyiC7O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.7.2.3.png?itok=UbqoJ96c)

3. [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located in a [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are measured vertically from the nearest surface of the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), to the topmost point of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.7.2.5.png.webp?itok=2T1HfbRh)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.7.2.5.png?itok=twWmowm4)
5. ##### Exceptions


1. Where a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) minimum height requirement that exceeds the maximum height allowed in Subsection C. (Standards) above, the maximum [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height allowed shall instead be two feet greater than the minimum [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height specified by the required applicable [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards.

2. This Section (Side/Rear Fences & Walls) does not apply to [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.7.3. Fence/Wall Design & Installation

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Fence/Wall Design & Installation) is to allow for needed security and privacy while preventing looming, and ensuring adequate [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to light and air for [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) properties.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Fence/Wall Design & Installation) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When the Fence/Wall Design & Installation standards apply, they apply to the [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, or hedges on any portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      1. No [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be constructed of tires, junk, leaves or other discarded materials.

      2. [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not interfere with visibility at intersections and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s pursuant to [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.200. (Street Intersections - Obstructions to Visibility)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158888) of this Code.
2. ##### Maintenance


      [Wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be maintained in good repair and shall be kept vertical, structurally sound and protected from deterioration.
4. ##### Measurement


\[Reserved\]

5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to Fence/Wall Design & Installation standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any Fence/Wall Design & Installation dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any Fence/Wall Design & Installation standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 4C.8. Screening

#### Sec. 4C.8.1. Frontage Screens

A frontage screen is a device or combination of elements, including [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, trees and other plants, along a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that conceals, obstructs or protects the public realm from [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, activities, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) elements.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Frontage Screens) is to mitigate negative impacts from subject [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, activities, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) elements with significant impacts on the public realm, promoting visual interest and increasing comfort for [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) rs of the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


[Frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to specified [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) when required by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), including, but not limited to, the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), [Sec. 4C.2.2. (Motor Vehicle Use Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2), [Sec. 4C.2.2.C.3. (Drive-Through Facilities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2), [Sec. 4C.2.2.C.2. (Freight Loading Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2), [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4) or [Sec. 4C.4.5. (Parking Structure Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      01. Required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be located between the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), area, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) element subject to [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements and all [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. Any [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) required by the [frontage screen type](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be continuous with the following exceptions:

          1. Openings in a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) accommodating [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are allowed for a width no greater than eight feet in width for each individual [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Where an opening in the [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) accommodates both pedestrian and automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the maximum allowable opening width is eight feet greater than the maximum allowed [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width.

          2. Openings in a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) accommodating automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are allowed for a width no greater than the maximum allowed [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width allowed by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

          3. For portions of [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of at least 10 feet in height is located between the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), area, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) element subject to [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing requirements, no [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required as part of the [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided that the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is contiguous with the required [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      02. Required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s including their sub-grade elements, such as footings or foundations, shall be located entirely on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      03. Where there are overlapping [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements, the screen type with the highest minimum height of [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall apply. Where none of the required screen types have a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or wall requirement, the screen type with the widest required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall apply.

      04. Where a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may only be located in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) if the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) complies with the allowed frontage yard fence & wall standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B). [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, activities, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) elements subject to [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ing requirements shall not be located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) if the required minimum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height specified by the [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) exceeds the maximum height of allowed frontage yard fence & walls as specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      05. Where a required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a minimum height that exceeds the maximum height allowed in the [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) per [Sec. 4C.7.2.C.2. (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2) pursuant to [Sec. 4C.7.2.E. (Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2), the maximum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height standard for [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be two feet greater than the minimum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height required for the [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      06. All [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided in a [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).

      07. All plants provided in a [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      08. Maximum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height is regulated by [Sec. 4C.7.1. (Frontage Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.1) and [Sec. 4C.7.2. (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2).

      09. [Wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided to meet the standards of any required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not include barbed wire or concertina.

      10. For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.8. (Frontage Screens & Transition Screens)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17)
2. ###### Frontage Screen Types


      Frontage screen types are packages of standards for required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.





      |     |     |     |

#### Sec. 4C.8.2. Transition Screens

A transition screen is defined as a device or combination of elements along a [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that conceals, obstructs or protects [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s from impactful uses, activities, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) elements.

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Transition Screens) is to mitigate negative impacts from subject [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, activities, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) elements on [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, promoting visual interest and increasing comfort for users of the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the public realm and [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


[Transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to specified [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) when required by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), including, but not limited to, the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), [Sec. 4C.2.2. (Motor Vehicle Use Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2), [Sec. 4C.2.2.C.3. (Drive-Through Facilities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2), [Sec. 4C.2.2.C.2. (Freight Loading Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2), [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4), [Sec. 4C.4.5. (Parking Structure Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5), [Sec. 4C.8.2.C.2.a. (Freeway Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.2), or [Sec. 8.3.2.B.3. (Freeway Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.3.2).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      01. Required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be located between the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), area, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) element subject to [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements and all [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. Any [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required by the [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be continuous with the following exceptions:

          1. Openings in a required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) accommodating [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are allowed for a width no greater than six feet in width for each individual [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

          2. For portions of [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of no less that 10 feet in height is located between the [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), area, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) element subject to [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements, no [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required as part of the [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided that the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is contiguous with the required [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      02. Required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s including their sub-grade elements, such as footings or foundations, shall be located entirely on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      03. Where there are overlapping [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements, the screen with the highest minimum height [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall apply. Where none of the required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s have a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirement, the [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with the widest required [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall apply.

      04. Where a required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may only be located in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) if the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) complies with the allowed frontage yard fence & wall standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B). Uses, activities, or [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) elements subject to [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements shall not be located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) if the required minimum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height specified by the [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) exceeds the maximum height of allowed frontage yard fence & walls as specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      05. Where a required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a minimum height requirement that exceeds the maximum height allowed in the [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) per [Sec. 4C.7.2. (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2), pursuant to [Sec. 4C.7.2.E. (Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2) the maximum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height standard for Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls shall be two feet greater than the minimum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height required for the [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      06. All [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided in a [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).

      07. All plants provided in a [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      08. Maximum [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height is regulated by [Sec. 4C.7.1. (Frontage Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.1) and [Sec. 4C.7.2. (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2).

      09. [Wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s provided to meet the standards of any required [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not include barbed wire or concertina.

      10. For a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) affected by a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.17.B.8. (Frontage Screens & Transition Screens)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.17).
2. ##### Freeway Screening


      1. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a Freeway (FWY) Special Zone (Sec. 8.3.2.) shall provide a [T-Screen 3 (4C.8.2.C.3.c.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3) for the entire length of any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a Freeway (FWY) [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. On [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with an applied [Freeway (FWY) Special Zones (Sec. 8.3.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.3.2), [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be provided as according to [Sec. 8.3.2.B.3. (Freeway Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.3.2).

(Fence & Wall Height)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.2).

1. Alternative Compliance to [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.8.3. Outdoor Storage Screening

Outdoor storage screening is defined as [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s surrounding outdoor storage areas in which goods, material, and equipment, new or used, are held outside of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for future use

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Outdoor Storage Screening) is to ensure [storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) areas are designed in a manner that conceals, obstructs or protects [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s from impactful activities associated with [storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

2. ##### Applicability


[Outdoor storage screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) when required by an applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Location


      [Storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and its [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not be located in any of the following locations:

      1. In a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Closer to any [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) than the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) setback listed in the applicable outdoor storage screening type pursuant to Paragraph 3. (Outdoor Storage Screening Types) below.
2. ##### Screening Enclosure


      1. [Storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) areas shall be screened with the [outdoor storage screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type specified by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

      2. Gates provided in the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the standards of the applicable [outdoor storage screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type pursuant to Paragraph 3. (Outdoor Storage Screening Types) below in addition to the following standards:

         1. Shall have a height of no less than the minimum required [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height.

         2. Where a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is taller than the minimum height, gates shall be no more than one foot shorter than the height of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided.

         3. In no case shall gates exceed the height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by more than one foot.
      3. No material or equipment shall be stored to a height greater than the height of the enclosing [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. All provided [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with [Sec 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design and Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).
