### Div. 4C.9. Grading & Retaining Walls

#### Sec. 4C.9.1. Grading & Hauling

\[Reserved\]

#### Sec. 4C.9.2. Retaining Walls

A retaining wall is defined as a freestanding continuous [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), as viewed from the top, intended to support earth, which is not attached to a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Retaining Walls) is to prevent [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s which loom over neighboring properties and [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and improve the aesthetic quality of large [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


[Retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is designated with an Agricultural or Residential [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), is also located within a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), and is developed or to be developed with [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      A maximum of one free-standing vertical or approximately vertical [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be built on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a maximum height of 12 feet. However, as shown in the diagram below, a maximum of two vertical or approximately vertical [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or portions of a [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) can be built if they comply with all of the following standards:

      1. The minimum horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between the two [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s is three feet,

      2. Neither of the two [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s exceed a height of 10 feet, and

      3. In no case shall the height of a [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located in a [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) exceed the maximum height specified by the frontage yard fence & wall type allowed in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B), except as allowed in [Sec. 4C.7.2. (Side/Rear Yard Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.2).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.9.2.1.png.webp?itok=2ro7bStE)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.9.2.1.png?itok=TL0mfNLg)
2. ##### Landscaping


      All [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of eight feet or greater in height shall be landscaped so as to be completely hidden from view and in accordance with any plant standards in [Div. 4C.6. (Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6), and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards in [Div. 4C.7. (Fences & Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7).
4. ##### Measurement


The height of [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s is measured from the top of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the lower side of the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) ground [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

5. ##### Exceptions


1. ##### Exception for Public Agency Projects


      This Section (Retaining Walls) does not apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s undertaken by a public agency.

2. ##### Exception for Retaining Walls Required by Building and Safety


      The provisions of this Section (Retaining Walls) do not apply to any [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) built to comply with an order issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to repair an unsafe or substandard condition.

3. ##### Exception for Retaining Walls Approved Prior to March 9th, 2005


      See [Sec. 12.4.1. (Retaining Walls Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.4.1) for exceptions to the standards in this Section (Retaining Walls) for [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s approved prior to March 9th, 2005.
6. ##### Relief


1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may approve [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that exceed the heights or the maximum number allowed in this Section (Retaining Walls) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1).

2. A deviation from any [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 4C.10. Outdoor Lighting & Glare

#### Sec. 4C.10.1. Outdoor Lighting

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Outdoor Lighting) is to minimize [light trespass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and provide lighting standards to support a variety of environments.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Outdoor Lighting) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When the outdoor lighting standards apply, they apply to the installation or alteration of new and existing outdoor lighting, including exterior [luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, new and existing [luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located within [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and new and existing illuminated [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Light Trespass


      1. Outdoor [luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that have the ability to be redirected, shall be directed away from [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to minimize [light trespass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall construct, establish, create, or maintain any stationary exterior light source that may cause [light trespass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) onto [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s exceeding the following amounts:

         1. From any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) onto a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with an applied [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), the maximum allowable [light trespass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be 0.5 [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s (5.38 lux).

         2. From any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) onto a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with an applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) other than a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), the maximum allowable [light trespass](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be one [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) (10.76 lux).
      3. The owner of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with any existing light source shall bring such light source into compliance with this Section (Outdoor Lighting) upon receipt of written notice from the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
2. ##### Lighting Quantity


      1. All [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and garages provided for three or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall have an average [horizontal illuminance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of at least 0.2 [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s (2.15 lux), measured from the finished surface of the [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a special river [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) according to [Sec. 14.2.12.C.3. (Special Lot Line)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12) must meet the additional standards below:

         1. All [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) mounted lighting shall be designed such that it produces a maximum initial luminance value no greater than 0.20 horizontal and vertical [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s (2.15 lux) at the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) boundary and no greater than 0.01 horizontal [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s (0.11 lux) 15 feet beyond the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. All low pressure sodium, high pressure sodium, metal halide, fluorescent, quartz, incandescent greater than 60 watts, mercury vapor, and halogen lighting shall be in a [fully shielded luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
3. ##### Pedestrian-Oriented Lighting


      The walking surface of spaces required to install pedestrian-oriented lighting shall be illuminated to the following standards:

      1. A minimum average [horizontal illuminance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 0.75 [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

      2. A [uniformity ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 3:1.

      3. [Luminaire](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be mounted no more than 15 feet above the walking surface.
4. ##### Measurement


A [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is a unit of illuminance. One [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is equivalent to one lumen per square foot and shall be measured using a light meter.

5. ##### Relief


A deviation from any lighting standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).


#### Sec. 4C.10.2. Glare

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Glare) is to prevent the generation of high levels of glare and reflected heat resulting in detrimental effects on surrounding properties and the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Glare) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) involving the installation or alteration of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) materials on a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


[Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not use materials with an external reflectance rating of 30 percent or greater.

4. ##### Measurement


External reflectance values are based on spectrophotometric measurements and energy distribution of solar radiation, and shall be measured according to the listed specifications for each glass product.

5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to any glare standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any glare standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

### Div. 4C.11. Signs

#### Sec. 4C.11.1. General Sign Rules

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Division (Signs) is to promote public safety and welfare by regulating [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in keeping with the following objectives:

1. That the design, construction, installation, repair and maintenance of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s will not interfere with traffic safety or otherwise endanger public safety.

2. That the regulations will provide reasonable protection to the visual environment by controlling the size, height, spacing and location of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. That both the public and [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) users will benefit from [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s having improved legibility, readability and visibility.

4. That consideration will be given to equalizing the opportunity for messages to be displayed.

5. That adequacy of message opportunity will be available to [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) users without dominating the visual appearance of the area.

6. That the regulations will conform to judicial decisions, thereby limiting costly litigation and facilitating enforcement of these regulations.
2. ##### Applicability


General [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) rules standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When general [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) rules standards apply, the standards apply to exterior [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [window sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, which are not located entirely in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


01. ##### Ideological, Political, and Non-Commercial Messages


       No provision of this Division (Signs) prohibits an ideological, political or other non- [commercial message](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) otherwise permitted by this Division (Signs).

02. ##### Sign Height


       A [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not be located at a height that exceeds the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height limit specified by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

03. ##### Sign Illumination Limitations


       No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be arranged and illuminated in a manner that will produce a light intensity of greater than 3.0 [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s above ambient lighting, as measured at the property line. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) illumination shall also comply with any applicable provisions from [Sec. 4C.10.1. (Outdoor Lighting)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).

04. ##### Maintenance


       1. ##### Appearance


          Every [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be maintained in a clean, safe and good working condition, including the replacement of defective parts, defaced or broken faces, lighting and other acts required for the maintenance of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Display surfaces shall be kept neatly painted or posted at all times.

       2. ##### Debris Removal


          The base of any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) erected on the ground shall be kept clear of weeds, rubbish or other combustible material at all times.

       3. ##### Abandoned Signs


          Ninety days after the cessation of a business activity, service or product, the related [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be removed, or the face of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s removed and replaced with blank panels, or be painted out.
05. ##### Hazard To Traffic


       1. ##### Prohibition


          No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be erected, constructed, painted or maintained, and no permit shall be issued, if the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), because of its location, size, nature or type, constitutes a hazard to the safe and efficient operation of [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s upon a street or a [freeway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or creates a condition that endangers the safety of [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or property.

       2. ##### Hazard Referral


          The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will refer the following to [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for hazard evaluation and determination prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#):

          1. All permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that will be visible from and are located within 500 feet of the [main traveled roadway of a freeway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#); and

          2. All other permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that are determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to have a potential for hazard.
       3. ##### Hazard Determination


          [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will return to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) each [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) given to it together with a statement of its determination. If [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) determines that the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will constitute a hazard, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall deny the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for permit.
06. ##### Freeway Exposure


       1. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall erect, construct, install, paint or maintain, and no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or electrical permit can be issued for, any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) within 2,000 feet of a [freeway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) unless the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) has determined that the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) will not be viewed primarily from a [main traveled roadway of a freeway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or an on-ramp/off-ramp.

       2. The phrase "viewed primarily from" means that the message may be seen with reasonable clarity for a greater [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) traveling on the [main traveled roadway of a freeway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or on-ramp/off-ramp than by a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) traveling on the street [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
07. ##### Sign Permit Priority Status


       1. To maintain location, area, frontage, or spacing status, [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be installed within six months of issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and prior to expiration of any permit extension granted by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. When more than one permit is issued for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and the more recently issued permit or permits cause such [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to violate this Division (Signs), the more recently issued permit or permits are invalid and are subject to revocation. Any prior issued permits remain valid provided that such permits were issued in compliance with this Division (Signs).
08. ##### Prohibited Signs


       [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are prohibited if they:

       01. Contain obscene matters, as defined in [California Penal Code, Part 1. (of Crimes and Punishments), Sec. 311. (Obscene Matter)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PEN&sectionNum=311).

       02. Contain or consist of posters, pennants, banners, ribbons, streamers or spinners, except as permitted in [Sec. 4C.11.2. (Temporary Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.2).

       03. Contain flashing, mechanical and strobe lights in conflict with the provisions of [Chapter VIII. (Traffic), Sec. 80.08.4. (Flashing Lights – Interference With Traffic Signals)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-165511) or [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 93.0107. (Distracting, Confusing or Nuisance Lighting Viewed From Public Streets, Highways or Other Public Thoroughfares Used by Vehicular Traffic)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-183693) of this Code.

       04. Are revolving and where all or any portion rotate at greater than six revolutions per minute.

       05. Are tacked, pasted or otherwise temporarily affixed on the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, barns, sheds, trees, poles, posts or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, except as permitted in [Sec. 4C.11.2. (Temporary Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.2).

       06. Are affixed to any [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or trailer on private property if the [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or trailer is not intended to be otherwise used in the business and the sole purpose of attaching the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or trailer is to attract people to a place of business.

       07. Emit audible sounds, odor or visible matter.

       08. Use human beings, live animals, animated figures, motion pictures or projectors or any other means that causes continuous motion in connection with any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       09. Are [supergraphic sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, except where [supergraphic sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are specifically permitted pursuant to a legally-adopted [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an approved development agreement or a [Sign District (Sec. 8.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.2.3). In addition, despite the provisions of [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2. (Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1), this prohibition does not apply to any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) issued prior to August 14, 2009 if the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) determines that both substantial liabilities have been incurred, and substantial work has been performed on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), in accordance with the terms of that permit pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.106.4.3.1. (Limit of Authorization)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code.

       10. Are [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including off- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, except when [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are specifically permitted pursuant to a relocation agreement entered into pursuant to [California Business and Professions Code, Div. 3. (Professions and Vocations Generally), Sec. 5412. (Regulations)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=5412.&lawCode=BPC). This prohibition also applies to alterations, enlargements or conversions to [digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of legally existing [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, except for alterations that conform to the provisions of [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.6216. (Existing Signs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-177158) and all other requirements of this Code. This prohibition does not apply to [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including off-site [digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, that are specifically permitted pursuant to a legally-adopted [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an approved development agreement or a Sign District. In addition, despite the provisions of [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2. (Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1), this prohibition does not apply to any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) issued prior to August 14, 2009 if the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) determines that both substantial liabilities have been incurred, and substantial work has been performed on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), in accordance with the terms of that permit pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.106.4.3.1. (Limit of Authorization)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code.

       11. Are inflatable devices, except where inflatable devices are specifically permitted pursuant to a legally-adopted [Specific Plan (Div. 8.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.1), a [Supplemental District (Div. 8.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.2), or an approved development agreement.
09. ##### Prohibited Locations


       1. No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall project into any public [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), except that a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) above a height of 14 feet may project no more than six inches into a public [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

       2. No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located less than six feet horizontally or 12 feet vertically from overhead electrical conductors energized in excess of 750 volts. As used here, the term overhead electrical conductors means any electrical conductor, either bare or insulated, installed above-ground, except electrical conductors that are surrounded in iron pipe or other material covering of equal strength. Arcs of six-foot radius may be used to define corners of the prohibition area.

       3. No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be erected in a visibility triangle as defined by [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.200. (Street Intersections - Obstructions to Visibility)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158888) of this Code.

       4. No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located within two feet of the curb or edge of any [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
10. ##### Temporary Signs


       For additional standards applicable to [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, see [Sec. 4C.11.2. (Temporary Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.2).

11. ##### Off-site Signs


       For additional standards applicable to [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, see [Sec. 4C.11.3. (Off-Site Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.3).

12. ##### On-Site Signs


       For additional standards applicable to [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, see [Sec. 4C.11.4. (On-Site Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.4).
4. ##### Measurement


For the measurement of [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 4C.10.1.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).

5. ##### Exceptions


1. ##### General


      A [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), having no [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) visible from any public or private [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), that is fully surrounded on all sides by permanent, opaque [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, freestanding [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, roofs, or overhangs, is not subject to the requirements of this Division (Signs) except for the general brightness limitation set forth in [Sec. 4C.11.1.C.3. (Sign Illumination Limitations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1).

2. ##### Wall Signs


      [Wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in compliance with all of the standards below are exempt from the limitations in [Sec. 4C.11.1.C.6. (Freeway Exposure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1).

      1. The total area of all [wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not exceed 100 square feet.

      2. An individual [wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not exceed 50 square feet in area.

      3. [Wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that can be viewed primarily from an off ramp and not from the [main traveled roadway of a freeway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. [Wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not have moving parts or any arrangement of lights that create the illusion of movement.
3. ##### Original Art Murals, Vintage Original Art Murals & Public Art Installations


      1. ##### General


         1. A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) from the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required for the necessary physical alterations to a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or other [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s due to a new hand-tiled or digitally printed [original art mural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or any [public art installation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that may require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      2. ##### Original Art Mural


         An original art mural is a one-of-a-kind, hand-painted, hand-tiled, or digitally printed image on the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that does not contain any [commercial message](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         1. An [original art mural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that conforms to the requirements of [Sec. 22.119. (Original Art Murals on Private Property)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-48276) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is not considered a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and is not subject to the provisions of this Division (Signs) or any other ordinance that regulates [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

         2. Any supposed "mural" that does not conform to the requirements of [Sec. 22.119. (Original Art Murals on Private Property)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-48276) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is considered a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and is subject to the provisions of this Division (Signs) or any other ordinance that regulates [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
      3. ##### Vintage Original Art Mural


         A vintage original art mural is an [original art mural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that existed prior to October 12, 2013 (the operative date of [Ord. No. 182,706](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2011/11-0923_ord_182706.pdf)).

         1. A [vintage original art mural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that conforms to the requirements of [Sec. 22.119.(c) (Grandfathering of Vintage Original Art Murals)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-48276) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is not considered a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and is not subject to the provisions of this Division (Signs) or any other ordinance that regulates [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
      4. ##### Public Art Installation


         A public art installation is a facility, amenity or [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that does not contain any [commercial message](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and which is either an "approved public arts [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)" as defined by [Sec. 19.85.4. (Direct Expenditure on Approved Public Arts Projects)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-44991) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or approved pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.107.4.6. (Arts Development Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172789) of this Code.

         1. A [public art installation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) registered pursuant to the requirements of [Sec. 19.85.4. (Direct Expenditure on Approved Public Arts Projects)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-44991) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or the requirements of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.107.4.6 (Arts Development Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172789) of this Code is not considered a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), but is subject to [Sec. 4C.11.1.C.3. (Sign Illumination Limitations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1) and any other applicable zoning and land use regulations set forth in the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
4. ##### Existing Nonconforming Signs


      See [Sec. 12.4.2. (Signs Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.4.2).
6. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.11.2. Temporary Signs

A temporary sign is any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is to be maintained for a limited duration, including paper [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, posters, pennants, banners, ribbons, streamers, spinners, and other [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that are not permanently affixed to the ground or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

1. ##### Intent


See [Sec. 4C.11.1.A. (Intent)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1).

2. ##### Applicability


[Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). All [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s not located entirely in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall conform to the requirements of this Division (Signs) and all other applicable provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Permit Required


      1. A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is required for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), pennant, banner, ribbon, streamer or spinner. The permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall specify the dates being requested for authorized installation and the proposed location.

      2. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be required for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), other than one that contains a political, ideological or other non- [commercial message](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall specify the dates being requested for authorized installation and the proposed location.
2. ##### General


      [Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may display only on- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or non- [commercial message](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. ##### Temporary Signs


      1. ##### Location


         [Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may, including those that do not require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), be tacked, pasted or otherwise temporarily affixed to [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or on the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, barns, sheds or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

      2. ##### Area


         1. The combined [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area of [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not exceed 10 square feet in an [Agricultural Use District (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2) or [Residential Use District (5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), or two square feet for each foot of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in all other [Use Districts (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B). Square footage for [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not be counted toward the total [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area allocation from the [Sign Packages (Sec. 4C.11.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.5).

         2. The combined [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area of [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, when placed upon a [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and any other [window sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not exceed a maximum of 10 percent of the [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area.
      3. ##### Construction


         [Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be made of paper or any other material. If the [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is made of cloth, it shall be flame-proofed when the aggregate area exceeds 100 square feet. Every temporary cloth [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be supported and attached with stranded cable of 1/16-inch minimum diameter or by other methods as approved by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. ##### Time Limit


         1. [Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that require a permit shall be removed within 30 days of installation and shall not be reinstalled for a period of 30 days of the date of removal of the previous [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The installation of [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not exceed a total of 90 days in any calendar year.

         2. [Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that do not require a permit shall be removed within 30 days of the date of installation of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
4. ##### Measurement


\[Reserved\]

5. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from any [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from any [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.11.3. Off-Site Signs

An off-site sign is defined as a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that displays any message directing attention to a business, product, service, profession, commodity, activity, event, [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), institution, or any other [commercial message](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), which is generally conducted, sold, manufactured, produced, offered or occurs elsewhere than on the premises where the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is located.

1. ##### Intent


See [Sec. 4C.11.1.A. (Intent)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1).

2. ##### Applicability


[Off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). All exterior [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including [window sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s not located entirely in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall conform to the requirements of this Section (Off-Site Signs) and all other applicable provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Location


      1. No portion of an off-site [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area greater than 80 square feet shall be placed within 200 feet of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a property with an applied [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), which is located on the same side of the same street as the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on which the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is placed. However, where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) has two or more [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be located on that [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), which is not on the same street as the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or property zoned with a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3); provided the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are placed in that half of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is the farthest from the [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on which the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is located.

      2. No portion of an [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) can be located in that half of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located farthest from the [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) when a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a property zoned with a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) is located to the rear of that [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. Off-site [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are not permitted along that portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) having a [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of less than 50 feet.

      4. No more than four [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s can be located at the intersection of two or more streets when the [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are located within 150 feet of the intersection of two [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

      5. An off-site [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not be located within one foot of a [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
2. ##### Area


      The [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area of a single [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not exceed 800 square feet.

3. ##### Height


      1. The height to the top of the [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is limited to a maximum of 42 feet above the [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or edge of [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) nearest the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), except that a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is more than 80 percent above a roof of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may extend to the top of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a maximum of 30 feet above the surface of the roof under the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. In no event can the height to the top of the [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) exceed a height greater than that height specified in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) in which the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is located, or a height of 60 feet above the [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or edge of [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) nearest the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), whichever is more restrictive.

      3. The bottom of the [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be at least eight feet above the [sidewalk grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or edge of [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) nearest the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
4. ##### Spacing


      An off-site [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), which is either single-faced or parallel double-faced, shall be spaced as specified below from any other existing or previously permitted [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), which is single-faced or parallel double-faced.



      |     |     |     |     |
      | --- | --- | --- | --- |
      | SPACING REQUIREMENTS BETWEEN Off-site SIGNS |
      | Existing or Permitted Sign by Sign Area | Proposed Sign by Sign Area |
      | <80 SF | 80 - 300 SF | >300 SF |
      | <80 SF | 100' | 100' | 200' |
      | 80 - 300 SF | 100' | 300' | 300' |
      | >300 SF | 200' | 300' | 600' |

5. ##### Double-Faced Off-site Signs


      1. [Off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be either single or double-faced.

      2. For double-faced [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s whose [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are parallel, the [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s cannot exceed six feet.

      3. For double-faced [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s whose [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are not parallel, the [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s at their widest point cannot exceed 35 feet. The separation of [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s at their closest point cannot exceed six feet. In no event can the angle between [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s exceed 37 degrees.
6. ##### Projection


      [Off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not project over the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

7. ##### Covering


      The backs of [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s exposed to public view shall be [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a finished surface or material and shall be properly maintained.

8. ##### Other Requirements


      1. A maximum of two poles are permitted for any [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The maximum cross-sectional dimension of a pole cannot exceed 10 percent of the overall height of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. [Off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) supports shall be structurally independent of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be located directly under the [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) as viewed from the front of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The maximum horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) between the center of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) face shall not exceed 10 feet.
4. ##### Measurement


1. ##### Lots with Multiple Street Frontages


      If a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or any other [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with two or more [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, the following rules for the determination of which street an [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is located on shall apply:

      1. For the purposes of this Subsection D. (Measurement) and [Sec. 4C.11.3.C.2. (Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.3), an [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be considered to be on a single street, if the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and its support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are located entirely on the side of the [bisecting line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) closest to that street and the [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is placed at the same angle as the [perpendicular line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or at an angle not to exceed 20 degrees from either side of the [perpendicular line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.3.1.png.webp?itok=LkG4wmUT)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.3.1.png?itok=8R2EkMth)
      2. An [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located on a [through lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located on a single street if the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and its support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are located entirely on that half of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) closest to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that street.

      3. Any [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) not in conformance with either Subparagraph a. or Subparagraph b. of this Paragraph (Lots with Multiple Street Frontages) is considered to be located on more than one [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
2. ##### Spacing


      1. For any double-faced [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the spacing requirements are based on the area of the largest [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. For double-faced [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s whose faces are not parallel, the spacing between any proposed, permitted or existing [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is determined by the following formula:

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.3.3.png.webp?itok=2UpEeuDN)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.3.3.png?itok=VOeiSnNC)

         Where:

         D = required spacing between [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, in feet.

         S = [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) spacing determined by the table in [Sec. 4C.11.3.C.4. (Spacing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.3).

         B = widest edge separation of [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in feet.

      3. Spacing is measured between [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that are located on the same side of the same street. Spacing is measured from a line that is perpendicular to the [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and that passes through a point on the [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is closest to the nearest [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) edge. Spacing is measured along the center line of the street.
5. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from any [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from any [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.11.4. On-Site Signs

An on-site sign is a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is other than an [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

1. ##### Intent


See [Sec. 4C.11.1.A. (Intent)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1).

2. ##### Applicability


[On-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). All exterior [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including [window sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s not located entirely in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall conform to the requirements of this Section (On-Site Signs) and all other applicable provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Sign Packages


      [On-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with the applicable sign package pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.5. (Sign Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.5).

2. ##### Sign Types


      [On-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with all applicable sign type standards pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.6. (Sign Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.6).

3. ##### Street Address Requirement


      No [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be maintained on any property unless a street address for the property has been obtained, and is maintained in accordance with the provisions of [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 63.113. (Street Address Numbers - Responsibility Therefor, Designation, Location, Size, Maintenance, Change and Removal)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-160130) of this Code.

4. ##### Projection Over the Public Right-Of-Way


      Where [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are allowed to project over the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), they shall comply with the following standards:

      1. An [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) less than eight feet has a maximum projection allowance of 1/4 inch.

      2. An [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) equal to eight feet has a maximum projection allowance of one foot.

      3. For every extra foot of [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) over eight feet, the projection maximum for [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s increases by 1/2 inch.

      4. The maximum allowed projection for any [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is five feet, which applies to [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with a [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 16 feet or greater.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.4.1.png.webp?itok=0zlAU_Fz)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.4.1.png?itok=CYP7Uxi1)
4. ##### Measurement


See [Sec. 4C.11.6.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.6).

5. ##### Relief


1. A deviation from any [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. Deviation from any [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.11.5. Sign Packages

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Sign Packages) is to provide variety in the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) allocation based on the extent of reliance on specific modes of travel.

1. Sign Package 1 is intended for areas with a variety of transportation modes.

2. Sign Package 2 is intended for areas with a focus on pedestrian experience and alternative transportation modes besides automobiles.
2. ##### Applicability


[Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) package standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) package standards apply to all [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s determined by the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) package assigned by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Digital Display


      [Digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are prohibited in Sign Package 2.

2. ##### Total Sign Area Allowed


      1. The maximum total area of [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s allowed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is specified by a Sign Package according to the category of the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) as indicated below:



         |     |     |     |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         |  | Sign Package 1 | Sign Package 2 |
         | Agricultural, Residential & Open Space Use Districts |
         | Total sign area allocation for all sign types allowed (max) | 30 SF | 30 SF |
         | All Other Use Districts |
         | Total sign area allocation for all sign types allowed (max) | 4 SF per foot of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) | 4 SF per foot of [building frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) |
         | Combined sign area of [illuminated canopy sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)s, [roof sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)s, [roof sign: open panel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)s, & [wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)s [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) the same direction (max) | 2 SF per foot of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), \+ 1 SF for each foot of [building frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) | n/a |

      2. In Sign Package 1, [awning sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, high-rise signs and [marquee sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s do not count towards the total [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area allocation of four square feet per foot of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. In Sign Package 2, [awning sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and high-rise signs do not count towards the total [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area allocation of four square feet per foot of [building frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
3. ##### Sign Types Allowed




      |     |     |     |     |
      | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Where a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets the standards and definition of both an allowed [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type and a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type that is not allowed per the table in this Paragraph 3. (Sign Types Allowed), the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is considered to be the allowed [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type.
4. ##### Measurement


1. ##### Sign Area


      1. Maximum [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area is measured independently for each [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area is measured as the area circumscribed by the smallest geometric shape created with a maximum of eight straight lines that will enclose all words, letters, figures, symbols, designs and pictures, together with all framing, background material, colored or illuminated areas and attention-attracting devices, forming an integral part of an individual message except that:

         1. For [wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s having no discernible boundary, each of the following shall be included in any computation of surface area:

            1. The areas between letters;

            2. Words intended to be read together; and

            3. Any device intended to draw attention to the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) message.
         2. For spherical, cylindrical or other three-dimensional [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, the area of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be computed from the smallest two-dimensional geometrical shape or shapes, which will best approximate the greatest actual surface area visible from any one direction. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are excluded if neutral in color.
2. ##### Sign Area Allocation


      1. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area allocation, either total or by sign type pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.6. (Sign Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.6), when specified per foot of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is calculated by multiplying the specified area by the length of the [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area allocation, either total or by sign type pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.6. (Sign Types)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.6), when specified per foot of [building frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is calculated by multiplying the specified area by the length of the [building frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. The [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area for all [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including required [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s displaying addresses, is counted toward the total [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area allocation as specified in this Section (Sign Packages).
5. ##### Exceptions


Flag [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s containing less than 50 feet of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are allotted 50 feet of street frontage for the purpose of determining the type of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) permitted and for the allowable [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area.

6. ##### Relief


1. In Sign Package 2, deviations from the dimensional standards for [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be authorized in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5). In addition to the findings otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of Planning shall find that the proposed [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets the following criteria:

      1. The total [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) area of all [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, including existing [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and existing [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, does not exceed 25 SF plus 1.5 SF per foot of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), with no individual [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) exceeding 300 SF per [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#); and

      2. The proposed [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) contributes to the existing pattern and character of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of the area within a 500 foot radius of the site.
2. A deviation from any Sign Package dimensional standard 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any Sign Package standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.11.6. Sign Types

1. ##### Intent


That the regulations will provide reasonable protection to the visual environment by controlling the size, height, spacing and location of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ##### General


      1. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), involving any construction or modification of an [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.5. (Sign Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.5) specified by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

      2. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type standards apply to each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) according the [Sign Package (Sec. 4C.11.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.5) specified by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).
2. ##### Combination Signs


      A [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) subject to more than one type of classification, shall meet the requirements for the type to which each portion is subject.
3. ##### Standards


The standards for each [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) type are specified in the tables below:

| A pedestrian sign is a small [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) attached perpendicular to the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that hangs from a bracket or support. |

[Pedestrian sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be located within five feet horizontally of a [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) tenant entrance.<br>iv. [Pedestrian sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be located at least 15 feet from any other [pedestrian sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).<br>v. (Projecting Signs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-177068).<br>vi. [Pedestrian sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with [Sec. 4C.11.4.C.4. (Projection Over the Public Right-Of-Way)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.4). |

| ###### 8.Pole Sign |
| [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.6.15.png.webp?itok=P6ryeA_r)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.6.15.png?itok=FQKascTd) |





|     |
| --- |
| a.DEFINITION |
| A pole sign is a freestanding [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is wholly independent of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for support, permanently affixed to the ground using one or more poles or posts. |
| b.GENERAL STANDARDS |
| i. A [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located at least 10 feet from a [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#); however, on a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be at least five feet from [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.<br>ii. A [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located at least 15 feet from any other [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [monument sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).<br>iii. The maximum width of a pole or post shall not exceed 10 percent of the overall [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) height.<br>iv. A [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located so as not to interfere or present a hazard to pedestrian or automobile traffic.<br>v. Where the lower part of a [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is less than eight feet above sidewalk [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or the edge of [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) nearest the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall extend to 18 inches from [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or be installed in a planter that extends beyond the edges of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and any support [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is 18 inches minimum in height.<br>vi. A [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may project over a [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), but shall comply with [Sec. 4C.11.4.C.4. (Projection Over the Public Right-Of-Way)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.4). [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) projections shall fall within an area that is perpendicular to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and has a width of three feet as measured parallel to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). |

| ###### 9.Projecting Sign |
| [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.6.17.png.webp?itok=rjAu5_Bp)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.11.6.17.png?itok=XfMGmJfs) |





|     |
| --- |
| a.DEFINITION |
| A projecting sign is a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) attached approximately perpendicular to the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that does not meet the standards for a [pedestrian sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). |
| b.GENERAL STANDARDS |
| i. The plane of the [sign face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be within 15 degrees of a line perpendicular to the [building face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), except at the corner of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).<br>ii. A [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not extend above the top of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).<br>iii. A [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be located at least 7.5 feet from any [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and be located at least 15 feet from any other [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [monument sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), measured in any direction.<br>iv. [Projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be attached to a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to withstand the loads as required by [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [Sec. 91.6212. (Projecting Signs).](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-177068)<br>v. A [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may project over the public [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), but shall comply with [Sec. 4C.11.4.C.4. (Projection Over the Public Right-Of-Way)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.4). [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) projections shall fall within an area that is perpendicular to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and has a maximum width of three feet as measured parallel with the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).<br>vi. For [projecting sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located above 16 feet and on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) having a [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) greater than 50 feet, projections over the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may vary linearly from five feet at 50 feet to eight feet at 100 feet of [street frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). This is an exception to Sub-subparagraph v. above, and does not require compliance with [Sec. 4C.11.4.C.4. (Projection Over the Public Right-Of-Way)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.4). |
