### Div. 4C.12. Site Elements

#### Sec. 4C.12.1. Roof-Mounted Equipment

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Roof-Mounted Equipment) is to ensure [roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is designed to minimize effects on surrounding properties and the public realm and to ensure [roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is obscured from view on the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) skyline.

2. ##### Applicability


[Roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When [roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply, the standards apply to all [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [utility equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located on a roof. In addition to the [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards in this Section (Roof-Mounted Equipment), [utilities: wireless facility, rooftop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be designed according to [Sec. 4C.12.4. (Wireless Telecommunication Facilities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.4).

3. ##### Standards


1. Roof-mounted equipment (including but not limited to, compressors, condensers, conduits, pipes, vents, and ducts) shall be screened on all sides by a parapet or [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that:

      1. Has an [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of at least 75 percent;

      2. Has a minimum height six inches greater in height than the topmost point of the equipment; and

      3. Encloses the equipment 100 percent up to the minimum height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
2. The [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).
       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.1.1.png.webp?itok=ee_WTroQ)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.1.1.png?itok=84Vx-yDR)
4. ##### Measurement


1. For measurement of [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).

2. For measurement of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

3. Height from topmost point of the equipment is measured to the top of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at its lowest height.
5. ##### Exceptions


The following are exempt from the standards in this Section (Roof-Mounted Equipment):

1. [Sustainable energy systems](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

2. [Los Angeles Fire Department equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#);

3. Helipads;

4. [Window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) cleaning systems; and

5. Solar panels and their required appurtenances.
6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to [roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any [roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any [roof-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.12.2. Ground-Mounted Equipment

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Ground-Mounted Equipment) is to minimize visibility of [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) from the public realm and support the intent of the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply, the standards apply to [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [utility equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), either publicly or privately owned, subject to the following:

      1. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply when located at an [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) within six feet of the [surrounding grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), serving five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or at least 5,000 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Location


      1. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be installed entirely below [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in a vault.

      2. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be located within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), such as a utility room or [parking garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided no portion of the equipment [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) unobstructed.

      3. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be located outdoors and [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided that it meets the following standards:

         1. No portion of the equipment is located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. When located on a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the equipment shall not be located in the [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

         3. Equipment is screened with a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) screen that meets the requirements of Paragraph 2. (Fence/Wall Screen) below, or a landscape screen that meets the requirements of Paragraph 3. (Landscape Screen) below. [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or landscape screens may be combined to achieve full [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the subject equipment.
2. ##### Fence/Wall Screen


      [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s used to meet [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements shall meet the following standards:

      1. Form a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that creates a contiguous perimeter around 100 percent of the subject equipment for a height no less than six inches taller than the topmost point of the equipment. In no case may the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) be less than three feet in height.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.2.1.png.webp?itok=Go-lo0e_)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.2.1.png?itok=C0JOufEr)

      2. Have a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.

      3. Access gates provided in the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Shall have a height no less than six inches taller than the topmost point of the equipment.

         2. Where a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is taller than the minimum height, gates may be no more than one foot shorter than the height of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided.

         3. In no case shall gates exceed the height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by more than one foot.

         4. Have a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.
      4. A [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of an existing or proposed [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may serve as a partial element of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided that the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets the height and [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements outlined in this Paragraph (Fence/Wall Screen).

      5. Areas within the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be maintained free of trash and debris.

      6. [Screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).

      7. [Screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with any [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and clearance standards required by [LADWP](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
3. ##### Landscape Screen


      [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be used to meet [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) requirements provided it meets the following standards:

      1. ##### General


         1. Landscape screens shall be composed of hedges meeting the requirements of Subparagraph b. (Hedges) below, or [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting the requirements of Subparagraph c. (Screening Plants) below. Landscape screens may be composed of a combination of [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and hedges.

         2. All required [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and hedges shall have a minimum height at maturity no lower than the height of the topmost point of the equipment subject to [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         3. All required [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and hedges shall comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

         4. Areas within the landscape screen shall be maintained free of trash and debris.

         5. All plants provided in a landscape screen shall be planted and maintained so as to ensure a minimum three-foot clearance between all portions of the equipment and the plants, based on [spread at maturity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         6. [Screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may need to comply with additional [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and clearance standards as may be required by [LADWP](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      2. ##### Hedges


         1. A continuous perimeter of hedge shall surround 100 percent of the subject equipment. A maximum gap of three feet breaking the continuous perimeter is permitted to allow for equipment [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided that the [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) gap does not face a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. Hedges shall meet the requirements of [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.d. (Hedges)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
      3. ##### Screening Plants


         1. [Screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be planted in a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) no less than three feet in depth that creates a contiguous perimeter surrounding 100 percent of the subject equipment. A maximum gap of three feet breaking the contiguous perimeter is permitted to allow for equipment [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), provided that the [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) gap is not [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. A minimum of 20 [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be planted for every 50 linear feet of [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), measured at the outside perimeter of the [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         3. [Screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the requirements of [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.b. (Screening Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For measurement of [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).

2. Height from topmost point of the equipment is measured to the top of the screen and gate at their lowest point.

3. For measurement of plant and hedge height at maturity, see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.11. (Height at Maturity)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

4. For measurement of plant and hedge [spread at maturity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.3. (Canopy Diameter, Spread, & Height at Maturity)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

5. For measurement of [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width, see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.1. (Planting Area Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

6. For measurement of [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 3C.2.1.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.2.1).

7. For measurement of [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 2C.5.1.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.5.1).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards do not apply to Water and Power assets, as defined in [Sec. 672. (Possession, Management and Control of Water and Power Assets)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-3325) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s owned or leased by the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power.

2. [Ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards do not apply to fire hydrants.
6. ##### Relief


1. Where Los Angeles Department of Water and Power determines that [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [utility equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) must be located in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and that locating the equipment in a below [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) vault is infeasible for reasons not related to cost, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may grant an Alternative Compliance to the [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) location standards in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1) allowing for the equipment to be located [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

2. A deviation from any [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any [ground-mounted equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.12.3. Wall-Mounted Equipment

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Wall-Mounted Equipment) is to ensure wall-mounted equipment is concealed to minimize effects on the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


1. Wall-mounted equipment standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When the wall-mounted equipment standards apply, the standards apply to [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [utility equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) attached or being attached to the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Location


      Wall-mounted electrical meters, gas meters, cable boxes and other utility equipment shall not be attached to a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and shall not be located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) unless it is fully screened with a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting the standards in Paragraph 2. (Screening Enclosure) below, and that [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) complies with the frontage yard fence & wall type standards allowed in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

2. ##### Screening Enclosure


      Wall-mounted equipment located on a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be screened with a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that meets the following requirements:

      1. Has a minimum of 75 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for a height of at least six inches taller than the topmost point of the equipment. For wall-mounted equipment located more than three feet above the base of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall have a minimum of 75 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for no less than six inches below the bottommost point of the equipment.

      2. Has a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 75 percent.

      3. Any [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) gates provided in the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Shall have a height no less than six inches taller than the topmost point of the equipment and, where located more than three feet above the base of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), shall continue no less than six inches below the bottommost point of the equipment.

         2. Where a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is taller than the minimum height, gates may differ no more than one foot from the height of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided.

         3. Gates shall not exceed the height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by more than one foot.

         4. Shall have a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.
      4. The [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For measurement of [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).

2. For measurement of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

3. Height from topmost point of the equipment is measured to the top of the screen and gate at their lowest height.
5. ##### Exceptions


1. Wall-mounted equipment standards do not apply to fire alarms.
6. ##### Relief


1. An alternative to wall-mounted equipment [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any wall-mounted equipment [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any wall-mounted equipment [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.12.4. Wireless Telecommunication Facilities

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Wireless Telecommunication Facilities) is to minimize visual impacts, make the installation, operation, and appearance of wireless telecommunication facilities as inconspicuous as possible, to prevent the facility from visually dominating the surrounding area, and to hide the facility from predominant views visible from surrounding properties.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Wireless Telecommunication Facilities), applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), involving all wireless telecommunications [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. ##### Standards


Wireless telecommunications facilities shall meet the following standards.

1. ##### General


      1. All wireless telecommunications facilities shall meet the minimum siting [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to habitable [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s required for compliance with Federal Communications Commission (FCC) regulations and standards governing the environmental effects of radio frequency emissions.

      2. New wireless telecommunication equipment shall be installed at an approved existing facility, when co-location is feasible.

      3. For modifications involving the removal or replacement of transmission equipment or the collocation of new transmission equipment on existing wireless telecommunication facilities subject to [47 U.S.C § 1455(a) (Section 6409(a) of the Spectrum Act)](https://www.congress.gov/bill/112th-congress/house-bill/3630/text#:~:text=SEC.%206409.%20%3C%3CNOTE%3A%2047%20USC%201455.%3E%3E%20%20WIRELESS%20FACILITIES%20DEPLOYMENT), see [Sec. 4C.12.5. (Existing Wireless Telecommunications Facilities Spectrum Act Compliance Handbook)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.5).

      4. Existing [utilities: wireless facility, rooftop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), in which new wireless telecommunication equipment is installed that exceeds the scope of the Spectrum Act, shall be subject to the standards included in Paragraph 2. (Rooftop Wireless Telecommunications Facilities) below.

      5. Existing [utilities: wireless facility, freestanding](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), in which new wireless telecommunication equipment is installed that exceeds the scope of the Spectrum Act, shall be subject to the standards included in Paragraph 3. (Freestanding Wireless Facilities) below.

      6. All wireless telecommunication facilities shall be removed within 90 days of discontinuance of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
2. ##### Rooftop Wireless Telecommunications Facilities


      [Utilities: wireless facility, rooftop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including antennas and any associated equipment shall meet the following standards:

      1. [Utilities: wireless facility, rooftop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are only allowed where they are a permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

      2. Where located on the rooftop of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [utilities: wireless facility, rooftop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) require review and approval pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

      3. Shall be located on rooftops no less than 40 feet above [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. Shall be screened on all sides by a parapet or [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that meet the standards provided in [Sec. 4C.12.1. (Roof-Mounted Equipment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.1) or [Sec. 4C.12.3. (Wall-Mounted Equipment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.3).

      5. The [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) covering the antenna and any equipment cabinet shall be painted and textured to match the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      6. Any wireless antenna [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and associated equipment shall have a height no greater than 10 feet, measured from rooftop surface at the base of the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or equipment.

      7. Where mounted on the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of a rooftop [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or vertical circulation, wireless antenna [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and associated equipment cabinets shall not exceed the height of the rooftop [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      8. The cumulative area occupied by all [utilities: wireless facility, rooftop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and associated equipment shall not exceed 10 percent of the total area of the rooftop.
3. ##### Freestanding Wireless Facilities


      [Utilities: wireless facility, freestanding](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including antennas and any associated equipment shall meet the following standards:

      1. The footing of an antenna shall be structurally designed to support a freestanding wireless facility which is at least 15 feet higher than the freestanding wireless facility under review in order to allow a future wireless network to replace an existing freestanding wireless facility with a new freestanding wireless facility capable of supporting equipment co-location.

      2. Freestanding wireless facilities shall not exceed the maximum height specified in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

      3. Freestanding wireless facilities shall be set back a minimum [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) equal to 20 percent of the freestanding wireless facility height or 35 feet, whichever is greater, from the following [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s:

         1. [Primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s;

         2. [Lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shared with a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that includes a [sensitive use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#); and

         3. [Lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shared with a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with an applied [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [Agricultural Use District (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2).
      4. Freestanding wireless facilities shall be screened on all sides with a [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meeting the following standards:

         1. Has a minimum width of five feet;

         2. Provides [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) at a [frequency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 30 per 50 feet of [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#); and

         3. Provides [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s at a [frequency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of three per 50 feet of [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      5. All [utilities: wireless facility, freestanding](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall use surfacing and camouflaging techniques that satisfy the following criteria:

         1. Exterior colors, textures, and shapes are visually compatible with the surrounding built or natural environment;

         2. Exterior finish is non-reflective, unless otherwise required by the Federal Aviation Administration; and

         3. Situated so as to utilize existing natural or man-made features including topography, [vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, or other [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to provide the greatest amount of visual [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      6. The approving authority may require additional measures designed to camouflage a [utilities: wireless facility, freestanding](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including placing the facility entirely within a vertical [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Suitable [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s include, but are not limited to, clock towers, bell towers, church steeples, icon [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, lighthouses, flagpoles, utility poles, or faux trees. All facility components, including the antennas, shall be mounted inside said [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      7. Freestanding wireless facilities that are not designed according to Subparagraph f. above shall be of tapered design (three-foot diameter at the base up to 1.5-foot diameter at the top).
4. ##### Existing Wireless Facilities


      For the modification of existing wireless telecommunication facilities pursuant to the Spectrum Act, see [Sec. 4C.12.5. (Existing Wireless Telecommunications Facilities Spectrum Act Compliance Handbook).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.5)
4. ##### Measurement


1. Setbacks from [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are measured according to [Sec. 2C.2.2.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2).

2. [Planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) width is measured according to [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.1. (Planting Area Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

3. Planting [frequency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is measured according to [Sec. 14.2.8. (Frequency)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.8).

4. [Screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are measured as provided or not provided, based on the presence of [screening plants](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.b. (Screening Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) and all other applicable provisions of [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

5. [Large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are measured as provided or not provided, based on the presence of [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that comply with [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.a. (Trees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4) and all other applicable provisions of [Sec. 4C.6.4. (Plant Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).
5. ##### Exceptions


Wireless telecommunication facilities standards do not apply to satellite dish antennae, radio and television transmitters, and antennae incidental to [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to wireless telecommunication facilities standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any wireless telecommunication facilities dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any wireless telecommunication facilities standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.12.5. Existing Wireless Telecommunications Facilities Spectrum Act Compliance Handbook

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Existing Wireless Telecommunications Facilities Spectrum Act Compliance Handbook) is to ensure the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s wireless standards, procedures, and timelines are consistent with [Sec. 6409(a) of Title VI. of the Middle Class Tax Relief and Job Creation Act of 2012 (Spectrum Act)](https://www.congress.gov/bill/112th-congress/house-bill/3630/text#:~:text=SEC.%206409.%20%3C%3CNOTE%3A%2047%20USC%201455.%3E%3E%20%20WIRELESS%20FACILITIES%20DEPLOYMENT).

2. ##### Applicability


The [Existing Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Spectrum Act Compliance Handbook](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/17869f4d-48a2-4297-ab35-cb44a764b915/wireless_handbook.pdf) (Handbook) applies to existing wireless facilities that are applying for Spectrum Act approval.

3. ##### Adoption and Maintenance of the Existing Wireless Telecommunications Facilities Spectrum Act Compliance Handbook


The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of Planning, as they deem necessary and appropriate, shall have the authority to [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), maintain, amend, and adopt the [Handbook](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/17869f4d-48a2-4297-ab35-cb44a764b915/wireless_handbook.pdf). This [Handbook](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/17869f4d-48a2-4297-ab35-cb44a764b915/wireless_handbook.pdf) explains the standards, procedures, and timelines of the review of existing wireless telecommunication facilities. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may, as they deem appropriate, use technical consultants or a consultant advisory panel to update the [Handbook](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/17869f4d-48a2-4297-ab35-cb44a764b915/wireless_handbook.pdf) in order to comply with changes in federal and state laws.

4. ##### Noncompliance


Failure to comply with the [Handbook](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/17869f4d-48a2-4297-ab35-cb44a764b915/wireless_handbook.pdf) or any condition or commitments made in compliance with it is a violation of the Code, subject to all available administrative, criminal and civil remedies.


#### Sec. 4C.12.6. Waste Receptacles

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Waste Receptacles) is to ensure waste receptacle service areas are designed in a manner that does not detract from the safety, comfort, or enjoyment of users of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), neighboring [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Waste Receptacles) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). When waste receptacles standards apply, the standards apply to any solid waste, recycling, or organic waste receptacle 96 gallons in size or greater stored on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Location


      1. Waste receptacles and their [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not be located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. Waste receptacles may be located within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided they are located in a room with 100 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. Waste receptacles may be located in the same area, room, or [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) as required [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s as long as the area, room, or [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets both the standards of this Section (Waste Receptacles) in addition to the [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s standards outlined in [Sec. 4C.12.7. (Recycling Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.7).

      4. Waste receptacle storage areas shall be made accessible to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) through a [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) with a minimum width of 4 feet in order to accommodate waste hauling services.
2. ##### Screening Enclosure


      The outdoor waste receptacle shall be screened with a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that meets the following requirements:

      1. Has 100 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for a minimum height of six feet , but no less than one foot taller than the height of the waste receptacles the facility is designed to enclose.

      2. Has a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.6.1.png.webp?itok=LPTnldaF)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.6.1.png?itok=9vuKNtwt)

      3. Outdoor waste receptacle [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in a Residential or Agricultural [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) or located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) a Residential or Agricultural [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) shall be [sheltered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The [sheltering structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Have a [slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of no less than five degrees;

         2. Be made of non-pervious material to ensure runoff; and

         3. Provide a minimum [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of eight feet under the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      4. Wheel stops with a minimum height of eight inches shall be installed a minimum of six inches from [interior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of waste receptacle [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to prevent damage to [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

      5. [Access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) gates provided in the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Have a height of no less than six feet;

         2. Where a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is seven feet or greater in height, gates may be no more than one foot shorter than the height of the [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided;

         3. In no case shall gates exceed the height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by more than one foot; and

         4. Have a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.
      6. All provided [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designation, see [Sec. 14.2.16.C.1. (Frontage Yard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.16).

2. For measurement of height, see [Sec. 4C.7.1.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.1).

3. For measurement of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

4. For measurement of [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. Waste receptacles standards do not apply to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s containing only [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and four or fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. [Use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) project activities on a site having less than 2,500 square feet of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be exempt from waste receptacle [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards in this Section (Waste Receptacles).
6. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to waste receptacle standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any waste receptacle dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any waste receptacle standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.12.7. Recycling Areas

A recycling area is an outdoor [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a room within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which is designated for the collection of recyclable materials generated by the use(s) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Recycling Areas) is to ensure that adequate facilities for collecting and loading [recyclable materials](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) are provided in order to divert solid waste, address source reduction, and facilitate recycling and composting activities by users, tenants, and [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which introduces or modifies a [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and results in any of the following:

      1. A 25 percent increase in [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for [residential project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with four or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, or a 30 percent increase of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for non-residential [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s;

      2. Marinas where the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) includes the space dedicated to the docking or mooring of marine vessels; or

      3. Any [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) where multiple [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are issued within a 12-month period that result in the addition of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) beyond the above thresholds.
3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      01. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be equipped with [recycling receptacle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containers that are [sheltered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), durable, waterproof, rustproof, and of incombustible construction, and that either provide protection against the environment or are located in a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that is [sheltered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Containers must be clearly labeled to indicate the type of material to be deposited, and all recyclable materials must be placed or stored in such containers.

      02. When a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provides a [trash chute](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including adding a [trash chute](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to an existing development, a [recycling chute](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall also be provided. [Recycling chute](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be clearly marked "recycling only" at every point of entry.

      03. Outdoor [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be constructed with a concrete floor [slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) d to drain, and a water faucet for hose attachment shall be located [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to or within the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      04. The [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be clearly identified by one or more [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with a minimum dimension of 16 inches by 20 inches that designate the area for recycling collection and loading.

      05. The [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be available for use by [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s residing or employed on the property.

      06. No payment shall be made to [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s depositing recycling materials in the [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and no processing of recycling materials shall be permitted within the [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). For recyclable materials deposited or redeemed for monetary value, see [Sec. 5D.9.4.A. (Collection)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.4). For sorting or processing of recyclable materials from off- [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) sources, see [Sec. 5D.9.4.B. (Sorting & Processing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.4).

      07. Each property owner or lessee shall contract with a recycler or hauler for the pick-up of recyclable materials, separate from trash collection, when receptacles are full or every week, whichever occurs first.

      08. To encourage active participation in recycling to the maximum extent possible, each property owner, manager, or lessee shall inform all tenants and/or employees living or working on the property of the availability and location of the [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)(s), the types of materials that are collected for recycling, and that the recycling collection facilities are located on the property pursuant to state law requiring the diversion of a substantial portion of solid waste.

      09. No toxic or hazardous material shall be stored in [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or receptacles.

      10. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be kept free of litter, debris, spillage, bugs, rodents, odors, and other similar undesirable hazards.

      11. [Recycling receptacle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containers shall be covered, durable, waterproof, rustproof, and of incombustible construction, and shall provide protection against the environment or be in completely enclosed indoor recycling areas. Containers shall be clearly labeled to indicate the type of material to be deposited.
2. ##### Location


      1. Outdoor [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and their [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not be located in a [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      2. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be located within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided they have 100 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be placed within 10 feet of waste receptacles or waste receptacle service areas or rooms wherever feasible. Where multiple [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are provided, at least one [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) must be placed within 10 feet of at least one waste receptacle or waste receptacle service area or room.

      4. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s may be located in the same area, room, or [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) as waste receptacles as long as the area, room, or [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets both the [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards in this Section and the waste receptacle standards outlined in [Sec. 4C.12.6. (Waste Receptacles)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.6).

      5. [Recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall not diminish the required number of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or bicycle parking spaces or impair traffic flow.
3. ##### Size


      1. For [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s with 20 or fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or any other uses with a total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of less than 3,000 square feet, the minimum area of the required [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be 30 square feet.

      2. For [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of 21 to 50 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s or any other uses having a total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 3,001 to 7,500 square feet, the minimum area of the required [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be 60 square feet.

      3. For [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of 51 or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, or any other uses having a total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of greater than 7,500 square feet, the minimum area of the required [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be 100 square feet.

      4. No individual [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall exceed an area of 300 square feet.

      5. Multiple [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may be combined to meet the applicable required minimum area, as long as no individual [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) has an area of less than 30 feet and the total combined area of the provided [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s does not exceed 300 square feet.

      6. Every [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall contain a minimum [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of at least eight feet.

      7. The [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be of adequate size for the collection of all recyclable materials generated by the use(s) occupying the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), without such materials overflowing the area or forcing significant amounts of recycling to be discarded as general refuse, or the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may require a larger space for the recycling area in excess of the minimum requirements listed in Subparagraph a. through Subparagraph c. above to meet the intent of this Subparagraph.
4. ##### Screening Enclosure


      Outdoor [recycling area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be screened with a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that meets the following requirements:

      1. Has 100 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for a minimum height of six feet; and

      2. Has a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.7.1.png.webp?itok=eMC9sEht)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/4C.12.7.1.png?itok=w7hoyDq2)

      3. Access gates provided in the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall meet the following standards:

         1. Have a height of no less than six feet;

         2. Where a [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is seven feet or greater in height, any gate is no more than one foot shorter than the height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) provided;

         3. Does not exceed the height of the [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) by more than one foot; and

         4. Have a minimum [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 90 percent.
      4. All provided [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall comply with [Sec. 4C.7.3. (Fence/Wall Design & Installation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.3).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) designation, see [Sec. 14.2.16.C.1. (Frontage Yard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.16).

2. For measurement of height, see [Sec. 4C.7.1.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.7.1).

3. For measurement of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

4. For measurement of [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), see [Sec. 14.2.13. (Opacity (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.13).
5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative compliance to [recycling receptacle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standards may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any [recycling receptacle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dimensional standard of 15 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. Deviation from any [recycling receptacle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).

#### Sec. 4C.12.8. Shopping Cart Containment

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Shopping Cart Containment) is to prevent or reduce the accumulation of [abandoned shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), which may obstruct pedestrian and vehicular traffic, and constitute a hazard to the health, safety, and general welfare of the public.

2. ##### Applicability


[Shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containment requirements apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s involving [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), and [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for commercial uses established in [Div. 5D.1.5. (General Commercial Uses)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.1.5) that provide six or more [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### General


      1. ##### Shopping Cart Noticing


         Every [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) owned or provided by any business establishment in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall have a notice permanently affixed to it that:

         1. Identifies the owner of the [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or the name of the business establishment, or both;

         2. Notifies the public of the procedure to be utilized for authorized removal of the [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) from the business premises;

         3. Notifies the public that the unauthorized removal of the [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) from the premises or [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of the business establishment is a violation of state and [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) law;

         4. Lists a telephone number to contact to report the location of the [abandoned shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#); and

         5. Lists an address for returning the [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) to the owner or business establishment.
      2. ##### Shopping Cart Collection Areas


         [Shopping cart corral](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and/or storage areas shall be provided with a minimum width of five feet and minimum depth of 15 feet, but shall not be located within a required [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. ##### Signs


         [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that warn customers that [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) removal is prohibited and constitutes a violation of [California Business and Professions Code, Sec. 22435.1. (Identification of Shopping and Laundry Carts)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=22435.&lawCode=BPC) and [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 41.45. (Unauthorized Removal, Use Or Possession of Shopping Carts)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-128850) of this Code shall be installed and maintained at exits, [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) collection areas, and any vehicular or [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be no less than 16 inches by 20 inches, and placed at a minimum height of three feet and a maximum height of six feet.
2. ##### Containment Methods


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall include a practical containment approach with one or more of the following containment methods to ensure that [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s remain on the premises.

      1. ##### Wheel Locking or Stopping Mechanisms


         [Shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be equipped with a wheel locking or stopping mechanism that is used in conjunction with an electronic magnetic barrier along the perimeter of the commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including customer entrances, loading areas, [basement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, landscaped areas, along crossings and [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) points required for [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and [pedestrian passageway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, or any other perimeter identified on a [shopping cart containment plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). The wheel locking or stopping mechanism must activate when the [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) crosses the electronic or magnetic barrier.

      2. ##### Screening Plants


         An [F-Screen 1 (Sec. 4C.8.1.C.2.a.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1) shall be provided along the perimeter of the commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or any other perimeter identified on a [shopping cart containment plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. ##### Bollards


         [Bollard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s shall be installed at customer entrances, or within 10 feet of the entrances, and shall be spaced at a maximum [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 17 inches from each other or nearby [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) space.

      4. ##### Other Methods


         Other methods for [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containment may be used, so long as the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Sanitation has approved the system or method as effectively containing or controlling [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on the premises.
3. ##### Performance Standards


      Owners shall do all of the following and execute and record a covenant to the satisfaction of the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Sanitation to ensure compliance by the owner and any leasee:

      1. ##### Daily After Hours Cart Containment


         [Prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and maintain a plan for securing [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s whenever the store is not open for business.

      2. ##### Shopping Cart Retrieval


         Retrieve their carts or provide evidence of a contract with a [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) retrieval service with terms requiring collection of [abandoned shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s within 24 hours of notification of an [abandoned shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      3. ##### Employee Training


         Implement and maintain a periodic training program for its new and existing employees designed to educate employees about the abandonment and retrieval of [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s of the [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

      4. ##### Shopping Cart Containment Plan


         A [shopping cart containment plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall be [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) d that identifies areas on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) where [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s can be removed from the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and identifies the proposed containment method for each area.
4. ##### Measurement


\[Reserved\].

5. ##### Relief


1. Alternative Compliance to the [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containment standards established in this Section (Shopping Cart Containment) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. A deviation from any [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containment dimensional standard of 10 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. A deviation from any [shopping cart](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) containment standard may be granted as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3).
6. ##### Enforcement


Regardless of [Div. 13B.10. (Department of Building and Safety)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10), the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Sanitation shall have the authority and responsibility to enforce the provisions of this Section (Shopping Cart Containment).


### Div. 4C.13. Environmental Protection

[notes](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)

#### Sec. 4C.13.1. Environmental Protection Measures

1. ##### Intent


1. The intent of the standards of this Section (Environmental Protection Measures) is the following:

      1. Ensure that development in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) does not result in detrimental impacts to those residing or working in and around construction activities, and to [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) properties, and the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), including the habitat, cultural resources, and [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or fragile [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s;

      2. Provide a mechanism for mitigation measures adopted pursuant to [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) for [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) plans, policies, or regulations to be made enforceable on future development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s consistent with [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, [California Code of Regulations, Sec. 15162.4. (Subsequent EIRs and Negative Declarations)](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Document/I8A075AF75B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3?viewType=FullText&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=CategoryPageItem&contextData=(sc.Default)); and

      3. Provide a flexible mechanism to adopt and amend uniformly applicable development standards to allow streamlined environmental review, including pursuant to [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s [California Code of Regulations, Sec. 15183.3. (Streamlining for Infill Projects)](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Document/I8AA633105B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3?viewType=FullText&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=CategoryPageItem&contextData=(sc.Default)).
2. ##### Applicability


No permit shall be issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) without the applicant demonstrating compliance with any regulations adopted by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) under this Division (Environmental Protection) to implement any adopted environmental protection measures.

3. ##### Adoption and Maintenance of the Environmental Protection Measures


The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is authorized to, and shall, as they deem necessary and appropriate, [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), maintain, amend, and adopt environmental protection measures to meet the intent of this Division (Environmental Protection) and to adopt regulations to implement environmental protection measures. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may, as the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) deems appropriate, use technical consultants or a consultant advisory panel to make recommendations on new environmental protection measures or updates to existing environmental protection measures.

4. ##### Noncompliance


Failure to comply with the environmental protection measures or any condition or commitments made in compliance with the environmental protection measures, or regulations adopted to implement environmental protection measures, is a violation of the Code, subject to all available administrative, criminal and civil remedies. Additionally, upon verification of non-compliance, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may require the applicant or property owner to retain at its own expense an independent consultant, subject to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s approval, to ensure compliance with the environmental protection measures and any conditions or commitments made in compliance with the environmental protection measures and regulations.


### Div. 4C.14. Development Review

#### Sec. 4C.14.1. Development Review Threshold Packages

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Development Review Threshold Packages) is to require the discretionary review of development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s when certain thresholds are met, and to allow for variation in these thresholds appropriate to the context of development.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Development Review Threshold Packages) applies to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s involving [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), or a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which meets the thresholds of the assigned development review threshold package as applied by the [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

3. ##### Standards


1. ##### Development Review Threshold Package 1


      1. ##### Project Review Thresholds


         When the applicable [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) specifies Development Review Threshold Package 1, the following development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are subject to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4):

         1. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which creates, or results in an increase of, 50,000 square feet or more of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which creates, or results in an increase of, 50 or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

         3. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that includes [drive-through lane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s which results in a net increase of 500 or more average daily trips.

         4. Any [change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which results in a net increase of 1,000 or more average daily trips.

         5. Any one unit development with a [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 17,500 square feet or larger located in the [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      2. ##### Major Development Project Review Thresholds


         When the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) specifies Development Review Threshold Package 1, development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s having one or more of the characteristics listed below are subject to [Sec. 4C.14.1.C.3. (Supplemental Procedure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14.1) of this Subsection (Standards):

         1. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that creates or results in an increase of 250,000 square feet or more of warehouse [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         2. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that creates or results in an increase of 100,000 square feet or more of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) in other non-residential or non-warehouse [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
2. ##### Development Review Threshold Package 2


      1. ##### Project Review Thresholds


         When the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) specifies Development Review

         Threshold Package 2, development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s having one or more of the characteristics listed below are subject to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4):

         1. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) including a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) having a height of 500 feet or taller.

         2. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which adds at least 500,000 square feet of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

         3. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which adds at least 500 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

         4. Any development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) that includes [drive-through lane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s which results in a net increase of 500 or more average daily trips.

         5. Any [change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) which results in a net increase of 1,000 or more average daily trips.

         6. Any one unit development with a [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of 17,500 square feet or larger located in the [hillside area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
      2. ##### Major Development Project Review Thresholds


         When the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) specifies Development Review Threshold Package 2, development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that create or result in an increase of 250,000 square feet or more of warehouse area are subject to [Sec. 4C.14.1.C.3. (Supplemental Procedure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14.1) of this Subsection (Standards).

         Exception: Development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s which obtain any development rights under [Div. 9.3 (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3) are not subject to this Subparagraph (Major Development Project Review Thresholds).
3. ##### Supplemental Procedure


      Development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s subject to Development Review Package 1 or Development Review Package 2 meeting the thresholds outlined in [Sec. 4C.14.C.1.b. (Major Development Project Review Thresholds)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14), shall use the project review approval process in [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4); except initial decisions shall be appealed to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), rather than the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#). Additionally, if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) fails to make a decision on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) within the time limit specified in [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4), the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6), rather than a transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For calculating [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

2. Average daily trips are determined by, and using the trip generation factors promulgated by, the Los Angeles Department of Transportation.

3. For [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) see [Sec. 2C.4.2.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.2).

4. For the purposes of calculating [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s for this Section (Development Review Threshold Packages), [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s are exempted from the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).
5. ##### Exceptions


1. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) subject to Development Review Threshold Package 1 are exempt from review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4) provided that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets all of the following requirements:

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) involves the [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to one or more [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s and to one or more non-residential [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s;

      2. Fifty percent or more of the total new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) is dedicated to [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s;

      3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) maintains or increases the total number of preexisting [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and maintains or increases the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s; and

      4. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) results in the [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) of no more than 150,000 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) dedicated to one or more non-residential [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.
2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that provide [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s consistent with the affordability requirements in Subparagraph b. of [Sec. 15.4.3.B.1. (Exemptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3) are exempt from review pursuant to this Section (Development Review Threshold Packages).
6. ##### Relief


None.


### Div. 4C.15. Resident Protections

#### Sec. 4C.15.1. Housing Projects That Result In The Demolition of Dwelling Units

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Housing Projects That Result In The Demolition Of Dwelling Units) is to codify housing replacement requirements, ensure preservation of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s, and ensure consistent occupant protections when residential [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s result in the loss of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ##### Loss of Protected Units


      The requirements of this Section (Housing Projects That Result In The Demolition Of Dwelling Units) apply to any project that meets the definition of “housing development project” as defined in California Government Code Sec. 65589.5(h)(2), except that, for purposes of this Section (Housing Projects That Result In The Demolition Of Dwelling Units), “housing development project” also includes [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that involve no discretionary approvals and [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s to construct a single [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#), and either:
