For a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)(s) identified on the [Inventory of Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.13.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.13), the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) and [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall not, through any administrative, quasi-judicial, legislative or other actions, reduce the density of an applicable site, or approve any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on an applicable site with fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s in aggregate, by income category, than shown as realistic capacity in the most recent inventory of land suitable for residential development for the remaining housing element planning period, pursuant to California Government Code Sec. 65584, unless the applicable Department either:

      1. Makes applicable findings pursuant to California Government Code Sec. 65863(b), including that, while the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) would result in fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s by income category than those identified in the most recent inventory of land suitable for residential development prepared for the 2021-2029 Housing Element, the remaining sites identified in the Housing Element of the General Plan are adequate to meet the requirements of California Government Code Sec. 65583.2 and to accommodate the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)’s share of the regional housing need pursuant to California Government Code Sec. 65584. A written finding with substantial evidence shall be included as part of approval of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) on the number of sites by income category and their adequacy to meet the requirements; or

      2. If a finding cannot be made, then within 180 days of any of the actions described in Paragraph 1. above the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) shall, in accordance with the provisions of this Code, identify and make available additional adequate sites through a rezoning to accommodate the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#)'s share of the regional housing need by income level.
2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) may not be denied on the basis that approval of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) would require compliance with Subparagraph a. of Paragraph 1., above, if the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) meets the definition of “housing development project” as defined in paragraph (2) of subdivision (h) of California Government Code Sec. 65589.5, including [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that involve no discretionary approvals and [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#) s that include a proposal to construct a single [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#).

# Article 5. Use

## Part 5A. Introduction

### Div. 5A.1. Orientation

#### Sec. 5A.1.1. Relationship to Zone String

A [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is composed of the following Districts:

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=5abzLcA6)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.1.1.png?itok=Trr4N9Kt)

The [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is a separate and independent component of each zone.

#### Sec. 5A.1.2. How to Use Article 5. (Use)

1. ##### Identify the Applicable Use District


The fourth component in a [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) identifies the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) applied to a property.

2. ##### Determine What Uses are Permitted


1. ###### Reference the Use District Table


      The [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) identifies the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s permitted in a district, as well as their standards and limitations. The [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is organized into four columns. The first column, titled "Use", lists the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), to which a [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and applicable standards, if any, are assigned in the subsequent table columns to the right. The second column, titled "Permission", lists the [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) applied to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The third column, titled "Use Standard" includes any applicable standards regulating the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), and the fourth column, titled "Specification", includes additional specifications establishing the parameters or details for the applicable standards.

2. ###### Reference the Use Permissions


      [Permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are outlined in [Div.5A.3. (Use Permissions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.3), and a key is also included in the footer of each page of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for each [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ###### Reference the Use Definitions


      Refer to [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D) to confirm the definition of any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) listed in each [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Text in italics below a heading provides a definition of that heading.
3. ##### Identify Use District Rules


1. [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) rules are outlined in [Part. 5C. (Use Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C). The use standard column in each [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) page identifies the applicable rules, if any, specific to each [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) within that [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The specification column identifies the details or parameters for the applicable general use standard, supplemental use standard, supplemental use finding, or special use program, if any. Any supplemental use standard or findings or standards applicable to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) can be found in the code Section referenced in the Specification column. General use standards are provided in [Sec. 5C.1. (General Use Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1), Supplemental use standards and findings are provided in [Sec. 5C.2. (Supplemental Use Standards & Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2), and special use programs are provided in [Sec. 5C.3. (Special Use Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3).

2. Some general use standards apply to an entire use category. When this is the case, the general standard is listed in the row below the use category heading (see, e.g., Light Industrial use category in the Industrial Use Districts.). If the general use standard reads "Use standard applicability" that standard only applies if the specification criteria listed below “Use standard applicability” is met (e.g., "Adjoining lot" in the use standard column and "Sensitive use, Residential, Residential-Mix, or Agricultural Use District" listed in the specification column, means the standards listed below only apply when the lot adjoins a lot within a residential, residential-mix, or agricultural use district).

3. ###### Identify General Use Standards


      Every general [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard on a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) page in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) corresponds with a Section in [Div. 5C.1. (General Use Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1), where the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard is explained in detail.

4. ###### Identify Supplemental Standards


      The [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) identifies required supplemental standards, if any. The required supplemental standards for a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are established in [Div. 5C.2. (Supplemental Use Standards & Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2).

5. ###### Identify Supplemental Findings


      The [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) identifies required supplemental findings, if any. The required supplemental findings for a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are established in [Div. 5C.2. (Supplemental Use Standards & Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2).

6. ###### Relief From Use Standard


      When “relief” is provided within the standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the specified relief option is from the standard(s) shown indented directly above the word "relief." Where multiple standards are shown indented, relief is available for each of those standards. Relief from a general use standard in [Division 5C.1. (General Use Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1) may also be allowed if a relief process is indicated in the relief subsection of the standard.
       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=ETx042c4)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.2.1.png?itok=rvK_ssbT) [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.2.3.png.webp?itok=6Lr6vW7C)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.2.3.png?itok=jCMBZ2a1)

#### Sec. 5A.1.3. Use District Naming Convention

All [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) names are comprised of two components: a [use category](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and a variation number.

1. ##### Use District Category


The first component of each [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) name is a [use category](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). A [use category](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) groups all districts with similar characteristics. The use categories are organized as follows:

1. Open Space (OS)

2. Agricultural (A)

3. Residential (RG)

4. Residential-Mixed (RX)

5. Commercial-Mixed (CX)

6. Industrial-Mixed (IX)

7. Industrial (I)

8. Public (P)
2. ##### Variation Number


The last component of each [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) name is a variation number. All [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are numbered in the order they fall within this Article (Use).

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.3.1.png.webp?itok=L_ORAUHX)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/5A.1.3.1.png?itok=XTAEgaUY)


### Div. 5A.2. General Rules

#### Sec. 5A.2.1. Use Intent

The intent of this Article (Use) is to establish the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definitions in order to regulate the activities on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), and to mitigate any potential impacts within a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and on surrounding property as a result of those activities, to protect public health, safety, and welfare.

#### Sec. 5A.2.2. Use Applicability

1. ##### General


1. Most [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, operations, and facilities will contain more than one [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Where more than one [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) occurs on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or in the same operation or facility:

      1. Allowed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are specified by the applicable [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in accordance with [Div. 5A.3. (Use Permissions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.3), and combinations of allowed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are also permitted. Certain [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are allowed only as accessory to (pursuant to [Sec. 5C.1.1.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.1)), incidental to (pursuant to [Sec. 5C.1.2.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.2)), or in conjunction with (pursuant to [Sec. 5C.1.3.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.3)) another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      2. If all proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are permitted by the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), but there are conflicts between the required [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards, the most restrictive of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards shall prevail, including where multiple [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s overlap on the same portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
2. All [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s filed after the effective date of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall comply with the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards and all other provisions in this Article (Use), as further specified below. For vested rights, see [Sec. 1.4.5. (Vested Rights)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.4.5), and for continuance of existing development, see [Sec. 1.4.6. (Continuance of Existing Development)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.4.6).
2. ##### Applicable Components of Lots, Buildings, & Structures


1. Unless otherwise provided, [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) regulations apply to all portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. Unless otherwise provided, [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) regulations apply to all portions of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. Specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) regulations may further limit which components of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are required to comply with [Part 5C. (Use Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C).
3. ##### Nonconformity


[Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) provides relief from the requirements of this Article (Use) for existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) improvements, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that conformed to the zoning regulations at the time they were established, but do not conform to current [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards or [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s as to the provisions of [Div. 5A.3. (Use Permissions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.3), [Div. 5C.1. (General Use Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1), or [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D) specified by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), no [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may decrease the conformance with any regulations specified in this Article (Use), unless otherwise specified by [Div. 12.5.(Use Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5).


#### Sec. 5A.2.3. Relationship to Form, Frontage, & Development Standards

Regardless of allowed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, the form of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), its [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) improvements are regulated by, and shall comply with the standards in [Form Districts (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [Frontage Districts (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B), and [Development Standards Districts (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B). For example, an eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) might be allowed, but the Development Standard District regulations may prohibit [drive-through facilities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

#### Sec. 5A.2.4. Relationship to Density Districts

[Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that contain provisions for [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s do not include regulations regarding the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that are permitted. The [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) component of the [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), as described in [Article 6. (Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6), is the mechanism that regulates the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s permitted on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

### Div. 5A.3. Use Permissions

#### Sec. 5A.3.1. General

Use [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s set out in each [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) indicate how a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is permitted within the district. [Permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s range from permitted without requiring conformance to any additional standards or conditions of approval, permitted only when specific standards are met, or permitted only through a process requiring approval by a [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or decision-making body. [Permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s may be assigned to individual [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [use group](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, or entire use categories. [Permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are represented within each [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) using symbols that indicate which [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is assigned to a particular [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or [use category](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The following Sections summarize the meaning of each [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

#### Sec. 5A.3.2. Permitted (P)

A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is permitted without requiring conformance to specific standards is indicated in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the letter P.

#### Sec. 5A.3.3. Use Standard Applies (\*)

A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is permitted only when conforming to a specific set of standards is indicated in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the asterisk (\*) symbol in combination with the underlying [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Any [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be combined with an \* to cross-reference a specific set of general [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards, supplemental standards, or supplemental findings, that shall be applied. General [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards, supplemental standards, or supplemental findings indicated by the presence of an \* are important for ensuring that a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) exists and operates in a manner that is consistent with the intent of the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

#### Sec. 5A.3.4. Conditional Uses (CU1, CU2 & CU3)

A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that requires approval by an authority or decision-making body with input from the members of the public who may be affected by the existence of that [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be approved under certain conditions that address potential issues the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may introduce to its surroundings. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that may require specific conditions of approval applied through a discretionary process are indicated within the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s by the following [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s: CU1, CU2, and CU3, as described below.

1. ##### Class 1 Conditional Use (CU1)


A CU1 [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) indicates that a Class 1 Conditional Use Permit shall be obtained through approval granted by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in accordance with the processes and procedures described in [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1).

2. ##### Class 2 Conditional Use (CU2)


A CU2 [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) indicates that a Class 2 Conditional Use Permit shall be obtained through approval granted by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in accordance with the processes and procedures described in [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

3. ##### Class 3 Conditional Use (CU3)


A CU3 [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) indicates that a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit shall be obtained through approval granted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in accordance with the processes and procedures described in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3).


#### Sec. 5A.3.5. Special Use Program (S)

A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is permitted as established by, and in conformance with an applied Special Use Program is indicated in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the letter S. Special Use Program [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are subject to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and are considered generally appropriate within a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when in compliance with the applied Special Use Program to achieve a certain performance outcome or to moderate potential effects a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may have on its surroundings.

#### Sec. 5A.3.6. Dependent on Adjoining Zoning (A- & A+)

When an A- or A+ [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is indicated the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall assume the same [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) permissions, [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards, supplemental standards, and any supplemental procedures required by a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) applied to the zoning of an [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

1. ##### Dependent on Most Restrictive Adjoining Zone (A-)


1. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s assigned an A- permission level are regulated as follows:

      1. The [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be permitted, restricted, or disallowed according to the most restrictive set of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) permissions, [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards, supplemental standards, and supplemental procedures applied to the same [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of any [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      2. Only joint public and private developments that are approved in accordance with the processes and procedures described in [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5) and satisfying the finding requirements in [Div. 5C.2. (Supplemental Use Standards & Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2) shall be permitted when a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is assigned an A- permission level. No solely private developments are permitted when a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is assigned an A- permission level.
2. ##### Dependent on Most Permissive Adjoining Zone (A+)


1. The [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be permitted, restricted, or disallowed according to the most permissive set of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) permissions, use standards, supplemental standards, and supplemental procedures applied to the same [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of any [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      1. Only joint public and private developments that are approved in accordance with the processes and procedures described in [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5) shall be permitted when a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is assigned an A+ permission level. No solely private developments are permitted when a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is assigned an A+ permission level.
3. ##### Special Findings for Adjoining Zoning (A- & A+)


1. Regardless of Subsection A (Dependent on Most Restrictive Adjoining Zoning (A-)), when an A- permission level is indicated, any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is not permitted by the most restrictive [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) permission applied to the same [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of any [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be permitted by a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit. In addition to the other findings required by [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall also find:

      1. The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) provides a public benefit as a result of increased tax revenue or the provision of public facilities; and

      2. The benefit of the project providing the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is sufficient to outweigh any potential detriment to the public interest created by the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the land.
2. Regardless of Subsection B (Dependent on Most Permissive Adjoining Zoning (A+)), when an A+ permission level is indicated, any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is not permitted in the most permissive [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) permission applied to the same [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of any [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be permitted by a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit. In addition to the other findings required by [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall also find:

      1. The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) provides a public benefit as a result of increased tax revenue or the provision of public facilities; and

      2. The benefit of the project providing the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is sufficient to outweigh any potential detriment to the public interest created by the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the land.

#### Sec. 5A.3.7. Not Permitted (--)

When a double-dash line (--) is indicated as the [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is not permitted. A -- permission level signifies that under no circumstances shall the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) be allowed to be established in the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

### Div. 5B.6. Industrial-Mixed Use Districts

Industrial-Mixed Use Districts accommodate a mixture of [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), and research & development activity, with limited [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and other compatible [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

#### Sec. 5B.6.1. Industrial-Mixed 1 (IX1)

1. ##### Intent


The IX1 District is intended to accommodate a wide variety of employment, cultural, and recreational opportunities while supporting vulnerable [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with affordable housing and social services, and facilitate the efficient management of municipal resources.

#### Sec. 5B.6.4. Industrial-Mixed 4 (IX4)

1. ##### Intent


The IX4 District supports [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, as well as research & development, wholesale, and [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. This District allows for a limited amount of live/work units. This District is intended to promote productive industries and entrepreneurial activities.

#### Sec. 5B.7.2. Industrial 2 (I2)

1. ##### Intent


The I2 District allows [heavy commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and [heavy industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s as well as a limited amount of commercial activity. This District is intended to support employment and accommodate the most intense industrial activities while minimizing potential disruptions to surrounding uses.
