## Part 5C. Use Rules

### Div. 5C.1. General Use Standards

#### Sec. 5C.1.1. Accessory To

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Accessory To) is to allow an [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to complement a [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by limiting its scale in proportion to the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), thereby ensuring that the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not undermine the mix of [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is intended to accommodate.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Accessory To) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Accessory to" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be accessory to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) identified in the Specification column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and comply with all of the following:

1. [Accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are only allowed when provided on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or within the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. The [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed 25 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designated for the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. For outdoor [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s located [at-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the total [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage occupied by the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed 25 percent of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). In instances where the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located outdoors and the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage of the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed 25 percent of the [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) area occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

4. Where there are conflicts between the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards required for the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the most restrictive of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards shall prevail.
4. ##### Measurement


1. For measuring [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

2. The maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) allowed for an [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by multiplying the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by 25 percent.

3. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage is measured by dividing the total [at-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) surface area occupied by a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the total [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

4. The maximum [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage allowed for an [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by multiplying the total [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by 25 percent

5. Where the [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located outdoors and the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the maximum [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage allowed for an [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by multiplying the total [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by 25 percent.
5. ##### Relief


1. A 20 percent or less square footage increase for the allowable [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).

#### Sec. 5C.1.2. Incidental To

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Incidental To) is to allow an incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to complement a [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in limited scale, to ensure that the incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not undermine the mix of [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is intended to accommodate.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Incidental To) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Incidental to" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be incidental to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) identified in the Specification column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and comply with all of the following:

1. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that are required to be incidental to a [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are only allowed when provided on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or within the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. The [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designated for the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. For outdoor [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s located [at-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the total [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage occupied by incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed the lot coverage occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). In instances where the incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located outdoors and the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage of the incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed the [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) area occupied by the specified [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

4. Where there are conflicts between the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards required for the incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the most restrictive of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards shall prevail.
4. ##### Measurement


1. For measuring [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

2. The maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) allowed for an incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by determining the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designated for the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage is measured by dividing the total [at-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) surface area occupied by a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by the total [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

4. The maximum [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage allowed for an incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by determining the total [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

5. Where the incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located outdoors and the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the maximum [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) coverage allowed for an incidental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by determining the total [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) occupied by the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
5. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).


#### Sec. 5C.1.3. In Conjunction With

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (In Conjunction With) is to ensure that a [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is consistently combined with other specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s to help sustain the mix of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is intended to accommodate, and to achieve the benefits of multi-use facilities.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (In Conjunction With) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "In conjunction with" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be provided in conjunction with the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s specified in the Specification column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and comply with all of the following:

1. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that are required to be in conjunction with another specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are only allowed when provided on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or within the same [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may exceed the size of the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. When a [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes a “Minimum area” requirement in the Use Standard column, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall only be allowed when the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is provided with dedicated [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that meets or exceeds the minimum [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) cited in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s Specification column.

4. Where there are conflicts between the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards of the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the most restrictive of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards shall prevail.
4. ##### Measurement


1. A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be measured as in conjunction with another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when both [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are present concurrently on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), within the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or within the same [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. The minimum area that is required to be dedicated for a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is calculated by multiplying the total [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or cumulative [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) area by the [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specified in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s Specification column.

      1. For measuring [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).

      2. For calculating the total [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 2C.1.1. (Lot Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.1.1).

      3. Cumulative [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) area shall be calculated by determining the total square footage of all land area within a [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
5. ##### Relief


1. A 20 percent or less reduction in the minimum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) requirement for the specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).

#### Sec. 5C.1.4. Size

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Size) is to allow a [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) while ensuring the scale of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is compatible with the overall mix of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is intended to accommodate.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Size) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Size" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Size, Entire Use


      Where the [Use District Table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies "Size, entire use", [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s limited to a specified size for the entire [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are allowed only when the total area dedicated to the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is less than or equal to the size maximum specified in the Use District table.

2. ###### Size, Tenant Space


      Where the [Use District Table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies "Size, tenant space", [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s limited to a specified size per tenant space are allowed only when the [ground floor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) area of an individual tenant space dedicated to the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is less than or equal to the size maximum specified in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      1. Multiple tenant spaces dedicated to the same [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be allowed on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or within the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), provided that each tenant space is less than or equal to the size maximum specified in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      2. [Upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is exempt from tenant space size limits.
3. ###### Size, Dwelling Unit Average


      Where the [Use District Table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies "Size, dwelling unit average", [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s required to conform to an average unit size are allowed only when the average [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) provided to [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is equal to or greater than the average size specified in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
4. ##### Measurement


1. ###### Size, Entire Use


      The size of an entire [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be measured by calculating the cumulative area dedicated to the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on a single [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      1. For [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s located within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be used to determine cumulative area.

      2. For [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s not located within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the total square footage shall be used to determine cumulative area.
2. ###### Size, Tenant Space


      The size of a tenant space shall be measured by calculating the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that meets the following criteria:

      1. Is located on the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

      2. Has a dedicated entrance, not shared with any other tenant space;

      3. Has no direct connections to another tenant space sharing a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with the tenant space dedicated to the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

      4. Is not inclusive of common corridors and shared restrooms intended for all tenants of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
3. ###### Size, Dwelling Unit Average


      The average [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) size shall be measured by determining the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#); then dividing the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) allocated to [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s by the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The result will be the average [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) size.

4. For measuring [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.7. (Floor Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.7).
5. ##### Relief


1. A 20 percent or less increase in the maximum size specified by the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).

#### Sec. 5C.1.5. Location

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Location) is to limit [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s having specific qualities in order to ensure the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is compatible with its surroundings and complies with the intent of the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Location) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Location" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Alley Abutting


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies "Alley Abutting" for the location requirement, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be permitted when the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) having a width of 15 feet or greater.

2. ###### Boulevard or Avenue Fronting


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies "Boulevard or Avenue Fronting" for the location requirement, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be permitted when the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) sharing a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with a street designated as a [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). On [through lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s sharing a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with a street designated as a Collector or Local, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may only be permitted on the 1/2 portion of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is fronting a street designated as a [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ###### Ground Story


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Ground Story” as the location requirement, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be located at the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and no portion of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be located on any [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

4. ###### Upper Story


      Where the applied [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Upper Story” as the location requirement, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be located in the upper stories of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and no portion of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be located on the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

5. ###### Corner Lot


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies "Corner Lot" for the location requirement standard, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be permitted when the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) located at the intersection of two streets.
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) width is measured as the narrowest horizontal distance between opposite edges of a designated [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. For [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) determination see [Sec. 14.2.12. (Lot Line Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12).

3. For [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) measurement see [Sec. 2C.1.1.D. (Lot Area, Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.1.1).
5. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).


#### Sec. 5C.1.6. Hours of Operation

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Hours of Operation) is to limit the negative impacts of the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on neighboring [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s containing [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or other [sensitive use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s by limiting the duration of activity for a [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Hours of Operation) applies to a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Hours of operation" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


1. The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not open to the public or perform services for clients or customers earlier than the time of earliest open specified by the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not be open to the public or performing services for clients or customers later than the time of latest close specified by the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. An additional hour prior to the earliest allowed opening time and after the latest allowed closing time is permitted for the following activities:

      1. Opening preparations and closeout tasks associated with the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

      2. Clearing of all temporary installations, debris, trash and any other material associated with the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

      3. Trash service; and

      4. Loading and unloading activities, including deliveries and shipments.
4. ##### Measurement


Subject to Subsection C. (Standards), hours of operation are measured as the hours during which the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is open to the public or performing services for clients or customers.

5. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).


#### Sec. 5C.1.7. Screening

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Screening) is to mitigate negative external impacts from a [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on the surrounding area through filtering pollutants, reducing noise, and promoting visual interest in order to maintain comfort for users of the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), adjacent [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and the public realm.

2. ##### Applicability


[Screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes " [Screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


[Proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be screened using the screen type specified by the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s as described in [Div. 4C.8. (Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8) subject to the following:

1. [Frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall meet the standards provided in [Sec. 4C.8.1.C. (Frontage Screens)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.1).

2. [Transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall meet the standards provided in [Sec. 4C.8.2.C. (Transition Screens)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.2).

3. [Outdoor storage screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall meet the standards provided in [Sec. 4C.8.3. (Outdoor Storage Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.3).
4. ##### Measurement


1. [Frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be measured according to the provisions of [Sec. 4C.8.1.D. (Frontage Screens)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.1).

2. [Transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be measured according to the provisions of [Sec. 4C.8.2.D. (Transition Screens)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.2).

3. [Outdoor storage screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be measured according to the provisions of [Sec. 4C.8.3.D. (Outdoor Storage Screening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.3).
5. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A. 1.2.C.4. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A).


#### Sec. 5C.1.8. Enclosure

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Enclosure) is to mitigate potential external impacts from activities generated by a [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) such as pollutants, debris or noise on surrounding areas.

2. ##### Applicability


1. [Enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards apply to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Enclosure" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. [Enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) requirements shall not apply to [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) areas, such as [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [drive aisle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and maneuvering, loading, and staging areas, that serve the [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Indoors


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Indoors” for the enclosure standard, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be located entirely within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that meets the following criteria:

      1. Has an [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of 100 percent, with the exception of [building entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and bay doors, which shall remain closed except during the allowed hours of operation.

      2. Is [sheltered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by a solid roof, including mechanical ventilation to prevent fugitive emissions, unless another regulatory agency requires natural ventilation. A stack, vent and flare is exempt from this requirement.
2. ###### Covered


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Covered” for the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard, any area containing the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall meet the standards of a [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specified in [Sec. 14.2.2. (Covered Area (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2).

3. ###### Enclosed


      Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Enclosed” for the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard, any area containing the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall meet the standards of [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specified in [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

4. ###### Covered & Enclosed


      Where the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Covered & enclosed” for the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard, any area containing the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall meet the standards of both [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specified in [Sec. 14.2.2. (Covered Area (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2) and [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specified in [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).
4. ##### Measurement


1. For the measurement of indoors, see [Sec. 14.2.2.A.3. (Sheltered)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2), [Sec. 14.2.2. (Covered Area (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2) and [Sec. 14.2.4.B. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

2. For the measurement of [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.2.A.1. (Covered Area (%))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.2).

3. For the measurement of [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.4.B. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).
5. ##### Exceptions


[Motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s allowed in connection with the [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are exempt from [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) requirements.

6. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).


#### Sec. 5C.1.9. Separation

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Separation) is to ensure appropriate distancing between a [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), that may be disruptive or hazardous, and [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and [sensitive use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within its vicinity.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Separation) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Separation" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


The proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be located at least the minimum distance away from any specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as provided in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

4. ##### Measurement


[Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) separation shall be measured as the horizontal distance to any portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designated with the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) from one of the following:

1. When measured from a specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the nearest [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s containing that specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. When measured from a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the nearest [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s zoned as that [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
5. ##### Relief


1. A 20 percent or less reduction in required [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) away from any specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).

#### Sec. 5C.1.10. Amplified Sound Restrictions

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Amplified Sound Restrictions) is intended to reduce potential negative external sound impacts from activities generated from a [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on the surrounding area by regulating amplified sound for said [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Amplified Sound Restrictions) standard applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Amplified sound restrictions" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


Where the applied [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies “Amplified Sound Restrictions” are “Applicable", no amplified sound is permitted and all background music and permanently installed speakers are prohibited in areas dedicated to the [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which meet one or more of the following criteria:

1. Are [uncovered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#),

2. Are [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or

3. Meet the definition of an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
4. ##### Measurement


A [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be measured as having no amplified sound if there is an absence of any permanently installed speakers in all areas on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that meet the criteria outlined in Subsection C. (Standards), above.

5. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).


#### Sec. 5C.1.11. Designated Work Space

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Designated Work Space) is to ensure that a specified amount of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as part of a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is dedicated to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that generate productive activity, creative enterprises, and employment.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Designated Work Space) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Designated work space" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


1. Where the applied [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies a “Designated Work Space” is “Required”, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be combined with a space that meets all the following standards:

      1. Contained within each [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) provided;

      2. Occupy a minimum of 48 percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of each live/work unit;

      3. Designed and intended for [general commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and/or [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s;

      4. Have a minimum width of 10 feet;

      5. Have a minimum depth of 15 feet;

      6. Have a minimum floor to ceiling height of 16 feet when occupying the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

      7. Have a minimum floor to ceiling height of 10 feet when occupying the upper stories of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#); and

      8. Provide an open plan area, with no fixed interior separation [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for 70 percent of the total designated work space area.
2. Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) stipulates that live/work [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be provided in conjunction with a minimum area reserved for specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, the designated work space incorporated within each live/work unit can be included in the calculation of the minimum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) required to be reserved for specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.
4. ##### Measurement


1. Designated work space area as a percentage of each live/work unit shall be calculated as the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the designated work space area divided by the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the live/work unit.

2. For determining the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), see [Sec. 14.2.10.A. (Ground Story)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.10).

3. Designated work space width is measured as the shortest horizontal distance along the boundaries of the Designated Work Space.

4. Designated work space depth is measured from the primary entrance to the Designated Work Space inward to the closest edge of the Designated Work Space.

5. Floor to ceiling height is measured vertically from the top of the finished floor to the top of the ceiling above.

6. Only portions of the interior space that meet that minimum depth, width, and floor to ceiling height dimensions shall be counted towards meeting the designated work space standard.
5. ##### Exceptions


1. ###### Adaptive Reuse


      Designated work space provided as part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be exempt from all design and dimension standards listed in Subsection C. (Standards) above. Instead, the following standards shall apply to designated work space provided as part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#):

      1. Shall be contained within each live/work unit provided.

      2. Shall occupy a minimum of 10 percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of each live/work unit.
2. ###### Industrial-Mixed 4


      Standard provisions described in Subsection C. (Standards) above allowing the Designated Work Space incorporated within each live/work unit to be included in the calculation of the minimum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) required to be reserved for specified [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall not apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s in the Industrial-Mixed 4 Use District.
6. ##### Relief


1. A reduction in any dimensional standard of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

2. A reduction in the minimum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) required to be Designated Work Space of 20 percent or less may be granted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).

3. See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).

#### Sec. 5C.1.12. Project Category Exceptions

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Project Category Exceptions) is to allow or prohibit specific [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) types as an exception to permissions or standards applied to a [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Project Category Exceptions) applies to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Project category exceptions" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Project Category Exceptions


      1. Where the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies a “Project category exceptions”, the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard will cite one of the following [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) category listed below:

         1. [New construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)

         2. [Change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)

         3. [Intensification of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)

         4. [Adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)

         5. Affordable Housing

         6. Campus Unified Development
      2. The [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will specify that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) category (or categories) cited are either “exempt” or “prohibited”.
2. ###### Exempt


      When the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies that one of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) categories listed in Paragraph 1. (Project Category Exceptions) above is “Exempt”, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be exempted from otherwise complying with any general [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards and restrictive permission levels that applies to the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ###### Prohibited


      When the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies that the one of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) types listed in Paragraph 1. (Project Category Exceptions) above is “Prohibited”, the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not be permitted in accordance with [Sec. 5A.3.2. (Permitted (P))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.3.2) when the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is provided as part of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) type cited.

4. ###### New Construction


      Where the use standard cites "new construction" as the project category exception, any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in order to accommodate the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be either “exempt” in accordance with Paragraph 2, or “prohibited” in accordance with Paragraph 3, based on the exception citied in [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s specification column.

5. ###### Change of Use


      Where the use standard cites "change of use" as the project category exception, any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving a [change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in order to accommodate the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be either “exempt” in accordance with Paragraph 2, or “prohibited” in accordance with Paragraph 3, based on the exception citied in [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s specification column.

6. ###### Intensification of Use


      Where the use standard cites "intensification of use" as the project category exception, any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving an [intensification of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in order to accommodate the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be either “exempt” in accordance with Paragraph 2, or “prohibited” in accordance with Paragraph 3, based on the exception citied in [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s specification column.

      1. ###### Intensification Threshold


         When the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes an intensification threshold represented as a percentage (%), the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) exception applies only to [intensification of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that are less than or equal to the threshold cited.

         1. ###### Floor Area


            The increase in the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be limited to a percentage increase from the previously approved [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), based on the percentage cited in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s Specification column.

         2. ###### Dwelling Units

#### Sec. 5C.1.13. Affordable Housing

1. ##### Intent


The intent of the standards of this Section (Affordable Housing) is to limit housing development within a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that include affordable housing.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Affordable Housing) applies to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) includes "Affordable housing" in the Use Standard column of the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Standards


[Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s including [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall provide, at minimum, the percentage of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s specified by the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

4. ##### Measurement


1. The percentage of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that are [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s is calculated by dividing the number of affordable units by the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), exclusive of a [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or units.

2. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are measured as [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s when provided in accordance with the definition of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3).
5. ##### Relief


See the Use Standard column in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for relief options pursuant to [Sec. 5A.1.2.C.6. (Relief from Use Standard)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.1.2).


### Div. 5C.2. Supplemental Use Standards, Procedures, & Findings

Supplemental use standards are development and operational regulations that apply only to the specified use. Supplemental use standards are unique for each [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and, unless specific [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) are listed, apply to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) affecting the [subject use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). See the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for applicable supplemental use standards. When a supplemental use standard for a specified use does not apply the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will indicate “Not required” for that specified use.

Supplemental procedures are modifications of existing procedures from Sec. 13B. (Processes & Procedures) that apply to the approval of a specified use or allowed relief from the use standards when indicated in the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). When supplemental procedures for a specified use do not apply, the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will indicate “Not required” for that specified use.

Supplemental use findings are additional findings or requirements that apply to the conditional use process for specified uses when indicated by the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). When applicable, supplemental use findings are unique for each [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). See the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for applicable supplemental use findings. When supplemental use findings for a specified use with a conditional use process does not apply, the [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will indicate “Not required” for that specified use.

That the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s of property surrounding the proposed location of the household business: joint living & work quarters and the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the proposed location will not be detrimental to the health, safety and welfare of prospective [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s of the quarters;

1. ##### Animal Services: General

2. ##### Eating & Drinking: All


Any portion of any eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on private property designed and intended for the service and consumption of food and drinks, that has less than 75 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) (regardless of [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) percentage), or less than 25 percent [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) (regardless of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) percentage) shall be considered an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and subject to the following:

1. ###### Supplemental Standards


      01. The [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) must be provided in conjunction with an eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that has 75 percent or more [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or 25 percent or more [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to [Sec. 5C.1.3. (In Conjunction With)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.3).

      02. The [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) supplemental standards may, at the applicant's request, supersede conditions associated with the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which were previously imposed as part of a discretionary approval.

      03. Hours of operation in the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall end at 10:30 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday if the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or across an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) from a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3). If the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is not [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or across an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) from a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), then the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is subject to applicable hours limitation imposed by law, discretionary action, or other previously issued permit.

      04. Despite any provisions to the contrary, the noise levels of the area dedicated to the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not exceed the standards set forth in the [Noise Ordinance](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/c9fbcb13-317a-4c17-ac49-dd73c048d995/GPF_FEIR_DEIR2.20.pdf).

      05. Live music, live entertainment including but not limited to disc jockeys, karaoke, dancing, and [sexually oriented business](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are prohibited in [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

      06. Pool tables and billiard tables are prohibited in [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

      07. Television monitors and other similar audiovisual devices are prohibited in [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

      08. [Outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be cleaned nightly and adjoining sidewalk areas shall be kept free of debris, litter, and graffiti.

      09. A City-issued identification shall be posted in [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and made clearly visible to the public, indicating that the area is subject to the standards of the Al Fresco Ordinance. The identification shall include the City’s MyLA311 portal as the contact information for complaints or concerns regarding the operation of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) during regular business hours. A hotline phone number and contact information for [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be provided for complaints or concerns regarding the operation of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that occur after business hours. A telephone number of the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) operator or manager shall be provided for complaints or concerns regarding the operation of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      10. A [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) reminding guests to be respectful of surrounding neighbors shall be posted in [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

3. ###### Noncompliance/Revocation


      1. ###### Failure to Comply


         Failure to comply with any of the regulations and standards set forth in this Subsection (Eating & Drinking: All) shall constitute a violation of the Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and may result in a citation, Administrative Citation, Orders to Comply and/or other available enforcement mechanisms identified herein or in the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      2. ###### Inspections


         The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall have the authority to conduct inspections, consistent with [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 98.0105. (Inspections)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189429) of this Code, to verify compliance with all of the requirements prescribed in this Subsection (Eating & Drinking: All).          A citation for violating this Subsection (Eating & Drinking: All) shall include, but is not limited to, Administrative Citations and/or Notice to Appear Citations issued by the Los Angeles Police Department, and Orders to Comply and/or Notices of Violation issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      5. ###### Administrative Process Applicable to Administrative Citations


         Unless otherwise specified herein, all Administrative Citations issued for violations of this Subsection (Eating & Drinking: All) shall be subject to the provisions set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1.2. (Administrative Citations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225704) of this Code, including, but not limited to, an administrative hearing and appeal process as set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1.2. (Administrative Citations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225704) of this Code and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s authority to use any civil remedy available to collect any unpaid administrative fine.

(Supplemental Standards) above may result in revocation of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.3. (Building Permit Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.3).

(General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.00. (m) (Provisions Applicable to Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107510) of this Code and not the administrative fines authorized by this Subsection (Eating & Drinking: All).

      1. The [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for an [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) keeping [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not be less than 17,500 square feet.

      2. The number of [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s kept shall not exceed one [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for each 4,000 square feet of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      3. An animal which is under 12 months of age, and is the offspring of or is unweaned and being nursed by a female [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) lawfully kept on the property where said animal is kept, shall not be considered an [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and shall be allowed by right on said property.
4. ##### Animal Keeping: Equine, Non-commercial


1. ###### Supplemental Standards


      1. The [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for an [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) keeping [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not be less than 17,500 square feet.

      2. The number of [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s kept shall not exceed one [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for each 4,000 square feet of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      3. An animal which is under 12 months of age, and is the offspring of or is unweaned and being nursed by a female [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) lawfully kept on the property where said animal is kept, shall not be considered an [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and shall be allowed by right on said property.
5. ##### Animal Keeping: Livestock


1. ###### Supplemental Standards
