### Div. 5C.3. Special Use Programs

Special use programs are established for [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that require a detailed and prescriptive set of performance standards for safe, orderly, and efficient operation, in addition to any general [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards and supplemental standards or findings that may be included in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

#### Sec. 5C.3.1. Inclusionary Housing Program

1. ##### Intent


The Inclusionary Housing Program is intended to ensure the development of housing that is affordable to a range of [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s at all income levels by requiring that a portion of all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving the construction of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, referred to in this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program) as an [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to this program includes [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. When implemented, this program will help to increase the availability of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s at all income levels, and help the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) meet its share of regional housing needs in a manner that is consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) policies related to housing.

2. ##### Applicability


1. The requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program) apply to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a major remodel, a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), that will result in 10 or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) included on the Inclusionary Housing Map, as established in [Sec. 1.5.10. (Inclusionary Housing Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.10), and as outlined in the Subsections below.

2. The requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program) do not apply to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or a [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), that will result in 9 or fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. These [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are considered permitted if the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) specifies the use permission level of “S” or “S\*” for the [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), but may be subject to additional use standards as established in the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

3. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that have not been designated on the Inclusionary Housing Map shall not be subject to the requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program).

4. An [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in accordance with [Sec. 9.4.5. (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.5) or [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6) shall not be subject to the requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program).

5. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) subject to this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program) shall be referred to as an [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
3. ##### Inclusionary Standards


An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall comply with the following requirements in this Subsection (Inclusionary Standards), or the requirements of an applicable [Community Plan Implementation Overlay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), unless a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) otherwise complies with the alternatives established in Subsection D. (Inclusionary Alternatives) below.

1. ###### Inclusionary Rental (IR)


      An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s which are for rent shall set aside the minimum required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for rent provided in the applicable Inclusionary Program Set Designation. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which are for sale shall not be subject to the minimum required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

2. ###### Inclusionary Rental & For-Sale (IRF)


      An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s which are either rental, for-sale, or a combination of both, shall set aside the minimum required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s as required by the designated Affordability Requirement Set. The designated Affordability Requirement Set shall be determined for a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by referring to the Inclusionary Housing Map.

3. ###### Inclusionary Program Set Designations


      An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall provide, at minimum, the percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s specified in at least one of the income ranges listed in the applicable Affordability Requirement Set, as established below. The applicable Affordability Requirement Set for an [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be based on the Inclusionary Housing Set the project is located within on the Inclusionary Housing Map.




      | Affordability Requirement Sets |
      | --- |
      | Inclusionary Housing Set | Affordability Requirements |
      | --- | --- |
      | Acutely Low Income | Extremely Low Income | Very Low Income | Low Income | Moderate Income |
      | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
      | A | 8% | 8% | 10% | 12% | 16% |
      | B | 12% | 13% | 15% | 17% | 28% |
      | C | 80% | 80% | 80% | 80% | 80% |



      1. ###### Calculating Required Units


         The minimum percentage of required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be calculated based on the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s in the [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number, and not calculated as specified in [Sec. 6C.1.2. (Lot Area Per Household Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.2) or [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area Per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3). [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s provided pursuant to this program may also count towards the affordable housing incentive programs established in [Sec. 9.2.1. (Density Bonus)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1) or [Sec. 9.3.2. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2), provided they comply with the requirements in those Sections.

      2. ###### For-Sale Units


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s which are offered on a for-sale bases shall be subject to an applicant agreement with the Los Angeles Housing Department that ensures that a for-sale unit that qualified the applicant for the Inclusionary Housing Program meets either of the following conditions:

         1. The unit is initially occupied by a [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or [extremely low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), as required, and it is offered at an affordable housing cost, as that cost is defined in [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 50052.5. (Definitions)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50052.5.&lawCode=HSC) and is subject to an equity sharing agreement; or

         2. The unit is purchased by a [qualified nonprofit housing corporation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to a recorded contract that satisfies all of the requirements specified in the [California Revenue and Taxation Code, Sec. 402.1. (General Requirements), Paragraph (10).](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=402.1.&lawCode=RTC) and that includes all of the following:

            1. A repurchase option that requires a subsequent purchaser of the property that desires to resell or convey the property to offer the [qualified nonprofit housing corporation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) the right to repurchase the property prior to selling or conveying that property to any other purchaser;

            2. An equity sharing agreement, as specified in Paragraph 4. (Equity Sharing Agreement) of Subsection E. (Records & Agreements) below; and

            3. Affordability restrictions on the sale and conveyance of the property that ensure that the property will be preserved for lower income housing for at least 45 years for owner-occupied housing units and will be sold or resold only to [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, or [extremely low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, as defined in [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 50052.5. (Definitions)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50052.5.&lawCode=HSC).
      3. ###### Restricted Affordable Unit Size & Distribution


         The size, construction finishes, and distribution of all required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be provided in accordance with any guidelines established by the Los Angeles Housing Department.
4. ###### Non Designated Lots


      [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that have not been designated on the Inclusionary Housing Map are not be subject to the requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program). [Residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on non-designated [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with an applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) assigning an S (Special Use Program) [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be permitted in accordance with [Sec. 5A.3.2. (Permitted (P))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.3.2), in addition to any applicable general or supplemental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards as indicated by an asterisk (\*) in accordance with [Sec. 5A.3.3. (Use Standard Applies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5A.3.3).
4. ##### Inclusionary Alternatives


In lieu of compliance with the requirements in Subsection C. (Inclusionary Standards) above, the requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program) may be satisfied by implementing one of the following alternatives if approved pursuant to the applicable process in Subsection F. (Procedures) below.

1. ###### In-Lieu Fee


      The affordability provisions of this program may be satisfied by the payment of an in lieu fee to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in lieu of constructing the [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within the [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The fee is due and payable to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund, established in [Chapter 122. (Affordable Housing Trust Fund), Div. 5. (Finance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-26973) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) at the time of and in no event later than issuance of the first [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), concurrent with and proportional to project phases. The developer may defer payment of all or a portion of the in lieu fee until, but no later than issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), by payment of a deferral surcharge, as established in Paragraph d. (Deferral Surcharge), below, with the in lieu fee. The in lieu fee shall be determined by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) based on the following:

      1. ###### Fee


         The amount of the in lieu fee shall be determined by the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s equivalent to 1.1 times the required number of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for the [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), in the same proportion of affordability, multiplied by the applicable affordability gap, as established in Paragraph b. (Affordability Gap) below.

      2. ###### Affordability Gap


         The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall identify the affordability gap for rental and ownership units of each bedroom size (studio, one bedroom, two bedroom and three bedroom) for each required affordability level supported by a study (affordability gap study) that considers the following:

         1. ###### Rental Units


            For rental [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, the study shall collect and determine, by unit type and affordability level, the following information from recently completed affordable housing [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s funded by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s Affordable Housing Trust Fund: total development costs and operating expenses. The study shall also determine the amount of permanent financing available based on restricted rents and prevailing interest rates. The difference between the total development cost and permanent financing amount shall be the affordability gaps per unit by unit type and affordability level.

         2. ###### For-Sale Units


            For for-sale [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, the study shall identify the market median sales prices by unit type in the 34 Community Plan areas. It shall determine the restricted sales prices of for-sale units by unit type and affordability level. The difference between the market median sales price and the restricted sales price shall be the affordability gaps per unit by unit type and affordability level.
      3. ###### Bi-Annual Fee Adjustment


         The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall adjust the in lieu fee every two years, based on the results of a new affordability gap study. An affordability gap study, the proposed adjusted affordability gaps, and the adjusted fees shall be published within two years of the date that the original affordability gaps study is released, and consecutively thereafter by the date that is two years after the release of the previous affordability gaps study. If the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not meet the deadline in this paragraph, the in lieu fee will remain set at the existing level until the provisions of this paragraph are met.

      4. ###### Deferral Surcharge


         The deferral surcharge will be assessed at the Wall Street Journal Prime Rate plus 200 basis points at the time such fee is due, (at the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)). The deferral surcharge fee shall be deposited into the Affordable Housing Trust Fund established in [Chapter 122. (Affordable Housing Trust Fund), Div. 5. (Finance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-26973) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
5. ##### Records & Agreements


Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the following requirements shall be met.

1. ###### Restricted Affordable Unit Covenants


      For any [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that contains [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, a covenant acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department must be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, guaranteeing that the affordability criteria will be observed for at least 99 years, except as established in Subparagraph a., Subparagraph b., and Subparagraph c. below, from the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or a longer period of time if required by the construction or mortgage financing assistance program, mortgage assistance program, or rental subsidy program. The following are exempt from the 99 year covenant length:

      1. An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in which 100 percent of all [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, exclusive of a [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or units, are [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, which are subject to a recorded affordability restriction of at least 55 years or utilize public subsidies that are tied to a specified covenant period. At minimum, all [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s in the [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be covenanted for at least 55 years; or

      2. A mixed-income [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) utilizing public subsidies that are tied to a specified covenant period. At minimum, all [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s in the [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be covenanted for at least 55 years; or

      3. [Inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s financed by low-income housing tax credits. At minimum, all [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s in the [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be covenanted for at least 55 years.
2. ###### Conflicts of Duration of Affordability Covenants


      If the duration of affordability covenants established in Paragraph 1. (Restricted Affordable Unit Covenants) above conflicts with the duration for any other government requirement, the longest duration controls.

3. ###### Right of Enforcement


      Any covenant described in this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program) must provide for a right of enforcement by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), any tenant, and the owner of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to which a covenant and agreement applies.

4. ###### Equity Sharing Agreement


      An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that has opted to an equity sharing agreement for for-sale [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be required to enter into an agreement with the Los Angeles Housing Department as outlined below, unless it is in conflict with the requirements of another public funding source or law.

      1. Upon resale, the seller of the unit shall retain the value of any improvements, the down payment, and the seller’s proportionate share of appreciation.

      2. Except as provided in Subparagraph e. below, the local government shall recapture any initial subsidy, as defined in Subparagraph c. below, and its proportionate share of appreciation, as defined in Subparagraph d. below, which amount shall be used within five years for any of the purposes described in the [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 33334.2., Subdivision (e).](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=33334.2.&lawCode=HSC) that promote home ownership.

      3. For purposes of the equity sharing agreement, the Los Angeles Housing Department’s initial subsidy shall be equal to the fair market value of the home at the time of initial sale minus the initial sale price to the [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), plus the amount of any down payment assistance or mortgage assistance. If upon resale the market value is lower than the initial market value, then the value at the time of the resale shall be used as the initial market value.

      4. For purposes of the equity sharing agreement, the Los Angeles Housing Department’s proportionate share of appreciation shall be equal to the ratio of the Los Angeles Housing Department’s initial subsidy to the fair market value of the home at the time of initial sale.

      5. If the unit is purchased or developed by a [qualified nonprofit housing corporation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) the Los Angeles Housing Department may enter into a contract with the [qualified nonprofit housing corporation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) under which the [qualified nonprofit housing corporation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) would recapture any initial subsidy and its proportionate share of appreciation if the [qualified nonprofit housing corporation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is required to use 100 percent of the proceeds to promote homeownership for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s as defined by [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 50079.5.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50079.5.&lawCode=HSC) within the jurisdiction of the Los Angeles Housing Department.
6. ##### Procedures


The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall issue a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for any [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that meets the requirements of this Section (Inclusionary Housing Program).

1. ###### Administrative Guidelines


      An [inclusionary housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) utilizing an alternative in Subsection D. (Inclusionary Alternatives) above, shall also require approval from the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

#### Sec. 5C.3.2. Home-Sharing Program

01. ##### Intent


    To allow for the efficient use and sharing of a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) structure which is a host’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), without detracting from the surrounding residential character or the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s available housing stock.

02. ##### Definitions


    The following definitions shall apply to this Section (Home-Sharing Program):

    01. ###### Administrative Guidelines


        The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or Office of Finance may promulgate regulations, which may include, but are not limited to, [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) requirements, interpretations, conditions, reporting requirements, enforcement procedures, and disclosure requirements, to implement the provisions, and consistent with the intent, of this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

    02. ###### Booking Service


        A booking service is defined as any reservation or payment service provided by a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that facilitates a [short-term rental](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction between a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and a prospective guest or transient user, and for which the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) collects or receives, directly or indirectly through an agent or intermediary, a fee in connection with the reservation or payment of services provided for the transaction.

    03. ###### Citation


        Citation includes any enforcement citation, order, ticket or similar notice of violation, relating to the condition of or activities at a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or property, issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), Los Angeles Housing Department, Los Angeles Police Department, or Los Angeles Fire Department, including an Administrative Citation issued pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1.2. (Administrative Citations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225704) of this Code.

    04. ###### Extended Home-Sharing


        Extended home-sharing is defined as home-sharing that is permitted for an unlimited number of days in a calendar year.

    05. ###### Host


        Host is defined as an individual who is registered for home-sharing pursuant to this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

    06. ###### Hosting Platform


        Hosting platform is defined as a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that participates in short-term rental business by collecting or receiving a fee, directly or indirectly through an agent or intermediary, for conducting a [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction using any medium of facilitation.

    07. ###### Person


        Person shall have the same meaning as that term is defined in [Chapter II. (Licenses, Permits, Business Regulations), Sec. 21.7.2. (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-126755) of this Code.

    08. ###### Platform Agreement


        Platform agreement is defined as a signed agreement between a [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), which, among other things, provides that the platform will collect and submit the [Transient](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) Occupancy Tax to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on behalf of [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s listed for [short-term rental](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

    09. ###### Primary Residence


        Primary residence is defined as the sole residence from which the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) conducts home-sharing and in which the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) resides for more than six months of the calendar year.

    10. ###### Rental Unit


        Rental unit is defined as a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or portion thereof.

    11. ###### Short-Term Rental


        Short-term rental is defined as a [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), rented in whole or in part, to any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)(s) for use of 30 consecutive days or less. [Rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)-approved [lodging](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall not be considered a short-term rental.

    12. ###### Transient


        Transient shall have the same meaning as that term is defined in [Chapter II. (Licenses, Permits, Business Regulations), Sec. 21.7.2. (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-126755) of this Code.
03. ##### Home-Sharing Registration


    To register a home-sharing, home-based business, the applicant shall provide the material below to the satisfaction of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning within 45 days of when the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is first submitted:

    1. Information verifying the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s identification and [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

    2. Identification of a local responsible contact [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#);

    3. A list of all [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s to be used;

    4. Whether home-sharing is for an entire [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or a portion thereof;

    5. Any other information required by the instructions on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or by the guidelines promulgated by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning; and

    6. Payment of any filing fee required under [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15).
04. ##### Eligibility Requirements


    The following requirements shall be met at the time of submitting an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for home-sharing registration:

    1. The applicant has obtained a Transient Occupancy Registration Certificate from the Office of Finance pursuant to [Chapter II. (Licenses, Permits, Business Regulations), Sec. 21.7.6. (Registration)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-126812) of this Code, unless the applicant exclusively lists their [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that have a [platform agreement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with the City of Los Angeles.

    2. The proposed home-sharing is consistent with the provisions of this Subsection (Eligibility Requirements) and is limited to the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       1. A renter or lessee shall not engage in home-sharing without prior written approval of the landlord. A renter or lessee shall provide copies of the landlord’s written approval to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) at the time of filing the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for registration. A landlord may proactively prohibit home-sharing by tenants at any or all of the owner’s properties by submitting a notification in writing to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       2. A [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is subject to affordable housing covenants, or [Chapter XV. (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195151) of this Code, or are income-restricted under city, state, or federal law, is not eligible for home-sharing.

       3. No [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which is the subject of any pending citation may be registered for home-sharing.

       4. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may apply for or obtain more than one home-sharing registration or otherwise operate more than one home-sharing [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) at a time in the City of Los Angeles.
05. ##### Expiration & Renewal


    1. A home-sharing registration is valid for one year from the date of issuance. It may not be transferred or assigned and is valid only at the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). A home-sharing registration may be renewed annually if the host:

       1. Pays the renewal fee;

       2. Has complied with the provisions of this Section (Home-Sharing Program) for the past year;

       3. Provides information concerning any changes to the previous [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for, or renewal of, the home-sharing registration; and

       4. Submits home-sharing records described in [Sec. 5C.3.2.H. (Host Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2) below for the last year to demonstrate compliance with this Section (Home-Sharing Program), unless the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) lists exclusively on a [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with a [platform agreement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes a provision for pass-through registration for applicants for a home-sharing registration.
    2. The records described in [Sec. 5C.3.2.H. (Host Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2) below shall be made public to the extent required by law.
06. ##### Suspensions & Revocations


    Notwithstanding any other provision to the contrary, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning may require the suspension, modification, discontinuance or revocation of any home-sharing registration if it is found that the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has violated this Section (Home-Sharing Program) or any other city, state, or federal regulation, ordinance or statute.

    1. ###### Suspension


       If a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) receives two [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home-sharing registration shall be suspended for 30 days, or as long as at least one [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is open, whichever is longer. The suspension shall become effective 15 days after the mailing of a Notice of Intent to Suspend the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). If a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) initiates an appeal of either [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the suspension will take effect only if the appeal is not resolved entirely in the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s favor.

       1. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may challenge a [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by submitting an appeal to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) department that issued the [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and providing notice to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as described in the [Administrative Guidelines](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       2. Where no process is described in the [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may challenge a [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) by submitting an appeal to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning in accordance with the process in [Sec. 13B.6.1. (Evaluation of Non-Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.1), with no further appeal to a commission or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
    2. ###### Revocation


       If three [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s have been issued to the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and have been sustained (after exhaustion of any related remedies, including appeals) within a registration year, the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home-sharing registration shall be revoked. The revocation of a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home-sharing registration shall become effective 15 days after the mailing of a Notice of Intent to Revoke to the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       1. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may challenge a Notice of Intent to Revoke by submitting an appeal to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning in accordance with the process in [Sec. 13B.6.1. (Evaluation of Non-Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.1), with no further appeal to a commission or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       2. Pursuant to the revocation, the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be prohibited from participating in home-sharing for one year from the effective date of the Notice of Intent to Revoke.
    3. ###### Modification


       The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may modify, discontinue or revoke any home-sharing registration based upon an order to show cause, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.2.A.1. (Zoning Administrator Authority)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2), why any proposed modifications, discontinuances or revocations of any home-sharing registration should not be issued. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall provide notice to the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or recorded owner and lessees of the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to appear at a public hearing at a time and place fixed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to respond to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s order to show cause.
07. ##### Prohibitions


    01. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall offer, advertise, book, facilitate or engage in home-sharing or [short-term rental](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) activity in a manner that does not comply with this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

    02. No person or host may advertise a rental unit for short term rental or home sharing unless all advertisements clearly list a City-issued home sharing registration number for that rental unit.

    03. No [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall engage in home-sharing for more than 120 days in any calendar year unless the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has issued the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) an [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) registration pursuant to Subsection K. (Extended Home-Sharing) below.

    04. [Accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for which a complete [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) was submitted on or after January 1, 2017, to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2(a) (General Provisions; Permits and Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1) may not be used for home-sharing, unless an applicant demonstrates the [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is the applicant’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

    05. No [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall offer, advertise, or engage in home-sharing in a non-residential [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), including but not limited to, a vehicle parked on the property, a storage shed, trailer or any temporary [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), including, but not limited to, a tent.

    06. If a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) lists a [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on multiple listings on multiple [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, only one listing shall be booked at any given time.

    07. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not rent all or a portion of their [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for the purposes of home-sharing to more than one group of guests or under more than one booking, at any given time.

    08. Home-sharing is not permitted in [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that have been converted from units subject to [Chapter XV. (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195151) of this Code to single-unit [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s until five years after the date of conversion.

    09. Except for allowable [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) uses, non-residential [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s including, but not limited to, sales or exchange of products, events that charge a fee, or the promotion, display or servicing of any product shall not be permitted during home-sharing activity.

    10. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall only advertise on a [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that was listed on the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home-sharing [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) form, unless the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has submitted a written request and received written approval from the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to use another [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

    11. No more than two overnight guests (not including children) are allowed per [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), not including [kitchen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, during home-sharing activities.

    12. There shall be no use of sound amplifying equipment, as that term is defined in [Chapter XI. (Noise Regulation), Sec. 111.01. (j). (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-193779#JD_111.01.) of this Code after 10:00 pm and no evening outdoor congregations of more than eight people (excluding children) during home-sharing activities. Home-sharing activities are subject to the noise regulations in [Chapter XI. (Noise Regulation)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-193741) of this Code.

    13. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) whose home-sharing registration has been suspended is prohibited from participating in home-sharing for the duration of the suspension.

    14. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) whose home-sharing registration has been revoked may not participate in home-sharing unless and until a new registration is authorized.
08. ##### Host Requirements


    01. A [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or owner of the host’s primary residence if the host does not own it, may be responsible for any nuisance violations, as described in [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2), arising at the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) during home-sharing activities. Either the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or owner of the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) if the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not own it, may be assessed a minimum inspection fee, as specified in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 98.0412. (Inspection Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-190052) of this Code for each site inspection.

    02. The [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall keep and preserve, for a minimum period of three years, all records regarding each home-sharing stay, including the length of stay and the price paid for each stay, and any other records required by [Administrative Guidelines](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) promulgated by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning.

    03. On the home-sharing registration [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall acknowledge and consent to Office of Finance and other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) agencies’ inspection of records at all reasonable times and places for purposes of enforcement of this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

    04. The [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall fully comply with all the requirements of [Chapter II. (Licenses, Permits, Business Regulations), Article 1.7. (Transient Occupancy Tax)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-126729) of this Code.

    05. The [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall pay a per-night fee for each night of home-sharing, which will be deposited into the Short Term Rental Enforcement Fund per the requirements in [Sec. 5.576. (Creation and Administration of the Short-Term Rental Enforcement Trust Fund)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-91956) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall adopt, by resolution, a per-night fee based on an analysis of the cost of implementing, maintaining, and enforcing this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

    06. Every [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall provide and maintain working fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, and carbon monoxide detectors, in compliance with fire, life and safety codes; information related to emergency exit routes on the property and contact information, including the contact information of the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or a designated responsible agent of the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

    07. Every [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that lists a [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) located in a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designated pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 51178. (Moderate, High, and Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zones)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=51178.&lawCode=GOV) shall include in all [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) listings and post written notices on any patio or deck that smoking is not permitted in any exterior of the property.

    08. Every [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall provide a code of conduct to guests that includes the relevant provisions of this Section (Home-Sharing Program) and other information to address behavioral, safety, security, and other matters, as required in the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [Administrative Guidelines](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

    09. Every [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall authorize any [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on which their [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is listed to provide to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) listing and other information described in Paragraph 4. of Subsection I. (Hosting Platform Responsibilities) below.

    10. Every [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall consent to receive all [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) notices and citations regarding their home-sharing registration by U.S. mail.
09. ##### Hosting Platform Responsibilities


    1. [Hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall not process or complete any [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction for any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), unless the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has a valid home-sharing registration number issued by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

    2. [Hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall not process or complete any [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction for any [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) listing that has exceeded the authorized 120-day limit in one calendar year, unless the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has obtained an [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) approval.

    3. Within 45 days of the effective date of this Section (Home-Sharing Program), [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with listings located in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall provide to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) the contact information for an employee or representative responsible for responding to requests for information, including requests related to possible violations of this Section (Home-Sharing Program). Hosting platforms that commence listings in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) after the effective date shall provide this information prior to facilitating home-sharing activity or providing [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

    4. Subject to applicable laws, a [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with listings in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall provide to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), on at least a monthly basis, in a format as specified by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the home-sharing registration number of each listing, the name of the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) responsible for each listing, the street address of each listing and, for each booking that occurs within the reporting period, the number of days booked.

    5. In the event a [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has entered into an agreement with the Office of Finance to collect and remit [transient](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) Occupancy Tax pursuant to [Chapter II. (Licenses, Permits, Business Regulations), Article 1.7. (Transient Occupancy Tax)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-126729) of this Code, and a [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has assigned the responsibilities for the collection and remittance of the [transient](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) Occupancy Tax to the [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), then the [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall have the same duties and liabilities, including but not limited to the collection and remittance of the tax to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on a monthly basis.

    6. ###### Exception


       The provisions of this Subsection I. (Hosting Platform Responsibilities) shall not apply to a [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) whenever it,

       1. Complies with the [Administrative Guidelines](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), issued by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and approved by resolution of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), that describe how the [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall satisfy the [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) responsibilities in this Subsection I. (Hosting Platform Responsibilities), or

       2. Enters into a [platform agreement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the terms of which shall be set forth in a master [platform agreement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) approved by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), that establishes the manner in which the [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) supports the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s enforcement of this Section (Home-Sharing Program) and meets the purposes of the [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) responsibilities in this Subsection I. (Hosting Platform Responsibilities). Each individual [platform agreement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be approved by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
10. ##### Enforcement of Violations


    1. The provisions in this Subsection (Enforcement of Violations) shall be in addition to any criminal, civil, or other legal remedy established by law that may be pursued to address violations of this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

    2. Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) who has failed to comply with the provisions of this Section (Home-Sharing Program) may be subject to the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.00. (Provisions Applicable to Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107510) of this Code. The owner or operator of any property used for home-sharing, including the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or owner of any [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), may be assessed a minimum inspection fee, as specified in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 98.0412. (Inspection Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-190052) of this Code for each site inspection.

    3. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning may, at any time, require the modification, discontinuance, or revocation of any home-sharing registration in the manner prescribed in Subsection F. (Suspensions & Revocations) above.

    4. The Administrative Citation Enforcement (ACE) program in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1.2. (Administrative Citations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225704) of this Code may be utilized to issue Administrative Citations and impose fines pursuant to this Section (Home-Sharing Program). The [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be served by personal service or by depositing in the mail for delivery by the United States Postal Service, in a sealed envelope, postage prepaid, addressed to the operator of the [short-term rental](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or the property owner, if different than the operator or [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), shown on the County’s last equalized property tax assessment roll. Fines for violations of this Section (Home-Sharing Program) shall be as follows:

       1. Hosting platform: a $1,000 fine per day shall be imposed for any of the following violations:

          1. Completing a [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction for each listing without a valid [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) home-sharing registration number or pending registration status number.

          2. Completing a [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction for each listing where more than one property is affiliated with a single [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or each listing where the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home address does not match the listing location.

          3. Completing a [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction for any listing for a [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home-sharing or [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) registration has been revoked or suspended by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

          4. Completing a [booking service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) transaction for any [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) lacking [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) approval that has exceeded the authorized 120-day limit for hosting [short-term rental](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s in one calendar year.
       2. Owner of [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#):

          1. A daily fine of $500, or two times the nightly rate charged, whichever is greater, for advertising a [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for the purposes of [short-term rental](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in violation of this Section (Home-Sharing Program).

          2. A daily fine of $2,000, or two times the nightly rent charged, whichever is greater, for each day of home-sharing activity beyond the 120 day limit in a calendar year, unless the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has a valid [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) registration.

          3. For all other violations of this Section (Home-Sharing Program), the administrative fine shall be levied according to the amounts described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.2.04. (a)(2) (Administrative Fines)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-27883) of this Code. The square footage for the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in calculating the fine shall be the amount of indoor space to which the [transient](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) guest has access. If the square footage is unable to be ascertained, it shall be deemed to be between 500 and 2,499 square feet.
       3. The fine amounts listed above shall be updated annually, from the date of effective date of this ordinance, according to the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U).
11. ##### Extended Home-Sharing


    For [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s who participate in [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the following shall apply:

    1. ###### Application & Eligibility Requirements


       1. ###### Ministerial Approval


          [Extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be approved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning if, in addition to the eligibility requirements for home-sharing, all of the following requirements are met:

          1. The [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) maintains a current home-sharing registration and has maintained a home-sharing registration for at least six months or has hosted for at least 60 days based on substantial evidence provided by the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [hosting platform](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

          2. No more than one [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) was issued within the prior three years.

          3. The [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) provides proof of mailing of a notification concerning commencement of [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), which includes a [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning-issued publication outlining the complaint process, to [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owners and occupants on a form provided by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
       2. ###### Discretionary Approval


          A discretionary review of an [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is required if the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) complies with Sub-subparagraph i. of Subparagraph a. (Ministerial Approval) above, but two [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s have been issued within the prior three years.

       3. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning finds that the matter may have a significant effect on neighboring properties, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may set the matter for public hearing. Written notice of the hearing shall be sent by First Class Mail at least 21 days prior to the hearing to the applicant, owners, and tenants of the property involved, owners and tenants of all properties [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) the proposed [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) activity, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) Councilmember representing the area in which the property is located, and the applicable Neighborhood Council. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) determines that the matter will not have a significant effect on neighboring properties, no hearing shall be held.

       4. The [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may only be approved if, in addition to the eligibility requirements for home-sharing, all of the following requirements are met, to the satisfaction of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#):

          1. The [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) provides proof of mailing of a notification, which includes a [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of Planning-issued publication outlining the complaint process, to [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owners and occupants on a form provided by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

          2. In consideration of any comments received by the public on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) finds the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is in substantial conformance with the following findings:

             1. That the [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will enhance the built environment in the surrounding neighborhood or will perform a function or provide a service that is essential or beneficial to the community, [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or region;

             2. That the [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) operations and other significant features will be compatible with and will not adversely affect or further degrade [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) properties, the surrounding neighborhood, the availability of housing, or the public health, welfare, and safety;

             3. That the [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) substantially conforms with the purpose, intent, and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the applicable community plan, and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#); and

             4. That there is no substantial evidence of continued nuisance behavior from the location.
       5. If no appeal is filed within 15 days from the date of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s determination approving or denying an [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s decision is final. An appeal to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be filed by the applicant or any [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owner and occupant. An appeal shall be filed at the public counter of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) within 15 days of the date of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s decision. The appeal shall set forth specifically how the appellant believes the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s findings and decision are in error. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may grant, conditionally grant, or deny the appeal. The failure of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to act upon an appeal within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period, or within an additional period as may be agreed upon by the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), shall be deemed a denial of the appeal and the original action on the matter shall become final.

          1. ###### Ineligibility


             If the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s home-sharing registration has been suspended or revoked, the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is not eligible to apply for [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for two years from the effective date of the revocation or suspension or as long as a [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) remains open or unresolved, whichever is later.

          2. ###### Expiration & Renewal


             An [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) registration is valid for one year from the date of issuance. An [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) registration is subject to the same expiration and renewal terms described in Subsection E. (Expiration & Renewal) above and may be renewed annually if the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) meets the same renewal requirements in that Subsection.

          3. ###### Revocations


             An [extended home-sharing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) approval shall be revoked if there are two [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s within a registration year in accordance with the process set forth in Subsection F. (Suspensions & Revocations) above. Pursuant to the revocation, the [host](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be prohibited from participating in home-sharing for two years from the effective date of the Notice of Revocation or as long as a [citation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) remains open or unresolved, whichever is later.
12. ##### Administration & Regulations


    No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall fail to comply with the [Administrative Guidelines](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

13. ##### Effective Date


    This effective date of this Section (Home-Sharing Program) is July 1, 2019.


#### Sec. 5C.3.3. Alcohol Sales Program

1. ##### Intent


To enable regulations for alcohol sales to be applied through an opt-in program that serves as an alternative to traditional conditional use permit in compliance with the California Constitution. Alternative permission areas allow for the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages to be tailored to local neighborhoods and districts in accordance with the needs of the surrounding economic and social context, while protecting public health, safety, and welfare.

2. ##### Applicability


1. For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s identified as being within an Alcohol Permission Area, as established in [Sec. 1.5.9. (Alcohol Permission Area Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.9), all [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages (eating & drinking: alcohol service, and [retail: alcohol](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s) shall be subject to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and performance standards as established in Subsection C. (Alcohol Permission Area Standards) below that correspond to the specified Alcohol Permission Area designation.

2. Establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s not designated as being within a specific Alcohol Permission Area as established in [Sec. 1.5.9. (Alcohol Permission Area Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.9) shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for the permission to sell or dispense of alcoholic beverages in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments) of Subsection G. (Process) below.

3. If the establishment or property has been the subject of Nuisance Abatement/Revocation pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2) resulting in the revocation of any permit or imposition of any corrective conditions, all [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments) of Subsection G. (Process) below.

4. If the establishment is proposing to modify or expand existing alcohol service to an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the operator may be permitted pursuant to the Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization Process in Paragraph 6. (Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization) of Subsection G. (Process), below.

4. ##### Performance Standards


The following standards apply if "Applicable" is provided for the Alcohol Permission Area for that performance standard type.

01. ###### In Conjunction With Restaurant


       Eating & drinking: alcohol service [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall only be permitted in conjunction with a [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which complies with all of the following provisions:

       1. The establishment is a [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), which shall include an operational kitchen where food is prepared on-site and with a full menu containing an assortment of foods. Food service is available at all times during operating hours.

       2. The [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not include [drive-through facilities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       3. All food and beverages, except for takeout or delivery orders, shall be delivered to tables by an employee.

       4. The [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has a business tax registration certificate issued by the City of Los Angeles.

       5. Outdoor food and beverage service shall be limited to seated patrons.
02. ###### Lodging Establishments


       The [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing alcohol service shall not be located in a lodging establishment.

03. ###### Food Halls/Courts


       There shall be no shared seating between the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing alcohol service [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and other [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

04. ###### Amount of Patron Seating


       The [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing alcohol service shall have between a minimum of 10 patron seats and a maximum of 150 patron seats. Any patron seating provided in an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that has less than 75 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) (regardless of [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) percentage), or less than 25 percent [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) (regardless of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) percentage), shall not be counted toward the maximum number of patron seats allowed.

05. ###### Booth/Group Seating


       Where booth or group seating is provided, no [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s or partitions separating the booth or seating area from the main dining room shall be installed which exceed 48 inches in height above the surface on which occupants’ feet are intended to rest. This requirement shall not apply to any booth or group seating provided in an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that has less than 75 percent [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) (regardless of [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) percentage), or less than 25 percent [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) (regardless of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) percentage).

06. ###### Private Dining & Banquet Rooms


       Where a private dining or banquet room is provided, a minimum of 50 percent of the vertical surface area of that portion, extending up to six feet above the floor, of any [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or partition separating the private dining or banquet room from the main dining room shall be composed of a transparent surface and ensure the occupants are visible to [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s looking into the private dining or banquet room. Hours of operation may be further limited by a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standard listed in the [Use District table](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

07. ###### Hours of Operation


       Daily hours of operation shall be limited to the hours between 7:00 am and 11:00 pm for both indoor and outdoor areas. There shall be no after-hours use of the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), other than for routine clean-up and maintenance.

08. ###### Alcohol License Type


       The [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall operate under a valid Type 41 or Type 47 license as issued by the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control.

09. ###### Gross Sales Limit


       The establishment shall operate with gross annual sales of alcohol not in excess of 45 percent of the establishment’s total sales.

10. ###### Serving of Alcohol


       The serving of alcoholic beverages shall be subject to the following requirements:

       1. All service of alcoholic beverages shall be conducted by an employee.

       2. The establishment shall not sell distilled spirits by the bottle, or wine or champagne bottles that exceed 750 milliliters.
11. ###### Fixed Bar Areas


       The establishment shall only use fixed bars that are depicted on floor plans submitted to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Portable bars are prohibited.

12. ###### Live Entertainment


       Live entertainment, karaoke, or disc jockeys on the premises are prohibited.

13. ###### Dance Floors


       Dance floors or other designated dance areas on the premises are prohibited.

14. ###### Pool/Billiard Tables


       Pool tables and billiard tables are prohibited.

15. ###### Patron Access Requirements


       The establishment shall not impose any of the following patron restrictions or requirements:

       1. Minimum drink purchase required of patrons.

       2. Charge for admission.

       3. Age limitation restricting access to any portion of the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

       4. No more than 50 percent of the entire [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may be closed to the public for private events at a given time. Any portion of the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) used for private events shall be subject to all the same applicable standards.
16. ###### Adult-Oriented Activities


       The establishment shall not engage in any of the following adult-oriented activities:

       1. Activities established in [Sec. 5D.6.13. (Sexually Oriented Business)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.13).

       2. Solicitation or acceptance of any alcoholic or non-alcoholic beverage from any customer by any employee while working.

       3. Engage any employee for the specific purpose of sitting with or otherwise spending time with customers while on the premises.
17. ###### Alcohol-Oriented Events


       The establishment shall not organize or participate in organized events where participants or customers pre-purchase tickets or tokens to be exchanged for alcoholic beverages at the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

18. ###### Proximity to Agricultural or Residential Use Districts


       For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or across an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) from a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with an applied [Agricultural Use District (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2) or [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3):

       1. Outdoor seating shall be limited to the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and surrounding [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) only; and

       2. A wholly [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), at least eight feet in height [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and extending the full length of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), shall be located between the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with an applied [Agricultural Use District (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2) or [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) that may or may not be separated by an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The wholly [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall extend at minimum along the full length of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This requirement shall not apply to [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that comply with [Sec. 5C.2.4.B. (Eating & Drinking: All)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2.4) or outdoor dining permitted on a public sidewalk by a revocable permit issued by the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering.
19. ###### “Good Neighbor” Standards


       All participating establishments shall be responsible for maintaining conformance with the following “good neighbor” standards:

       1. ###### Debris & Litter


          The establishment shall maintain the premises and adjoining rights-of-way free of debris and litter.

       2. ###### Graffiti Abatement


          Within 24 hours of its occurrence, all graffiti on the property under the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s control shall be removed or painted over to match the color of the surface to which it is applied.

       3. ###### Waste Receptacles


          All trash and recycling bins under control of the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be kept closed and locked at all times when they are not in use, and shall be maintained such that they do not overflow.

       4. ###### Entertainment Equipment


          Entertainment equipment, including televisions monitors/screens, music/speakers shall be prohibited outdoors, and shall be limited to indoor ambient sound at a low volume that is not audible outside of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
20. ###### On-Site Notices & Information


       All participating establishments shall provide the following on-site notices and information on the premises:

       1. ###### City-Issued Placard


          A placard pursuant to this Section (Alcohol Sales Program) issued by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be posted by the establishment in an area clearly visible to the public, indicating that it is subject to the requirements and restrictions applicable to the designated Alcohol Permission Area.

       2. ###### Copy of Alcohol Sales Program


          A copy of this Section (Alcohol Sales Program) shall be retained on the premises at all times and produced upon request by the Los Angeles Police Department, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control.

       3. ###### Complaint Number


          A telephone number and email address shall be maintained for complaints or concerns regarding the operation of the establishment. The phone number and email address shall be provided on the establishment's website or, if there is no website, on its social media pages. The phone number and email address also shall be posted on a sign at least 8.5 × 11 inches in size, which shall be updated to reflect any changes, at the following locations:

          1. Entry, visible to pedestrians; and

          2. Customer service desk, front desk or near the reception area, and visible to patrons.
       4. ###### Complaint Response Time


          The establishment shall respond to complaints within 24 hours.
