The establishment shall maintain a log of all calls and emails, detailing the date the complaint was received, the nature of the complaint, and the manner in which the complaint was resolved. This log shall be made available to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) upon request.
5. ##### Security Standards


The following standards apply if "Applicable" is provided for the Alcohol Permission Area for that security standard type.

1. ###### Interior Illumination


      Within the establishment, the interior shall be adequately illuminated so as to make discernible all objects and [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, or have a minimum average surface illumination of 2.0 [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s (21.5 lx).

2. ###### Exterior Illumination


      In addition to the requirements in [Sec. 4C.10.1.C.2. (Lighting Quantity)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1), all exterior portions of the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be adequately illuminated in the evening so as to make discernible the faces and clothing of persons utilizing the space, or have a minimum average surface illumination of 0.2 [footcandle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s (2.15 lx). Lighting shall be installed in conformance with [Sec. 4C.10.1.C.1. (Light Trespass)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.10.1).

3. ###### Surveillance System


      A camera surveillance system shall be installed and in operation at all times to monitor the interior, entrance, exits and exterior areas, in front of and around the premises. Recordings shall be maintained for a minimum period of 30 days.

4. ###### Loitering


      Loitering is prohibited in all areas under the control of the establishment. A "No Loitering or Public Drinking" sign that is a minimum of 4 × 6 inches shall be posted outside next to every exit.

5. ###### Electronic Age Verification


      An electronic age verification device shall be retained on the premises available for use during operational hours. This device shall be maintained in operational condition and all employees shall be instructed in its use.

6. ###### Patron & Employee Conduct


      The establishment shall monitor both patron and employee conduct on the premises, and take all reasonable steps to ensure that the conditions and activities on the premises and within the [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s under its control do not adversely affect or detract from the quality of life for the [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, property owners, and businesses. Reasonable steps include, but are not limited to:

      1. Requesting that those persons engaging in conduct that constitutes a nuisance cease such conduct, unless the owner or operator has reasonable cause to believe such request may jeopardize personal safety;

      2. Contacting the Los Angeles Police Department or other law enforcement agency if the owner or operator’s attempts to abate the nuisance conduct have been unsuccessful, or if the owner or operator has reasonable cause to believe such attempts may jeopardize personal safety; and

      3. Taking timely preventive actions to address conditions that facilitate loitering and other nuisance activity on the premises, such as removing furniture from areas [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) to the entry of the [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or prohibiting persons from using any portion of the premises for the installation or operation of a temporary business or other [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
7. ###### On-Duty Authority


      A minimum of one on-duty manager with authority over the activities within the establishment shall be on the premises at all times that the establishment is open for business. The on-duty manager’s responsibilities shall include the monitoring of the premises to ensure compliance with all applicable state laws, [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) requirements and the conditions imposed by the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control. The establishment shall be responsible for discouraging illegal and criminal activity on the subject premises and any exterior area under its control.

8. ###### “Responsible Beverage Service” (RBS) Training


      Within the first six months of the date of approval in accordance with the applicable process established in Subsection G. (Process) below, all employees involved with the sale of alcohol shall enroll in a training program as required by the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control and/or the Los Angeles Police Department, such as the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control “Responsible Beverage Service” (RBS) training program. Upon completion of such training, the establishment shall request the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control or Los Angeles Police Department to issue a letter identifying which employees completed the training. Said letter shall be maintained on the premises and shall be made available to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) upon request. All required training shall be conducted for each new hire within three months of the start of employment.
6. ##### Supplemental Procedures


In addition to the procedures established in [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) or pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), whichever is applicable, the following supplemental procedures shall be carried out when "Applicable" to is provided for the Alcohol Permission Area:

1. ###### Notice of Application


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) District office, the Los Angeles Police Department, and the Certified Neighborhood Council within which the establishment is located shall be notified by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) at the time an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is filed. If the establishment is not within the boundaries of a Neighborhood Council, then notification to only the applicable [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) District office shall be sufficient.

2. ###### Preliminary Outreach


      Prior to filing the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), the applicant shall conduct outreach by presenting information about the establishment at one or more Certified Neighborhood Council meetings, Business Improvement District meetings, or other meetings of such established community organization if the establishment is not within either a Certified Neighborhood Council or Business Improvement District boundary. Presentations shall include a flyer or other summary including the establishment name, contact information, projected opening date, menu and alcohol to be sold (beer, wine, and/or distilled spirits).

3. ###### Provisional Approval


      The sale of beer and wine within the establishment shall be limited to a one year provisional period that begins the day following the date of approval by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and ends after 365 days. Upon completion of the one year provisional period, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall conduct a review of the establishment's compliance with this section and any validated complaint received by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and take actions consistent with the following:

      1. ###### Validated Complaints


         Validated complaints are complaints that were either submitted by the public through a [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) complaint portal or initiated as a result of [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)-initiated inspections regarding violations of the provisions applicable to the designated alcohol permission area, and which result in an Order to Comply issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), or citations issued by the Los Angeles Police Department, or any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) enforcement-related action.

      2. ###### Four or Fewer Validated Complaints


         If an establishment receives four or fewer validated complaints upon completion of the one year provisional period, the establishment shall be allowed to continue participating in the Alcohol Sales Program pursuant to this Section (Alcohol Sales Program). The [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall continue to be subject to the provisions applicable to the designated Alcohol Permission Area.

      3. ###### Five or More Validated Complaints


         If an establishment receives five or more validated complaints upon the completion of the one year provisional period, the provisional approval by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be terminated. If the establishment wishes to continue the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages, it shall only be permitted with approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).
7. ##### Process


1. ###### Alcohol Sensitive Sales Area


      1. For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s identified as being within an Alcohol Sensitive Sales Area, [retail: alcohol](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are not permitted.

      2. Eating & drinking: alcohol service [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be provided in conjunction with a [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which complies with all of the performance standards provided in Subsection D. (Performance Standards) and shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) for permission to sell or dispense alcoholic beverages in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments) below.
2. ###### Limited Restaurant Beverage Area


      1. For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s identified as being within a Limited Restaurant Beverage Area, eating & drinking: alcohol service [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall be permitted by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), when in compliance with the applicable provisions established for the Limited Restaurant Beverage Area in [Sec. 5C.3.3.C. (Alcohol Permission Area Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.3).

      2. For establishments that do not seek administrative review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), permission to sell or dispense alcoholic beverages shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments) below.
3. ###### Restaurant Beverage Area


      1. For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s identified as being within a Restaurant Beverage Area, eating & drinking: alcohol service [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s may be permitted by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), when in compliance with the applicable provisions established for the Restaurant Beverage Area in [Sec. 5C.3.3.C. (Alcohol Permission Area Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.3).

      2. For establishments that do not seek administrative review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), permission to sell or dispense alcoholic beverages shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments) below.
4. ###### Restaurant & Bar Nightlife Area


      1. For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s identified as being within a Restaurant & Bar Nightlife Area, alcohol service may be permitted to sell or dispense alcoholic beverages by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), when in compliance with the applicable provisions established for the Restaurant & Bar Nightlife Area in [Sec. 5C.3.3.C. (Alcohol Permission Area Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.3).

      2. For establishments that do not seek administrative review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), permission to sell or dispense alcoholic beverages shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) in accordance with Paragraph 5. (Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments) below.
5. ###### Unmapped/Noncompliant Establishments


      For establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that do not have an Alcohol Use Permission Area designation, or establishments on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s identified as being within Alcohol Sales Area but do not seek compliance with the provisions applicable to the designated Alcohol Permission Area, or that have had a permit revoked or had corrective conditions applied as a result of Nuisance Abatement/Revocation pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2), eating & drinking: alcohol service and [retail: alcohol](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall require review and approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) for the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages and be subject to the following:

      1. ###### Supplemental Findings


         In addition to the findings otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall also consider:

         1. Whether the granting of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will result in an undue concentration of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that dispense alcoholic beverages within a 1,000-foot radius of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) according to the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control’s guidelines for undue concentration.

         2. The existing crime rate nearby, especially those crimes involving public drunkenness, the illegal sale or use of narcotics, drugs or alcohol, disturbing the peace, and disorderly conduct, and whether revocation or nuisance proceedings have been initiated for any similar [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in the area.

         3. Whether the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) will not detrimentally affect nearby [Residential Use Districts (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [sensitive use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.
      2. ###### Multiple Approvals


         With the exception of [retail: alcohol](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), permission for multiple approvals to allow alcohol service for three or more tenant spaces may be applied for under a single conditional use permit entitlement, subject to the following:

         1. Tenant spaces are maintained under a single ownership within a unified complex comprising a combined [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of 10,000 square feet or greater on the same site.

         2. The entitlement [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for multiple conditional use permits shall be subject to processes and procedures required by [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

         3. Project review, as established in [Sec. 13B.2.2.H. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), shall be completed for each individual tenant space resulting in approval for each individual tenant space prior to the establishment of the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) within the subject tenant space.

         4. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall detail the square footage of each tenant space, suite or unit number, hours of operation, and specific nature of [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for each tenant-operator space.

         5. Each individual tenant space shall be separately addressed with applicable site-specific conditions. Any change in tenant-operator shall be required to apply for approval of plans as established in [Sec. 13B.2.2.H. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), in order to evaluate the applicability of existing conditions and review any potential changes in [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) operations and conditions.
      3. ###### Process Exemption


         Establishments that have [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that comply with [Sec. 5C.2.4.B. (Eating & Drinking: All)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2.4) shall be exempt from conditional use approval or a plan approval for the purposes of providing an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
6. ###### Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization


      1. ###### Eligibility Criteria & Standards


         On-site alcohol service provided in conjunction with an eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the sale of food for on-site consumption may be provided in an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on private property and/or in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) through an administrative alcohol authorization, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), provided the establishment meets all of the following eligibility criteria and standards:

         1. The establishment is not located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) identified as being within an Alcohol Sensitive Sales Area.

         2. The [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) complies with [Sec. 5C.2.4.B. (Eating & Drinking: All)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2.4) or is permitted on a public sidewalk by a revocable permit issued by the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering

         3. The eating & drinking establishment has a valid approval for the alcohol service use they wish to expand from the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or have existing alcohol sales with no conditional use approval prior to March 1, 1977;

         4. The eating & drinking establishment has a license to sell alcohol from the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control;

         5. The eating & drinking establishment is not subject to any enforcement mechanisms set forth in [Sec. 5C.2.4.B. (Eating & Drinking: All)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2.4) that upon further investigation by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), result in citation, the imposition of fines or penalties, or revocation;

         6. The eating & drinking establishment has not been the subject of a wage claim, on or after January 31, 2024, under [Chapter XVIII. (Employee Wages and Protections), Article 8. (Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards Ordinance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-287786) of this Code.
      2. ###### Performance Standards


         1. Any fixed or portable bars located in an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall not used as a point of sale;

         2. All alcohol shall be delivered to and served at tables by employees;

         3. All patrons shall be seated.
      3. ###### Deemed Approved with LA Al Fresco Authorization


         1. Establishments that have a valid LA Al Fresco Authorization issued or renewed as of January 31, 2024 and have not been previously revoked for violations shall be considered deemed approved and authorized to continue alcohol service operations of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in compliance with the eligibility criteria and standards set forth in Subparagraph a. (Eligibility Criteria & Standards), above.

         2. No fee shall be charged for administrative verification of Al Fresco deemed approved status. Deemed approved status must be obtained within six months of the expiration of the previously-issued temporary authorization (LA Al Fresco Temporary Authorization).
      4. ###### Expanded Outdoor Dining Area Clearance


         1. Establishments that did not receive deemed approved status through the LA Al Fresco Temporary Authorization shall be authorized to serve in [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s pursuant to an Expanded Outdoor Dining Area Clearance issued in compliance with the eligibility criteria and standards set forth in Subparagraph a. (Eligibility Criteria & Standards), above.

         2. The “Building Permit Clearance - Minor” fee pursuant to [Sec. 15.3.2. (Ministerial Action Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.2) of this Code shall be charged for an Expanded Outdoor Dining Area Clearance.
8. ##### Records & Agreements


1. ###### Case File Material


      Upon submission of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for the Alcohol Sales Program, the applicant shall submit the following with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), which shall be kept as part of the case file:

      1. A floor plan and site plan to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) demonstrating compliance with the requirements and standards as established for the Alcohol Use Permission Area designation;

      2. When the establishment is in a Limited Restaurant Beverage Area, a flyer or other summary including the establishment name, contact information, projected opening date, menu and alcohol to be sold (beer, wine, and/or distilled spirits) prepared and presented for outreach purposes;

      3. When the establishment is in a Limited Restaurant Beverage Area, proof of outreach conducted pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Preliminary Outreach) of Subsection F. (Supplemental Procedures) above which shall include an official agenda listing the establishment as intending to apply for the Alcohol Sales Program or a letter on organization letterhead attesting to the appearance or presence of the applicant before the Board of the local Certified Neighborhood Council, Business Improvement District, or established community organization pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Preliminary Outreach) of Subsection F. (Supplemental Procedures) above; and

      4. A revocable permit from the Department of Public Works, Bureau of Engineering, is required for any [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) located in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). A copy of the approved revocable permit, including a plan and any conditions thereto, shall be provided to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) prior to placing any seating in the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      5. Establishments seeking to expand an existing alcohol approval to an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and that are eligible for approval through an Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization shall submit materials required pursuant to Paragraph 6. (Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization) of Subsection G. (Process) above.
2. ###### Covenant & Agreement


      1. Prior to approval by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to [Sec. 13.B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13), or by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), a Covenant and Agreement acknowledging and agreeing to comply with all applicable performance and security standards or conditions of approval shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder. The Covenant and Agreement shall run with the land and shall be binding for any subsequent owners, heirs or assigns. After recordation, a certified copy bearing the recorder’s number and date shall be provided to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      2. This Paragraph (Covenant & Agreement) does not apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s authorized pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.3.G.6. (Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.3).
3. ###### Mandated Inspections


      The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall have the authority to conduct inspections to verify compliance with any and all of the requirements and standards as established in this Section (Alcohol Sales Program). Upon payment of fees pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 19.04. (Fees for Sign Off or Clearance Requests)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123899) of this Code, the applicant is subject to the following:

      1. Within the first 24 months of the approval by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), or by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), an inspector shall conduct a [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) visit to assess compliance with, or violations of, any of the applicable provisions of this Section (Alcohol Sales Program). A second inspection shall take place within 36 months of the first inspection.

      2. The owner and operator shall be notified in writing of the deficiency or violation and required to correct or eliminate the deficiency or violation. Multiple or continued documented violations or Orders to Comply issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) which are not addressed within the time prescribed may result in additional corrective actions taken by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).
4. ###### Violations


      If an establishment is issued three citations for violating the provisions applicable to the designated Alcohol Permission Area in any two-year period, the approval by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be terminated and the establishment shall be made ineligible to participate in the Alcohol Service Program for a period of five years commencing on the date of the third citation. If the establishment wishes to continue the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages, it shall only be permitted with approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

      1. A citation shall include citations issued by the Los Angeles Police Department or Orders to Comply issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

      2. The California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control shall be notified by the Los Angeles Police Department or other enforcement agency of the issued citations.
5. ###### Modification of Establishment


      The owner or the operator of the establishment shall reapply for approval by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), if there is:

      1. A change in State alcohol license type;

      2. A change in the ownership or the operator of the establishment; or,

      3. A modification to the floor plan, including, but not limited to, [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or number of seats, or a modification to outdoor seating. However, establishments that are eligible for an Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization pursuant to Paragraph 6. (Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization) of Subsection G. (Process) above shall not be required to reapply for approval pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) and may request approval through Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization instead.

#### Sec. 5C.3.4. Certified Farmers' Market

1. ##### Intent


To increase access to healthy food in neighborhoods and expand opportunities for small-scale entrepreneurs through a set of performance standards that ensure the safe, orderly, and efficient operation of farmer's markets.

2. ##### Performance Standards


1. [Retail: farmers&apos; market, certified](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) activities are limited to two days per week, and limited to the hours of operation specified by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B).

2. Operator shall be limited to certified producers, non-profit organizations, and local government agencies.

3. If selling fruits, nuts, or vegetables, the producer is authorized by the County Agricultural Commissioner to sell directly to consumers these products that are produced upon the land which the certified producer farms and owns, rents, leases or sharecrops.

4. If selling eggs, honey, fish and other seafood and freshwater products, live plants, and other agricultural products, the market operator and producer secure all necessary licenses, certificates and health permits which are required to sell these products directly to consumers, provided these products are raised, grown, caught, and processed, if necessary, in California.

5. Safety barricades shall be provided to separate and protect vendors and their customers from moving vehicles wherever active [motor vehicle use area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and farmer's market activities are not separated by a permanent curb.

6. Trash containers shall be provided during the hours of operation.

7. Any portion of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) used for market activities shall be cleaned at the close of hours of operation. For purposes of this Section (Certified Farmers' Market) only, “cleaned” shall include, but not be limited to, the removal of stalls, materials, debris and trash, etc., used in conjunction with market activities.

8. (EBT) card payments shall be accepted by all vendors for all hours of operation. A Food and Nutrition Service (FNS) Number issued by the United States Department of Agricultural shall be available at the public’s request as proof of Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) card acceptance.

9. Certification of the Certified Farmers’ Market and contact information for the operator shall be posted at the main entry, and otherwise available at the public’s request. The contact [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be available during the hours of operation and shall respond to any complaints. The operator shall keep a log of complaints received, the date and time received, and their disposition.

#### Sec. 5C.3.5. Seasonal Market Program

1. ##### Intent


To accommodate the seasonal retail sale of ornamental pumpkins and Christmas trees through a set of performance standards that ensure the safe, orderly, and efficient operation of temporary market activities on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

2. ##### Performance Standards


1. The operator of such sale of pumpkins and/or Christmas trees shall pay a business tax and post a $200 clean-up deposit with the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)’s Office of Finance prior to any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) preparation or sales.

2. ###### Pumpkin Sales


      This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), including construction or preparation of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), fencing, trailers, tents, storage, equipment, installations, and sales is permitted between October 15th and October 31st inclusive. The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) must be cleaned and restored to its original condition by November 14th. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of the clean-up deposit.

3. ###### Christmas Tree Sales


      This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), including construction or preparation of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), fencing, trailers, tents with aggregate area up to 600 sq. ft., storage, equipment, installations, and sales is permitted between December 1st and December 25th inclusive. The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) must be cleaned and restored to its original condition by January 8th. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of the clean-up deposit.

4. ###### Pumpkin & Christmas Tree Sales


      This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), including construction or preparation of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), fencing, trailers, tents, storage, equipment, installations, and sales of pumpkins is permitted between October 15th and October 31st inclusive. The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) must be cleaned of pumpkins and accessory materials by November 7th. Thereafter, the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) must be maintained secure, clean, and not utilized. Existing fencing, trailers, and equipment may be maintained on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) until the sale of Christmas trees commencing on December 1st through December 25th inclusive. The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) must be cleaned and restored to its original condition by January 8th. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of the clean-up deposit.

5. Any lights to illuminate the site shall be arranged to reflect the light away from any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s zoned with a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), except that this restriction does not apply to frosted light bulbs of 100 watts or less.

6. There shall be no use of any sound equipment in any [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4) in conjunction with the retail sale of pumpkins and Christmas trees.

7. A Los Angeles County Health Department approved chemical toilet shall be provided on the premises.

## Part 5D. Use Definitions

### Div. 5D.1. Use Definitions

#### Sec. 5D.1.1. Intent

[Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definitions are intended to describe and classify land uses that share a common set of key attributes, such as general function, activity, intensity, and impact for the purposes of prescribing a common [permission level](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and a set of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards within a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may maintain a more comprehensive list of specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s according to their [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definition classification.

#### Sec. 5D.1.2. Qualitative Descriptions

[Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definitions are often broad in nature and typically capture a wide variety of specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that share common attributes. Each definition provides a qualitative description of these attributes that is intended to guide the user toward the defined [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that most closely describes the nature of the specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in question.

#### Sec. 5D.1.3. Numeric Thresholds

[Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definitions may include a numerical threshold, such as size or capacity. Numeric thresholds are established based on the scale at which a particular [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may require separate consideration of potential impacts, or may be inappropriate within the particular [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) mix that a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is intended to accommodate. [Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that contain a numeric threshold may be assigned a naming modifier, such as ‘minor’ or ‘major’, ‘local’ or ‘regional’, and ‘light’ or ‘heavy’.

#### Sec. 5D.1.4. Specified Uses

[Use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definitions may include a list of specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that share common attributes to support a definition's broader qualitative description. These specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are provided as illustrative examples to guide users in interpretation and implementation, but are not intended to represent an exhaustive list. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) has the authority to establish and maintain a Specific Use List administratively as deemed necessary and appropriate for the purposes of ensuring consistent application and alignment of specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) definitioins in this code.

### Div. 5D.2. Residential Uses

Residential uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that provide housing accommodations, residential support services, and home-based enterprise.

#### Sec. 5D.2.1. Dwelling

A dwelling is defined as a housing accommodation serving as a primary residency or having an occupancy of greater than 30 consecutive days. A dwelling includes [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), and group dwelling.

#### Sec. 5D.2.2. Household Business

A household business is a use that combines a [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with productive uses and entrepreneurial activities within a unit or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

1. ##### Family Child Care


Household business: family child care is defined as the provision of non-medical care and supervision for children in the provider's [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for periods of less than 24 hours per day. No more than 14 children shall be in care, unless [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards specify otherwise. Any children under the age of 10 years who reside within the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and are in care count toward the maximum number of children in care. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall comply with all regulations set forth in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 1597.465 (Family Day Care Homes)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=1597.465.&lawCode=HSC).

2. ##### Home Occupation


Household business: home occupation is defined as the incidental use of a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for the intent of conducting a business enterprise by a primary [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Home occupation business enterprises are limited to [instructional services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [personal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) uses, and [industrial homework](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

3. ##### Home-Sharing


Household business: home-sharing is defined as the use of a [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for [lodging](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for periods of 30 days consecutively or less, and no more than 120 days annually. The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for home-sharing shall be in conjunction with a [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for home-sharing shall meet the registration and eligibility requirements pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.2. (Home-Sharing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2).

4. ##### Joint Living & Work Quarters


Household business: joint living & work quarters is defined as the adaptive reuse of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), which is part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), from commercial or industrial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s to [household business: live/work](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

5. ##### Live/Work


Household business: live/work is defined as the combination of a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with a work space designated for productive [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and entrepreneurial activities within a single [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).


#### Sec. 5D.2.3. Mobile Home Park

Mobile home park is defined as any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) used to provide rental or lease sites for two or more individual manufactured homes, [mobile home](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, or [park trailer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) used to provide housing accommodations.

#### Sec. 5D.2.4. Supportive Housing

Supportive housing is defined as a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that provides housing accommodations and support services on a voluntary basis to [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on an ongoing basis.

1. ##### General


Supportive housing: general is defined as a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with no limit on length of stay for persons with low incomes and/or who have one or more disabilities who may require support from on-site or off-site [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for daily living. Eligible populations may include seniors, children within the foster care system, emancipated minors, families with children, elderly persons, young adults aging out of the foster care system, individuals exiting from institutional settings, individuals receiving rehabilitation or mental health support, veterans, and persons or families experiencing homelessness. The housing accommodations are linked to on-site or off-site [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), including, but not limited to: subsidized, permanent housing; intensive case management; medical or mental health care; substance abuse treatment; employment services; benefits advocacy; or other services or service referrals necessary to obtain and maintain housing. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) used for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) workspace accommodating the administration of [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be incidental to the [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Medical services shall not be provided on the premises, unless otherwise permitted by the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Supportive housing: general includes a residential [community care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), [residential care facility for elderly](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), and [permanent supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). [Residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with six or fewer beds shall be classified as a [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) rather than supportive housing: general. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include non-residential community care facilities, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.10. (Social Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.10).

2. ##### Medical Care


Supportive housing: medical care is defined as a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of long, and short-term occupation, which may be licensed by the [California Department of Health](https://www.cdph.ca.gov/), to provide 24-hour non-acute medical services and supportive care on the premises. Supportive housing: medical care includes congregate living health facilities, [skilled nursing home](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, residential mental health facilities, and hospice care. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) used for [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) workspace accommodating the administration of medical services and supportive care shall be incidental to the [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Supportive housing: medical care facilities may include [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, common dining areas, or other community rooms.

3. ##### Temporary


Supportive housing: temporary is defined as a facility providing temporary housing accommodations or services, including low barrier navigation, to persons or families experiencing homelessness. Supportive housing: temporary may provide housing for persons or families experiencing homelessness for a time period not to exceed six months within a calendar year. Supportive housing: temporary shall be provided by a government agency or private non-profit organization which provides, or contracts with recognized community organizations to provide, emergency or temporary shelter or services for persons or families experiencing homelessness.


### Div. 5D.3. Public & Institutional Uses

Public & institutional uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s dedicated to serving the public through the provision of government services, utilities, healthcare, education, and culture.

#### Sec. 5D.3.1. Cemetery

A cemetery is defined by [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 7003. (Definitions)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=7003.&lawCode=HSC). A cemetery includes columbarium, crypt, and mausoleum facilities integrated within a burial ground. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include crematoriums, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.11. (Postmortem Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.11).

#### Sec. 5D.3.2. Civic Facility

Civic facility is defined as any [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) facility that provides governmental or cultural services to the general public and is operated by or in partnership with a governmental institution. A civic facility includes a post office, civic center, community center, public museum, courthouse, government office, or library.

1. ##### Local


A civic facility: local is defined as a [civic facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that occupies no more than 50,000 square feet of total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include similar [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that occupy more than 50,000 square feet of total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.2.B. (Civic Facility: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.2).

2. ##### Regional


A civic facility: regional is defined as a [civic facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that occupies more than 50,000 square feet of total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include similar [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that occupy 50,000 square feet or less of total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.2.A. (Civic Facility: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.2).


#### Sec. 5D.3.3. Civic Fleet Services

Civic fleet services include maintenance, storage, and management of government or publicly operated [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, such as school buses, municipal transit vehicles, emergency response vehicles, public utility vehicles, or waste hauling vehicles, in service of any [civic facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Where [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, such as dispatch, do not include [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) maintenance or storage, they are allowed pursuant to [Sec. 5D.3.2. (Civic Facility)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.2).

#### Sec. 5D.3.4. Detention Facility

Detention facility is defined as any facility where persons are incarcerated, or otherwise involuntarily confined under the jurisdiction and custody of a governmental entity. Detention facilities include correctional facilities and penal institutions.

#### Sec. 5D.3.5. Hospital

Hospital is defined as an inpatient or outpatient healthcare facility that provides direct medical treatment to patients.

1. ##### Local


Hospital: local is defined as an inpatient or outpatient acute or subacute care facility with a capacity of 100 or fewer beds that provides direct medical treatment to patients. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include outpatient facilities not providing acute or sub-acute care, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.8. (Medical Clinic)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.8).

2. ##### Regional


Hospital: regional is defined as an inpatient acute care and sub-acute care facility with a capacity of more than 100 beds that provides direct medical treatment to patients. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include inpatient facilities providing sub-acute care with a capacity of fewer than 100 beds, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.3.5.A. (Hospital: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.5).


#### Sec. 5D.3.6. Parking

Parking is defined as a facility intended for the temporary storage of operable vehicles belonging to a [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s occupants, employees, or visitors and is designed to meet the standards of [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4). Includes [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and surface [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include long term vehicle storage, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.5. (Storage, Outdoor)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).

#### Sec. 5D.3.7. Public Safety Facility

A public safety facility is defined as any government facility that provides public safety services. Public safety facility includes fire stations and police stations.

#### Sec. 5D.3.8. Community Assembly

Community assembly is defined as any non-residential and not-for-profit facility that is oriented around an assembly space used primarily for the temporary gathering of people for a shared social purpose. Access to the general public may be limited based on association. Community assembly includes any place of worship, community meeting room, private club, event space, assembly hall, social club, or union hall.

1. ##### Local


Community assembly: local is defined as any [community assembly](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes an assembly space 2,000 square feet or less. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include similar [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that occupy more than 2,000 square feet of total assembly space [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.8.B. (Community Assembly: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.8).

2. ##### Regional


Community assembly: regional is defined as any [community assembly](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes an assembly space larger than 2,000 square feet. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include similar [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that occupy 2,000 square feet or less of total assembly space [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.8.A. (Community Assembly: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.8).


#### Sec. 5D.3.9. School

School is defined as an institution of academic learning and social development that provides facilities for teaching and instruction to accommodate a student body. A school [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) is inclusive of preschool, K-12, post-secondary education, and associated athletic and recreational facilities. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include avocational, recreational, or other educational or instruction-based [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.6. (Instructional Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.6). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include a campus auditorium or stadium facilities with a seating capacity greater than 3,000 seats, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.4.1. (Amphitheater or Stadium)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1).

1. ##### Preschool/Daycare


School: preschool/daycare is defined as a facility providing care, supervision, and educational services to children during the day. A school: preschool/daycare includes all forms of early childhood education, daycare, and after school supervision. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include in-home child care, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.2.2.A. (Household Business: Family Child Care)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.2.2).

2. ##### K-12


School: K-12 is defined as an institution of learning which offers instruction in grades Kindergarten through 12th grade, and associated recreation and athletic facilities serving its students.

3. ##### Post-Secondary


School: post-secondary is defined as an institution offering a formal educational program beyond K-12, including programs whose intent is academic, vocational, or continuing professional education. School: post-secondary includes college, technical school, trade school, and university.


#### Sec. 5D.3.10. Social Services

Social services are defined as [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) administrative services and governmental services that support public welfare through social programs. Social services may be operated by a government entity, a non-profit or a non-governmental organization, and includes welfare service, foster family services, day treatment, adult day care, special needs care, and all other non-residential [community care facilities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

#### Sec. 5D.3.11. Utilities

Utilities use is defined as utility infrastructure as a primary [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of land, necessary for the public provision of services such as water, sewer, power, or communications. For the purposes of this definition, utilities uses exclude the following off-site systems: transmission lines, pipes, or other systems for conveying and transmitting services within utility [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, as those systems are not regulated as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of land by this Article (Use).

1. ##### Minor


Utilities: minor is defined as utility infrastructure that does not require significant health, safety, and environmental precautions, and do not require on-site personnel. Utilities: minor includes renewable energy generation, including wind turbines, geothermal systems, and solar photovoltaic systems serving no more than 10 different [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s with supporting on-site storage, control and transmission equipment, storm water retention or detention ponds, aeration and septic systems, reservoirs, lift stations, water supply wells and water tanks or towers, telecommunications switching facilities, and electrical substations.

2. ##### Major


Utilities: major is defined as utility infrastructure that requires significant health, safety, and environmental precautions due to potential adverse impacts immediate surroundings, and requires on-site personnel. Utilities: major include non-solar power generation facilities, wastewater treatment, and water supply treatment.

3. ##### Solar Energy Facility


Utilities: solar energy facility is defined as utility infrastructure that generates energy for the general public using a solar photovoltaic system primarily for off-site use or sale serving 11 or more [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

4. ##### Wireless Facility, Freestanding


Utilities: wireless facility, freestanding is defined as a freestanding device or system including a monopole, tower, or antenna for the transmitting or receiving of electromagnetic signals, including, but not limited to, radio waves and microwaves, for cellular technology, personal communications services, mobile services, paging systems and related technologies. Facilities include antennas, microwave dishes, parabolic antennas and all other types of equipment used in the transmission and reception of such signals; [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for the support of such facilities, associated [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s or cabinets to house support equipment, and other [accessory structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s or development. A utilities: wireless facility, freestanding is a type of telecommunications facility.

5. ##### Wireless Facility, Rooftop


Utilities: wireless facility, rooftop is defined as a device or system that is mounted on a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) rooftop for the transmitting or receiving of electromagnetic signals, including, but not limited to, radio waves and microwaves, for cellular technology, personal communications services, mobile services, private antennas, paging systems and related technologies. Facilities include antennas, microwave dishes, parabolic antennas and all other types of equipment used in the transmission and reception of such signals; [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s for the support of such facilities, associated [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s or cabinets to house support equipment, and other [accessory structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s or development. A utilities: wireless facility, rooftop is a type of telecommunications facility.


### Div. 5D.4. Open Space & Recreation Uses

Open space & recreational uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that provide opportunities for recreation, sport, and the enjoyment of open space and nature.

#### Sec. 5D.4.1. Amphitheater or Stadium

1. ##### Local


Amphitheater or stadium: local is defined as any outdoor or semi-outdoor assembly facility intended to accommodate a large number of spectators for performances or sporting events and having an associated seating capacity of less than 3,000 seats. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include facilities with seating capacity of 3,000 seats or more, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.4.1.B. (Amphitheater or Stadium: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1). This use does not include an amphitheater or stadium associated with a school, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.3.9. (School)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.9). This use does not include a fully indoor assembly facility intended to accommodate a large number of spectators for performances or sporting events, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.6.4. (Entertainment Venue, Indoor)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.4).

2. ##### Regional


Amphitheater or stadium: regional is defined as any outdoor or semi-outdoor assembly facility intended to accommodate a large number of spectators for performances or sporting events and having an associated seating capacity of 3,000 seats or more. This use includes an amphitheater or stadium associated with a [school](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This use does not include facilities with seating capacity of less than 3,000 seats, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.4.1.A. (Amphitheater or Stadium: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include fully indoor assembly facilities intended to accommodate a large number of spectators for performances or sporting events, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.4. (Entertainment Venue, Indoor)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.4).


#### Sec. 5D.4.2. Indoor Recreation

Indoor recreation is defined as any indoor [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing sports, fitness, leisure, amusement, or recreational facilities. Indoor recreation includes the following [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s when fully indoors: sports courts, health clubs, spas, fitness, martial arts, and dance studios, gymnasiums, aquatics centers, bowling alleys, billiard halls, gaming arcades, ice skating and roller rinks, skate parks, play facilities, and amusement rides.

1. ##### Public


Indoor recreation: public is defined as any indoor recreational [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owned or operated by or in partnership with a public institution.

2. ##### Commercial


Indoor recreation: commercial is defined as any indoor recreational [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owned or operated by a private or commercial entity. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include associated spectator facilities with seating capacity greater than 500 seats, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.4.1. (Amphitheater or Stadium)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1).


#### Sec. 5D.4.3. Nature Reserve

A nature reserve is defined as an area managed so as to protect its flora, fauna, and physical features. Nature reserve includes ecological preserve, marine preserve, natural resource preserve, and water conservation area.

#### Sec. 5D.4.4. Open Space, Public

Open space, public is defined as [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), outdoor areas for passive recreation, which include spaces such as parks, plazas, walking trails, lawns, and picnic benches.

#### Sec. 5D.4.5. Outdoor Recreation

Outdoor recreation is defined as any outdoor [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing sports, fitness, leisure, amusement, or recreation facilities. Outdoor recreation includes the following uses when outdoors: sports courts and fields, aquatic centers, skate parks, play facilities, and amusement rides.

1. ##### Public


Outdoor recreation: public is defined as any outdoor recreational [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owned or operated by or in partnership with a public institution.

2. ##### Commercial


Outdoor recreation: commercial is defined as any outdoor recreational [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) owned or operated by a private or commercial entity. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include associated spectator facilities with seating capacity greater than 500 seats, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.4.1. (Amphitheater or Stadium)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1).

3. ##### Golf Course


Outdoor recreation: golf course is defined as an area of land designed and intended for the game of golf with a series of holes each including tee, fairway, and putting green, and often one or more natural or artificial hazards. A outdoor recreation: golf course [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes any course having a total par of 65, or greater. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) also includes a clubhouse incidental to a standard-sized golf course. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include miniature golf, pitch & putt, driving range, or 3-par courses, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.4.5.A. (Outdoor Recreation: Public)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.5) or [Sec. 5D.4.5.B. (Outdoor Recreation: Commercial)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.5).


### Div. 5D.5. Transportation Uses

Transportation uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that facilitate major modes of transportation for the loading or unloading of passengers and freight.

#### Sec. 5D.5.1. Airport

An airport is defined as a runway landing area or other facility used for the landing and taking off of aircraft including all the necessary taxiways, aircraft storage and tie-down areas, hangars, passenger terminals, and warehousing facilities.

#### Sec. 5D.5.2. Freight Railway Facility

A freight railway facility is defined as any railway facility accommodating the transportation of cargo by train on a railway network. Freight railway facilities includes freight railway track networks and accompanying railway yards, stations, and maintenance facilities. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include cargo transfer between vehicles; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.5.3. (Freight Transfer Facility)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.5.3).

#### Sec. 5D.5.3. Freight Transfer Facility

Freight transfer facility is defined as a facility intended for the transshipment of freight between different modes of transport, including ship transport, rail transport, and road transport, and accompanying warehousing used in connection with such activities. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the storage of empty cargo containers; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s; see [Sec. 5D.7.5.E. (Storage, Outdoor: Cargo Container)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).

#### Sec. 5D.5.4. Heliport

Heliport is defined as any public-use, special-use, or personal-use airport, as defined by the [California Code of Regulations, Title 21. Sec. 3527. (Definitions)](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Document/IA62581C14C8511ECB533000D3A7C4BC3?viewType=FullText&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=CategoryPageItem&contextData=(sc.Default)), suitable only for use by helicopters.

#### Sec. 5D.5.5. Passenger Transit Facility

A passenger transit facility is defined as any facility that includes a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) accommodating [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) passenger transport vehicles which regularly load and unload passengers along a fixed route. A passenger transit facility include bus terminals, light rail stations and right-of-ways, subway stations and right-of-ways, and passenger train stations and right-of-ways.

### Div. 5D.6. General Commercial Uses

General commercial uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that involve business activity serving the general public, including [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), professional and personal services, hospitality, and entertainment.

#### Sec. 5D.6.1. Animal Services

Animal services is defined as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the provision of services related primarily to domestic animal care and keeping.

1. ##### General


Animal services: general is defined as [animal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in which domestic dogs or cats are provided non-medical care, such as, grooming, training, supervision, or boarding. This does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s where the overnight boarding of dogs or cats exceeds 30 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) of a facility, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.1.B. (Animal Services: Kennel)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include medical care of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.1.C. (Animal Services: Veterinary Care)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1).

2. ##### Kennel


Animal services: kennel is defined as [animal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in which four or more dogs or cats, at least four months of age, are sheltered for periods beyond 24 hours per day. This definition does not include [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) establishments dedicated to the commercial sale of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12.H. (Retail: Pet Shop)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the breeding and raising of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D. 10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Small Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D).

3. ##### Veterinary Care


Animal services: veterinary care is defined as [animal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) in which animals or pets are given medical or surgical treatment and care. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the non-medical treatment and care of dogs and cats, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.1.A. (Animal Services: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1).


#### Sec. 5D.6.2. Commissary Kitchen

A commissary kitchen is defined as a kitchen facility used for cooking and preparing food to be primarily served and consumed off-site. This definition includes multi-tenant shared kitchen facilities, order fulfillment kitchens, and catering kitchen facilities. The following uses are allowed when incidental to the kitchen facility: research and teaching facilities, commercial food processing, and order fulfillment pick-up lobbies.

#### Sec. 5D.6.3. Eating & Drinking

Eating & drinking is defined as the sale of prepared, ready-to-consume meals or drinks for consumption by the public.

1. ##### General


Eating & drinking: general is defined as an eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that involves serving and sale of prepared food and drinks for on or off-site consumption. Eating & drinking: general [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s includes table service at a [restaurant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), counter service for off-site consumption, and self-service cafeteria dining. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the dispensing of alcoholic beverages for consumption on-site, for such uses, see [Sec. 5D.6.3.B. (Eating & Drinking: Alcohol Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.3). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the sale of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption, without prepared food orders, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12.B. (Retail: Alcohol)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12).

2. ##### Alcohol Service


Eating & drinking: alcohol service is defined as an eating & drinking [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that involves the serving and dispensing of alcoholic beverages primarily for consumption on-site. Eating & drinking: alcohol service includes the provision of alcoholic beverages to customers in a dining setting, while gathered at a bar or tasting room, or in conjunction with another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), such as an entertainment venue, stadium, hotel, indoor recreation, brewery or distillery. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the sale of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption, without prepared food orders, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12.B. (Retail: Alcohol)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12).


#### Sec. 5D.6.4. Entertainment Venue, Indoor

Entertainment venue, indoor is defined as any indoor assembly [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designed or intended for entertainment, includes live music venues, performing arts theaters, movie theaters, dance clubs, comedy clubs, karaoke lounges, and banquet halls.

1. ##### Local


Entertainment venue, indoor: local is defined as an [entertainment venue, indoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) use designed for an assembly capacity of less than 3,000 persons. For [entertainment venue, indoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s designed for an assembly capacity of 3,000 or greater, see [Sec. 5D.6.4.B. (Entertainment Venue, Indoor: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.4). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include activities established in [Sec. 5D.6.13. (Sexually Oriented Business)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.13). For the inclusion of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption, see [Sec. 5D.6.3.B. (Eating & Drinking: Alcohol Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.3).

2. ##### Regional


Entertainment venue, indoor: regional is defined as any [entertainment venue, indoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) use designed for an assembly capacity of 3,000 persons or greater. For [entertainment venue, indoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s designed for an assembly capacity of less than 3,000 persons, see [Sec. 5D.6.4.A. (Entertainment Venue, Indoor: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.4). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include activities established in [Sec. 5D.6.13. (Sexually Oriented Business)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.13). For the inclusion of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption, see [Sec. 5D.6.3.B. (Eating & Drinking: Alcohol Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.3).


#### Sec. 5D.6.5. Financial Services

Financial services are defined as professional services involving the investment, lending, or management of money and assets in a [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) setting rather than a private office setting. This use does not include private workspace settings,for such uses see [Sec. 5D.6.9. (Office)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.9).

1. ##### General


Financial services: general is defined as [financial services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that provide retail banking services. Financial services: general include only those institutions engaged in the transfer and circulation of money, such as banks and credit unions. This use does not include check-cashing businesses and payday lenders, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.6.5.B. (Financial Services: Alternative)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.5).

2. ##### Alternative


Financial services: alternative is defined as [financial services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving for-profit lending facility offering small, unsecured, short-term loans, such as bail bonds, or a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that primarily consists of check cashing services for a fee, or any business where articles of personal property may be left as security in exchange for a loan of money. Financial services: alternative include pawnshops, precious metal buyback centers, short-term credit lenders, and title loan centers. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include remittance services, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.5.A. (Financial Services: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.5).


#### Sec. 5D.6.6. Instructional Services

Instructional services are defined as any establishment primarily engaged in offering avocational or recreational educational courses to adults or children for the purposes of play, amusement, or relaxation, including education offered for the intent of teaching the fundamentals, skills, or techniques of a hobby or activity. This use includes establishments offering programs in art, cooking, drama, driving, language, music, sewing, tutoring, or other similar forms of self-improvement. This use does not include vocational and other educational [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.3.9. (School)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.9).

#### Sec. 5D.6.7. Lodging

Lodging is defined as commercial overnight accommodations for transient occupancy, often for periods of 30 consecutive days, or less. Lodging [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s shall not serve as a [primary residence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Lodging [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s include, hotels, motels, and hostels. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.2.2.C. (Home-Sharing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.2.2).This use does not include [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) housing accommodations, for such uses see [Div. 5D.2. (Residential Uses)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.2).

#### Sec. 5D.6.8. Medical Clinic

Medical clinic is defined as an outpatient healthcare facility that provides direct medical, dental, or therapeutic services to patients. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include healthcare facilities providing acute, sub-acute or inpatient healthcare; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.8.A. (Hospital: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.8) and [Sec. 5D.3.8.B. (Hospital: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.8).

#### Sec. 5D.6.9. Office

Office is defined as any workspace accommodating administrative, creative and business services.
