Office [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s may be operated independently or combined with other [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, provided each of the other [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s is permitted and meets the applicable standards. An office [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes workspace accommodating the following activities: administrative, clerical, legal, accounting, design, consulting, graphics and sound editing, and dry lab research.

#### Sec. 5D.6.10. Personal Services

Personal services are defined as any commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing an in-person service directly to individuals seeking cosmetic services, counseling services, document services, or servicing of consumer goods. Personal services include: cosmetic services such as hair cutting and styling, nail salon, day spas, licensed massage therapy, tattooing and piercing; counseling services, such as non-medical counseling, legal counseling, financial counseling, and psychic counseling; document services, such as printing, form and application assistance, notary services, photo developing, visa and passport services; garment services, such as garment tailoring and alterations, laundromat, dry-cleaning; and consumer goods repair services when occupying less than 3,000 square feet in area, such as electronics repair, jewelry repair, shoe repair, appliance repair, furniture restoration, and bicycle repair. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include consumer goods repair services when occupying 3,000 square feet in area, or greater, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.8.1. (Machine Shop)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include maintenance and repair of [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.1. (Motor Vehicle Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.1).

#### Sec. 5D.6.11. Postmortem Services

Postmortem services are defined as any establishment engaged in the provision of services involving the care, preparation, or arrangement of human or animal remains, and conducting memorial services. Postmortem service establishments include crematoriums, funeral homes, mortuaries, and pet crematoriums. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include a [cemetery](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.1. (Cemetery)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.1).

#### Sec. 5D.6.12. Retail

Retail is defined as a commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involved in the sale or dispensing of consumer goods to the general public, including any associated indoor or outdoor display and point of sales.

01. ##### General


    Retail: general is defined as any [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) primarily involved in the sale or rental of new or used consumer goods to the general public. Retail: general includes but is not limited to, the sale or rental of household goods, clothing, books, toys, art supplies, pet supplies, house plants, medicine, consumer electronics, appliances, hardware, building supplies, mattresses, and furniture. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the sale or rental of [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.3. (Motor Vehicle Sales & Rental)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.3).

02. ##### Alcohol


    Retail: alcohol is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the sale or dispensing of alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption and are licensed or seeking a license to sell or otherwise dispense alcoholic beverages for off-site consumption, as defined by the [California State Alcoholic Beverage Control Act](https://www.abc.ca.gov/law-and-policy/legislation/abc-act/) (ABC). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the on-site consumption of alcoholic beverages, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.3.B. (Eating & Drinking: Alcohol Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.3).

03. ##### Farmers' Market, Certified


    Retail: farmers' market, certified is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involved in the sale or dispensing of agricultural products by producers or certified producers directly to consumers or to individuals, organizations, or entities that subsequently sell or distribute the products directly to end users and is certified by the Los Angeles County Agricultural Commissioner.

04. ##### Firearms


    Retail: firearms is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where firearms, ammunition, or related accessories are sold.

05. ##### Food & Beverage


    Retail: food & beverage is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) primarily involved in the retail sale of food and beverages for off-site consumption. Retail: food & beverage includes grocery stores, produce markets, seafood and meat markets, bakeries, delis, and on-site seating areas for dining accessory to the primary [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include alcoholic beverage sales; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12.B. (Retail: Alcohol)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12).

06. ##### Large Format


    Retail: large format is defined as any [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with a non-residential tenant size of 100,000 square feet or greater. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may include but is not limited to any of the following types of [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) when occupying a non-residential tenant size of 100,000 square feet or greater: superstore, department store, wholesale club, furniture store, and home improvement store. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include any [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) with a non-residential tenant size of less than 100,000 square feet, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12.A. (Retail: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12).

07. ##### Merchant Market


    Retail: merchant market is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes ten or more tenants or vendors within a shared facility with common entrances and walkways, where goods, products, groceries, and prepared food are offered or displayed for sale or exchange, and may include on-site seating areas for dining as incidental to the market [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#).

08. ##### Pet Shop


    Retail: pet shop is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) possessing a pet shop permit issued by the Department of Animal Services where domestic animals such as dogs, cats, rabbits, rodents, birds, fish, amphibians, and small reptiles are kept and offered for commercial sale, for hire, or adoption. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s where the overnight keeping of dogs or cats exceeds 30 percent of the floor area of a facility, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.6.1.B. (Animal Services: Kennel)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the breeding and raising of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Small Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1).

09. ##### Seasonal Market


    Retail: seasonal market is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the seasonal outdoor retail sale of ornamental holiday decor, primarily ornamental pumpkins and Christmas trees.

10. ##### Smoke & Vape Shop


    Retail: smoke & vape shop is defined as a [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) primarily involving the sale of tobacco products, substances intended for smoking, or smoking accessories, including but not limited to cigars, pipes, vaporizing devices, or other smoking paraphernalia. The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may include an [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) smokers’ lounge that is solely dedicated to smoking tobacco products. This use does not include medicinal or recreational cannabis establishments, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see the [Department of Cannabis Regulation](https://cannabis.lacity.gov/).


#### Sec. 5D.6.13. Sexually Oriented Business

A sexually oriented business is defined as any commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the retail sale, rental or exhibition, of any goods or services that are characterized by an emphasis on the exposure or display of [specified sexual activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or [specified anatomical parts](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). Each sexually oriented business [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall constitute a separate sexually oriented business, even if operated in conjunction with another sexually oriented business at the same establishment, for the intent of meeting applicable [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) standards. For the purposes of regulating the distance between each specific sexually oriented business, (such as adult arcade, adult bookstore, adult theaters, striptease venue, or sexual encounter accommodations) each specific use shall constitute a separate sexually oriented business.

1. ##### General


Sexually oriented business: general is defined as any [sexually oriented business](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), other than a [sexually oriented business: sexual encounter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) establishment. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes but is not limited to adult arcades, adult bookstores, adult cabaret theaters, adult motion picture theaters, or striptease venues.

2. ##### Sexual Encounter


Sexually oriented business: sexual encounter is defined as any [sexually oriented business](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), other than [lodging](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) offering public accommodations, which, for any form of consideration, provides a place where two or more persons may congregate, associate or consort in connection with [specified sexual activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) or the exposure of [specified anatomical parts](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where a medical practitioner, psychologist, psychiatrist, or similar professional licensed by the State of California engages in sexual therapy, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.8. (Medical Clinic)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.8).


### Div. 5D.7. Heavy Commercial Uses

Heavy commercial uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that involve the servicing and sale of [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and businesses dedicated primarily to storage.

#### Sec. 5D.7.1. Motor Vehicle Services

Motor vehicle services are defined as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the diagnosing of malfunctions, repair, or maintenance of [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

1. ##### Light


Motor vehicle services: light is defined as any [motor vehicle services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the mechanical or electrical repair, diagnosis, maintenance or servicing of standard [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes automotive emissions testing; electrical diagnostic, battery testing, and charging; tire removal, replacement, and repair; mechanical adjustment; oil change; lubrication; sound system or alarm service and installation; and window repair. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in the following Sections: [Sec. 5D.7.1.B. (Motor Vehicle Services: Heavy)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.1), [Sec. 5D.7.1.C. (Motor Vehicle Services: Large Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.1), or [Sec. 5D.7.1.D. (Motor Vehicle Services: Car Wash)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.1).

2. ##### Heavy


Motor vehicle services: heavy is defined as any [motor vehicle services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving auto body repair or rebuilding, painting, or servicing of standard [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes the repair or rebuilding of a vehicle’s frame, roof, doors, fenders, bumpers, hood, trunk, automobile painting, and electric vehicle battery reconditioning and replacement.

3. ##### Large Vehicle


Motor vehicle services: large vehicle is defined as any [motor vehicle services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) performed for large vehicles, classified for this purpose as a vehicle having three or more axles, such as trailer trucks, construction vehicles, motor homes, and [recreational vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

4. ##### Car Wash


Motor vehicle services: car wash is defined as any [motor vehicle services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) engaged in cleaning, washing, or waxing of [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, such as passenger cars, trucks, vans, and trailers. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include wash facilities for large vehicles, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.1.C. (Motor Vehicle Services: Large Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.1).


#### Sec. 5D.7.2. Fueling Station

A fueling station is defined as any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to the sale and dispensing of [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) fuel.

1. ##### Standard Vehicle


Fueling station: standard vehicle is defined as any [fueling station](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to dispensing fuel for standard vehicles. Standard vehicles include [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s possessing two or fewer axles, such as cars, motorcycles, sport utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and vans.

2. ##### Large Vehicle


Fueling station: large vehicle is defined as any [fueling station](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) dedicated to dispensing fuel for large vehicles. Large vehicles include [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s possessing three or more axles, such as trailer trucks, construction vehicles, motor homes, and [recreational vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.


#### Sec. 5D.7.3. Motor Vehicle Sales & Rental

Motor vehicle sales & rental is defined as any [heavy commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that sells, rents, or leases [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

1. ##### Standard Vehicle


Motor vehicle sales & rental: standard vehicle is defined as any motor vehicle sales & rental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving indoor or outdoor display of three or more new or used standard vehicles for sale, rental, or lease. Standard vehicles include [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s possessing two or fewer axles, such as cars, motorcycles, sport utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and vans. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the outdoor storage of [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that do not comprise an establishment's sale or rental inventory, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see, [Sec. 5D.7.5.B. (Storage, Outdoor: Standard Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).

2. ##### Large Vehicle


Motor vehicle sales & rental: large vehicle is defined as any motor vehicle sales & rental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving indoor or outdoor display of three or more new or used large vehicles for sale, rental, or lease. Large vehicles include [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s possessing three or more axles, such as trailer trucks, construction vehicles, motor homes, and [recreational vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, in addition to recreational boats and watercraft. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the outdoor storage of [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that do not comprise an establishment's sale or rental inventory, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see, [Sec. 5D.7.5.C. (Storage, Outdoor: Large Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).

3. ##### Household Moving Truck Rental


Motor vehicle sales & rental: household moving truck rental is defined as any motor vehicle sales & rental [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the rental of household moving rental trucks or utility trailers. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the outdoor storage of [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s that do not comprise an establishment's rental inventory, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see, [Sec. 5D.7.5.C. (Storage, Outdoor: Large Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).


#### Sec. 5D.7.4. Storage, Indoor

Storage, indoor is defined as the indoor holding of goods, merchandise, supplies, material, machinery, equipment, or other items for future use.

1. ##### General


Storage, indoor: general is defined as any [storage, indoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is incidental to another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [storage, indoor: self-service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.4.B. (Storage, Indoor: Self-Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.4). This use does not include indoor storage that functions as the [primary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) and is not incidental to another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#), for such uses see [Sec. 5D.8.6. (Wholesale Trade & Warehousing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8.6).

2. ##### Self-Service


Storage, indoor: self-service is defined as any [storage, indoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that offers secure self-storage for household goods in individual rooms, compartments, lockers, or containers, to which clients bring goods for storage and retrieve them at any time during normal business hours.


#### Sec. 5D.7.5. Storage, Outdoor

Storage, outdoor is defined as the outdoor holding of goods, merchandise, supplies, material, machinery, equipment, vehicles, or other items for future use. Includes contractors' equipment storage yards and lumber yards.

1. ##### General


Storage, outdoor: general is defined as any [storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that is in conjunction with another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the keeping of empty cargo containers, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.5.E. (Storage, Outdoor: Cargo Container)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include inactive large vehicles, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.5.C. (Storage, Outdoor: Large Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include towing and storage for official motor vehicle impound, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.5.F. (Storage, Outdoor: Official Motor Vehicle Impound)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include inactive standard vehicles, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.5.B. (Storage, Outdoor: Standard Vehicle)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).

2. ##### Standard Vehicle


Storage, outdoor: standard vehicle is defined as the outdoor storage of standard vehicles that are not actively used by the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s occupants, employees, or visitors. Standard vehicles include [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s possessing two or fewer axles, such as cars, motorcycles, sport utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and vans. Includes storage of inoperable [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s where [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are actively used by the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s occupants, employees, or visitors; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.6. (Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.6).

3. ##### Large Vehicle


Storage, outdoor: large vehicle is defined as the outdoor storage of large vehicles that are not actively used by the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s occupants, employees, or visitors. Large vehicles include [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s possessing three or more axles, such as trailer trucks, construction vehicles, motor homes, and [recreational vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s as well as recreational boats and watercraft. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes storage of inoperable vehicles. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s where [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are actively used by the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)'s occupants, employees, or visitors; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.3.6. (Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.6).

4. ##### Donation Bin


Storage, outdoor: donation bin is defined as any [storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving a box, canister, receptacle, or other container that can be opened and closed, and is used for collecting salvageable personal property, including, but not limited to, clothing, shoes, books, and household items for periodic off-site processing or redistribution. For purposes of this definition, salvageable personal property shall not include recyclable materials not intended for re-use, including, but not limited to, newspapers, plastic, glass, aluminum, electronics, toxic or hazardous materials, and solid waste. For purposes of this definition, donation bins are limited dimensionally to 82-inches in height, 50-inches in depth, and 60-inches in width. For bins that are larger in size, see [Sec. 5D.9.4.A. (Recycling Facility: Collection)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.4).

5. ##### Cargo Container


Storage, outdoor: cargo container is defined as any [storage, outdoor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the keeping of empty cargo containers. Storage, outdoor: cargo container may include storage of container chassis and commercial truck cabs, repair facilities, warehouses, and [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, incidental to the movement or storage of cargo containers. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the storage of cargo containers that are not empty, or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s which are part of any freight transfer, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.5.3. (Freight Transfer Facility)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.5.3).

6. ##### Official Motor Vehicle Impound


Storage, outdoor: official motor vehicle impound is defined as any [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) towing and storage service that involves [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#)-approved vendors that support the public safety mission of the Los Angeles Police Department and Department of Transportation.


### Div. 5D.8. Light Industrial Uses

Light industrial uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving the production, warehousing, or manufacturing of goods, materials, and products in an intensive manner that require a significant separation from residential and commercial districts.

#### Sec. 5D.8.1. Machine Shop

A machine shop is defined as any facility engaged in the maintenance, repair, custom fabrication and finishing of products, parts, props, equipment, or machinery primarily using metal and woodworking machinery and tools. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the servicing of consumer goods when occupying less than 3,000 square feet in area; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.10. (Personal Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.10). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) repair and maintenance; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.7.1. (Motor Vehicle Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the fabrication of heavy machinery used for manufacturing, [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, aircraft or watercraft; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.9.2.A (Manufacturing, Heavy: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.2).

#### Sec. 5D.8.2. Manufacturing, Light

Manufacturing, light is defined as any [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the making or processing of materials or components into new products.

1. ##### General


Manufacturing, light: general is defined as the manufacturing of finished goods intended to be sold as consumer goods to the general public, including devices and instruments used in a workplace. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes, but is not limited to, the manufacturing and assembly of the following: medical equipment and supplies; semiconductors and electronic instruments; signs and printed material; musical instruments; jewelry; toys; furniture; crates; boxes; and barrels. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.9.2.A. (Manufacturing, Heavy: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.2).

2. ##### Alcoholic Beverage


Manufacturing, light: alcoholic beverage is defined as any [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where beer, wine, or other alcoholic beverages are fermented, distilled, and/or processed for distribution and sale on a wholesale basis. For [retail](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) sale of any alcoholic beverage, see [Sec. 5D.6.12.B. (Retail: Alcohol)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12).

3. ##### Artistic & Artisanal


Manufacturing, light: artistic & artisanal is defined as a small-scale [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where skilled craftspersons are integral to the creation of each product, materials, substances, or components, and may include, but are not limited to the use of hand tools or light mechanical equipment such as commercial mixers, sewing machines, wax melters, bottle sealers, paste filling machines, and button press machines. Manufacturing, light: artistic & artisanal [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s are less than 5,000 square feet in area, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s larger than 5,000 square feet in area see [Sec. 5D.8.2. (Manufacturing, Light: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8.2).

4. ##### Cosmetic & Pharmaceutical


Manufacturing, light: cosmetic & pharmaceutical is defined as any [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where cosmetics, soaps, or pharmaceutical drugs are produced. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes, but is not limited to, manufacturing of makeup products, deodorants, shampoos, hair dyes, perfumes, skin moisturizers, medications, or supplements.

5. ##### Electronics


Manufacturing, light: electronics is defined as any [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involved in the manufacturing or assembly of computer or electronic products, electrical equipment, appliances, fixtures, or electronic product components. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes testing and repair incidental to the product or component assembly.

6. ##### Food & Drink


Manufacturing, light: food & drink is defined as any [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where food or drink products are processed or manufactured. The food and beverage products manufactured in these facilities are typically sold to wholesalers or retailers for distribution to consumers. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes, but is not limited to, the processing and packaging of the following: sodas & juices, coffee & tea, ice, dairy products, fruit, nut, & vegetable products, grain & oilseeds, baked or fried goods, sugar and confectionery products, animal food, and tobacco products. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes food & drink products composed of previously rendered animal products. This use does not include meat processing, the rendering of animal products, or animal slaughtering, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.9.1. (Animal Products Processing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.1). This use does not include breweries, distilleries, and wineries, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.8.2.B. (Manufacturing, Light: Alcoholic Beverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8.2).

7. ##### Garment & Accessory


Manufacturing, light: garment & accessory is defined as any [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the cutting, stitching or assembly of materials to produce finished clothing, footwear, and accessories. Specific activities include, but are not limited to, sewing of finished textiles, printing or stenciling of designs on garments, assembly of accessories or footwear, or the knitting of finished garments. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.8.2.H. (Manufacturing, Light: Textile)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8.2).

8. ##### Textile


Manufacturing, light: textile is defined as any [manufacturing, light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving mechanized production of fibers and fabrics used to create materials for the production of garments and accessories. Specific activities include, but are not limited to, textile spinning, weaving, dying, printing, or finishing. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.8.2.G. (Manufacturing, light: Garment & Accessory)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8.2).


#### Sec. 5D.8.3. Research & Development

Research & development is defined as any [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) requiring a wet laboratory where chemicals, drugs, or other material or biological matter are handled in liquid solutions or volatile phases, requiring direct ventilation, or specialized piped utilities. Research & development does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s requiring a dry laboratory, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.9. (Office)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.9).

#### Sec. 5D.8.4. Soundstages & Backlots

Soundstages & backlots are defined as any [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) providing facilities for the construction and use of indoor or outdoor filming sets and adjoining backlot facilities, including supporting [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) workspace, [machine shop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, and warehousing related to filming or film production.

#### Sec. 5D.8.5. Wholesale & Warehousing

Wholesale & warehousing is defined as any [light industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) facility primarily [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) d for the high volume storage of goods for sale in large quantities primarily to businesses, or the storage of products intended for consolidation and distribution to manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, or end users. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes seasonal inventory storage, distribution centers, fulfillment centers, cold storage facilities, and facilities housing goods for sale in bulk to businesses or institutions. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the sale of goods directly to consumers; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12. (Retail)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the transshipment of freight between different modes of transport, such as rail to trucking transport; for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s see [Sec. 5D.5.3. (Freight Transfer Facility)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.5.3).

### Div. 5D.9. Heavy Industrial Uses

Heavy industrial uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s involving manufacturing, processing of animal products, waste, or extraction activities, which requires siting away from the general public due to potentially adverse impacts on the immediate surroundings.

#### Sec. 5D.9.1. Animal Products Processing

Animal products processing is defined as a [heavy industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving one or more of the following: preparing and processing of meat, poultry, or seafood and their byproducts; refining or rendering animal fat, bones, and meat scraps; preparing, tanning, and finishing hides and skins; dressing or dyeing furs; and animal slaughtering.

#### Sec. 5D.9.2. Manufacturing, Heavy

Manufacturing, heavy is defined as any [heavy industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the making or processing of materials or components into finished products.

1. ##### General


Manufacturing, heavy: general is defined as manufacturing that requires significant health, safety, or environmental precautions due to potential adverse impacts from the manufacturing process on immediate surroundings. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes, but is not limited to, the manufacturing of heavy machinery, [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, aircraft and watercraft, primary metal products, wood or paper products, metal fabrication, or manufacturing involving the processing, mixing, or refinement of inorganic raw materials. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.9.2.B. (Manufacturing, Heavy: Chemical Products)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.2). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.9.2.C. (Manufacturing, Heavy: Petroleum & Coal Products)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.2).

2. ##### Chemical Products


Manufacturing, heavy: chemical products is defined as any [manufacturing, heavy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) producing basic chemicals or manufacturing products by predominantly chemical processes. Includes, but is not limited to, production of acid, alkali, organic chemical, salt, dry color, pigment, synthetic fiber, fertilizer, explosives, or paint. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.9.2.C. (Manufacturing, Heavy: Petroleum & Coal Products)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.2).

3. ##### Petroleum & Coal Products


Manufacturing, heavy: petroleum & coal products is defined as any [manufacturing, heavy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that processes petroleum, coal, plastic, or rubber materials into products, including the refining of petroleum, gas, or other hydrocarbons.


#### Sec. 5D.9.3. Salvage Yard

Salvage yard is defined as any [heavy industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) having any portion of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) located outdoors where a junk dealer or automobile dismantler operates, or where partially dismantled, obsolete, or wrecked automobiles are stored. This use does not include [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) storage, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.7.5. (Storage, Outdoor)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.7.5).

#### Sec. 5D.9.4. Recycling Facility

Recycling facility is defined as any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the recovery and processing of recyclable or reusable materials.

1. ##### Collection


Recycling facility: collection is defined as any [recycling facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) where recyclable materials including, but not limited to, paper, plastic, glass, metal, newspaper, or cardboard, are deposited or redeemed for monetary value. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes baling or crushing operations for the purposes of efficient storage and transfer, but shall not include sorting or processing activities other than for temporary storage purposes. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes [reverse vending machine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s and buyback centers.

2. ##### Sorting & Processing


Recycling facility: sorting & processing is defined as any [recycling facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that accepts recyclable materials for on-site sorting or processing. For the purpose of this definition, processing shall mean the process of changing the physical characteristics of a recyclable material, including the shredding, smelting, grinding and crushing of cans, bottles, and other materials, other than for temporary storage purposes. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes the transfer and processing of scrap metals.


#### Sec. 5D.9.5. Waste Facility

Waste facility is defined as any [heavy industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the receipt, storage, separation, conversion, combustion, processing of solid waste, transfer of waste directly from small to larger vehicles for transport, or operation as a landfill. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes facilities involved in the transfer, processing, and transformation of organic waste, construction and demolition debris, inert material, solid waste.

1. ##### Organic Waste


Waste facility: organic waste is defined as any [waste facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that receives any material that comes from a plant or animal and is biodegradable, for chipping and grinding, composting, curing, mulching or similar processing methods. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include any chipping and grinding, composting, curing, or mulching conducted as part of the maintenance of landscaped areas associated with any public & institutional uses or open space & recreation uses.

2. ##### Hazardous Waste


Waste facility: hazardous waste is defined as any [waste facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) involving the storage, treatment, and disposal of hazardous waste, as defined in the [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 25117.1. (Definitions)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=25117.1.&lawCode=HSC).

3. ##### Solid Waste


Waste facility: solid waste is defined as any [waste facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that does not involve any storage, treatment, and disposal of hazardous waste, or that does not exclusively receive organic waste. For such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s, see [Sec. 5D.9.5.B. (Waste Facility: Hazardous Waste)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.5) and [Sec. 5D.9.5.A. (Waste Facility: Organic Waste)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.5).


#### Sec. 5D.9.6. Mineral & Ore Extraction

Mineral & ore extraction is defined as any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) engaged in the extraction of metallic minerals, non-metallic minerals, or other natural compounds. This use includes the exploration or development of any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) for such purposes, and any preparation of those resources until the point of shipment from the producing property. This use includes metal ore mining, nonmetallic mineral mining, and quarrying. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include extraction, recovery, or production of oil, natural gas, or any other hydrocarbon materials, for these activities see [Sec. 5D.9.7. (Oil, Gas, or Hydrocarbon Well)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.7).

#### Sec. 5D.9.7. Oil, Gas, or Hydrocarbon Well

Any well or hole already drilled, being drilled or to be drilled into the surface of the earth which is used or intended to be used in connection with coring or the drilling for prospecting for or producing petroleum, natural gas or other hydrocarbon substances, or is used or intended to be used for the subsurface injection into the earth of oil field waste, gases, water or liquid substances, including any such existing hole, well or casing which has not been abandoned in accordance with the requirements of [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Sec. 57.5706.3.16. (Abandonment of Oil Wells)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-351526) and the mitigation monitoring program and well plugging and abandonment mitigation measures adopted with [Ordinance No. 187,709](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf) (Oil and Gas Drilling Ordinance). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include any well operated by a public utility regulated by the California Public Utilities Commission.

### Div. 5D.10. Agricultural Uses

Agricultural uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s dedicated to the cultivation of plants or the keeping of animals.

#### Sec. 5D.10.1. Animal Keeping

Animal keeping is defined as any [agricultural use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the breeding, boarding, training, or raising of animals.

1. ##### Bees


Animal keeping: bees is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the keeping of [bee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s.

2. ##### Dairy


Animal keeping: dairy is defined as an [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the storage, processing, or distribution of milk or milk products.

3. ##### Equine, Commercial


Animal keeping: equine, commercial is defined as the keeping, breeding, raising, training, or boarding of more than two [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s not owned by and registered to [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as the equine [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). [Equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes mules and donkeys.

4. ##### Equine, Non-Commercial


Animal keeping: equine, non-commercial is defined as the keeping, breeding, raising, training, or boarding of [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s owned by and registered to [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) as the equine [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#). No more than two [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s owned by or registered to persons not residing on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) shall be allowed. [Equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes mules and donkeys.

5. ##### Livestock


Animal keeping: livestock is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the breeding, raising, training, boarding, or keeping of animals such as alpacas, cattle, donkeys, goats, mules, sheep, swine, or similar livestock, typically for fiber, meat, milk, or other products. This use includes day-to-day care, selective breeding, raising, and selling of livestock.

6. ##### Pets


Animal keeping: pets is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the keeping of domestic pets that are readily classifiable as being incidental to another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) such as dogs, cats, rabbits, rodents, birds, poultry, fish, amphibians, and small reptiles. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Small Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Wild Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1) or [Sec. 5D.6.1.B. (Animal Services: Kennel)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1).

7. ##### Small Animals


Animal keeping: small animals is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) licensed by the Department of Animal Services for the breeding, raising, training, or boarding of small domestic animals such as dogs, cats, rabbits, rodents, birds, poultry fish, amphibians, and reptiles. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) does not include the uses defined in [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Wild Animals).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1)

8. ##### Wild Animals


Animal keeping: wild animals is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) licensed by the Department of Animal Services pursuant to [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Sec. 53.38. (Wild Animals - Keeping - Permit)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-137173) for the keeping of wild, exotic, dangerous, or non-domestic animals.


#### Sec. 5D.10.2. Plant Cultivation

Plant cultivation is defined as any [agricultural use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) that includes the growing of plants.

1. ##### Community Garden


Plant cultivation: community garden is defined as a [plant cultivation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) designed and intended for multiple [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) s or organizations to cultivate plants for domestic use. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) may include shared facilities for storage and maintenance or services incidental to the [agricultural use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) such as an educational space.

2. ##### Farming


Plant cultivation: farming is defined as the cultivation of produce, ornamental plants, herbs, seeds, or fungi, for off-site sale or distribution. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#) includes, but is not limited to, truck gardening, indoor farming, or vertical farming. For the sale of produce on-site beyond a farm stand pursuant to [Sec. 5C.2.8.G.1. (Supplemental Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2.8), see [Sec. 5D.6.12.E. (Retail: Food & Beverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12).

Click on to see related Notes for the section. ## Use Finder Enter a use to see how it is organized in the Zoning Code. Submit # Article 6. Density ## Part 6A. Introduction ### Div. 6A.1. Orientation #### Sec. 6A.1.1. Relationship to Zone String A [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is composed of the following districts, as established in [Sec. 1.5.2. (Zoning Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2): [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/6A.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=IYkdOGzQ)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/6A.1.1.1.png?itok=HmbgGmDC) The Density District is a separate and independent component of each zone. #### Sec. 6A.1.2. How to Use Article 6. (Density) 1. ##### Identify the Applicable Density District The fifth component in a [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is the Density District for a property. 2. ##### Determine Applicable Density District Standards 1. Density Districts standards are located in [Part 6B. (Density Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B). Each Density District identifies the standards specific to that Density District. 2. Each standard in a Density District in [Part 6B. (Density Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) provides a reference to [Part 6C. (Density Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C) where the standard is explained in detail. Text in italics below a heading provides a definition of that heading. [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/6A.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=Mx87q1Jj)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/6A.1.2.1.png?itok=LN9XorI1) #### Sec. 6A.1.3. Density District Naming Convention There are two categories of Density Districts, lot-limited and lot area-based. 1. ##### Lot-Limited Density Districts Lot-Limited Density District names include a number, which represents the maximum quantity of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s allowed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), followed by the letter "L." 2. ##### Lot Area-Based Density Districts With the exception of the "FA" and "N" Density Districts, Lot Area-Based Density District names are a number that represents how many hundreds of square feet of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) are required per [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). The FA Density District is an abbreviation for "Floor Area," indicating that [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is the only practical limit to density in this district and that the effective minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) per [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is zero square feet. The N Density District is an abbreviation for "Not Permitted," indicating that no [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s are allowed in this Density District. ### Div. 6A.2. General Rules #### Sec. 6A.2.1. Density This Article (Density) establishes [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), a mechanism that regulates the number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s permitted on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), otherwise known as density. Density Districts allow for a wide variety of zoning approaches to housing. #### Sec. 6A.2.2. Density Applicability 1. ##### General All [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s filed after the effective date of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall comply with the density standards in this Article (Density), as further specified in the applicability statement of each Section in [Part 6C. (Density Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C). For vested rights, see [Sec. 1.4.5. (Vested Rights)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.4.5), and for continuance of existing development, see [Sec. 1.4.6. (Continuance of Existing Development)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.4.6). 2. ##### Nonconformities [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) may provide relief from the requirements of this Article (Density) for existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) improvements, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s that conformed to the zoning regulations, at the time they were established, but do not conform to current district standards or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) permissions. All [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall conform with [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) standards unless otherwise specified by [Div. 12.7. (Nonconforming Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.7). #### Sec. 6A.2.3. Relationship to Use Districts 1. When [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s are permitted by a [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), the Density Districts in this Article (Density) establish limits on the number of allowed [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s. 2. Some [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) establish additional requirements for [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s in addition to those in this Article (Density). #### Sec. 6A.2.4. Relationship to Public Benefit Systems [Affordable housing incentive program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, outlined in [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9), offer a variety of methods to obtain additional density in excess of the limits established in this Article (Density) and the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) in exchange for different affordability levels and types of affordable housing. #### Sec. 6A.2.5. Relationship to Form Districts [Form Districts (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) do not directly limit density, but do establish requirements that may result in physical constraints that could impact the number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s that can be accommodated on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). ## Part 6B. Density Rules ### Div. 6C.1. Maximum Density #### Sec. 6C.1.1. Dwelling Units Per Lot The maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s allowed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 1. ##### Intent The intent of regulating the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s based on a fixed number per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is to provide a method to establish a specific maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, regardless of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. ##### Applicability [Dwelling units per lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) applies to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and is constructed in a Lot-Limited Density District . 3. ##### Standards 1. Regardless of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s is limited to the maximum [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) outlined in [Div. 6B.1 (Lot-Limited Density Districts) above](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B.1). 2. Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is large enough to be subdivided following the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) standards and the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) requirements in [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11), each new [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is entitled to the [dwelling units per lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) established by the applied Density District. 4. ##### Measurement 1. [Dwelling units per lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is measured as the cumulative number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 5. ##### Exceptions [Accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [junior accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, compliant with [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), are exempt from the density limit for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s having one or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s. 6. ##### Relief 1. An increase in the dwelling units per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3). #### Sec. 6C.1.2. Lot Area Per Household Dwelling Unit The maximum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s allowed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) based on [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 1. ##### Intent The intent of regulating the [lot area per household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is to provide a method that ensures there is a specified maximum ratio of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s in relation to the size of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. ##### Applicability [Lot area per household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) applies to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that includes [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s in a [Lot Area-Based Density District (Div. 6B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B.2). 3. ##### Standards The number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall not exceed the maximum established by the applied Density District in [Div. 6B.2. (Lot Area-Based Density Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B.2). 4. ##### Measurement 1. The maximum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s is calculated by dividing the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) by the [lot area per household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) value outlined in [Div. 6B.2. (Lot Area-Based Density Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B.2), and can be provided in combination with [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s where permitted, as calculated in [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area Per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3). 1. [Lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that has been committed to the minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) required per [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) cannot be counted toward the minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) required for an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. ###### Example: 1. A 5,000 square-foot [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) with a 10 Density District could have five [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, or three [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s plus four [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, or any combination that does not exceed the maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s permitted by the ratios. 2. If this same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) had five [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, it would not be able to add any [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, as the 5,000 square feet of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) would have been committed to the minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) required for the allowance of the five [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s. 2. For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s that are adjacent to one or more [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), the maximum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s may be calculated using the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) plus the area between the exterior [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and the centerline of the [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 3. Fractions of units do not count towards an additional [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), except as permitted in [Article 9. (Public Benefit Systems)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9). 4. When density is designated as "Limited by floor area", there is no maximum density. [Household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s are limited only by the physical constraints of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B). 5. When density is designated as "Not Permitted", [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s are not permitted. 5. ##### Exceptions [Accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [junior accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, that comply with [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5) are exempt from the density limit for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s having one or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s. 6. ##### Relief 1. A decrease in the minimum [lot area per household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) may be granted as a variance pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3). 2. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s that include multiple [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s with different applied [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), the transfer of density across the development site may be granted, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2). 1. ###### Supplemental Findings In addition to the findings in [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall also find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) meets the following conditions: 1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) meets the definition of [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. All [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s included in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) have [Commercial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) applied, or the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is located entirely in the Downtown Community Plan Area and all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s included in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) have [Residential-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), [Commercial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) applied. 3. Where any individual [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) exceeds the maximum density specified by the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s across all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s included in the [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall not exceed the sum of the maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s allowed across all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s as calculated based on the maximum density specified by each applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B). 2. ###### Supplemental Procedures If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) approves the density transfer, then prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), the property owner shall file with the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) a covenant running with the land that specifies the following obligations: 1. The operation and maintenance of the development as a [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is continued in perpetuity; 2. The density used and the remaining unbuilt density, if any, is allocated to each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#); 3. The unifying design elements are maintained and continued in perpetuity; and 4. The individual or entity responsible and accountable for compliance and the fee for the annual inspection of compliance by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), as required pursuant to [Sec. 15.3.12. (Annual Inspection of FAR Averaging & Density Transfer Covenants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.12). #### Sec. 6C.1.3.
