A decrease in the minimum [lot area per efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) may be granted as a variance in accordance with [Sec. 13B.5.3. (Variance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3). 2. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s that include multiple parcels having different applied [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), the transfer of density across the development site may be granted, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2). 1. ###### Supplemental Findings In addition to the findings in [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall also find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) meets the following conditions: 1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) meets the definition of [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. All [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s included in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) have [Commercial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) applied, or the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is located entirely in the Downtown Community Plan Area and all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s included in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) have [Residential-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), [Commercial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) applied. 3. Where any individual [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) exceeds the maximum density specified by the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s across all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s included in the [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall not exceed the sum of the maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s allowed across all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s as calculated based on the maximum density specified by each applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B). 2. ###### Supplemental Procedures If the Zoning Administrator approves a density transfer then, prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), the property owner shall file with the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) a covenant running with the land that specifies the following obligations: 1. The operation and maintenance of the development as a unified development is continued in perpetuity; 2. The density used and the remaining unbuilt density, if any, is allocated to each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#); 3. The unifying design elements are maintained and continued in perpetuity; and 4. The individual or entity responsible and accountable for compliance and the fee for the annual inspection of compliance by the Department of Building and Safety, as required pursuant to [Sec. 15.3.12. (Annual Inspection of FAR Averaging & Density Transfer Covenants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.12). ### Div. 6C.2. Minimum Density #### Sec. 6C.2.1. Minimum Dwelling Units Per Lot Area 1. ##### Intent The Minimum Dwelling Units per Lot Area standard is intended to implement State housing element law requirements for designated Lower Income Housing Element Rezoning Sites, and to advance the goals, policies, and objectives identified in the 2021-2029 Housing Element. 2. ##### Applicability 1. The Minimum Dwelling Units per Lot Area standard applies when a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) involves the following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#): [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. The minimum density rules in this Section (Minimum Dwelling Units Per Lot Area) apply to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) where Minimum Dwelling Units per Lot Area is listed in [Div. 6B.2. (Lot Area-Based Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B.2) as “Applicable”, “Market-Contingent”, or “As Mapped” by the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B). 3. ##### Standards 1. ###### Applicable Where the applied Density District specifies Minimum Dwelling Units per Lot Area as “Applicable” any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) must propose a minimum of one [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) per 2,000 square feet of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) area, which can be a combination of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s where permitted. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s provided as [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, pursuant to [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), count toward the required minimum density on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. ###### Market Contingent 1. Where the applied Density District specifies Minimum Density as “Market-Contingent,” any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that is located within a High or Medium High Residential Market Area as identified by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) resolution pursuant to [Sec. 15.4.3.C.1. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), must propose a minimum of one [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) per 2,000 square feet of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) area, which can be a combination of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s where permitted. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s provided as [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, pursuant to [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), count toward the required minimum density on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. Where the applied Density District specifies Minimum Density as “Market-Contingent,” any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that is located within a Low, Medium, or Not Applicable Market Area as identified by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) resolution pursuant to [Sec. 15.4.3.C.1. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), are not subject to any minimum density requirements, unless they are located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) mapped on the [Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.15.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15). If the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) mapped on the [Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.15.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) shall include a minimum density of 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s per acre, which may include a combination of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s where permitted. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s provided as [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, pursuant to [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), count toward the required minimum density on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 3. ###### As Mapped 1. Where the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) specifies Minimum Density as “As Mapped,” any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) mapped on the [Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.15.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15) shall include a minimum density of 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s per acre, which may include a combination of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s where permitted. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s provided as [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, pursuant to [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), count toward the required minimum density on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 2. Where the applied Density District specifies Minimum Density as “As Mapped,” any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that is not mapped on the [Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.15.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15) is not subject to any minimum density requirements. 4. ##### Measurement 1. The required minimum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s is calculated by dividing the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) by 2,000 square feet, and can be provided in combination with [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s where permitted, as calculated in [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3). [Lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that has been committed to the minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) required per [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) does not count toward the minimum [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) area required for an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). An [Accessory Dwelling Unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) counts toward the required minimum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s. 2. For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s that are adjacent to one or more [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, the minimum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s may be calculated using the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) plus the area between the exterior [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and the centerline of the [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). 3. If the minimum number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s is a fraction, the minimum density required shall be rounded up to the nearest unit. 4. When density is designated as "Not Permitted," [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s are not permitted. 5. ##### Exceptions A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that meets any of the following criteria is exempt from the minimum density requirement established in Subsection C. (Standards), above. However, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) or a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) located on the [Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.15.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15) is not subject to the exceptions listed below and must comply in all cases with the requirements of Subsection C. (Standards), above. 1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is limited to [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) of 1,500 square feet or less on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) with existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s, results in no increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s and involves no [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) of an existing [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#)(s); 2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) where the only new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) added on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is an [Accessory Dwelling Unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#)(s); 3. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) to reconstruct an existing [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) damaged by a disaster or deemed unsafe by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), and results in no increase to the amount of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) in the prior [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) s; 4. A development located on any of the environmentally sensitive sites specified in subparagraphs (B) to (K) of California Government Code Sec. 65913.4(a)(6), including a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), regardless of any mitigation; 5. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) listed in [Sec. 1.5.6. (Hillside Area Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.6), where at least 60 percent of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) is composed of slopes which are 30 percent or greater; 6. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that has an applied [Open Space Use District (Div. 5B.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.1) ; 7. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that contains a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#); or 8. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#) that cannot achieve the minimum density requirement due to any objective provision of this Code that physically precludes the construction of a development, as determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), or due to any provision of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#), or a [Community Plan Implementation Overlay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#). # Article 7. Alternate Typologies

## Part 7A. Introduction

### Div. 7A.1. Orientation

#### Sec. 7A.1.1. Relationship to Zone String

Alternative Typologies may be used on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s where all districts in the applied [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) are listed as eligible districts in the eligibility table of an Alternate Typology. An Alternate Typology either supersedes or defers to the standards of the underlying applied [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s as specified by the Alternate Typology.

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/7A.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=Poh__wyU)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/7A.1.1.1.png?itok=ohanmFHK)

#### Sec. 7A.1.2. How to Use Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)

1. ##### Determine Eligibility


Review each component in a [zone string](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) against the eligible districts for an Alternate Typology.

2. ##### Identify Standards


1. ###### Form Standards


      Outlined in Subsection D. (Form Standards) of each [Alternate Typology (Part 7B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B).

2. ###### Frontage Standards


      Outlined in Subsection E. (Frontage Standards) of each [Alternate Typology (Part 7B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B).

3. ###### Development Standards


      Outlined in Subsection F. (Development Standards) of each [Alternate Typology (Part 7B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B).

4. ###### Use Standards


      Outlined in Subsection G. (Use Standards) of each [Alternate Typology (Part 7B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B).

5. ###### Density Standards


      Outlined in Subsection H. (Density Standards) of each [Alternate Typology (Part 7B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B).
3. ##### Interpret Standards


Each standard in an Alternate Typology in [Part 7B. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B) provides a reference to [Part 7C. (Alternate Typology Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7C) where each standard is explained in detail.

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/7A.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=kv8_WF-6)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/7A.1.2.1.png?itok=o-76lnUy)


#### Sec. 7A.1.3. Alternate Typology Graphics

1. ##### General


1. Illustrations and graphics are included in [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) only to assist users in understanding the intent and requirements of the text. In the event a conflict occurs between the text of [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) and any illustration or graphic, the text prevails.

2. To interpret the Form standard graphics in [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) see [Sec. 2A.1.3. (Form District Diagrams)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2A.1.3).

3. To interpret the Frontage standard graphics in [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) see [Sec. 3A.1.3. (Frontage District Diagrams)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.1.3).

#### Sec. 7A.1.4. Alternate Typology Naming Convention

Alternate Typology names are composed of two components: a typology category and a variation number.

1. ##### Typology Category


The first component of each Alternate Typology name is a typology category. Typology categories group all typologies with similar allowed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s, characteristics, and intent. Typology categories are organized as follows:

1. Civic Institution

2. Corner Store

3. Small Lot Subdivision

4. Drive-Through

5. Fueling Station

6. Opportunity Corridors

7. Corridor Transitions
2. ##### Variation Number


The last component of each Alternate Typology name is a variation number. Alternate Typologies are numbered based on the order in which they were incorporated into this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).


### Div. 7A.2. General Rules

#### Sec. 7A.2.1. Alternate Typologies Intent

There are certain cases where the desired physical form for a specific type of development is prohibited by the zoning applied to a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#). In those cases, Alternate Typologies provide an option to override specific standards in the underlying zoning that may otherwise prohibit the desired form. In exchange for providing greater flexibility on particular standards, Alternate Typologies require adherence to other standards that promote the desired form and ensure that projects are contextually appropriate.

#### Sec. 7A.2.2. Alternate Typologies Applicability

1. ##### Eligibility


Alternate Typologies are only allowed in eligible districts. Each Alternate Typology provides an eligibility table that lists all [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s where the Alternate Typology is allowed. Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) within one of the eligible [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s may use the Alternate Typology. When an eligible district is listed with "\_", all variations of the district are eligible (for example, RN\_ includes RN1, RN2 and any other RN variation).

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/7A.2.2.1.png.webp?itok=P0U4Byk7)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/7A.2.2.1.png?itok=vELsGAAJ)

2. ##### Project Activities


1. Alternate Typology standards apply to [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) as shown in the applicability statements of each Section in [Part 2C. (Form Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C), [Part 3C. (General Frontage Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C), [Part 3D. (Character Frontage Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D), [Part 4C. (Development Standards Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C), [Part 5C. (Use Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C), and [Part 6C. (Density Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C). More than one [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) may apply to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) (for example, an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) may also include a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#)).

2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) applicability may also be modified by [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12).

3. [Project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) are defined in [Sec. 14.2.15. (Project Activities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.15).
3. ##### Applicable Components of Buildings & Lots


1. Alternate Typology regulations apply to all portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#).

2. Alternate Typology regulations apply to all portions of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#).

3. Specific Alternate Typology regulations may further limit which components of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s and [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s are required to comply with the rules in [Part 7C. (Alternate Typology Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7C).
4. ##### Nonconformities


1. [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) provides relief from the requirements of [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7) for existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s, [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) improvements, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s that conformed to the zoning regulations at the time they were established, but do not conform to current district standards or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) permissions. No proposed [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) using an Alternate Typology may decrease the conformance with any Form, Frontage, Development, Use, or Density standard in [Article 7. (Alternate Typologies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7), unless otherwise specified in [Div. 12.2. (Form Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.2), [Div. 12.3. (Frontage Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.3), [Div. 12.4. (Development Standards Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.4), [Div. 12.5. (Use Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5), or [Div. 12.6. (Density Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.6).

#### Sec. 7A.2.3. Relationship to Zoning Districts

1. Where a standard is listed in an Alternate Typology, the specification listed for each standard in the Alternate Typology supersedes the specification listed in the underlying [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s for the same standard.

2. The underlying [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) standard applies where an Alternate Typology:

1. Expressly defers to the underlying districts (for example, "Set by Form District");

2. Provides no specification for a standard listed by the underlying [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s; or

3. Does not list a standard that is listed by the underlying [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s.

#### Sec. 7A.2.4. Relationship to Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts

1. Alternate Typologies do not supersede the requirements of [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s.

2. [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#) s are not eligible to use Alternate Typologies.

# Article 8. Supplemental & Special Zoning

[faq](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)

## Div. 8.1. Specific Plans (SP)

### Sec. 8.1.1. General

1. ##### Intent


The intent of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is to provide additional regulatory controls or incentives beyond, or in-lieu of, those provided in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for the systematic implementation of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). This Division (Specific Plans (SP)) is intended to supplement any rules on the adoption or amendment of [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s in [Sec. 13B.1.2. (Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.2) and implementation of Specific Plans in [Div. 13B.4. (Specific Plan Implementation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4).

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Definition of Project


      The definition of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and the applicability of [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations are established in each [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

2. ###### Specific Plan Guidelines


      A [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may establish, or authorize the adoption of, guidelines in order to provide guidance for the implementation of the plan or for the review of projects seeking relief from the standards outlined in each [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

3. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      In the event that a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflicts with any provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail. In the event that a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is silent regarding any provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, the provisions of the Zoning Code shall apply.

4. ###### Violations


      The violation of any provision of an adopted [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or condition imposed by a decision-making body in approving the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) requirements, methods of operation, development plans or other actions taken in accordance with the authority contained in each [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and this Division (Specific Plans (SP)) shall constitute a violation of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.E. (Violations of Specific Plans)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4).

### Sec. 8.1.2. Specific Plan Standards

1. ##### Specific Plan Regulations


Regulations are established in each [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as a regulatory document outside of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

1. ###### Project Exception


      An applicant for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that cannot comply with the requirements of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may be granted relief, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.5. (Project Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5), subject to any limitations in the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

2. ###### Specific Plan Interpretation


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall interpret [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.6. (Specific Plan Interpretation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.6).

### Sec. 8.1.3. Procedures

1. ##### Establishing & Amending Specific Plans


[Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are established and amended by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.2. (Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.2), and are represented as part of the zone for any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subject to a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as provided in [Sec. 1.5.2.A.3. (Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2).

2. ##### Issuance of Building Permits


For any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subject to review under a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not issue a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) unless approved by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with the applicable procedures below:

1. ###### Administrative Review


      If administrative review is permitted by the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that complies with the applicable regulations in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be approved in accordance with [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

2. ###### Project Compliance


      If review and consideration by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) for compliance with the applicable regulations and guidelines in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is required by the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be approved in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.2. (Project Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.2).

3. ###### Project Compliance (Design Review Board)


      If review and consideration by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), with recommendation from a Design Review Board, for compliance with the applicable regulations and guidelines in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is required by the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be approved in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.3. (Project Compliance (Design Review Board))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.3).

4. ###### Project Adjustment


      An applicant for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that cannot comply with the requirements of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may be granted relief, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.4. (Project Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.4), subject to any limitations in the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).
