## Div. 8.2. Supplemental Districts

### Sec. 8.2.1. General

1. ##### Intent


The zoning system established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) provides responsive zoning solutions to a wide variety of policy objectives. However, some policies are difficult to express through the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s alone and are better addressed through topic-specific or geographic-specific regulations. The [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s established in this Division (Supplemental Districts)are intended to provide additional regulations that build upon and enhance the regulations applied through [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


The adoption, amendment, and implementation of [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s in this Division (Supplemental Districts) shall be subject to the following unless provided otherwise in the particular [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) provisions:

1. ###### Establishing Supplemental Districts


      New [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are established, and the enabling provisions are amended by, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3). [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are applied to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s as outlined in each district, and are represented as part of the third bracket set of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s zone string, as outlined in [Sec. 1.5.2.A.3. (Specific Plans & Supplemental Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2), with the acronym established for each district.

2. ###### Limitations on Supplemental Districts


      The [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s established in this Division (Supplemental Districts) shall not supersede any provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), unless otherwise specified by the Zoning Code, with the following the following exceptions:

      1. [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s may establish defined terms and definitions that supersede the defined terms and definitions established in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3). Where the definitions within a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with those of [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), the definitions within the [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail.

      2. When a provision of a Sign District or the Transportation Communication Network (TCN) District conflicts with the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations established by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), the provisions in the Sign District or the TCN District supersedes the [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) regulation.
3. ###### Definition of Project


      The definition of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and the applicability of [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations are established in each [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) based on the applicable [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

4. ###### Supplemental District Guidelines


      A [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may establish, or authorize its adoption of, guidelines in order to provide guidance for the implementation of a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or for the review of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s seeking relief from the standards outlined in each [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

5. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      The enabling language of each [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall establish direction regarding potential conflicts with any provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), other [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

6. ###### Issuance of Building Permits


      The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not issue a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) unless approved by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with the applicable procedures identified in each [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), unless otherwise stated in the [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

7. ###### Violations


      The violation of any provision of a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or condition imposed by a decision-making body in approving the [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) requirements, methods of operation, development plans or other actions taken in accordance with the authority contained in this Division (Supplemental Districts) shall constitute a violation of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 8.2.2. Community Plan Implementation Overlay (CPIO)

1. ##### Intent


A [Community Plan Implementation Overlay](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) (CPIO) is a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) intended to provide supplemental regulations tailored to a community plan area. A [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is intended to:

1. Ensure that development enhances the unique architectural, environmental, and cultural qualities of the community plan area.

2. Integrate improvements and enhancements to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

3. Maintain compatible land [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, scale, intensity, and density.
2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Definition of Project


      The definition of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and the applicability of a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is established in the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). The [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may define the term [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) differently for each subarea within the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), but the definition shall utilize and be consistent with the [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) established in [Sec. 14.2.15. (Project Activities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.15).

2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Zoning Code Provisions


         In the event that the provisions of a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of the Zoning Code shall prevail, unless otherwise specified by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), with the exception of defined terms and definitions in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3). If the defined terms or definitions within a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with those of [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), those of the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail, except when defining a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in a CPIO, [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be consistent with, and defined by, the list and definitions of [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) pursuant to Paragraph 1. (Definition of Project) above.

      2. ###### Other Supplemental Districts


         In the event that the provisions of a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with provisions of another [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the more restrictive provision shall prevail, except that where the provisions of a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with those of a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or the Transportation Communication Network District, then the provisions of the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or the Transportation Communication Network District shall prevail.

      3. ###### Specific Plans


         Where the provisions of a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with those of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), then the provisions of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail.
3. ##### District Standards


Each [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall contain the following:

1. ###### Subarea Boundaries


      A map showing all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s within the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s subarea(s).

2. ###### District Regulations


      [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations and definitions that for some or all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and/or the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), within the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s subarea(s).
4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Establishing a CPIO


      [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations and boundaries are established and amended in accordance with [Sec. 13.B.1.2. (Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13), and are represented as part of the third bracket set of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s zone with the acronym “CPIO.”

      1. ###### Boundaries


         A [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall share the boundaries of the Community Plan. Subarea boundaries shall be defined at the time the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is established.

      2. ###### CPIO Subareas


         A [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall include one or more defined subareas within which community plan programs and policies are implemented through additional regulations. Subareas may be contiguous or non-contiguous [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s characterized by common community plan goals, themes, and policies, grouped by a common boundary.

      3. ###### Minimum Area


         Each [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall have a minimum of one mapped subarea.
2. ###### Issuance of Permits


      For all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s within a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subarea, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not issue a [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of land, [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit unless approved by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with the applicable procedures below. Work that is not considered a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or is otherwise exempt, by the applied [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is not subject to the procedures below. The rules below apply to the review and approval of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s in the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

      1. ###### Administrative Review


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that complies with the applicable provisions of an adopted [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may be approved in accordance with [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1). [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) applicants which do not comply with the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations may request relief through the procedures in Subparagraph b. (Project Adjustment) and Subparagraph c. (Project Exception) below.

      2. ###### Project Adjustment


         Applicants may request relief of 20 percent or less from the quantitative district regulations or minor adjustments from the qualitative district regulations in an adopted [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subarea, unless otherwise limited by a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subarea, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.4. (Project Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.4), subject to the following limitations and supplemental finding:

         1. ###### Limitations


            1. A [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall indicate district regulations which are not eligible for a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). If an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) request includes more than one [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may require that the applicant, prior to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) being deemed complete, file the requests as a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.5. (Project Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5).

            2. To the extent that a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) contains [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations, [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall not qualify for relief through a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

            3. All other [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s seeking relief from any district regulation that contains prohibition language, or district regulations otherwise designated in the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as not eligible for a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), shall be processed through the [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) procedure below.
         2. ###### Supplemental Finding


            In addition to the findings set forth in [Sec. 13B.4.4. (Project Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.4), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on appeal, shall also find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is compatible with the neighborhood character of the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subarea.
      3. ###### Project Exception


         Unless stated otherwise in the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), if a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) cannot comply with the requirements of a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the City may grant an exception in accordance with [Sec. 13B.4.5. (Project Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5), subject to the following limitations and supplemental findings:

         1. ###### Limitations


            An exception from a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulation shall not be used to grant a special privilege, nor to grant relief from self-imposed hardships.

         2. ###### Supplemental Findings


            In addition to the findings set forth in [Sec. 13B.4.5. (Project Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) , or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on appeal, may grant a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) from a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulation concerning [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s if the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) also makes all the following findings:

            1. Strict compliance would result in practical difficulty or unnecessary hardship inconsistent with the intent of the zoning restrictions due to unique existing physical circumstances on the subject property;

            2. An exception from the district regulation is necessary for the preservation and enjoyment of a substantial property right or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) generally possessed by other properties within the same [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) district or subarea, the same zone, and the vicinity, but which because of special circumstances and practical difficulties or unnecessary hardships is denied to the property in question;

            3. The exception would not constitute a special grant of privilege.

### Sec. 8.2.3. Sign Districts (SN)

1. ##### Intent


A Sign District is a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) intended to identify areas of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) with unique characteristics for enhancement through the imposition of special [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations designed to reinforce the theme or unique qualities of that district, or which eliminate blight through a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) reduction program.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Definition of Project


      A Sign District project involves the erection, construction, addition to, or exterior structural modification of any sign located within a Sign District, and is subject to the regulations outlined in the Sign District in which it is located, in accordance with the adopted Sign District standards.

2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      In the event that the provisions of a Sign District conflict with any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or Supplemental District, the Sign District shall prevail, except that where the provisions of a Sign District conflict with those of the Transportation Communication Network (TCN) District, then the provisions of the Transportation Communication Network (TCN) District shall prevail. However, the standards for a Sign District do not supersede the regulations of a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), any zoning regulation implementing or relied on in an approved Development Agreement, or any standard not regulating signs. In the event that the provisions of a Sign District conflict with any provisions of an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) the provisions of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail.
3. ##### District Standards


The Sign District standards shall be determined at the time the district is established. The [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations shall enhance the character of the district by addressing the location, number, square footage, height, light illumination, hours of illumination, [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) reduction program, duration of signs, design and types of signs permitted, as well as other characteristics, and may include murals, [supergraphic sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and other [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s and [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

1. ###### Definitions


      Definitions shall be consistent with [Div. 4C.11. (Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11). Terms that are not defined in [Div. 4C.11. (Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11) may be defined in a Sign District.
4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Establishing a Sign District


      Sign District standards and boundaries are established and amended in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4), and are represented as part of the third bracket set of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s zone string with the acronym “SN.”

      1. ###### Applicable Zones


         Each Sign District shall include only properties in the [Commercial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7), except that properties in [Residential Use Districts (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) or [Residential-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4) with a [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of 2 or FA may be included in a Sign District, provided the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are designated as part of a Regional Center in the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) Land Use Map.

      2. ###### Minimum Area


         No Sign District shall contain less than one block or three acres in area, whichever is the smaller. The total acreage in the Sign District shall include contiguous [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s of land which shall only be separated by public streets, ways or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, or other physical features, or as set forth in Sign District rules approved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). Precise boundaries are required at the time of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) for initiation of an individual Sign District.
2. ###### Issuance of Permits


      The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall approve and issue sign permits for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) within a Sign District that conforms to the applicable Sign District standards.

3. ###### Review of Projects


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be reviewed in conformance with the procedures established in each Sign District.

### Sec. 8.2.4. Oil Drilling Districts (O)

1. ##### Intent


Oil Drilling (O) Districts establish standards and procedures for [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s in areas in the City where oil drilling and related operations were permitted, conditionally or otherwise, prior to January 18, 2023, the effective date of [Ord. No. 187, 709](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf), which deems all [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s to be [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General Applicability


      The provisions of this Section (Oil Drilling Districts(O)) shall apply to the Supplemental Districts established by ordinance and to remain until said district is terminated in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3).The provisions of this Section (Oil Drilling Districts(O)) do not apply to the location of subterranean gas holding areas or [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s that are operated as a public utility regulated by the California Public Utilities Commission.

2. ###### Oil Drilling Area Types


      Each district shall be determined to be in one of the following oil drilling area types using the corresponding criteria: The standards and requirements of each [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) depend on the oil drilling area type in which the district is located.

      1. ###### Non-Urbanized Area


         All those portions of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) which the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) has determined will not be detrimentally affected by the drilling, maintenance, or operation of [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s. In making its determination, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on appeal, shall give due consideration to the amount of land subdivided, the physical improvements, the density of population, and the zoning of the district.

      2. ###### Urbanized Area


         All land in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), except land in the Heavy Industrial 1 Use District, and land which has been determined to be [non-urbanized area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or land located in the [Los Angeles City Oil Field Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) (as identified below).

      3. ###### Los Angeles City Oil Field Area


         All land in the City within the areas identified on the maps in [Ord. No. 156,166](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/1980/80-3951_ORD_156166_12-08-1981.pdf) located in [Council File No. 80-3951](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/lacityclerkconnect/index.cfm?fa=ccfi.viewrecord&cfnumber=80-3951), and shall include all oil producing zones beneath those areas, but no deeper than the third zone beneath the surface of the earth.
3. ##### District Standards


The following standard conditions apply to [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s to the extent that they are incorporated by ordinance through the establishment of an [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prior to January 18, 2023, the effective date of [Ord. No. 187, 709](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf).

1. ###### Standard Conditions


      1. ###### Non-Urbanized Areas


         Each [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) established in a [non-urbanized area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be subject to the following conditions:

         1. Each district shall contain a net area of one acre or more which shall be composed of contiguous lots that may be separated by an alley or walk, except that a district may contain an area of less than one acre where it is surrounded on all sides by streets.

         2. Each drilling site in any district shall contain a net area of one acre or more, and shall be composed of contiguous lots which may be separated only by an alley or walk. A drilling site may contain less than one acre of area where it is surrounded on all sides by public or approved private streets.

         3. Only one [oil well Class I or A](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may be established or maintained on each acre of land, except that there may be one [oil well Class I or A](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on any land surrounded on all sides by public or approved private streets. Provided, however, in determining conditions for drilling, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may permit surface operations for more than one [oil well Class I or A](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in a semi- [controlled drilling site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) where the additional wells are to be bottomed under adjacent land in a drilling district in lieu of surface operations. There shall be no less than one net acre of land in the combined drill site and production site for each well in a semi- [controlled drilling site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall require a site of more than one acre for each well associated with an [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) where a larger area is required in the particular [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may require larger minimum drilling sites or production areas when reasonably necessary in the public interest for a particular oil producing section.

         4. Where drilling sites greater than one acre are required, and two or more lessees or oil drilling developers in a block or area have at least 1 net acre each, but all lessees or developers do not have the greater area required for drilling under these regulations, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall equitably allocate permitted wells among the competing lessees or developers. Where necessary, the lessee or developer having control of the larger portion of the property shall be given preference. In those situations outlined above, in addition to the proration required by Sub-subparagraph iv., below, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall require that the lessee or developer who is authorized to drill the well shall offer an equitable consolidation agreement to the lessee or developer who has not been permitted to drill. This consolidation agreement shall contain an offer in writing, open for acceptance for 30 days, giving the other lessees or developers a choice of either:

            1. A lease on terms and conditions agreed upon, or on substantially the same terms and conditions contained in leases owned by the applicant; or

            2. A consolidation agreement agreed upon providing that each lessee or developer shall contribute to the cost of drilling and operation of the well and share in the production from the well in the proportion that the area of their property bears to the total area in the drilling unit.
         5. No public street, alley, walk, or way shall be included in determining the net area within any district or drilling site.

         6. Where the drilling site is so located as to isolate any lot in the [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in such a manner that it could not be joined with any other land so as to create another drilling site of the area required in the particular district in which it is located, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall require, as a condition to the drilling and production on the drilling site, that the owner, lessee or permittee, or their successor, shall pay to the owners of the oil and gas mineral rights in each isolated lot, a pro-rata share of the landowners’ royalty in all of the oil and gas produced from the drilling site, the share to be in that proportion as the net area of the isolated lot is to the total net area of the drilling site, plus the area of all the isolated lots; provided that the landowners’ royalty shall be determined in accordance with any existing contracts for payments to the landowners of the drilling site, but, in no event, as to the owner of the isolated lot or lots, shall it be less than a 1/6th part of the oil and gas produced and saved from the drilling site.
      2. ###### Urbanized Areas


         Each [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) established in an [urbanized area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be subject to the following conditions:

         01. Each district shall be not less than 40 acres in area, including all streets, ways, and [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s within the boundaries thereof.

         02. No more than one controlled drill site shall be permitted for each 40 acres in any district, and that site shall not be larger than two acres when used to develop a district approximating the minimum size; provided, however, that where the site is to be used for the development of larger [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or where the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) requires that more than one [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) be developed from one [controlled drilling site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the site may be increased, at the discretion of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) when concurred in by the Board of Fire Commissioners, by no more than two acres for each 40 acres included in the district or districts.

         03. The number of oil wells Class I or A which may be drilled and operated from any [controlled drilling site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may not exceed one well to each five acres in the district or districts to be explored from said site.

         04. Notwithstanding the above, should the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) determine that an Urbanized [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) contains more than one producing zone, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may then authorize, by ordinance, the drilling of additional oil wells Class I or A, not to exceed one well per five acres for each identified producing zone, and specify the maximum number of wells to be drilled as the result of such authorization.

         05. Each applicant, requesting a determination by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prescribing the conditions controlling drilling and production operations, shall have proprietary or contractual authority to drill for oil under the surface of at least 75 percent of the property in the district to be explored.

         06. Each applicant, or the applicant’s successor in interest, shall, within one year from the date the written determination is made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prescribing the conditions controlling drilling and production operations as provided in, execute an offer in writing giving to each record owner of property located in the [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) who has not joined in the lease or other authorization to drill, the right to share in the proceeds of production from wells bottomed in the district, upon the same basis as those property owners who have, by lease or other legal consent, agreed to the drilling for and production of oil, gas, or other hydrocarbon substances from the subsurface of the district. The offer hereby required shall remain open for acceptance for a period of five years after the date the written determination is made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). During the period the offer is in effect, the applicant, or the applicant’s successor in interest, shall impound all royalties to which the owners or any of them may become entitled in a bank or trust company in the State of California, with proper provisions for payment to the record owners of property in the district who had not signed the lease at the time the written provisions were made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), but who accepts the offer in writing within the 5-year period. Any such royalties remaining in any bank or trust company at the time the offer expires, which are not due or payable as provided above, shall be paid pro-rata to those owners who, at the time of the expiration, are otherwise entitled to share in the proceeds of the production.

         07. The entire [controlled drilling site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be adequately landscaped, except for those portions occupied by any required structure, appurtenance or driveway, and all landscaping shall be maintained in good condition at all times. Plans showing the type and extent of the landscaping shall be first submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

         08. Each applicant requesting a determination by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prescribing the conditions controlling drilling and production operations, shall post in the Office of Zoning Administration a satisfactory corporate surety bond (to be approved by the City Attorney and duplicates to be furnished to the City Attorney) in the sum of $5,000 in favor of the City of Los Angeles, conditioned upon the performance by the applicant of all of the conditions, provisions, restrictions, and requirements of this Section, and all additional conditions, restrictions or requirements determined and prescribed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). No extension of time that may be granted by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or any change of specifications or requirements that may be approved or required by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or by any other officer or department of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or any other alteration, modification or waiver affecting any of the obligations of the grantee made by any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) authority or by any other power or authority whatsoever, shall be deemed to exonerate either the grantee or the surety on any bond posted in accordance with this Section.

         09. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) determines, after first receiving a report and recommendation from the Board of Public Works or its designee, that oil drilling and production activities within the district have caused or may cause subsidence in the elevation of the ground within the district or in the immediate vicinity, then after consulting with recognized experts in connection with that problem and with those producing hydrocarbons from the affected area, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall have the authority to require the involved oil producer or producers to take corrective action, including re-pressurizing the oil producing structure or cessation of oil drilling and production.

         10. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may impose additional conditions or require corrective measures to be taken if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) finds, after actual observation or experience with drilling one or more of the wells in the district, that additional conditions are necessary to afford greater protection to surrounding property.
      3. ###### Los Angeles City Oil Field Area


         Each [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) established in the [Los Angeles City Oil Field Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be subject to the following conditions:

         01. The boundary of each district shall follow the center line of [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) streets as far as practicable;

         02. Each district shall include the streets, ways, and alleys within the boundaries thereof and shall be substantially compact in area;

         03. The drilling, pumping, redrilling, repairing, maintenance or other servicing of any new [oil well Class I or A](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in said district shall be conducted only on a Drilling and Production Site in the [Los Angeles City Oil Field Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) upon which site at least one [oil well Class I or A](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#):

             1. Was in existence on January 24, 1982; and

             2. Had not been abandoned in accordance with State Division of Oil and Gas regulations prior to January 24, 1982; and

             3. Has a Los Angeles Fire Department Serial Number, which number was in existence on January 24, 1982.
         04. The number of new oil wells Class I or A permitted on such a Drilling and Production Site in the [Los Angeles City Oil Field Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not exceed one well to each acre in the District;

         05. Each applicant, requesting a determination by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prescribing the conditions controlling new drilling and production operations, shall have proprietary or contractual authority to drill for oil under the surface of at least 75 percent of the total land area of the property in the district to be explored.

         06. Within one year from the date the written determination is made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prescribing the conditions controlling drilling and production operations, each applicant or the applicant’s or her successor in interest shall offer in writing to each record owner of property located in the [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) who has not joined in the lease or other authorization to drill, the right to share in proceeds of production from new wells bottomed in the district upon the same basis as those property owners who have, by lease or other legal consent, agreed to the drilling for and production of oil, gas or other hydrocarbon substances from the sub-surface of the district. The offer hereby required shall remain open for acceptance for a period of five years after the date the written determination is made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). During the period the offer is in effect, the applicant, or his or her successor in interest, shall impound all royalties to which the owners or any of them may become entitled in a bank or trust company in the State of California, with proper provisions for payment to the record owners of property in the district who had not signed the lease at the time the written determination was made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), but who accepts the offer in writing within the five-year period. Any royalties remaining in any bank or trust company at the time the offer expires which are not due or payable as provided above shall be paid pro-rata to those owners who, at the time of the expiration, are otherwise entitled to share in the proceeds of the production.

         07. The entire site upon which new [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are to be drilled shall be adequately fenced and landscaped; plans showing the type and extent of the landscaping shall be first submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

         08. Each applicant requesting a determination by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) prescribing the conditions controlling drilling and production operations, as provided in, shall post in the Office of Zoning Administration a satisfactory corporate surety bond (to be approved by the City Attorney, and duplicates to be furnished by the City Attorney) in the sum of $5,000 in favor of the City of Los Angeles, conditioned upon the performance by the applicant of all of the conditions, provisions, restrictions, and requirements of this section, and all additional conditions, restrictions, or requirements determined and prescribed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). No extension of time that may be granted by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or any change of specifications or requirements that may be approved or required by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or by any other officer or department of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or any other alteration, modification or waiver affecting any of the obligations of the grantee made by any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) authority or by any other power or authority whatsoever shall be deemed to exonerate either the grantee or the surety of any bond posted in accordance with this section.

         09. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) determined, after first receiving a report and recommendation from the Board of Public Works or its designee, that oil drilling and production activities within the district have caused or may cause subsidence in the elevation of the ground within the district or in the immediate vicinity, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall have the authority, after consulting with recognized experts in connection with the problem and with those persons producing hydrocarbons from the affected area, to require the involved oil producer or producers to take corrective action, including re-pressurizing the oil producing structure or cessation of oil drilling and production.

         10. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may impose additional conditions or require corrective measures to be taken if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) finds, after actual observation or experience with drilling one or more of the wells in the district, that additional conditions are necessary to afford greater protection to surrounding property.
2. ###### Additional Conditions


      1. In addition to the standard conditions applying to [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), by ordinance, or the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may have imposed other conditions in each district as deemed necessary and proper. These Additional Conditions remain to the extent that they were incorporated by reference in an ordinance or into approvals issued by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or other decision maker prior to January 18, 2023, the effective date of [Ord. No. 187, 709](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf). Some of these additional conditions, which may have been imposed in the ordinance establishing the districts or by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in determining the drilling site requirements, and which may have been applied by reference, are as follows:

         01. That all pumping units established in the subject district(s) shall be installed in pits so that no parts thereof shall be above the surface of the ground. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.1.\]

         02. That all oil produced in the subject district shall be carried away by pipe lines or, if stored in said district, shall be stored in underground tanks so constructed that no portion thereof shall be above the surface of the ground. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.2.\]

         03. That the operator of any well or wells in the subject district(s) shall post in the Office of Zoning Administration a $5,000 corporate surety bond conditioned upon the faithful performance of all provisions of this Article (Supplemental & Special Zoning) and any conditions prescribed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). No extension of time that may be granted by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or change of specifications or requirements that may be approved or required by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or by any other officer or department of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or other alteration, modification or waiver affecting any of the obligations of the grantee made by any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) authority shall be deemed to exonerate either the grantee or the surety on any bond posted as required in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.3.\]

         04. That the operators shall remove the drilling rig from each well within 30 days after the drilling of said well has been completed, and thereafter, when necessary, such completed wells shall be serviced by portable drilling rigs. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.4.\]

         05. That the drilling site shall be fenced or landscaped as prescribed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.5.\]

         06. That, except in case of emergency, no materials, equipment, tools or pipe used for either drilling or production operations shall be delivered to or removed from the drilling site, except between the hours of 8:00 A.M. and 8:00 P.M. of any day. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.7.\]

         07. That adequate fire fighting apparatus and supplies, approved by the Fire Department, shall be maintained on the drilling site at all times during drilling and production operations. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.8.\].

         08. That no refining process or any process for the extraction of products from natural gas shall be carried on at a drilling site. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.9.\]

         09. That no more than one well shall be bottomed in each five acres of the [Oil Drilling District (O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.13.\]

         10. That no new wells associated with [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall be spudded in after the President of the United States, or other proper authority, has declared that a state of war no longer exists. \[Editor’s note: Formerly Chapter 1, Section 13.01.F.14.\]
