### Sec. 8.2.5. Community Design Overlay (CDO)

1. ##### Intent


This Section (Community Design Overlay (CDO)) provides a method for maintaining guidelines and standards in existing Community Design Overlays ( [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s) that were established prior to January 1, 2020. The intent of the [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), to:

1. Ensure that development within communities is in accordance with community design policies adopted in the community plans, and with the community design guidelines and standards;

2. Promote the distinctive character, stability, and visual quality of existing neighborhoods and communities by considering the unique architectural character and environmental setting of the district to ensure development visually provides a sense of place;

3. Assist in improving the visual attractiveness of multi-unit housing available to meet the needs of all social and economic groups within the community;

4. Protect areas of natural scenic beauty, cultural or environmental interest;

5. Prevent the development of [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s which are not of acceptable exterior design or appearance;

6. Protect the integrity of previously attained entitlements; and

7. Provide for on-going community involvement in [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) design and evolution of guidelines.
2. ##### Applicability


The following definitions and regulations shall apply to the implementation of [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s:

1. ###### Definition of Project


      Project is defined as the erection, construction, [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) to, or exterior structural modification of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), including, but not limited to, [pole sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or [monument sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s located in a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) does not include construction that consists solely of:

      1. Interior remodeling, interior rehabilitation or repair work;

      2. Modifications of, including structural repairs, or [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s to any [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or structure in which the aggregate value of the work, in any one 24-month period, is less than 50 percent of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s replacement value before the modifications or [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, as determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), unless the modifications or [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are to any [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) a public street; or

      3. A [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) which is developed entirely as a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and consists of four or fewer [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, unless expressly provided for in a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) established in accordance with this Section (Community Design Overlay (CDO)).
2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Zoning Code Provisions


         In the event that the provisions of a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with any other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of the Zoning Code shall prevail, unless otherwise specified by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), with the exception of defined terms and definitions in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3). If the defined terms or definitions within a CDO conflict with those of [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), those of the CDO shall prevail.

      2. ###### Other Supplemental Districts


         In the event that the provisions of a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with provisions of another [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the more restrictive provision shall prevail, except that where the provisions of a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with those of a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or the Transportation Communication Network District, then the provisions of the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or the Transportation Communication Network District shall prevail.

      3. ###### Specific Plans


         Where the provisions of a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with those of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), then the provisions of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail.

      4. ###### Previously Granted Entitlements


         Nothing in the guidelines and standards established in a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall interfere with any previously granted entitlements, nor shall they restrict any right authorized in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
3. ##### District Standards


[CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) guidelines and standards shall be based on the design policies contained in the applicable community plan. The guidelines and standards shall be organized into those which are anticipated to be superseded by future citywide guidelines and standards, and those that are necessary to protect the unique architectural and environmental features of the [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Maintaining an Existing CDO


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may amend an existing [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.5. (Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.5), and as represented by the acronym “CDO” as part of the third bracket set of the zone of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). However, the [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not be amended to expand the existing boundaries or establish new guidelines and standards.

2. ###### Boundaries


      The [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not be amended in a way that expands its existing boundaries. A [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not encompass an area designated as an [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with [Sec. 8.2.6. (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.2.6).

3. ###### Issuance of Permits


      No [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit shall be issued for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) subject to a [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), and no [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall perform any construction work on a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), until the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) has been submitted and approved in accordance with Paragraph 4. (Director Determination) below. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall do any construction work on a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) except in conformance with the approved [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) Determination.

4. ###### Director Determination


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall approve a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) with conditions if necessary if the plans comply with the provisions of approved [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) guidelines and standards in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5).

      1. ###### Supplemental Findings


         In addition to the findings established in [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on appeal, shall approve a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as requested or in modified form if, based on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and the evidence submitted, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) finds the following:

         1. That the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) substantially complies with the adopted [CDO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) guidelines and standards.

         2. The [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) plan and [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) are harmonious in scale and design with existing development and any cultural, scenic or environmental resources adjacent to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and in the vicinity.
      2. ###### Notice of Director’s Determination


         Instead of the transmittal requirements in [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), a notice of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s determination, and copies of the approved plans, shall be mailed to the applicant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the Councilmember in whose City Council District the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is located, the Citizen Advisory Committee, and any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or organizations commenting on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or requesting a notice.

### Sec. 8.2.6. Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ)

1. ##### Intent


1. As a matter of public policy, the recognition, preservation, enhancement, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and areas within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) having [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), architectural, cultural or aesthetic significance are required in the interest of the health, economic prosperity, cultural enrichment, and general welfare of the people. The intent of the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is to establish a local historic district tool that:

      1. Protects and enhances the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and areas, which are reminders of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s history, or which are unique and irreplaceable assets to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and its neighborhoods, or which are worthy examples of past architectural styles;

      2. Develops and maintains the appropriate settings and environment to preserve these [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and areas;

      3. Enhances property values, stabilizes neighborhoods or communities, renders property eligible for financial benefits, and promotes tourist trade and interest;

      4. Fosters public appreciation of the beauty of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), of the accomplishments of its past as reflected through its [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and areas;

      5. Promotes education by preserving and encouraging interest in cultural, social, economic, political, and architectural phases of its history;

      6. Promotes the involvement of all aspects of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s diverse neighborhoods in the historic preservation process; and

      7. Ensures that all procedures comply with the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).
2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Definition of Project


      For the purposes of this Section and regardless of the definition in [Article 14 (General Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14), project is the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), construction, [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), relocation, removal or [restoration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of the exterior of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), within a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), except as provided under Paragraph 2. (Exemptions) below. A project may or may not require a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit, and may include but not be limited to changing exterior paint color, removal of [significant tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), installation or removal of fencing, replacement of [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or doors which are character-defining features of architectural styles, removal of features, or changes to public spaces and similar activities.

2. ###### Exemptions


      This Section (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ)) does not apply to the following:

      1. ###### Emergency or Hazardous Conditions


         The correction of emergency or hazardous conditions where the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), Los Angeles Housing Department, or other enforcement agency has determined that emergency or hazardous conditions currently exist and the emergency or hazardous conditions must be corrected in the interest of the public health, safety, and welfare. When feasible, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), Los Angeles Housing Department, or other enforcement agency should consult with the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on how to correct the hazardous condition, consistent with the goals of the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). However, any other work shall comply with the provisions of this Section (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ)).

      2. ###### Department of Public Works Improvements


         Department of Public Works improvements located, in whole or in part, within a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#):

         1. Where the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) finds:

            1. That the certified [historic resources survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) for the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) does not identify any [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s located within the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or where the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is not specifically addressed in the approved Preservation Plan for the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#); and

            2. Where the Department of Public Works has completed the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) review of the proposed improvement, and the review has determined that the improvement is exempt from [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or will have no potentially significant environmental impacts on the HPOZ.
         2. The relevant Historic Preservation Board shall be notified of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), given a description of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), and an opportunity to comment.
      3. ###### Historical Property Contracts


         Where work is authorized by an approved [historical property contract](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) has been designated as a [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), unless proposed for [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). However, those properties with federal or state historic designation which are not designated as [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or do not have a [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [historical property contract](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) are not exempt from review under this Section (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ)).

      4. ###### Structural Repairs


         Where work consists of repairs to existing structural elements and foundations with no physical change to the exterior of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

      5. ###### Interior Modifications


         Where work consists of [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) modifications that do not result in a change to an exterior feature.

      6. ###### Preservation Plan Exemptions


         Where the type of work has been specifically deemed exempt from review as set forth in the approved Preservation Plan for a specific [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).
3. ###### Authority of Cultural Heritage Commission not Affected


      Nothing in this Section (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ)) supersedes or overrides the Cultural Heritage Commission’s authority as provided in [Sec. 22.171, et seq.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-48551) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

4. ###### Publicly Owned Property


      The provisions of this Section (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ)) shall apply to any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) within a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) which is owned or leased by a public entity to the extent permitted by law.
3. ##### District Standards


1. ###### Preservation Plans


      District Standards are established in each specific [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s as a Preservation Plan adopted in accordance with [Sec. 13B.8.3. (Preservation Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.3).
4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Establishing an HPOZ


      Historic Preservation Overlay Zone regulations, Preservation Plans, and boundaries are established and amended in accordance with [Div. 13B.8. (Historic Preservation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8), and are represented as part of the third bracket set of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s zone string with the acronym “HPOZ.”

2. ###### Review of Projects


      [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s in [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall be reviewed in accordance with [Div. 13B.8. (Historic Preservation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8).

### Sec. 8.2.7. Conservation Districts (CD)

1. ##### Intent


The Conservation District is a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) intended to maintain areas of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that are listed in an [historic resources survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as eligible to be [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and assure that individual [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s retain sufficient integrity to help ensure their eligibility for future designation. A Conservation District is not an [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) designation, but rather a series of standards and additional review that provide protection beyond that afforded by [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s alone. Conservation Districts are an additional tool to complement existing historic designations, thus filling a void left by other existing tools.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Definition of Project


      For the purposes of this Section (Conservation Districts), and regardless of the definition in [Article 14 (General Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14), a project is any [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [facade modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or maintenance & repair of the exterior of any [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that is located within a Conservation District, regardless of whether a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit is required or not.

2. ###### Scope of District Standards


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be subject to standards in Subsection C. (District Standards) below for [facade modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s to primary and secondary [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s of [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, to the peak of the highest roof ridge or 15-foot depth, whichever is greater. Conservation District standards do not apply to [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

3. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Zoning Code Provisions


         In the event that the provisions of a Conservation District conflict with any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of the Zoning Code shall prevail, unless otherwise specified by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), with the exception of defined terms and definitions in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3). If the defined terms or definitions within a Conservation District conflict with those of [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), those of the Conservation District shall prevail.

      2. ###### Other Supplemental Districts


         In the event that the provisions of a Conservation District conflict with provisions of another [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the more restrictive provision shall prevail.

      3. ###### Specific Plans


         Where the provisions of a Conservation District conflict with those of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the provisions of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail.
3. ##### District Standards


1. ###### Modification and Replacement of Architectural Elements


      1. Deteriorated historic [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall be repaired rather than replaced. If deteriorated historic [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s cannot be repaired, replacements shall match the original in size, shape, scale, materials, finish, texture, detail, arrangement of panes, hardware, method of construction, and profile.

      2. When original [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s have been lost and are being replaced, replacement designs shall be based on available historic evidence. If a similar [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) exists on the existing [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the replacement [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall match the original in material, texture, size, or scale. If no such evidence or [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) exists, the replacement shall comply with the applied Character Frontage District, as established in [Div. 3B.9. (Character Frontage Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9).

      3. Original building materials and [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall not be covered or replaced with stucco, vinyl siding or other materials.

      4. Additional [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall not be added if they did not exist historically. For example, the addition of decorative “gingerbread” brackets to a Craftsman-style porch would be prohibited. Awnings and railings are exempt from this requirement.

      5. [Enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of part or all of a historic [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) on [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall be prohibited. See [Sec. 14.2.6.D. (Street-Facing Facade)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.6).

      6. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or related [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall have a different principal exterior material than the existing [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), as established in [Sec. 3D.10.1. (Principal Material Coverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.10.1), or the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be recessed or project from the existing [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) at least six inches. The principal exterior materials are regulated by the applied Character Frontage District, as established in [Div. 3B.9. (Character Frontage Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9).
2. ###### Demolition of Surveyed Historic Resources


      For any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that involves [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, approval shall not be issued, in accordance with [Sec. 8.2.7.D.3. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.2.7), until one of the following occurs:

      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of Planning, in consultation with the Office of Historic Resources, determines, based upon a Phase 1 Historic Resources Assessment and substantial evidence, that the [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are not [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

      2. A replacement project has been approved in accordance with [Sec. 8.2.7.D.3. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#8.2.7). A surface [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not qualify as a replacement project.
4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Establishing a Conservation District


      Conservation District boundaries are established and amended in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.2. (Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.2), and are represented as part of the third bracket set of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)’s zone with the acronym “CD.” Conservation Districts shall:

      1. Be within the boundaries of an area identified in [Survey LA](https://hpla.lacity.org/), or another [historic resources survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) accepted by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), as potentially eligible for historic designation.

      2. Encompass at least one [block face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

      3. Be applied in conjunction with a Character Frontage District, as established in [Div. 3B.9. (Character Frontage Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9), appropriate for the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s or improvements listed in an [historic resources survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as potentially eligible to become a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or contributors to a historic district.
2. ###### Issuance of Permits


      For all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s within a Conservation District, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not issue a [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit unless approved by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with  Paragraph 3. (Director Determination) below.

3. ###### Director Determination


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall approve, with conditions if necessary, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) if the plans comply with the standards established in Subsection C. (District Standards) above in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5).

      1. ###### Supplemental Notification


         In addition to the notification requirements in [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), no [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit for [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall be issued until the applicant has complied with [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.106.4.5.1. (Notification of Demolition)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code.

### Sec. 8.2.8. Transportation Communication Network District (TCN)

1. ##### Intent


The Transportation Communication Network District (TCN) is intended to impose special [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations designed to facilitate the implementation of the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority’s ( [Metro](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)) TCN program citywide, which will provide intelligent transportation technology, public messaging, service alerts, emergency and public safety alerts, revenue generation, and visual blight reduction through a citywide [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) reduction program.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Definition of Project


      The Transportation Communication Network (TCN) District project includes [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) that involves the erection, construction, [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) to, or structural modification of an [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) located within the TCN District, and is subject to the regulations outlined in the TCN District in which it is located, in accordance with the adopted TCN District standards established pursuant to this Section (Transportation Communication Network Districts (TCN).

2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      In the event that any provision of the TCN District is different from, more restrictive than, or more permissive than any provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), or other [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) (except [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s ( [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#)) and Conservation Districts (CD)), the TCN District provisions shall prevail. In the event that any provision of the TCN District conflicts with any provision of a [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or Conservation District (CD), the more restrictive provision shall prevail. However, the provisions of the TCN District do not supersede [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulation or zoning regulation implementing or relied on in an approved Development Agreement.
3. ##### District Standards


The TCN District standards shall be determined at the time the TCN District is established. TCN District standards shall consist of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) regulations that enhance the character of the district by addressing the location, number, square footage, height, light illumination, hours of illumination, [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) reduction program, duration of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, design and types of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s permitted, as well as other characteristics; and may include murals, [supergraphic sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, and other [on-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s and [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

1. ###### Cumulative Number & Area of Signs


      At no time shall the cumulative number of TCN support structures with [digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s permitted within all TCN Districts exceed 41 support structures, and such [digital display](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall be limited to a maximum of 44,000 square feet of cumulative [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) area.

2. ###### Net Reduction in Off-Site Signs


      The TCN District shall include requirements for [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) reduction that, at minimum, result in a net reduction in [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s citywide.
4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Establishing a TCN District


      TCN District boundaries and standards shall be established and amended in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4), and such boundaries and standards are represented as part of the third bracket set of the zoning designation of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) with the acronym “TCN.”

      1. ###### Applicable Lots


         The TCN District shall only include [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s with an applied [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Public Use District (Div. 5B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.8), or an equivalent [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) zone and that are owned by [Metro](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#). For the purposes of this Section (Transportation Communication Network Districts (TCN)), any [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) with an applied [Public Use District (Part 5B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.8) in a portion of the TCN District shall be considered equivalent to a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Part 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5).

      2. ###### Boundaries


         The TCN District may include contiguous and non-contiguous [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s. Precise [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and/or district boundaries are required at the time of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) to create or expand the TCN District.
2. ###### Issuance of Building Permits


      The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may approve and issue [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permits for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) within the TCN District that conforms to the applicable TCN District standards.

3. ###### Review of Projects


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall be reviewed in conformance with the procedures established in the TCN District.

## Div. 8.3. Special Zones

### Sec. 8.3.1. General

1. ##### Intent


In order to achieve specific planning objectives in designated areas having unique characteristics, [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s may replace the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s and [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s as established in [Sec. 1.5.2.A.4. (Special Zones)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2). [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s respond to unique conditions and set land [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and development requirements and incentives tailored to distinctive qualities that may not lend themselves to the regulations established elsewhere in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), except as outlined within each [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Establishing Special Zones


      New [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are established, and the enabling provisions are amended by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.3. (Zoning Code Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3). [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s are applied to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s as outlined in each district, and are the zone of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), as outlined in [Sec. 1.5.2.A.4. (Special Zones)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.2), with the acronym established for each district. [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s may utilize the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as the vehicle for regulatory measures necessary to achieve the planning objectives that necessitate their creation.

2. ###### Limitations on Special Zones


      The [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s established in this Division (Special Zones) supersede all conflicting provisions in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and shall only be limited by state, local, and federal law.

3. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall contain self-contained zoning regulations, within this Division (Special Zones) or through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), which may include references to apply other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s shall utilize the defined terms and regulations within this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), but may replace them as needed. In the event that the provisions of a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or its corresponding [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) conflict with any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of the [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or its corresponding [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall prevail.

4. ###### Issuance of Building Permits


      Unless otherwise stated in this Division (Special Zones), for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) within a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not issue a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) permit unless the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) complies with the provisions of the [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or its corresponding [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

5. ###### Violations


      The violation of any provision of a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) or condition imposed by a decision-making body in approving the site requirements, methods of operation, development plans or other actions taken in accordance with the authority contained in this Division shall constitute a violation of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 8.3.2. Freeway (FWY)

1. ##### Intent


The Freeway Special Zone (FWY) is intended to regulate property owned by the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans). To the extent that Caltrans is using or building on State-owned property for highway purposes, it will be immune from the regulations established in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). However, when Caltrans property is being used wholly or in part for other purposes, the following limitations on development and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall apply.

2. ##### Development of Caltrans Land


1. ###### Floor Area


      Development of land is limited to a maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of 50 percent of the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#).

2. ###### Use


      The [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) of Caltrans land for non-highway purposes shall be limited to those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s listed below, defined in [Article 5. (Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5), and only permitted by approval of a conditional use permit as outlined below.




      | Uses | Conditional Use Permission Level |
      | --- | --- |
      | Civic Facility: All | C3 |
      | Civic Fleet Services | C3 |
      | Parking | C3 |
      | Public Safety Facility | C3 |
      | Utilities: |  |
      | Minor | C3 |
      | Major | C3 |
      | Solar Energy Facility | C3 |
      | Wireless Facility, Freestanding | C2 |
      | Wireless Facility, Rooftop | C2 |
      | Nature Reserve | C3 |
      | Open Space, Public | C3 |
      | Indoor Recreation: |  |
      | Public | C3 |
      | Outdoor Recreation: |  |
      | Public | C3 |
      | Freight Railway Facility | C3 |
      | Passenger Transit Facility | C3 |
      | Motor Vehicle Services: All | C3 |
      | Fueling Station: All | C3 |
      | Motor Vehicle Sales & Rental: All | C3 |
      | Storage, Indoor: All | C3 |
      | Storage, Outdoor |  |
      | General | C3 |
      | Standard Vehicle | C3 |
      | Large Vehicle | C3 |
      | Official Motor Vehicle Impound | C3 |



      1. ###### C2 Permission Level


         A permission level of C2 indicates that the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may be permitted only after approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

      2. ###### C3 Permission Level


         A permission level of C3 indicates that the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) may be permitted only after approval by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3). In addition to the findings outlined in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall also determine that in approving the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not expose the general public to prolonged or sustained health and safety impacts.
3. ###### Freeway Screening


      [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s approved for one of the permissible non-highway [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s must provide a Type T-3 [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) as established in [Sec. 4C.8.2.C.3.c. (T-Screen 3)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.2) for the entire length of any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) a highway. On [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s where tree planting is infeasible, such as [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s located beneath [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) highways, or on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s with no highway adjacency, such as [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s on capped highways, applicants may apply for relief as outlined in [Sec. 4C.8.2.E. (Relief)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.2).
3. ##### Sale of Caltrans Land


In the event Caltrans property is sold to another party, the limitations established in Subsection B. (Development of Caltrans Land) above shall continue to apply unless the Freeway Special Zone designation has been changed to a different zone in accordance with [Sec. 13.B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13).


### Sec. 8.3.3. Ocean — Submerged Land (SL)

1. ##### Intent


1. The Ocean — Submerged Land (SL) Special Zone is intended to regulate the City of Los Angeles seacoast and off-shore water and underwater areas. These areas constitute a unique and important geographical and scenic resource, utilized for shipping, industry, commerce, residence, and recreation.

2. Off-shore zoning is a related and appropriate extension of planning and zoning principles and practices on land. Its basic intent is to protect all users of affected land from the recognized problems and depreciation brought about by unregulated development. Particular intent in the City of Los Angeles includes:

      1. Protection of the recreational, [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), and scenic uses of coast areas, now much in demand for these [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s and with greater demand forecast for the future;

      2. Preservation of the near seaward prospect of [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) zones along the coast, where this outlook constitutes part of the environment and value of overlooking on-shore properties; and

      3. Provision for such other uses as benefit the public and [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) without significant impairment of these recreational and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.
3. This Section (Ocean — Submerged Land (SL)) also intends to regulate new coastline or off-shore developments with proper consideration of existing recreational and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, public necessity and interest, convenience, general welfare, and good zoning practice.
2. ##### General Provisions


To realize the purposes enumerated in Subsection A. (Intent) above, in accordance with established planning principles, practice, and supportive zoning, the following requirements shall be met for the constructive control of off-shore activities, regardless of whether a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) involves a zone change, variance, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), or otherwise:

1. There shall be no chemical and biological contamination, visual clouding or soiling of urban coastline, beaches or off-shore waters by industrial or commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s.

2. Installations on-shore, temporary or relatively permanent, shall be of such size, nature, location, and spacing that they do not significantly interfere with or adversely affect the [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) and recreational [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), operation, environment or enjoyment of coastline and off-shore areas.

3. The preservation of urban coastline and off-shore areas, above and below water level, in the natural state or for recreation and residence, should take precedence if their function and enjoyment are threatened by additional potentially conflicting off-shore [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s which are not clearly of greater public necessity and interest.

4. Any shoreline industrial or commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s should be of limited and designated duration, with provision for complete removal of installations and restoration of the prior or natural state after expiration of the permissible time period, unless such removal and restoration are unnecessary to maintain desirable recreational and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) environment.

5. No industrial or commercial operations should be undertaken where or when they may significantly alter the underlying geologic stability of other areas, off-shore and on-shore, or otherwise bring about undesirable changes of basic topographical condition.

6. Piers, jetties, causeways, human-made islands, bridges or other connective structures should be prohibited, except when they enhance the recreational and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) environment.

7. Emission of smoke, steam, chemical, odor, sound, artificial light or other form of atmospheric pollutant or environmental impairment from any seaside industrial or commercial installation or facility should be controlled to fulfill the purposes of this zoning.

8. No provision of off-shore urban zoning in this Section (Ocean — Submerged Land (SL)) is intended, or should be interpreted to, conflict with state, federal or international rights or control established by law within the same geographical areas. To the extent there is a conflict, the conflicting provision in this Section (Ocean — Submerged Land (SL)) shall be found by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) to have no force or effect.
3. ##### Development of Ocean — Submerged Land (SL)


For all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s within an Ocean — Submerged Land (SL) Special Zone, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) shall not issue any permit unless approved as established below:

1. Any development on property of any kind within an Ocean — Submerged Land (SL) Special Zone shall be permitted only by approval of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#), in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3).

2. No piers, jetties, man-made islands, floating installations or the like are permitted in connection with any permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s unless authorized under the provisions of [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3).
4. ##### Use of Ocean — Submerged Land (SL)


No property of any kind within the Ocean — Submerged Land (SL) Special Zone shall be [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) d except for the following [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) s, or when a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) is created in accordance with the provisions of this Article (Supplemental & Special Zoning), provided, however, that in no event shall any property be [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) d for surface-type operations (either above or below water level) relating to oil drilling and production of oil, gas, or hydrocarbons.

1. Navigation.

2. Commercial Shipping.

3. Fishing.

4. Recreation.

5. Any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8#) required by any trust or legislative grant to the City of Los Angeles.

# Article 9. Public Benefit Systems

## Div. 9.1. General Rules

### Sec. 9.1.1. Purpose

The purpose of this Article (Public Benefit Systems) is to establish procedures for implementing State [Density Bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provisions, as set forth in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), local incentives to increase the production of affordable housing, as well as other programs to facilitate the provision of public benefits to communities in the vicinity of new development in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and other housing-related [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) policies. Incentives include, but are not limited to, relief from a variety of regulations and requirements, or the granting of additional allowances beyond what would normally be allowed. In addition, it is also the purpose of this Article (Public Benefit Systems) to provide mechanisms to use the maximum [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as allowed in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B)

### Sec. 9.1.2. General Provisions

1. ##### Summary


This Article (Public Benefit Systems) consists of [affordable housing incentive program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in [Div. 9.2. (Citywide Housing Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2), the community benefits program established in [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3), a variety of other incentive programs established in [Div. 9.4. (General Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4), and [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) incentive programs established in [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5).

2. ##### Eligibility


A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) providing [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, including a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s of land, may use an affordable housing program as provided in [Div. 9.2. (Citywide Housing Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2) or [Div. 9.3. (Community Benefits Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3), pursuant to the eligibility requirements for the specific program being used. The programs provided in [Div. 9.4. (General Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4) and [Div. 9.5. (Accessory Dwelling Unit Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.5), can be used, as applicable, and in conjunction with any other [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) program established in this Article (Public Benefit Systems), unless otherwise specified.


## Div. 9.2. Citywide Housing Incentive Programs

### Sec. 9.2.1. State Density Bonus Program

1. ##### Intent


The purpose of this Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program), “State Density Bonus Program,” is to establish procedures for implementing the State Density Bonus provisions in California [Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), and to increase the production of affordable housing citywide in the City of Los Angeles, consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) policies related to housing.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Project Activities


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meeting the eligibility criteria established in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C.(Program Rules), below, and that meets the definition of “housing development” pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), may be eligible for participation in the State Density Bonus Program, for the following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      1. [New construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which all new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).

      2. A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including the conversion of existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from a commercial use to a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for which all resulting new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and all renovated [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).

      3. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) modification that results in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).
2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Relationship to Other Incentive Programs


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the State Density Bonus Program in this Section (State Density Bonus Program) shall be ineligible for the bonuses, [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and procedures of any other housing incentive program contained in this Article (Public Benefit Systems), elsewhere in the Los Angeles Municipal Code, or in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or in any other City regulation or guideline, except a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may utilize the streamlining [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in the [Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6) and the [Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program (Sec. 9.4.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), as applicable. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requesting additional density pursuant to Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.e. (Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive), below, shall not be eligible for the [Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6).

         2. For a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) providing 80-100 percent of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (including bonus units) as [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may instead seek development bonuses and [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s through the procedures of [Sec. 9.2.2. (Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2).
      2. ###### Relationship to Specific Plans, Supplemental Districts, and Special Zones


         As this Section (State Density Bonus Program) is intended to implement State Density Bonus Law contained in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event that any provision of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) differs from the procedures, requirements, and provisions of this Section (State Density Bonus Program), the provisions of this Section (State Density Bonus Program) shall prevail where a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicant seeks approval through this Section (State Density Bonus Program).

      3. ###### Relationship to Other Zoning Provisions


         1. ###### Relationship to Inclusionary Housing


            [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in order to meet the eligibility criteria for participation in the State Density Bonus Program may also be used in order to count toward the [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required by the Inclusionary Housing Program, pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1) where applicable.
      4. ###### Relationship to State Density Bonus Law


         This Section (State Density Bonus Program) is consistent with State Density Bonus Law contained in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=). If at any time, this Section (State Density Bonus Program) becomes inconsistent with [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec.65915-65918 (State Density Bonus Law)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provisions of State Density Bonus Law shall supersede the provisions in this Section (State Density Bonus Program). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may prepare Implementation Memorandums, Technical Bulletins, and/or User Guides for the requirements set forth in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), for the purpose of providing guidance of implementation of this Section (State Density Bonus Program) in compliance with the State Density Bonus Law.
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      To be eligible for any base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), public benefit, or other [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provided in the State Density Bonus Program in Paragraphs 2. (Base Incentives) through Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits), below, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with all requirements provided in this Paragraph (Eligibility), as applicable, and provide any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in order to obtain any particular [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      1. ###### Unit Threshold


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including a mixed-use development, must have a minimum of five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or five or more [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in a [shared housing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). For the purpose of establishing the minimum number of five units, [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be included and [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units shall be excluded.

      2. ###### Maximum Allowable Residential Density


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must occur on a lot with a [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of five or more units.

      3. ###### Affordability Levels


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall reserve a minimum percentage of its [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in a [shared housing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) (excluding bonus units), for [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (at the specified income level) or for the [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s as shown in the table below, subject to the provisions in Sub-subparagraphs i. through iv., below.




         | Required Percentage of Restricted Affordable Units or Target Population Units |
         | --- |
         | Income Level | Minimum % of Dwelling Units |
         | --- | --- |
         | Very Low Income (For Rental or For Sale) | 5 |
         | Low Income (For Rental or For Sale) | 10 |
         | Moderate Income (For Sale) | 10 |

Sec. 11301 et seq.](https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?hl=false&edition=2023&req=granuleid%3AUSC-2000-title42-section11301&num=0&saved=%7CZ3JhbnVsZWlkOlVTQy0yMDAwLXRpdGxlNDItc2VjdGlvbjExMzAy%7C%7C%7C0%7Cfalse%7C2000) | 10 |
         | [Lower income student](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 20 |



         1. [Senior citizen housing development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall comply with [California Civil Code, Sec. 51.2](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=51.2.) and [Sec. 51.3](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=51.3.), and all [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in the resulting [senior citizen housing development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be reserved for senior citizens.

         2. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided for [transitional foster youth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [disabled veteran](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or [homeless person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be provided as very low income [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

         3. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided for [lower income student](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be provided at an affordability level as specified in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(b)(1)(F)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.).

         4. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may exceed the minimum percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in the table above and provide a higher percentage in exchange for additional bonuses or [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s as described in this Section (State Density Bonus Program).
      4. ###### Calculating Affordability Requirements


         The required number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for any particular [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be calculated based on a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s provided [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in a [shared housing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), excluding any units added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) awarded pursuant to this Section (State Density Bonus Program). When calculating a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s affordability requirement, any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

      5. ###### Rent and Housing Cost Schedules and Covenants


         The rate of housing costs or rent for any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not exceed those specified in [California Health and Safety Code, Chapter 2. (Definitions), Sec. 50052.5 (Affordable Housing Costs)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) for for-sale [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [California Health and Safety Code, Chapter 2. (Definitions), Sec. 50053 (Affordable Rent)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.) for rental [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Covenants documenting required rental or for sale rates shall be recorded pursuant to the procedures in Sec. 9.2.1.D.3. (Records and Agreements) below.

      6. ###### Housing Replacement


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet any applicable housing replacement requirements and [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) protections of [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(c)(3)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.) and [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) of this Chapter. Replacement dwelling units required pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall count toward any [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements. When calculating a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s housing replacement requirement, any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

      7. ###### Fair Housing Requirements


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet the applicable requirements regarding the size, location, amenities and allocation of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) and in any Implementation Memorandum or Technical Bulletin prepared and adopted by the Los Angeles Housing Department or the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      8. ###### Historic Resources


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requiring the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is defined in Subsection C. (Definitions) of [Sec. 13B.8.1. (General Provisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1), is not eligible for the State Density Bonus Program. Any proposed alteration to a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be approved for the State Density Bonus Program until any required review pursuant to the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or other state or federal law, is completed.

      9. ###### Unit Habitability Requirements


         For purposes of this Section (State Density Bonus Program), the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” shall mean a complete independent living facility that includes permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, a kitchen, and sanitation, and shall also mean a [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a [shared housing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The term “dwelling unit” or “unit” in this Section (State Density Bonus Program) shall not be a reference to a [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
2. ###### Base Incentives


      [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting the eligibility criteria established in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility), above, shall receive the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s as provided below.

      1. ###### Density

(Calculating a Density Bonus), below. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be permitted in geographic areas of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) other than the areas where [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for a [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) are located. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not need to use any or all of the [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is eligible.

            2. When calculating a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

         [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s granted additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may request those incentives from the following “Menu of Additional Incentives,” subject to the review procedures in Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.a. (Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives from the Menu of Additional Incentives), below.          1. ###### Floor Area Ratio


            An eligible [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may request a percentage increase in the allowable base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) equal to the percentage of [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is eligible, not to exceed 35 percent or 3.0:1 whichever is greater, provided the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located within a 1/2 mile radius (2,640 feet) of a [major transit stop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), subject to the following:

            1. For a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that includes [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [non-residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) bonus shall only apply to the portion of the development dedicated to [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the units; and the portion of the [development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) dedicated to [non-residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be limited to the base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B)).

            2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B)) of 1L to 4L or 15 through 60 shall not be eligible for this [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            3. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or [non-contributor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be eligible for this [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) incentive.
         2. ###### Height


            An eligible [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may request an increase in height of one additional [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) beyond the base height of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B). (Relief)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2). The bundle of reduced setbacks shall require the use of only one [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is located on two or more abutting lots may average the maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum parking, and maximum density over the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provided that:

A covenant running with the land is recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, and a copy is provided to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), that specifies no further [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) adjustment or any other action that may cause the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to be subdivided subsequent to this grant, is permitted for the life of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located on one or more contiguous [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that are not separated by a street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            4. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) includes the number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s sufficient to qualify for a 35 percent [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

(Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(p)(5)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.).
