(Base Incentives), above, by providing additional [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in that single income category, subject to the procedures in Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.e. (Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive).

      1. An additional [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted for setting aside additional [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in the following manner:

         1. For every additional one percent set aside of very low income [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted an additional 2.5 percent density increase; or

         2. For every additional one percent set aside of low income [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted an additional 1.5 percent density increase; or

         3. For every additional one percent set aside of moderate income [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in for-sale [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the project shall be granted an additional one percent density increase.
      2. In calculating the density increase and [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, each component of any density calculation, including the calculation of [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), base density and bonus density, resulting in fractional units shall be separately rounded up to the next whole number.

      3. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) receiving additional density increases beyond 50 percent may be granted the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives) and Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), above, pursuant to the requirements in those Paragraphs.
4. ##### Administration


1. ###### Procedures


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) utilizing this Section (State Density Bonus Program) shall be reviewed using the procedures in this Subsection (Administration) Approval of any base or additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or public benefit, pursuant to this Section (State Density Bonus Program) shall not, in and of itself, require a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) amendment, zone change, project review or other discretionary review action required by this Chapter, a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Ministerial approval in this Paragraph (Procedures) shall mean an administrative process to approve a “use by right” as this term is defined in [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).

      1. ###### Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives from the Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, or additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s from the menu of additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Sec. 9.2.1.C.3.c. (Menu of Additional Incentives), above, and not requesting any [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under Sec. 9.2.1.C.4. (Waivers) or [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under Sec. 9.2.1.C.3.d. (Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives), shall be approved with a ministerial approval by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as follows:

         1. Base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be granted.

         2. Additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be granted subject to the standards provided in Sec. 9.2.1.D.2.a. (Standards for Review for Additional Incentives), below.
      2. ###### Projects Requesting Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting “off menu” [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under Sec. 9.2.1.C.3. (Additional Incentives), above, shall be ministerially approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2), subject to the additional standards provided in Sec. 9.2.1.D.2.a. (Standards for Review for Additional Incentives).

      3. ###### Projects Requesting Waivers


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, modifications, or reductions of applicable zoning standards and requirements beyond the number of additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted pursuant to Sec. 9.2.1.C.3.a. (Number of Incentives), above, shall be reviewed pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), except the approval is subject to the findings in Sec. 9.2.1.D.2.b. (Required Findings for Waivers), below, instead of the findings in [Sec. 13B.2.3.E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), and there is no right to an appeal of the initial decision.

      4. ###### Projects Providing Public Benefits


         [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requesting higher [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for providing one or more public benefit options described in Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be ministerially approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2).

      5. ###### Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) over the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be approved pursuant to the procedures in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3), except a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that exceeds 88.75 percent requires the following supplemental findings:

         1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is consistent with and implements the affordable housing provisions of the Housing Element of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and does not seek approval through the [Housing Element Sites Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6);

         2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) contains at minimum the requisite number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, based on the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided, excluding [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), on the date of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as follows under a single income category:

            1. Twenty-five percent very low-income units for an 88.75 percent density increase (15 percent + 10 percent per [California Government Code Sec. 65915(f) and (v))](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); or

            2. Twenty-four percent low-income units for a 50 percent density increase [(California Government Code Sec. 65915(f))](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); or

            3. Forty-four percent moderate income units for a 50 percent density increase in for-sale [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [(California Government Code Sec. 65915(f))](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.).
         3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets any applicable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) replacement requirements and [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) protections of [California Government Code Sec. 65915(c)(3)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), and [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) of this Chapter, as verified by the Los Angeles Housing Department ( [LAHD](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)). Replacement units required pursuant to these provisions may count towards any on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirement above.

         4. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)'s [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are subject to a recorded affordability restriction of 55 years or 99 years pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) as applicable, running from the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), recorded in a covenant acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department, and subject to fees as set forth in [Sec. 15.4.2. (Fees For Enforcement of Housing Covenants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.2).

         5. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the requirements for projects that include affordable housing referenced in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3), including the Fair Housing Requirements For Affordable Housing.
      6. ###### Other Discretionary Approvals


         Applicable procedures set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) apply to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) seeking other discretionary approvals in conjunction with an application requested pursuant to this Section (State Density Bonus Program).

         Regardless of any other findings that may be applicable for the other discretionary approvals, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall approve the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested pursuant to the State Density Bonus Program, subject to any procedures established in this Paragraph (Procedures) and findings and standards established in Paragraph 2. (Standards for Review and Required Findings), below.
2. ###### Standards for Review and Required Findings


      1. ###### Standards for Review for Additional Incentives


         For the purposes of standards of review for additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘incentive’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(k)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.).

         Additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Sec. 9.2.1.C.3. (Additional Incentives) shall be granted unless one of the following written findings is made, based upon substantial evidence:

         1. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not result in identifiable and actual cost reductions, consistent with [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(k)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), to provide for affordable housing costs as defined in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.), or for rents for the targeted units to be set as specified in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); or

         2. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety or on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) without rendering the [development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unaffordable to [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Inconsistency with the zoning ordinance or [General Plan Land Use Designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not constitute a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon the public health or safety; or

         3. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would be contrary to state or federal law
      2. ###### Required Findings for Waivers


         For the purposes of required findings for [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘ [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(o)(2)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). [Waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to Paragraph 4. (Waivers) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be approved by the applicable [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unless the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) finds any of the following, based on substantial evidence:

         1. The [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) associated with a request for a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will not have the effect of physically precluding the construction of a [development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meeting the eligibility criteria described in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, at the densities or with the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted under Subsection C. (Program Rules), above; or

         2. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), upon public health and safety and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Inconsistency with the zoning ordinance or [General Plan Land Use Designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not constitute a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon the public health or safety; or

         3. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have an adverse impact on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources; or

         4. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would be contrary to state or federal law.
3. ###### Records and Agreements


      Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) qualifying for a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to the provisions of this Section (State Density Bonus Program), covenants acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department and meeting the requirements in this Section (State Density Bonus Program) and in [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

4. ###### Vesting


      An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (State Density Bonus Program) becomes operative, shall be subject to all applicable provisions of this Chapter, including any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) menus or options, that were in effect on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was filed and fees were paid where a public hearing, when required, has been held. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (State Density Bonus Program) becomes operative, may elect to apply the Procedures and comply with the Administration requirements of this Section (State Density Bonus Program), if a public hearing, when required, has not yet been held for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Any such [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be subject to all other applicable provisions of this Chapter that were in effect on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was filed and fees were paid. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall only be eligible for the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s of this Section (State Density Bonus Program) if a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is filed and associated fees for the new filing are paid on or after the operative date of this Section (State Density Bonus Program).

### Sec. 9.2.2. Affordable Housing Incentive Program

1. ##### Intent


The Affordable Housing Incentive Program aims to increase the production of affordable housing projects, including priority housing projects, by implementing state density bonus requirements as set forth in California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918 for [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, with tailored [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s owned by public agencies, [religious institution](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, nonprofit community land trusts, and cooperatives. In conjunction with the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s granted by state law, the program offers [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to make affordable housing construction more feasible, particularly in areas of higher opportunity and quality transit service. The program establishes applicability, program rules, and streamlined procedures through which eligible [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s can access state and local [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), the “Affordable Housing Incentive Program”, applies to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that meets all of the following criteria: meets the definition of either a [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [shared equity project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [public land project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#); provides the required set-asides of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s; meets the eligibility criteria in Sec. 9.2.2.C.1. (Eligibility), below, and involves a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) activity listed in Paragraph 1. (Project Activities), below.

1. ###### Project Activities


      The following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) are subject to the Affordable Housing Incentive Program:

      1. [New construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which all new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      2. A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including the conversion of existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from a [non-residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for which all resulting new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and all renovated [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      3. A [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that results in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).
2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Relationship to Other Incentive Programs


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is ineligible for the bonuses, [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and procedures of the Affordable Housing Incentive Program, if it participates in any other housing incentive program in this Article (Public Benefit Systems), elsewhere in the Los Angeles Municipal Code, in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or in any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulation or guideline, except:

         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may utilize the streamlining [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in the [Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6), provided that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the requirements for both programs.

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that meets the definition of a Type I Unified Adaptive Reuse Project, and the eligibility requirements for both the Affordable Housing Incentive Program and the Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program, pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), may participate in both [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) programs and receive [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to both programs. The portion of the Type I Unified Adaptive Reuse [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) consisting of [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be eligible for base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and public benefits options outlined in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), Paragraph 4. (Waivers), and Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below, unless otherwise stated, and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with Paragraph 1. (Procedures) in Subsection D. (Administration) based on the corresponding [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) type definition and associated [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) request.

         3. This Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) expressly authorizes a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to use another housing incentive program as specified.
      2. ###### Relationship to Specific Plans, Supplemental Districts, and Special Zones


         As this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) differs from the procedures, requirements, and provisions of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), the provisions of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) shall prevail where a project applicant seeks approval through this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program).

      3. ###### Relationship to Other Zoning Provisions


         1. ###### General


            As this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3 (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event of any difference between the provisions of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) and any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) shall prevail.

         2. ###### Relationship to Inclusionary Housing


            [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in order to meet the eligibility criteria for participation in the Affordable Housing Incentive Program may also be used in order to count toward the [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required by the Inclusionary Housing Program, pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1), where applicable.

         3. ###### Relationship to Project Review Threshold Packages


            Regardless of the otherwise applicable Development Review Threshold Package required by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) and the requirements in [Development Review (Sec. 4C.14.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14), [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s participating in the Affordable Housing Incentive Program are exempt from review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4).
      4. ###### Relationship to State Density Bonus Law


         The Affordable Housing Incentive Program is intended to be consistent with State Density Bonus Law in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=). If at any time, the Affordable Housing Incentive Program becomes inconsistent with [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provisions of State Density Bonus Law shall supersede the provisions in this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may prepare Implementation Memorandums, Technical Bulletins, and/or User Guides for the purposes of providing additional guidance on the implementation of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) and maintaining consistency with the State Density Bonus Law.
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      To be eligible for any base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, public benefits, or other [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in the Affordable Housing Incentive Program in Paragraphs 2. (Base Incentives), Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), Paragraph 4. (Waivers), and Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits), below, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with all requirements provided in this Paragraph (Eligibility), as applicable, and provide the required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in order to obtain any particular [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      1. ###### Unit Threshold


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must have a minimum of five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. The units counted for purposes of this requirement includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), below.

      2. ###### Zoning


         1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of N, except a [public land project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be located on a lot with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of 1L, except any of the following:

            1. A [public land project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            2. A [faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) purchased by a [religious institution](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) before January 1, 2024, or on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located within 0.1 miles of a lot containing an operating [community assembly](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) use owned by the filing [religious institution](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            3. A [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with a [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.
      3. ###### Residential Use


         A minimum of 2/3 of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including newly constructed [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and renovated or converted [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), must be dedicated to [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the units.

      4. ###### Affordability Levels


         1. ###### Percentage of Restricted Affordable Units


            The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall reserve a minimum percentage of all [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (including bonus units) for [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on-site according to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) type as shown in the table below, subject to the affordability standards below.




            | Required Percentage of <br>Restricted Affordable Units by Project Type |
            | --- |
            | Project Type | Minimum % of All Project Units That Are Restricted Affordable Units |
            | --- | --- |
            | [One hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) | 100 |
            | [Public land project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 80 |
            | [Faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 80 |
            | [Shared equity project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 80 |

         2. ###### Income Levels


            1. One Hundred Percent Affordable Housing Projects

               Consistent with [California Government Code Sec. 65915(b)(1)(G)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), in a [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) all [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in a [shared housing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) (including [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units but excluding a [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or staff units pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65913.16)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65913.16.), shall be [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s ( [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50079.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50079.5.)), except that up to 20 percent of all [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be for [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s ( [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.) and [50093](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50093.)). The affordable rents for at least 20 percent of all units shall be set per [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.), but affordable rents for the remaining units shall be set for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s as determined by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee. For for-sale units, the affordable housing costs are defined by [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.)

            2. Public Land Projects

               A [public land project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall provide a percentage of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (excluding [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)) as [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting one of the following income and affordability levels for one of the unit types specified in parentheses: 16 percent for [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for rent or sale), 25 percent for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for rent or sale), or 45 percent for [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for sale), as those referenced incomes, rents and housing costs are specified in [California Government Code Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). The remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be set up to the maximum income, affordable rent, and affordable for-sale housing cost, for households earning up to 120 percent of the area median income, as determined by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee, or per [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) and [Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may elect to set these remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at a lower income and affordability level. In addition, 20 percent of all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (inclusive of [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units) may be unrestricted.

            3. Faith Based Organization Projects

               A [faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall provide a percentage of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (excluding [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)) as [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting one of the following income and affordability levels for one of the unit types specified in parentheses: 16 percent for [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for rent or sale); 25 percent for [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for rent or sale); or 45 percent for [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for sale), as those referenced incomes, rents and housing cost are defined in [California Government Code Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.).The remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be set up to the maximum income, affordable rent, and affordable for-sale housing cost for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as determined by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee, or per [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) and [Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.); but with the exception that up to 20 percent of the remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be set at an affordable rent or for-sale housing cost to [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s earning up to 120 percent of the area median income, as determined by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee, or per [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) and [Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may elect to set these remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at a lower income and affordability level. In addition, 20 percent of all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (inclusive of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)) may be unrestricted.

            4. Shared Equity Projects

               A [shared equity project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall provide a percentage of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (excluding [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)) as [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting one of the following income and affordability levels for one of the unit types specified in parentheses: 16 percent for [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for rent or sale), 25 percent for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for rent or sale), or 45 percent for [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (for sale), as those referenced incomes, rents and housing costs are specified in [California Government Code Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). The remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be set up to the maximum income, affordable rent, and affordable for-sale housing cost, for [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s earning up to 120 percent of the area median income, as determined by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee, or per [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) and [Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may elect to set these remaining required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at a lower income and affordability level. In addition, 20 percent of all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (inclusive of [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units) may be unrestricted.
         3. ###### Calculating Affordability Requirements


            In calculating the minimum percentage of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the percentage of each affordability level shall be based on the total [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) count, including [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted pursuant to Subparagraph a. (State Base Incentives) of Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), except where otherwise specified for certain project types. Any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number, and not as specified in [Sec. 6C.1.2. (Lot Area Per Household Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.2) or [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area Per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3).

         4. ###### Rent Schedules


            As specified in the provisions in this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall use the indicated rent schedule published by the Los Angeles Housing Department for purposes of providing [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Covenants documenting required rental or for sale rates shall be recorded pursuant to the procedures described in Sec. 9.2.2.D.3. (Records and Agreements).
      5. ###### Housing Replacement


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet any applicable housing replacement requirements and [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) protections in [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15). Replacement [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall count toward any [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements.

      6. ###### Fair Housing Requirements


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet the applicable requirements regarding the size, location, amenities and allocation of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) and in any Implementation Memorandum or Technical Bulletin prepared and adopted by the Los Angeles Housing Department or Department of City Planning.

      7. ###### Environmental Exclusions


         1. A [faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or shared equity [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Affordable Housing Incentive Program shall not be located fully or partially on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located within a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Sea Level Rise Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         2. A [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with a [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of less than five [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be eligible for the Affordable Housing Incentive Program if the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is fully or partially on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located within a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Sea Level Rise Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
      8. ###### Historic Resources


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requiring the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is defined in Subsection C. (Definitions) of [Sec. 13B.8.1. (General Provisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1), shall not be eligible for the Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.) Any proposed alteration to a designated historic resource shall not be approved for the Affordable Housing Incentive Program until any required review pursuant to the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or other state or federal law, is completed.

         2. A [faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or a shared equity [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be eligible for the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2) if it requires the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as defined in [Sec. 13B.8.1.C. (General Provisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1), of a [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. A faith-based organization projects or a [shared equity project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that proposes to alter a [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be consistent with the Secretary of the Interior's Standards for the Treatment of Historic Properties, as supported by an expert study that has been accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, or demonstrated by the project plans and accepted by the Office of Historical Resources if consistent with adopted Implementation Memorandum, Guidelines, or Technical Bulletin of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of City Planning. This requirement does not apply if the Office of Historic Resources has determined the [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is not eligible for listing individually or as a contributor to a district on a local, state or federal register of historic resources.
      9. ###### Unit Habitability Requirements


         For purposes of a [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” shall mean a complete independent living facility that includes permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, a [kitchen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and sanitation, or a [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a [shared housing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#); but the term shall not include a [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). When the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” is used in reference to a [shared equity project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [public land project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [faith-based organization project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” shall mean a complete independent living facility that includes permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, a [kitchen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and sanitation; but the term shall not include a [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

(Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), as shown in the table below for reference.

[Primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setback reductions are limited to no more than the average of the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setbacks of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s facing the same [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). If there are no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, no reduction in [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setback is permitted. If a project occupies all the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on an entire [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a reduction to the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setback is permitted when combined with an increase in the rear setback of the same dimension.

             2. Side setback of four feet for a three-story [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or three feet for a two-story [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

             4. Rear setback of four feet.

Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(k)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). Additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s allowed pursuant to Sec. 9.2.2.C.3. (Additional Incentives), above, shall be granted unless one of the following written findings are made, based upon substantial evidence:

         1. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not result in identifiable and actual cost reductions, consistent with [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(k)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), to provide for affordable housing costs as defined in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50052.5.&lawCode=HSC), or for rents for the targeted units to be set as specified in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); or

         2. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety or on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) without rendering the development unaffordable to low income households and [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Inconsistency with the zoning ordinance or [General Plan Land Use Designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not constitute a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon the public health or safety; or

         3. The incentive would be contrary to state or federal law.
      2. ###### Required Findings for Waivers


         For the purposes of required findings for [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘ [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(o)(2)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). [Waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to Sec. 9.2.2.C.4. (Waivers), above, shall be approved by the applicable [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unless the decision maker makes one of the following findings, based upon substantial evidence:

         1. The [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) associated with a request for a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will not have the effect of physically precluding the construction of a development meeting the eligibility criteria described in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, at the densities or with the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted above; or

         2. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Inconsistency with the zoning ordinance or [General Plan Land Use Designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not constitute a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon the public health or safety; or

         3. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have an adverse impact on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources; or

         4. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would be contrary to state or federal law.

      Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Affordable Housing Incentive Program and utilizing one or more [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), covenants acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department and meeting the requirements in this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) and [Div. 4C.15.       An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) becomes operative, shall be subject to all applicable provisions of this Chapter, including any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) menus or provisions, that were in effect on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was filed and fees were paid where a public hearing, when required, has been held. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) becomes operative, may elect to apply the Procedures and comply with the Administration requirements of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program), if a public hearing, when required, has not yet been held for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Any such [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be subject to all other applicable provisions in this Chapter that were in effect on the date the application was filed. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall only be eligible for the incentives of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program) if a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is filed and associated fees for the new filing are paid on or after the operative date of this Section (Affordable Housing Incentive Program).

### Sec. 9.2.3. Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program

1. ##### Intent


The Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program aims to establish specific incentives and procedures for the local implementation of State Density Bonus requirements, pursuant to [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(n)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), in order to encourage the creation and development of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in mixed-income developments along transit corridors in [higher opportunity area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and to ensure an equitable distribution of affordable housing across the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program), the “Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program”, applies to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) providing [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for incentives granted in this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program), and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria in Sec. 9.2.3.C.1. (Eligibility), below, and involves a [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) listed in Paragraph 1. (Project Activities), below.

1. ###### Project Activities


      The following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) are subject to the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program:

      1. [New construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which all new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      2. A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including the conversion of existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from a commercial use to a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for which all resulting new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and all renovated [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      3. A [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including a subdivision, or common interest development (as defined in [California Civil Code, Sec. 4100](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=4100.)), that results in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.
2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Relationship to Other Incentive Programs


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is ineligible for the bonuses, [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and procedures in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program if it is participating in any other housing incentive program in the Los Angeles Municipal Code, or in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or in any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulation or guideline, except:

         1. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s participating in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program may utilize the streamlining incentives granted through the [Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6), provided that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meet the eligibility requirements and program rules for both programs.

         2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the definition of a Type I Adaptive Reuse [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and the eligibility requirements for both the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program and the Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program, pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), may participate in both incentive programs and receive [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to both programs. The portion of the Type I Adaptive Reuse [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) consisting of [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be eligible for base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional incentives, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and public benefits options provided in Paragraphs 2., 3., 4., and 5. of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below, unless otherwise stated, and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with Paragraph 1. (Procedures) in Subsection D. (Administration)) based on the corresponding project type definition and associated [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) request.

         3. This Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) expressly authorizes a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to use another housing incentive program, as specified.
      2. ###### Relationship to Specific Plans, Special Districts, and Special Zones


         As this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event of any difference between the provisions of an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and the provisions of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program), the provisions of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) shall prevail where a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) seeks approval through this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program).

      3. ###### Relationship to Other Zoning Provisions


         1. ###### General


            As this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event of any difference between the provisions of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) and any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) shall prevail.

         2. ###### Relationship to Inclusionary Housing


            [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in order to meet the eligibility criteria for participation in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program may also be used in order to count toward the [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required by the Inclusionary Housing Program, pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1) where applicable.

         3. Regardless of the otherwise applicable Development Review Threshold Package required by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) and the requirements of the [Development Review (Sec. 4C.14.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14), [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s participating in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program are exempt from review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4).
      4. ###### Relationship to State Density Bonus Law


         The Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program is intended to be consistent with State Density Bonus Law at [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=). If at any time, the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program becomes inconsistent with [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provisions of State Density Bonus Law shall supersede the provisions in this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may prepare Implementation Memorandums, Technical Bulletins, and/or User Guides for the purposes of providing additional guidance on the implementation of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) and maintaining consistency with the State Density Bonus Law.
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      To be eligible for any base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, public benefits, or other incentives provided in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), Paragraph 4. (Waivers) and Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits), below, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with all requirements provided in this Paragraph (Eligibility), as applicable, and provide any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in order to obtain any particular incentive.

      1. ###### Unit Threshold


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must have a minimum of five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. The units counted for purposes of this requirement includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), below.

      2. ###### Zoning


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of N or 1L or with an applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) in [Div. 5B.7. (Industrial Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7).

      3. ###### Residential Uses


         A minimum of 2/3 of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including newly constructed [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and renovated or converted [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), must be dedicated to [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the units.

      4. ###### Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), in whole or in part, for which an Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Set has been mapped on the [Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.17.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.17), or is mapped through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      5. ###### Affordability Levels


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall reserve a minimum percentage of its [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on-site according to the Mixed Income Incentive Set designated for the project lot, based on the housing market tier or the opportunity area of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and subject to the affordability standards in Sub-subparagraphs i. through v., below.

         1. ###### Single or Mixed Affordability Option


            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may opt to meet its affordability requirement by providing [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at rates determined by the methodology provided in: Sub-sub-subparagraph a) (Single Affordability Requirements), below; Sub-sub-subparagraph b) (Mixed Affordability Options), below; or Sub-sub-subparagraph c) (Low Income Site Affordability Requirements), below, as applicable.

            1. Single Affordability Requirements

               A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) opting to use the “Single Affordability Requirements” shall provide [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for one of the income levels listed in the “Income Levels” column in the table below at the corresponding percentage of total [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (all units including bonus units) for the applicable Opportunity Corridors Incentive Set and Market Tier for the project lot.




               | Single Affordability Requirements |
               | --- |
               | Mixed Income Incentive Set | Market Tiers | Income Levels |
               | Extremely Low Income | Very Low Income | Low Income |
               | OC-3 | High Medium and High Market Tiers | 13% | 17% | 27% |
               | OC-2 | 12% | 16% | 25% |
               | OC-1 | 11% | 14% | 23% |
               | OC-3 | Low and Medium Market Tiers | 11% | 15% | 25% |
               | OC-2 | 10% | 14% | 23% |
               | OC-1 | 9% | 12% | 21% |

            2. Mixed Affordability Requirements

               A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a [higher opportunity area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as specified by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee (TCAC) opportunity area for the project lot, may use the “Mixed Affordability Options” table to meet its [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirement. Under this option a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may provide [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at the percentages and in the combinations listed in the “Income Levels” columns in the following table, by applying the percentages to all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units (including bonus units). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) opting to use the Mixed Affordability Options must also provide at least one [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) containing four or more [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at the acutely low-income affordability level.




               | Mixed Affordability Options |
               | --- |
               | TCAC Opportunity Area | Income Levels |
               | Acutely Low Income | Extremely Low Income | Very Low Income | Moderate Income |
               | [Higher Opportunity Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 4% | 4% | - | 12% |

            3. Low Income Site Affordability Requirements

               A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a site identified in [Sec. 1.5.15. (Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15) may meet its affordability requirement by providing 20 percent of its on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, consistent with [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583..)
         2. ###### Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Set Designation


            The applicable Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Set shall be determined based on the designation shown on the Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map established in [Sec. 1.5.17. (Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.17) or is mapped through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. ###### Calculating Affordability Requirements


            In calculating the minimum percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the percentage of each affordability level shall be based on the total [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) count, including [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number, and not as specified in [Sec. 6C.1.2. (Lot Area Per Household Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.2) or [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area Per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3).

         4. ###### Housing Market Tier Designation


            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s housing market tier shall be determined by the residential market areas adopted by City Council resolution, as described in [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3).

         5. ###### Rent and Housing Cost Schedules and Covenants


            The rate of housing costs or rent for any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not exceed those specified in [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 50052.5 (Affordable Housing Costs)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) for for-sale units or [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50053.) for rental units. Covenants documenting required rental or for sale rates shall be recorded pursuant to the procedures described in Sec. 9.2.3.D.3. (Records and Agreements). [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s associated with [one hundred percent affordable housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall comply with the affordability specified in [Sec. 9.2.2.C.1.d.ii.a. (One Hundred Percent Affordable Housing Projects)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2).
      6. ###### Housing Replacement


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet any applicable housing replacement requirements and demolition protections established in [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15). Replacement dwelling units required pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall count toward any [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements. In calculating replacement units, any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

      7. ###### Fair Housing Requirements


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet the applicable requirements regarding the size, location, amenities and allocation of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) and in any Implementation Memorandum or Technical Bulletin prepared and adopted by the Los Angeles Housing Department or [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      8. ###### Historic Resources


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requiring the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is defined in Subsection C. (Definitions) of [Sec. 13B.8.1. (General Provisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1), of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) identified for historic protection or special consideration or review by an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or Conservation District is not eligible for [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program.

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) involving the alteration of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be consistent with the Secretary of the Interior's Standards for Rehabilitation as supported by an expert study that has been accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, or demonstrated by the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) plans and accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, if consistent with the applicable adopted Implementation Memorandum, Guidelines or Technical Bulletins of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of City Planning.
      9. ###### Unit Habitability Requirements


         For purposes of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program), the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” shall mean a complete independent living facility that includes permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, a [kitchen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and sanitation. The term “dwelling unit” or “unit” in this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) shall not be a reference to a [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may utilize an Alternate Typology established in [Div. 7B.6. (Opportunity Corridors)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.6) as provided in the table below.

(Waiver and Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10).
