A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s subject to procedures in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) shall not be eligible for this base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. ###### Additional Incentives


      In addition to the applicable base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in [Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2), above, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted up to four additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in this Paragraph (Additional Incentives). Such a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may receive up to four incentives provided a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) includes the applicable percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (excluding units added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)) that is necessary to obtain the maximum number of [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s available to an income category under [California Government Code Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), as listed on the table in [Sec. 9.2.1.C.3.a.i. (Allowed Number of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1). [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may use [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to deviate from a [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or requirement in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), unless otherwise specifically provided. The four additional incentives may be any combination of [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s listed in Subparagraph a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), below, or [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested under Subparagraph b. (Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives).

      1. ###### Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted requested [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s from the Menu of Additional Incentives listed in Sub-subparagraphs i. through v., below, pursuant to the procedures in Sec. 9.2.3.D.1.a. (Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives on the Menu of Additional Incentives), below.

         1. ###### By-Right Adjustments


            Relief from any zoning standard that would otherwise require approval pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2) may be granted as an on-menu [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and shall not be subject to the requirements of [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2). Each adjustment-equivalent grant shall count as one [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) request. By-right adjustments shall not be granted in the following cases:

            1. A by-right adjustment shall not apply to standards that regulate [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), height, any modifications of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s standards, or for requests to allow parking in front of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and lot amenity space.

            2. A by-right adjustment shall not apply to a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or a [non-contributor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
         2. ###### Averaging of Floor Area, Lot Amenity Space, Parking, and Density


            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is located on two or more abutting lots may average the maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum parking, and maximum density over the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provided that:

            1. The [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are permitted by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) of each area the [proposed use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s will be located; and

            2. A covenant running with the land is recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, and a copy is provided to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), that specifies no further [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) adjustment or any other action that may cause the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to be subdivided subsequent to this grant, is permitted for the life of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
         3. ###### Density Calculation


            Any area of any land required to be dedicated for street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) purposes may be included as [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for purposes of calculating the maximum density permitted by the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B).

         4. ###### Building Coverage


            Up to a 25 percent increase in [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limits is allowed.

         5. ###### Lot Width


            Up to 25 percent decrease in the required [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is allowed.
      2. ###### Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may request [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s not listed in, or in excess of an [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed in, Subparagraph a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), above, subject to the approval process in Sec. 9.2.3.D.1.b. (Projects Requesting Incentives Not on the Menu of Additional Incentives), below, with the exception of any modification listed in Sub-subparagraph ii., below.

         2. Modifications to the following standards, or their equivalents in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), altering the criteria or level of relief allowed in Sub-subparagraph i. (By-Right Adjustments) of Subparagraph a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), above, shall not be granted as an additional incentive through this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) and are not eligible for approval through this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program). [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that seek these types of incentives not on the menu shall seek approval pursuant to the procedures, incentives and other requirements in [Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1):

            1. [Lot Amenity Space (Sec. 2C.3.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1);

            2. Any [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height restriction established in [Div. 2C.4. (Floor Area Ratio & Height)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4);

            3. Any [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) bulk limitations established in [Div. 2C.6. (Upper-Story Bulk)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.6);

            4. [Building Width (Sec. 2C.5.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.5.1);

            5. [Building Setbacks (Sec. 2C.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2);

            6. [Ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) design requirements specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B); or

            7. [Required Trees (Sec. 4C.6.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.2).
4. ###### Waivers


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may request [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as defined in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), under [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives) Sec. 65915(e)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.) along with the additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s granted pursuant to Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives) above, subject to the procedures in Sec. 9.2.3.D.1.c. (Projects Requesting Waivers) below.

5. ###### Public Benefits


      1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may access up to the tier 2 bonus [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed by the eligible Opportunity Corridors Alternate Typology established in [Div. 7B.6. (Opportunity Corridors)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.6) or by an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), by providing one or more of the public benefits pursuant to [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4) pursuant to the following options:

         1. Any public benefit options listed for Public Benefits Incentive Set 2, as established in [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4).

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) providing public benefits shall also be eligible to provide one or more of the public benefit options listed for the Public Benefits Incentive Set mapped for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [Public Benefits Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.12.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.12). The mapped Public Benefits Incentive Set shall establish the [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height bonuses associated with each eligible public benefit option, pursuant to [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4).
      2. Multiple public benefit options can be provided by one [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in order to combine and stack public benefit bonuses, but in no case shall the total bonus received exceed the [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), allowed by the eligible Opportunity Corridors Alternate Typology established in [Div. 7B.6. (Opportunity Corridors)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.6).

      3. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s providing public benefits shall be reviewed and approved pursuant to the processes outlined in in Sec. 9.2.2.D.1.d. (Projects Providing Public Benefits), below.
4. ##### Administration


1. ###### Procedures


      The following review and approval procedures apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s participating in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program. Ministerial approval in this Paragraph (Procedures) shall mean an administrative process to approve a “use by right” as this term is defined in [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).

      1. ###### Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s outlined in Sec. 9.2.3.C.2. (Base Incentives), above, or additional on-menu incentives as outlined in Sec. 9.2.3.C.3.a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), above, and not requesting any [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under Sec. 9.2.3.C.4. (Waivers) or off-menu incentives under Sec. 9.2.3.C.3.b. (Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives), shall be subject to a ministerial approval process by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Additional incentives approved by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with the additional standards in Sec. 9.2.3.D.2.a. (Standards for Review for Additional Incentives), below.

      2. ###### Projects Requesting Incentives Not on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         A project requesting incentives pursuant to Sec. 9.2.3.C.3.b. (Incentives Not on the Menu of Additional Incentives), above, shall be subject to a ministerial approval process pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2) and shall be granted subject to the additional standards in Sec. 9.2.3.D.2.a. (Standards for Review for Additional Incentives), below.

      3. ###### Projects Requesting Waivers


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as defined in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), under [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives) Sec. 65915(e)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.) along with the number of additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted pursuant to Sec. 9.2.3.C.3. (Additional Incentives) above, shall be reviewed as follows:

         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only one [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to Paragraph 4. (Waivers) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination).](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5)

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting more than one [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to Paragraph 4. (Waivers) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3).

         3. Regardless of any provision of [Div. 13B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2), findings for [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be those in Subparagraph b. (Required Findings for Waivers) of Paragraph 2. (Standards for Review and Required Findings), in lieu of the findings in [Div. 13.B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13); and [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requiring a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit are final at the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and are not appealable. [Waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requiring a Director Determination are appealable to the City Planning Commission.
      4. ###### Projects Providing Public Benefits


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting higher [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for providing one or more public benefits as outlined in Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be ministerially approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2). Such requests shall not be subject to any hearing procedures regardless of the provisions contained in [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2).

      5. ###### Other Discretionary Approvals


         Applicable procedures set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s seeking other discretionary approvals in conjunction with any incentives requested pursuant to the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program including those listed in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), Paragraph 4. (Waivers), or Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above. Regardless of any other findings that may be applicable for the other discretionary approvals, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall approve the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested pursuant to the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program, subject to any procedures established in Paragraph 1. (Procedures), above, and standards established in Paragraph 2. (Standards for Review and Required Findings), below.

      6. ###### Density Bonuses, Incentives or Waivers Exceeding this Program


         [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that seek additional [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) es, [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s beyond what is expressly allowed by this Section (Opportunity Corridor Housing Incentive Program), shall be reviewed pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), including the requirements and findings in [Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.e. (Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1)
2. ###### Standards for Review and Required Findings


      1. ###### Standards for Review for Additional Incentives


         For the purposes of standards of review for additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘incentive’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(k)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). Additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s allowed pursuant to Sec. 9.2.3.C.3. (Additional Incentives), above, shall be granted unless one of the following written findings are made, based upon substantial evidence:

         1. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not result in identifiable and actual cost reductions to provide for affordable housing costs as defined in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.), or for rents for the targeted units to be set as specified in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); or

         2. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety or on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) without rendering the development unaffordable to [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Inconsistency with the zoning ordinance or [General Plan Land Use Designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not constitute a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon the public health or safety; or

         3. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would be contrary to state or federal law.
      2. ###### Required Findings for Waivers


         For the purposes of required findings for [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘ [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(o)(2)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). [Waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s allowed pursuant to Sec. 9.2.3.C.4. (Waivers) shall be approved by the applicable [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unless the decision maker makes one of the following findings, based upon substantial evidence:

         1. The [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) associated with a request for a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will not have the effect of physically precluding the construction of a development meeting the eligibility criteria described in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, at the densities or with the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and additional incentives permitted under Subsection C. (Program Rules), above.

         2. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have an adverse impact on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources.

         4. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is contrary to state or federal law.
3. ###### Records and Agreements


      Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program and utilizing one or more [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program), covenants acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department and meeting the requirements in this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) and [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

4. ###### Vesting


      An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) becomes operative, shall be subject to all applicable provisions of this Chapter, including any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) menus or other provisions, that were in effect on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was filed and fees were paid. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall only be eligible for the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, procedures and other provisions of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program) if a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is filed and associated fees for the new filing are paid on or after the operative date of this Section (Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program).

### Sec. 9.2.4. Corridor Transitions Incentive Program

1. ##### Intent


The Corridor Transitions Incentive Program aims to establish specific [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and procedures for the local implementation of State Density Bonus requirements, pursuant to [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(n)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), and to facilitate the creation and development of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in lower density areas in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), in order to aid in smoothing the transition between higher-scale development along principal corridors to lower-scale development in interior neighborhoods. The Corridor Transitions Incentive Program provides the rules and framework for offering graduated increases in density and [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to meet this goal, while responding to lower-scale residential design needs and constraints.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program), the “Corridor Transitions Incentive Program,” applies to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) providing [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for incentives granted in this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program), and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below, and involves a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) activity listed in Paragraph 1. (Project Activities), below.

1. ###### Project Activities


      The following [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) are subject to the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program:

      1. [New construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which all new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      2. A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including the conversion of existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from a commercial use to a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for which all resulting new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and all renovated [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meet the eligibility criteria outlined in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      3. A [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that results in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).
2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Relationship to Other Incentive Programs


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program shall be ineligible for the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and procedures of any other housing [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) program in this Article (Public Benefit Systems), elsewhere in the Los Angeles Municipal Code, or in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or in any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulation or guideline, except:

         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program may also utilize the streamlining [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s granted through the [Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6), provided that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility requirements and program rules for both programs.

         2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the definition of a Type I Adaptive Reuse Project and the eligibility requirements for both the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program and the Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program, pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), may participate in both [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) programs and receive [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to both programs. The portion of the Type I Adaptive Reuse Project consisting of [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be eligible for base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and public benefits options provided in Paragraphs 2., 3., 4., and 5. of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below, unless otherwise stated, and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with Paragraph 1. (Procedures) in Subsection D. (Administration) based on the corresponding [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) type definition and associated [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) request.
      2. ###### Relationship to Specific Plans, Supplemental Districts, and Special Zones


         As this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) differs from the procedures, requirements, and provisions of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program), the provisions of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) shall prevail where a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicant seeks approval through this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program).

      3. ###### Relationship to Other Zoning Provisions


         1. ###### General


            As this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event of any difference between the provisions of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) and any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) shall prevail.

         2. ###### Relationship to Inclusionary Housing


            [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in order to meet the eligibility criteria for participation in the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program may also be used in order to count toward the [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required by the Inclusionary Housing Program, pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1), where applicable.

         3. ###### Relationship to Project Review Threshold Packages


            Regardless of the otherwise applicable Development Review Threshold Package required by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B), and the requirements of the [Development Review (Sec. 4C.14.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14), [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s participating in the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program are exempt from review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4).
      4. ###### Relationship to State Density Bonus Law


         The Corridors Transitions Incentive Program is intended to be consistent with State Density Bonus Law at [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=). If at any time, the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program becomes inconsistent with the State Density Bonus Law, as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provisions of the State Density Bonus Law shall supersede the provisions in this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may prepare Implementation Memorandums, Technical Bulletins, and/or User Guides for the purposes of providing additional guidance on the implementation of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) and maintaining consistency with State Density Bonus Law.
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      To be eligible for any base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, public benefits, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or other [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives) or Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits) below, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with all requirements in this Paragraph (Eligibility), as applicable, and provide any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in order to obtain any particular incentive.

      01. ###### Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map


          The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is, in whole or in part, mapped with a Corridor Transitions Incentive Set on the [Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.17.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.17), or through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)

      02. ###### Zoning


          The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of N, 1L, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, or 10.

      03. ###### Unit Threshold


          The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must have a minimum of four or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. For purposes of calculating units for this requirement, new dwelling units created within existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be included and [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted pursuant to Subparagraph b. of Paragraph 2. (Incentives), below, may be counted.

      04. ###### Residential Uses


          A minimum of 2/3 of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including newly constructed [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and renovated or converted [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), must be dedicated to [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the units.

      05. ###### Affordability Levels


          The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall reserve the number of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in one of the income levels listed in the “Income Level” column in the table below for the corresponding applicable Corridor Transitions Incentive Set, unless the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is on a site identified in [Sec. 1.5.15. (Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15) and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) reserves at least 20 percent of its on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for lower income households, consistent with [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.). The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unit count in the below table includes all units in a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including units allowed through a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). All [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be subject to the affordability standards in Sub-subparagraphs i. through iii., below.




          | Affordability Requirements |
          | --- |
          | Project Units | Income Levels |
          | Very Low Income | Low Income | Moderate Income |
          | 11-16 | 2 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 2 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s | 3 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s |
          | 5-10 | 1 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) | 1 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) | 2 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s |
          | 4 | - | - | 1 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) |



          1. ###### Corridor Transitions Incentive Set Designation


             The applicable Corridor Transitions Incentive Set for a subject lot shall be mapped on the [Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.17.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.17) or mapped through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

          2. ###### Calculating Affordability Requirements


             The number of required on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be counted as a flat number of required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). For consolidated [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall provide the same total number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s as required prior to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) consolidation. For example, if a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) consolidated two lots that allow 10 units on each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) into one twenty-unit [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would be required to provide either two very low income or low-income units, or four moderate income units.

          3. ###### Rent and Housing Cost Schedules and Covenants


             The rate of housing costs or rent for any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not exceed those specified in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) for for-sale units, or [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50053.&nodeTreePath=37.1.2&lawCode=HSC) for rental units. Covenants documenting required rental or for-sale rates shall be recorded pursuant to the procedures described in [Sec. 9.2.4.D.2. (Records and Agreements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4). [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s associated with [One Hundred Percent Affordable Housing Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall comply with the affordability specified in [Sec. 9.2.2.C.1.d.ii.a) (One Hundred Percent Affordable Housing Projects)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2).
      06. ###### Housing Replacement


          The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet any applicable housing replacement requirements and demolition protections of [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(c)(3)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.) and [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) of this Chapter. Replacement [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall count toward any [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements.

      07. ###### Fair Housing Requirements


          [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet the applicable requirements regarding the size, location, amenities and allocation of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) and in any Implementation Memorandum or Technical Bulletin prepared and adopted by the Los Angeles Housing Department or [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      08. ###### Historic Resources


          A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with both of the following concerning historic resources:

          1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will not require the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is defined in Subsection C. (Definitions) of [Sec. 13B.8.1. (General Provisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1), of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) identified for historic protection or special consideration or review by an applicable [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Such a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is not eligible for [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program.

          2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) involving the alteration of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be consistent with the Secretary of the Interior's Standards for Rehabilitation as supported by an expert study that has been accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, or demonstrated by the project plans and accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, if consistent with the applicable adopted Implementation Memorandum, Guidelines or Technical Bulletins of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of City Planning.
      09. ###### Unit Habitability Requirements


          For purposes of this Sec. 9.2.4. (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program), the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” shall mean a complete independent living facility that includes permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, a [kitchen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and sanitation. The term “dwelling unit” or “unit” in this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) shall not be a reference to a [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      10. ###### Lot Amenity Alternatives


          The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet its [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirement by using one of the lot amenity alternative types in [Sec. 2C.3.5. (Lot Amenty Alternatives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.5).
2. ###### Base Incentives


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meeting the eligibility criteria in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) shall be granted the following [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, subject to the review procedures in Subsection D. (Administration), below, as applicable.

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may utilize one of the Alternate Typologies established in [Div. 7B.7. (Corridor Transitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.7) as provided in the table below.




         | Corridor Transitions Alternate Typologies Eligibility |
         | --- |
         | Corridor Transitions Incentive Set Mapped on the Mixed Income Housing Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.17.) | Eligible Corridor Transitions Alternate Typologies |
         | CT-3 | Corridor Transitions 3 ( [Sec. 7B.7.3.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.7.3)) |
         | CT-2 | Corridor Transitions 2 ( [Sec. 7B.7.2.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.7.2)) |
         | CT-1 | Corridor Transitions 1 ( [Sec. 7B.7.1.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.7.1)) |

      2. Regardless of Subparagraph a., above, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a site with a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or a [non-contributor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be eligible for Corridor Transitions 3 Alternate Typology and may use the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s outlined in the Corridor Transitions 2 Alternate Typology.

      3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be exempt from any applicable improvement requirement for roadway widening, including the relocation of an established curb or curb and gutter, pursuant to [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1). This [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not require an approval pursuant to [Sec. 10.1.10. (Waiver and Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) utilizing this incentive shall comply with all dedication requirements under [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1) and complete all other required [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) improvements, including but not limited to sidewalk improvements, unless a Waiver of Dedication and Improvement is granted pursuant to [Sec. 10.1.10. (Waiver & Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall further be eligible for relief from some required dedication, where specified by [Sec. 10.2.1. (Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.2.1). Regardless of the above, any otherwise required dedication and improvement shall conform to the Street Dedication and Improvement Investigation Criteria adopted or amended pursuant to Council File 22-1476. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s subject to procedures in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) shall not be eligible for this base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. ###### Public Benefits


      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may access up to the [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) or applicable [Corridor Transitions Alternate Typology (Div. 7B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B.7) by providing public benefits options allowed pursuant to [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4).

      2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are eligible for the following public benefit options:

         1. The public benefit option listed in [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4) Set 1; and

         2. One or more of the public benefit options listed for the Public Benefits Incentive Set mapped for the lot on the [Public Benefits Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.12.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.12).
      3. The applicable Public Benefits Incentive Set shall establish the [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height bonuses associated with each eligible public benefit option, pursuant to Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu).
4. ##### Administration


1. ###### Procedures


      The following review and approval procedures apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s participating in the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program. Ministerial approval in this Paragraph shall mean an administrative process to approve a “use by right” as this term is defined in [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).

      1. ###### Projects Requesting Only Base Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s outlined in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be subject to a ministerial approval process by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      2. ###### Projects Providing Public Benefits


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting higher [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or additional incentives in exchange for providing one or more public benefits as outlined in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be ministerially approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2). Such [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be subject to any hearing procedures regardless of the provisions contained in [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2).

      3. ###### Other Discretionary Approvals


         Applicable procedures set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s seeking other discretionary approvals in conjunction with any incentives that are requested pursuant to the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program. Regardless of any other findings that may otherwise be applicable for the other discretionary approvals, the decision maker must approve the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested pursuant to the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program, subject to any procedures established in this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program).

      4. ###### Waivers and Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that requests a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or additional incentive not offered in Sec. 9.2.4. (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) is not eligible for review and approval through this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program). Such a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall seek approval pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), and the procedures, incentive menu and other requirements of that [Section 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), if eligible.
2. ###### Records and Agreements


      Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Corridor Transitions Incentive Program and utilizing one or more [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program), covenants acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department and meeting the requirements in this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) and set as forth in [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

3. ###### Vesting


      An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) becomes operative, shall be subject to all applicable provisions of this Chapter, including any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) menus or other provisions, that were in effect on the date the application was filed and fees were paid. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall only be eligible for the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, procedures and other provisions of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program) if a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is filed and associated fees for the new filing are paid on or after the operative date of this Section (Corridor Transitions Incentive Program).

### Sec. 9.2.5. Transit Oriented Incentive Program

1. ##### Intent


The Transit Oriented Incentive Program aims to: establish specific incentives and procedures for the local implementation of State Density Bonus requirements, pursuant to [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(n)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); encourage the creation and development of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s through mixed-income housing citywide; and offer tailored incentives in areas throughout the City with [high quality transit service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program), the “Transit Oriented Incentive Program,” applies to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that: provides [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for incentives granted in this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program); meets the eligibility criteria established in [Sec. 9.2.5.C.1. (Eligibility)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), below; and involves a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) activity listed in Paragraph 1. (Project Activities), below.

1. ###### Project Activities


      The following project activities are subject to the Transit Oriented Incentive Program:

      1. [New construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which all new floor area meets the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      2. A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including the conversion of existing floor area from a non-residential use to a [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or an increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for which all resulting new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and all renovated [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below.

      3. A [lot modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that results in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the eligibility criteria provided in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).
2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Relationship to Other Incentive Programs


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is ineligible for the bonuses, incentives and procedures of the Transit Oriented Incentive Program if it is participating in any other housing incentive program in the Los Angeles Municipal Code, or in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or in any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulation or guideline, except:

         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may also utilize the streamlining incentives in the [Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program (Sec. 9.2.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.6), provided that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility requirements and program rules for both programs.

         2. A project that meets the definition of a Type I Adaptive Reuse Project and the eligibility requirements for both the Transit Oriented Incentive Program and the Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program, pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), may participate in both incentive programs and receive [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to both programs. The portion of the unified adaptive reuse project consisting of [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be eligible for base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional incentives, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and public benefits options outlined in Paragraphs 2., 3., 4., and 5. of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below, unless otherwise stated, and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with Paragraph 1. (Procedures) in Subsection D. (Administration) based on the corresponding [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) type definition and associated [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) request.

         3. This Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) expressly authorizes a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to use another housing incentive program as specified.
      2. ###### Relationship to Specific Plans Special Districts, and Special Zones


         As the Transit Oriented Incentive Program implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event of any difference between any provision in this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) and any provision in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provisions of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) shall prevail where a project applicant seeks approval through this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program).

      3. ###### Relationship to Other Zoning Provisions


         1. ###### General


            As this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) implements State Density Bonus law pursuant to [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3 (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), in the event of any difference between the provisions of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) and any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the provisions of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) shall prevail.

         2. ###### Relationship to Inclusionary Housing


            [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in order to meet the eligibility criteria for participation in the Transit Oriented Incentive Program may also be used in order to count toward the [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required by the Inclusionary Housing Program, pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.1. (Inclusionary Housing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.1), where applicable.
      4. ###### Relationship to State Density Bonus Law


         The Transit Oriented Incentive Program is intended to be consistent with State Density Bonus Law in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=). If at any time, the Transit Oriented Incentive Program becomes inconsistent with [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915-65918](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.3.&article=), as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provisions of State Density Bonus Law shall supersede the provisions in this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may prepare Implementation Memorandums, Technical Bulletins, and/or User Guides for the purposes of providing additional guidance on the implementation of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) and maintaining consistency with the State Density Bonus Law.
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      To be eligible for any base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, public benefits, or other [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in the Transit Oriented Incentive Program in Paragraphs 2. (Base Incentives) through Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits), below, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with all requirements provided in this Paragraph (Eligibility), as applicable, and provide any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in order to obtain any particular [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      1. ###### Unit Threshold


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must have a minimum of five or more [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. The units counted for purposes of this requirement includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), below.

      2. ###### Zoning


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of N or 1L.

      3. ###### Residential Uses


         A minimum of 2/3 of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including newly constructed [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and renovated or converted [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), must be dedicated to [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the units.

      4. ###### Transit Oriented Incentive Map


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be located on a lot for which a Transit Oriented Incentive Set has been mapped on the [Transit Oriented Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.16.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.16), or through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      5. ###### Affordability Levels


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall reserve the minimum percentage of its [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided for the Transit Oriented Incentive Program Set designated for the project lot, based on the housing market tier or opportunity area of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), subject to the affordability standards in Sub-subparagraphsi. through iv., below.

         1. ###### Single or Mixed Affordability Option


            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may opt to meet its affordability requirement by providing [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at rates determined by the methodology outlined in Sub-sub-subparagraph a) (Single Affordability Requirement), below, or the methodology described in Sub-subparagraph ii. (Mixed Affordability Options), below, or the methodology described in Sub-sub-subparagraph c) (Low Income Site Affordability Requirements), below, as applicable.

            1. Single Affordability Requirement

               A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) opting to use the Single Affordability Requirements table shall provide [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for one of the income levels listed in the table below in the “Income Levels” column at the corresponding percentage of total [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (all units including bonus units) for the applicable Transit Oriented Incentive Set and Market Tier for the project lot.




               | Single Affordability Requirements |
               | --- |
               | Mixed Income Incentive Set | Market Tiers | Income Levels |
               | Extremely Low Income | Very Low Income | Low Income |
               | T-3 | High Medium and High Market Tiers | 13% | 17% | 27% |
               | T-2 | 12% | 16% | 25% |
               | T-1 | 11% | 14% | 23% |
               | T-3 | Low and Medium Market Tiers | 11% | 15% | 25% |
               | T-2 | 10% | 14% | 23% |
               | T-1 | 9% | 12% | 21% |

            2. Mixed Affordability Requirements

               A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) using the Mixed Affordability Options shall provide [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at the percentages and in the combinations listed in the “Income Levels” columns in the following table, by applying the percentages to all project units (including bonus units). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall provide the percentages of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s associated with the opportunity area for the project lot, as specified by the California Tax Credit Allocation Committee (TCAC) opportunity area for the project lot. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) opting to use any of the Mixed Affordability Level Options must also provide at least one [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) containing four or more [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at the deepest affordability level required.




               | Mixed Affordability Options |
               | --- |
               | TCAC Opportunity Area | Income Levels |
               | Acutely low income | Extremely Low Income | Very Low Income | Moderate Income |
               | Moderate and Lower Opportunity Areas | - | 4% | 8% | - |
               | Higher Opportunity Areas | 4% | 4% | - | 12% |

            3. Low Income Site Affordability Requirements

               A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a site identified in [Sec. 1.5.15. (Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15) may meet its affordability requirement by providing 20 percent of its on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for lower income households, consistent with [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).
         2. ###### Transit Oriented Incentive Set Designation


            The applicable Transit Oriented Incentive Set shall be determined based on the designation shown on the Transit Oriented Incentive Map established in [Sec. 1.5.16. (Transit Oriented Incentive Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.16), or is mapped through a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. ###### Calculating Affordability Requirements


            In calculating the minimum percentage of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the percentage of each affordability level shall be based on the total [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) count, including [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted as a result of a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), below. Any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number, and not as specified in [Sec. 6C.1.2. (Lot Area Per Household Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.2) or [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area Per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3).

         4. ###### Housing Market Tier Designation


            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s housing market tier shall be determined by the residential market areas adopted by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) resolution, as described in [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3).

         5. ###### Rent and Housing Cost Schedules and Covenants


            The rate of housing costs or rent for any required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not exceed those specified in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5 (Affordable Housing Costs)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.) for for-sale units or [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50053](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50053.&nodeTreePath=37.1.2&lawCode=HSC) for rental units. Covenants documenting required rental or for sale rates shall be recorded pursuant to the procedures described in [Sec. 9.2.3.D.3. (Records and Agreements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3). [Restricted Affordable Unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s associated with [One Hundred Percent Affordable Housing Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall comply with the affordability specified in [Sec. 9.2.2.C.1.d.ii.a. (One Hundred Percent Affordable Housing Projects)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2).
      6. ###### Housing Replacement


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet any applicable housing replacement requirements and [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) protections established in [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15). Replacement [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall count toward any [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements.

      7. ###### Fair Housing Requirements


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet the applicable requirements regarding the size, location, amenities and allocation of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) and in any Implementation Memorandum or Technical Bulletin prepared and adopted by the Los Angeles Housing Department or [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      8. ###### Historic Resources


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requiring the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is defined in Subsection C. (Definitions) of Sec. 13B.8.1. (General Provisions), of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) identified for historic protection or special consideration or review by an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or Conservation District is not eligible for [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under the Transit Oriented Incentive Program.

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) involving the alteration of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be consistent with the Secretary of the Interior's Standards for Rehabilitation as supported by an expert study that has been accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, or demonstrated by the project plans and accepted by the Office of Historic Resources, if consistent with the applicable adopted Implementation Memorandum, Guidelines or Technical Bulletins of the Director of City Planning.
      9. ###### Unit Habitability Requirements


         For purposes of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program), the term “dwelling unit” or “unit” shall mean a complete independent living facility that includes permanent provisions for living, sleeping, eating, a kitchen, and sanitation. The term “dwelling unit” or “unit” in this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) shall not be a reference to a [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [shared housing unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or an [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
