A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) utilizing this [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with all dedication requirements under [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1) and complete all other required [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) improvements, including but not limited to sidewalk improvements, unless a Waiver of Dedication and Improvement is granted pursuant to [Sec. 10.1.10. (Waiver & Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall further be eligible for relief from some required dedication, where specified by [Sec. 10.2.1. (Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.2.1). Regardless of the above, any otherwise required dedication and improvement shall conform to the Street Dedication and Improvement Investigation Criteria adopted or amended pursuant to [Council File 22-1476](https://cityclerk.lacity.org/lacityclerkconnect/index.cfm?fa=ccfi.viewrecord&cfnumber=22-1476). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) subject to the procedures in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) shall not be eligible for this base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. ###### Additional Incentives


      In addition to the applicable base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), above, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted up to four additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in this Paragraph (Additional Incentives). Such a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may receive up to four [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) includes the applicable percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (excluding units added by a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)) that is necessary to obtain the maximum number of [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s available to an income category under [California Government Code Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), as listed on the table in [Sec. 9.2.1.C.3.a.i. (Allowed Number of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1). [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may use additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to deviate from a [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or requirement in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The four allowable additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be any combination of incentives listed in Subparagraph a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), below, and/or [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested under Subparagraph b. (Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives), below.

      1. ###### Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be granted requested incentives from the Menu of Additional Incentives listed in Sub-subparagraph i. (By-Right Adjustments) through Sub-subparagraph v. (Lot Width), below, pursuant to the procedures in [Sec. 9.2.5.D.1.a. (Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives on the Menu of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), below.

         1. ###### By-Right Adjustments


            Relief from any zoning standard that would otherwise require approval pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2) may be granted as an on-menu [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and shall not be subject to the requirements of [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2). Each adjustment-equivalent grant shall count as one [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) request. By-right adjustments shall not be granted in the following cases:

            1. A by-right adjustment shall not apply to standards that regulate [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), height, any modifications of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s standards, or for requests to allow parking in front of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            2. A by-right adjustment shall not apply to a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or a [non-contributor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
         2. ###### Averaging of Floor Area, Lot Amenity Space, Parking, and Density


            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is located on two or more abutting [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may average the maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum parking, and maximum density over the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provided that:

            1. The proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are permitted by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) of each area the proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s will be located; and

            2. A covenant running with the land is recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, and a copy is provided to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), that specifies no further lot line adjustment or any other action that may cause the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to be subdivided subsequent to this grant, is permitted for the life of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
         3. ###### Density Calculation


            Any area of any land required to be dedicated for street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) purposes may be included as [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for purposes of calculating the maximum density permitted by the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B).

         4. ###### Building Coverage


            Up to a 25 percent increase in [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limits is allowed.

         5. ###### Lot Width


            Up to 25 percent decrease in the required [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is allowed.
      2. ###### Incentives Not Listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may request [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s not listed in, or in excess of an [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed in, Subparagraph a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), above, subject to the approval process in [Sec. 9.2.5.D.1.b. (Projects Requesting Incentives Not on the Menu of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), below, with the exception of any modification listed in Sub-subparagraph ii., below.

         2. Modifications to the following standards or their equivalents in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), altering the criteria or level of relief allowed as outlined in Sub-subparagraph i. (By-Right Adjustments) of Subparagraph a. (Menu of Additional Incentives), above, shall not be granted as an additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) through this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) and are not eligible for approval through this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program). [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that seek these types of [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s not on the menu shall seek approval pursuant to the procedures, [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and other requirements in [Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).

            1. [Lot Amenity Space (Sec. 2C.3.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1);

            2. Any [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height restriction established in [Div. 2C.4. (Floor Area Ratio & Height)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4);

            3. Any upper story bulk limitations established in [Div. 2C.6. (Upper Story Bulk)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.6);

            4. [Building Width (Sec. 2C.5.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.5.1);

            5. [Building Setbacks (Sec. 2C.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2);

            6. [Ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) design requirements specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B); or

            7. [Required Trees (Sec. 4C.6.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.2).
4. ###### Waivers


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may request [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as defined in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), under [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives) Sec. 65915(e)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.) along with the additional incentives granted pursuant to Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), above, subject to the procedures in Sec. 9.2.5.D.1.c. (Projects Requesting Waivers), below.

5. ###### Public Benefits


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may access additional [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or height, or other modifications of standards by providing one or more public benefits, as described below. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s providing public benefits shall be reviewed and approved pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.5.D.1.d. (Projects Providing Public Benefits)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), below.

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may use the following public benefits options:

         1. [Sec. 9.3.4.C.3.b. (Public Benefits Incentive Set 2)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4).

         2. Public Benefits Menu

            A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) providing public benefits shall also be eligible to provide one or more of the public benefit options listed for the Public Benefits Incentive Set mapped for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [Public Benefits Incentive Map (Sec. 1.5.12.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.12). The mapped Public Benefits Incentive Set shall establish the [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height bonuses associated with each eligible public benefit option, pursuant to [Sec. 9.3.4. (Public Benefits Menu)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.4). Multiple public benefit options can be provided by one [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in order to combine and stack public benefit bonuses.
4. ##### Administration


1. ###### Procedures


      The following review and approval procedures apply to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Transit Oriented Housing Incentive Program. Ministerial approval in this Paragraph (Procedures) shall mean an administrative process to approve a “use by right” as this term is defined in [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).

      1. ###### Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only the base incentives outlined in [Sec. 9.2.5.C.2. (Base Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), above, or additional on-menu incentives as outlined in [Sec. 9.2.5.C.3.a. (Menu of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), above, and not requesting any [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under [Sec. 9.2.5.C.4. (Waivers)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5) or [off-menu incentives under Sec. 9.2.5.C.b. (Incentives Not listed on the Menu of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5) shall be subject to a ministerial approval process by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s approved by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with the additional standards in [Sec. 9.2.5.D.2.a. (Standards for Review for Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), below.

      2. ###### Projects Requesting Incentives Not on the Menu of Additional Incentives


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.5.C.3.b. (Incentives Not on the Menu of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5), above, shall be subject to a ministerial approval process pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2), and shall be granted subject to the standards outlined in Subparagraph a. (Standards for Review of Additional Incentives) of Paragraph 2. (Standards for Review and Required Findings), below. Such requests shall not be subject to any hearing procedures regardless of the provisions contained in [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2).

      3. ###### Projects Requesting Waivers


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as defined in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), under [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives) Sec. 65915(e)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.) along with the number of additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.3.C.3. (Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), above, shall be reviewed as follows:

         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only one [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to Paragraph 4. (Waivers) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be reviewed pursuant [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5).

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting more than one [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to Paragraph 4. (Waivers) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be reviewed pursuant [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3).

         3. Regardless of any provision of [Div. 13B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2), findings for [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be those in Subparagraph b. (Required Findings for Waivers) of Paragraph 2. (Standards for Review and Required Findings), in lieu of the findings in [Div. 13B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2); and [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requiring a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit are final at the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and are not appealable. [Waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requiring a Director Determination are appealable to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
      4. ###### Projects Providing Public Benefits


         [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requesting higher [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in exchange for providing one or more public benefits as outlined in Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, shall be ministerially approved pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2), and shall not be subject to any hearing procedures regardless of the provisions contained in [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2).

      5. ###### Other Discretionary Approvals


         Applicable procedures set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s seeking other discretionary approvals in conjunction with any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested pursuant to the Transit Oriented Incentive Program, including those listed in Paragraph 2. (Base Incentives), Paragraph 3. (Additional Incentives), Paragraph 4. (Waivers), or Paragraph 5. (Public Benefits) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above. Regardless of any other findings that may be applicable for the other discretionary approvals, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall approve the [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s requested pursuant to the Transit Oriented Incentive Program, subject to any procedures established in Paragraph 1. (Procedures), above, and standards established in Paragraph 2. (Standards for Review and Required Findings), below.

      6. ###### Density Bonuses, Incentives or Waivers Exceeding this Program


         Projects that seek additional [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) es, [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s beyond what is expressly allowed by this Section (Transit Oriented Housing Incentive Program), shall be reviewed pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), including the requirements and findings in [Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.e. (Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).
2. ###### Standards for Review and Required Findings


      1. ###### Standards for Review for Additional Incentives


         For the purposes of standards of review for additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘incentive’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(k)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). Additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s allowed pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.5.C.3. (Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5) shall be granted unless one of the following written findings are made, based upon substantial evidence:

         1. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not result in identifiable and actual cost reductions to provide for affordable housing costs as defined in [California Health and Safety Code Sec. 50052.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50052.5.), or for rents for the targeted units to be set as specified in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.); or

         2. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety or on any real property that is listed in the California Register of Historical Resources and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) without rendering the development unaffordable to [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Inconsistency with the zoning ordinance or [general plan land use designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not constitute a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon the public health or safety; or

         3. The [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would be contrary to state or federal law.
      2. ###### Required Findings for Waivers


         For the purposes of required findings for [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, ‘ [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’ shall be defined as in [California Government Code, Chapter 4.3. (Density Bonuses and Other Incentives), Sec. 65915(o)(2)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.). [Waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s allowed pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.5.C.4. (Waivers)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5) shall be approved by the applicable decision-making authority unless the decision-making authority makes one of the following findings, based on substantial evidence:

         1. The [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) associated with a request for a [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will not have the effect of physically precluding the construction of a development meeting the eligibility criteria described in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, at the densities or with the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and additional [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted under Subsection C. (Program Rules), above.

         2. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have a [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) upon public health and safety and for which there is no feasible method to satisfactorily mitigate or avoid the [specific adverse impact](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would have an adverse impact on any real property that is listed in the [California Register of Historical Resources](https://ohp.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=21238).

         4. The [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is contrary to state or federal law.
3. ###### Records and Agreements


      Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Transit Oriented Incentive Program and utilizing one or more [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program), covenants acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department and meeting the requirements in this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) and [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

4. ###### Vesting


      An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for an entitlement that was filed and fees paid prior to the date on which this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) becomes operative, shall be subject to all applicable provisions of this Chapter, including any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) menus or other provisions, that were in effect on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was filed and fees were paid. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall only be eligible for the incentives, procedures and other provisions of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program) if a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is filed and associated fees for the new filing are paid on or after the operative date of this Section (Transit Oriented Incentive Program).

### Sec. 9.2.6. Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program

The Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program is a map-based program for streamlining the review and approval of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s with at least 20 percent of the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s set aside for [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

1. ##### Intent


The Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program is intended to facilitate and incentivize the construction of affordable housing by establishing procedures, objective review criteria, and allowances for ministerial review as required by [California Government Code Sec. 65583.2(h)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Project Activities


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that meets the eligibility criteria established in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below, and consists of any of the [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) listed in Subparagraphs a. and b. below may be eligible for participation in the Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program:

      1. [New Construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which all new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility criteria outlined in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below; or

      2. A [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including retrofitting for accessibility purposes, for which all resulting new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and all renovated [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meet the eligibility criteria outlined in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), below
2. ###### Housing Development Project


      To participate in the Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) listed above must also meet the definition of “Housing Development Project” as defined in [California Government Code Sec. 65589.5(h)(2)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65589.5.), except that a [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall also include a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that involves no discretionary approvals and a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that includes a proposal to construct a single [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

3. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      1. ###### Relationship to Other Incentive Programs


         A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that seeks streamlining through this program pursuant to this Section (Housing Element Site Ordinance Streamlining Program) shall be eligible for a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), concession, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or reduction of [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65915.), or a local incentive program in this Article (Public Benefits System) or any [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provided that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the requirements for both the streamlining program and the applicable incentive program.

      2. ###### Relationship to Supplemental Districts and Special Zones


         If any provision of an applicable [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) conflicts with the procedures, requirements, and provisions of this Section (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program), the provisions of this Section (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program) shall prevail.

      3. ###### Relationship to Other Zoning Provisions


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided to meet the eligibility criteria for participation in the Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program may also be used to count toward any other applicable [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required for any other purpose.

      4. ###### Implementation Memoranda, FAQs, Forms/Applications and User Guides


         The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may prepare Implementation Memoranda, Technical Bulletins and/or User Guides related to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s implementation of state Housing Element law [(California Government Code, Article 10.6. (Housing Elements), Sec.65580 et seq.)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65580.) through the provisions of Chapter 1A of this Code, including, but not limited to, providing additional information for the purpose of maintaining consistency with state law.
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      An affordable housing [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meeting all of the following eligibility criteria shall qualify for participation in the Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program, including the streamlined review outlined in Paragraph 2. (Streamlined Review) below.

      1. ###### Affordability Levels


         At least 20 percent of the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in an eligible [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be made affordable and available to [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

      2. ###### Zoning


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) that specifies a minimum density requirement of “Applicable”, “Market-Contingent”, or “As Mapped”.

      3. ###### Mapped Lots


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) mapped on the [Prior Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.14.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.14) or [Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites Map (Sec. 1.5.15.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.15).

      4. ###### Housing Replacement


         The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall meet any applicable housing replacement requirements and demolition protections established in [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15). Replacement housing units required pursuant to [Div. 4C.15. (Resident Protections)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15) shall count toward any [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements.

      5. ###### Fair Housing Requirements


         [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet the applicable requirements regarding size, location, amenities, and allocation of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s established in [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) and in any Implementation Memorandum or Technical Bulletin prepared and adopted by the Los Angeles Housing Department or [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
2. ###### Streamlined Review


      1. ###### Administrative Review Process


         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that meets the eligibility criteria outlined in Paragraph 1. (Eligibility) above, shall be approved via Administrative Review, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) and consistent with [Gov. Code Sec. 65583.2(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65583.).

         2. An eligible [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that would have otherwise required a discretionary entitlement from the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to permit an owner-occupied or rental multifamily residential dwelling use shall be subject to and processed through an Expanded Administrative Review, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.2. (Expanded Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.2). Any [non-residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in an eligible mixed-use [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall comply with any discretionary review required for that [non-residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) under the Code, or any plan or overlay adopted under the Code. In no case shall Project Review pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4) be required for an eligible [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. ###### Supplemental Procedures


            Despite the provisions of [Sec. 13B.3.1.H. (Modification of Action)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Housing Element streamlining program and approved via Administrative Review, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) may request a modification of action only as allowed under [California Government Code Sec. 65913.4(h)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65913.4.).
      2. ###### Exceptions


         1. If a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is requesting a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) process shall not be streamlined pursuant to Sec. 9.2.6. (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program) and shall be subject to all applicable review procedures and laws, including those outlined in [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) and [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7). The part of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting an entitlement outside of [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7) may be streamlined pursuant to this Section (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program).

         2. A [non-residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is not permitted by-right by the applied [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), including those requiring a Class 1 Conditional Use Permit, Class 2 Conditional Use Permit, or Class 3 Conditional Use Permit, or that requires discretionary review pursuant to an applicable special use program outlined in [Div. 5C.3. (Special Use Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3) shall not be streamlined and shall be subject to the otherwise applicable review procedures.

         3. Any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a density increase in excess of the base [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that requires review under [Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.e. (Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1) shall not be eligible for the streamlined review in Subparagraph a. (Administrative Review Process) above and shall be processed pursuant to the provisions of [Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.e. (Projects with Requests for Density Bonuses in Excess of the Base Incentive)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).
4. ##### Administration


1. ###### Procedures


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program shall be reviewed and approved via the streamlined process established in Paragraph 2. (Streamlined Review) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above.

2. ###### Records & Agreement


      Prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program, covenants acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department and meeting the requirements in this Section (Housing Element Sites Streamlining Program) and [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

## Div. 9.3. Community Benefits Program

### Sec. 9.3.1. Community Benefits Program Structure

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Division (Community Benefits Program) is to promote the production of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and improvements, facilities, resources, and services for the benefit and enjoyment of the general public.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section (Community Benefits Program Structure) shall apply to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) using an incentive program that meets all of the following requirements:

1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meets the eligibility requirements in Subsection C. (Eligibility), below;

2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is providing the percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required in [Sec. 9.3.2. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2), or public benefits required pursuant to a program established in this Division (Community Benefits Program); and

3. The applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) provides for [tier 1 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [tier 1 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. ##### Eligibility


A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may obtain incentives pursuant to this Division (Community Benefits Program) subject to the allowances and requirements provided below:

1. ###### Residential Projects


      1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that involves the construction of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s must use the incentive program in [Sec. 9.3.2. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2) to its fullest extent. For purposes of this Subparagraph (Residential Projects), to its fullest extent means the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provides the number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to qualify for the maximum density increase allowed by the applicable local incentive program set in [Sec. 9.3.2.B.1. (Local Incentive Program Sets)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2).

      2. Calculation of the maximum density increase allowed and number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required shall be based on the [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      3. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that involves dwelling units with unused [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height based on the [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) available in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), may use the remaining development potential using one of the methods below, up to the maximum allowed by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B):

         1. ###### Additional Restricted Affordable Units


            Providing additional [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s above the minimum percentage required to qualify for the maximum density increase of the applicable affordable housing program. The amount of additional [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height provided for additional percentages of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be determined by the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         2. ###### Public Benefits Incentive Programs


            Using one or more of the programs established in this Division (Community Benefits Program) for additional public benefits other than [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, if available as incentive programs in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
2. ###### Non-Residential Projects


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which does not involve the construction of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may use any of the programs established in this Division (Community Benefits Program) that incentivize public benefits other than [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Additional [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height may be awarded up to the maximum [tier 1 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [tier 1 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), as established in this Section (Community Benefits Program Structure) and in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

### Sec. 9.3.2. Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of the Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program is to encourage the creation and development of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s citywide beyond the levels encouraged by the State [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) program, and to increase the production of affordable housing units in specific areas identified in the applicable Community Plan or other plan or ordinance.

2. ##### Eligibility


A [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that includes the minimum percentage of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required by Paragraph 1\. (Local Incentive Program Sets) below, provides the required housing replacement units in Paragraph 2. (Housing Replacement) below, or pursuant to [Chapter XV., Article 1. (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195170#JD_C15A1) of this Code, and meets the additional eligibility requirements for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in the applicable CPIO or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), if any, is entitled to receive all of the incentives in Subsection C. (Base Incentives) below, and additional incentives as outlined in Subsection D. (Additional Incentives) below.

1. ###### Local Incentive Program Sets


      1. ###### Established


         Local Incentive Program Sets A through G are established below, and define the minimum percentage of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s required.




         | Local Incentive Program Sets |
         | --- |
         | Set | Affordability Requirements |
         | Acutely low Income | Extremely Low Income | Very Low Income | Lower Income | Moderate |
         | A | n/a | 11% | 15% | 25% | n/a |
         | B | n/a | 11% | 15% | 25% | n/a |
         | C | n/a | 10% | 14% | 23% | n/a |
         | D | n/a | 10% | 14% | 23% | n/a |
         | E | n/a | 9% | 12% | 21% | n/a |
         | F | n/a | 8% | 11% | 20% | n/a |
         | G | 7% | 8% | 11% | 20% | 40% |

      2. ###### Local Incentive Program Set Designation


         The applicable Local Incentive Program Set shall be determined based on the designation shown on the Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map established in [Sec. 1.5.4. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.4), or in the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      3. ###### Calculating Affordability Requirements


         In calculating the minimum percentage of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the percentage of each affordability level shall be based on the total final [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) count. Any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number, and not as specified in [Sec. 6C.1.2. (Lot Area Per Household Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.2) or [Sec. 6C.1.3. (Lot Area Per Efficiency Dwelling Unit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6C.1.3).

      4. ###### Ownership Requirement


         [Moderate income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be for sale only. [Restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s of all other affordability levels may be rental or for sale units.

      5. ###### Linkage Fee Calculation


         For the purpose of the fee established in [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), a minimum of seven percent [acutely low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be calculated in the same manner as a minimum of eight percent [extremely low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.
2. ###### Housing Replacement


      A [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must meet any applicable housing replacement requirements of [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(c)(3)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV). Consistent with [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(c)(3)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV), [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that are subject to [Chapter XV. (Rent Stabilization) of the LAMC](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195151) and [California Government Code Sec. 65915(c)(3)(C](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV)) and that are also deemed or presumed to be occupied by persons or families above the lower income category shall be replaced with low income units pursuant to [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(c)(3)(C)(i)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV), as determined by the Los Angeles Housing Department.
3. ##### Base Incentives


A [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that includes the minimum amount of on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Paragraph 1. (Local Incentive Program Sets) of Subsection B. (Eligibility) above, shall be entitled to the following base incentives.

1. ###### Residential Density


      1. [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be granted an increase in the maximum allowable [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) density as follows:



         |     |     |     |     |     |     |     |     |
         | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
         | Residential Density Incentive |
         | Density District | Allowable Density Increase |
         | Set A | Set B | Set C | Set D | Set E | Set F | Set G |
         | 2, 3, 4 | 80% | 80% | 70% | 70% | 60% | 50% | 40% |
         | 6, 8 | 80% | 70% | 70% | 60% | 60% | 50% | 40% |
         | 10, 12 | 60% | 60% | 50% | 50% | 45% | 45% | 35% |
         | 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60 | 45% | 40% | 40% | 40% | 35% | 35% | 35% |
         | 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, FA | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a |

      2. [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that consist of 100 percent on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, exclusive of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or units, shall be permitted an additional increase in density of 10 percentage points more than listed in Subparagraph a. above. For example, a 50 percent density increase will become a 60 percent density increase.
2. ###### Floor Area Ratio


      1. [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be entitled to the portion of [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted in the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), up to the maximum [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

      2. [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that consist of 100 percent on-site [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, exclusive of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or units, shall be permitted an additional 10 percent more of maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) than listed Subparagraph a. above or in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B). However, in no instance shall the [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) exceed an [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of 13:1.
3. ###### Height


      [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be entitled to use the entire [bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) (if any) allowed by the applied Form District.

4. ###### Automobile Parking Incentives


      1. [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall qualify for reduced [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) parking according to the table below. The applicable Automobile Parking Incentive shall be determined based on the designation shown on the Local Affordable Housing Incentive Map established in [Sec. 1.5.4. However, the number a [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is entitled to, and the type of additional incentives may be superseded by a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

1. ###### Density Calculation


      Any area of any land required to be dedicated for street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) purposes may be included as [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for purposes of calculating the maximum density permitted by the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B).

2. ###### Building Coverage


      Up to a 25 percent increase in [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limits.

3. ###### Lot Width


      Up to 25 percent decrease in the required [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

4. ###### Averaging of Floor Area, Lot Amenity Space, Parking, & Density


      A [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is located on two or more contiguous [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may average the maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), minimum parking, and maximum density over the [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) site, provided that:

      1. The proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are permitted by the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of each [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#); and

      2. A covenant running with the land is recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, and a copy is provided to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, that specifies no further [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) adjustment or any other action may cause the [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) site to be subdivided subsequent to this grant, is permitted for the life of the [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
5. ###### CPIO Additional Incentives


      Additional incentives (if any), and eligibility requirements for additional incentives, shall be outlined in the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
5. ##### Process


The following procedures apply to [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, but may be superseded by a Specific Plan, Supplemental District, or Special Zone:

1. ###### Base and Additional Incentives


      A [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requesting only the base incentives in Subsection C. (Base Incentives) above, and additional incentives outlined in Subsection D. (Additional Incentives) above, or in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), shall follow the procedures in [Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.a. (Projects Requesting Base Incentives & Incentives from the Menu of Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).

2. ###### Additional Incentives


      Housing development projects requesting additional incentives outlined in Subsection D. (Additional Incentives) above, or in the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall follow the procedures in [Sec. 9.2.1.F.2. (Projects Requesting Additional Incentives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).

3. ###### Off-Menu Incentives


      [Housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that qualify for incentives by meeting the minimum required percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as outlined in Paragraph 1. (Local Incentive Program Sets) of Subsection B. (Eligibility) above, and for which the applicant requests an off-menu incentive, [waiver](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or modification of any [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) standard or [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B) standard that is not included in the incentives outlined in Subsection C. (Base Incentives) above, or Subsection D. (Additional Incentives) above, must be approved pursuant to [Sec. 9.2.1.D.1.c. (Projects with Requests for Waivers)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).

4. ###### Records and Agreement


      Prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the applicant shall record a covenant acceptable to the [LAHD](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that reserves and maintains the total combined number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s designated as restricted affordable for at least 55 or 99 years pursuant to [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) from the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

### Sec. 9.3.4. Public Benefits Menu

1. ##### Intent


The purpose of this Section (Public Benefits Menu), the “Public Benefits Menu,” is to encourage the development of facilities and services that are necessary to or are of benefit to the public and the community in which the facility or service is located. The Public Benefits Menu provides a centralized and standardized list of beneficial facilities and services that other incentive programs can point to in order to activate the provision of public facilities and services that are appropriate for the goals and needs of each program or community.

2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Project Activities


      As the Public Benefits Menu is enabled and activated by various incentive programs throughout this Article (Public Benefit Systems), [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, the [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicable to the use of the Public Benefits Menus shall be those [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed for the incentive program, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) being utilized by the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

2. ###### Reconciling Provisions


      As the Public Benefits Menu is enabled and activated by various different incentive programs throughout this Article (Public Benefit Systems), [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, any conflict between the provisions of this Section and conflicting provisions in any [Zoning District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or other zoning provision shall be resolved pursuant to the reconciling provisions established for the incentive program, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), being utilized by the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. ##### Program Rules


1. ###### Eligibility


      A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be authorized by an incentive program in this Article (Public Benefit Systems), or in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), to be eligible to receive incentives in the Public Benefits Menu in exchange for providing public benefits.

2. ###### Incentives

If the option to provide public benefits is enabled by an incentive program in this Article (Public Benefit Systems) or in an applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be awarded additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) up to the maximum [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), by providing one or more of the public benefits options in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets), below, or by providing an alternative community facility pursuant to Sec. 9.3.1.D.1.b. (Alternative Public Benefit Options), below.

In order to qualify for additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height pursuant to this Section (Public Benefits Menu), a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is only eligible to use the public benefits options listed in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets), below, for the Public Benefits Incentive Set mapped for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [Public Benefits Incentive Map (Sec.1.5.12.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.12), or for the Public Benefits Incentive Set specified within an applicable incentive program.

However, the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not exceed the maximum [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) allowed by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) or applicable [Alternative Typology (Part 7B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/7#7B), except where permitted in [Sec. 2C.4.1.C.3. (Tier 2 Bonus)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.1), [Sec. 2C.4.2.C.3. (Tier 2 Bonus)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.2), or [Sec. 2C.4.3.C.2.b. (Tier 2 Bonus)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.4.3).

4. ###### Public Benefits Options


      In order to qualify for any [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provided in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets) above, or an applicable [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) program in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), which refers to this Section (Public Benefits Menu), any public benefits option included in a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must meet all the applicable requirements provided below.

      01. ###### Childcare Facility


          1. The childcare facility shall comply with all requirements of [California Code of Regulations, Title 22 (Social Security), Division 12 (Child Care Facility Licensing Regulations), Chapter 1 (Child Care Center General Licensing Requirements)](https://cdss.ca.gov/ord/entres/getinfo/pdf/ccc7.pdf).

          2. The childcare facility shall be appropriately licensed by the [California Department of Social Services](https://www.cdss.ca.gov/).

          3. [Floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) used as a childcare facility shall be used for such purpose for a minimum of 55 years after the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is issued. For the purposes of this provision, the time in which the childcare facility space is vacant does not count towards the required minimum.

          4. A minimum 10-year lease with a licensed childcare provider, with a five-year renewal option, shall be required prior to the issuance of a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). This requirement does not mean that the licensed childcare provider is required to complete the term of the lease. If the lease is not completed prior to the 10-year term, the property owner or their representative shall find a new licensed childcare provider to complete the ten-year term. For the purposes of this provision, the time in which the childcare facility space is vacant does not count towards the required minimum.

          5. The [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) devoted to a childcare facility shall be located on-site.

          6. For a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is obtaining additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for providing a childcare facility, no other [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be issued prior to a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the childcare facility required pursuant to this Section (Public Benefits Menu).

          7. Notwithstanding the Public Benefit available under this Subparagraph (Child Care Facility), pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65915 (h)(3)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml), a [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or incentive for a childcare facility shall not be provided if it is found, based on substantial evidence, that the community has adequate childcare facilities.
      02. ###### Full-Service Grocery Store


          1. The [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall have at least 10,000 square feet of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

          2. At least 25 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be dedicated to perishable food items.

          3. The [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall accept EBT or other forms of government assistance.

          4. [Floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) used as a [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be used for such purpose for a minimum of 55 years after the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is issued. For the purposes of this provision, the time in which the [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) space is vacant does not count towards the required minimum.

          5. A minimum 10-year lease with a [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), with a five-year renewal option, shall be required prior to the issuance of a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). This requirement does not mean that the [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is required to complete the term of the lease. If the lease is not completed prior to the 10-year term, the property owner or their representatives shall find a new [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to complete the 10-year term. For the purposes of this provision, the time in which the [full-service grocery store](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) space is vacant does not count towards the required minimum.

      08. ###### Multi-Bedroom Units


          For the purposes of this public benefit option, a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with four or more [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be considered a multi-bedroom unit, and calculations of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for purposes of this Subparagraph (Multi-Bedroom Units) resulting in fractional numbers shall be rounded up to the next whole number. The applicant and property owner shall execute a covenant in favor of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is recorded in the development site’s chain of title in order to guarantee the qualifying multi-bedroom units will maintain the same bedroom count and will not be converted to additional residential units in the future.

          1. ###### Multi-Bedroom Option A


             At least ten percent of the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (including bonus units) in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be multi-bedroom units. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting this criterion shall be granted the additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height allowances listed for multi-bedroom “Option A” in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets), above.

          2. ###### Multi-Bedroom Option B


             One or more dwelling units in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) (including bonus units) shall be multi-bedroom units; however, additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) granted for this multi-bedroom public benefit is only equivalent to the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) dedicated to multi-bedroom units, as the additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height allowances are outlined for multi-bedroom “Option B” in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets), above.

          3. ###### Multi-Bedroom Option C


             At least 40 percent of the total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s (including bonus units) in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be multi-bedroom units. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting this criterion shall be granted the additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and height allowances listed for multi-bedroom “Option C” in Paragraph 3. (Public Benefits Incentive Sets), above.

          01. The entire [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space shall comply with the requirements in [Sec. 2C.3.3.C.3. (Public Amenity Space)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.3), including making the open space permanently and physically open to the public for use free of charge between sunrise and sunset, or during regular business hours, whichever is longer.

          02. The [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space shall be, at minimum, equal to or greater than the size of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s minimum required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) area required by the applied Form District, including any pedestrian amenity exemption.

This provision may not be used in conjunction with the 25 percent reduction for making outdoor amenity space [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in accordance with [Sec. 2C.3.1.D.3. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.3.1). If the applied Form District does not specify a [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirement, the [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space shall be, at minimum, equal to or greater than 15 percent of the total [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

          04. All portions of the [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space shall be contiguous, whether located [at-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or at an [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

          05. Any access walkways to the privately owned public space from the [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be a minimum of seven feet wide.

          06. If a publicly accessible open space is located along a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), one entrance to the privately owned public space shall be provided from each [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

          07. Along a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space shall be [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as established in [Sec. 14.2.4.A.2. (Unenclosed)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

          08. When additional a public facility in conjunction with a [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space is required, and is not provided within the open space, access to the public facility shall be provided from the adjacent [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

          09. Way-finding signs shall be provided at each of the access points, whether externally or internally, located on or in the building, to guide people to the publicly accessible open space. Standards include the following:

              1. Minimum sign dimension, no less than 16 inches by 20 inches;

              2. Required posting of the hours of operation; and

              3. Mandatory language regarding public access.
          10. The [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) open space complies with any additional requirements set forth in the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

4. ##### Administration


1. ###### Process


      1. ###### Administrative Review


         A [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height incentive granted for the provision of a public benefits option included in Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), shall be approved using the procedures in [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), unless otherwise specified by the applicable incentive program [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      2. ###### Alternative Public Benefit Options


         The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of Planning may approve a [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height incentive provided in the applicable Public Benefits Incentive Set or applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for providing public benefit options that are not listed in Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) of Subsection C, (Program Rules) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5).

         1. ###### Supplemental Findings


            In addition to the findings required by [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5), to approve an incentive for an alternative public benefit option, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of Planning must also find that the alternative public benefit option will enhance the built environment or quality of life in the surrounding neighborhood and will perform a function or provide a service that is essential or beneficial to the community.
      3. ###### Change in Operator or Provider


         The property owner shall notify the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in the event a change in operator or provider for a public benefit occurs. The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall approve any change in tenant pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

         1. ###### Exceptions


            1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or those portions of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), which provided contributions pursuant to Sec. 9.3.4.C.8. (Community Benefits Fund) shall not be subject to this notification and approval requirement.

            2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the [State Density Bonus Program (Sec. 9.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), the [Corridors Transitions Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4), or the Transit Oriented Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.5.) shall not be subject to this notification and approval requirement for public benefits options listed in Sec. 9.3.4.C.3.a. (Public Benefits Set 1) or Sec. 9.3.4.C.3.b. (Public Benefits Set 2).

            3. In the event that the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) declares a fiscal emergency, property owners will not be required to have an operator or provider for public benefits for the duration of the emergency.
      4. ###### Annual Reporting


         [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that provide public benefits shall demonstrate compliance with the terms required under Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) of Subsection C. (Program Rules) by the property owner submitting an annual report, the “Annual Community Public Benefits Report,” to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         1. ###### Annual Community Public Benefits Report


            The Annual Community Facilities Report shall include all of the following information:

            1. Occupancy status of the development over the last year.

            2. Occupancy status of the public benefit over the last year.

            3. Type of public benefit options provided.

            4. Evidence showing compliance with the requirements of Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) of Subsection C. (Program Rules).
         2. ###### Non-Compliance


            If the Director of City Planning determines after reviewing the Annual Community Public Benefits Report, or at any other time, a property is non-compliant with the requirements in Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options), of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may notice the property owner that the 55-year term of compliance has been extended consistent with the requirements of Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) and/or request the City Attorney’s Office to take legal action against the owner to enforce the terms of the covenant recorded pursuant to Paragraph 2. (Records and Agreements), below.

         3. ###### Review


            The Department of City Planning shall review the Annual Community Facilities Public Benefits Report pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

         4. ###### Exceptions


            1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or those portions of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), that provided contributions pursuant to Sec. 9.3.4.C.8. (Community Benefits Fund) shall not be subject to the annual report requirement.

            2.
