A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) participating in the [State Density Bonus Program (Sec. 9.2.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), the [Affordable Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.2), the [Opportunity Corridors Housing Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.3), the [Corridors Transitions Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.4), or the [Transit Oriented Incentive Program (Sec. 9.2.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.5) shall not be subject to this annual report requirement for public benefits options listed in Sec. 9.3.4.C.3.a. (Public Benefits Set 1) or Sec. 9.3.4.C.3.b. (Public Benefits Set 2).

            3. In the event that the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) declares a fiscal emergency, [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s will not be subject to annual report requirements during the duration of the emergency.
      5. ###### Fine


         If a property owner is found in violation of any of the applicable standards for the public benefits options in Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), above, the property owner shall be subject to an administrative fine pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.2.04. (Administrative Fines)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225936#JD_11.2.04.) of this Code.

         1. ###### Exceptions


            1. This fine shall not be imposed for public schools or public libraries after the first lease agreement has been filed with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

            2. This fine shall not be imposed in the event that the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) declares a fiscal emergency for the duration of the emergency.
         2. ###### Administration of Fine


            This fine shall be administered in accordance with the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1.2. (Administrative Citations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225704) of this Code, including but not limited to the appeal in [Sec. 11.2.08. (Appeal of the Administrative Citation)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-225866).
2. ###### Records and Agreements


      Prior to issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) obtaining [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under this Section (Public Benefits Menu), a covenant acceptable to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, guaranteeing that the applicant, tenant, or property owner will dedicate [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) within the development for public benefits for the periods outlined in Paragraph 4. (Public Benefits Options) of Subsection C. (Program Rules), and will submit annual reporting to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a manner consistent with Sec. 9.3.4.D.1.c. (Annual Reporting), above.

### Sec. 9.3.5. Transfer of Development Rights Programs

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Transfer of Development Rights Programs) is to allow for a [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to establish a transfer of development rights program to facilitate the preservation of historically or culturally significant [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and resources or to encourage the accumulation of land for [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as public parks, while enabling development rights to be used on more appropriate sites.

2. ##### Applicability


If the transfer of development rights is listed as an available incentive program in the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) can obtain additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) up to the maximum [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) through a transfer of development rights, subject to the eligibility requirements and other regulations established in the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). However, [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with an applied Public Use District can obtain additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) beyond the maximum [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) when the transfer is from a donor site with an applied Public Use District up to a maximum of 13:1 [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), but may not exceed any applied height restrictions.

3. ##### Eligibility


A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is eligible to use the transfer of development rights program if the [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) establishes donor sites (if any) that are eligible to transfer unused [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), up to the maximum [bonus FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), and receiver sites that may receive some or all available unused [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from the donor sites. As part of the transfer of development rights program, the applicable [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall establish the applicable rules of transfer needed to implement the program.

4. ##### Process


To use a transfer of development rights, an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be filed pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.5. (Director Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.5). The [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall establish additional supplemental procedures in order to facilitate the transfers and their successful implementation.

5. ##### Records & Agreements


A [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall establish any requirements for required records, such as covenants or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and any other agreements necessary to implement the transfers.


## Div. 9.4. General Incentive Programs

### Sec. 9.4.1. Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program

1. ##### Purpose


1. The purpose of this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program) is to facilitate the expedient production of [supportive housing: general](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units meeting the established definitions and regulations, or [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, in order to provide high-quality, well-serviced and affordable housing units which are responsive to the needs of the [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

2. This Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program) is intended to facilitate construction or maintenance of [supportive housing: general](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) units pursuant to a ministerial approval process in conformance with the State [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provisions in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV). [Qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are those that meet the following objectives:

      1. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s should be located at [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that are accessible by public transit, including paratransit.

      2. Individual [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s should be provided with basic amenities that are sufficient to support independent living.

      3. Sufficient non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), as determined in Paragraph 3. (Supportive Services) below, should be made available on the subject property to provide the appropriate level of [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to the resident [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. The purpose of this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program) is also intended to maintain the standards in Ordinance numbers [185,489](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-1432_ORD_185489_04-20-2018.pdf) and [185,492](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-1422_ORD_185492_05-28-2018.pdf) for purposes of the exemption from [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in [California Public Resources Code, Sec. 21080.2](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=21080.2.&lawCode=PRC).
2. ##### Eligibility


In order for a [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to be eligible for this Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program, it must comply with the following requirements:

1. ###### Use of Other Residential Incentive Programs


      A [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applying for another incentive program established in [Div. 9.2. (Affordable Housing Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2), [Sec. 9.3.2. (Local Affordable Housing Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.3.2), or affordable housing incentive provisions in any other [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) at the same location, shall not be eligible for approval.

2. ###### Affordable Housing Requirements


      Rents or housing costs to the occupying [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s do not exceed 30 percent of the maximum gross income of [extremely low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [very low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or [low income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as those income ranges are defined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), or any successor agency, as verified by the [LAHD](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). A minimum of 50 percent of the total combined [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s is occupied by the [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

3. ###### Supportive Services


      Applicants shall provide documentation describing the [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that will be provided on-site and off-site. Prior to any approval of a [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the applicant shall submit information demonstrating that [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will be provided to [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The applicant shall indicate the name of the entity or entities that will provide the [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [local public agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) funding source(s) for those services, and proposed staffing levels. If a preliminary funding commitment is needed, the applicant shall also submit a signed letter of intent from the [local public agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) verifying that it is providing a preliminary funding commitment for the [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). If no funding commitment is needed, the applicant shall demonstrate that the entity or entities that will provide the [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) are service providers pre-qualified by the relevant a [local public agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) used for the delivery of [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be considered incidental to the [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

4. ###### Housing Replacement


      [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall meet any applicable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) replacement requirements of [Sec. 4C.15.1. (Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.1) or [Sec. 4C.15.2. (Non-Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.2). Consistent with [Sec. 4C.15.1. (Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.1) or [Sec. 4C.15.2. (Non-Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.2), [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that are subject to [Chapter XV. (Rent Stabilization)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195151) of this Code and [Sec. 4C.15.1. (Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.1) or [Sec. 4C.15.2. (Non-Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.2) and that are also deemed or presumed to be occupied by persons or families above the lower income category shall be replaced pursuant to [Sec. 4C.15.1. (Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.1) or [Sec. 4C.15.2. (Non-Housing Projects that Result in the Demolition of Dwelling Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.2), as determined by the [LAHD](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and all applicable monitoring fees in [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) shall be paid by the applicant prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

5. ###### Performance Standards


      1. ###### Location Requirement


         The [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be located within a High Quality Transit Area for the horizon year in the current Regional Transportation Plan/Sustainable Communities Strategy for the Southern California Association of Governments region.

      2. ###### Supportive Services


         Non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be provided for on-site [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in the following amounts:

         1. For [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s with 20 or fewer total combined [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, no less than 90 square feet of dedicated office space shall be provided; or

         2. For [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s with greater than 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, a minimum of three percent of the total [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be dedicated for on-site [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provided solely to on-site [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, including but not limited to community rooms, case management offices, computer rooms, or a community kitchen.
      3. ###### Dwelling Unit Requirements


         Each [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall have a private bathroom and cooking facilities containing, at minimum, a sink, refrigerator, counter space, and a hotplate or microwave.

      4. ###### Historical Resources


         The [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not involve a [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
3. ##### Incentives


The grant of any incentives under this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program) shall not be considered an increase in density or other change which requires any corresponding zone change, [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) amendment, [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or other discretionary action.

1. ###### Base Incentives


      A [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meeting the requirements in Subsection B. (Eligibility) above is eligible for the following base incentives:

      1. ###### Minimum Lot Area per Dwelling Unit


         In all [Density Districts (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), except for 1L and 15, the number of allowable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be subject to the otherwise maximum density under any applicable ordinance or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). On any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in Density District 15, the minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be 500 square feet.

      2. ###### Parking


         The following requirements shall apply to all [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s:

         1. Up to 40 percent of the total required parking spaces may be provided by compact stalls.

         2. No parking spaces shall be required for [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s restricted to the [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s located within 1/2-mile of a transit stop, no more than 1/2 parking spaces shall be required for each income-restricted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) not occupied by the [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Otherwise, no more than one parking space shall be required for each [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) not occupied by the [target population](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         4. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s located within a 1/2-mile of a [major transit stop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), no parking shall be required.

         5. One parking space for every 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be required for the purpose of accommodating guests, [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and case management.

         6. Parking reductions offered for [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall always be consistent or greater than those in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(p)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV).

         7. If the parking requirements applicable to the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to [Div. 4C.4. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4) are less than the parking required in this Subparagraph (Parking), an applicant may use the parking requirements of [Div. 4C.4. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4).
      3. ###### Floor Area


         Areas designated exclusively for [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) use or public areas accessible to all [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, including those for [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) uses, shall not be considered as [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the purposes of calculating the total allowable [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be measured to the center line of [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) partitions between public and non-public areas.

      4. ###### Conversion or Replacement of Existing Residential Hotel Use


         Despite the provisions of the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) developed pursuant to this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program) shall be permitted when the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is converted from, or is a replacement of a Residential Hotel as defined in [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.73.S. (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205208) of this Code, and is a continuation of an existing [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The replacement shall comply with the provisions of [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Article 7.1. (Residential Hotel Unit Conversion and Demolition)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205147) of this Code, as approved by the Los Angeles Housing Department. The total number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be increased as part of the conversion or replacement. This Subparagraph (Conversion or Replacement of Existing Residential Hotel Use) shall not apply to a Residential Hotel located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in Density District 20 or more restrictive.
2. ###### Additional Incentives


      A [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) meeting the requirements in Sec. 9.4.1.B. (Eligibility) is eligible for any combination of up to five additional incentives described below, as applicable.

      1. ###### Yard


         A [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may obtain up to a 20 percent decrease in any required [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and all adjustments to individual [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be combined to count as one incentive, except that:

         1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must still provide [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) sufficient in compliance with the landscape requirements of the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) per [Sec. 3C.3.1. (Frontage Planting Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.1) and any applicable standards from [Div. 4C.6. (Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6).

         2. No reduction is permitted along a property line [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) a property in Density District 1L or any Open Space Use District.

         3. In Residential Use Districts, the resulting [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setback may not be less than the average of the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setbacks, as measured to the main [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), of [adjoining lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s along the same street face. If located on a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to a [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) setback may align with the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) along the same [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and may result in more or less than a 20 percent decrease in the required [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). If there are no [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, no reduction is permitted.
      2. ###### Building Coverage


         Up to a 20 percent increase in [building coverage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limits, provided that the [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is sufficient to provide 10 percent more landscaping than otherwise required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) per [Sec. 3C.3.1. (Frontage Planting Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.1) and any applicable standards from [Div. 4C.6. (Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6).

      3. ###### Floor Area Ratio


         1. Up to a 35 percent increase in the base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         2. On [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Density District 15, up to a 20 percent increase in the base [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. Regardless of the [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) established by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), [FAR](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) not to exceed 3:1, provided the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is in a Commercial-Mixed Use District.
      4. ###### Height


         Up to a 35 percent increase in the maximum allowable [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), applicable over the entire [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regardless of any of the lower underlying height limits. In any [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) in which the [height in stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is limited, this provision shall permit a maximum height increase of one additional [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of up to eleven feet. For the purposes of this height incentive, other transitional height requirements in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall not apply. In their place, the following transitional height requirements shall be applied:

         1. When [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to or across an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within Density District 1L or 2L, the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)'s height shall be stepped back within a 45-degree angle as measured from a point 25 feet [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) at the property line.

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.5.0/9.4.1.1.png.webp?itok=M_IVkGuk)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.5.0/9.4.1.1.png?itok=6_zPR2_m)

         2. On [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Density District 15, when [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to or across an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) from [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Density District 1L or 2L, the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)'s height shall be stepped back within a 45-degree angle as measured from a point 20 feet [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) at the property line.

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.5.0/9.4.1.3.png.webp?itok=22lMM9z6)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.5.0/9.4.1.3.png?itok=Moe7pRUs)
      5. ###### Lot Amenity Space & Residential Amenity Space


         Up to a 20 percent decrease in the required [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provided that the [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is sufficient to provide 10 percent more [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) than otherwise required by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) per [Sec. 3C.3.1. (Frontage Planting Area)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.3.1) and any applicable standards from [Div. 4C.6. (Plants)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6).

      6. ###### Averaging of Floor Area Ratio, Parking


         A [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is located on two or more contiguous [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may average the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and parking over the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provided that:

         1. The proposed [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is permitted by the applied zone for each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#); and

         2. No further [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) adjustment or any other action that may cause the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) site to be subdivided subsequent to this grant shall be permitted.
      7. ###### Ground Floor Use


         Where non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is required by this Code, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), community plan, or other set of standards, that requirement may be satisfied by any active [ground floor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) such as community rooms, [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) amenities, [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) areas, or [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      8. ###### Other Development Standard


         Up to 20 percent relief may be granted from one other "development standard" not described in this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program), as that term is defined in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV).
4. ##### Process


1. ###### Qualified Permanent Supportive Housing Projects Meeting All Applicability Requirements


      To use an incentive, as outlined is Subsection C. (Incentives) above, an applicant must file pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1.(Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

      1. ###### Application Material


         All [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be reviewed for compliance with the provisions in this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program), eligibility requirements in Subsection B. (Eligibility) above, and compliance with the applicable incentive standards in Subsection C. (Incentives) above. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be approved by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) if the standards of this Section (Permanent Supportive Housing Incentive Program) are met.

      2. ###### Notification of Application


         Despite the provisions of [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1), the following requirements shall be completed at least 30 days prior to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) approval of the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#):

         1. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall send written notices of the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) by U.S. mail to the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) property owners, applicable Neighborhood Council and the Council District Office of the site; and

         2. The applicant shall post, in a conspicuous place near the entrance of the property, a public notice of the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The applicant shall submit proof of posting to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), which includes submission of a completed public notice form provided by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and photographs of the posted notice.
      3. ###### Additional Incentives


         The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may not apply a [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that will physically preclude the construction of the [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Applicants may request additional incentives pursuant to the procedures described in [Sec. 9.2.1.F.3. (Projects with Requests for Waiver or Modification)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).
2. ###### Deviations from Performance Standards


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may modify the requirements of Sec. 9.4.1.B.5. (Performance Standards) for [qualified permanent supportive housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), when the applicant can demonstrate that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) remains consistent with the purpose of those standards.
5. ##### Records & Agreements


Prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a qualified permanent supportive housing project, the applicant shall record a covenant acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department that reserves and maintains the total combined number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s designated as restricted affordable for at least 55 or 99 years pursuant to [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) from the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).


### Sec. 9.4.2. Interim Conversions of Lodging Unit Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Interim Conversions of Lodging Unit Program) is to facilitate the interim use of existing [lodging](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s as [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for persons experiencing homelessness or those at risk of homelessness. Under this Section (Interim Conversions of Lodging Unit Program), the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may return to its previous [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) consistent with the zoning of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), upon termination of the interim [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) use.

2. ##### Eligibility


An [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is eligible for conversion to [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for persons experiencing homelessness or those at risk of homelessness, as determined by the [local public agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), if they meet the following requirements:

1. ###### Certificate of Occupancy


      The [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) has a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as a [lodging](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

2. ###### Use of Dwelling Units


      All [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or a combination of both, in the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must be used for [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

3. ###### No Additions


      The [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not increase or add [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or expand the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height.

4. ###### No Expansion of Use


      The [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not increase the total combined number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not exceed the existing number of [lodging unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

5. ###### Permitted Use


      Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) used for on-site [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be considered accessory to the [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

6. ###### Supportive Service Area


      For every 20 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, a minimum of one dedicated office space shall be provided for the provision of on-site [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including case management. A minimum of one dedicated office space shall be provided for [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s with fewer than 20 total [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) dedicated to [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be provided on-site within an existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), but shall not exceed 10 percent of the total [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

7. ###### Supportive Services Contract


      1. The applicant shall provide a copy of an executed contract agreement between the [local public agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the provider of the [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and the [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicant for the provision of on-site [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or a combination of both.

      2. The applicant shall provide proof that the applicant has received funding from a [local public agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      3. The applicant shall provide proof that the [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) contract is in effect.
8. ###### Residential Hotel Ordinance


      If [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or units are subject to the provisions of [Chapter IV., Article 7.1. (Residential Hotel Unit Conversion and Demolition)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205147) of this Code on the date of the [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), they shall remain subject to all requirements and restrictions of that Article during the [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) contract.

9. ###### Historic Resource


      An [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not involve alteration of a historic-character-defining feature of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), unless the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), in consultation with the Office of Historic Resources, determines the proposed alteration will not adversely impact the property's historic eligibility.
3. ##### Incentives


[Interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be subject to any otherwise applicable zoning, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulations, including, but not limited to, the following:

1. ###### Minimum Area per Household Dwelling Unit or Efficiency Dwelling Unit


      [Interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be considered an increase in density or other change which requires any corresponding discretionary action. A [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), regardless of any [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) status as to the regulations of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) and [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), may be used for an [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

2. ###### Off-Street Automobile Parking


      [Interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be exempt from the provisions of [Div. 4C.4. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4) during the [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) contract, however, the [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall maintain and not reduce the number of on-site parking spaces existing on the date of the [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

3. ###### Use Permission


      Despite the provisions of the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or any [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provision to the contrary, an [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be permitted and not considered a [change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

4. ###### Minor Interior Alterations for Cooking Facilities


      Approved [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicants may make minor interior alterations adding cooking facilities, including a sink, a refrigerator not exceeding 10 cubic feet, counter space not exceeding 10 square feet, and a hotplate or microwave. In the event a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is returned to the motel or hotel use in accordance with [Sec. 9.4.2.D.3. (Termination of Supportive Housing or Transitional Housing Contract)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.2), the [lodging](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may maintain any added cooking facilities.

5. ###### Preservation of Nonconforming Rights


      Upon termination of the [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), in accordance with [Sec. 9.4.2.D.3. (Termination of Supportive Housing or Transitional Housing Contract)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.2), any [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as to area or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulations or any other requirements in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) may return to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and condition authorized by a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) existing on the date of the [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), despite any physical alterations to the subject property. Any [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) used for [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be returned to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as [lodging unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or may be converted to accessory amenity spaces, so long as the total number of [lodging unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s do not exceed the number approved on the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) existing at the time of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
4. ##### Process


1. ###### Department of Building and Safety Review


      [Interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be approved and the incentives described above in Subsection C. (Incentives) shall be granted by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) if the eligibility requirements of Subsection B. (Eligibility) above and the applicable standards described above in Subsection C. (Incentives) are met.

2. ###### Residential Hotel Ordinance


      [Interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicants seeking to convert [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s subject to the Residential Hotel Ordinance pursuant to [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Article 7.1. (Residential Hotel Unit Conversion and Demolition)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205147) of this Code must also submit an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) using the process described in [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.78. (Application for Clearance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-208840) of this Code.

3. ###### Termination of Supportive Housing or Transitional Housing Contract


      Upon any termination of the [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) contract, the following shall apply:

      1. The [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) applicant shall be required, within 90 days, to notify the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and to complete one of the following:

         1. Submit an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to return to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), authorized by a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), existing on the date of the [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or to any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) permitted by the current zoning regulations; or

         2. Provide a copy of a new executed contract agreement to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in accordance with the requirements in Sec. 9.4.2.B.7. (Supportive Services Contract) to begin a new contract term for provision of [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [transitional housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
      2. The number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as defined in [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.73.T. (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205208) of this Code, at each participating structure of an [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which has been converted to [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s subject to [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Article 7.1. (Residential Hotel Unit Conversion and Demolition)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205147) of this Code shall be identical to the number of units originally determined by the Los Angeles Housing Department to be [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s pursuant to [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.76. (Residential Unit Status Determination)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-208891) of this Code or any subsequent number approved as part of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) using the process described in [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.78. (Application for Clearance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-208840) of this Code.
4. ###### Modifications to Interim Lodging Unit Housing Project Applicability Requirements


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may modify or exempt the applicability requirements for [interim lodging unit housing project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in Sec. 9.4.2.B.6. (Supportive Service Area) and Sec. 9.4.2.B.9. (Historic Resource), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2.(Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), when the applicant can demonstrate that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) remains consistent with the purpose of those standards.

### Sec. 9.4.3. Senior Care Facilities Incentive Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Senior Care Facilities Incentive Program) is to provide [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for [senior citizen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, including for the provisions of medical care, and create a single process for approvals and facilitate the processing of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for an [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). These facilities provide much needed services and housing for the growing senior population of the City of Los Angeles.

2. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to a [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in any Agricultural, Residential, Residential-Mixed, or Commercial-Mixed [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

3. ##### Incentives


1. ###### Zoning District Requirements


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may permit a [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) under this Section (Senior Care Facilities Incentive Program) that does not meet the requirements of the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), or height provisions of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), or the requirements of any [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or Chapter 1A regulation adopted or imposed by [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) action pursuant to Subsection D. (Procedures) below.

2. ###### Development of Site


      New [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be erected, enlargements may be made to existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and the existing housing types within the [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may be extended on the approved site, provided that development plans are submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may disapprove the plans where it is found that the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) does not conform to the purpose and intent of the findings required for [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) under this Section (Senior Care Facilities Incentive Program), and may specify the conditions under which the plans may be approved.
4. ##### Procedures


1. ###### Review


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may permit a [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) under this Section (Senior Care Facilities Incentive Program) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2.(Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

      1. ###### Supplemental Findings


         In addition to the findings set forth in [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not grant the approval unless it is also found that:

         1. The [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall provide services to [senior citizen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to meet citywide demand;

         2. The [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not create an adverse impact on street [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or circulation in the surrounding neighborhood; and

         3. The [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provides for an arrangement of [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, open spaces, and other improvements that are compatible with the scale and character of the [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) properties and surrounding neighborhood.
2. ###### Subsequent Change of Use


      [Residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as established in [Div. 5D.2. (Residential Uses)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.2), within a [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may not be changed to a different [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unless it has been subsequently approved. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may approve changes to the number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, [efficiency dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, beds, or [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provided that a minimum of 75 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), exclusive of common areas, shall consist of [supportive housing: medical care](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for [senior citizen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

### Sec. 9.4.4. Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program) is to further health and safety standards in multi-unit [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and preserve and create affordable housing units by establishing procedures to legalize certain pre-existing unpermitted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in conformance with the State Density Bonus provisions in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV).

2. ##### Eligibility


A [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with a unpermitted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located in any [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B), except for Density District 1L, is eligible for the provisions of this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program) when the following criteria are met:

1. ###### Pre-Existing Units


      The units to be legalized have been occupied as a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) at any time between December 11, 2010 and December 10, 2015. Examples of the types of evidence to establish occupancy include, but are not limited to:

      1. Apartment lease;

      2. Utility bill;

      3. Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) Rent Registration Certificate;

      4. Code enforcement case documentation (e.g., Orders to Comply); or

      5. Other evidence identified on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) form and made available for public inspection in the case file.
2. ###### Restricted Affordable Units


      At least one additional [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is being provided on the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). A [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). Affordable means that rents or housing expenses cannot exceed 30 percent of the maximum gross income of each respective household income group. Moderate income units may be used, provided the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is not located in a Low-Moderate Census Tract pursuant to the Community Reinvestment Act.

3. ###### Performance Standards


      The property shall meet the following performance standards:

      1. ###### Front Yard Landscaping


         All portions of the required front yard not used for necessary driveways and walkways, including decorative walkways, are landscaped and maintained, and not otherwise paved.

      2. ###### Lighting


         Security night lighting is shielded so that the light source cannot be seen from [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) residential properties.

      3. ###### Parking Area


         Any surface [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are landscaped pursuant to the requirements of [Div. 4C.4.4.C.2. (Parking Lot Landscaping)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4).

      4. ###### Signs


         Any illegal [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall have been removed.

      5. ###### Code Violations


         The [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) must not have any outstanding code violations other than those being addressed by the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) under this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program).

      6. ###### Unpermitted Building Footprint Expansion


         The [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to be legalized shall not result or have resulted in an unpermitted expansion of the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or height, except that additions of less than 250 square feet, not resulting in any additional height, may be permitted, provided it is not located on the [building frontage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) adjoining the front yard. The purpose of this standard is to limit exterior alterations to those that are minor and do not have a significant impact on the visual character of the building or neighborhood.
3. ##### Incentives


A property meeting the eligibility criteria above must comply with all applicable zoning regulations, except:

1. The grant of permitted status to pre-existing unpermitted units under this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program) shall not be considered an increase in density or other change which requires any corresponding [Zone Change (Sec. 13B.1.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4), [General Plan Adoption/Amendment (Sec. 13B.1.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.1), [Project Exception (Sec. 13.B.4.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13), or other discretionary action pursuant to [Article 13. (Administration)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13).

2. The number of allowable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s can be increased up to 35 percent over the otherwise maximum allowable density of the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) or applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), depending on the percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided in the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), pursuant to the [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) charts in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(f)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV). These charts can be extended proportionally to permit both a density increase and an affordable set-aside less than what is shown on the charts.

3. For properties which have more permitted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s than are allowed under current maximum allowable density, an increase in current maximum allowable density beyond 35 percent may be authorized as long as the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) offers sufficient [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to achieve at least a 35 percent [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to the [density bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) charts in [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(f)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV) and the increase in number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s does not exceed 35 percent of the number of permitted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on the property. Regardless of the actual number of permitted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on the property, the base number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for calculating the percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s allowed by the current maximum [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) density.

4. A property containing one [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) with two permitted [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in any [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) except for Density District 1L may legalize a third unit as long as one of the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s is a [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), even if the third [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) increases the density by more than 35 percent.

5. An applicant may choose any one of the following methods of calculating required parking, if applicable, in conjunction with the bicycle parking provisions in [Div. 4C.3. (Bicycle Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3). If the net new number of required parking spaces is other than a whole number, it shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

      1. Parking may be recalculated for all units in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) (not just the restricted units) using Parking Option 1 in [Sec. 9.2.1.C.2. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1).

      2. Parking may be calculated by maintaining all existing parking and providing additional parking just for the newly legalized units in accordance with Parking Option 2 in [Sec. 9.2.1.C.2. (Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1), as long as one [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for low income individuals who are [senior citizen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or who have a physical or mental impairment that limits one or more major life activities, is provided for each legalized unit.

      3. Parking may be calculated by maintaining all existing parking and providing additional parking at a ratio of 0.5 parking spaces per bedroom for the newly legalized [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) located within 1/2 mile of a [major transit stop](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).
6. The applicant shall be eligible for up to three concessions or incentives in accordance with [California Government Code, Sec. 65915(d)(2)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65915.&lawCode=GOV), depending on the percentage of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s provided. For the purposes of this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program), a concession or [incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) means a reduction in a site [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or a modification of zoning code requirements or architectural design requirements that exceed the minimum building standards approved by the California Building Standards Commission, including, but not limited to, a reduction in [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements and in the ratio of vehicular parking spaces that would otherwise be required.

7. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may not apply a [development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that will physically preclude the legalization of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which meets the eligibility criteria of Sec. 9.4.4.B. (Eligibility) at the densities or with the concessions or incentives permitted by this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program). [Development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s include, but are not limited to: a site condition; a height limitation; a [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirement; a [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#); an [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirement; or a parking ratio that applies to a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) development pursuant to any ordinance, general plan element, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), charter, or other local condition, law, policy, resolution, or regulation. [Development standard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s do not include conditions imposed through discretionary approvals. [Incentive](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be used to exempt compliance with performance standards.

8. The street dedication provisions of [Article 10. (Streets & Parks)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10) shall not apply when [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are legalized under this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program).

9. The City's [Affordable Housing Incentives Guidelines](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s under this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program).
4. ##### Process


1. ###### Administrative Review


      The applicant shall submit an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a form developed by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that contains basic information about the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the owner or applicant, and conformance with this Section (Unpermitted Dwelling Units Program). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall review all [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for compliance with the eligibility criteria in Subsection B. (Eligibility), above. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be approved by the Director of Planning if the eligibility criteria and performance standards of this Section are met pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

2. ###### Relief


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may modify or exempt the performance standards in Paragraph 3. (Performance Standards) of Subsection B (Eligibility), above, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.2.(Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), when the applicant can demonstrate that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) remains consistent with the purpose of those standards.
5. ##### Records & Agreements


Prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), a covenant acceptable to the Los Angeles Housing Department shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder, guaranteeing that each required [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be reserved and maintained for at least 55 years or 99 years pursuant to [Sec. 4C.15.3. (Restricted Affordable Units)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.15.3) from the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).


### Sec. 9.4.5. Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program) is to facilitate the preservation and reuse of [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in the Downtown Community Plan Area, and implement the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) by facilitating the conversion of older, economically distressed, or historically significant [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s to apartments, live/work units, [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, or visitor-serving facilities. This will help to reduce vacant space as well as preserve Downtown’s architectural and cultural past and encourage the development of a live/work and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) community Downtown, thus creating a more balanced ratio between housing and jobs in the region’s primary employment center. This revitalization will also facilitate the development of a “24-hour city” and encourage mixed commercial and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s in order to improve air quality and reduce [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) trips and [motor vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) miles traveled by locating residents, jobs, hotels and transit services near each other.

2. ##### Eligibility


The provisions of this Section (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program) shall apply to an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in the Downtown Community Plan area in all or any portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s meeting the criteria below (as evidenced by a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or other suitable document.

1. ###### Buildings That Are At Least 15 Years Old


      [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built and for which at least 15 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.

2. ###### Buildings That Are At Least 10 Years Old


      [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built and for which at least 10 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.

3. ###### Historic Buildings


      [Designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are also eligible [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

4. ###### Parking Structures


      Any [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), within an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built, for which at least 10 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.
3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Affordable Housing Linkage Fee


      The linkage fee, as established in [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), shall continue to apply, as applicable, to any new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) devoted to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s described in the linkage fee schedule, regardless of the exemptions in Subsection D. (Incentives) below.
4. ##### Incentives


Despite any other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s eligible under Subsection B. (Eligibility) above shall be entitled to the incentives set forth below. These incentives shall not apply to any [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s located on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unless otherwise stated below.

01. ###### Floor Area


       1. ###### Existing Floor Area


          Existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which exceeds the maximum [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) shall be allowed.

       2. ###### New Floor Area Within Existing Building Envelope


          Any additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, as defined by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code, created within an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be counted towards the maximum [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limit for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

       3. ###### Use Modification in Previously Exempted Floor Area


          The following actions shall not be considered as adding new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that enlarges an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#):

          1. The [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of any area of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is exempt from [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limitations to any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) permitted in the applied [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), including the [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of any interior portion of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). However, this shall not include [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), and must be located within the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s existing [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and below the existing roof.

          2. The [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of any area of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is exempt from [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

          3. The [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of any area of an existing [basement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or portions of an eligible [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that are below [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

          4. This incentive shall not be utilized if the [unified development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) involves the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [facade modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of any portion of a [designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which has not been approved by the Office of Historic Resources.

The averaging of [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may be permitted even if [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on each individual [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) would exceed the permitted [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).           An [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is a part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be allowed to maintain its existing height, regardless of whether it complies with the height requirements of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), including but not limited to [height in stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

       2. ###### New Stories Within Existing Building Envelope


          Any additional [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) created within an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is a part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be counted as an additional [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) towards any [height in stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) limit.

       Existing observed [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s which do not meet the [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements of the applied [Form District (Part 2B)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) shall be allowed.

       An [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be required to provide any additional [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as a result of a [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

05. ###### Upper-Story Bulk


       An [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is a part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be required to comply with any applicable [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provisions in [Div. 2C.6. (Upper-Story Bulk)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.6).

06. ###### Building Mass


       An [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is a part of an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall not be required to comply with any applicable [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) mass provisions in [Div. 2C.5. (Building Mass)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.5).

07. ###### Frontage District Standards


       [Adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be required to bring eligible [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s into conformance with the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B). (Freight Loading Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.2).
