       [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and household business: joint living & work quarters shall not be subject to the [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) requirements of the applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B).

(Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), if the [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) complies with the requirements of Subsection B. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall have the authority to grant any other zoning incentives or exceptions from this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) required to permit [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s proposed pursuant to this Section (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program), including but not limited to the authority to permit [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and household business: joint living & work quarters in [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

### Sec. 9.4.6. Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program) is to encourage and facilitate the conversion and retention of existing, or historically significant [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and conversion between [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s permitted or conditionally permitted by the designated [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of the property. The goal is to reduce vacant space, as well as preserve the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s architectural and cultural past, and encourage the sustainable practice of retaining the inherent energy that goes into the construction of [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. This practice has demonstrated its effectiveness as a revitalization tool that encourages the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of underutilized [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and the creation of new [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

2. ##### Eligibility


The provisions of this Section (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program) shall apply to [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s outside the Downtown Community Plan Area, in any Commercial-Mixed Use District, or on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in Density District 2 or FA, regardless of [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), in the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s. Meeting the following criteria (evidenced by a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or suitable document):

1. ###### Buildings That Are At Least 25 Years Old


      [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built and for which at least 25 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.

2. ###### Buildings That Are At Least 10 Years Old


      [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built and for which at least 10 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.

3. ###### Historic Buildings


      [Designated historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and [surveyed historic resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

4. ###### Parking Structures


      Any [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provided in excess of the minimum parking required by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), within an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built, for which at least 10 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.
3. ##### Standards


1. ###### Affordable Housing Linkage Fee


      The linkage fee, as established in [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), shall continue to apply, as applicable, to any new [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) devoted to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s described in the linkage fee schedule, regardless of the exemptions in Subsection D. (Incentives) below.
4. ##### Incentives


Despite any other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall be entitled to the incentives set forth below. These incentives shall not apply to any [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s located on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) as an [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) unless otherwise stated below.

1. ###### Department of Building and Safety Review


      The following types of [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s that meet the requirements of Subsection B. (Eligibility), and meet the criteria described above in Subsection C. (Standards) and Subsection D. (Incentives) shall be approved by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#):

      1. [Adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s involving [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built for which at least 25 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction, and

      2. [Adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s involving [parking structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within an existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for which at least 10 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction.
2. ###### Zoning Administrator Review


      1. [Adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s involving [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s constructed in accordance with building and zoning codes in effect at the time they were built for which at least 10 years have elapsed since the date of permitted and completed construction may be approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), if the [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) complies with the requirements of Subsection B. (Eligibility), and the criteria described in Subsection C. (Standards) and Subsection D. (Incentives), above, are met. If the [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is approved, the incentives described in Subsection D. (Incentives) above for which the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) qualifies may be granted.

      2. Furthermore, pursuant to the processes and procedures of [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall have the authority to grant any other zoning incentives or exceptions from this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) required to permit [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s proposed pursuant to this Section (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program), including but not limited to the authority to permit [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and household business: joint living & work quarters in [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

      3. ###### Supplemental Findings.


         In addition to the findings in [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall also find that:

         1. The eligible [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is no longer economically viable in its current use or uses. In making this finding, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall consider the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)’s past and current vacancy rate, existing and previous [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and real estate market information. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may require the applicant to submit independently verified documentation.

         2. In approving a reduced parking incentive pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.6.D.8. (Off-Street Automobile Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall find that the surrounding area will not be adversely affected by overflow parking or traffic congestion originating or terminating at the site of the [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

### Sec. 9.4.7. Public Nuisance Abatement Program

1. ##### Purpose


The purpose of this Section (Public Nuisance Abatement Program) is to facilitate the removal of graffiti, posters/handbills and any other illegal postings, as well as trash, debris, rubbish, and weeds on public property in exchange for the temporary placement of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at construction sites and [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s.

2. ##### Eligibility


Construction sites and [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are eligible for the placement of [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, including [off-site sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, on [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and/or solid wood [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, if the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) has an applied Residential-Mixed, Commercial-Mixed, Industrial-Mixed, or Industrial [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) complies with the requirements of the public nuisance abatement program as outlined in this Section (Public Nuisance Abatement Program).

3. ##### Program Requirements


Upon issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and installation of any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and/or solid wood or similar material [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s surrounding [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s it shall be the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company and property owner's responsibility to comply with the provisions of this Subsection (Program Requirements), and as established in [Sec. 9.4.7.F.4. (Authorized Representative)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7) it shall be the responsibility of the Department of Public Works — Office of Community Beautification (Office of Community Beautification) to enforce them.

1. ###### Notification


      1. Within 10 days after the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), provide written notification to the Office of Community Beautification and the Council District Office of the council district in which the construction site or [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located.

      2. The notification shall contain the name and address of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner and the property address where the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s will be placed.

      3. The notification to the Office of Community Beautification shall include a copy of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company's contract with the property owner to post [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s at the specified location.
2. ###### Reporting


      1. Report the amount, type, and location of clean-ups within the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) to the Office of Community Beautification every 30 days for the duration of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      2. Reporting shall be thorough and include before and after photo documentation, City of Los Angeles MyLA311 App request confirmation and/or other documentation stating date and time of clean up, as well as receipts for where materials were disposed.
3. ###### Public Nuisance Abatement


      1. Clean and maintain free from graffiti, posters/handbills and any other illegal postings, as well as trash, debris, rubbish, and weeds from public property and [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s within the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The removal of graffiti shall include, but not be limited to, spray paint on walls, poles, and fences on public property.

      2. Remove any posters/handbills on light poles, utility poles, bus stops, and any other illegal postings on public property.

      3. Patrol the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) every 24 hours to search for and remove any graffiti within 24 hours of its discovery.

      4. Report, through the City of Los Angeles MyLA311 program, bulky items within the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) around the permitted [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      5. Comply with the administrative policies and procedures set by the Office of Community Beautification.
4. ###### Abatement Radius Calculation


      The [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) will be measured as a horizontal extension of the perimeter of the entire [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) at a distance determined by the Office of Community Beautification.

      1. Initially, a 750-foot radius around the permitted [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), or

      2. A radius around the permitted lot expanded in 250-foot increments, up to a maximum of 1,500 feet per [Sec. 9.4.7.E.3.d. (Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).
4. ##### Incentives


Regardless of the provisions of [Sec. 4C.11.2. (Temporary Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.2), [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s placed on [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and/or solid wood [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s surrounding [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall comply with the following:

1. ###### Placard


      Install an 18 inch x 24 inch placard in a conspicuous location on the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#). The placard shall be made of a durable laminated paper, vinyl or other weather resistant material with contrasting black letters on white background at least one inch in height and display the following information:

      1. “This is an Official Notice of the City of Los Angeles and shall not be defaced.”

      2. Signs have been placed on this wall or fence pursuant to Chapter 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code Sec. 9.4.7. (Public Nuisance Abatement Program).

      3. Building permit number:\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ and expiration date:\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

      4. Phone number of the Department of Public Works’ Office of Community Beautification:\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

      5. Name and phone number of the sign operator’s representative for public reporting of graffiti, posters/handbills and any other illegal postings, as well as trash, debris, rubbish, and weeds for removal within the required abatement radius:\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
2. ###### Individual Sign Area


      Individual [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not exceed a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) area of 250 square feet.

3. ###### Grouped Sign Area


      [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not be grouped to form a maximum [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) area that exceeds 250 square feet.

4. ###### Separation of Signs


      Individual [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or groups of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s having an area of 250 square feet shall be separated from any other [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s and/or solid wood fences surrounding [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s by at least 10 feet measured horizontally.

5. ###### Combined Area


      The combined [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) area of temporary [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s shall not exceed eight square feet for each linear foot of street frontage.

6. ###### Maximum Height


      [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s may only be placed to a maximum height of eight feet and shall not extend above the top of the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) or fence.

7. ###### Time Limits


      A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is time limited by the following:

      1. ###### Temporary Construction Wall


         1. A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) placed on a [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall remain valid for two years, or during the duration of the construction work, under a separate valid [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), requiring a barrier, pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.3306. (Protection of Pedestrians)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-201509) of this Code, whichever is less.

         2. The [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) permitted pursuant to Subsection E. (Process) below shall be expired if: the construction work authorized by the separate [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) has not commenced by the 180th day following the permit issuance date, or by the 90th day when an operating business exists on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#); or work has been suspended, discontinued or abandoned for a continuous period of 180 days, or for a continuous period of 90 days when an operating business exists on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         3. If the separate [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is revoked or expired, the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) permitted pursuant to Subsection E. (Process) below, shall be expired.

         4. Subsequent [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) at the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), issued in conjunction with the original separate construction permit, shall not be authorized.
      2. ###### Fence Around a Vacant Lot


         1. A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) placed on a fence of solid wood or similar material surrounding a [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall remain valid for one year, or for as long as the lot remains vacant, whichever is less.

         2. Any subsequent [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of solid wood or similar material surrounding a [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall be issued pursuant to Subsection E. (Process) below, not to exceed two additional permits, for a total of three years.
8. ###### Sign Materials


      Regardless of the provisions of [Sec. 4C.11.2.C.3.c. (Construction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.2), [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s authorized by this Section (Public Nuisance Abatement Program) shall be made of paper, vinyl, or other similar material.

9. ###### Operating Business


      When a business is operating on a construction site, [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s must also comply with the following:

      1. ###### Display Location


         [Temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s are limited to the portion of the [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) that is required pursuant to [Chapter IX (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.3306. (Protection of Pedestrians)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-201509) of this Code; and

      2. ###### Wall Minimum


         A minimum 40 linear feet of required [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), not exceeding the boundaries of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), may be installed and used for [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s; and

      3. ###### Sign Maximum


         The total area of [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) authorized by this Section (Public Nuisance Abatement Program) shall not exceed a maximum of 250 square feet.
5. ##### Process


The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall issue a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), pursuant to this Section (Public Nuisance Abatement Program), after verifying that the plans comply with all applicable [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) provisions, all permit clearances have been approved and the following requirements have been met.

1. ###### Initial Permit Application — Temporary Construction Wall


      1. ###### Valid Building Permit


         There is a separate valid [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) authorizing construction work on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#)(s).

      2. ###### Required Wall


         At least a portion of the [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is required pursuant to [Chapter IX (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.3306. (Protection of Pedestrians)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-201509) of this Code.

      3. ###### Previous Permit


         A previous [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was not issued in conjunction with the same [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) referenced in Subparagraph a. (Valid Building Permit) above.

      4. ###### Expiration and Revocation


         A previous [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was not expired or revoked within the preceding 12 months pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.7.D.7.a. (Temporary Construction Wall)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7) or [Sec. 9.4.7.F.2. (Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).

      5. ###### Operating Business


         When a business is operating on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s must comply with [Sec. 9.4.7.D.9. (Operating Business)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).
2. ###### Initial Permit Application — Fence Surrounding a Vacant Lot


      1. ###### Existing Use


         There are no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s or uses of land on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      2. ###### Expiration & Revocation


         A previous [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was not expired or revoked within the preceding 12 months pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.7.D.7.a. (Temporary Construction Wall)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7) or [Sec. 9.4.7.F.2. (Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).
3. ###### Subsequent Permit Application - Fence Surrounding a Vacant Lot


      If [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) records indicate that a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) of solid wood or similar material surrounding a [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was previously issued on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), the following must be met.

      1. ###### Use


         The [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) complies with [Sec. 9.4.7.E.2. (Initial Permit Application — Fence Surrounding a Vacant Lot)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7) as applicable.

      2. ###### Expiration & Revocation


         A previous [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) was not expired or revoked within the preceding 12 months pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.7.F.2. (Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).

      3. ###### Previous Permit


         No more than one initial [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and one subsequent [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#), for a total of two years, have been issued at the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

      4. ###### Review


         The Director of the Office of Community Beautification reviews and consents to the subsequent [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in a written statement and determines an [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) pursuant to the following:

         1. Response for consent shall be provided within 10 days of written request and based solely on the assessment as to whether a public nuisance exists within the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#).

         2. Investigation and determination of the existence of a public nuisance within the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) may occur for the purpose of determining whether to consent to a subsequent permit or at any time after the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) under [Sec. 9.4.7.E. (Process)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).

         3. Expansion of the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the purpose of a subsequent [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a sign when a public nuisance cannot be found to exist within the initial [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) per [Sec. 9.4.7.D.7.b. (Fence Around a Vacant Lot)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7) and requiring the sign company or property owner to abate the public nuisance in the expanded [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) in accordance with [Sec. 9.4.7.C.4. (Abatement Radius Calculation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).
6. ##### Permit Termination


Permits that become invalid or are terminated by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) are subject to the following provisions.

1. ###### Expiration


      For all [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which expired due to failure to meet the notification and reporting requirements pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.7.C. (Program Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7), above, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) shall issue a notification to the permit holder upon expiration of the permit, including information about the appeals process.

2. ###### Revocation


      Any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) issued pursuant to this Section may be revoked by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for any of the following reasons. However, for all [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s for a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) revoked for the reasons stated specifically in Subparagraphs (c), (d), (e), (f) or (g) of this Paragraph (Revocation) a written and signed notification of the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner's failure shall be sent to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) by the Director of the Office of Community Beautification prior to the revocation.

      1. Failure by the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner to comply with the terms of the permit.

      2. Failure by the sign company or property owner to maintain the bond required in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.6201.2.2. (General Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-176636) of this Code.

      3. Failure by the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner to maintain the [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) and/or solid wood [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s surrounding [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s free from graffiti.

      4. Failure by the sign company or property owner to eliminate graffiti within an [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) within 24 hours of receiving notification of the presence of graffiti from the Office of Community Beautification or the City Council district office of the district in which the construction site or [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located.

      5. Failure by the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner to remove posters/handbills placed on light poles, utility poles, bus stops and any other illegal postings on public property within an [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) within 24 hours of receiving notification from the Office of Community Beautification or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) district office of the district in which the construction site or [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) is located.

      6. Failure by the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner, at the time of graffiti removal, to report bulky items and/or remove trash, debris, rubbish and weeds from public property within the [abatement radius](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) established pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.7.C.4. (Abatement Radius Calculation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).

      7. The Office of Community Beautification sends three or more notifications of failure to comply with Subparagraphs (c), (d), (e), or (f) of this Subdivision to the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner within a three-month period.
3. ###### Removal of Signs


      1. The [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) company or property owner must remove the [temporary sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s authorized by this Section (Public Nuisance Abatement Program) by the date the [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) permit becomes invalid due to its time limit or no later than the permit expiration or revocation date.

      2. Any [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s remaining on [temporary construction wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s, and/or solid wood or similar material [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s surrounding [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) s after the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) has expired or is revoked are deemed to be a public nuisance that can be abated by utilizing the procedure contained in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.8904., et seq., (Special Provisions for Vacant Property Graffiti Removal)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-181231) of this Code.
4. ###### Authorized Representative


      The Office of Community Beautification is hereby designated the authorized representative of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) for the purpose of enforcing and implementing the provisions of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.89041.2., et seq., (Special Provisions for Vacant Property Graffiti Removal)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-181231) of this Code for compelling the removal of a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) which is a public nuisance under [Sec. 9.4.7.F.3.b. (Removal of Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.7).

(Accessory Dwelling Units (ADU) and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units (JADU))](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-6561) of this Code for applicable [accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#) regulations.
