# Article 10. Streets & Parks

## Div. 10.1. Street Dedication & Improvement

### Sec. 10.1.1. Street Standards

1. ##### Street Standards Committee


This Section creates a Street Standards Committee comprised of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) (as Chair), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and the General Manager of the Department of Transportation, or their designees. This Street Standards Committee shall:

1. Recommend to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) minimum width and improvement standards for all classes of public and [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall adopt such minimum width and improvement standards as it determines necessary for the safe and adequate movement of pedestrians, bicyclists, equestrians, transit service, and vehicular traffic, the increased retention and detention of stormwater, the installation of necessary utilities, and for reasonable and proper access to [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) properties. Such standards shall not be applicable to any street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for which the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), by ordinance, adopts specific standards.

2. Modify the Complete Street Design Guide (CSDG) on an as-needed basis to align the CSDG with current and innovative street design practice.

3. Develop guidelines consistent with the goals and intent of the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), as determined by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). These guidelines shall also establish a procedure for providing notice to interested [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, including the Councilmember of the district where the property is located.
2. ##### Adoption of Standards


A public hearing shall be conducted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.5. (Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.5), prior to the approval of any change in the standards.


### Sec. 10.1.2. Requirements

01. No [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall be erected or enlarged, and no [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall be issued, on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) in a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) with an applied [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) of 2 through 8, or in a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), [Industrial Use District (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7), or [Public Use District (Div. 5B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.8) where such [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s a [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), unless the one-half of the [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) that is located on the same side of the center of the [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) as such [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) has been dedicated and improved for the full width of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), so as to meet the standards for such [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) provided in [Sec. 10.1.9. (Improvement Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.9); or such dedication and improvement has been assured to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

02. In the case of either a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or an L-shaped interior [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) a [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and a local standard street or local limited street that intersect, that one-half of the local standard street or local limited street, on the same side of the center of the local standard street or local limited street as such [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), has been dedicated and improved for that portion of said [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s within 300 feet of the ultimate property line of said [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) so as to meet the standards for local standard street or local limited street provided in [Sec. 10.1.9. (Improvement Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.9) and provide adequate right-turn ingress to, and egress from, the [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#); or such dedication and improvement has been assured to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

03. As used in this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), the center/control line of the [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), shall mean the center of those [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shown on the Citywide General Plan Circulation System map of the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or, with respect to [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, on the adopted Community Plans of the [Land Use Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/plans-policies/community-plans) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) on file in the offices of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

04. The maximum area of land required to be so dedicated shall not exceed 25 percent of the area of any such [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) which was of record on March 1, 1962 in the Los Angeles County Recorder’s Office. In no event shall such dedication reduce the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) below a width of 50 feet or an area of 5,000 square feet.

05. No such dedication for any [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#); or any other street shall be required with respect to those portions of such a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) occupied by a legally existing main [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) that is to remain.

06. No additional improvements shall be required on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) where complete [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), curb, gutter, and sidewalk improvements exist within the present dedication contiguous to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

07. No [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall be erected on any such [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) within the dedication required by [Sec. 10.1.9. (Improvement Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.9).

08. No dedication shall be required where the existing [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) is equal to or greater than the street standard, even where the improved sidewalk does not meet the standard dimension.

09. Where the existing improved [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) meets or exceeds the street standard, no dedication shall be required, except as necessary to bring the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) sidewalk dimension into compliance with the street standard as depicted in the most recent version of the Bureau of Engineering's standard plan number [S-470-1. (Standard Street Dimensions)](https://apps.engineering.lacity.gov/techdocs/stdplans/s-400.htm).

10. Nothing in this Section (Street Standards) shall preclude the decision-maker on a discretionary entitlement from requiring a dedication or improvement greater than what is set forth in this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), where the decision-maker determines that a greater dedication or improvement bears an essential nexus and rough proportionality to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s impact.

11. For streets accompanied by a parallel frontage or [service road](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and for streets designated as divided streets, existing [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) dimensions are deemed to be in compliance with the street standards, and no additional dedication or improvement is required. A dedication for sidewalk improvement shall be required, however, as necessary to bring the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) sidewalk dimension into compliance with the street standard.

12. Additional dedication and improvement requirements may be imposed in order to ensure compliance with the [Americans with Disabilities Act](https://www.ada.gov/).

13. Notwithstanding the above, in order to achieve consistent [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) dimensions, the Bureau of Engineering on a by-right [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or the decision-maker on a discretionary entitlement, may modify this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement)'s dedication and improvement requirements for meandering streets or portions of streets that lack uniform [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) widths, including for divided streets, and streets accompanied by a parallel frontage or [service road](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

14. The guidelines developed by Street Standards Committee shall be consistent with the goals and intent of the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) as determined by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). These guidelines shall also establish a procedure for notice to interested [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, including the Councilmember of the district where the property is located.


### Sec. 10.1.3. Exceptions

The provisions of [Sec. 10.1.2. (Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.2) shall not apply to the following construction [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s:

1. A single- [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) with customary [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s when erected on a [vacant lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

2. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s incidental to a legally existing [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), provided no additional [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s are created.

3. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s incidental to a legally existing non-residential [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), provided that the total cumulative [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) of all such [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall not exceed 500 square feet.


### Sec. 10.1.4. Dedication Procedure

Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) required to dedicate land pursuant to the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) shall make an offer to dedicate, properly executed by all parties of interest including beneficiaries in deeds of trust as shown by a current preliminary title report prepared by a title company approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for that intent. The trustee under a deed of trust shall not be required to execute the dedicatory instrument, unless, in the view of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), such execution is necessary to satisfactorily dedicate the land. Such report shall be furnished by the applicant. Such offer shall: be on a form approved by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) Attorney and the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#); be in such terms as to be binding on the owner, heirs, assignees or successors in interest; and shall continue until the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) accepts or rejects such offer or until one year from the date such offer is filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for processing, whichever occurs first. The offer shall provide that the dedication will be complete upon acceptance by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). The offer shall be recorded by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) with the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder upon its acceptance by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall accept or reject the offer for recordation within 10 days after it is filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). The offer shall be promptly processed by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) Departments concerned and submitted to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), in order to complete the dedication within one year. If the offer is rejected by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or not processed within one year, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall issue a release from such offer which shall be recorded with the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder unless the parties making the offer wish to have the time extended.

### Sec. 10.1.5. Improvement Procedure

1. Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) required to make improvements by the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) shall either make and complete the improvements to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or shall file with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) a bond in an amount as the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall estimate and determine to be necessary to complete all of the improvements required.

2. Such bond may be either a cash bond or a bond executed by a company authorized to act as a surety in the State of California. The bond shall be payable to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and be conditioned upon the faithful performance of any and all work required to be done, and that should the work not be done or completed within the time specified, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may, at its option, cause the work to be done or completed, and the parties executing the bond shall be firmly bound under a continuing obligation for the payment of all necessary costs and expenses incurred in the construction. The bond shall be executed by the owner of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) as principal, and if a surety bond, shall also be executed by a corporation authorized to act as a surety under the laws of the State of California.

3. Whenever the owner elects to deposit a cash bond, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) is authorized, in the event of any default on the owner's part, to use any or all of the deposit money to cause all of the required work to be done or completed, and for payment of all costs and expenses. Any money remaining shall be refunded to the owner.

4. When a substantial portion of the required improvement has been completed to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and the completion of the remaining improvements is delayed due to conditions beyond the owner’s control, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may accept the completed portion and consent to a proportionate reduction of the surety bond in an amount estimated and determined by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) to be adequate to assure the completion of the required improvements remaining to be made.

5. Whenever a surety bond has been filed in compliance with this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) is authorized, in the event of any default on the part of the principal, to enforce collection under such bond, for any and all damages sustained by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) by reason of any failure on the part of the principal faithfully and properly to do or complete the required improvements, and in addition may cause all of the required work to be done or completed, and the surety upon the bond shall be firmly bound for the payment of all necessary costs for completing the work.

6. The term of the bond shall begin on the date of the deposit of cash or the filing of the surety bond, and shall end upon the date of the completion to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) of all improvements required to be made. The fact of such completion shall be endorsed by a statement of completion signed by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and the deposit shall be returned to the owner, or the surety bond may be exonerated at any time thereafter.

7. For purposes of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), improvements shall be considered satisfactorily assured when the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) accepts the cash or surety bond provided for in this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), or the improvements required to be made have been completed to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s satisfaction. When the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) accepts the bond or the work has been completed to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s satisfaction, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall notify the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) of the completion.


### Sec. 10.1.6. Issuance of Building Permits

When all dedication and improvements required by this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) have been completed or satisfactorily assured, a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may be issued.

### Sec. 10.1.7. Bureau of Engineering Fees

In addition to all other required fees, the fees pursuant to [Sec. 15.3.14. (Streets Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.14) shall be charged for services provided for processing [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s under the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement).

### Sec. 10.1.8. Lots Affected by Street Widening

On [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s affected by street widening required by the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and density shall be calculated based on the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s that existed immediately prior to such required street widening. All other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall be measured and calculated from the new [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s being created by any widening, including when street widening is required by or included as part of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) process.

### Sec. 10.1.9. Improvement Standards

1. All [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, and [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall be constructed and improved in accordance with the standards adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) pursuant to [Sec. 10.1.1. (Street Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.1).

2. All streets not designated as [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, but that intersect a [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), shall be dedicated to a maximum width of 60 feet. [Roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) widths shall conform to those standards adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) in accordance with [Sec. 10.1.1. (Street Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.1), depending upon street classification type. Whenever uncertainty exists as to the application of the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement), or in instances of streets so classified as requiring less than 60 feet of dedication in order to conform to the minimum width standards as adopted in accordance with [Sec. 10.1.1. (Street Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.1), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall make any necessary determinations.

3. All improvements required to be made by the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) shall be made in accordance with the current applicable provisions of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction adopted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

4. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may approve and allow variations from the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction as determined necessary based on conditions of terrain and the existing improvements contiguous to the property involved.


### Sec. 10.1.10. Waiver & Appeals

This Section shall constitute the exclusive mechanism for waivers and appeals of dedication and improvement requirements under this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement). Waivers of dedication or improvement requirements may not be granted by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) motion.

1. ##### Waivers for By-Right Projects


Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) seeking a waiver of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement)'s dedication or improvement requirements for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) that does not require a discretionary entitlement shall file an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for a waiver with the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

1. ###### Notice


      Within 10 calendar days of the receipt of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for a waiver, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall mail notice of the requested waiver to the following individuals and entities with a notice that all comments shall be submitted to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) no later than 14 calendar days following mailing of the notice:

      1. Owners of property across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) from the subject property;

      2. Owners of property with frontage along the same street that has a common corner with or [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s the subject property;

      3. Owners of property with frontage along the same street that has a common corner with or [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s any properties listed in Subparagraph a. or Subparagraph b. above;

      4. The Councilmember of the district where the subject property is located; and

      5. The Department of Transportation and Bureau of Engineering.

      6. Notification pursuant to this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) shall also be provided to [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) members for waivers that require the modification of a map.

         1. Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) seeking a waiver that requires a modification of a map shall submit a map modification request and payment of map modification fees to the Bureau of Engineering as required by [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7).
2. ###### Findings


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may waive, reduce, or modify the required dedication or improvement as appropriate after making any of the following findings, in writing, based on substantial evidence in the record:

      1. The dedication or improvement requirement does not bear a reasonable relationship to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) impact.

      2. The dedication or improvement is not necessary to meet the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s mobility needs for the next 20 years, based on guidelines established by the Street Standards Committee.

      3. The dedication or improvement requirement is physically impractical.
3. ###### Written Determination


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall issue a determination regarding the request no sooner than 15 calendar days following mailing of the notice described above, and no later than 75 days from receipt of the waiver [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or within any additional period mutually agreed upon by the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall mail the determination letter to all individuals to whom notice of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) was provided.

4. ###### Appeal


      Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) required to dedicate land or make improvements pursuant to this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) may appeal the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). The appeal shall be filed within 15 calendar days of the date of mailing of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s determination letter. Such appeal shall be made in writing, shall be filed at the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s public counter, shall state in clear and concise language the grounds for the appeal, and shall be accompanied by a filing fee pursuant to [Sec. 15.3.14.A.4. (Street Dedication & Improvement Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.14).

      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall set the matter for a hearing, giving at least 15 calendar days notice to the individuals identified in [Sec. 10.1.10.A.1. (Notice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10).

      2. On appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall consider the waiver request de novo based on the findings set forth in [Sec. 10.1.10.A.2. (Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10). The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall act to approve or deny the appeal within 75 calendar days after the expiration of the appeal period or within any additional period mutually agreed upon by the applicant and the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).
2. ##### Waivers for Discretionary Projects


1. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s that require a discretionary entitlement, an applicant shall file a waiver request as part of the City Planning [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#)'s statement for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). In such case, the decision-maker for the discretionary entitlement shall process the waiver request pursuant to the procedures established for the discretionary entitlement, but may only grant a waiver after making one of the required findings set forth in [Sec. 10.1.10.A.2. (Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10). The waiver request shall be set forth in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) filed with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and may not be raised for the first time at the hearing on the entitlement or at any entitlement appeal hearing. The applicant may appeal the waiver determination pursuant to the same procedures that govern the entitlement. Except in the case of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s that include a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), the waiver determination is subject to only one level of appeal. On appeal, the decision maker shall consider the waiver request de novo based on the findings set forth in [Sec. 10.1.10.A.2. (Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10).

2. If the discretionary entitlement for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) has already been approved prior to March 4, 2017, an applicant may apply for a waiver following the procedures in [Sec. 10.1.10.A. (Waivers for By-Right Projects)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10).
3. ##### Waivers for a Map Modification


Notwithstanding the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), or [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) modification procedures set forth in [Article 13. (Administration)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13), [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s that have an approved or recorded map, and where the street standards for which the original dedication or improvements were revised after the map was either approved or recorded, may apply for a waiver from a street dedication or improvement using the procedures in [Sec. 10.1.10.A. (Waivers for By-Right Projects)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10), with the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) acting for the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

4. ##### Exceptions


[Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s located in a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) that seek to obtain a waiver from a required street dedication or improvement shall use the procedures described in [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), as applicable.

5. ##### Authority of the City Engineer


Notwithstanding any other requirement of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may waive or modify any condition of approval or other obligation related to [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) improvement or dedication consistent with the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) without requiring any discretionary entitlement, including, but not limited to, a modification under [Sec. 10.1.10.C. (Waivers for a Map Modification)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.10) and [Article 13. (Administration)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13). Nothing in this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) is intended to relieve applicants and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) of compliance with the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and state law.


### Sec. 10.1.11. Cost-Sharing for Unusual Improvements

Upon proper [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and upon recommendation of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) may accept and provide for contribution toward the cost of making any improvement required by the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) which the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) determines will cost an amount greatly in excess of the cost to other property owners who are required to make improvements under the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) in the immediate vicinity of the improvement.

### Sec. 10.1.12. Use Of Future Streets & Alleys

No [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), except a [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), shall be erected or maintained on any portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) which has been designated as a future street or future [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), as provided by this Article (Streets & Parks), nor shall any portion of said future street or future [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) be used in providing minimum automobile parking required by the applied [Development Standards District (Part 4B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4B).

### Sec. 10.1.13. City Engineer to Determine Street Alignment

Whenever uncertainty exists as to the proper application of the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) in the matter of street alignment, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall determine their application in conformity with the spirit and intent of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement).

### Sec. 10.1.14. Written Notification Required

When the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) determines that the provisions of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) are applicable to any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall inform the applicant of that determination, of the specific requirements of this Division (Street Dedication & Improvement) determined to be applicable, and of the availability and procedure for appeal of this determination to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

## Div. 10.2. Dedication by Lease

### Sec. 10.2.1. Eligibility

A lessee holding a parcel of real property under a long-term lease may offer to dedicate or convey a street easement for the term of the lease only in satisfaction of the requirements of [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1), providing all the following conditions are met.

1. Such lease is of record in the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder, and the lessee certifies under penalty of perjury that, except for the rental provided for by such lease, the owners will receive no financial benefit or other income from the proposed development during the term of the lease.

2. The area of real property to be dedicated will be used for sidewalk only, and not for vehicular traffic or the installation of any subsurface or above surface lines, pipes or other public or private utility facilities, except for facilities that connect from the fully dedicated streets into the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s to be constructed.

3. That notwithstanding that the adjacent public street is fully improved with all improvements as specified in [Sec. 10.1.2.C. (Requirement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.2), the sidewalk will be fully constructed and all other necessary or desirable public improvements in the adjacent street will be fully constructed by the lessee as a part of its development on the leasehold estate, and the lessee shall post the requisite bonds to guarantee such construction.

4. The total value of the improvements to be constructed for which the dedication is required is $3,000,000.00 or more, as determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).


### Sec. 10.2.2. Dedication Document Procedures

The dedication of the leasehold estate for street purposes pursuant to this Division (Dedication by Lease) shall be a form of deed making specific reference to the document creating the leasehold estate and the deed shall convey only the leasehold rights. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) is authorized to accept such deeds and place same of record with the Los Angeles County Recorder without further authority of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), upon the approval of such deed as to form by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) Attorney. Dedication of a leasehold estate for street purposes shall not be approved and no [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall be issued if the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) Attorney determines that the granting of such public right will cause a forfeiture or termination of the leasehold rights in the area to be dedicated.

## Div. 10.3. Private Street Regulations

### Sec. 10.3.1. Intent

The intent of this Division (Private Street Regulations) is: to prescribe rules and regulations governing the platting and division of land as [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s which are contiguous or adjacent to [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s; to provide for the filing and approval of [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) maps; to provide for the approval of [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s as [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s; to provide for the naming of [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s; and to require that [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s which are contiguous or adjacent to [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s conform to the minimum requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) before permits may be issued.

### Sec. 10.3.2. Applicability

1. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall plat or divide land as [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s which are contiguous or adjacent to a [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and no [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall be granted a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for such a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) unless a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map has been first filed with and approved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) in accordance with the provisions of this Division (Private Street Regulations).

2. When [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s have been laid out and designated as such to a recorded [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map or on a filed record of survey map, the provisions of this Division (Private Street Regulations) shall not apply thereto.

3. When a developed [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) has its [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) located within a [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) that existed and was recorded prior to September 6, 1961, the [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) is deemed to have been approved in accordance with the provisions of this Division (Private Street Regulations) and may be continued. Further, on such [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and modifications may be made to such [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s may be erected on said [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) if no additional [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s are created.


### Sec. 10.3.3. Subdivisions

The provisions of this Division (Private Street Regulations) shall not be construed as authorizing the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) of land without fully complying with the provisions contained and set forth in [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11). However, the provisions of this Division (Private Street Regulations) may be met by complying with the provisions of [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) relating to [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, without the necessity for filing a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map in addition to the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) maps required by [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11).

### Sec. 10.3.4. Procedure

See [Sec. 13B.7.7. (Private Street Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.7).

### Sec. 10.3.5. Private Street Standards

All [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall conform to the following regulations:

01. ##### Boulevards, Avenues & Collector Streets


    The location, widths, and alignment of all [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall conform: to the location, widths, and alignment of all [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, and [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s designated on the Citywide General Plan Circulation System maps of the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#); to any proceedings for any public improvement; and to any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map that has been tentatively approved.

02. ##### Local Street Alignment


    All [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, as far as practical, shall be in alignment with existing public streets or [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and their proper projections or prolongations, provided however that where the property being divided into [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s or [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s is large enough, a modified curve street layout may be permitted.

03. ##### Private Street Width


    All [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall be designed to conform with [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) standards adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) as provided in [Sec. 10.1.1. (Street Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.1).

04. ##### Street Grades


    On hillside or mountain streets comprising a through route, a [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) in excess of six percent shall not be permitted unless a [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) not to exceed eight percent will obviate an excessive curvature or eliminate excessive cuts. [Grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s of all streets shall be as low as possible, consistent with the advantageous development of the proposed platting and division of land. The [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) of any street of more than local traffic needs shall not exceed 10 percent. No [local street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) shall exceed 15 percent.

05. ##### Curves & Tangents


    A minimum centerline radius of at least 75 feet shall be used on winding mountain streets, a minimum centerline radius of at least 500 feet shall be used on all through traffic streets. In flat areas, curves on local streets shall have radii as long as possible, consistent with local conditions. The tangent distance between reversed curves shall not be less than 50 feet.

06. ##### Intersections


    [Private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) intersections shall be as nearly at right angles as practicable.

07. ##### Effect on Adjoining Property


    [Private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) layouts shall be designed to provide access to and not impose undue hardship upon property adjoining the proposed division of lands.

08. ##### Cul-De-Sacs (Dead-End Streets)


    Cul-de-sacs shall be permitted only where through streets are not practical, or where good neighborhood design suggests their use. Adequate provisions for turning shall be made at the end of each cul-de-sac by providing a circle or other area with a minimum overall radius of 42 feet. In the case of unusual topographic conditions, a “T” or “Y” turn may be permitted. The legs of the “T” or “Y” turn shall have a minimum paved surface 12 feet in width and 20 feet in length, the minimum radius between each leg and the street shall be 20 feet.

09. ##### Rounding Block Corners


    At all block corners, the property line shall be rounded or cut back. Intersection corners on the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) prolongation of [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, and [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall be rounded with 20-foot radius curves and all other corners shall be rounded with 15-foot radius curves, provided that where business development is indicated, a diagonal cut-off substantially equivalent to rounding may be used in order to aid [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) construction, in which case at right-angle intersections a substantial equivalent shall be a 10-foot by 10-foot cutoff.

10. ##### Improvements, Drainage & Sewage


    1. All [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and all [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s laid out contiguous or adjacent to [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall have approved drainage facilities and the method for sewage disposal shall be approved by the Bureau of Engineering, Bureau of Sanitation, and the Los Angeles County Health Department.

    2. All such [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall be graded and improved to an approved width and [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#). The street grading and improvement shall include surface improvements, fire hydrants and water mains, catch basins, pipe culverts, sanitary sewers, where reasonably available, and storm drains, where required. Drainage [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall be improved to an approved manner.

    3. [Boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, and [collector street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s shall be graded to an approved width and improved to an approved width and [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) necessary for the general use of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) owners adjoining said [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) and local neighborhood traffic and drainage needs.

    4. Where street improvements, drainage or sewers are required to be constructed on a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), plans and profiles showing the [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s and the nature and extent of the required improvements shall be filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for approval, the checking of plans, inspections, supervision, and other services rendered in connection with the construction of required improvements shall be accomplished under permits in accordance with the provisions of [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.105. (Streets, Sidewalks and Other Improvements - Permits Required)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158028) of this Code.

    5. Where improvements have been previously constructed in a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#), plans and profiles showing the [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) s, nature and extent of the existing improvements shall be filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) for their approval and the plans shall be checked and where additional construction is required, the additional construction shall be inspected and supervised, and all services rendered in connection with the existing or required improvements shall be accomplished under permit in accordance with the provisions of [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.105. (Streets, Sidewalks and Other Improvements - Permits Required)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158028) of this Code.

    6. A [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map or a portion of a map that includes land within a local drainage district established pursuant to [Sec. 11.3.7. (Maps, Local Drainage Districts, Exemption from Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.7), shall comply with the provisions and requirements of the ordinance establishing such district.
11. ##### Conformance To General Plan


    1. Each [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map shall be designed in compliance with the property's zoning or may be approved or amended by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

    2. Each [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) map shall substantially conform to all other elements of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#) as adopted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#).

(LAMC Sec. 10.3.6.)". The words, letters and figures of the sign shall be substantially arranged in the following manner:
