Except in [Industrial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7), [Public Use Districts (Div. 5B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.8), and [Open Space Use Districts (Div. 5B.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.1),in all portions of a [tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) area, all such utility lines shall be installed underground, provided, however, that incidental, appurtenant equipment such as transformers, terminal boxes, and meter cabinets may be placed above ground, but shall conform with regard to placement and height with those standards adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as it determines are necessary to safeguard the public against hazards created by the equipment and to further the intent of this Article (Division of Land). The [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), as established in [Sec. 13A.1.10. (Subdivision Committee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.1.10), shall make its report and recommendation of the Planning Commission prior to the adoption of the standards.

    3. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall make the necessary cost and other arrangements for such underground installation and for relocation of existing facilities with each of the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, firms or corporations furnishing utility services involved.
13. ##### Model


    Regardless of any other provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), a model or models may be erected and maintained on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or site designated by the Advisory Agency as a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a model or models on an approved or conditionally approved [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or tentative tract map for lots in [Agricultural Use Districts (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2) or [Residential Use Districts (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) and the "1L" [Density District (Part 6B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6#6B) with respect to one-unit dwellings, and in [Residential Use Districts (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) allowing multiple-unit structures, for example, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s containing more than one [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), for a period of time as determined by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), provided that:

    01. Not more than 15 percent of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and in no case more than 20 [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s at any one time in a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be designated as [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s for the construction of models, and, with respect to multiple-unit [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, not more than 15 percent of the units and in no case more than 20 units at any one time in a proposed [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) designated as a model [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), may be designated as models. Each of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be located in a manner as to not adversely affect existing developed [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) properties. Further, each of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be easily accessible and provision for the accessibility shall be assured at the time that the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is conditionally approved.

    02. In a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), a [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plan for the entire approved or conditionally approved [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or any final map unit thereof has been approved by the Grading Division of the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and a Grading Certificate has been issued for the property involved or that the [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is being carried on under the authorization of a valid [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) permit.

    03. Necessary [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s for the installation of water system facilities and underground utilities have been dedicated and the developer has guaranteed the cost of relocation or future adjustment of these facilities to the satisfaction of the Department of Water and Power.

    04. The owner assumes liability for any damage caused to water system facilities and underground utilities prior to final street improvements in a manner satisfactory to the Department of Water and Power.

    05. Adequate [fire protection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) facilities are provided to the satisfaction of the Fire Department.

    06. Adequate sewer facilities are provided to the satisfaction of the Bureau of Engineering, Bureau of Sanitation, and the Los Angeles County Health Department.

    07. A paved access [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) at least 20 feet in width is provided which is satisfactory to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    08. [Automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s be provided as follows:

        1. For multiple-unit [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, the numbers and location of the automobile parking facilities will be determined by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

        2. For one-unit detached [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, one [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for each six [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be located contiguous to the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) lots. All automobile parking facilities and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be dust-proofed with asphaltic surfacing or with decomposed granite which is sprinkled at sufficient intervals to prevent dust, or by an alternate method of dust control satisfactory to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
    09. The [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are attractively maintained and, with respect to one-unit detached [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, attractively landscaped.

    10. Any furnishings placed in the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) are maintained solely for purposes accessory to the display of the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and in no way are used to sell or promote the sale of such furnishings.

    11. Prior to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the property owner shall first execute and file with the Superintendent of Building a notarized agreement assuming all risks and agreeing to all of the conditions set forth in this Article (Division of Land). With respect to one-unit detached [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, the agreement shall further provide that in the event that a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that includes the property where the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located is not recorded, all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s authorized by the permit will be removed, within 90 days from the expiration of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and that if all buildings and structures are not completely removed as required above, they may be confiscated and removed or demolished by the City without further notice. Prior to the erection of any [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that is a one-unit detached structure, authorized in accordance with the approval of any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and contingent on the approval of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the property owner shall post in the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) a bond in favor of the City of Los Angeles (to be approved by the City Attorney and duplicates to be furnished) in an amount satisfactory to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) sufficient to defray any expense incurred by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in the removal or demolition of the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s. The bond will be released to the property owner or [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) legally entitled to it either upon recordation of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or upon removal of the concerned [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, as the case may be, to the satisfaction of the Superintendent of Building.

    12. This Subsection M. (Model) applies to approved or conditionally approved [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s that include [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and that have not been recorded as of the effective date of this ordinance.

    13. A real estate tract sales office may be established and maintained in one [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approved in accordance with the provisions of this Subsection M. (Model) or in a dwelling constructed on a recorded [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) previously designated as a model dwelling lot by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and temporarily serving as an example of houses or units built or to be built in the same [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), provided that:

        1. No general real estate brokerage business is conducted on the premises, and any business transacted there is limited to the original sale of vacant or improved land shown on the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or units of airspace shown on the [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plan.

        2. All signs conform to the applicable provisions of [Div. 4C.11. (Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11).

        3. The tract sales office is attractively maintained and, where located in a one-unit detached [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), is attractively landscaped.

        4. The property owner has first executed and filed with the Superintendent of Building a notarized agreement agreeing to comply with all other provisions of this Paragraph 13. (Model) and, further, agreeing that after all [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in the development are initially sold or rented, all tract sales being conducted within the structure will cease, all signs will be entirely removed from the premises, any residential type of sliding glass door in a private garage doorway will be replaced with a conventional private garage door, and any sales office activity located in a private garage will be discontinued and this area reconverted for the storage of private vehicles.
    14. The unit is constructed on a proposed [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or in a proposed [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) previously designated as a [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) site by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a multiple unit development for which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has approved or conditionally approved a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), but for which a [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has not yet been recorded.

    15. The proposed [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) upon which the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is constructed is recognized as a legal [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for the duration of the [model dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) permit.

    16. No [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for such unit has been issued by the Superintendent of Building.

    17. Where applicable, temporary [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is permitted over future streets previously restricted to public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
14. ##### Park & Recreation Sites


    Park and recreation sites to serve the future inhabitants of each new [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be provided and located in conformance with the standards contained in the [Open Space Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/01ea5f66-3281-488a-930b-f523712fef07/Open_Space_Element.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

15. ##### Where Subdivision Includes Land Within Drainage District


    Whenever a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a portion of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) includes land which is within a local drainage district, the provisions and requirements of the ordinance establishing such district shall be met.

16. ##### Protected Vegetation Regulations


    No [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be relocated or removed except as provided in this Article (Division of Land) or [Chapter IV, Article 6. (Preservation of Protected Trees and Shrubs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132239) of this Code. The term “removed” or “removal” includes any act that will cause [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to die, including, but not limited to, acts that inflict damage upon the root system or other parts of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) by fire, [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of toxic substances, operation of equipment or machinery, or by changing the natural [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of land by excavation or filling the [drip line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) area around the trunk.

    1. ###### Required Determinations


       Subject to historical preservation requirements set forth in [Sec. 11.1.3.P.3. (Historical Monuments)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3), when [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) exists within a proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be relocated or removed if the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), in consultation with the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s Chief Forester, determines the existence of either Subparagraph a. or Subparagraph b. below:

       1. There has been prior applicable government action in which:

          1. The removal of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); or

          2. The property on which the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located was the subject of a determination by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the appeal period established by [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7) with respect to the determination has expired, the determination is still in effect, and in accordance with the determination, the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s removal would be permissible; or

          3. A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has been issued for the property on which the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located, the permit is still in effect, and the removal or relocation is not prohibited by the permit.
       2. The removal of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) would not result in undesirable, irreversible soil erosion through diversion or increased flow of surface waters that cannot be mitigated to the satisfaction of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s Chief Forester, and the physical condition or location of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is such that:

          1. Its continued presence in its existing location prevents the reasonable development of the property; or

          2. According to a report required in accordance with [Sec. 11.2.1.C. (Protected Vegetation Reports for Tentative Tract Maps)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.2.1) or [Sec. 11.4.2.H. (Protected Vegetation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.2) acceptable to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and prepared by a [tree expert](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), there is a substantial decline from a condition of normal health and vigor of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and its restoration through appropriate and economically reasonable preservation procedures and practices is not advisable; or

          3. It is in danger of falling due to an existing and irreversible condition; or

          4. Its continued presence at its existing location interferes with proposed utility services or [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s within or without the subject property, and the only reasonable alternative to the interference is the removal of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); or

          5. It has no apparent aesthetic value, which will contribute to the appearance and [subdivision design](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); or it is not located with reference to other vegetation or [monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in such a way as to acquire a distinctive significance at the location.
    2. ###### Supplemental Authority


       In the event the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), in consultation with the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s Chief Forester, determines in accordance with [Sec. 11.1.3.P.1.b. (Required Determinations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) that a [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be removed or relocated, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may:

       1. Require relocation elsewhere on the same property where [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has been approved for removal, and where the relocation is economically reasonable and favorable to the survival of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Relocation to a site other than upon the same property may be permitted where there is no available or appropriate location on the property and the owner of the proposed off-site relocation site consents to the placement of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). In the event of relocation, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may designate measures to be taken to mitigate adverse effects on the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

       2. Permit [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of a lesser size, or vegetation of a different species, to be planted as replacement vegetation for [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) permitted by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to be removed or relocated, if replacement vegetation required in accordance with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) are not available. In that event, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require a greater number of replacement vegetation.
    3. ###### Historical Monuments


       The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), except as to [Sec. 11.1.3.P.1.b.iii. (Required Determinations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3), shall require retention of [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) at its existing location, if the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is officially designated as a historical [monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or as part of a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    4. ###### Requirements


       In the event the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), in consultation with the City’s Chief Forester, determines in accordance with [Sec. 11.1.3.P.1.b. (Required Determinations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) that [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be removed or relocated, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall require that:

       1. The [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is replaced within the property by at least four specimens of a protected variety, except where the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is relocated in accordance with [Sec. 11.1.3.P.2.a. (Supplemental Authority)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) [Protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall only be replaced by other [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) varieties. A protected shrub shall only be replaced by other protected shrub varieties, to the extent feasible as determined by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), Board of Public Works, or a licensed or certified arborist. When replacement concerns more than two types of [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the permit at issue shall be considered at a full public hearing at the Board of Public Works. For protected trees, the size of each replacement tree shall be a 15-gallon, or larger, specimen, measuring one inch or more in diameter at a point one-foot above the base, and not less than seven feet in height, measured from the base. The size and number of replacement trees shall approximate the value of the tree to be replaced.

       2. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) record those covenants and agreements approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) necessary to assure compliance with conditions imposed by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and to assure preservation of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

       3. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) provide [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) maintenance information to purchasers of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s within the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

       4. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) post a bond or other assurance acceptable to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to guarantee the survival of [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) required to be replaced or permitted or required to be relocated, in a manner to assure the existence of continuously living [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) at the approved replacement or relocation site for three years from the date that the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is replaced or relocated. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall use the provisions of [Sec. 11.3.3.E. (Guarantees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3) as its procedural guide in satisfaction of the bond requirements and processing. Any bond required shall be in a sum estimated by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be equal to the dollar value of the replacement vegetation or of the vegetation that is to be relocated. In determining value for these purposes, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall consult with the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the City’s Chief Forester, the evaluation of trees guidelines approved and adopted for professional horticulturists by the International Society of Arboriculture, the American Society of Consulting Arborists, the National Arborists Association and the American Association of Nurserymen, and other available local information or guidelines.
    5. ###### Grading


       The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is authorized to prohibit grading or other construction activity within the [drip line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
17. ##### Preliminary Soils Report


    1. A preliminary soils report, prepared by a [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and based upon adequate test borings, is required with the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may waive the preliminary soils report upon its determination that no preliminary analysis is necessary due to its knowledge of the qualities of the soils of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    2. If the preliminary soils report indicates the presence of critically expansive soils or other soil problems which, if not corrected, would lead to structural defects, a soils investigation of each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be required. Such soils investigation shall be done by a [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), who shall recommend the corrective action which is likely to prevent structural damage to each [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) proposed to be constructed in the area where such soils problem exists. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may approve the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a portion of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where such soils problems exist if it determines that the recommended corrective action is likely to prevent structural damage to each [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be constructed, and as a condition to the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require that the approved recommended action be incorporated in the construction of each [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
18. ##### Mulholland Scenic Parkway


    1. Notwithstanding the street standards adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with [Sec. 10.1.1. (Street Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.1), the width and improvement standards for the Mulholland Scenic Parkway shall be substantially as follows:

       01. Two travel lanes, one in each direction, each 15 feet wide;

       02. Passing lane segments and turn pockets where necessary to facilitate movement of traffic;

       03. Substantial conformance to existing [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) alignment;

       04. No median strip except to facilitate turning movements;

       05. Hard surfaced shoulders but with a natural look, separated from the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) by a painted line where the shoulder is utilized for bikeway purposes;

       06. Minimum street and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) access to the Parkway;

       07. Reasonable protection of a scenic corridor 500 feet more or less, depending on topography, from each side of the existing [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), to preserve the scenic quality and for the development of parks, vista points, automobile parking facilities, and continuous bicycle, equestrian and hiking trails;

       08. All utilities to be underground;

       09. All necessary signs and road related fixtures to be of a special design to blend with the scenic character of the Parkway;

       10. [Grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be kept to an absolute minimum; and

       11. All necessary [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be gently contoured and fully landscaped with fire-resistant plants to present a natural appearance.
    2. It is the duty of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to interpret and apply these standards in conformance with the spirit and intent of the Report of the Citizens’ Advisory Committee on the Mulholland Scenic Parkway as adopted as City policy by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on March 26, 1973, under Council File No. 70-5000, or with such Parkway plans as may subsequently be adopted.

    3. These standards are applicable to any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map within 500 feet of the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of Mulholland Drive between the Hollywood Freeway on the west and Mulholland Highway on the west and along Mulholland Highway to the southerly [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) boundary, as shown on the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s official cadastral or district maps.
19. ##### Valley Circle Boulevard, Plummer Street Scenic Corridor


    1. Notwithstanding the street standards adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with [Sec. 10.1.1. (Street Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.1), the width and improvement standards for Valley Circle Boulevard from Roscoe Boulevard to Plummer Street and for Plummer Street from Valley Circle Boulevard to Topanga Canyon Boulevard shall be substantially as follows:

       01. Two travel lanes, one in each direction;

       02. Left turn pockets as needed;

       03. Forty-eight feet of paved [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), including two-foot wide concrete gutters and curbs;

       04. No continuous raised median strip;

       05. Wide shoulders to accommodate recreation trails;

       06. Minimum street and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) access to the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

       07. All utilities to be underground;

       08. Lighting only at intersections and automobile parking areas, and kept to a minimum useful Intensity;

       09. Fire hydrants and light standards located away from the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for increased safety;

       10. Picnic areas, drinking fountains, restroom facilities, watering troughs, hitching rails, and simple shade structures provided at suitable locations;

       11. The general design and development of the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), trails, turnouts, and all appurtenant fixtures, facilities, and amenities to be rustic, natural, and in keeping with the scenic character of the corridor;

       12. Reasonable protection of a scenic corridor, 1,500 feet more or less depending on topography, from each side of the existing rights-of-way, to preserve the scenic quality, protect long-distance views, and for the development of parks, vista points, automobile parking facilities, and continuous trails;

       13. Specific dimension standards for a 100-foot-wide [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the preferred width, shall be a 14-foot-wide two-way bicycle path, a hiking trail meandering in a 10-foot-wide landscaped [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), a 16-foot-wide equestrian trail bordered by bolted wood fences and a 12-foot-wide [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on the opposite side of the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

       14. The dimension standards for an 86-foot-wide [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be a 12-foot-wide, two-way bicycle path, hiking trail meandering in an eight-foot-wide landscaped [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), a 12-foot-wide equestrian trail bordered by bolted wood fences, and a six-foot-wide [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on the opposite side of the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

       15. Trails to be built prior to or concurrently with the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and to have suitable crossings and [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to areas of interest;

       16. Attractively designed masonry walls or screening landscaping along the edges of private developments adjacent to the scenic corridor;

       17. Maximum preservation of natural terrain and vegetation;

       18. [Grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be kept to an absolute minimum; all necessary [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be gently contoured and fully landscaped with native, low-water-need, fire-resistant plants to present a natural appearance;

       19. All buildings in the corridor to be placed so as to preserve a clear line of sight from the [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the visible mountain crest;

       20. Off-site advertising signs to be prohibited within the corridor;

       21. On-site advertising, traffic, informational and regulatory signs to be kept to a minimum number and size, and to be of special rustic design.
    2. It is the duty of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to interpret and apply these standards in conformance with the spirit and intent of the Valley Circle Boulevard Plummer Street Scenic Corridor Study adopted as City policy by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on March 28, 1977, under Council File No. 77-82, or with such [parkway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plans as may subsequently be adopted.

    3. The standards stated here are applicable to any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map within 1,500 feet of the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of Valley Circle Boulevard from Roscoe Boulevard to Plummer Street and of Plummer Street from Valley Circle Boulevard to Topanga Canyon Boulevard as shown on the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s official cadastral or district maps.

## Div. 11.2. Tentative Tract Maps

### Sec. 11.2.1. Tentative Tract Map Standards

1. ##### Tentative Tract Map Requirements


1. ###### Filing & Reports


      1. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall pay the necessary fees for, and file with the Department of City Planning at least five copies of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); two copies of an area map showing the location of ownerships which are located within the area covered by the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and within a 500-foot radius of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); and two copies of a certified list showing the names and addresses of owners and the addresses of all [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), commercial, and industrial occupants of all property located within 500 feet of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

      2. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall furnish a copy of the certified list of names and addresses and a copy of the area map to the Bureau of Engineering, and copies of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to each member of the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and to any other departments or public agencies which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) had determined may have an interest in the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall make such examination of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and property, and make such reports and recommendations to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as they find are necessary. All such reports shall be submitted in writing. Such reports shall be made within 39 calendar days after the filing of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or within such additional time as the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may approve.
2. ###### Action of Advisory Agency


      The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall approve, conditionally approve or disapprove the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.3. (Tentative Tract Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3),

      1. Whenever two or more [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are to be created on a common slope and the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or Superintendent of Building determines that conditions so dictate, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require as a condition of approval of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that appropriate deed covenants, on a form approved by the City Attorney, be recorded which provide to each owner of the common slope a joint right of entry for necessary access of people and equipment, and a joint [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) over the slope area to maintain and repair any portions of the common slope.

      2. All streets on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be identified by their proposed names. All proposed street names shall be approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may withhold approval of the map if the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has determined that a proposed street name would create confusion, be misleading, be unduly long or carry connotations offensive to good taste and decency.
2. ##### Map Requirement


[Tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s filed with the Department of City Planning shall be prepared by or under the direction of a licensed [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Such maps shall clearly show all information required by this Article (Division of Land), and shall be drawn to an engineer’s scale of not less than one inch equals 200 feet. The [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall contain all the following:

01. The tract number;

02. Sufficient legal description of the property to define its boundaries;

03. Names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the record owner, [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) preparing the map;

04. North point, engineering scale, date, and area;

05. The widths and approximate locations of all existing and proposed public [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or rights of way, or [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, within and adjacent to the property involved;

06. Locations, widths, and approximate grades of existing and proposed highways, streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or ways, whether public or private within and adjacent to the property involved;

07. Existing street names, and names or designations for all proposed streets and highways;

08. Approximate radii of all centerline curves for streets, highways, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or ways;

09. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) layout, approximate dimensions of each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and number of each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

10. The locations of potentially dangerous areas, including geologically hazardous areas and areas subject to [inundation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [flood hazard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); the location, width and direction of flow of all watercourses, flood control channels, and mud or debris paths where ravines or swales will exist within and adjacent to the property involved; [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s from such hazards; the proposed method of providing flood, erosion, and mud or debris control; and areas where [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and emergency paths will be located in the event flood design capacity is exceeded. [Lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be located so that the flow of watercourses, mud and debris paths, access and emergency paths, and setbacks shall be adjacent to [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or in areas or restrictions against construction;

11. The existing contour of the land at intervals of not more than five feet, and of not more than two-foot intervals if the [slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the land is less than five percent;

12. The approximate location of all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s on the property involved which are to be retained, notations concerning all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s which are to be removed, and approximate locations of all existing wells;

13. The approximate location and general description of any large or historically significant trees, and of any [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and an indication as to the proposed retention or destruction of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

14. If any streets shown on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) are proposed to be [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, they shall be clearly indicated. Such streets shall conform to the requirements of [Div. 10.3. (Private Street Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3) or shall have been previously approved in accordance with the then applicable [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) provisions;

15. The proposed method of providing sewage disposal and drainage for the property; and

16. A statement regarding existing and proposed zoning.
3. ##### Protected Vegetation Reports for Tentative Tract Maps


1. No [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval for a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located is considered complete unless it includes a report, in a form acceptable to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s Chief Forester, which pertains to preserving the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and evaluates the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s proposals for the preservation, removal, replacement or relocation of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The report shall be prepared by a [tree expert](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and shall include all [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) identified in accordance with [Sec. 11.1.3.P. (Protected Vegetation Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) and [Sec. 11.2.1.B.13. (Map Requirement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.2.1).

2. In the event the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) proposes any [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), land movement, or other activity within the [drip line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) referred to in the report, or proposes to relocate or remove any [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the report shall also evaluate any mitigation measures proposed by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and their anticipated effectiveness in preserving the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

## Div. 11.3. Final Tract Maps

### Sec. 11.3.1. Final Tract Map Standards

01. ##### Process


    See [Sec. 13B.7.4. (Final Tract Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.4).

02. ##### Filing Requirements


    The following information shall be submitted with the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#): names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the record owners, [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) preparing the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The general form and layout of the map, including size and type of lettering, drafting, and location of acknowledgments, shall be determined by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The map shall be prepared on high-quality tracing cloth or other material approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    1. Each sheet of the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be 18 × 26 inches. A marginal line shall be drawn completely around each sheet, leaving a blank margin of one inch. The scale of the map shall be such as to show all details clearly. Each sheet shall be numbered, and its relation to other sheets clearly shown. The tract number, scale, and north point shall be shown on each sheet. If more than three sheets are necessary to show the entire [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), an index map shall be included on one of the sheets. The boundary line of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be indicated by distinctive symbols and clearly so designated.

    2. Where any land to be subdivided is separated or divided into two or more [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or portions by any [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of land other than a street, highway, or other [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or a railroad, public utility or flood control [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), each separate [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or portion of a [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be subdivided as a separate [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and shown on a separate [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map.
03. ##### Boundary Evidence


    Such stakes, monuments or other evidence determining the boundaries of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as are found on the ground, together with sufficient designations of adjoining [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s by [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and tract number and page of record, or by section, township and range, or other proper legal description as may be necessary to locate precisely the limits of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), shall be clearly and fully shown on the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

04. ##### Monuments


    1. ###### Boundary


       1. Each [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall show durable monuments of not less than two-inch steel pipe at least 24 inches long found or set at or near each boundary corner and at intermediate points approximately 1,000 feet apart or at such lesser distance as may be necessary by topography or culture to assure accuracy in reestablishment of any point or line without unreasonable difficulty. The precise position and character of each monument shall be shown on the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Where the elevation of the top of each such monument is not approximately level with the surface of the ground, its relative position shall be indicated.

       2. The establishment of boundary monuments may be required by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) upon appeal, prior to the recordation of the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), however, such requirement may be modified to accept the submission of complete field notes as evidence of a thorough survey, or the setting of only a portion of the boundary monuments, or the referencing of monuments to adjacent reference points. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall submit a recommendation concerning this matter. The reference points shall be indicated in a set of field notes showing clearly the ties between such monuments and sufficient number to set accurately each boundary monument after recordation of the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The boundary monuments shall be properly located by coordinates in the California Coordinate System or in such manner as determined by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be suitable and sufficient.
    2. ###### Centerline


       Complete centerline data, including lengths of tangents and semi-tangents, shall be shown on the map for all streets within or adjoining the tract where no official centerline has been previously established. In locations where the point of intersection falls on private property, chords shall be shown instead of semi-tangents. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall have approved monuments placed with permanent references to the monuments and furnish a set of field notes to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    3. ###### Deferment


       1. In the event any or all of the monuments required to be set are subsequent to the recordation of the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the map shall clearly show and describe such monuments. All such monuments or the furnishing of notes for deferred monuments shall be agreed to be set and furnished by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

       2. When the placement of monuments is to be deferred, the Bureau of Engineering shall charge and collect a fee as established in [Sec. 15.3.6.P. (Deferred Placement of Monuments)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.3.6) for the service of receiving and processing a bond to guarantee placement of the monuments.
    4. ###### Geodetic Controls


       Ties to the Geodetic Triangulation System shall be provided where stations have been established within reasonable distance from the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) boundary, and such ties are deemed necessary by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
05. ##### Surveys


    1. ###### Requirements


       1. The procedure and practice of all survey work, done on any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), shall conform to the accepted standards of engineering and surveying professions. The [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall close in all its parts.

       2. In the event the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has established the centerline of any street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in or adjoining a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall show such centerline together with the reference to a field book or map showing such centerline and the monuments that determine its position. If determined by ties, that fact shall be stated on the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
    2. ###### Notes to be Furnished


       1. For such centerline monument set, the [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall furnish to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) a set of notes showing clearly the ties such monument and a sufficient number (normally four) of durable distinctive reference points or monuments. Such reference points may be lead and tacks in sidewalks, or curbs, or two-inch × two-inch stakes set back of the curb line and below the surface of the ground or such substitute as appears to be not more likely to be disturbed.

       2. The set of notes shall be of such quality, form and completeness, and shall be on paper of such quality and size as may be necessary to conform to the standardized office records of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). All such notes shall be indexed by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as part of the permanent public records.
    3. ###### Identification Marks


       All monuments set as required in this Article (Division of Land) shall be permanently and visibly marked or tagged with the registration or license number of the [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
06. ##### Bearings


    1. ###### Basis


       1. The [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall indicate the basis of bearings, making reference to some recorded [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map, or other record acceptable to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

       2. The [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall have as the basis of bearings a line based on the Geodetic Triangulation System where ties to the system are deemed feasible by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
    2. ###### Distances


       The bearing and length of each [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) line, and boundary line shall be shown on the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and each required bearing and distance shall be indicated.
07. ##### Lot Numbers


    The [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be numbered consecutively commencing with the number one, except as otherwise provided in this Article (Division of Land), with no omissions or duplications. Each numbered [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be shown entirely on one sheet.

08. ##### Curve Data


    The length, radius, and total central angle and bearings of terminal radii of each curve and the bearing of each radial line to each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) corner on each curve, and the central angle of each segment within each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be shown on the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

09. ##### Easement


    1. ###### Lines


       The [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall show all the necessary data including width and side lines of all public [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s to which the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) are subject. If the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is not located on record, a statement as to the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall appear on the title sheet.

    2. ###### Designation


       [Easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be denoted by broken lines.

    3. ###### Identification


       Each [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be clearly labeled and identified and, if already of record, proper reference to the records given. [Easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s being dedicated shall be so indicated in the Certificate of Dedication.
10. ##### City Boundary Lines


    City boundary lines crossing or abutting the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be clearly designated and tied in.

11. ##### Natural Water Course Designation


    In the event that a dedication of [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for flood control or storm drainage is not required, the location of any natural water course shall be shown on the [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), unless such natural water course, channel, stream or creek is shown on the [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plans to be filled or otherwise eliminated by the [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the tract.

12. ##### Title Sheet


    The title sheet for each [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall contain all the certificates and acknowledgment required by the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The wording of such certificates and acknowledgments shall be approved by the City Attorney. Forms of certificates and acknowledgment may be obtained from the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).


### Sec. 11.3.2. Notifications

1. ##### Notification Regarding Street Lighting Maintenance Assessments


The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall cause to be filed, at the time of filing of any [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map with the Los Angeles County Recorder, a notice or notices which shall provide information with respect to each [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regarding the obligation of any purchaser of such property to pay street lighting maintenance assessments in accordance with the provisions of [Div. 6. (Special Assessment District Procedures), Chapter 3. (Street Lighting and Improvements)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-28468) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. ##### Notification Regarding Sewer Pumping or Drainage Facilities & Maintenance Districts


The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall execute and record with the Los Angeles County Recorder a notice identifying all sewer pumping or drainage facilities within the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), either in existence or to be constructed, which could be maintained under maintenance district procedures authorized by [Div. 6. (Special Assessment District Procedures), Chapter 3. (Street Lighting and Improvements)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-28468) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Such notice shall provide information regarding the possible obligation of each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) owner for assessments and shall be recorded at the time the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is filed with the Los Angeles County Recorder. Notifications for sewer pumping connection to [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) sewer shall also be sent to City of Los Angeles Bureau of Sanitation to verify if a Sewer Capacity Availability Request (SCAR) is required.


### Sec. 11.3.3. Subdivision Improvements

01. ##### Requirements


    The streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in all [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s subject to the provisions of this Article (Division of Land) shall be laid out to provide for sewer and drainage facilities. All streets and [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and other [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s within and immediately adjoining the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), together with any drainage and sanitary sewer [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, shall be graded and improved to a width and [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with plans approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Other [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s as authorized by the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be required.

    1. In addition to permanent [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, temporary [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s may be required to be made prior to or concurrent with permanent [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s. In a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), temporary erosion control devices shall be designed and installed in a manner approved by the Board of Public Works and the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    2. If the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has been submitted only for the purpose of clarifying records by consolidating existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or metes and bounds [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, or for the purpose of absorbing vacated streets or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or for the purpose of reversion to acreage, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) upon the recommendation of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may waive all or a portion of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s which otherwise would be required.
02. ##### Improvement Plans


    1. Final plans, profiles, and specifications for [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be furnished to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for approval and processing concurrently with the checking of the final map. Such plans, profiles, and specifications shall show full details for such [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and shall be in accordance with the standards adopted by the City of Los Angeles.

    2. In lieu of final plans, profiles and specifications, the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may furnish preliminary plans for [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in a form satisfactory to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), provided the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) agrees to furnish final plans, profiles, and specifications to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) not later than six months from the date the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is filed for recording with the Los Angeles County Recorder. Preliminary plans shall be of sufficient detail and extent so as to permit the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to determine the type, extent, quantity, and estimated cost of the required [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.
03. ##### Street Lighting


    Plans for a street lighting system shall be submitted to and be approved by the Bureau of Street Lighting. The time requirement for submittal shall be as prescribed in [Sec. 11.3.3.B. (Improvement Plans)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3).

04. ##### Street Trees


    1. Arrangements between the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to ensure the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) either places street trees in [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s to the satisfaction of the Bureau of Street Maintenance of the Department of Public Works, or makes a cash payment to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The amount of cash payment shall be in accordance with rates established by the Board of Public Works. When planted by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), street trees may be planted under contract or by [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) forces.

    2. Any street tree planted by a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or for which a payment is made to the City of Los Angeles to provide such tree, is subject to the street tree maintenance fee set forth in [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.176 (Street Maintenance Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158882) of this Code.
05. ##### Guarantees


    1. No [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be presented to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for approval until the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner has completed the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, or has guaranteed that all [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s will be constructed and installed within a specified time. The requirement of guaranteeing the construction and installation of [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s will not be waived under any condition except as provided in this Subsection E. (Guarantees). [Parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, the preliminary maps for which have been approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) specifying that [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are not required until such time as a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or other grant of approval for development is issued, are exempt from this provision. California non-profit corporations are exempt from these requirements to the extent provided in the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

    2. The guarantee shall be furnished in accordance with the provisions of this Subparagraph 2.:

       1. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner shall execute an Improvement Agreement. Under the terms of this agreement, the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner shall, among other things: agree to construct and install the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s at the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner’s expense; shall warrant all work performed against any defective work or labor done, or defective materials furnished for a period of one year following acceptance by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of all [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; and shall agree to reimburse the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for all costs and reasonable expenses and fees incurred by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in enforcing the terms of the agreement including reasonable attorney’s fees.

       2. Performance of the Improvement Agreement shall be guaranteed by one of the following, at the option of and subject to the approval of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#):

          1. A surety bond or bonds payable to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), executed by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner as principal and one or more corporate sureties authorized to act as surety under the laws of the State of California and having a certificate of authority as acceptable surety on Federal bonds; or

          2. A deposit of cash; or

          3. A deposit of negotiable United States Treasury bonds or notes, for which the faith and credit of the United States are pledged for the payment of principal and interest, payable to the bearer; or

          4. A deposit of fully-insured certificates of deposit issued by a financial institution whose deposits are insured by an instrumentality of the Federal Government, together with a non-revocable assignment to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that pledges that the funds are on deposit and guaranteed for the performance of the Improvement Agreement. Such certificates of deposit may provide that interest shall be paid to the depositor. The assignment shall allow the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to withdraw the principal amount, or any portion of the principal amount, on declaration of default by the Board of Public Works without the necessity of any further consent by the depositor. The Improvement Security shall be on a form prepared by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), shall be a joint and several obligation, and shall be in an amount estimated by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be reasonably necessary to complete the construction and installation of all of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s required to be done in accordance with the Improvement Agreement and to warrant the work against defective work or labor done, or defective materials furnished in the performance of the work.
       3. The term of the Improvement Security shall begin on the day it is approved by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and shall continue until the work is accepted by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

       4. The Improvement Security shall contain the further conditions that: in addition to the face amount, all parties executing the security shall be firmly bound under a continuing obligation for payment of all reasonable costs, expenses and fees, including reasonable attorney’s fees incurred by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in enforcing the obligation secured; that all parties agree to any extensions of time within which to construct and install the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; and that all parties further agree to such modifications of or additions to the work as may be deemed necessary by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) provided the cost increase does not exceed 10 percent of the value of the Improvement Security.
    3. ###### Improvement Warranty Guarantee


       As a part of the Improvement Security there shall be included an amount to be determined by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) sufficient for the guarantee and warranty of the work for a period of one year following the date of acceptance of the work by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) against any defective work or labor done, or defective materials furnished in the performance of the work.

    4. ###### Labor & Material Payment Security


       Security shall be furnished for payment of labor and materials furnished in the construction and installation of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s. The security shall be furnished in one of the forms described in [Sec. 11.3.3.E.2. (Guarantees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3), and shall be in an amount equal to not less than 50 percent of the Improvement Security as estimated by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The security shall inure to the benefit of all [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and entities furnishing services, supplies or equipment for the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s as referenced in [California Civil Code, Div. 4. (General Provisions), Sec. 8400, 8402 and 8404](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?division=4.&chapter=4.&part=6.&lawCode=CIV&title=2.&article=1.). All claims under this labor and materials payment security shall be filed with the City Clerk on or before the expiration of 90 days after the completion of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

    5. ###### Existing Security


       If the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner already has on file with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) an Improvement Security in one of the forms described in [Sec. 11.3.3.E.2. (Guarantees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3), posted in accordance with [Chapter VI (Public Works and Property), Sec. 62.111. (Class “B” Permits-Plans-Bonds-Insurance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-158265) of this Code which guarantees completion of all of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s designated in the Improvement Agreement and in an amount at least equal to the amount determined by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be necessary to complete all of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, no additional Improvement Security is required; however, improvement warranty guarantee and labor and material security may be required.
06. ##### Extension of Time


    If it appears that the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s cannot be completed by the date specified in the Improvement Agreement, written [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be made to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for an extension of the completion date. One extension of time shall be granted to a time at which the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines the work of [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) should reasonably be completed. Further extensions of time may be granted at the discretion of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). If the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) disagrees with the determination of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) such decision may be appealed to the Board of Public Works. Any extension may be considered upon agreement by the surety and principal to:

    1. Begin or resume construction of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s on a schedule to be specified by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); or

    2. Update the estimated cost of construction and installation of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s with an adjustment in the Improvement Security commensurate with the updated estimates; or

    3. To the extent possible, construct and install the required [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in accordance with the standards and specifications of the Board of Public Works in effect at the time such extension of time is granted; or

    4. Comply with other conditions as may be deemed necessary by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to ensure diligent prosecution of the work.
07. ##### Reduction of Improvement Security


    When a portion of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s have been completed to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may consent to a reduction in the amount of the Improvement Security upon written request from the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may consent to two reductions provided the original security for the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s exceeds $200,000 and the work completed is identifiable, capable of being maintained by the City, and accepted by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). In extreme hardship circumstances, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may consent to one reduction without regard to the preceding provisions. The remaining security shall be adequate to cover the estimated cost of completing the remaining [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, the improvement warranty guarantee, and reasonable expenses and fees for enforcement of the terms of the Improvement Agreement. If a cash deposit or negotiable security is on deposit, that portion of the cash or negotiable security not required as a guarantee for the remaining [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, improvement warranty guarantee and reasonable expenses and fees for enforcement of the terms of the Improvement Agreement, shall be returned to the depositor. If a certificate of deposit is on file, reduction in the Improvement Security will be accomplished by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) issuing a notice of reduction to the depositor and financial institution. If a surety bond is on file, reduction in the Improvement Security will be accomplished by the execution of a rider to the improvement surety bond by the principal and surety and is effective upon approval by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the City Attorney.

08. ##### Release of Improvement Security


    When all of the requirements of the Improvement Agreement and the Improvement Security have been completed to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the improvement warranty guarantee has expired, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall issue a Certificate of Acceptance and Termination of Improvement Warranty Bond to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner and a copy thereof shall be sent to the surety company if a surety bond is on file. However, if the improvement warranty guarantee has not expired, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may issue a Certificate of Acceptance, which exonerates the portion of the Improvement Security guaranteeing completion of the construction and installation of the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, but not the improvement warranty guarantee. The warranty guarantee shall thereafter be released in total by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on or after one year from the date of the completion notice from the Bureau of Engineering, provided no claims against the guarantee have been made by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

09. ##### Release of Labor & Material Payment Security


    On or after 90 days from the date of completion notices from both the Bureau of Contract Administration and the Bureau of Engineering, security posted under [Sec. 11.3.3.E.4. (Labor & Material Payment Security)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3) to secure payment for labor and materials may be released by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in whole if no claims are filed or reduced to an amount equal to 150 percent of those claims filed with the City Clerk.
