If a cash, negotiable security, or certificate of deposit payment security is on file, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall:

    1. Release the cash, negotiable security or certificate of deposit payment bond in total, if no claims have been filed; or

    2. Reduce the cash or negotiable security or certificate of deposit payment bond to an amount equal to 150 percent total amount of the claims filed with the City Clerk.
10. ##### Enforcement


    If the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner neglects, refuses or fails to construct the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s with such diligence as to insure completion within the time specified, or within such extensions of the time as may have been granted by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the Board of Public Works or if the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)/owner neglects, refuses or fails to perform satisfactorily any act required under the Improvement Agreement, the Board of Public Works may declare the Improvement Agreement in default, and shall take whatever actions are necessary to enforce the terms and conditions of the Improvement Security. The Board of Public Works is hereby empowered to order all or any part of the work to be done either by [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) forces or by separate contract, and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is entitled to reimbursement for all costs and expenses as a result of such construction. If the Improvement Security is a cash deposit, negotiable security or certificate of deposit the Board of Public Works is empowered to deduct therefrom, on behalf of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), an amount sufficient to reimburse and to indemnify the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for any and all damages, costs and expenses sustained or incurred by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in enforcing the terms and conditions of the Improvement Agreement.


### Sec. 11.3.4. Private Streets

1. Whenever a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is proposed to be used or included in a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall conform in all respects with all the requirements contained and set forth in [Div. 10.3. (Private Street Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3). A [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map need not be filed with the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in addition to the maps required by the provisions of this Article (Division of Land), provided that the maps filed in conformance with the provisions of this Article (Division of Land) show the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and contain the information pertaining to the street that is required to be provided in a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map.

2. If a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) located within a newly proposed [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was approved according to the regulations at the time of the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval, then the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is deemed to comply with the requirements of this Section (Private Streets) and [Div. 10.3. (Private Street Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3) and no further approval is required.


### Sec. 11.3.5. Reversion to Acreage

1. Proceedings for reversion to acreage of subdivided real property may be initiated by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on its own motion or by petition of all of the owners of record of the real property within the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.3. (Tentative Tract Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3).

2. Upon the title sheet of each map filed for the purpose of reverting subdivided land to acreage, the subtitle shall consist of the words “A reversion to acreage of . . .” Any map so submitted shall be accompanied by evidence of title and non-use or lack of necessity of any streets or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s which are to be vacated or abandoned. Any streets or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s to be left in effect after the reversion shall be adequately delineated on the map.

3. When a reversion is effective, all fees and deposits shall be returned and all improvement security released, except those retained in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.3. (Tentative Tract Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3).

4. After approval of the reversion by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be delivered to the Los Angeles County Recorder. The filing of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) constitutes legal reversion to acreage of the land affected and also constitutes abandonment of all streets and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s not shown on the Map.


### Sec. 11.3.6. Merger & Resubdivision

Subdivided lands may be merged and resubdivided without reverting to acreage by complying with all the applicable requirements for the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of land as provided in this Article (Division of Land). The filing of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), in accordance with [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7), constitutes legal merging of the separate [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s into one [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the resubdivision of the [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Any unused fees or deposits previously made in accordance with this Article (Division of Land) pertaining to the property shall be credited pro rata towards any requirements that are applicable at the time of resubdivision. Any streets or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s to be left in effect after the resubdivision shall be adequately delineated on the map. After approval of the merger and resubdivision by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the map shall be delivered to the Los Angeles County Recorder. The filing of the map constitutes legal merger and resubdivision of the land affected and also constitutes abandonment of all streets and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s not shown on the map.

### Sec. 11.3.7. Maps, Local Drainage Districts, Exemption From Fees

1. Payment of fees is required in the sums fixed by ordinance for local drainage districts involved and as a condition to approval of final [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) maps and [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) maps, except as provided in Subsection B. below, whenever the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines such need and finds:

1. That [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and development of property requires or will require construction of facilities described in the local drainage plan; and

2. That the fees are fairly apportioned within the area on the basis of benefits conferred on the property proposed for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or on the need for facilities created by the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and development of other property within such area.
2. In the event the owner filing the map petitions the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for an exemption from payment of fees required by ordinances to be paid to defray actual or estimated costs of constructing planned drainage facilities for removal of surface and storm waters from local or neighborhood drainage areas, and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) finds and determines that the final [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map or the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map filed for approval is not filed for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or development purposes, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may thereupon exempt that map from payment of the fees or other consideration notwithstanding provisions of [Sec. 11.1.3.O. (Where Subdivision Includes Land Within Drainage District)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3), [Sec. 11.4.4.B.9. (Where Parcel Map Includes Land Within Drainage District)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.4), or [Sec. 10.3.5.J.4.(Improvements, Drainage & Sewage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3.5) or requirements of [Sec. 11.3.7.A. (Maps, Local Drainage Districts, Exemption from Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.7) or of the ordinance for such payment.

3. For purposes of this Subsection C. the term “subdivision” and the term “development” neither includes nor applies to final [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) maps or [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) maps that are filed within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#):

1. In connection with a sale of land which is to be further divided by the filing of either a subdivision map or private street map prior to development occurring.

2. Solely for the purposes of reversion to acreage, or to combine portions of vacated streets with adjoining [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, or to make boundary line adjustments without creating any new [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, or to effect technical corrections on existing recorded maps in order to cause those maps to conform to actual fact, clarify the record, and cause them to read correctly, provided however that approval or recordation of such new maps does not or will not otherwise change or amend any existing recorded map or any legend.

### Sec. 11.3.8. Modifications

See [Sec. 13B.7.3.H. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3).

### Sec. 11.3.9. Subdivision Requiring Import or Export of Earth

1. Upon the filing of a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that, for its implementation, requires the import or export of more than 1,000 cubic yards of earth materials, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall request that the Superintendent of Building and the General Manager of the Department of Transportation investigate the circumstances of the proposed import or export of earth materials and the effect upon the public health, safety, and welfare. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall request the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to determine the effect of any import and export on the structural integrity of the public streets and to determine the effect on public safety relative to street alignment, width and [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. In taking action on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall impose conditions of approval to mitigate any detrimental effects of the hauling operations necessary to import or export earth, including but not limited to:

1. Designating routes to be followed by trucks hauling earth materials;

2. Limiting truck weight, length or speed; and

3. Any other conditions of approval necessary to ensure repair of damages to public streets along the hauling route that may reasonably be expected to be caused by hauling operations. Such additional conditions may include a condition that the developer shall file a bond for the benefit of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). Any such bond shall be in a form approved by the City Attorney, executed by the developer and a corporate surety authorized to do business in the State in an amount sufficient to cover the repair of any damage to the public streets reasonably expected to be caused by the hauling operations. The conditions of the bond shall guarantee to indemnify the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for all costs and expense in repairing the damaged streets or other public facilities. In lieu of a surety bond, the developer may file a cash bond with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) upon the same terms and conditions and in an amount equal to that which would be required in the surety bond. The deposit submitted may be in the form of cash or negotiable United States securities. The term of such bond shall begin on the date of filing and shall remain in effect until the completion of the hauling operations and subsequent inspection of the affected public streets by the Department of Public Works.
3. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may disapprove the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as provided in [Sec. 13B.7.3.E. (Standards for Review & Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3).


### Sec. 11.3.10. Modification of Recorded Final Tract Maps

In addition to amendments to [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s authorized by [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66469.,](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66469.&lawCode=GOV) after a [final tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is filed with the Los Angeles County Recorder, the recorded map, including the conditions of approval, may be modified in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.4.H. (Modification of Recorded Final Tract Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.4). Modifications and amending maps shall be governed by the following limitations.

1. No modifications involving increases in density are allowed if the increase would change the density of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as approved on appeal by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), where such density was the subject of the appeal to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. No condition may be modified if it was imposed as a mitigating measure identified in a mitigated or conditional negative declaration or in an Environmental Impact Report.

3. Modifications involving increases in density over that originally approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in approving the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be limited to the following:

1. For [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of fewer than 10 [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, any density increase shall be limited to one [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); and

2. For [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s containing 10 or more [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, any increase shall be limited to not more than 10 percent of that originally approved.
4. Modifications involving either an increase in the height of [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, or in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) pads where the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of such pads has been specified by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), shall be limited as follows:

1. An increase in the height of [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s of not more than 10 percent above the approved height of such [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; or

2. An increase in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) pads of not more than five feet above the approved [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of such pads; or

3. Any such increase in height or [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall not obstruct the view from surrounding properties; or

4. A greater increase in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) pads may be approved if such increase has been determined to be necessary for health and safety reasons by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
5. No modifications are permitted that violate the intent of any of the original conditions of the [tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval as that intent is expressed in the findings or otherwise by the decision-maker.


## Div. 11.4. Parcel Maps

### Sec. 11.4.1. General

1. ##### Intent


The following [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations are intended to: ensure compliance with the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); to assure [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s of acceptable [subdivision design](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and of a size compatible with the size of existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in the immediate neighborhood; to preserve property values; to assure compliance with the design standards for streets and [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in this Article (Division of Land) where street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) dedication or [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are required; to prevent interference with the opening or extension of streets necessary for emergency vehicle access, proper traffic circulation, and the future development of adjacent properties; and to provide that the dividing of land in the [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s be done in a manner that ensures that the separate [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s can be safely graded and developed as [building site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

2. ##### Scope


1. No land shall be separated in ownership or otherwise divided into two, three, or four [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and no such divided [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be separately maintained unless the division conforms to that shown on a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that has been approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

2. No [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be issued, and no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be constructed, altered or maintained on any land which has been separated in ownership or otherwise divided into two, three, or four [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in violation of the provisions of this Article (Division of Land), and until and unless a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has been recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder. All conditions of approval shall be completed prior to filing the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

3. These regulations do not apply to the leasing of [apartment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, offices, stores or similar space within an [apartment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), industrial [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), commercial [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or mobile home park, nor to mineral, oil or gas leases, nor do they apply to the following divisions of land, except as may be required by Subsection C. (Parcel Maps — Divisions of Land of Five or More Parcels Not Subdivisions):

      1. Those divisions of land made in compliance with the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations contained in this Article (Division of Land).

      2. Those divisions of land made solely because of the sale, acquisition, lease or combining of lands by governmental agencies, including the City of Los Angeles and any of its departments, or any further division of such lands by a lessee of such governmental agency.

      3. Those where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that all the following conditions exist:

         1. A [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) adjustment is made between four or fewer existing adjoining [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and the land taken from one [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is added to an adjoining [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

         2. The resulting number of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s remains the same or is decreased; and

         3. The [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s resulting from the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) adjustment conform to the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), any applicable Coastal Plan, this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)'s building ordinances.
4. Those involving land dedicated for cemetery purposes under the applicable provisions contained in the [California Health and Safety Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codesTOCSelected.xhtml?tocCode=HSC&tocTitle=+Health+and+Safety+Code+-+HSC).
3. ##### Divisions of Land of Five or More Parcels Not Subdivisions


1. No [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of land may be separated in ownership or otherwise divided into five or more [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, where such a division is not a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) by reason of the exceptions contained in [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66426.(a), (b), (c), and (d)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66426.&lawCode=GOV), and no such divided [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be separately maintained unless a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of such division has been approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) prepared in conformity has been recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

2. Where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) filed for the division of land described in [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66426.(b) and (c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66426.&lawCode=GOV) complies with all the requirements of this Article (Division of Land), but that dedication for street opening or widening or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s is necessary, it shall require that an offer to dedicate such additional land as is necessary to be made in a manner provided by [Sec. 11.4.4.B.1. (Conditional Approval)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.4).

3. Where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) filed for the division of land described in [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66426.(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66426.&lawCode=GOV) complies with all of the requirements of this Article (Division of Land), but that improvement of public or [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, highways, ways or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s is necessary for local traffic, drainage or sanitary needs, such improvements shall be constructed, or their construction and completion guaranteed in the manner provided by [Sec. 11.3.3. (Subdivision Improvements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3), as a condition of approval of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

4. No [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be issued, and no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be constructed, altered or maintained on any land which has been separated in ownership or otherwise divided into five or more [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, where a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is not required for such a division by reason of the exceptions contained in [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66426.(a), (b), (c), and (d)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66426.&lawCode=GOV), in violation of the provisions of this Article (Division of Land). All conditions of approval shall be completed prior to submitting the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
4. ##### Slope Density


1. In [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, which are designated in the "Minimum Residential" [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) land use designation, the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) density shall not exceed that allowed by the following formula:

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.1.0/11.4.1.1.png.webp?itok=s3FdHafg)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.1.0/11.4.1.1.png?itok=QXfLrOQt)

      Where:

      D = the maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per gross acre allowable; and

      S = the [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the land in percent.

2. Where the total allowable number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) calculated under the above formulas results in a number other than a whole number, it shall be rounded to the nearest whole number as follows:

      1. Where the fractional portion of the total allowable number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s equals 0.5 or more, the total number of allowable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be rounded to the next larger whole number;

      2. Where the fractional portion of the total allowable number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s equals less than 0.5, the total number of allowable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be rounded to the next smaller whole number.
3. In no case may the permitted density be less than 0.05 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per gross acre. Where the total allowable number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) calculated under the above formula results in a number less than one, it shall be rounded up to allow one [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) per [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

4. Where previous [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) makes it difficult to determine [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) using the above formula, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall determine the [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in a manner to carry out the intent of this Subsection D.
5. ##### Forms & Map Requirements


Each [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) applying for approval of a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) required by [Sec. 11.4.1.B. (Scope)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.1) shall submit a reproducible [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) showing the land to be divided and its proposed division. The map may be prepared by the applicant, except that the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require the map to be prepared by a licensed land [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and that it be based upon a field survey when it determines that such is necessary to provide the information required by this Subsection E. or Subsection F. (Incomplete Map), Subsection G. (Additional Reports), or Subsection H. (Protected Vegetation Reports) below. The map shall be made on one or more sheets of tracing paper or polyester based film at least 8 1/2 inches x 11 inches but shall not exceed 18 x 26 inches. It shall be legibly drawn using a decimal or an engineer’s scale and shall clearly show the following information:

1. The dimensions and record boundaries of the total [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) together with a legal description of the total [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) attached to the map.

2. The dimensions and boundaries of each proposed [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

3. The names, addresses, and telephone numbers of the property owners, the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) filing the map, and the [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or licensed land [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), if any, who prepared the map.

4. The [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) streets and [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and existing surface improvements and proposed dedications and [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

5. The location of other existing public [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, or [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

6. In [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, the existing contours of the land at intervals of not more than five feet.

7. The accurate location of any [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s on the property.

8. Names or designations for all proposed streets.

9. Such other information as the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines is necessary to properly consider the proposed division.
6. ##### Incomplete Map


If at any time during the processing of the map it is discovered that the map has been improperly prepared or required pertinent information has not been submitted, the applicant shall be promptly notified in writing by mail of the defect and of further information or correction required. The time limits specified shall not begin until the omitted or inaccurate information is furnished in a proper manner.

7. ##### Additional Reports


In addition to the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and when determined by the Superintendent of Building or the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be necessary, the following reports shall be submitted to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) by the applicant when the property is located in a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s:

1. A geologic report prepared by an engineering geologist, as defined in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Article 1. (Building Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172105) of this Code, setting forth all relevant geologic data pertaining to the proposed separate [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and including separately stated conclusions listing any potential hazards to public health, safety or welfare which may exist on the proposed [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or which could result from [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or building upon the proposed separate [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

2. A report prepared by a soils engineer, as defined in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Div. 70. (Grading, Excavations, and Fills)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-177742) of this Code, setting forth sufficient engineering data to explain the proposed solutions to:

      1. Any potential geologic hazards disclosed by the geologic report; and

      2. Any potential geologic hazards that could be created by the proposed [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
8. ##### Protected Vegetation Reports


No [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval for a [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located will be considered complete unless it includes a report pertaining to preserving the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with [Sec. 11.1.3.P. (Protected Vegetation Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3). The report shall be prepared by a [tree expert](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and shall evaluate the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s proposals for [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) preservation, removal, replacement or relocation. In the event the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) proposes any [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), land movement, or other activity within the [drip line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of any [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) referred to in the report, or proposes to relocate or remove any [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the report shall also evaluate any mitigation measures proposed by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the anticipated effectiveness in preserving the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).


### Sec. 11.4.2. Preliminary Parcel Map Standards

1. ##### Disapproval of Maps


1. Where a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) involves land for which a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), including [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) densities, has been adopted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and the land is also in a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the number of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s on the map shall be limited so that the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s permitted by the applicable zoning regulations does not substantially exceed the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) densities shown on the plan.

2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) when the property is situated in a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the Bureau of Engineering has submitted a report in writing to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) recommending disapproval of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) because of any existing or potential geologic hazards lacking satisfactory engineering solutions.

3. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may disapprove a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) unless the proposed name of each street has been approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval shall be withheld if the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has determined that a proposed street name would create confusion, be misleading, be unduly long or carry connotations offensive to good taste and decency.
2. ##### Lots May Be Increased in Size


1. Where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) finds it necessary in order to promote the general welfare, to provide for a more consistent development for the area, and to preserve property values, it may require that [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s described in a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and located in a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) be increased in size from that proposed so as to more closely conform to the size of existing contiguous [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or nearby [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s on the same street. However, in no case may the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) require such [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in the aforementioned [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), other than when a zone includes a Rural-Limited, Estate-Limited 4, or Estate-Limited 5 Form District, to contain an area of more than 20,000 square feet.

2. Where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) finds that a future public [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) will be needed on a portion of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s for street or other public [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, it may require that the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s be increased in size from the proposed to provide space for such [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). In addition, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may impose conditions prohibiting or restricting the erection for [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s on that portion needed for the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
3. ##### Maps Involving Private Road Easements


Whenever a proposed division of land involves one or more [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s that are contiguous or adjacent to a [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) with the remaining [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) contiguous or adjacent to a dedicated street, only the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) need be filed, without requiring the payment of additional fees or the filing of a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) map. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove the map subject to the applicable provisions of this Article (Division of Land) or [Div. 10.3. (Private Street Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3).

4. ##### Lots in the Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone


1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may disapprove a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for land located in the [Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) because of inadequate [fire protection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) facilities unless:

      1. The designated area in which [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are to be erected on each proposed [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), as shown on the map, is located not more than 1,000 feet from a fire hydrant, the distance to be measured along a route providing reasonable [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), as determined by the Fire Chief, for the laying of fire hoses in an emergency; or

      2. The Fire Chief reports that adequate [fire protection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) exists, or is in the process of being provided, for the [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.
2. Upon proper [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and upon recommendation of the Chief Engineer of Waterworks of the Department of Water and Power, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may provide for contribution toward the cost of installation of water mains and hydrants necessary to comply with this Subsection (Lots in the Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone) where the Chief Engineer determines that the cost of such installation is greatly in excess of normal charges for providing like facilities.
5. ##### Maps Involving Future Streets


In the event that the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that certain streets or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in a proposed division of land shall be reserved for future public [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), they shall be indicated on the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and offered for dedication as future streets or future [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s prior to recording the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The applicant shall furnish the Bureau of Right-of-Way and Land an offer of dedication therefor in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 11.4.4.B.1. (Conditional Approval)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.4).

6. ##### Maintenance of Accessory Structures


Where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that a proposed [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) complies with all provisions of these [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations, but otherwise finds that the proposed division of land will result in a [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where an [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [accessory structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is separated from the main [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or, a [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where a [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is without the required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, then, in order to afford the applicant time to remedy these problems (by providing a main [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) on the same [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as the [accessory structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), removing the [accessory structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or providing the required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may: approve the proposed [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the continued [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and maintenance of the [accessory structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s separated from the main [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), for a period of time not to exceed one year; or, approve the proposed [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the continued [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and maintenance of the [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) without the required [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, for a period of time not to exceed 90 days. However, in either situation, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s approval is subject to the following conditions:

1. That as a prerequisite to the filing of the final [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the owner or owners of record of the subject property shall record with the Los Angeles County Recorder a covenant running with the land in which such owner or owners agree to comply with the conditions imposed by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in approving the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. That upon approval of the proposed [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), in addition to the permanent copy placed on file in the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall furnish a copy of the action to the applicant and to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).
7. ##### Lots Involving a Common Slope


Whenever two or more [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are to be created on a common slope and the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or Superintendent of Building determines that condition so dictate, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require as a condition of approval of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that appropriate deed covenants on a form approved by the City Attorney be recorded which provide to each owner of the common slope a joint right on entry for [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of persons and equipment, and a joint [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) over the slope area to maintain and repair the common slope.

8. ##### Protected Vegetation


When [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) exists on a proposed [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the preservation of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) at its existing location, its relocation for preservation purposes, or the removal of the [protected vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be regulated in the same manner as that provided under [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations set forth in this Article (Division of Land).
