### Sec. 11.4.4. Preliminary Parcel Map Review Considerations

1. ##### Approval


When the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that the proposed [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) complies with all the provisions of these [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations, and no dedication or [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is required, it shall approve the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. ##### Conditional Approval


When the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) determines that the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) complies with all of the provisions of these [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations, but that street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) dedications or [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, storm drain [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, sanitary sewer [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or slope [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are necessary, or that [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or construction of an engineered retaining [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as specified in this Section (Preliminary Parcel Map Review Considerations) is necessary, it may approve the proposed [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) subject to the following conditions being complied with to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#):

01. That an offer be made to dedicate such land as is necessary for street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) purposes in compliance with the applicable street and [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) design standards established in [Sec. 11.1.3. (Subdivision Design Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) and such storm drain [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, sanitary sewer [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and slope [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s as are deemed necessary. The offer shall be properly executed by all parties having a record interest, including beneficiaries under deeds of trust as shown by a current preliminary title report prepared by a title company approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for that intent. The trustee under the deed of trust shall not be required to execute the dedicatory instrument, unless, in the view of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), such execution is necessary to satisfactorily dedicate the land. This report shall: be on a form approved by the City Attorney and the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); be in such terms as to be binding on the owner, heirs, assigns or successors in interest; and shall continue until the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) accepts or rejects it. The offer shall provide that the dedication will be complete upon acceptance by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall approve or disapprove the offer for recordation within ten days after it is filed. The offer shall be recorded by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) with the Los Angeles County Recorder upon its approval. If the streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s being offered for dedication are required for immediate public use as streets, [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, a resolution of acceptance shall thereafter be submitted to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) concurrently with the final [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in order to complete the dedication. Offers to dedicate that are not required for immediate public use will be retained by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) until such time as acceptance for public use occurs. If an offer is rejected by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall issue a release from such offer, which shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

02. When it is determined that additional street dedication for widening will be required from property adjoining that depicted in the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in order to comply with the applicable street standards provided for in [Sec. 11.1.3. (Subdivision Design Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3), the offer of dedication provided for above shall include an agreement as a covenant running with the land that upon completion of the dedication, a one-foot wide portion of the property included within the dedication and [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) such adjoining property shall not be used for [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). This agreement shall be in the form of a covenant running with the land and shall be recorded, but shall by its own terms become null and void upon the completion of the dedication of the additional land needed for street purposes from the adjoining property. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall show that portion of the dedication which is subject to the recorded covenant on the District Maps of the City of Los Angeles. As long as the agreement remains in effect, the one-foot strip shall not be used as a means of [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the adjoining property, nor shall any permits be issued by any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) department permitting its use for [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) purposes.

03. That such [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s as are required be constructed and installed to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or that construction and installation of such [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s be guaranteed in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 11.3.3.E. (Guarantees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3). The [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be limited to [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the installation of local drainage and sewer facilities, curbs, gutters, sidewalks, street lights, street trees, and [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) surfacing. In addition, the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may also require such other incidental [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s as are essential to the proper installation of the required public street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) improvements. All such [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be graded and improved in accordance with plans approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). When the conditions of approval of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) specify that [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s are required to be constructed prior to the grant of any development right, no [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be issued until the [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s have been constructed or suitably guaranteed in accordance with [Sec. 11.3.3.E. (Guarantees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3).

04. That if [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or construction of an engineered retaining structure is required by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to remove potential geologic hazards, such [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or construction shall be completed or guaranteed to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or the Superintendent of Building.

05. When recommended by the Fire Department, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may as a condition of approval of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), require the installation of fire hydrants to the satisfaction of the Fire Department.

06. Upon proper [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), and upon recommendation of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of Waterworks of the Department of Water and Power, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may provide for contribution toward the costs of installation of water mains and hydrants necessary to comply with this subsection where the Chief Engineer determines that the cost of such installation is greatly in excess of normal charges for providing like facilities.

07. Failure to fulfill all conditions of a conditional approval within one year after the date of such approval will automatically terminate and void the proceedings. Upon [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), prior to the expiration of the original one-year period, an extension of time for a period not exceeding one year may be granted by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s determination on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a time extension shall be subject to the appeal provision of [Sec. 13B.7.8. (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8).

08. ###### Modification of Requirements


       The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may modify or waive any dedication or [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) requirements in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.5.D.6. (Modification of Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.5).

09. ###### Where Parcel Map Includes Land Within Drainage District


       Whenever a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or a portion thereof includes land which is within a Local Drainage District, the provisions and requirements of the ordinance establishing such District shall be met.

10. ###### Modifications of Approved Preliminary Parcel Maps


       The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may grant slight modifications to a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) upon its own initiative or upon a request from a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.5.H. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.5).

11. ###### Map Identification & Reproduction


       Each [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be identified with a number assigned by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the date of filing. The number shall be shown on the recorded [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

### Sec. 11.4.5. Final Parcel Map

1. ##### Final Parcel Map Requirements


A final [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be prepared and filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in compliance with the provisions of this Article (Division of Land). The map shall conform substantially to the approved [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or the approved [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) which was filed in accordance with the requirements contained in [Sec. 11.4.1.C. (Parcel Maps — Divisions of Land of Five or More Parcels Not Subdivisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.1). The final [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be accepted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) provided that:

1. The necessary [subdivision improvement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or retaining structure construction, as set forth in the approval of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), have been installed and approved by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or provided the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) executes an Improvement Agreement and submits or agrees to submit:

      1. Improvement plans; and

      2. Satisfactory [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or construction plans, where [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or construction of an engineered retaining structure is required in [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; and

      3. Improvement Securities, warranty guarantees, and labor and material payment securities in accordance with provisions of [Sec. 11.3.3.E. (Guarantees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3).
2. All approvals have been obtained from [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) departments and other public agencies; and

3. Any special assessment or bond required to be paid or guaranteed in accordance with [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66493.(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66493.&lawCode=GOV) has been paid in full, or such payment has been guaranteed.
2. ##### Final Parcel Map Drafting Requirements


1. The following information shall be submitted with the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#): names, address, and telephone numbers of the record owners, and the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) preparing the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The general form and layout of the map, including size and type of lettering, drafting and location of acknowledgment, and other required information shall be determined by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The map shall be prepared on high quality tracing cloth, polyester based film, or other material approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. The map shall show the location of each [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and its relation to surrounding surveys. The location of any remainder of the original [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be shown, but need not be shown as a matter of survey but only by reference to the existing record boundaries of such remainder if such remainder has a gross area of five acres or more.

3. Each sheet of the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be 18 x 26 inches. A marginal line shall be drawn around each sheet, leaving a blank margin of one inch. The scale of the map shall be such as to show all details clearly. Each sheet shall be numbered, and its relation to other sheets clearly shown. The [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) number, scale, and north point shall be shown on each sheet. If more than three sheets are necessary to show the entire division of land, an index map shall be included on one of the sheets.

4. The exterior boundary of the land included within the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be indicated by distinctive symbols and clearly so designated. Each [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be identified by a letter.

5. The [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be compiled from recorded or filed data when sufficient survey information exists on filed maps to locate and retrace the exterior boundary lines of the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if the location of at least one of these boundary lines can be established from an existing monumented line.

6. All other [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s not utilizing Paragraph 5. above shall be based upon a field survey made in conformance with the Land Surveyor’s Act.

7. The [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be prepared by a registered civil engineer or licensed land [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). A signed Surveyor’s Certificate as required by the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall appear on the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

8. Where there are no dedications being made by the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), a certificate signed and acknowledged by the fee owners only, of the real property being subdivided, consenting to the preparation and recordation of the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), is required.

9. Each approved [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder shall contain the following statement:

      “The approval of this Parcel Map shall not be construed as having been based upon geological investigation such as will authorize the issuance of building permits on the subject property. Such permits will be issued only at such time as the Department of Building and Safety has received such topographic maps and geological reports as it deems necessary to justify the issuance of such building permits.”

### Sec. 11.4.6. Approval of Map Does Not Authorize Violation of Other Laws

See [Sec. 13B.7.5.F. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.5) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 11.4.7. Modification of Recorded Parcel Maps, Review Considerations

See [Sec. 13B.7.6.H. (Modification of Recorded Final Parcel Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.6) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 11.4.8. Sales Contrary to Parcel Map Regulations are Voidable

Any deed of conveyance, sale or contract to sell made contrary to the provisions of these [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) regulations is voidable to the extent and in the same manner as is provided for violations of [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66499.32](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66499.32.&lawCode=GOV).

## Div. 11.5. Condominiums, Community Apartments, & Stock Cooperatives

### Sec. 11.5.1. Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial

1. ##### Intent


The intent of these provisions is: to promote greater individual choice in the type, quality, price, and location of housing; to provide for the housing needs of all segments of the population; to provide increased homeownership opportunities for all segments of the population; to mitigate the hardship caused by displacement of tenants, particularly those in low to moderate cost housing and those who are elderly, families with minor dependent children, the handicapped and the disabled; to promote the safety of [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and correct any violations of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code which may occur in [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; to provide adequate [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; to encourage construction of new [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s to replace units lost due to conversions; to protect the existing rental housing stock by reducing conversions; to provide increased opportunities for the ownership of commercial or industrial real property in the form of [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; to assure that the continued [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s for commercial or industrial purposes is substantially consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; and to generally regulate [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in accordance with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and with the public health, safety and welfare.

2. ##### Applicability


The provisions of this Section shall apply to all [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, except as otherwise expressly stated in this Section.

3. ##### Application Requirements


1. ###### Residential Conversion Projects


      1. A [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall comply with the Division of Land regulations in this Article (Division of Land), the provisions of this Section (Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial), and other applicable State laws and local ordinances.

      2. In addition to the information required by other applicable provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the following information shall be submitted at the time of filing:

         1. Building plans or other documents containing the following information pertaining to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as proposed, certified as to accuracy by a licensed engineer:

            1. Description of the features of the type of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), including age, type of construction, number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and number of [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#);

            2. Site plan, including [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, open spaces, and accessory storage areas and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s including trash storage areas; and

            3. Parking plan, including: the total number of spaces actually provided on-site or off-site and the total number required if different from that actually provided; dimensions of stalls, aisles, and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; locations of columns, walls and other obstructions; total number of covered and uncovered [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and location and number of guest [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.
         2. Tenant Information: Name and address of each tenant; total number of project occupants; length of tenancy; rent schedule for 18 months preceding the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); relocation assistance plan.

         3. Sales Information: Anticipated range of sales prices of individual [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or shares based on information known at the time of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); anticipated terms of sale to existing tenants; statement as to whether sales will be permitted to families with minor children; incentives to tenants for the purchase of the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; written notice to the tenants of an exclusive right to purchase the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) occupied by the tenant; and the number of tenants that have expressed interest in purchasing their [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

         4. Floor plans and [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, including indications of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and required exits.
      3. The following additional information may be required by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as a condition of approval:

         1. Certificate of Housing Compliance Inspection Report as provided by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.8205. (Certificate of Building Compliance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-179478) of this Code, or equivalent report satisfactory to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), which report shall detail any violations of provisions of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code enacted after such permit was issued and which are explicitly made applicable to existing [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

         2. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) inspection reports (if any such report has already been submitted to the [California Department of Real Estate](https://www.dre.ca.gov/), a copy of such report shall be furnished to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)):

            1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) component reports indicating conditions and estimated remaining useful life of the roof, foundation, plumbing, electrical, heating, air conditioning, other mechanical and structural systems, prepared by a registered civil or structural engineer, licensed general building contractor, licensed general engineering contractor or architect;

            2. Structural pest control report, prepared by a licensed pest control contractor;

            3. Acoustical report, indicating: (1) the type of construction between [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and the general sound attenuation characteristics of such construction, or indicating the level of sound attenuation between [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and (2) the feasibility of various levels of improvement, prepared by a licensed acoustical engineer; and

            4. Utility metering reports, if the units of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) are not individually metered, indicating the feasibility of individual or submetering, prepared by qualified engineers.
         3. Any other information, including conditions, covenants and restrictions, articles of incorporation, and by-laws, which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) deems necessary to determine if the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is consistent with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
2. ###### Residential to Commercial/Industrial Conversion Projects


      1. A [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall comply with the Division of Land regulations in this Article (Division of Land), the provisions of this Section (Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial), and other applicable State laws and local ordinances.

      2. In addition to the information required by other applicable sections of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the following information shall be submitted at the time of filing:

         1. Tenant Information: Name and address of each tenant in the existing [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); rent schedule for 18 months preceding the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and relocation assistance plan if any;

         2. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plans or other documents containing the following information pertaining to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as proposed, certified as to accuracy by a licensed engineer:

            1. Description of the features of the type of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), including age, type of construction, the number of separate units proposed, the square footage of each such unit and of the entire [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

            2. Parking plan, including the total number of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s actually provided on-site or off-site, and the total number required if different from that actually provided, dimensions of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, aisles, and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, locations of columns, walls, and other obstructions, and location and number of guest [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.
         3. The following additional information may be required by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as a condition of approval:

            1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) component reports prepared by a registered civil or structural engineer, licensed general building contractor, licensed general engineering contractor or architect, describing the condition and estimated remaining useful life of the roof, foundation, plumbing, electrical, heating, air conditioning, and other mechanical and structural systems.

            2. Site plan, including, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, open spaces, accessory storage areas, and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s including trash storage areas.

            3. Floor plans and [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, including indication of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and required exits.

            4. Building inspection reports, (if any such report has already been submitted to the [California Department of Real Estate](https://www.dre.ca.gov/), a copy of such report shall be furnished to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)).

            5. Any other information, including conditions, covenants and restrictions, articles of incorporation, and by-laws, which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) deems necessary to determine if the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is consistent with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
3. ###### All Projects


      No [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval of a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be accepted without adequate evidence from the applicant that each tenant of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) has received: written notice of intention to file a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) at least 60 days prior to the filing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and a written copy of the relocation assistance provisions of [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.06. (Tenant Relocation Assistance Where Apartments Are To Be Converted)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132676) and [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.07. (Tenant Relocation Assistance Where Apartments Are To Be Demolished)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132764) of this Code. Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) who becomes a tenant of a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) proposed for conversion to a residential or commercial/industrial [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [community apartment project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) after the date of the filing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be given written notice of the pending [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) prior to entering into any written or oral rental agreement.
4. ##### Tenant Notification


1. ###### Notification of Hearing on Tentative Tract Map or Preliminary Parcel Map


      In addition to other notification requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall give notice of any public hearing on a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to each tenant in each [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s proposed for conversion.

      This notice shall be in writing and mailed no less than 10 days prior to the public hearing on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

      The notice may include a questionnaire, to be completed at the option of each tenant, regarding the approximate ages and disabilities or handicaps, if any, of the [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) members, comments concerning the physical condition of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and its various components and characteristics as outlined in [Sec. 11.5.1.C.1.c.ii. (Residential Conversion Projects)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.5.1), and any other information as may be pertinent to the pending proceedings.

2. ###### Notification of Proposed Conversion Prior to Termination of Tenancy Due to Conversion


      Each tenant of a [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) subject to this Section (Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial) shall be given 180 days written notice of intention to convert prior to termination of tenancy due to the conversion or proposed conversion. Each [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) who becomes a tenant of the [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) after the date of the 180 days written notice shall be given a copy of the notice of intention to convert before entering into any written or oral rental agreement, but shall not be entitled to 180 days written notice prior to termination of tenancy due to the conversion or proposed conversion.

3. ###### Residential Conversion Project – Notification of Exclusive Right to Purchase


      The applicant shall give each tenant of any proposed [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) written notice of an exclusive right to contract for the purchase of the [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) occupied by the tenant or purchase of a share in the corporation entitling the shareholder to enjoy exclusive occupancy of the unit upon the same or more favorable terms and conditions than those on which such unit or share will be initially offered to the general public. The right shall run for a period of not less than 90 days from the issuance of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) public report in accordance with [California Business and Professions Code, Div. 4. (Real Estate), Sec. 11018.2.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=BPC&sectionNum=11018.2.), unless the applicant receives prior written notice of the tenant’s intention not to exercise the right.

      Where two or more units are combined in accordance with conditions of [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval, the notice required by this Subsection (Tenant Notification) shall be given to the tenants of the combined [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and priority among tenants shall be determined in an equitable manner. A tenant who is prevented from purchasing their unit due to combination of units shall be given a right of first refusal with respect to the comparable unit in the same [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), to the extent possible.
5. ##### Tentative Tract Map & Preliminary Parcel Map Approval:


1. All [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s filed in connection with [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be subject to this Article (Division of Land), except as otherwise provided in this Section (Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial). All such maps shall be subject to the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) only to the extent that such plan contains a definite statement of policies and objectives explicitly applicable to [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, except as otherwise provided in this Section (Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial).

2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), if it finds: (a) that the map is not substantially consistent with the applicable density provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in effect at the time the original [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued, and (b) the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for map approval is filed less than five years from the date the original [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where the conversion would be inconsistent with either the existing zoning pattern, [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), unless it finds that there are special circumstances which justify approval of the map. Such circumstances may exist only with respect to the following facts: (1) the prevailing pattern of [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and commercial/industrial land [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in the vicinity of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) site; and (2) the existing and anticipated need for commercial/industrial development in the planning area in which the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located. This provision shall not apply to any [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) involving [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s for which a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was applied for prior to July 1, 1978.

3. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if it finds that any applicable [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) provision contains a definite statement of policies and objectives explicitly applicable to [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and the proposed map is not substantially consistent with such provision.

4. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if it finds that there are uncorrected violations of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code, and that an adequate plan to correct such violations has not been developed or accomplished. For purposes of this provision, [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code means the Code in effect when the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued and other subsequently enacted regulations explicitly made applicable to existing [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

5. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), if it finds that: (a) the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued prior to October 1, 1933, and the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is of unreinforced masonry construction, or (b) the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is more than three stories in height without an elevator. This provision may be waived where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) finds that any such condition has been corrected in conformity with [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) standards.

6. After considering the following criteria, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may approve a tentative tract map or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or a [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), unless it makes both of the following findings: (1) the vacancy rate of the planning area in which the property is located is five percent or less, and (2) the cumulative effect of the rental housing market in the planning area of successive [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s (past, present and future) is significant. A finding of significant cumulative effect shall be based on the following factors: (a) in the case of [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s only, the number of tenants who are willing and able to purchase a unit in the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); (b) the number of units in the existing [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) prior to conversion; (c) the number of units which would be eliminated in case conversion occurred in order to satisfy [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) requirements; (d) the adequacy of the relocation assistance plan proposed by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); and (e) any other factors pertinent to the determination. “Vacancy rate” shall refer to the most current vacancy rate for [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s as published by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in its Semi-Annual Population Estimate and Housing Inventory, or other estimate or survey satisfactory to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). “Planning area” shall refer to those areas established by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for purposes of community planning in accordance with [Sec. 13B.1.1. (General Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.1).
6. ##### Relocation Assistance


1. ###### Requirement


      The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall require, as a condition of map approval, that the applicant execute and record a covenant and agreement, in a form satisfactory to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), binding the applicant and any successor-in-interest to provide relocation assistance in a manner consistent with [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.06. (Tenant Relocation Assistance Where Apartments Are To Be Converted)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132676) of this Code. The covenant and agreement shall be executed and recorded within 10 days after the expiration of the appeal period, or final approval, whichever is later, for [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval and a copy provided to each tenant within five days of recordation. The covenant and agreement shall run to the benefit of any [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), as defined in Paragraph 2. (Eligible Tenant) below and shall be enforceable by any [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. ###### Eligible Tenant


      As used in this Subsection F. (Relocation Assistance), the term eligible tenant means any tenant who was [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the property both on the date of [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the date of approval of such map, or at any time after that, and who does not intend to purchase a unit in the [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

3. ###### Special Protection


      An [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is entitled to special protection, as defined in this Subsection F. (Relocation Assistance), if the tenant meets the definition of qualified tenant in [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.06. (Tenant Relocation Assistance Where Apartments Are To Be Converted)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132676) of this Code.

4. ###### Dispute Resolution


      The covenant and agreement specified in Paragraph 1. (Requirement) above shall establish an expeditious mechanism to resolve any disputes among tenants, the applicant and the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) concerning the interpretation or [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of the covenant and agreement.

5. ###### Continued Tenancy Pending Relocation; Eviction; Review Procedure


      1. Until each [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is successfully relocated in accordance with the provisions of this Subsection F. (Relocation Assistance), the tenant shall be permitted to reside in the unit presently occupied in the [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). There shall be no time limit for such continued tenancy for each tenant qualified for “special protection,” as defined in Paragraph 3. (Special Protection) above. In all other cases, the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is not required to consent to continued tenancy beyond 12 months from the date of tentative tract map or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval or the date on which the 120-day notice of intent to convert is given to all tenants, whichever is the latter.

      2. An [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may be evicted, notwithstanding Subparagraph a. (Continued Tenancy Pending Relocation; Eviction; Review Procedure) above, for the following reasons only:

         1. The tenant has failed to pay the rent to which the landlord is entitled.

         2. The tenant has violated an obligation or covenant of the tenancy, other than the obligation to surrender possession upon proper notice and has failed to cure such violation after having received written notice thereof from the landlord.

         3. The tenant is committing or permitting to exist a nuisance in or is causing damage to, the [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or to the appurtenances thereof, or to the common areas of the property containing the [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or is creating an unreasonable interference with the comfort, safety, or enjoyment of any of the other [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s of the same or adjacent [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

         4. The tenant is using or permitting a [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to be used for any illegal intent.

         5. The tenant who had a written lease or rental agreement which terminated on or after November 10, 1979, has refused, after written request or demand by the landlord, to execute a written extension or renewal thereof for a further term or like duration with similar provisions and in such terms as are not inconsistent with or violative of any provision of this Section (Conversion: Residential; Residential to Commercial/Industrial).

         6. The tenant has refused the landlord reasonable [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to the unit for the intent of making repairs or improvements, or for the intent of inspection as permitted or required by the lease or by law, or for the intent of showing the [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to any prospective purchaser or mortgagee.

         7. The [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in possession of the [rental unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) at the end of the lease term is a subtenant not approved by the landlord.
      3. Any dispute regarding an [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)’s right to continue tenancy in accordance with this Subdivision may be heard by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) when [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for such review is made by the subdivider or an [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#). The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may release the applicant from further compliance with a relocation assistance plan with respect to any [eligible tenant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where it finds that the tenant is not entitled to continued tenancy in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 5. (Continued Tenancy Pending Relocation; Eviction; Review Procedure).
7. ##### Parking


1. ###### Residential Conversion Projects


      1. The minimum number of resident [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall be provided in accordance with the applicable [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) package in [Sec. 4C.4.1.C.2. (Required Automobile Parking Table)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.1).

      2. The design and improvement of automobile parking facilities and areas shall substantially conform to the provisions of [Sec. 4C.4.3. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3), [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4), and [Sec. 4C.4.5. (Parking Structure Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5), as applicable.
8. ##### Building Reports – Residential Conversion Projects


The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require, as a condition of approval, that the applicant notify such [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) who communicates an interest in purchasing a unit or share that the following reports are available for inspection during normal business hours, and shall take all reasonable steps to assure that such reports fully, fairly and accurately describe the conditions reported:

1. Any report submitted in accordance with [Sec. 11.5.1.C. (Application Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.5.1).

2. A report concerning compliance with the sound transmission control standards established by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.1206. (Sound Transmission)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-173892) of this Code.

3. Report concerning compliance with the [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) energy conservation standards established by [California Code of Regulations, Title 24. (Building Standards Code), Part 6. (California Energy Code)](https://www.dgs.ca.gov/BSC).

4. A report concerning compliance with the elevator safety standards established by [California Code of Regulations, Title 8. (Industrial Relations)](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Browse/Home/California/CaliforniaCodeofRegulations?guid=IDC2EA8505A0E11EC8227000D3A7C4BC3&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=Default&contextData=(sc.Default)).

5. A report concerning compliance with any provision of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the Superintendent of Building find appropriate for such reporting purposes.
9. ##### Rental Housing Production


1. As a condition of [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) approval, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall require that the applicant or their successor-in-interest pay to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) a fee of $1,492 for each unit in a [residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [residential to commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), based on the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) prior to conversion. For the year beginning July 1, 2008, and all subsequent years, the fee amount shall be adjusted on an annual basis in accordance with the formula set forth in [Chapter XV. (Rent Stabilization Ordinance), Sec. 151.06. (Automatic Adjustments)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195445) of this Code. The adjusted amount shall be rounded to the nearest $50 increment. This fee shall be paid prior to approval of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

2. All fees collected in accordance with this Subsection (Rental Housing Production) shall be deposited and held in the Rental Housing Production Account of the Los Angeles Housing Department, which account is hereby established to be administered by the Los Angeles Housing Department separately from all other money expended by the Department. Money in this account shall be used exclusively for the development of low and moderate income rental housing in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), in accordance with guidelines carrying out this purpose prepared by the Department and approved by resolution of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

### Sec. 11.5.2. Conversion: Commercial/Industrial; Commercial/Industrial to Residential

1. ##### Intent


The intent of these provisions is: to promote greater individual choice in type, quality, price, and location of housing; to provide for the housing needs of all segments of the population; to provide increased homeownership opportunities for all segments of the population; to promote the safety of [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and correct any violations of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code which may occur in [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; to provide adequate [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; to provide increased opportunities for the ownership of commercial or industrial real property in the form of [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; to assure that the continued [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s for commercial or industrial purpose is substantially consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; and to generally regulate [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in accordance with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and with the public health, safety, and welfare.

2. ##### Applicability


The provisions of this Section shall apply to all [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, except as otherwise expressly stated in this Section.

3. ##### Application Requirements


1. ###### Commercial/Industrial to Residential Conversion Projects


      1. A [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall comply with the Division of Land regulations in this Article (Division of Land), the provisions of this Section (Conversion: Commercial/Industrial; Commercial/Industrial to Residential) and other applicable State laws and local ordinances.

      2. In addition to the information required by other applicable provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the following information shall be submitted at the time of filing:

         1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plans or other documents containing the following information pertaining to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as proposed, certified as to accuracy by a licensed engineer:

            1. Description of the features of the type of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), including age, type of construction, number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, number of [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s per [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); and

            2. Site plan, including [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, open spaces, accessory storage areas and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, including location of and [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to trash storage areas; and

            3. Parking plan, including: the total number of spaces actually provided on-site or off-site, and the total number required if different from that actually provided; dimensions of stalls, aisles, and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; location of columns, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and other obstructions; and total number of [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and [uncovered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and location and number of guest [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.
         2. Sales Information: Anticipated range of sales prices of individual [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or shares based on information known at the time of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); and statement as to whether sales will be permitted to families with minor children.

         3. Floor plans and [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, including indication of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and required exits.
      3. The following additional information may be required by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as a condition of approval:

         1. Certificate of Housing Compliance Inspection Report as provided by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.8205. (Certificate of Building Compliance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-179478) of this Code, or equivalent report satisfactory to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), which report shall detail any violations of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code in effect at the time the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued and any violations of provisions of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code enacted after such permit was issued and which are explicitly made applicable to existing [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

         2. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) inspection reports (if any such report has already been submitted to the [California Department of Real Estate](https://www.dre.ca.gov/), a copy of such report shall be furnished to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)):

            1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) component reports prepared by a registered civil or structural engineer, licensed general building contractor, licensed general engineering contractor or architect, describing the condition and estimated remaining useful life of the roof, foundation, plumbing, electrical, heating, air conditioning, and other mechanical and structural systems;

            2. Structural pest control report, prepared by a licensed pest control contractor;

            3. Acoustical report indicating: (a) the type of construction between [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and the general sound attenuation characteristics of such construction, or indicating the level of sound attenuation between [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, and (b) the feasibility of various levels of improvement, prepared by a licensed acoustical engineer; and

            4. Utility metering reports, if the units of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) are not individually metered, indicating the feasibility of individual or submetering, prepared by qualified engineers.
         3. Any other information, including conditions, covenants and restrictions, articles of incorporation, and by-laws, which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) deems necessary to determine if the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is consistent with the intent of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
2. ###### Commercial/Industrial Conversion Projects


      1. A [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall comply with the Division of Land Regulations in this Article (Division of Land), the provisions of this Section (Conversion: Commercial/Industrial; Commercial/Industrial to Residential) and other applicable State laws and local ordinances.

      2. In addition to the information required by other applicable sections of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) plans or other documents containing the following information pertaining to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as proposed, certified as to accuracy by a licensed engineer, shall be submitted at the time of filing:

         1. Description of the features of the type of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), including age, type of construction, number of separate units proposed, the square footage of each such unit and of the entire [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#).

         2. Parking plan, including: the total number of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s actually provided on-site or off-site, and the total number required if different from that actually provided; dimensions of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, aisles, and [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s; location of columns, walls, and other obstructions; and total number of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and guest [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.
      3. The following additional information may be required by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as a condition of approval:

         1. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) component reports prepared by a registered civil or structural engineer, licensed general building contractor, licensed general engineering contractor or architect, describing the condition and estimated remaining useful life of the roof, foundation, plumbing, electrical, heating, air conditioning, and other mechanical and structural systems;

         2. Site plan, including [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, open spaces, and accessory storage areas and [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s including location of and [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) to trash storage areas;

         3. Floor plans and [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, including indication of [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [residential amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and required exits;

         4. [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) inspection reports (if any such report has already been submitted to the [California Department of Real Estate](https://www.dre.ca.gov/), a copy of such report shall be furnished to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#)); and

         5. Any other information including, conditions, covenants and restrictions, articles of incorporation, and by-laws, which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) deems necessary to determine if the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is consistent with the intent of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
4. ##### Tentative Tract Map & Preliminary Parcel Map Approval


1. All [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s filed in connection with [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s or [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s shall be subject to the Division of Land regulations contained in this Article (Division of Land), except as herein otherwise provided. All such maps shall be subject to the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) only to the extent that such plan contains a definite statement of policies and objectives explicitly applicable to such [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s, except as otherwise provided in this Section (Conversion: Commercial/Industrial; Commercial/Industrial to Residential).

2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if it finds that the map is not substantially consistent with the applicable density provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in effect at the time the original [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued. This provision shall not apply to any [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for which a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was applied for prior to July 1, 1978.

3. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) where such conversion would be inconsistent with either the existing zoning pattern, the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), or applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#), unless it finds that there are special circumstances which justify approval of the map. Such circumstances may exist only with respect to the following facts: (1) the prevailing pattern of commercial/industrial and [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) land [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) in the vicinity of the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#); and (2) the existing and anticipated need for [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) development and continued commercial/industrial development in the planning area in which the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is located.

4. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if it finds that any applicable [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) provision contains a definite statement of policies and objectives explicitly applicable to such [conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s and the proposed map is not substantially consistent with such provision.

5. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if it finds that there are uncorrected violations of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code, and that an adequate plan to correct such violations has not been developed or accomplished. For purposes of this provision, [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code means the Code in effect when the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued and other subsequently enacted regulations explicitly made applicable to existing [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s.

6. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) shall disapprove a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for a [commercial/industrial conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or [commercial/industrial to residential conversion project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) if it finds that: (a) the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) for the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) was issued prior to October 1, 1933, and the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is of unreinforced masonry construction, or (b) the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) is more than three stories in height without an elevator. This provision may be waived where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) finds that any such condition has been corrected in conformity with current [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) standards.
5. ##### Parking


1. ###### Commercial/Industrial to Residential Conversion Projects


      1. The design and improvement of automobile parking facilities and areas shall substantially conform to the provisions of [Sec. 4C.4.3. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3), [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4), and [Sec. 4C.4.5. (Parking Structure Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5), as applicable.

      2. Regardless of any other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to the contrary, the required number of [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) s in [Sec. 9.4.6.(Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6) shall be the same as the number of spaces that existed on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) as of as of June 3rd, 1999, and shall be maintained and not reduced.
2. ###### Commercial/Industrial Conversion Projects


      1. The design and improvement of automobile parking facilities and areas shall substantially conform to the provisions of [Sec. 4C.4.3. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3), [Sec. 4C.4.4. (Parking Lot Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.4), and [Sec. 4C.4.5. (Parking Structure Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.5), as applicable.
6. ##### Building Reports – Commercial/Industrial To Residential Conversion Projects


The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) may require, as a condition of approval, that the applicant notify any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) who communicates an interest in purchasing a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) or share in a [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) that the following reports are available for inspection during normal business hours, and shall take reasonable steps to assure that such reports fully, fairly and accurately describe the conditions reported:

1. Any report submitted in accordance with [Sec. 11.5.2.C. (Application Requirements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.5.2).

2. A report concerning compliance with the sound transmission control standards established by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.1206. (Sound Transmission)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-173892) of this Code.

3. A report concerning compliance with the [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) energy conservation standards established by [California Code of Regulations, Title 24. (Building Standards Code), Part 6. (California Energy Code)](https://www.dgs.ca.gov/BSC).

4. A report concerning compliance with the elevator safety standards established by [California Code of Regulations, Title 8. (Industrial Relations)](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Browse/Home/California/CaliforniaCodeofRegulations?guid=IDC2EA8505A0E11EC8227000D3A7C4BC3&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=Default&contextData=(sc.Default)).

5. A report concerning compliance with any provisions of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#) and the Superintendent of Building find appropriate for such reporting purposes.
