# Article 12. Nonconformities

## Div. 12.1. General Rules

### Sec. 12.1.1. Intent

The provisions of this Article (Nonconformities) provide relief from the requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for any existing nonconformity, defined as any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that conformed to the zoning regulations at the time they were established, but do not conform to current requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 12.1.2. General Nonconforming Rules

The following general rules apply to all nonconformities. Specific rules in the following Divisions of this Article (Nonconformities) may provide additional standards or exceptions to these general rules.

1. Any portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), site improvement, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that meets the definition of [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be continued, provided it is not expanded, changed or modified. Maintenance & repair, as well as [renovation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), of the nonconformity are allowed.

2. Current [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be conducted, provided they meet the standards of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) and do not increase the degree of nonconformity with any individual standard in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), except as expressly allowed in this Article (Nonconformities).

3. Each increment of [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or [use modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) must meet the standards of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), except as expressly allowed in this Article (Nonconformities).

4. A [nonconforming building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [nonconforming structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may have additional rights when it is located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) affected by a public acquisition. See [Div. 12.8. (Lots Affected by Acquisition for Public Use)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.8).


### Sec. 12.1.3. Applicability

1. ##### Relationship to Article-Level Applicability Standards


1. The provisions of this Article (Nonconformities) apply in addition to the applicability provisions of any [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) article ( [Article 2. (Form)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2) through [Article 6. (Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6)) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

2. [Sec. 12.7.1. (Restoration of Damaged Nonconforming Buildings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.7.1) and [Sec. 12.7.2. (Replacement of Earthquake Hazardous Buildings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.7.2) supersede any other provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
2. ##### Relationship to Specific Plans, Supplemental Districts, & Special Zones


The provisions of this Article (Nonconformities) apply to [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, and [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s only to the extent that those provisions apply the standards of a [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) article ( [Article 2. (Form)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2) through [Article 6. (Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/6)) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).


### Sec. 12.1.4. Discontinuance of Nonconforming Use

1. A [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or any land that contained a [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that has been discontinued for a continuous period of one year or more shall only be occupied by a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that conforms to the current [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) regulations of the applied zone.

2. Discontinued [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s that haven't lapsed within the limited time frame may be allowed to maintain [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) rights with change of ownership or tenancy.

3. A [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of land that is accessory or incidental to the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be discontinued on the same date the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is discontinued.

4. In [Agricultural Use Districts (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2), [Residential Use Districts (Div.5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), and [Residential-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), any [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) first permitted in a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5) shall be discontinued within five years from the date the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) becomes [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), except that the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may permit its continuation pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1).

5. In [Agricultural Use Districts (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2), [Residential Use Districts (Div.5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), and [Residential-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), any [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) first permitted in an [Industrial Use District (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) or [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6) shall be discontinued within five years from the date the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) becomes [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). No continuation is permitted.

6. [Nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [animal keeping: livestock](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for commercial intent, or other [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s listed in the [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use group](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) in any [Residential Use District (Div.5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), or [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4) shall be discontinued within 15 years from the date such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) became [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

7. In [Agricultural Use Districts (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2), [Residential Use Districts (Div.5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), [Residential-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), [Commercial-Mixed Use Districts (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), a [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of land where no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s are occupied in connection with the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or where the only [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s occupied are accessory or incidental to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), shall be discontinued within five years from the date the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) becomes [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

8. [Nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s in [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) shall be discontinued five years from the date the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) became [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).


### Sec. 12.1.5. Calculation of Time

Whenever a period of time related to a nonconformity is specified in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the period of time is computed from the effective date of the ordinance that created the nonconformity.

### Sec. 12.1.6. Relief

1. In circumstances where Alternative Compliance is specified as a form of relief in the standards of the [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), it is available as a way to achieve a standard in an acceptable alternate way, which may be used to bring a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) into conformity pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.1. (Alternative Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.1).

2. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#)'s [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) standards may allow some relief and provide incentives for the reuse of existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.5. (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.5) and [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6).

3. When relief is granted through any discretionary action taken consistent with this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), the element that is the subject of the discretionary action is no longer considered [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).


### Sec. 12.1.7. Orders to Comply

1. The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall have the authority to issue an order to comply to an owner who is in violation of this Article (Nonconformities) and advise the owner of the required discontinuance of the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

2. Included in any order shall be a provision advising the owner of the right to apply to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) within 90 days for permission to continue the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as provided in this Article (Nonconformities), but the failure to include that provision shall not nullify the order or provide a basis for the continuation of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

3. The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall record a notice of any order issued pursuant to this Article (Nonconformities) with the Los Angeles County Recorder, but the failure to so record shall not nullify the order or provide a basis for the continuation of the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) by any owner, purchaser or lessee who was not aware of the order.


### Sec. 12.1.8. Compliance With Other Laws

Nothing in this Article (Nonconformities) relieves any person from the obligation to comply with the requirements of any federal, state, or county law.

## Div. 12.2. Form Exceptions

### Sec. 12.2.1. Coverage Exceptions

1. ##### Building Setbacks


Where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, an [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is allowed as [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), provided that:

1. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s located in the [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) setback do not encroach to a greater extent than the existing encroachment or reduce the [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) setback to less than 50 percent of that required by the dimensional requirements of the applied zone.

2. The total of all [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s made since the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) became [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) do not exceed, in height or length, the height or length of that portion of the adjoining [nonconforming building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that extends into the same setback.

### Sec. 12.2.2. Floor Area Ratio & Height Exceptions

1. ##### Rural, Estate, & House Form Districts


In the [Rural Form Districts (Div. 2B.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B.1), [Estate Form Districts (Div. 2B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B.2), and [House Form Districts (Div. 2B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B.3), an [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is allowed, provided that the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) conforms to all individual standards in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), except as may be approved or permitted pursuant to a discretionary approval. This exception is not available for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s in the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), that are not located in a [hillside area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).


## Div. 12.3. Frontage Exceptions

### Sec. 12.3.1. Build-To Exceptions

1. On a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) with an existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) where the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to the maximum [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) requirements, any [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall meet the minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) between the minimum and maximum [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) in one or more of the ways described below.

1. ###### New Construction on an Interior Lot


      All [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall occupy the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) until the [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) has been met, except that [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s may be developed in phases - each new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is not required to meet the entire required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). Until all [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) standards have been met, new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s shall occupy the [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for 100 percent of their [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and may not be deeper than they are wide.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.1.png.webp?itok=nAecLFL3)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.1.png?itok=RMEJjFBe)

2. ###### New Construction on a Corner Lot


      All [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall occupy the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) until the [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for both streets has been met, except that buildings may be developed in phases - each new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is not required to meet the entire required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). The initial new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall begin at the corner and be located within the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on both streets. Additional new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s may be placed anywhere within the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.3.png.webp?itok=UoNeV6Ql)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.3.png?itok=_vr7gN4O)

3. ###### Additions on an Interior Lot


      1. Any [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to the [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall occupy the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), except that the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) does not have to meet the entire required [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      2. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of any size that extend a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) between the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are allowed.

      3. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s that extend a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) between the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and the [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are allowed, except that they shall have a [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) less than 20 percent of the existing [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      4. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s on top of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are allowed, except that they shall not increase the existing [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) by more than 50 square feet and shall not exceed the height limit for the applied zone.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.5.png.webp?itok=qn_F7-mT)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.5.png?itok=-fo1AJYj)
4. ###### Additions on a Corner Lot


      1. Any [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to the primary [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be located within the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), except that the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) does not have to meet the minimum [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the entire [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      2. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of any size that extend a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) between the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) (but not any wider than the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#)) and are located behind the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), are allowed, except that:

         1. A [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be provided as required in [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4), at least six feet wide, abutting the [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), and installed across the entire length of the side street frontage where no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) occupies the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). Breaks for pedestrian, bicycle and vehicular access are allowed.

         2. The [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) with [large species tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, shall be provided as required in [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.3.a. (Trees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4), planted at a rate of one tree per 30 feet along the entire length of the [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). Trees should be planted offset from street trees to maximize space for canopy growth.

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.7.png.webp?itok=1SoxoR1n)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.7.png?itok=Kiye1T32)
      3. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s that extend a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) between the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and the [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are allowed, except that the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be no greater than 20 percent of the existing [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.9.png.webp?itok=aMoyVdD9)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/12.3.1.9.png?itok=TbB6gqD0)

      4. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s on top of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are allowed, except that they shall not increase the existing [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) by more than 50 square feet.
2. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s to any [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are allowed behind the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), except that they shall not exceed 10 percent of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) area of the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

3. On [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s with an existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), except where the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is a residential [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) where [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of additional [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s that are detached from the existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) are located in a [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and [build-to width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) requirements do not apply.

### Sec. 12.4.1. Retaining Walls Exceptions

The [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) standards in [Sec. 4C.9.2. (Retaining Walls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.9.2) do not apply to a [retaining wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that received a final discretionary approval from the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) under another provision of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) prior to March 9, 2005, the effective date of [Ord. No. 176,445](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2003/03-0238_ORD_176445_03-09-2005.pdf), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1).

Any existing [nonconforming sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), as defined in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.6216. ## Div. 12.5. Use Exceptions

### Sec. 12.5.1. Use Permission Exceptions

1. Where a building in any [Open Space Use District (Div. 5B.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.1), [Agricultural Use District (Div. 5B.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.2), [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3), [Residential-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.4.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.4), [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5) or [Public Use District (Div. 5B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.8) includes an existing [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), any [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be enlarged, provided that the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) does not create any additional [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s or [lodging unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, and the [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or expansion meets all other requirements for the applied zone.

2. An establishment dispensing, for sale or other consideration, alcoholic beverages, including beer and wine, for on-site or off-site consumption shall not be continued or re-established after September 13, 1997 without conditional use approval granted in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), where there is a substantial change in the mode or character of operation of the establishment, including any [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) by more than 20 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), seating or occupancy, whichever applies. Construction for which a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is required in order to comply with an order issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to repair or remedy an unsafe or substandard condition is exempt from this provision. Any [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of less than 20 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), seating or occupancy, whichever applies, requires the approval of plans pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.4. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4).

3. Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) in a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), [Industrial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.6.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.6), or [Industrial 1 (I1) (Sec. 5B.7.1.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1) [Use District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that was being used on June 1, 1951, for the temporary storage of abandoned, dismantled, partially dismantled, obsolete or wrecked automobiles, but not for the dismantling or wrecking of automobiles nor for the storage or sale of used parts, may continue.

4. Any [Light Industrial Uses (Div. 5D.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.8) lawfully existing prior to March 22, 1981, in any portion of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) in a [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5) shall not be extended beyond that portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) except in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2).

5. Joint living & work quarters are considered [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to [household business](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), and may be continued. Additional flexibility and incentives may be granted for existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s that are eligible for [adaptive reuse project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s pursuant to [Sec. 9.4.5. (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.5) and [Sec. 12.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.4.6).

6. In the [Industrial Use Districts (Div.5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7), the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of land where no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s are occupied in connection with the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or where the only [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s occupied are accessory to or incidental to the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), may be continued, subject to the following limitations:

1. The [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall not be enlarged in any way beyond the limits of what was originally permitted.

2. The [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be completely [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or within an area [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on all sides with a Type T1 [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) pursuant to [Sec. 4C.8.2.C.3.a. (T-Screen 1)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.8.2), within one year from the date the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) becomes [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).
7. In the [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7):

1. A [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) with no [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s shall not be redesigned or rearranged to contain [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s.

2. A [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) with [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s shall not be redesigned or rearranged so as to increase the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s in the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

3. [Caretaker Unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s in [Industrial Use Districts (Div. 5B.7.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.7) are permitted to continue.

### Sec. 12.5.2. Use Standards Exceptions

Where a [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) standards it may be continued until the expiration of the [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) permit. When a [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is subject to a new [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) permit, it shall meet all of the [Use District (Part 5B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) standards.

### Sec. 12.5.3. Equine Keeping Exceptions

1. ##### Lot Area Exception


In a [Residential Use District (Div. 5B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.3) where [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is permitted, [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s may be kept and a stable may be erected or maintained on any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), provided the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) had the area required for the keeping of [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s at the time the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) was established.

2. ##### Equine Use Exceptions


1. [Animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) uses shall be allowed to be continued if, after the legal establishment of the [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), an adjacent property is granted a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) to construct a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) within the 75 foot required distance between an [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and the adjacent property’s [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). The [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be subject to the following limitations:

      1. The subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall have been designated by an Equine License to stable at least one licensed equine during the 12 months prior to the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the adjacent property’s [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      2. The [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure shall not be closer than 35 feet to the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of any [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      3. The [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure shall not be expanded, extended or relocated in such a manner as to reduce the [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) distance between the enclosure and the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of the neighbor’s [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      4. The [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) use shall be discontinued if, during a successive three year period, no [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is licensed by the Department of Animal Services to be stabled on the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).
2. If, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) grants permission for a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on an adjacent property to be constructed closer than 35 feet from a legally existing [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure, the [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure may be considered relocated not closer than 35 feet from the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s attached to any [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), and retain its [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) status. The [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be subject to the following limitations:

      1. The subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall have been designated by an Equine License to stable at least one licensed [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) during the 12 months prior to the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the adjacent property’s [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      2. The [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure shall not be closer than 35 feet to the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of any [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      3. The [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure shall not be expanded, extended or relocated in such a manner as to reduce the [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) distance between the enclosure and the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of the [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on an adjacent [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      4. The [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be discontinued if, during a successive three year period, no [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is licensed by the Department of Animal Services to be stabled on the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).
3. If an [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) was legally established prior to November 22, 1982, that [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be allowed to continue, even though the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) issued a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) between November 22, 1982 and July 1, 1986, to construct a [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on an adjacent [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) within the 35 foot required distance between an [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of a [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on the adjacent [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#). This provision shall not apply to [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s authorized by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1). This [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be subject to the following limitations:

      1. The subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall have been designated by an Equine License to stable at least one licensed [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) during the 12 months prior to the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on an adjacent [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      2. The [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) enclosure shall not be expanded, extended, or relocated in such a manner as to reduce the [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) distance between the enclosure and the [habitable room](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s of the [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) on an adjacent [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

      3. The [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [animal keeping: equine, non-commercial](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be discontinued if, during a successive three year period, no [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is licensed by the Department of Animal Services to be stabled on the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

### Sec. 12.5.4. Nonconforming Oil, Gas, or Hydrocarbon Well Use Exceptions

1. All [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s including those operating pursuant to any discretionary permit in all zones, whether by ordinance or approval of a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), and all oil wells in an M3 Zone as established in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, are [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s as of January 18, 2023, the effective date of [Ord. No. 187,709](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf). No new [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the production of oil, gas or other hydrocarbon substances, which is a [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), shall be maintained, drilled, re-drilled, or deepened, except to prevent or respond to a threat to public health, safety, or the environment, as determined by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

2. The operation of all [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s shall cease within 20 years from January 18, 2023, the effective date of [Ord. No. 187,709](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf), which deemed such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

3. After the time period set forth in Subsection B., above, all [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s shall be abandoned in a manner consistent with and in strict accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, rules, and standards.

4. If an [oil, gas, or hydrocarbon well](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is abandoned, or its operation is discontinued or idled for a continuous period of one year, such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be deemed terminated.

5. A well operator as defined by [California Public Resources Code, Div. 3. (Oil and Gas), Sec. 3237.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=3237.&lawCode=PRC) shall comply with the mitigation measures and mitigation monitoring program adopted with [Ord. No. 187,709 (effective 1/18/23)](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/2017/17-0447-S2_ord_187709_1-18-23.pdf) in the plugging and abandoning of all wells.


## Div. 12.6. Density Exceptions

The expansion of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) does not increase the degree of nonconformity as to any density standard. Only a change in the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s impact the degree of nonconformity as to a density standard.

## Div. 12.7. Damaged or Earthquake Hazardous Buildings

### Sec. 12.7.1. Restoration of Damaged Nonconforming Buildings

1. A [nonconforming building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [nonconforming structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) that is damaged or partially destroyed by any fire, flood, wind, earthquake or other calamity, or the public enemy may be restored and the occupancy or use of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or part of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), which existed at the time of the damage or destruction, may be continued or resumed, provided that the total cost of restoration does not exceed 75 percent of the replacement value of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) at the time of the damage or destruction. A permit for restoration shall be obtained within a period of two years from the date of the damage or destruction. Except as set forth in [Sec. 12.1.6.B. (Relief)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.1.6), if the damage or destruction exceeds 75 percent of the replacement value of the [nonconforming building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [nonconforming structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) at the time of the damage or destruction, no repairs or restoration shall be made unless every portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is made to conform to all regulations for [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) in the zone in which it is located, and other applicable current [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) regulations.

2. If the damage or destruction of a [nonconforming building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) exclusively for [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s in any zone exceeds 75 percent of its replacement value at the time of the damage or destruction, the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be reconstructed provided the following requirements are met:

1. The restored or reconstructed [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may encroach into any [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) setbacks no more than half the width of the required setback in the zone in which it is located, or in other applicable current regulations of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), but in no event more than three feet.

2. The restored or reconstructed [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may encroach in the [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), and [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) setbacks no more than half the width of the required setback in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), or in other applicable current regulations of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. Neither the footing, nor the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), projects into any area planned for widening or extension of existing or future streets as determined by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) upon the recommendation of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

4. The height shall not exceed the allowable height for new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), or in other applicable current regulations of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

5. A [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for the reconstruction shall be obtained within two years of the damage or destruction from fire, flood, wind, earthquake, or other calamity, or the public enemy.

### Sec. 12.7.2. Replacement of Earthquake Hazardous Buildings

1. ##### General


1. Except as otherwise provided in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to height, number of stories, [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), loading space or parking, which is demolished as a result of enforcement of the Earthquake Hazard Reduction Ordinance provisions in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Article 1. (Building Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172105) of this Code may be reconstructed with the same [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) height, number of stories, [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), loading space or parking as the original [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), provided, however, that reconstruction shall be commenced within two years of obtaining a permit for [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and completed within two years of obtaining a permit for reconstruction. Provided further, that neither the footing, nor any portion of the replacement [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may encroach into any area planned for widening or extension of existing or future streets as determined by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) upon the recommendation of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

2. Additionally, a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, which is demolished as a result of enforcement of the Earthquake Hazard Reduction Ordinance, may be reconstructed with the same [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s provided that the approval of a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is obtained as outlined below.
2. ##### Nonconforming Rights Related to Earthquake Safety Ordinance


A [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may, in accordance with [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), permit a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) as to [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s, which is demolished as a result of enforcement of the [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Div. 88. (Earthquake Hazard Reduction in Existing Buildings)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-180358) of this Code, to be reconstructed with the same [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [nonconforming yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s as the original [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

1. ###### Procedures


      1. ###### Notification


         1. Regardless of the provisions of [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) pursuant to this Section (Replacement of Earthquake Hazardous Buildings) involving a [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall instead notify the owners and occupants of all property within and outside the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).

         2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) pursuant to this Section (Replacement of Earthquake Hazardous Buildings) involving only structures that have a [nonconforming yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), when a public hearing is held, the notice shall be given in the same manner as required in [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1).
      2. ###### Waiver of Public Hearing


         1. Regardless of the provisions of [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may waive the public hearing if the applicant has secured the approval for the reconstruction from the owners of all properties [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) from, or having a common corner with the subject property. If that approval is obtained from the surrounding property owners, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may waive the public hearing if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) makes the following written findings:

            1. That the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) will not have a significant adverse effect on adjoining property or on the immediate neighborhood; and

            2. That the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is not likely to evoke public controversy.
         2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) pursuant to this Section (Replacement of Earthquake Hazardous Buildings) involving only a [nonconforming yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be set for a public hearing in accordance with the same procedures as above, if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) determines that the public interest requires a hearing.
2. ###### Supplemental Findings


      In addition to the findings otherwise required by [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall also require and find the following:

      1. That reconstruction be commenced within two years of obtaining a permit for [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) and completed within two years of obtaining a permit for reconstruction;

      2. That neither the footing nor any portion of the replacement [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) encroaches into any area planned for widening or extension of existing or future streets; and

      3. That the continued [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of the property or the continued maintenance of [nonconforming yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s will not be materially detrimental to the public welfare and will not have a substantial adverse impact on or be injurious to the properties or improvements in the vicinity.

## Div. 12.8. Lots Affected by Acquisition for Public Use

### Sec. 12.8.1. Maintenance & Repair of Existing Buildings Acquired for Public Use

1. Where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is located upon a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) where a portion is acquired for any public use (by condemnation, purchase, dedication, or otherwise) by any governmental entity, or if all or a part of a separate off-street automobile [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) serving such [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is acquired for public use, such [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be maintained, and may continue to be used, maintained or repaired without relocating or altering the same to comply with the area regulations or [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). Further, if such [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is partially located upon the area being acquired for public use, it may be relocated upon the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or premises or remodeled or reconstructed without observing the required [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) adjacent to the new [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) created by such acquisition, and without reducing the number of [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) s to conform to the regulations of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) and without observing the [automobile parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). The exemptions provided in this Section permit compliance only to the extent that such non-compliance is caused by an acquisition for public use.

2. If only a portion of an existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is acquired for public use, any [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), exterior modification, [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) of the remainder of said [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) which was made necessary by said acquisition, shall conform to the provisions of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code. Any portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) which does not require any [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#), or [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) by reason of said acquisition shall not be required to be made to conform to the provisions of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code, unless it would otherwise be required to conform independently of and in the absence of the acquisition of only a portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#).


### Sec. 12.8.2. Lot Area

If a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) resulting from the acquisition of all or a portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) for public use does not comply with the requirements of the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), or if a legally existing [nonconforming lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is further reduced in size because of such acquisition, the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) may be used, and a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) shall be issued for any intent permitted in the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B), so long as the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) is not smaller in size or width than 50 percent of the minimum [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) or [lot width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#) required by the applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B).

# Article 13. Administration

## Part 13A. General Provisions

### Div. 13A.1. Authorities

This Division (Authorities) recognizes or identifies the agencies involved in administering the Zoning Code, this Chapter and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code. This Division (Authorities) also describes how the agencies are composed, and their powers and duties. If the agency is established by another body of law, such as the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), cross-references to those laws are provided. All [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2) provisions still apply.

#### Sec. 13A.1.1. Mayor

1. ##### Establishment


See [Sec. 200 (City Officers)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-364#JD_Ch200.) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

2. ##### Composition


See [Sec. 201 (City Offices)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-379) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

3. ##### General Authority


See [Sec. 230 (Mayor)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-571) and [231 (Powers and Duties)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-576) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

4. ##### Specific Authority


Consistent with the duties set forth in the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) exercises the following specific authority:

1. Review and submit recommendations pertaining to an amendment, in whole or in part, of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. Approve or veto pursuant to the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2):

      1. A [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      2. A Zoning Code Amendment; and

      3. A Zone Change (including Supplemental Use Districts).
3. Exercise any other authority delegated by this Code or the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

#### Sec. 13A.1.2. City Council

1. ##### Establishment

2. ##### Composition


See [Sec. 204 (Election and City Council Members; Redistricting)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-406), [205 (Term of office)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-425), [206 (Term Limits)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-430), and [241 (Council Size)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-635) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

3. ##### General Authority


See [Sec. 240 – 254 (Legislative Branch)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-630) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

4. ##### Specific Authority


Consistent with the duties set forth in the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) exercises the following specific authority:

01. Adopt or amend the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

02. Adopt or amend a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

03. Adopt or amend the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code;

04. Adopt or amend a Zone Change (including Supplemental Use Districts);

05. Approve, conditionally approve, or deny a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit on appeal from the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

06. Approve, conditionally approve, or deny a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal from an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

07. Approve, conditionally approve, or deny a Nuisance Abatement/Revocation on appeal from the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

08. Accept [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and dedications pursuant to a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

09. Accept final [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and dedications pursuant to a final [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

10. Adopt or amend a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (“ [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)”) designation or boundary change;

11. Approve, conditionally approve, or deny a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) on appeal from an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

12. Exercise any other authority delegated by the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, or the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

#### Sec. 13A.1.3. City Planning Commission

1. ##### Establishment


See [Sec. 551 (City Planning Commission)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2427) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

2. ##### Composition


See [Sec. 551 (City Planning Commission)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2427) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

3. ##### General Authority


See [Sec. 551 (City Planning Commission)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2427) and [559 (Delegation of Authority)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2544) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

4. ##### Specific Authority


Consistent with the duties set forth in the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) exercises the following specific authority:

1. Review and submit recommendations to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on:

      1. The adoption or amendment of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      2. The adoption or amendment of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      3. The adoption or amendment of the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code;

      4. Any Zone Change (including Supplemental Use Districts); and

      5. Any [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (“ [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)”) designation or boundary change.
2. To render a final decision on any:

      1. Class 3 Conditional Use Permit;

      2. Preservation Plan Adoption / Amendment; and

      3. Guidelines or Standards Adoption / Amendment.
3. To approve or deny, on appeal, any:

      1. Project Review relating to a [Density Bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      2. [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation (which affects an entire [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or any of its subareas);

      3. Appeals of [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action on [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Appeal (which have a Citywide impact);

      4. [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as provided in [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7); and

      5. [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation.
4. Make decisions on any matter that would otherwise be heard by an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if the matter involves a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which crosses the boundaries of the area served by more than one [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

5. Adopt guidelines for the administration of the provisions of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code if it determines that guidelines are necessary and appropriate. Authority to adopt guidelines for the administration of the provisions of these Chapters may be delegated to others by adoption of a resolution by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Existing provisions of these Chapters that delegate authority for the adoption of guidelines to others shall continue to apply with respect to those provisions.

6. No ordinance, order or resolution referred to in Sec. 554 (General Plan – Purpose and Contents) or [558 (Procedure for Adoption, Amendment or Repeal of Certain ordinances, orders and Resolutions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2515) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2) shall be adopted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), unless it shall have first been submitted to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for report and recommendation, in the manner set forth in those Sections. The report and recommendation shall indicate whether the proposed ordinance, order, or resolution is in conformance with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, any plans being [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any other applicable requirement set forth in those [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2) Sections.

7. Exercise any other authority delegated by the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, or the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

3. ##### General Authority


See [Sec. 552 (Area Planning Commissions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2440) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

4. ##### Specific Authority


Consistent with the duties set forth in the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) exercises the following specific authority:

1. Review and submit recommendations to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a Zone Change (including Supplemental Use Districts).

2. To render a final decision on any:

      1. [Project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      2. [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation).
3. To approve or deny, on appeal, any:

      01. Class 2 Conditional Use Permit;

      02. Project Review;

      03. [Project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      04. [Project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Design Review Board);

      05. [Project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      06. [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation (which is applicable only on a site specific basis);

      07. Alternative Compliance;

      08. Adjustment;

      09. [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      10. [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or [Reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#));

      11. [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

      12. Appeals of [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action on [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Appeal (which do not have a Citywide impact);

      13. [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as provided in [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7);

      14. Coastal Development Permit; and

      15. [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation on a [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) specific issue.
4. Despite the above provisions, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make decisions on any matter that would otherwise be heard by an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if the matter involves a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which crosses the boundaries of the area served by more than one Area Planning Commission.

5. Exercise any other authority delegated by the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, or the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

4. Appoint a designee to act on his or her behalf, in which case references in this Code and other land use ordinances to [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall include this designee, unless otherwise stated.

5. Require the modification, discontinuance, or revocation of any conditional use or other similar [quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted in accordance with the procedures in [Sec. 13B.2.1. (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.1), [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2), or [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) in the manner prescribed in [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2). In the event of a revocation, the property affected by the revocation shall be subject to all the regulations of the zone in which the property is located.

6. Exercise any other authority delegated by the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, or the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

      4. [Evaluation of Non-Compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      5. Nuisance Abatement/Revocation.
2. ###### Zoning Administrator Interpretation


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has the authority to determine the appropriate [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) definition and interpret specific [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) subject to this Chapter, in accordance with this Paragraph (Zoning Administrator Interpretation).

      2. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also have authority to interpret zoning regulations when the meaning of the regulation is not clear, either in general or as it applies to a specific property or situation.

      3. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also have authority to adopt general interpretations determining the proper application of the yard regulations to groups of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s located in hillside districts or affected by common problems. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also have authority to interpret zoning regulations when the meaning of the regulation is not clear, either in general or as it applies to a specific property or situation.

      4. Anyone aggrieved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination may file an appeal within 15 days of the issuance of the written decision.

      5. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear appeals on [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretations where there is no site specific issue. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear appeals on site specific [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretations.

      6. For lots subject to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have authority to determine other uses, in addition to those listed in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), which may be permitted in each of the various zones, when in the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)'s judgment, the other uses are similar to and no more objectionable to the public welfare than those listed.

      7. For lots subject to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), in no instance shall the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determine, nor shall these regulations be so interpreted, that a use may be permitted in a zone when that use is specifically listed as first permissible in a less restrictive zone.
3. Exercise any other authority delegated by the Zoning Code, this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, or the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

2. ##### Specific Authority

(Department of Building and Safety) of Div. 22 (Departments, Bureaus and Agencies Under the Control of the Mayor and Council)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-47342#JD_D22C2) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and [Chapter IX.
