(General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code.

1. ###### Enforcement


      The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is granted the power to enforce the zoning ordinances of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Zoning information


      The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall maintain a public information bureau relative to zoning matters.

3. ###### Nonconforming Use


      The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has the authority to issue an order to comply to an owner of any building or structure who is in violation of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.23. (Nonconforming Building and Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115220) of this Code or [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) of this Chapter and advise the owner of the required discontinuance of the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      1. A provision advising the owner of the right to apply to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 90 days for permission to continue the [nonconforming use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the building or structure as provided in this Subdivision shall be included in the order, but the failure to include that provision does not nullify the order or provide a basis for the continued use of the building or structure.

      2. The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall record a notice of any order issued pursuant to this Subsection with the office of the Los Angeles County Recorder, but the failure to so record does not nullify the order or provide a basis for the continued [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by any owner, purchaser, or lessee who was not aware of the order.
4. ###### Issuance of Citations by Designated Employees


      Employees of the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) specified in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 98.0408. (Issuance of Citations by Designated Employees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189978) of this Code shall have the powers, duties, and immunities as set forth in said Section.

#### Sec. 13A.1.11. Design Review Board

1. ##### Establishment


1. ###### Formation


      Certain [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s call for design review boards. A design review board shall only be established for [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that expressly provide for one.

2. ###### Name of Board


      Each design review board shall have, as part of its name, words linking it to its area of administration and distinguishing it from other similar associations and boards.
2. ##### Composition


1. ###### Number of Members


      Design review boards shall consist of a minimum of five and maximum of seven voting members.

2. ###### Appointment of Members


      With the exception of the Mulholland [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the members of design review boards shall be appointed by the Councilmember(s) of the Council District(s) in which the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area is located.

3. ###### Qualifications of Membership


      1. Unless otherwise specifically required by a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), to the maximum extent practicable, each design review board shall be composed of two architects and two professionals from the following or related fields: planning, urban design, and landscape architecture. The remaining member or members need not be design professionals. All members shall reside, operate a business, or be employed within the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area. If no eligible person is known to be available for appointment in the designated disciplines who resides, operates a business, or is employed within the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area, then the Councilmember(s) may make the appointment from the community plan area(s) in which the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area is located. If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located in more than one community plan area, then the members may be chosen from any of those community plan areas.

      2. If the design review board area is represented by more than one Councilmember, then the President of the City Council shall determine the number of members appointed by the Councilmember of each Council District, based on the percentage of design review board area located in each Council District.
4. ###### Terms of Membership


      1. A term of office of a member of a design review board is four years.

      2. The members of design review boards shall be appointed to staggered terms so that at least one term becomes vacant on each successive year.

      3. The chairperson and vice-chairperson shall be elected annually by a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the design review board members.

      4. Upon expiration of the term of any member of the design review board, the appointment for the next succeeding term shall be made by the appointing authority. Appointments are limited to two consecutive four-year terms. Members of the board whose terms have expired shall remain members until their replacements have been appointed.
5. ###### Vacancies


      In the event of a vacancy occurring during the term of a design review board member, the Councilmember(s) who appointed the member, or the Councilmember(s)’ successor, shall make an appointment to serve the unexpired term of that member. Where the member is required to have specific qualifications, the vacancy shall be filled by a person having similar qualifications.

6. ###### Organization


      1. Design review boards shall schedule regular meetings at fixed times within the month with a minimum of two meetings a month.

      2. Meetings may be canceled if no [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s which have been deemed complete are received at least 14 calendar days prior to the next scheduled meeting.
7. ###### Quorum


      The presence of a simple [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the appointed members shall constitute a quorum. If a design review board cannot obtain a quorum for action within the stated time limits, the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be transferred to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for action with no recommendation from the design review board. An action by the board requires a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote of the members of the board. An action by the board cannot be made by a simple [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of those members present.
3. ##### Specific Authority


Design review boards shall review [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and accompanying materials in relation to compliance with the design components and criteria set forth in [Sec. 13B.4.3. (Project Compliance (Design Review Board))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.3), any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and adopted design guidelines, and provide their recommendations to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ##### Conflict of interest


No design review board member shall discuss with anyone the merits of any matter either pending or likely to be pending before the board other than during a duly called meeting of the board or subcommittee of the board. No member shall accept professional employment on a case that has been acted upon by the board in the previous 12 months or is reasonably expected to be acted upon by the board in the next 12 months.

### Div. 13A.2. General Procedural Elements

#### Sec. 13A.2.1. Applicability

1. ##### General


This Article (Administration) applies to any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for:

1. An amendment to any part of the Zoning Code (Chapters I. and 1A of the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)), including the text or Zoning Map;

2. Any other activity that is subject to the provisions of this Article (Administration).

3. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall not be subject to the provisions of this ordinance if a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an entitlement was filed and fees were paid prior to the date on which this ordinance becomes operative. Any such [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be subject to the administrative regulations in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code that were in effect on the date on which the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was filed. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for which a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an entitlement has been filed and for which fees were paid prior to this ordinance’s operative date may opt to proceed under the provisions of this ordinance if a required public hearing has not yet been held for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Notwithstanding the forgoing, any appeal filed on or after the operative date of this ordinance shall be subject to the appellate procedures established in this ordinance.
2. ##### Procedural Categories


This Article (Administration) establishes procedures for land development decisions made under this Article (Administration). These include:

1. ###### Legislative Decisions


      Examples of legislative decisions include Zone Changes, and amendments to the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and other ordinances. These may involve a new policy or rule, or a change in land use regulation and development regulation.

2. ###### Quasi-Judicial Decisions


      Examples of quasi-judicial decisions include [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Determinations, Conditional Use Permits and [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. These proceedings involve the exercise of discretion by the decision making body, which requires a weighing of evidence, an application of rules, regulations and ordinances to facts and a resolution of specific issues. These may involve a public hearing (unless the hearing is waived).

3. ###### Ministerial Decisions


      Examples of ministerial decisions include clearances or reviews of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for compliance with provisions of the Code or any applicable conditions of approval. Because these involve the application of non-discretionary rules to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, these [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are reviewed by [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) staff without a public hearing.

#### Sec. 13A.2.3. Applications

1. ##### General Requirements


1. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s filed under this Article must include all of the information required by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including any information required by the instructions on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) form and any applicable adopted guidelines. All [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be made on forms [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d by and available from the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The Council may establish fees for all [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s required in this Article by ordinance. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall include all fees required by [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503#JD_C1A9) or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. Whenever the provisions of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) provide that [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, requests, or appeals be filed with the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), in the public office of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), those [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, requests or appeals may be filed in any of the branch offices of the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) when designated for this purpose by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); that decision to be based upon considerations of need and available facilities.
2. ##### Application Completeness


1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or appeal shall be considered as filed whenever it has been completed in accordance with the applicable rules and regulations, has been submitted to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) together with the required filing fees, and a receipt for the filing fees has been issued.

2. If at any time during the processing of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) it is discovered that an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been improperly prepared, or required pertinent information has not been submitted in accordance with the previously established rules and regulations, upon notification to the applicant by the appropriate officer or employee the time limits specified within this Article shall be suspended and not continue to run until the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been rectified or the omitted information furnished in a proper manner.

3. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will not process incomplete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are reviewed for completeness in accordance with the Permit Streamlining Act, [California Government Code, Chapter 4.5 (Review and Approval of Development Projects) Sec 65940-65945.7](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=1.&title=7.&part=&chapter=4.5.&article=3.).
3. ##### Multiple Entitlement Requests


In order to facilitate the development process, [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for multiple entitlements for the same [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be submitted and processed concurrently as provided in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10).

4. ##### Withdrawal of Application


1. At any time before the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or appellate body on appeal makes a final decision on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicant may withdraw the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The withdrawal of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must be in writing and does not require the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to concur. The withdrawal of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be permanent and any associated authorization shall be void.

#### Sec. 13A.2.4. Notice of Public Hearing

1. ##### Public Hearing Purpose


A public hearing gives interested parties an opportunity to be heard. The specific procedures for providing testimony and conducting the public hearing are established by the agency that conducts the public hearing.

2. ##### General Procedures for Notice of Public Hearing


1. Unless otherwise provided by a specific process, the notice established in this Article is as provided in Table 3 (Notice of Public Hearing) below. Where notice is not specified, notice shall be given pursuant to [California Government Code Sections 54950](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=54950) et seq., [65090](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65090), and [65091](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65091), as applicable.

2. The time period required for a notice of public hearing is the minimum number of days preceding commencement of the applicable public hearing.

3. If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conducts a public hearing on behalf of the Area or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the notice requirements apply to only the [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) hearing.

4. Unless otherwise provided for a specific procedure, notice of a public hearing shall be given in writing to the owner, applicant, interested parties, and appellant, as appropriate.

5. At the noticed hearing, the agency may continue the hearing to another date if the matter is publicly continued to a date certain, no additional notice of the continued hearing is required.

6. Whenever the provisions of this Chapter provide that an applicant shall post notice of a public hearing or meeting, the applicant shall file a declaration in the appropriate public office prior to the date of the noticed public hearing or meeting. In this declaration, the applicant shall declare, under penalty of perjury, that notice has been posted in accordance with the applicable provisions of this Chapter.

7. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to adopt guidelines consistent with this Article for the posting of notices if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that guidelines are necessary and appropriate.

#### Sec. 13A.2.5. Decisions

1. ##### Decision Time Period


1. Decisions must be made within the time period specified in this Article, or as otherwise required by law. Unless otherwise provided in the regulations governing the particular [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), this time limit may be extended by mutual consent of the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the applicant. The extension of time to act also applies to [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or initiations under the multiple approval provisions in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10).

2. Where extensions on the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s time to act on a matter may be granted by mutual consent of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Council President or the Council President’s councilmember designee may consent to a time extension on behalf of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Criteria or Findings for Decision


1. Each decision is subject to all applicable standards of this Code, including the applicable zone.

2. Each process described in [Part 13B. (Processes & Procedures)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B) of this Article includes standards and/or findings for approval. In approving an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the standards and/or findings for approval.

3. For a Quasi-judicial action, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall adopt written findings of fact supporting the decision based upon evidence in the record. This evidence may include, but is not limited to, written or oral statements and documents presented to the agency, such as photographs, maps, and plans, and any results of the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s investigations.
3. ##### Decision and Conditions


1. Unless otherwise provided, an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be approved or disapproved in whole or in part.

2. Unless otherwise provided, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions that it determines are needed to ensure substantial compliance with the applicable standards or findings for approval.
4. ##### Transmittal


1. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s a letter of determination that notifies the applicant, owner, and interested parties, as applicable, of the decision. The notification will indicate whether the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved, approved with conditions, or denied.

2. The date of transmittal is the date the decision is mailed (as shown by the date stamp), unless otherwise provided.
5. ##### Effective Date


1. ###### Initial Decision or Commission Decisions That Are Appealable to City Council


      The decision is final and effective upon the close of the appeal period if no appeal is filed.

2. ###### Appellate Decision or Commission Decisions That Are Not Appealable to City Council


      The decision is final and effective as provided in [Charter Section 245](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-663).

3. ###### Legislative Actions


      A legislative action is final pursuant to [Charter Section 252](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-730).

#### Sec. 13A.2.6. Transfer of Jurisdiction

1. ##### Applicability


When specifically authorized by this Article, the applicant may request a transfer of jurisdiction.

2. ##### Failure to Act


1. If the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to act on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 75 days from the date a filed [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been deemed complete, or within a mutually agreed upon extension of time, the applicant may file a request for a transfer of jurisdiction to the designated appellate body for decision. The designated appellate body is the body to whom the matter would normally be appealable, pursuant to [Div. 13B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall prescribe the form and manner of filing requests for transfers of jurisdiction.

2. When the designated appellate body receives the applicant’s request for a transfer of jurisdiction, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall lose jurisdiction. However, the body to whom the matter is transferred may remand the matter to the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) who shall regain jurisdiction for the time and purpose specified in the remand action. In addition, upon receipt of a written request by the applicant for withdrawal of the transfer of jurisdiction prior to the matter being heard by the appellate body, the matter shall be remanded to the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. If the matter is not remanded, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to whom the matter has been transferred shall consider the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) following the same procedures and subject to the same limitations as are applicable to the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except that the body to which the matter has been transferred shall act within 45 days of the transfer of jurisdiction once the request is properly filed with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including the office of Zoning Administration, shall make investigations and furnish any reports requested by the body to which the matter has been transferred.

#### Sec. 13A.2.7. Scope of Decision

1. ##### Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits


1. Unless otherwise provided in this Chapter, [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), or in a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)'s conditions of approval, any approval by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that is not effectuated within three years of its effective date becomes null and void.

2. When approvals are granted as part of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requiring multiple approvals pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) the following time limits apply unless a different time period is provided in a signed and effectuated development agreement:




      | Approvals | Granted in<br>Conjunction With | Expiration |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Quasi-judicial Approvals | Legislative Approvals | Expires with the Legislative Approval, not to exceed six years unless the initial decision maker extends the time period (see Subsection C.1. of this Section). |
      | Quasi-judicial Approvals | [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Approval | Expires with the [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Approval pursuant to Div. 13B.7 (Division of Land) of this Article. If the expiration date on a [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Approval is extended pursuant to Div. 13B.7 (Division of Land) or by amendment to the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Quasi-judicial Approval is automatically extended for the same time period. |
      | Legislative Approvals | [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Approval | Extended for the full time limit of the [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Approval, including time extensions pursuant to Div. 13B.7 (Division of Land), as needed to record an approved map. |
2. ##### Effectuation of Approvals


A discretionary [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval is considered effectuated by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) when the conditions of approval of the grant are satisfied. This must be done before the privileges of the grant may be utilized. Effectuation is accomplished upon procedural steps being followed and completed by the applicant to demonstrate compliance with all conditions of approval. The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall verify such compliance and assess appropriate fees. Effectuation is achieved when fees are paid, plans are verified and stamped as approved, and authorization is obtained to utilize grant. Authorization is typically demonstrated by a clearance on a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). However, if a [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) includes a use that is existing, and there is no physical work and/or change of use involved and the description of work in any previously issued permits do not specifically exclude or prohibit the entitled operation, then a permit from [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may not be necessary. Thus, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) not requiring permits for construction or alteration from the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) achieves effectuation when the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) verifies compliance with all conditions of the grant, including payment of all fees, and stamping of plans.

3. ##### Utilizing the Grant


1. A discretionary project approval is considered utilized after it has been effectuated by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Utilization of a grant must occur no later than three years from the last date an action can be effectuated. An approval not requiring [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s from the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is considered utilized when compliance with all conditions of approval have been demonstrated, appropriate fees paid, plans stamped and authorization has been obtained from the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Exceptions


      1. ###### Religious and Institutional Uses


         Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s have been approved for use as a governmental enterprise, religious use, [hospital](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), educational institution or private school, including elementary and high schools, no time limit to utilize the privileges shall apply provided that all of the following conditions are met:

         1. The property involved is acquired or legal proceedings for its acquisition are commenced within one year of the effective date of the decision approving the conditional use.

         2. A [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is immediately placed on the property indicating its ownership and the purpose to which it is to be developed, as soon as legally possible after the effective date of the decision approving the conditional use. This [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have a surface area of at least 20 square feet.

         3. The [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is maintained on the property and in good condition until the conditional use privileges are utilized.
      2. ###### Affordable Housing Projects


         A six-year time limit to utilize the privileges shall apply where a lot or lots have been approved for a one hundred percent affordable housing project, as defined in [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3).
4. ##### Abandonment of Approval


1. Unless otherwise stated in a specific process in this Code, for a [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owner (and applicant if different) shall file the appropriate form with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requesting the abandonment of their approval. If it is determined by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that the abandonment is in conformity with public necessity, convenience, general welfare, and good zoning practice, the request to abandon an approval shall be approved. A written response shall be issued by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. Unless otherwise stated in a specific process in this Code, for a legislative approval, any change shall be processed pursuant to the same legislative process that was used for the original approval.
5. ##### Planning and Zoning Matters in Litigation


The time limits set forth in Subsection A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits) and Subsection B. (Effectuation of Approvals) of this Section shall not include any time period during which the approval or the environmental clearance for the approval is challenged in court. Notwithstanding any contrary language in the Zoning Code, this Chapter and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, the time limits in Subsection A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits) and Subsection B. (Effectuation of Approvals) of this Section shall be tolled until litigation is concluded.

6. ##### California Coastal Commission Approvals


The time limits set forth in Subsection A. (Discretionary Project Approvals Time Limits), Subsection B. (Effectuation of Approvals), and Subsection C. (Utilizing the Grant) of this Section shall not include any time period during which the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or applicant is awaiting a California Coastal Commission decision on a Coastal Development Permit appeal or [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including the California Coastal Commission’s final action on an appeal of a Coastal Development Permit issued by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or applicant shall submit a written request for a suspension of time and a copy of the submitted California Coastal Commission [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for such approval to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 10 days of filing the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the California Coastal Commission. Suspensions of time shall be automatically granted until the California Coastal Commission has rendered a final decision on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including any appeal period. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or applicant shall submit a copy of the California Coastal Commission’s final action to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 10 days of the final decision. In cases where the California Coastal Commission’s final action on an appeal of a Coastal Development Permit issued by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is a finding of “no substantial issue”, the initial decision stands.

7. ##### Violation of Conditions – Penalty


A Quasi-judicial action or any conditional approval granted by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), pursuant to the authority of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code shall become effective upon utilization of any portion of the privilege, and the owner and applicant shall immediately comply with its conditions. The violation of any condition imposed by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in connection with the granting of any action taken pursuant to the authority of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), shall constitute a violation of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) and shall be subject to the same penalties as any other violation of this Code.


#### Sec. 13A.2.8. Appeals

1. ##### Filing of Appeals


1. Appeals shall be in writing and filed on forms maintained by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. An appeal shall specifically state the points at issue and the reasons why the decision should be overturned.

3. An appeal not properly or timely filed shall not be accepted, and will not be considered by the appellate body.
2. ##### Time Limits for Appeal


1. Unless otherwise required by a specific process, appeals must be filed within 15 days after the date on the letter of determination to the applicant.

2. Despite any provisions of this Chapter, whenever the final day for filing an appeal from any action, decision or determination of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday, the time for filing an appeal shall be extended to the close of business on the next succeeding working day, and the effective or final date of any action, decision, or determination shall be extended to the close of that appeal period.

3. If in any individual case involving a 15-day appeal period, that appeal period fails to include at least 10 working days, then the appeal period shall be extended as many days as the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines are necessary to include 10 working days.
3. ##### Appeal Procedures


1. An appeal stays the processing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and entitlement, and any development of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at issue until the appellate body makes a decision.

2. After an appeal is filed, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the appeal and the file to the appellate body, together with any report if one was [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d by staff responding to the points raised made in the appeal. The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make investigations and furnish any reports requested by the body to which the matter is transferred.

3. When the appellate body receives the appeal, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) loses jurisdiction.

4. Upon the date set for the hearing, the appellate body shall either hear the appeal, or continue the matter by mutual agreement with the applicant to another date. No additional notice of continuance need be given if the continuance to a date certain is announced at the time of the original hearing. If no date for the continued hearing is provided publicly at the original hearing, then notice of the continued hearing shall be provided in the same manner as the original notice for the appellate hearing.

5. The appellate body shall conduct a public hearing. After the public hearing, the appellate body shall render a decision:

      1. Affirming the initial decision in whole or in part; or

      2. Reversing the initial decision in whole or in part, after which it may render its own decision or remand the decision to the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for further proceedings.
6. The appellate body may impose conditions that it determines are needed to ensure substantial compliance with the standards or findings for approval.
4. ##### Withdrawal of Appeals


1. ###### Procedures


      Appellant(s) may withdraw an appeal of an initial determination if the withdrawal is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at least 15 days prior to the public hearing by the appellate body on the appeal.

2. ###### Requirements


      1. ###### Filing


         Withdrawal of an appeal shall be in writing and does not require the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to concur. The withdrawal shall be filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. ###### Withdrawal Before Close of Appeal Period


         1. If the withdrawal of the appeal is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after the close of the original appeal period, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall notify the same persons who received notice of the decision that was appealed, that an appeal had been filed and was now withdrawn. The notice shall state that the appeal period is being reopened.

         2. The reopened appeal period shall run for 10 days from the date the notice of withdrawal of the appeal is mailed.

         3. If more than one appeal was filed, the appeal period is only reopened if the withdrawal of the appeal would result in no other appeal going forward.

         4. The appeal period shall only be reopened once.
      3. ###### Withdrawal Before Public Notice


         If the withdrawal is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) before any required public hearing notice is mailed, then the time for the appellate body to act is extended for 10 days.

      4. ###### Withdrawal After Public Notice


         If the withdrawal is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after the public hearing notice is mailed, then any appeal filed during the reopened appeal period shall be heard on the same date and time as set forth in the previously mailed public hearing notice. No further notice of the appeal hearing is required.

      5. ###### Withdrawal Resulting in No Appeal


         If the withdrawal of the appeal, and the subsequent reopening of the appeal period, results in no appeal going forward:

         1. The withdrawal of the appeal is permanent; and

         2. The decision from which the appeal was taken automatically becomes final at the end of the appeal period or reopened appeal period.
      6. Appeals challenging [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decisions cannot be withdrawn.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. ###### Standard of Review


      Unless otherwise required by a specific process, the appellate body shall hear the matter de novo, considering the whole of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with no deference given to the decision of the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The appellate body shall make its decision based on the record before the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any other evidence or testimony presented at or before the appellate body’s hearing.

2. ###### Findings for Appeals


      Unless otherwise required by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), in making a decision to grant a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval, the appellate body shall make the same findings as required to be made by the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), supported by substantial evidence.
6. ##### Lack of Timely Decision on Appeal


1. Unless otherwise required by a specific process, the appellate body shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period or within any additional period mutually agreed upon by the applicant and the appellate body.

2. Failure of the appellate body to render a timely decision shall result in the denial of the appeal.

#### Sec. 13A.2.9. Permits Issued in Error

1. ##### Void Permits


Notwithstanding any other provisions of this Code or any other ordinance of the City, no permit or license shall be issued in violation of any provisions of this Code or any other ordinance of the City. Any permit or license issued in violation of any provision of this Code or any other ordinance of the City is void. Any permit or license that purports to authorize any act prohibited by any other provision of this Code or any other ordinance of the City is void.

2. ##### Building Permits for a Zone Change


Upon publication of a Zone Change, height district, or building line ordinance, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may issue a permit for a building or structure which will comply with all of the requirements of the new zone, height district, or building line. No such permit shall be issued unless the applicant has first executed and filed with the Superintendent of Building a notarized agreement assuming all risk and agreeing to remove all buildings or structures authorized by the permit if the Zone Change, height district, or building line ordinance becomes effective.

1. ###### General


      This Section applies to [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that require multiple Legislative and/or [Quasi-judicial Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

         | Modification of Entitlement for a Redevelopment Plan Project | [Sec. 13B.12.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12.4) |  | ¢ |  |  |
         | Redevelopment Plan Project Adjustment | [Sec. 13B.12.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12.5) |  | ¢ |  |  |
         | Redevelopment Plan Amendment | [Sec. 13B.12.6.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12.6) | ¢ |  |  |  |





         |     |     |     |

         | Key |
         | ¢ | = | qualifies for multiple approval |
         |  | = | varies with underlying [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
2. ##### Initiation


1. Applicants shall file [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s at the same time for all approvals reasonably related and necessary to complete the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The procedures and time limits set forth in this Section only apply to multiple [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s filed concurrently. Prior to a public hearing, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require an applicant to amend an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requiring multiple approvals to ensure that all relevant approvals are reviewed concurrently.
3. ##### Decision Makers and Procedures


Despite any provision of this Code to the contrary, the following procedures apply to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s requiring multiple approvals.

1. ###### Legislative Decisions


      1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has initial authority to submit a recommendation, and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has final decision-making authority for approvals of legislative decisions.

      2. ###### Procedures


         1. To the extent permitted by California law and the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), the procedures for consideration of all decision are those set forth in:

            1. [Sec. 13B.1.1. (General Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.1) if a General Plan Amendment is involved;

            2. [Sec. 13B.1.2. (Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.2) if a Specific Plan Amendment, but no General Plan Amendment, is involved; or

            3. [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) if a Zone Change is combined with a Zoning Code Amendment.
         2. If a development agreement is combined with a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), Zoning Code Amendment, or Zone Change, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit a Planning Commission recommendation, and all required notices and hearings required by this Chapter and the California Government Code shall be combined to the extent permitted by law.
2. ###### City Planning Commission


      1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has initial decision-making authority for all approvals and/or recommendations if a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires:

         1. A separate approval or recommendation by an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and/or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

         2. An approval or recommendation by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      2. ###### Procedures


         1. If all of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are for [quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, the procedures for consideration and appeal of all the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are those set forth in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) of this Code.

         2. If any Legislative Approval is included, the procedures for consideration and appeal of all the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are those set forth in [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) of this Code.

         3. If there is a request for a Modification of Entitlement, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may act on behalf of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is specified to be the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for any such modifications.
      3. ###### Appellate Body


         The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall decide all appeals of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decisions or recommendations under this Subdivision.
3. ###### Area Planning Commission


      If a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires an approval separately decided by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and/or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and also requires any approval or recommendation by an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) where the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located has initial decision-making authority for all of the approvals and recommendations.

      1. ###### Procedures


         1. If all of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are for [Quasi-judicial Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, the procedures for consideration and appeal of all the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are those set forth in [Sec. 13B.2.3. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3) of this Code.

         2. If a Legislative Approval is included, then the procedures for consideration and appeal of all the approvals shall be those set forth in [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) of this Code.
      2. ###### Appellate Body


         The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall decide all appeals of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decisions or recommendations under this Subdivision.
4. ###### Zoning Administrator


      If a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires approvals separately decided by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has decision-making authority for all of the approvals (except as provided in Paragraph (b) below).

      1. ###### Procedures


         The procedures for consideration and appeal of all related [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [Quasi-judicial Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are those set forth in [Sec. 13B.2.2. (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.2) of this Code.

      2. ###### Appellate Body


         The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) where the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located decides all appeals of decisions of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s requiring multiple approvals. However, if this Article requires any of the approvals to be heard by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decides all appeals of decisions of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ###### Director of Planning


      If a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires multiple approvals decided by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the following procedures apply:

      1. ###### Procedures


         The procedures for consideration and appeal of all related [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [Quasi-judicial Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are those set forth in [Sec. 13B.2.4. (Project Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.4) of this Code.

      2. ###### Appellate Body


         The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) where the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located shall decide all appeals of decisions of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s requiring multiple approvals. However, if this Article requires any of the approvals to be heard by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall decide all appeals of decisions of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. ###### Ministerial Action


         An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [Ministerial Action](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may only be reviewed after the final decision on a [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Determination is rendered, including all appeals.
6. ###### Advisory Agency


      1. ###### Procedures


         If a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requiring multiple approvals also requires a [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), that [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be decided and governed by the rules set forth in [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7) of this Code.

      2. ###### Appeals


         1. When a [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is appealed, it shall follow the procedures set forth in [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7), except when other approvals are also appealed.

         2. Hearings for and consideration of appeals of [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be scheduled for the same time as any hearing and decision by the Area Planning Commission or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has jurisdiction over the other approvals. In the event that the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as determined by [Div. 13B.8. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8) is the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the hearing for and consideration of the appeals shall be heard by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      3. Any time limit within which the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must act on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are automatically extended as necessary to allow the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to hear and decide appeals of [Subdivision Approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s at the same time as it serves as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the other approvals.
4. ##### Findings


When acting on multiple [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or appellate body shall separately make all required findings for each [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). When appropriate, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or appellate body may make findings by reference to findings made for another [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) involving the same [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

5. ##### No New Appeal Rights


This Section does not create any additional appeal or level of appeal in connection with any land use approval. This Section also does not limit or expand who may file an appeal as identified in each discretionary land use [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) process.


## Part 13B. Processes & Procedures

### Div. 13B.1. Legislative Action

#### Sec. 13B.1.1. General Plan Adoption/Amendment

1. ##### Applicability

    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.1.1.png.webp?itok=wnhGkWX6)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.1.1.png?itok=2Kp-kg3R)
1. This Section applies to the adoption or an amendment to the City’s comprehensive [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. Amendments to the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be initiated, [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d and acted upon in accordance with the procedures set forth in [Sec. 555 (General Plan – Procedures for Adoption) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2486) and this Section.

3. Nothing in this Section shall restrict the adoption of a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment which permits the development of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment meets the criteria described in [Sec. 11.5.6 A. (Initiation of Plan Amendment) of Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107826) of this Code.
2. ##### Initiation


1. As provided in [Sec. 555 (General Plan – Procedures for Adoption) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2486), only the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment.

2. Initiations by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) require a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote.

3. Upon initiation, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a report and recommendation to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The report shall contain an explanation of the reasons for the action recommended.

4. ###### Batching


      1. In order to comprehensively consider [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for amendments to any community plan, the intake of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s by private parties to request amendments to any of the community plan areas may be batched into geographically based groups.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall establish the boundaries of the groups and a schedule for review, and may modify them as necessary in order to more effectively carry out the purpose and intent of this Section.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
      | Posting (site specific amendments only) | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
      | Publication (City-initiated only) | 10 days | •Where the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) initiates changes to one or more specific plans to 1,000 [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or more, publication in two newspapers of general circulations in the area involved, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk, is required. Mailing of individual notices shall not be required. |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Public Hearing


      1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      2. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may hold the hearing itself, or may direct the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to hold the hearing. At the time of the hearing, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear public testimony from anyone wishing to be heard on the matter. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may continue the hearing to another date announced publicly at the hearing being continued; no additional notice of the continued hearing need be given.

      3. If the hearing is conducted by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

         1. After the close of the hearing, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit a report to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) summarizing the information received.

         2. The report may also contain a recommendation to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regarding its action on the proposed amendment.
3. ###### Action of the City Planning Commission


      1. After receiving the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report, or after the close of a public hearing conducted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall recommend to the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that the proposed amendment be approved or disapproved in whole or in part.

         1. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends approval of any proposed [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment or disapproval of either a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment initiated by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as soon as possible those actions to the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for consideration and report to the Council.

         2. If the City Planning Commission recommends disapproval of a [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment initiated by it, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall report its decision to the Council and [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      2. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report to the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set forth the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s findings for its recommendation.

      3. ###### Time to Act


         1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 90 days after receiving the report of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         2. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to do so, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s failure to act is deemed a recommendation for approval of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation regarding the General Plan Amendment.
4. ###### Action of the Mayor


      1. Within 30 days after receipt of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation, the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a recommendation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the proposed General Plan Amendment. If the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not act within the 30-day period, the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s inaction is deemed a recommendation for approval of [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation regarding the General Plan Amendment.

      2. The [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set forth the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s reasons for his or her recommendation.
5. ###### Action of the City Council


      1. After receiving the recommendations of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or at the expiration of the 30-day period for the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to act, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold a public hearing on the proposed General Plan Amendment.

      2. After the close of the public hearing, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may do either of the following:

         1. Approve or disapprove the General Plan Amendment in accordance with [Sec. 555(e) (General Plan – Procedures for Adoption) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2486); or

         2. Propose changes to the General Plan Amendment.
      3. The City Council shall take either of these actions within 75 days after receiving the recommendation of the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or within 75 days after the expiration of the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s time to act if the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has not made a timely recommendation. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to do so, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s failure to act is deemed a disapproval of the General Plan Amendment.

      4. ###### Required Vote


         In accordance with [Sec. 555 (General Plan – Procedures for Adoption) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2486), the votes necessary for adoption of a General Plan Amendment are as follows:




         | Recommendation | Required Council Vote |
         | --- | --- |
         | Both the CPC and the Mayor recommend approval | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
         | Either the CPC or the Mayor recommends disapproval | 2/3 Vote |
         | Both the CPC and the Mayor recommend disapproval | 3/4 Vote |
6. ###### Proposed Changes by the City Council


      1. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) proposes changes to the General Plan Amendment that differ from the amendment as initiated or as recommended by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the matter shall be returned simultaneously to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for their recommendations on the proposed changes.

      2. In acting on those changes, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall follow the procedures set forth above for their initial action.

      3. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 60 days of receipt of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s proposed change.

      4. The [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 30 days of the receipt of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation on the proposed change, or the expiration of the time for the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to act if the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely recommendation.

      5. If either the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) do not act within the time period, that inaction is a recommendation of approval of the proposed changes.

      6. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider only those changes made by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      7. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act to approve or disapprove, in whole or in part, the General Plan Amendment, including the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s changes, within 120 days after receiving both the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s and the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendations on the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s proposed changes, or the expiration of its time to act on those changes.
