#### Sec. 13B.1.2. Specific Plan Adoption/Amendment

1. ##### Applicability

    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.2.1.png.webp?itok=isxmysJd)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.2.1.png?itok=9RXhEKqM)
1. ###### General


      This Section applies to the adoption of, or any amendment to the map or text of, a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### When a Specific Plan Amendment is Required


      A Specific Plan Amendment is required whenever the policies or standards of plan need to be changed or updated, including but not limited to the following:

      01. To permit a new principal use or a change of use that the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) specifically prohibits, except where an applicant seeks to alter or enlarge an existing legal [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), in which case a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required;

      02. To permit a use which exceeds the maximum number of permitted establishments or the maximum permitted occupant load for that use within a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or subarea;

      03. To permit a sign specifically prohibited by the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      04. To deviate from a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) map footnote;

      05. To make significant changes to environmental mitigation measures that were adopted as part of the environmental clearance for the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if required by [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      06. To make changes to impact fees which affect implementation of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or planned improvements;

      07. To make boundary changes to a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or subarea;

      08. To change highway/ [street designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, which are identified in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      09. To reconcile an inconsistency with the applicable community plan(s) where the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires a community plan amendment; or

      10. To establish significant policy changes or modifications to [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations which affect the entire [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or a subarea, as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Initiation


Only the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Adoption or Amendment. An action to initiate a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Adoption or Amendment by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail (if the amendment affects the permitted uses or intensity of uses of real property) | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 500 feet of the area to be changed (or the expanded area described below); <br>•Residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of all properties within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located. |
         | Posting <br>(site specific amendments only) | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property<br>•If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the decision making body on the matter |

      2. If the mailed notice does not include at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.

      3. Where a public hearing before a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was held pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.2.D.2.c. (Public Hearing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.2) below, then notice for the Planning Commission hearing shall be given in the manner specified in [Sec. 13B.1.3.C. (Zoning Code Amendment; Notice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3) of this Chapter.

      4. Where the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) initiates changes to one or more [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s pursuant to Sec. 65455 (Zoning, tentative map, parcel map, and public works project consistency with specific plan) of the California Government Code to 1,000 [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or more, publication in two newspapers of general ciculation designated by the City Clerk for official advertising in the area involved, not less than 10 days prior to the date of the public hearing, giving notice of its time, place and purpose shall be sufficient notice of the hearing, and the mailing of individual notices shall not be required.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Public Hearing


      1. The Council or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall forward the proposed ordinance to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a report and recommendation.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a recommendation for action on the matter; that recommendation shall then be heard by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. Before making a recommendation, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may direct a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to hold a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section, and make a report and recommendation.
3. ###### City Planning Commission Action


      1. After receipt of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold a public hearing.

      2. The hearing proceedings shall be recorded or summarized as directed by the Commission. When proceedings are recorded and not summarized, they shall be transcribed at the request of any party or interested person upon payment of the fee, as required by ordinance. One copy of the transcript shall be furnished to the Commission to be filed.

      3. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider the matter and make a report and recommendation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. If the matter was initiated by either the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends denial of the proposed ordinance, the decision is final.

      5. ###### Time to Act


         1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days of receipt of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report and recommendation.

         2. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not act by that deadline, or any extension, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may then, by resolution, request the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to forward the matter to it for the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action.

         3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not do so, the time for the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to act shall automatically be extended for an additional 75 days. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may request the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to forward the matter at any time within the 75-day continuance period.

         4. If the Planning Commission fails to act on an initiation within the time allowed by this Subdivision, the Planning Commission shall be deemed to have approved the ordinance.
4. ###### City Council Action


      1. After the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has made its report and recommendation, or after the time for it to act has expired, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider the matter.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve or disapprove the proposed [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Adoption or Amendment.

      3. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends approval of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 90 days of receipt of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommendation. This time limit may be extended by mutual consent of the initiating body and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. ###### Required Vote


         The votes necessary for adoption of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Adoption or Amendment are as follows:




         | Recommendation | Required Council Vote |
         | --- | --- |
         | The CPC recommends approval | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
         | The CPC recommends disapproval (on a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Adoption/Amendment initiated by the City Council) | 2/3 Vote |
         | Failure of the CPC to act | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Adoption or Amendment, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that:

      1. The action substantially conforms to the purposes, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      2. The proposed ordinance is in conformity with public necessity, convenience, general welfare and good zoning practice.
2. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not adopt the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s findings and recommendations, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make its own findings.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Specific Plan Action


A Specific Plan Adoption or Amendment may be modified by following the same procedures established above for the original action.


#### Sec. 13B.1.3. Zoning Code Amendment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.3.1.png.webp?itok=nLlMMjd2)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.3.1.png?itok=Wn60fKv8)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to the adoption, amendment, or repeal of any text in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), including but not limited to:

1. The creation or change of any zones or districts for the purpose of regulating the use of land (including area-wide or comprehensive zone changes that the City initiates to implement a land use policy);

2. Zoning or other land use regulations concerning permissible uses, height, density, bulk, location or use of buildings or structures, size of yards, open space, setbacks, building line requirements, and other similar requirements, including [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ordinances;

3. [Private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations;

4. [Public project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s; and

5. The acquisition of, change of area or alignment to, abandonment of, or vacation of any [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), park, playground, airport, public building site or other [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), ground or open space, but not including [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for sewers, storm drains or slopes, nor the temporary transfer of jurisdiction over any portion of a street to another local agency.
2. ##### Initiation


Only the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate a Zoning Code Amendment. An action to initiate a Zoning Code Amendment by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Public Hearing


      1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall forward the proposed Zoning Code Amendment to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a report and recommendation.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a recommendation for action on the matter, which recommendation shall then be heard by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. Before making a recommendation, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may direct a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to hold a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section, and make a report and recommendation.
3. ###### City Planning Commission Action


      1. After receipt of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider the matter and make a report and recommendation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If the matter was initiated by either the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends denial of the proposed ordinance, the decision is final.

      3. ###### Time to Act


         1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days of receipt of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report and recommendation.

         2. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not act by that deadline, or any extension, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may then, by resolution, request the Planning Commission to forward the matter to it for the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action.

         3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not do so, the time for the Planning Commission to act shall automatically be extended for an additional 75 days. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may request the Planning Commission forward the matter at any time within any 75-day continuance period.

         4. If the Planning Commission fails to act on an initiation within the time allowed by this Subdivision, the Planning Commission shall be deemed to have approved the ordinance.
4. ###### City Council Action


      1. After the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has made its report and recommendation, or after the time for it to act has expired, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may consider the matter.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve or disapprove the proposed Zoning Code Amendment.

      3. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends approval of the proposed Zoning Code Amendment, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 90 days of receipt of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommendation.

      4. ###### Required Vote


         The votes necessary for adoption of a Zoning Code Amendment are as follows:




         | Recommendation | Required Council Vote |
         | --- | --- |
         | The CPC recommends approval | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
         | The CPC recommends disapproval (on a Zoning Code Amendment initiated by the City Council) | 2/3 Vote |
         | Failure of the CPC to act | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a Zoning Code Amendment, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that:

      1. The action substantially conforms to the purposes, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      2. Proposed ordinance is in conformity with public necessity, convenience, general welfare and good zoning practice; and

      3. Other findings required by law.
2. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not adopt the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s findings and recommendations, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make its own findings.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Zoning Code Amendment

#### Sec. 13B.1.4. Zone Change

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.4.1.png.webp?itok=CauNQd96)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.4.1.png?itok=h1B1_YUi)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to any amendment to the zoning map through a legislative land use ordinance.

2. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may recommend approval or disapproval in whole or in part of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or initiation of a proposed land use ordinance. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may recommend approval or disapproval in whole or in part of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a land use ordinance where permitted in this Section. These recommendations shall be made to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for its action pursuant to the procedures set forth in this Section.

3. Pursuant to [Sec. 565. (Delegation of Legislative Authority to Area Planning Commissions) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2610), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may delegate classes or categories of Zone Changes for consideration by an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has delegated the following categories of Zone or height district changes to [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s:

      1. Any development project which creates or results in fewer than 50,000 gross square feet of non-residential floor area;

      2. Any development project which creates or results in fewer than 50 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, guest rooms or combination of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or guest rooms; or

      3. Any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) involving a lot with fewer than 65,000 square feet of lot area.
5. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), rather than the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), shall have the authority to make recommendations on any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for or initiation of a proposed Zone Change when it is being considered in conjunction with an initiated General Plan Amendment.

6. Unless otherwise specified, further references in this Section to “Planning Commission” mean either the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has authority.

7. To be eligible for any Zone Change or height district change that results in increased allowable residential floor area, density or height, or allows a residential use where previously not allowed, [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s with 10 or more residential [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s must comply with the provisions in [Sec. 13B.1.1.E. (General Plan Adoption/Amendment; Standards for Review and Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.1).
2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### City initiated


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate a Zone Change. Any initiation by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be by [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote.

2. ###### Applicant initiated


      An applicant may apply for a Zone Change. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Zone Change shall be filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Establishment of Supplemental Use Districts or Overlays


      The following provisions apply to the establishment of Supplemental Use Districts pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 3 (Specific Plan – Zoning Supplemental Use Districts)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-10730) or Overlays pursuant to [Article 8. (Supplemental & Special Zoning)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/8) of this Chapter:

      1. One or more of the owners or lessees of property within the boundaries of the proposed district may submit a verified [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the establishment of a supplemental use district or overlay. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall contain the signatures of at least 75 percent of the owners or lessees of property within the proposed boundaries.

      2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the establishment of a Fence Height District shall contain the signatures of at least 50 percent of the owners or lessees of property within the proposed district.

      3. A Community Plan Implementation Ordinance ( [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)) District may not be established through the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) procedure.

      4. Only the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is authorized to make recommendations regarding approval or disapproval in whole or in part on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for or the initiation of the establishment of a supplemental use district to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail (if the amendment affects the permitted uses or intensity of uses of real property) | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 500 feet of the area to be changed (or the expanded area described below); <br>•Residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of all properties within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located. |
         | Posting (applicant initiated Zone Changes only) | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property<br>•If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the decision making body on the matter |
         | Publication (City-initated only) | 10 days | •Where the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) initates changes of zone or height districts to 1,000 lots or more, publication in two newspapaers of general circulations in the area involved, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk, is required. Mailing of individual notices shall not be required. |

      2. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.

      3. Where a public hearing before a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was held for a City-initiated matter pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.4.D.2.a.ii. (Public Hearing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) below, then notice for the Planning Commission hearing shall be given in the manner specified in [Sec. 13B.1.3.C. (Zoning Code Amendment; Notice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3) of this Chapter.

      4. Where the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) initiates changes of zone or height districts pursuant to [California Government Code Sec. 65860(d) (Adoption of Regulations)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65860&lawCode=GOV) to 1,000 [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or more, publication in two newspapers of general circulation designated by the City Clerk for official advertising in the area involved, not less than 10 days prior to the date of the public hearing, giving notice of its time, place and purpose shall be sufficient notice of the hearing, and the mailing of individual notices shall not be required.

      5. Notice of the public hearing shall also be given to the Bureau of Engineering and Department of Transportation for an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or initiation to establish a supplemental use district.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail (if the amendment affects the permitted uses or intensity of uses of real property) | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located.<br>•Any interested party who has requested in writing to be so notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### City initiated


      1. ###### Public Hearing


         1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a recommendation for action on the matter, which recommendation shall then be heard by the Planning Commission.

         2. Before making a recommendation, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may direct a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to hold a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section, and make a report and recommendation.
      2. ###### Planning Commission Action


         1. After receipt of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation, the Planning Commission shall hold a public hearing.

         2. The hearing proceedings shall be recorded or summarized as directed by the Commission. When proceedings are recorded and not summarized, they shall be transcribed at the request of any party or interested person upon payment of the fee, as required by ordinance. One copy of the transcript shall be furnished to the Commission to be filed.

         3. The Planning Commission shall consider the matter, and make a report and recommendation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         4. If the matter was initiated by either the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends denial of the proposed ordinance, the decision is final.
      3. ###### Time to Act


         1. The Planning Commission shall act within 75 days of receipt of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report and recommendation.

         2. If the Planning Commission does not act by that deadline, or any extension, the City Council may then, by resolution, request the Planning Commission to forward the matter to it for the City Council’s action.

         3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not do so, the time for the Planning Commission to act shall automatically be extended for an additional 75 days. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may request that the Planning Commission forward the matter at any time within the 75-day continuance period.

         4. If the Planning Commission fails to act on an initiation within the time allowed by this Subdivision, the Planning Commission shall be deemed to have approved the ordinance.
3. ###### Applicant Initiated


      1. ###### Public Hearing


         1. Once a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is received, as determined by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Commission shall hold a public hearing or direct a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to hold the hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

         2. If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) holds the public hearing, he or she shall make a recommendation for action on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      2. ###### Planning Commission Action


         1. The [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation shall be heard by the Planning Commission, which may hold a public hearing, and shall make a report and recommendation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         2. The hearing proceedings shall be recorded or summarized as directed by the Commission. When proceedings are recorded and not summarized, they shall be transcribed at the request of any party or interested person upon payment of the fee, as required by ordinance. One copy of the transcript shall be furnished to the Commission to be filed.

         3. If the Planning Commission recommends disapproval, that action is final unless the applicant timely files an appeal pursuant to Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section.
      3. ###### Time to Act


         1. The Planning Commission shall act within 75 days of the filing of a complete, verified [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a proposed Zone Change, except as otherwise provided in this Subsection. This time limit may be extended by mutual consent of the applicant and the Planning Commission.

         2. The Planning Commission may withhold action on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) relating to land located within an area in which the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is conducting a general survey or study, for a period of up to 180 days from the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was filed. The Planning Commission shall provide written notice of this decision to the applicant, advising of the study and the postponement.

         3. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is inconsistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Planning Commission may withhold action on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a period of up to 180 days with the applicant’s consent. This time limit may be extended for two additional 3-month periods by mutual consent of the applicant and the Planning Commission.

         4. If the Planning Commission fails to act on an initiation within the time allowed by this Subdivision, the Planning Commission shall be deemed to have approved the ordinance.
4. ###### City Council Action (On Both City and Applicant initiated Zone Changes)


      1. After the Planning Commission has made its report and recommendation, or after the time for it to act has expired, the Council may consider the matter.

      2. If the Planning Commission recommends approval of the proposed Zone Change, the Council shall act within 90 days of receipt of the Planning Commission recommendation. This time limit may be extended by mutual consent of the applicant and the Council.

      3. The Council may approve or disapprove the proposed Zone Change.

      4. As part of any proposed Zone Change, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may:

         1. Impose a Special Zoning Classification pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.32 G. (Special Zoning Classifications)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-117590) if the parcel is zoned with a Chapter I. zone per [Sec. 12.04. (Zones-Districts-Symbols)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-108871), or

         2. Approve changes to the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirements not to exceed 20 percent of the requirements otherwise required by this Code.
      5. ###### Required Vote


         The votes necessary for adoption of a proposed Zone Change are as follows:




         | Recommendation | Required Council Vote |
         | --- | --- |
         | The CPC recommends approval | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
         | The CPC recommends disapproval (on a Zone Change initiated by the City Council) | 2/3 Vote |
         | The CPC recommends disapproval (on a Zone Change initiated by an applicant, and an appeal was filed) | 2/3 Vote |
         | Failure of the CPC to act | [Majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
5. ###### Area Affected by Zone Change


      1. In the consideration of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a proposed Zone Change, the Planning Commission may approve or disapprove a change upon all or only a part of the subject area.

      2. The Planning Commission may recommend, without additional notice or hearing:

         1. A change to any zone between that existing on the property and that requested in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         2. That all or a portion of the property be changed to a P or PB Zone;

         3. That an M Zone be changed to an MR Zone; or

         4. Minor additions to the area proposed for a Zone Change or slight adjustments of proposed zone boundaries within that area that it determines are required by the public necessity, convenience, general welfare, or good zoning practice.
6. ###### Changes incident to Division of Land


      1. In the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of an area, it may be determined by the Planning Commission that the zones or height districts, as shown on the zoning map, do not conform to the best [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and use of the land. In such cases, the following shall apply:

         1. For lots subject to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may, upon the recommendation of the Planning Commission, approve within the boundaries of the area being subdivided the appropriate adjustment of zone or height district boundaries or the reclassification of the area into a more restrictive zone or height district where the zone or height district is consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to make changes without the Planning Commission holding a public hearing on the adjustment.

         2. For lots subject to Chapter 1A (City of Los Angeles Zoning Code), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may, upon the recommendation of the Planning Commission, approve within the boundaries of the area being subdivided the appropriate adjustment of zone boundaries or the reclassification of the area into a zone, consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), with 1) a Form District that reduced allowable [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), based on its maximum bonus floor area ratio or the maximum base floor area ratio if the Form District does not establish a bonus floor area ratio, or 2) a Density District which results in a reduced number of [household dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to make changes without the Planning Commission holding a public hearing on the adjustment.
      2. The Planning Commission shall make no recommendation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except upon written [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) made by the owner of the land being subdivided.

      3. Notice of a public hearing on any Zone Change incident to division of land to a less restrictive zone for lots subject to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), or to a Form District or Density District that allow additional [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or density, respectively, for lots subject to Chapter 1A (Los Angeles Zoning Code) per [Sec. 13B.1.4.D.6.a. (Changes incident to Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) above shall be included in the notice for the division. The notice shall conform to the procedures for Zone Change notification, and the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and Zone Change hearings shall be held concurrently. Appeal procedures shall conform to those required for Zone Changes as set forth in this Section.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a Zone Change, the Planning Commission and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that:

      1. The action substantially conforms to the purposes, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      2. The proposed ordinance is in conformity with public necessity, convenience, general welfare, and good zoning practice.
2. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not adopt the Commission’s findings and recommendations, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make its own findings.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. An applicant-initiated Zone Change that is not effectuated within six years of its effective date becomes null and void.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      1. See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

      2. Only applicant-initiated zone changes are appealable.
2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. If the Planning Commission recommends disapproval of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), in whole or in part, the applicant may appeal that decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If the Planning Commission recommends disapproval of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to establish a supplemental use district, in whole or in part, any owner or lessee of property included in a proposed district may appeal that decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. At any time prior to the action of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the appeal, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit any supplemental, pertinent information as the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or its Committee may request.
4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above, of this Section.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period. The 75-day time limit to act on an appeal may be extended by mutual written consent of the applicant and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to act within this time limit, the failure shall constitute a denial of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or disapproval of the initiated land use ordinance.
8. ##### Modification of the Zone Change


1. A Zone Change may be modified by following the same procedures established above for the original action.

2. ###### Special Zoning Classifications


      A request for an amendment of any Special Zoning Classification may be filed and processed pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.32.H. (Amendments of the T Classification and Clarifications of the Q Classification or D Limitation)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-117590) where applicable.
9. ##### Vesting Zone Change


1. ###### Applicability


      An applicant may elect to file an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Vesting Zone Change. If an applicant does not seek the rights conferred by this Subsection, the filing of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be required by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the approval of any proposed Zone Change.

2. ###### Development Rights


      1. The approval of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) confers a vested right to proceed with a development in substantial compliance with the rules, regulations, ordinances, zones, and officially adopted policies of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in force on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete, and with the conditions of approval imposed and specifically enumerated by the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in its action on the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case.

      2. These rights do not include exemption from:

         1. Other [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or approvals necessary to entitle a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to proceed (i.e., [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), zone [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), design review, etc.);

         2. Subsequent changes in the Building and Safety and Fire regulations contained in Chapters [V. (Public Safety and Protection)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-135598) and [IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code that the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds to protect the public health and safety and which apply on a citywide basis, or policies and standards relating to those regulations; or

         3. Citywide programs enacted after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete to implement State or Federal mandates.
      3. If the ordinances, policies, or standards described in Paragraph b. (Development Rights). above are changed subsequent to the approval or conditional approval of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicant, at any time prior to the expiration of the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case, may apply for an amendment to the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case to secure a vested right to proceed with the changed ordinances, policies, or standards. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall clearly specify the changed ordinances, policies, or standards for which the amendment is sought.

      4. Prior to final sign off on a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) filed pursuant to a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit a copy of the final site plan to the office of the affected council district for informational purposes only.
3. ###### Filing and Processing an Application


      1. A Vesting Zone Change shall be filed on the same form and have the same contents, accompanying data and reports and shall be processed in the same manner as procedures for [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for a Zone Change, except as provided here. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall specify that the case is for a Vesting Zone Change. If any rules, regulations, or ordinances in force at the time of filing require any additional approvals (such as a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Coastal Development Permit), the complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for these additional approvals shall be filed prior to or simultaneously with the Vesting Zone Change in order for the City Planning Department to be able to schedule a concurrent hearing.

      2. In all Vesting Zone Change cases, a site plan and a rendering of the architectural plan of the building envelope shall be submitted. The plans and renderings shall show the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s height, design, size and square footage, number of units, the use and location of buildings, driveways, internal vehicular circulation patterns, loading areas and docks, location of landscaped areas, walls and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, pedestrian and vehicular entrances, location of [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and any other information deemed necessary by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Conditional Approval or Denial


      Notwithstanding the provisions of Subparagraph a. of Paragraph 2. (Development Rights) above, of this Section, a Vesting Zone Change may be:

      1. Conditioned if the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that:

         1. The condition is necessary to protect the best interest of and assure a development more compatible with the surrounding property or neighborhood;

         2. The condition is necessary to secure an appropriate development in harmony with the objectives of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         3. The condition is necessary to prevent or mitigate potential adverse environmental effects of the Zone Change; or

         4. That public necessity, convenience, or general welfare require that provisions be made for the orderly arrangement of the property concerned into lots and/or that provisions be made for adequate streets, drainage facilities, grading, sewers, utilities, and other public dedications and improvements.
      2. Denied if the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines the Zone Change is not in substantial conformance with the purposes, intent, or provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or is not in conformance with public necessity, convenience, general welfare, and good zoning practice.

      3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not adopt the Planning Commission’s findings and recommendations, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make its own findings.
5. ###### Expiration


      1. The approval or conditional approval of a Vesting Zone Change expires six years after the effective date of the ordinance.

      2. Where a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to be developed under a Vesting Zone Change contains multiple phases, the vested zoning terminates if less than 25 percent the total [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) allowed by the Vesting Zone Change and as described in the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has not received a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) before the end of the period of time specified.
6. ###### Amendment of Vested Project Plans or Amendment of Vested City Regulations to Comply with Subsequent Regulation Changes


      1. Any owner or lessee of the subject property subject to an approved Vesting Zone Change may file a verified [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requesting an amendment of the City regulations described in Subparagraph a. of Paragraph 2. (Development Rights) above, of this Section vested by a Zone Change issued pursuant to this Section.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), after receiving a report and recommendation on the amendment from the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 40 days of the date of the request or within any additional time mutually agreed upon by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the applicant, may amend the vested building or site plans or add to the set of City regulations to which the applicant’s [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has vested. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to submit a timely report, [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may consider the amendment without the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s recommendation.

      3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), prior to making a decision pursuant to this Subdivision, shall hold a public hearing, giving notice pursuant to Subsection C. (Notice) above, of this Section.

#### Sec. 13B.1.5. Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.5.1.png.webp?itok=9MITYDxR)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.1.5.1.png?itok=99uNhegs)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section only applies where any provision of this Code specifically authorizes or requires a policy action the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to adopt or amend certain guidelines or standards.

2. ##### Initiation


The enactment of an ordinance authorizing the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to adopt or amend guidelines or standards initiates this process.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      Prior to any action on the Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall conduct a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above, of this Section.

4. ###### Recommending Body


      If a recommendation by another body is required, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may consider the matter after receipt of the recommendation.

5. ###### City Planning Commission Action


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve or disapprove the proposed Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that the action substantially conforms to the purposes, intent, and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any other applicable adopted plans.

6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment


A Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment may be modified by following the same procedures established above for the original action. However, any subsequent amendment to guidelines or standards already adopted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section may be presented to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for approval by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).


#### Sec. 13B.1.6. Land for Public Use

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to any ordinance, order, or resolution ordering or involving the acquisition, establishing, opening, widening, narrowing, straightening, abandoning, or vacating of any public street, road, highway, alley, square, park, playground, airport, public building site or any other [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), ground or open space, or the location, appearance, and width of any bridge, viaduct, subway, tunnel, or elevated [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the use of pedestrians or vehicular traffic, or the location and appearance of any public building.

2. ##### Initiation


A petition may be received by the City Clerk and presented to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or a resolution may be introduced in the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the purpose of adoption of an ordinance, order, or resolution involving land for public use.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for a consideration of Land for Public Use, and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Referral


      1. A petition or resolution regarding land for public use shall be referred to such City Department or Bureau as is determined by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to have jurisdiction over the matter involved in such petition or proposed ordinance, order or resolution, for report and recommendation thereon to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or to a Committee of the Council designated by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), before the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall grant such petition or adopt or enact any such ordinance, order or resolution.

      2. The said Department or Bureau to which any such petition or resolution is referred by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall, before reporting to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon the particular subject matter, refer the matter to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for report and recommendation thereon by the Commission concerning the relation of the matter to and its effect upon the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and any plans being [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. However, [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for local sanitary sewers, storm drains or slopes need not be referred to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. Such Bureau or Department shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) its report to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the subject matter of the petition or resolution or accompanying ordinance or order, together with an original copy of said report of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) relating thereto.
3. ###### Report and Recommendation


      1. Before any ordinance, order, or resolution relating to any of the matters referred to in Subsection A. (Applicability) above, of this Section, except [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for local sanitary sewers, storm drains or slopes is presented to the Council by the City Attorney for consideration, said ordinance, order or resolution shall be first submitted by the City Attorney to the City Planning Department for report and recommendation thereon by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Such ordinance, order, or resolution shall be returned by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the City Attorney for transmittal to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or its Committee, together with the report and recommendation relating thereto.
4. ###### City Planning Commission Action


      1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make and file its report and recommendations on any petition, ordinance, order, or resolution within 30 days of receipt of same.

      2. If the same be disapproved, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall advise the Bureau or [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) submitting the matter of its disapproval and reasons therefor within such 30-day period.
5. ###### Council Action


      1. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends against the approval of an ordinance, order or resolution, the Council may adopt the same only upon a 2/3 vote of the whole Council.

      2. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recommends approval, or fails to make any recommendation within the specified time limit, the Council may adopt such ordinance, order, or resolution by a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote of the whole Council.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In acting upon a consideration of Land for Public Use, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that the action substantially conforms to the purposes, intent, and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any other applicable adopted plans, or state the reasons that no such finding can be made.

2. If the Council does not adopt the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s findings and recommendations, the Council shall make its own findings.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of the Action


An ordinance, order, or resolution regarding land for public use may be amended by following the same procedures established above for the original action.


### Div. 13B.2. Quasi-Judicial Review

#### Sec. 13B.2.1. Class 1 Conditional Use Permit

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.1.1.png.webp?itok=_9JI88_v)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.1.1.png?itok=OUrhdC9N)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies where any provision of this Code requires a Class 1 Conditional Use Permit.

2. This Section also applies to conditional uses and deviations designated in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.24 X. (Further Authority of the Zoning Administrator for Other Similar Quasi-Judicial Approvals)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396).

3. ###### Existing Uses


      Any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which is being lawfully used for any of the purposes enumerated in this Code at the time the property is first classified in a zone in which the use is permitted only by conditional use or at the time the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in that zone first becomes subject to the requirements of this Section, shall be deemed to be approved for the conditional use and may be continued on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Further, the conditions included in any [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), exception or [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which authorized the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also continue in effect.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Class 1 Conditional Use Permit is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision, if held:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•Owners and occupants of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
      | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property<br>•If a Hearing officer is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the decision making body on the matter |

2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•Owners and occupants of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
      | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit).

      2. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may conduct the hearing or designate a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to conduct the hearing.
4. ###### Decision


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      2. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
5. ###### Conditions of Approval and inspections


      1. In approving a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions related to the interests addressed in the findings set forth in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit).

      2. The decision may state that the height and area regulations required by other provisions of this Chapter and Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) of this Code shall not apply to the conditional use approved.

      3. The Department shall have the authority to conduct inspections to verify compliance with any and all conditions imposed on any conditional use or other similar Quasi-judicial approval granted pursuant to this Section (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit). Clearance, monitoring, and inspection fees shall be paid by the business operator or property owner to the Department in accordance with the fee schedule in Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9. (Fees) of this Code, or in [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), as applicable.

      4. If, upon inspection, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the applicant has failed to comply with conditions of any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted pursuant to this Section (Class 1 Conditional Use Permit), the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall give notice to the business operator or property owner to correct the specific deficiencies and the time in which to complete the correction. Evidence of compliance shall be submitted to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the specified correction period. If the deficiencies are not corrected within the time prescribed by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), revocation proceedings pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.1. (Evaluation of Non-Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.1) or [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2) may commence.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a Class 1 Conditional Use Permit, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will enhance the built environment in the surrounding neighborhood or will perform a function or provide a service that is essential or beneficial to the community, city, or region;

      2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s location, size, height, operations and other significant features will be compatible with and will not adversely affect or further degrade adjacent properties, the surrounding neighborhood, or the public health, welfare, and safety; and

      3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the purpose, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicable community plan, and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also make any additional findings required by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), and shall determine that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) satisfies all applicable requirements in these Chapters.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate body in the case of a transfer of jurisdiction, and its decision shall be subject to [Charter Section 563(b)(2)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2586).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.

      3. When a conditional use decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is appealed to an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellate decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be final and effective as provided in [Sec. 245 (City Council Veto of Board Actions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-663).
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. ###### Development of Site


      1. On any lot or portion of a lot on which an approved or deemed-approved conditional use is permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Section, new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may be erected, enlargements may be made to [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and [existing uses](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be extended on an approved site, provided that plans are submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and, where applicable, the use is consistent with the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 C (Existing Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to [Chapter I.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), or, for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, consistent with the provisions of [Sec. 12.5.1.E. (Use Not allowed Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5.1) or [Sec. 12.5.1.F. (Use Not allowed Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5.1).

      2. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may deny the plans if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not conform to the purpose and intent of the findings required for a conditional [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under this Section, and may specify the conditions under which the plans may be approved.

      3. An applicant submitting development plans or any other person aggrieved by the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) made relative to the approval or disapproval of a development plan may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section.

      4. ###### Exceptions


         For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to [Chapter I.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), plan approval shall not be required in the instances listed as exceptions in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 D. (Development of Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396).
2. ###### Reduction of Site


      So long as the conditional use is continued, the entire approved site shall be retained for the conditional use. No portion shall be severed from the site or utilized for other purposes unless the plans for the reduced site are first submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The initial decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a proposed reduction of the area of an approved site shall be subject to the same appeal procedures as is provided for an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to establish the conditional use.

3. ###### Findings and Conditions of Approval


      In approving any conditional use plans, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must find that the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conforms to the purpose and intent of the findings required for a conditional use under this Section and may impose conditions on the same basis as provided for in this Section for the establishment of new conditional uses. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall adopt written findings of fact supporting the decision based upon evidence in the record, including any investigations.

4. ###### Change of Use


      No conditional use may be changed to a different type of conditional use unless the new use is authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a conditional use.

5. ###### Discontinuance of Use


      If a conditional use is abandoned, or is discontinued for a continuous period of one year, it may not be re-established unless authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a conditional use.

#### Sec. 13B.2.2. Class 2 Conditional Use Permit

1. ##### Applicability

    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.2.1.png.webp?itok=Tj-02bdn)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.2.1.png?itok=3iWCPQMD)
1. This Section applies where any provision of this Code requires a Class 2 Conditional Use Permit.

2. This Section also applies to the conditional uses designated in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 W. (Authority of the Zoning Administrator for Conditional Uses/Initial Decision)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396).

3. ###### Existing Uses


      Any lot or portion of a lot which is being lawfully used for any of the purposes enumerated in this Code at the time the property is first classified in a zone in which the use is permitted only by conditional use or at the time the use in that zone first becomes subject to the requirements of this Section, shall be deemed to be approved for the conditional use and may be continued on the lot. Further, the conditions included in any [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), exception or [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which authorized the use shall also continue in effect.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Class 2 Conditional Use Permit is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
