         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property<br>•If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the decision making body on the matter |

      2. Where all property within the 300 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership, or is separated from it only by a street, alley, public right-of way or other [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will also be notified.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are encompassed within the expanded area.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |

      2. Where all property within the 300 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership, or is separated from it only by a street, alley, public right-of way or other [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will also be notified.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are encompassed within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit).

      2. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may conduct the hearing or designate a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to conduct the hearing.
4. ###### Decision


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      2. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
5. ###### Conditions of Approval and Inspections


      1. In approving a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions related to the interests addressed in the findings set forth in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section (Class 2 Conditional Use Permit).

      2. The decision may state that the height and area regulations required by other provisions of this Chapter and Chapter 1 (General Provisions and Zoning) shall not apply to the conditional use approved.

      3. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to conduct inspections to verify compliance with any and all conditions imposed on any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted pursuant to this Section. Clearance, monitoring and inspection fees shall be paid by the business operator or property owner to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in accordance with the fee schedule in Article 9 (Fees) of Chapter 1 (General Provisions and Zoning), or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), as applicable.

      4. If, upon inspection, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the applicant has failed to comply with conditions of any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted pursuant to this Section, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall give notice to the business operator or property owner to correct the specific deficiencies and the time in which to complete the correction. Evidence of compliance shall be submitted to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the specified correction period. If the deficiencies are not corrected within the time prescribed by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), revocation proceedings pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.1. (Evaluation of Non-Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.1) or [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2) may commence.
6. ###### Transmittal


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the written findings and decision to the applicant, to all owners of properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with, the subject property and all persons who filed a written request for the notice with the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a Class 2 Conditional Use Permit, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will enhance the built environment in the surrounding neighborhood or will perform a function or provide a service that is essential or beneficial to the community, city, or region;

      2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s location, size, height, operations and other significant features will be compatible with and will not adversely affect or further degrade adjacent properties, the surrounding neighborhood, or the public health, welfare, and safety; and

      3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the purpose, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicable community plan, and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also make any additional findings required by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), and shall determine that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) satisfies all applicable requirements in these Chapters.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. As part of any conditional use approval, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the appellate body may approve changes to the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirements not to exceed 20 percent of the requirements otherwise required by this Chapter or Chapter I.(General Provisions and Zoning).
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate body in the case of a transfer of jurisdiction, and its decision shall be subject to [Charter Section 563(b)(2)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2586).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.

      3. When a conditional use decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is appealed to an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellate decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be final and effective as provided in [Sec. 245 (City Council Veto of Board Actions) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-663).
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. ###### Development of Site


      1. On any lot or portion of a lot on which an approved or deemed-approved conditional use is permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Section, new buildings or structures may be erected, enlargements may be made to [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and [existing uses](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be extended on an approved site, provided that plans are submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and, where applicable, the use is consistent with the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 C (Existing Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396) for lots subject to Chapter 1, or [Sec. 12.5.1.E. (Use Not allowed Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5.1) or [Sec. 12.5.1.F. (Use Not allowed Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5.1) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for lots subject to this Chapter.

      2. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may deny the plans if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the use does not conform to the purpose and intent of the findings required for a conditional use under this Section, and may specify the conditions under which the plans may be approved.

      3. An applicant submitting development plans or any other person aggrieved by the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) made relative to the approval or disapproval of a development plan may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section.

      4. ###### Exceptions


         A plan approval shall not be required in the instances listed as exceptions in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.24 D. (Development of Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396) for lots subject to Chapter 1.
2. ###### Reduction of Site


      So long as the conditional use is continued, the entire approved site shall be retained for the conditional use. No portion shall be severed from the site or utilized for other purposes unless the plans for the reduced site are first submitted to and approved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The initial decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a proposed reduction of the area of an approved site shall be subject to the same appeal procedures as is provided for an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to establish the conditional use.

3. ###### Findings and Conditions of Approval


      In approving any conditional use plans, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must find that the use conforms to the purpose and intent of the findings required for a conditional use under this Section and may impose conditions on the same basis as provided for in this Section for the establishment of new conditional uses. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall adopt written findings of fact supporting the decision based upon evidence in the record, including any investigations.

4. ###### Change of Use


      No conditional use may be changed to a different type of conditional use unless the new use is authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a conditional use.

5. ###### Discontinuance of Use


      If a conditional use is abandoned, or is discontinued for a continuous period of one year, it may not be re-established unless authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a conditional use.
9. ##### Vesting Conditional Use Permit


1. ###### Applicability


      1. Whenever a provision of this Code requires the filing of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Conditional Use Permit, a Vesting Conditional Use Permit may be filed instead, in accordance with and subject to the limitations of these provisions. If an applicant does not seek the rights conferred by this Subsection, the filing of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be required by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the approval of any proposed Zone Change, Conditional Use Permit, permit for construction or work preparatory to construction.

      2. Vesting Conditional Use Permits may only be filed for the conditional uses listed in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 T. (Vesting Conditional Use Applications)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396) of this Code.
2. ###### Filing an Application


      1. A Vesting Conditional Use Permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be filed on the same form and have the same contents, accompanying data, and reports and shall be processed in the same manner as set forth in this Section for a conditional use permit except as provided below. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall specify that the case is for a Vesting Conditional Use Permit. If any rules, regulations, or ordinances in force at the time of filing require any additional approvals, the complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for these additional approvals shall be filed prior to or simultaneously with the Vesting Conditional Use Permit to be processed pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10).

      2. In all Vesting Conditional Use Permit cases, a site plan and a rendering of the architectural plan of the building envelope shall be submitted with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The plans and renderings shall show the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s height, design, size and square footage, number of units, the location of buildings, driveways, internal vehicular circulation patterns, loading areas and docks, location of landscaped areas, walls and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, pedestrian and vehicular entrances, location of public rights-of-way and any other information deemed necessary by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ###### Transmittal


      Prior to final approval or sign off on a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) filed pursuant to a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Planning Department shall submit a copy of the final site plan to the office of the affected council district for informational purposes only.

4. ###### Development Rights


      1. The approval of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) confers a vested right to proceed with a development in substantial compliance with the rules, regulations, ordinances, zones, and officially adopted policies of the City in force on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete, and with the conditions of approval imposed and specifically enumerated in the final decision on the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case.

      2. These rights do not include exemption from:

         1. Other [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or approvals necessary to entitle a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to proceed (i.e., [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), zone [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), design review, etc.);

         2. Subsequent changes in the Building and Safety and Fire regulations contained in Chapters [V. (Public Safety and Protection)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-135598) and [IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code that apply on a citywide basis, and that the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds are necessary to protect the public health and safety; or

         3. Policies and standards relating to those regulations or from citywide programs to implement State or Federal mandates.
      3. If the ordinances, policies, or standards described in the preceding Paragraphs are changed subsequent to the approval or conditional approval of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case, the applicant, or his or her successor or assignee, at any time prior to the expiration of the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case, may apply, pursuant to Subdivision 5. (Amendment of Vested Project Plans or Amendment of Vested City Regulations to Comply With Subsequent Regulation Changes) below, for an amendment to the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case to secure a vested right to proceed with the changed ordinances, policies, or standards. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall clearly specify the changed ordinances, policies, or standards for which the amendment is sought.

      4. A Vesting Conditional Use Permit may be conditioned or denied if the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines:

         1. That the condition is necessary in order to make all of the findings in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section; or

         2. That one or more of the findings in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) above, of this Section; cannot be made.
5. ###### Amendment of Vested Project Plans or Amendment of Vested City Regulations to Comply With Subsequent Regulation Changes


      1. One or more of the owners or lessees of the subject property may file a verified [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requesting an amendment of the City regulations as described in Subdivision 4. (Development Rights) above vested by a Conditional Use Permit issued pursuant to this Subsection.

      2. The Area Planning Commission, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on Conditional Use Permit appeals may approve any changes to the set of City regulations to which the applicant’s [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has vested for a Conditional Use Permit issued pursuant to this Subsection. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report shall be made within 40 calendar days of the date of the request or within any additional time as may be mutually agreed upon by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the applicant.

      3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the office of Zoning Administration, prior to making a decision pursuant to this Subdivision, shall hold a public hearing. Notice shall be given in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

#### Sec. 13B.2.3. Class 3 Conditional Use Permit

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.3.1.png.webp?itok=LxaNhyZy)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.3.1.png?itok=vEg86EsV)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies where any provision of this Code requires a Class 3 Conditional Permit.

2. This Section also applies to conditional uses designated in [Sec. 12.24 U. (Conditional Use Permits - City Planning Commission With Appeals to City Council) of Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396).

3. ###### Existing Uses


      Any lot or portion of a lot which is being lawfully used for any of the purposes enumerated in this Code at the time the property is first classified in a zone in which the use is permitted only by conditional use or at the time the use in that zone first becomes subject to the requirements of this Section, shall be deemed to be approved for the conditional use and may be continued on the lot. Further, the conditions included in any [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), exception or [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which authorized the use shall also continue in effect.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property<br>•If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the decision making body on the matter |

      2. Where all property within the 300 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership, or is separated from it only by a street, alley, public right-of way or other [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will also be notified.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are encompassed within the expanded area.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |

      2. Where all property within the 300 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership, or is separated from it only by a street, alley, public right-of way or other [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will also be notified.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s other than the subject property, the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are encompassed within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit).

      2. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may conduct the hearing itself or designate the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to conduct the hearing.
4. ###### Decision


      1. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conducts the public hearing, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) its findings and recommendation to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. After the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s hearing is closed, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision at a public meeting.

      3. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      4. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
5. ###### Conditions of Approval and inspections


      1. In approving a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions related to the interests addressed in the findings set forth in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit).

      2. The decision may state that the height and area regulations required by other provisions of this Chapter and Chapter 1 (General Provisions and Zoning) of this Code shall not apply to the conditional use approved. If the [Density Bonus](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is increased beyond the maximum allowed as defined in Sec. 12.22.A.37 (State Density Bonus) of Chapter 1 (General Provisions and Zoning), and [Sec. 9.2.1. (State Density Bonus Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), as applicable, the [development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must also comply with the requisite number of [restricted affordable unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and requirements as set forth in Sec. 12.24 U.26. (a)(1) - (5) (Density Bonus for a Housing Development in Which the Density increase is Greater than the Maximum Permitted in Sec. 12.22 A.37) of Chapter 1 (General Provisions and Zoning), and [Sec. 9.2.1.C. (Program Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2.1) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), as applicable.

      3. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to conduct inspections to verify compliance with any and all conditions imposed on any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted pursuant to this Section. Clearance, monitoring, and inspection fees shall be paid by the business operator or property owner to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in accordance with the fee schedule in Article 9 (Fees) of Chapter 1 (General Provisions and Zoning) or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), as applicable.

      4. If, upon inspection, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the applicant has failed to comply with conditions of any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted pursuant to this Section, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall give notice to the business operator or property owner to correct the specific deficiencies and the time in which to complete the correction. Evidence of compliance shall be submitted to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the specified correction period. If the deficiencies are not corrected within the time prescribed by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), revocation proceedings pursuant to [Sec. 13B.6.1. (Evaluation of Non-Compliance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.1) or [Sec. 13B.6.2. (Nuisance Abatement/Revocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.6.2) may commence.
6. ###### Transmittal


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the written findings and decision to the applicant, to all owners of properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property and all persons who filed a written request for the notice.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

      1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will enhance the built environment in the surrounding neighborhood or will perform a function or provide a service that is essential or beneficial to the community, city, or region;

      2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s location, size, height, operations and other significant features will be compatible with and will not adversely affect or further degrade adjacent properties, the surrounding neighborhood, or the public health, welfare, and safety;

      3. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the purpose, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicable community plan, and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);
2. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also make any additional findings required by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), and shall determine that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) satisfies all applicable requirements in these Chapters.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. As part of any conditional use approval, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the appellate body may approve changes to the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirements not to exceed 20 percent of the requirements otherwise required by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408).
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above, of this Section.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear the matter within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period. Time can be extended by mutual agreement with the applicant. If there is no extension by mutual agreement, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing at the next regular meeting of the Council, giving the same notice as provided for the original hearing.

      3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will render its decision by resolution. A decision to reverse or modify the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision, in whole or in part, shall only be adopted by at least a two-thirds (2/3) vote of the whole [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. When a conditional use decision is appealed to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Council either approves the conditional use or denies an appeal from an earlier approval, the matter together with the files and reports shall forthwith be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      5. The [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve or disapprove the conditional use within 10 days of its presentation to him or her. This action shall be based solely upon the administrative record and whether the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) believes the conditional use conforms to the requirements for approval set forth in this Section. If the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) disapproves the conditional use, he or she shall return the matter to the City Clerk for presentation to the Council, together with the objections in writing.

      6. The Council within 60 days after the matter has been returned to it may override the disapproval:

         1. By a 2/3 vote if the Council had not modified the conditional use as approved by the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or if the Council had made the initial approval of the conditional use by reason of the failure of the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to act; or

         2. By a 3/4 vote if the Council had modified and approved the conditional use or reversed the action of the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and had approved the conditional use.
      7. If the Council fails to override the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s disapproval within the 60 days, the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s disapproval shall constitute a denial of the conditional use. If the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to return the matter to the City Clerk within 10 days of its presentation to him or her, the approval of the conditional use shall become final.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. ###### Development of Site


      1. On any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on which an approved or deemed-approved conditional use is permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Section, new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may be erected, enlargements may be made to [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and [existing uses](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be extended on an approved site, provided that plans are submitted to and approved by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and, where applicable, the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is consistent with the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 C (Existing Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I, or, for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, consistent with the provisions of [Sec. 12.5.1.E. (Use Not allowed Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5.1) or [Sec. 12.5.1.F. (Use Not allowed Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12#12.5.1) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A)..

      2. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may deny the plans if the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the use does not conform to the purpose and intent of the findings required for a conditional use under this Section, and may specify the conditions under which the plans may be approved.

      3. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may delegate to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the authority to approve or disapprove, on their behalf, plans for the development of an approved or deemed-approved conditional use site. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall establish reasonable guidelines and policies to be followed in the exercise of the delegated authority.

      4. An applicant submitting development plans or any other person aggrieved by the decision of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) made relative to the approval or disapproval of a development plan may appeal the decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section.

      5. ###### Exceptions


         For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to [Chapter I.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), plan approval shall not be required in the instances listed as exceptions in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 D. (Development of Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396).
2. ###### Reduction of Site


      So long as the conditional use is continued, the entire approved site shall be retained for the conditional use. No portion shall be severed from the site or utilized for other purposes unless the plans for the reduced site are first submitted to and approved by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The initial decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a proposed reduction of the area of an approved site shall be subject to the same appeal procedures as is provided for an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to establish the conditional use.

3. ###### Findings and Conditions of Approval


      In approving any conditional use plans, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must find that the use conforms to the purpose and intent of the findings required for a conditional use under this Section and may impose conditions on the same basis as provided for in this Section for the establishment of new conditional uses. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall adopt written findings of fact supporting the decision based upon evidence in the record, including any investigations.

4. ###### Change of Use


      No conditional use may be changed to a different type of conditional use unless the new use is authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a conditional use.

5. ###### Discontinuance of Use


      If a conditional use is abandoned, or is discontinued for a continuous period of one year, it may not be re-established unless authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a conditional use.
9. ##### Vesting Conditional Use Permit


1. ###### Applicability


      1. Whenever a provision of this Code requires the filing of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Conditional Use Permit, a Vesting Conditional Use Permit may be filed instead, in accordance with and subject to the limitations of these provisions. If an applicant does not seek the rights conferred by this Subsection, the filing of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be required by the City for the approval of any proposed Zone Change, Conditional Use Permit, permit for construction or work preparatory to construction.

      2. Vesting Conditional Use Permits may only be filed for the conditional uses listed in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 T. (Vesting Conditional Use Applications)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-115396).
2. ###### Filing an Application


      1. A Vesting Conditional Use Permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be filed on the same form and have the same contents, accompanying data and reports and shall be processed in the same manner as set forth in this Section for a conditional use permit except as provided below. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall specify that the case is for a Vesting Conditional Use Permit. If any rules, regulations or ordinances in force at the time of filing require any additional approvals, the complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for these additional approvals shall be filed prior to or simultaneously with the Vesting Conditional Use Permit to be processed pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10).

      2. In all Vesting Conditional Use Permit cases, a site plan and a rendering of the architectural plan of the building envelope shall be submitted with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The plans and renderings shall show the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s height, design, size and square footage, number of units, the location of buildings, driveways, internal vehicular circulation patterns, loading areas and docks, location of landscaped areas, walls and [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, pedestrian and vehicular entrances, location of public rights-of-way and any other information deemed necessary by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ###### Transmittal


      Prior to final approval or sign off on a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) filed pursuant to a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Planning Department shall submit a copy of the final site plan to the office of the affected council district for informational purposes only.

4. ###### Development Rights


      1. The approval of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) confers a vested right to proceed with a development in substantial compliance with the rules, regulations, ordinances, zones, and officially adopted policies of the City in force on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete, and with the conditions of approval imposed and specifically enumerated in the final decision on the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case.

      2. These rights do not include exemption from:

         1. Other [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or approvals necessary to entitle a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to proceed (i.e., [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), zone [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), design review, etc.);

         2. Subsequent changes in the Building and Safety and Fire Regulations contained in Chapters [V. (Public Safety and Protection)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-135598) and [IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code that apply on a citywide basis, and that the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds are necessary to protect the public health and safety; or

         3. Policies and standards relating to those regulations or from citywide programs to implement State or Federal mandates.
      3. If the ordinances, policies, or standards described in the preceding Paragraphs are changed subsequent to the approval or conditional approval of a vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case, the applicant, or his or her successor or assignee, at any time prior to the expiration of the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case, may apply, pursuant to Subdivision 5 of this Subsection, for an amendment to the vesting [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) case to secure a vested right to proceed with the changed ordinances, policies, or standards. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall clearly specify the changed ordinances, policies, or standards for which the amendment is sought.

      4. A Vesting Conditional Use Permit may be conditioned or denied if the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines:

         1. That the condition is necessary in order to make all of the findings in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) above of this Section; or

         2. That one or more of the findings in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) above, of this Section; cannot be made.
5. ###### Amendment of Vested Project Plans or Amendment of Vested City Regulations to Comply With Subsequent Regulation Changes


      1. One or more of the owners or lessees of the subject property may file a verified [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requesting an amendment of the City regulations as described in Subdivision 4. (Development Rights) above vested by a Conditional Use Permit issued pursuant to this Subsection.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on Conditional Use Permit appeals may approve any changes to the set of City regulations to which the applicant’s [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has vested for a Conditional Use Permit issued pursuant to this Subsection. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report shall be made within 40 calendar days of the date of the request or within any additional time as may be mutually agreed upon by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the applicant.

      3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the office of Zoning Administration, prior to making a decision pursuant to this Subdivision, shall hold a public hearing. Notice shall be given in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above, of this Section.

#### Sec. 13B.2.4. Project Review

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.4.1.png.webp?itok=a-6h4MYs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.2.4.1.png?itok=Pp0dhppK)

Purpose. The Project Review process promotes orderly development, evaluates and mitigates significant environmental impacts, and promotes public safety and the general welfare by ensuring that development projects are properly related to their sites, surrounding properties, transportation network, sewers, other infrastructure and environmental settings; and controls or mitigates the development of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s which are likely to have a significant adverse effect on the environment as identified in the City’s environmental review process or on surrounding properties by reason of inadequate site planning or improvements.

1. ##### Applicability


1. The Project Review process applies where any provision of this Code requires a Project Review, including but not limited to those described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 16.05 C. (Project Review Requirements)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121483) for lots subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 4C.14. (Development Review Threshold)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for lots subject to this Chapter. Additionally, the exemptions listed in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 16.05 D. (Exemptions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121483), or the exemptions listed in [Sec. 4C.14.1.E. (Exceptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.14.1), shall also apply as appropriate.

2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall establish administrative methods, guidelines, procedures, and forms as may be necessary to conduct the review and render a decision expeditiously, prior to processing any Project Review [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### Application


      1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Project Review is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be filed in any public office of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), upon such forms and accompanied by applicable fees, a site plan drawn to scale, and other information prescribed by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for that purpose. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be verified by either the property owner, lessee, owner in escrow, or a legally authorized agent.
2. ###### Environmental Review


      1. As part of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Project Review, the applicant shall file necessary forms and information for environmental review as prescribed by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall cause the required environmental studies and notices for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to be [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d concurrent with the Project Review.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision, if held:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) and tenant(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and tenants of all property within 300 feet of the boundary of the subject site;<br>•City Councilmember(s) representing the area in which the property is located; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Any organization representing property owners or the community in the project vicinity if they request in writing to be notified |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) and tenant(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and tenants of all property within 300 feet of the boundary of the subject site;<br>•City Councilmember(s) representing the area in which the property is located; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Any organization representing property owners or the community in the project vicinity if they request in writing to be notified |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Referral


      1. If applicable, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall refer all completed [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for the Project Review to the appropriate City departments for their review and report.

      2. If applicable, responses shall be returned within 15 days after receipt, or another period agreed to by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the appropriate agency or department.
4. ###### Public Hearing


      If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the matter may have a significant effect on neighboring properties, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

5. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve, conditionally approve or deny the Project Review within 75 days after the date an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete, or where any necessary environmental review is approved or completed.

      2. This time limit may be extended up to 45 days by mutual consent of the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The time limit shall also be extended if necessary to [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and process an EIR.

      3. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a decision on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the time limit specified in this Subsection, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
6. ###### Conditions


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may condition and/or modify the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or select an alternative [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as necessary to:

         1. Implement the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

         2. Address potential effects of the development project on the environment and surrounding areas, including the mitigation of significant adverse impacts when identified.
      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not approve or conditionally approve a Project Review without appropriate environmental review [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d in accordance with the requirements of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
7. ###### Transmittal


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall send notice of the determination to the applicant and all other parties listed in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. Failure to receive notice does not invalidate any action taken pursuant to this Section.

      3. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall notify the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the final approval of the Project Review.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a Project Review, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

1. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the purposes, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), applicable community plan, and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

2. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) consists of an arrangement of buildings and structures (including height, bulk and setbacks), off-street [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) facilities, loading areas, lighting, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), trash collection, and other such pertinent improvements, that is or will be compatible with existing and future development on adjacent properties and neighboring properties; and

3. Any residential [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provides recreational and service amenities to improve habitability for its [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and minimize impacts on neighboring properties.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. ###### Enforcement


      1. No grading permit foundation permit, [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be issued for any development project approved under this Section unless the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) meets all requirements and conditions of the Project Review. Permits issued in error shall be treated as specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.02 (Inconsistent Permits and Licenses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107594).

      2. If the development project approval authorized by this Section is utilized, the conditions of that approval become effective immediately. The violation of any such condition shall constitute a violation of this Chapter and shall be subject to the same penalties as any other violation of this Code.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the area in which the property is located is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      The applicant, any officer, board, department, or bureau of the City, or any interested person aggrieved by the decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may file an appeal to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold the public hearing within 75 days of the filing of the appeal.

      3. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render its decision in writing within 15 days after the hearing is completed.

      4. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may sustain or reverse any decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and may establish additional conditions to conform to the findings required in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) above.

      5. The decision shall be in writing and based upon evidence in the record, including but not limited to testimony and documents produced at the hearing before the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and supported by any additional findings required by Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) above.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


See [Sec. 13B.5.4. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4).


#### Sec. 13B.2.5. Director Determination

      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the written findings and decision to the applicant, to all owners of properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with, the subject property, and to the local Certified Neighborhood Council.

### Div. 13B.3. Ministerial Action

#### Sec. 13B.3.1. Administrative Review

1. ##### Applicability


1. An Administrative Review is a ministerial approval for [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that comply with all applicable regulations and standards of this Code.

2. This Section applies where any provision of this Code requires an Administrative Review.
2. ##### Initiation


1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an Administrative Review is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. An Administrative Review is initiated as required in order to obtain a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for an Administrative Review, and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
4. ##### Review


1. ###### Review


      The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall determine compliance with the applicable regulations and standards for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s requiring an Administrative Review.

2. ###### Clearance


      Clearance shall be issued as required pursuant to the applicable ordinance or [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirement.
5. ##### Criteria for Compliance Review


The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for compliance with the applicable regulations and standards of this Code or the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including the zone standards, established development standards, and any supplemental use regulations.

6. ##### Scope of Action


After the Administrative Review determines that the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is in compliance with the applicable regulations and standards, the following actions must comply with the approved plans:

1. The erection, enlargement or maintenance of buildings;

2. Any development or construction work; or

3. Issuance of a grading, building, demolition, or change of use permit.
7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Action


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.3.2. Expanded Administrative Review

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.3.2.1.png.webp?itok=9-7Z1N2J)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.3.2.1.png?itok=PXBLgTX9)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section (Expanded Administrative Review) applies where any provision of this Code requires an Expanded Administrative Review.
2. ##### Initiation


1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an Expanded Administrative Review is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. An Expanded Administrative Review is initiated as required in order to obtain a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public informational hearing on the decision, if held.



      |     |     |     |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and tenants of all properties within 300 feet of the boundary of the subject site;<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified. |
      | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property. |
4. ##### Review


1. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall determine compliance with the applicable regulations and standards for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s requiring an Expanded Administrative Review.

2. ###### Clearance


      A clearance shall be issued as required pursuant to the applicable ordinance or [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirement.

3. ###### Public Hearing


      If the matter has a significant effect on neighboring properties, or if required where any provision of this Code requires an Expanded Administrative Review and a public hearing, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require an informational public hearing subject to giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice).
5. ##### Criteria for Compliance Review


The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for compliance with the applicable regulations and standards of this Code, any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including the zoning standards, established development standards, and any supplemental use regulations.

6. ##### Scope of Action


After the Expanded Administrative Review determines that the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with the applicable regulations and standards, the following actions must comply with the approved plans:

1. The erection, enlargement or maintenance of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

2. Any development or construction work; or

3. Issuance of a grading, building, demolition, or change of use permit.
7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification Procedures


1. ###### Modifications Equal to or Less than 10%


      1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approved pursuant to this Section (Expanded Administrative Review) may seek a modification to modify conditions of approval for the original action prior to the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. For purposes of this Section (Expanded Administrative Review), a “modification” means any changes in the proposed physical development or related conditions of approval that were approved in the original action by no more than 10 percent.

      3. A modification does not include the granting of any new rights or increased or additional incentives, nor does it include the granting of any new deviation from zoning regulations in this Chapter or Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) of this Code.

      4. An application for a modification pursuant to this Section (Expanded Administrative Review) shall be filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) before the original action expires and include development plans showing the requested modifications.

      5. In approving a modification pursuant to this Section (Expanded Administrative Review), the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the application for compliance with the applicable regulations and standards of this Code or any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Supplemental District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including the zoning standards, established development standards, and any supplemental use regulations
2. ###### Modifications Greater than 10%


      Any request for a modification that exceeds the ten percent limitation will not be processed as a modification of the original action under this Subsection (Modification Procedures) and shall instead require a filing of a new Expanded Administrative Review Application pursuant to this Section (Expanded Administrative Review).

### Div. 13B.4. Specific Plan Implementation

#### Sec. 13B.4.1. General Provisions

1. ##### Purpose


1. A [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is a regulatory land use ordinance specifically designated in the ordinance as a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). A [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide by ordinance regulatory controls or incentives for the systematic execution of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and shall provide for public needs, convenience and general welfare.

2. This Division:

      1. Establishes uniform citywide procedures to review [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) areas in accordance with applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirements and the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2); and

      2. Establishes uniform citywide standards and criteria for processing [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for exceptions from and interpretations of [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
2. ##### Relationship to Provisions of Specific Plans


1. If any procedure established in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conflicts with any procedure set forth in this Division, the provisions of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall prevail.

2. If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) establishes a ministerial process and specifically references the Administrative Review process described in [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) of this Chapter, the provisions of [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) apply.

3. If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) refers to a “Project Permit Compliance,” it shall mean [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) refers to a “Project Permit Adjustment,” it shall mean project adjustment.

5. If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) refers to a “ [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Exception,” it shall mean [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ##### Decision Makers and Appellate Bodies for Other Specific Plan Provisions


1. The individual Sections in this Division assign initial decision-making authority for a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation. For [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provisions that are not addressed in this Division, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and appellate bodies responsible for implementing those provisions are the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), respectively, unless otherwise stated in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. Despite any [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provision to the contrary and notwithstanding the language in [Sec. 13B.4.1.B. (Relationship to Provisions of Specific Plans)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.1) above, there is only one level of appeal from any initial decision.
4. ##### Public Information Meetings


1. When provided for in individual [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may hold public information meetings in connection with the Planning Department’s review of a proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Division or a Project Permit if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decides that:

      1. The proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may have a potentially significant effect on adjoining properties or on the immediate neighborhood;

      2. It is likely to evoke public controversy; or

      3. It would be in the public interest to conduct the meeting.
2. Written notice of a public information meeting shall be sent at least 24 days prior to the meeting date to: the applicant; owners and occupants of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; to the Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; the chair of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; the Certified Neighborhood Council having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; and interested parties who have requested notice in writing.
5. ##### Violations of Specific Plans


It shall be unlawful for any person to violate any provision of any [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and every violation shall be punishable as a misdemeanor.


#### Sec. 13B.4.2. Project Compliance

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.2.1.png.webp?itok=w5pvWwEX)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.2.1.png?itok=qcz4VQhE)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section (Project Compliance) applies to the review of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) areas in accordance with applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirements and the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may determine the type of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are exempt from this Section based on exemption provisions and other regulations contained in individual [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

3. ##### Notice

      2. However, a public information meeting may be held and notice given pursuant to [Sec. 13B.4.1.D. (General Provisions; Public Information Meetings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.1).
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
