         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property;<br>•The Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located;<br>•The Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; <br>•The chairperson of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete or when an environmental impact report (EIR) is required, the date preparation of the EIR is complete consistent with State law.

      2. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
4. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision to: the applicant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located, the Department of Transportation (where appropriate), owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; the chairperson of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; and interested parties who have filed written requests with the City Planning Department.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

1. Substantially complies with the applicable regulations, findings, standards, and provisions of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

2. Complies with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. ###### Limitations


      The granting of a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not imply compliance with any other applicable provisions of this Code. Any corrections and/or modifications to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) plans made subsequent to a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that are deemed necessary by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for Building Code compliance, and which involve a change in floor area, [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), building height, yards or setbacks, building separation or lot coverage, shall require a referral of the revised plans back to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (and the Department of Transportation in cases where there are corrections and/or modifications that may affect the ingress, egress, circulation, project floor area or [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)) for additional review and sign-off prior to the issuance of any permit in connection with those plans.

3. ###### Applicant’s Compliance With Project Compliance Terms and Conditions


      Once a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is utilized, the applicant shall comply with the terms and conditions of the [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that affect the construction and/or operational phases of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). For purposes of this Subsection, utilization of a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall mean that a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been issued and construction work has begun and been carried on diligently.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) aggrieved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may file an appeal.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


See [Sec. 13B.5.4. (Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4).


#### Sec. 13B.4.3. Project Compliance (Design Review Board)

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.3.1.png.webp?itok=5lU1fUn3)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.3.1.png?itok=GDEk4HdP)

Purpose and Objectives. The role of a design review board is to evaluate the placement of mass, form, spatial elements and overall quality of the design of proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s based on defined objectives established in [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. Design review boards should assist the City [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, the community, private developers, property owners, and design professionals in implementing the design goals of communities contained within [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) boundaries.

The objectives of this Section are:

•To establish uniform citywide procedures for design review within [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) areas;

•To establish uniform citywide authority for design review boards to advise the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and/or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on aspects of exterior design, site layout and landscape, signs, and other design elements governed by a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

•To promote the general welfare of the community;

•To protect the community from the adverse effects of poor design; and

•To encourage good professional design practices and quality exterior design and appearance to improve the community and surrounding area.

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      1. This Section applies when design review is required by a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The design review process may occur in two steps:

         1. An optional preliminary review; and

         2. Mandatory final review.
      3. An applicant may request a technical review by the Land Development Counseling Center (LDCC) or its equivalent, for clarification of requirements of this Code or applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ###### Building Permits


      The procedures established in this Section must be completed before a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is issued for any building or structure regulated by a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that requires design review.

3. ###### Relationship to Specific Plans


      1. This Section does not convey any rights not otherwise granted under a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except as specifically provided. If any procedure established in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) governing a design review board created by or authorized to act pursuant to the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) differs from any procedures set forth in this Section, the provisions of this Section shall prevail.

      2. Despite any provisions of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the contrary and notwithstanding the language in 13B.4.1.B. above, no design review required by a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be recommended for approval by a design review board or approved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) except as provided in this Section.
2. ##### Initiation


1. All [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Design Review Board) are submitted to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a form supplied by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Additional information and materials may be required for optional preliminary design review and mandatory final review, as described in Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 16.50 C. (Design Review Procedure) for lots subject to Chapter I.

2. Before the acceptance of the completed [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a mandatory final review, the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the proposal for compliance with the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or ordinances under which the design review board is established. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be deemed incomplete for failure of the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to meet the requirements of the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Note, however, if the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not comply with these requirements, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will be denied unless it is redesigned or appropriate relief is secured, or if it is conditioned for approval.

3. In addition, prior to submitting a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicant may request a technical review by the LDCC. If this review is requested, the LDCC may require further materials and plans to be submitted to facilitate that review.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 10 days | •The applicant; <br>•Owners and occupants of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 10 days | •The appellant;<br>•The design review board;<br>•Owners and occupants of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      1. Design review boards review [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and provide their recommendations to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If no design review board is appointed, the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) staff reviews the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and makes a recommendation to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ###### Optional Preliminary Design Review


      1. ###### Option


         1. An applicant may request a preliminary design review to consult with the design review board for advice on the design of a proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         2. The design review board shall review all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for which [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for preliminary design review are accepted. The board shall provide comments to the applicant concerning the overall design of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), materials and colors to be used, and [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for conformance to the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      2. ###### Transmittal of Applications for Preliminary Review


         1. ###### Agenda


            Optional preliminary [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are referred to the design review board for placement on its agenda within five calendar days after they are deemed complete.

         2. ###### Review and Recommendation of Design Review Board


            The design review board shall preliminarily review the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 21 calendar days after the request for the optional preliminary review has been referred to the board along with all of the required materials.

         3. ###### Transmittal to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13\#)


            Results of the optional preliminary review shall be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the board to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 10 days after the design review board meeting. This is for the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s information only.
4. ###### Design Review of Final Applications


      1. ###### Design Review Board Authority


         The design review board shall review all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for which [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for final design review have been accepted.

      2. ###### Transmittal of Applications for Final Review


         [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for final design review are referred to the design review board for its recommendation within five calendar days after they are deemed complete.

      3. ###### Final Review and Recommendation of the Design Review Board


         1. The design review board shall hold a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

         2. The design review board shall review and make its recommendation on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 21 calendar days after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is referred to the board.

         3. The design review board shall submit its recommendation to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within five calendar days after it acts on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or within any additional time as is mutually agreed upon in writing between the applicant and the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         4. The design review board’s recommendation shall include approval, disapproval, or approval with conditions to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The design review board shall make its recommendation based upon design criteria in the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If the recommendation is for denial, the board shall specify how the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to comply with the design criteria in the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Recommendations and summaries of discussions shall be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         5. The design review board’s recommendation does not affect any entitlement or discretionary approvals by applicable agencies and departments. This Subsection does not affect the Mulholland Scenic Parkway design review board’s authority to advise under Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11 (Design Review Process) of the Mulholland Scenic Parkway Specific Plan.

         6. If the design review board does not act and an extension of time is not agreed upon as specified above in order for the applicant to provide a revised [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with modifications for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the revised [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be submitted to the design review board for a second meeting to be held within 30 calendar days of the first meeting. If the design review board fails to act at that meeting, the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be referred to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as provided in Paragraph d. below.
      4. ###### Design Review Board Failure to Act


         If a design review board fails to act on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the time limits specified in this Section, the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is immediately referred without recommendation to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for determination.
5. ###### Action of the Director


      1. Within 10 calendar days following the receipt of the design review board’s recommendation or of the design review board’s failure to act, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as presented to the board if it is in compliance with the specific regulations of the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not comply with specific regulations in the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and cannot be made to be so by imposition of conditions, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall disapprove the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. For sign approvals, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant minor adjustments to permitted signs in accordance with the adjustment criteria and findings set forth in [Sec. 13B.4.4. (Project Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.4). Any requests for minor adjustments to permitted signs shall be filed in accordance with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) procedures set forth in Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 16.50 C. (Design Review Procedure).

      4. In addition, if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requests changes or additional information, copies of all materials submitted in connection with the request shall be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the design review board for its information.
6. ###### Transmittal


      A copy of all decisions shall be forwarded to the applicant, the design review board, the Councilmember(s) in whose district(s) the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area is located, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any interested parties who make a written request for notice.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In making a determination on a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Design Review Board), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall make findings consistent with the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) criteria for any approval or disapproval.

6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. A design review board’s advice on an optional preliminary [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is valid for 24 months.

3. No [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be issued until a copy of the plans for the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), stamped by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as approved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), is made available to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to be included with the field set of approved plans.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may file an appeal.

      2. A board member may not appeal any design review determination of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless they are the applicant.
4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. ( Notice) of this Section.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act on the appeal within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification of Approved Plans or Materials Before Issuance of Building Permit or Certificate of Occupancy


1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal may, prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), approve exterior changes to a proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from that which was approved in the design review board only if these changes were required by a public agency.

2. Unless otherwise specifically required in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), at the discretion of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, these modifications may be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the design review board for its review at the next available meeting provided that the appropriate materials were received 14 days prior to that meeting.

3. An applicant requesting approval of a proposed modification to a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall do so in writing. The request shall include an illustrated description of the proposed modification and a narrative justification. Written proof that a modification is required by a public agency shall be submitted with the request. Copies of all materials submitted in connection with the request shall be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the design review board for its information at the time the request is submitted to the Planning Department. There shall be no fee for a review of a modification required by a public agency. An applicant may also request a minor modification which is not required by a public agency. In that case, a fee shall be paid pursuant to Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 16.50 C. (Design Review Procedures).

4. In reviewing any modification, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal) shall limit its review and reconsideration to those areas identified as changed or influenced by the changes.

#### Sec. 13B.4.4. Project Adjustment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.4.1.png.webp?itok=cCIww7dz)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.4.1.png?itok=d4xvRKmy)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to requests for minor adjustments from certain [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations.

2. [Project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are limited to the list described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.5.7 E. (Specific Plan Procedures; Project Adjustments)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-457).

3. If an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requests more than one [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may determine that the request be filed and processed as a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (see [Sec. 13B.4.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.5)). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall advise the applicant of this determination before the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. There is no public hearing required for the initial decision on a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.

      2. However, a public information meeting may be held and notice given pursuant to [Sec. 13B.4.1.D. (General Provisions; Public information Meeting)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.1).
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property;<br>•The Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located;<br>•The Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; <br>•The chairperson of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      2. In granting a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conditions as the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) deems necessary in order to achieve substantial conformance with the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations.

      3. The remainder of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provisions for which the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not need a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be reviewed concurrently with a [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
4. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision by email, electronic transmission, or mail to the applicant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located, the Department of Transportation (where appropriate), owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and interested parties who have filed written requests with the City Planning Department.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

      1. There are special circumstances applicable to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which make the strict [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulation(s) impractical;

      2. That in granting the project adjustment, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has imposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requirements and/or determined that the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will substantially comply with all applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations;

      3. The [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), if granted, will not have detrimental effects on surrounding properties and [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

      4. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and
2. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also find that the [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with any other required [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) findings that may pertain to the [project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. ###### Limitations


      The granting of a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not imply compliance with any other applicable provisions of this Code. Any corrections and/or modifications to [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) plans made subsequent to a [project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that are deemed necessary by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for Building Code compliance, and which involve a change in floor area, [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), building height, yards or setbacks, building separation or lot coverage, shall require a referral of the revised plans back to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (and the Department of Transportation in cases where there are corrections and/or modifications that may affect the ingress, egress, circulation, project floor area or [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)) for additional review and sign-off prior to the issuance of any permit in connection with those plans.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may file an appeal.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.4.5. Project Exception

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.5.1.png.webp?itok=MfXw4E5O)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.5.1.png?itok=mIkprP4x)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to exceptions from [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations, as follows:

1. ###### Description


      A [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) grants relief from a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s regulations on the basis of particular standards or criteria established in this Section, or in a particular section of a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Like a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must show a hardship. However, a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) typically includes relief from additional standards that relate to the purposes of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Project Exception Relationship to Other Entitlements


      1. ###### Exception for Relief from a Specific Plan Regulation and the Same Type of Regulation With the Same Standard in Chapter I. of this Code


         If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) contains a regulation that is the same type of regulation with the same standard as one contained in an applicable provision of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, an applicant seeking relief from those regulations need only apply for and receive a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In this situation, the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulation is considered to supersede the Code provision and thus a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is not required.

      2. ###### Exception for Relief from Specific Plan Regulation and the Same Type of Regulation With a Different Standard in Chapter I. of this Code Where Specific Plan Supersedes the Code


         If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) contains a regulation that conflicts with the same type of regulation but with a different standard contained in an applicable provision of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code and the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) supersedes the Code by its terms, then an applicant seeking relief from that [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulation need only apply for and receive a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In this situation, a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is not also required.

      3. ###### Exception for Relief from Specific Plan Regulation and the Same Type of Regulation With a Different Standard in Chapter I. of this Code Where Specific Plan Does Not Supersede the Code


         If a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) contains a regulation that conflicts with the same type of regulation but with a different standard contained in an applicable provision of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code and the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not supersede the Code by its terms, then an applicant seeking relief from those regulations must apply for and receive both a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for relief from those Code provisions.

      4. ###### Additional Exceptions


         The exceptions described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.5.7 F (1) (Exception for Wireless Telecommunications Facilities)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/preview/v/e137bc46-ef58-4045-84b6-473b7b610129/lapz/0-0-0-457) and [Sec. 11.5.7 F(2) (Eldercare Facilities)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/preview/v/e137bc46-ef58-4045-84b6-473b7b610129/lapz/0-0-0-457) of this Code apply as appropriate.
2. ##### Initiation


1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. If an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) potentially impacts a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) policy or a regulation affecting the entire [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or any of its subareas, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall advise the applicant to request the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to initiate a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Amendment in lieu of processing the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). This shall occur before the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.
3. ##### Notice of Public Hearing


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property<br>•If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the decision making body on the matter |

      2. Where all property within the 500 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership, or is separated from it only by a street, alley, [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or other [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will also be notified.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the City, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |

      2. Where all property within the 500 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership, or is separated from it only by a street, alley, [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or other [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will also be notified.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may conduct the hearing itself or designate the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to conduct the hearing.
4. ###### Decision


      1. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conducts the public hearing, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) their findings and recommendation to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. After the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s hearing is closed, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision at a public meeting.

      3. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      4. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
5. ###### Conditions


      In granting a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall impose conditions to remedy any resulting disparity of privilege and that are necessary to protect the public health, safety, welfare and assure compliance with the objectives of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the purpose and intent of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). A [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be used to grant a special privilege, nor to grant relief from self-imposed hardships.

6. ###### Transmittal


      1. Where required, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision to: the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; and the Department of Transportation, where appropriate.

      2. Copies of the decision shall also be provided to: the applicant; the Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; the chairperson of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; and interested parties who have filed written requests with the City Planning Department.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

1. The strict [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the regulations of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the subject property would result in practical difficulties or unnecessary hardships inconsistent with the general purpose and intent of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

2. There are exceptional circumstances or conditions applicable to the subject property involved or to the intended use or development of the subject property that do not apply generally to other property in the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area;

3. An exception from the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is necessary to preserve and enjoy a substantial property right or use generally possessed by other property within the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the same vicinity but which, because of special circumstances and practical difficulties or unnecessary hardships is denied to the property in question;

4. The granting of the exception is not detrimental to the public welfare or injurious to the property or improvements adjacent to or in the vicinity of the subject property; and

5. The granting of an exception is consistent with the principles, intent and goals of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any applicable element of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. Any person aggrieved by an initial decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) concerning a [project exception](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may appeal the decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. After an appeal is filed, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the appeal and the file to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), together with any report responding to the points made in the appeal.
4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice of Public Hearing) above.

      2. A decision to reverse or modify the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision, in whole or in part, shall only be adopted by at least a two-thirds vote of the whole [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The decision must contain a finding of fact showing why the proposed exception to a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies or fails to comply with the requirements of this Section. Any vote of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in which less than two-thirds of the whole [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote to reverse or modify the decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be deemed to be an action denying the appeal.

      3. The failure of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to vote upon an appeal within 90 days after the expiration of the appeal period, or within any additional period agreed upon by the applicant and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), shall be deemed a denial of the appeal.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.4.6. Specific Plan Interpretation

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.6.1.png.webp?itok=ZXzv7jEG)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.4.6.1.png?itok=vTkeMW11)

1. ##### Applicability


The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have authority to interpret [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s when there is a lack of clarity in the meaning of their regulations.

2. ##### Initiation


1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may consider an interpretation on his or her own initiative, or in response to an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (see Subdivision 2. below).

2. To request a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation, an applicant shall file an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall include a reference to the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulation(s) for which clarification is requested and a narrative description of why a clarification is necessary for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or subject property involved.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. There is no public hearing required for the initial decision on a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation, and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may hold a public information meeting, if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decides that the proposed [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may have a potentially significant effect on adjoining properties or on the immediate neighborhood, or that it is likely to evoke public controversy, or that it would be in the public interest to conduct the meeting. Notice for the public information meeting shall be given pursuant to [Sec. 13B.4.1.D. (General Provisions; Public information Meetings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.4.1).
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant (when initiated by applicant);<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved (when initiated by applicant);<br>•The owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property (when initiated by applicant);<br>•The Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located;<br>•The Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; <br>•The chairperson of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a determination within 75 days after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      2. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to render a timely decision, the interpretation is deemed denied.
4. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision to the applicant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located, the Department of Transportation (where appropriate), owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; the chairperson of any design review or plan review board having jurisdiction over the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area in which the property is located; and interested parties who have filed written requests with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review


In rendering a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interpretation, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or City or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall consider:

1. Any [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), community plan, or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) policies that relate to the regulation subject to interpretation;

2. The purpose statements or other official city policies relating to the regulation; and

3. The context of the regulation and its relationship to similar regulations.
6. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for interpretations which affect an entire [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or any of its subareas.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for interpretations that apply only to a specific site.
3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other interested person aggrieved by the decision may file an appeal.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the City or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The City or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render its decision within 75 days from the last day of the appeal period.

      3. The City or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may reverse or modify, in whole or in part, a decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and may issue its own interpretation of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. Failure to timely act is deemed a denial of the appeal, and the initial decision becomes final.

### Div. 13B.5. Quasi-Judicial Relief

#### Sec. 13B.5.1. Alternative Compliance

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.1.1.png.webp?itok=OyeRQD_A)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.1.1.png?itok=comI0yVI)

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      This Section applies to the following situations where this Code expressly allows Alternative Compliance:

      1. The proposed development does not comply with a design, development, or performance standard required by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, and the applicant proposes an alternative standard or condition consistent with Paragraph b. below.

      2. The applicant proposed deviations from regulations which do not substantially alter the execution or intent of the regulations that apply to a proposed development.

      3. For purposes of Chapter 1A, alternative compliance must be expressly allowed in the relief allowances of this Chapter.
2. ###### Specific Plan Excluded


      This Section does not apply to [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an Alternative Compliance is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. There is no public hearing required for the initial decision on an Alternative Compliance, and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on an appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•Property owner(s) of the subject property;<br>•Owners and occupants of properties within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved;<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render an initial decision within 75 days after the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

4. ###### Conditions


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall impose conditions binding on the applicant to secure substantial compliance with the goals and purposes of the design, development, or performance standards from which alternative compliance is requested.

5. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision by mail to the applicant, owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property, and persons who have filed a written request for notice with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving an Alternative Compliance, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

1. The proposed alternative is consistent with the purpose and intent of the applicable standards;

2. The proposed alternative is equivalent to or exceeds the effectiveness of meeting the intent of the applicable standards;

3. The proposed alternative will result in a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that is compatible with and does not adversely affect or further degrade the adjacent properties, the surrounding neighborhood, or the public health, welfare, and safety; and

4. The [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the purpose, intent, and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the applicable community plan.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The Area Planning Commission is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. An appeal may be filed to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by an applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision.

      2. After an appeal is filed, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the appeal and the file to the applicable [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), together with a report responding to the points raised in the appeal.
4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall conduct a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make its decision within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.5.2. Adjustment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.2.1.png.webp?itok=x7kLKmZH)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.2.1.png?itok=1fvOAadO)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to the following situations where this Code expressly allows an Adjustment:

      1. Adjustments and modifications from zoning regulations if expressly allowed in the relief allowances of this Chapter;

      2. Adjustments and modifications from zoning regulations as described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.28 A. and B.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/preview/v/e137bc46-ef58-4045-84b6-473b7b610129/lapz/0-0-0-9357) or in any subsection of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) that provides Relief from the Section standards;

      3. Any zone boundary or height district adjustments as described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.30 H., J., or K.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/preview/v/e137bc46-ef58-4045-84b6-473b7b610129/lapz/0-0-0-9413) or in any subsection of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) that provides Relief from the Section standards.
2. An Adjustment cannot be requested for increases in Floor Area Ratio.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an Adjustment is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision, if held:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•Owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from or having a common corner with the subject property; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested notice in writing |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The appellant(s);<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•Owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from or having a common corner with the subject property; and <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing and Decision


      1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an Adjustment shall be set for public hearing unless the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) makes written findings in the record that the requested Adjustment:

         1. Will not have a significant effect on adjoining properties or on the immediate neighborhood; or

         2. Is not likely to evoke public controversy.
      2. If a public hearing is held, notice shall be given in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      3. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render an initial decision within 75 days after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.
4. ###### Conditions for Approval


      In granting an Adjustment, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions to remedy any resulting disparity of privilege, to protect the public health, safety, welfare, and to assure compliance with the objectives of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the purpose and intent of the zoning.

5. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision by mail to the applicant, owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property, and persons who have filed a written request for the notice with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving an Adjustment, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Area Planning Commission (on appeal) shall find:

1. That while site characteristics or existing improvements make strict adherence to the zoning regulations impractical or infeasible, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) nonetheless conforms to the intent of those regulations;

2. That in light of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as a whole, including any mitigation measures imposed, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s location, size, height, operations and other significant features will be compatible with and will not adversely affect or further degrade adjacent properties, the surrounding neighborhood, or the public health, welfare, and safety; and

3. That the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is in substantial conformance with the purpose, intent and provisions of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicable community plan and any applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the Area Planning Commission.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


The plan approval procedures that apply to [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in [Sec. 13B.5.3.H. (Variance; Modification of Entitlement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3) shall also apply to Adjustments.

9. ##### Discontinuance of Adjustment – Revocation


The revocation procedures that apply to [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in [Sec. 13B.5.3.I. (Variance; Revocation and Repeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.3) shall also apply to Adjustments.


#### Sec. 13B.5.3. Variance

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.3.1.png.webp?itok=L33NP_tT)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.3.1.png?itok=3Xewhbb0)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that grant relief from a standard or regulation in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) on the basis of hardship or difficulties.

2. ###### Continuance of Variance or Exception


      1. Except as provided in Subsection I. (Revocation and Repeal) of this Section, with respect to [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or exceptions which have never been or are not being utilized, no provision of this Article shall be interpreted or construed as limiting or interfering with the rights established by any [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or exception granted prior to the effective date of this Article by:

         1. Ordinance pursuant to the provisions of ordinances Nos. 42,666 (N.S.), 66,750, 74,140 or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), or this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A);

         2. Decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the former Board of Zoning Appeals pursuant to the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), or this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A); or

         3. Former decision of the Board of City Planning Commissioners pursuant to the provisions of ordinance No. 74,145, [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) or this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
      2. Notwithstanding any of the provisions of the ordinance granting a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or exception, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have jurisdiction to perform all administrative acts with which the Board of City Planning Commissioners, [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or its Planning Committee were formerly charged with under the ordinance, such as approving plans, signs, types of use, and the like. The use of any building, structure or land existing at the time this Article became effective, by virtue of any exception from the provisions of former ordinance No. 33,761 (N.S.), may be continued provided no new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is erected, no [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is enlarged, and no [existing uses](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of land is extended.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision, if held:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners of all property within and outside of the City that is within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below);<br>•The residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of all property within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below); <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
         | Posting | 10 days | •Applicant must post in a conspicuous place on the property involved |

      2. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.

      3. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requesting relief from density or height requirements shall follow the procedures for public hearing and notice as set forth in [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The appellant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners of all property within and outside of the City that is within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below);<br>•The residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of all property within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below); <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
         | Posting | 10 days | •Applicant must post in a conspicuous place on the property involved |

      2. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.

      3. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requesting relief from density or height requirements shall follow the procedures for public hearing and notice as set forth in [Sec. 13B.5.2. (Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.2).
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be set for public hearing unless the Chief [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or, in their absence, an Associate [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) performing their functions, makes written findings, a copy of which shall be attached to the file, that the requested [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

         1. Will not have a significant effect on adjoining properties or on the immediate neighborhood; or

         2. Is not likely to evoke public controversy.
4. ###### Decision


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the submission of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).

5. ###### Conditions of Approval
