      In granting a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions to remedy a disparity of privileges and that are necessary to protect the public health, safety, welfare, and to assure compliance with the objectives of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the purpose and intent of the zoning ordinance.

6. ###### Transmittal


      Upon making a decision, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the written findings and decision to the applicant, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property and to all persons who have filed written requests for this notice with the office of Zoning Administration. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also place a copy of the findings and decision in the file.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. The standards in [City Charter, Sec. 562 (Variances)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2563) apply to [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. In granting a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find:

      1. That the strict [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the provisions of the zoning ordinance would result in practical difficulties or unnecessary hardships inconsistent with the general purposes and intent of the zoning regulations;

      2. That there are special circumstances applicable to the subject property such as size, shape, topography, location or surroundings that do not apply generally to other property in the same zone and vicinity;

      3. That the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is necessary for the preservation and enjoyment of a substantial property right or use generally possessed by other property in the same zone and vicinity but which, because of the special circumstances and practical difficulties or unnecessary hardships, is denied to the property in question;

      4. That the granting of the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will not be materially detrimental to the public welfare, or injurious to the property or improvements in the same zone or vicinity in which the property is located; and

      5. That the granting of the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will not adversely affect any element of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. A [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be used to grant a special privilege or to permit a use substantially inconsistent with the limitations upon other properties in the same zone and vicinity. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may deny a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if the conditions creating the need for the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) were self-imposed.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

3. ###### Filing


      Any person aggrieved by an initial decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) concerning a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will set the matter for a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period. If the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to render a timely decision, the action of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the matter shall be final, unless the appellant files a request for a transfer of jurisdiction to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for decision pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).

      3. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may affirm, reverse, or modify the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision.

      4. In considering appeals, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be subject to the same limitations regarding findings and conditions as are applicable to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the initial decision.

      5. Upon making a decision, a copy of the findings and decision shall forthwith be placed on file in the City Planning Department, and copies of the decision shall be sent to the applicant, the appellant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and the office of Zoning Administration.

      6. ###### Date of Final Decision


         A denial of a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal shall become final upon the date it was mailed to the applicant. However, a decision by the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granting or confirming the grant of a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall become final after 15 days from the date it was mailed to the applicant, unless an appeal is filed with the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within that period. The filing of an appeal stays proceedings in the matter until the Council makes a decision on the matter. The Council shall not consider any appeal not filed within the 15-day period.
5. ###### Appeal to City Council


      1. An appeal from a decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granting or affirming the grant of a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be filed by the applicant or any person aggrieved by the decision. There shall be no further appeal from the decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to deny a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. ###### Action by City Council and Mayor


         1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will set the matter for a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

         2. When considering an appeal from an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decision granting or affirming the grant of a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be subject to the same limitations regarding findings and conditions as are placed on the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by this Section.

         3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), by resolution, may affirm, reverse or modify, in whole or in part, the decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote. Failure of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to act within 90 days from the expiration of the appeal period, or within any additional period as may be agreed upon by the applicant and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be deemed to be a denial of the appeal.

         4. When a [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decision is appealed to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) either approves the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or denies an appeal from an earlier approval, the matter together with the files and reports shall forthwith be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve or disapprove the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 10 days of its presentation to him or her. This action shall be based solely upon the administrative record and whether the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) believes the [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conforms to the requirements for approval set forth in this Section.

         5. If the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) disapproves the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), he or she shall return the matter to the City Clerk for presentation to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), together with the objections in writing. The Council within 60 days after the matter has been returned to it may override the disapproval by a two-thirds vote.

         6. If the Council fails to override the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s disapproval within the 60 days, the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s disapproval shall constitute a denial of the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to return the matter to the City Clerk within 10 days of its presentation to him or her, the approval of the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall become final.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. ###### Development of Site


      1. On any [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on which a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is permitted pursuant to a variance, new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may be erected, enlargements may be made to [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and [existing uses](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be extended if plans for those changes are submitted and approved by a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). A [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not approve any use, single deviation, or combination or series of deviations from the zoning regulations which was not approved as part of the original [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or which would result in an increase in size or bulk of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s exceeding 20 percent.

      2. Any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) submitting development plans or any other [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the decision of a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) made relative to the approval or disapproval of a development plan may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). No fee shall be required for the filing of appeals by other [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
2. ###### Reduction of Site


      So long as the use approved by [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is continued, the entire approved site shall be retained for the approved use, and no portion of the site shall be severed or utilized for other purposes unless the plans for the reduced site are first submitted to and approved by a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The decision of a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a proposed reduction of the area of an approved site shall be subject to the same appeal as is provided in Subsection G.4. above for an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to establish the use by [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Conditions of Approval


      In connection with the approval of such plans, a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions on the same basis as provided for in this Section in connection with the original [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Change of Use


      No [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approved by [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be changed to a different use for which a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is otherwise required unless the new use is authorized in accordance with the procedure prescribed in this Section for the establishment of a use by [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
9. ##### Revocation and Repeal


1. ###### Discontinuance of Variance or Exception - Revocation


      1. If the use authorized by any [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granted by ordinance, or by decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is or has been abandoned or discontinued for a period of six months, or the conditions of the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) have not been complied with, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), upon knowledge of this fact, may give notice to the record owner or lessee of the real property affected to appear at a time and place fixed by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and show cause why the ordinance or decision granting the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) should not be repealed or rescinded, as the case may be.

      2. After the hearing, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may revoke the [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or if an ordinance is involved, recommend to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that the ordinance be repealed. The decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall become final after 15 days from the date of mailing of the decision to the owner or lessees of the real property affected, unless an appeal to the Council is filed within that 15-day period. An appeal may be taken to Council in the same manner as described in Subsection G. (Appeals) above. After revocation or repeal, the property affected shall be subject to all the regulations of the zone in which the property is located.
2. ###### Failure to Utilize Variance or Exception - Repeal


      1. The procedure for repeal of [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that have been abandoned or discontinued as set forth in Subdivision 1. (Discontinuance of Variance or Exception – Revocation) above shall not apply to those exceptions or conditional [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s granted by ordinance and which were once utilized, but the authorized use or development had been discontinued or removed from the site for at least one year and the ordinance has been repealed.

      2. If the rights established by any ordinance previously adopted authorizing an exception or conditional [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from the provisions of this Chapter, [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), or ordinances No. 42,666 (N.S.), 66,750 and 74,140, have never been executed or utilized, or, if once utilized, the use or development authorized has been discontinued or removed from the site for a period of least one year, that exception or conditional [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall no longer be of any force or effect and the respective ordinance granting the exception or conditional [Variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is hereby repealed.

#### Sec. 13B.5.4. Modification of Entitlement

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.4.1.png.webp?itok=T5ETC52Y)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.4.1.png?itok=s8oERS5A)

Purpose. The Modification of Entitlement is a discretionary process intended to be used for situations where the Code expressly provides for a possible modification of the original entitlement pursuant to this process and it is deemed necessary to modify conditions of approval for the original grant on an approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) prior to the issuance of the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Original Action


      This Section applies to modification of an approved entitlement, referred to in this Section as the “original action," only if the Code expressly provides for a modification of that entitlement pursuant to this process.

2. ###### Modification


      1. For purposes of this Section, a “modification” means any changes in the proposed physical development or related conditions of approval that were approved in the original action.

      2. A modification is limited to an alteration of the physical development or conditions of approval on the original action by no more than 20 percent, and the modification will not result in a new, significant unavoidable environmental impact.

      3. If multiple modifications are requested on the same original action, the modifications shall not cumulatively exceed the 20 percent limitation described above in Paragraph b.

      4. A modification does not include the granting of any new rights, nor does it include the granting of any deviation from zoning regulations in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408).

      5. Nothing in this Section is intended to limit the authority of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to find that a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is in substantial conformance with its approved entitlements, consistent with state law.
3. ###### New Application


      Any request for a modification that exceeds the 20 percent limitation described above in Subdivision 2.b. or Subdivision 2.c. will not be processed as a modification of the original action but will instead require a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Initiation


1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Modification of Entitlement is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must include development plans showing the requested modifications.

3. A Modification of Entitlement shall be filed and approved before the original action expires.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      Notice of the public hearing on the initial decision of a Modification of Entitlement is provided in the same manner as required on the initial decision of the original action.

2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      Notice of the public hearing on the appeal of a Modification of Entitlement is provided in the same manner as required on the appeal of the original action.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      1. The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a Modification of Entitlement is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the original action.

      2. If the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was subject to multiple approvals, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) assigned pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10), unless otherwise delegated.

      3. If the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was subject to an appeal, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the Modification of Entitlement is the appellate body on the original action, unless otherwise delegated.
3. ###### Public Hearing


      The public hearing requirements that applied to the original action also apply to the Modification of Entitlement, with notice given in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

4. ###### Decision


      The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve, conditionally approve, or deny the request within 75 days after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

5. ###### Conditions


      The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions on the modification on the same basis as in the original action.

6. ###### Transmittal


      The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision by mail to the applicant, all owners and occupants of properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property, and persons who have filed a written request for the notice with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a Modification of Entitlement, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that the modification complies with all of the findings that apply to the original action.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. Modification of Entitlement [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and approvals are only valid for permits or decisions which have not expired. A Modification of Entitlement does not suspend or extend the term grant of the original permit or decision.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Appealable in Same Manner as original Action


      The initial decision on a Modification of Entitlement is appealable in the same manner as an appeal on the original action.

3. ###### Scope of Appeal


      An appeal of a Modification of Entitlement is an appeal of the requested modification; it is not an appeal of the entire [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or grant as approved in the original action.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


An approved Modification of Entitlement may be modified thereafter by following the same procedures established above for the original Modification of Entitlement.


#### Sec. 13B.5.5. Reasonable Accommodation

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.5.1.png.webp?itok=uKsgjlIo)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.5.5.1.png?itok=rvzXiE3x)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section establishes a formal procedure for an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) seeking equal access to housing to request a [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as provided by the Federal Fair Housing Amendments Act of 1988 and California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act, and to establish criteria to be used when considering these requests.

2. The following definitions apply to this Section:

      Acts. The Federal Fair Housing Amendments Act of 1988 and California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act

      Individual with a Disability. As defined under the Acts, a person who has a physical or mental impairment that limits one or more major life activities, anyone who is regarded as having that type of impairment or, anyone who has a record of that type of impairment.

      Reasonable Accommodation. Providing an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or developers of housing for an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), flexibility in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of land use and zoning regulations or policies (including the modification or waiver of certain requirements), when it is necessary to eliminate barriers to housing opportunities.
2. ##### Initiation


1. A written request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from a land use or zoning regulation or policy shall be made on a form provided by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by any [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), his or her representative, or a developer or provider of housing for an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. A request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall state the basis of the request including but not limited to a modification or exception to the regulations, standards and practices for the siting, development and use of housing or housing related facilities that would eliminate regulatory barriers and provide an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) equal opportunity to housing of his or her choice.

3. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may request additional information necessary for making a determination on the request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that complies with the fair housing law protections and the privacy rights of the [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to use the specified housing. If additional information is requested, the 45-day time period for making a determination on the request stops running until the additional information is provided.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. There is no public hearing required on the initial decision of a [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the city, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The appellant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved; <br>•Owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from or having a common corner with the subject property; and <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall issue a written determination to either grant, grant with modifications, or deny a request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 45 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete, or within an extended period as mutually agreed upon in writing by the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Regulations Effective while Decision Pending


      While a request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is pending, all laws and regulations otherwise applicable to the property that is the subject of the request shall remain in full force and effect.

5. ###### Covenant


      Prior to the issuance of any permits relative to an approved [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require the applicant to record a covenant in the Los Angeles County Recorder’s office acknowledging and agreeing to comply with the terms and conditions established in the determination. The covenant is required only if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that a covenant is necessary to provide notice to future owners that a [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been approved.

6. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the written findings and decision to the applicant and to all owners of properties abutting the subject property. All written decisions shall give notice of the right to appeal and to request [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the appeals process as set forth in Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. ###### General


      In approving a request for a [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find:

      1. That the housing, which is the subject of the request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), will be used by an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) protected under the [Acts](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      2. That the requested accommodation is necessary to make housing available to an [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) protected under the [Acts](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      3. That the requested accommodation would not impose an undue financial or administrative burden on the City; and

      4. That the requested accommodation would not require a fundamental alteration in the nature of the City’s land use and zoning program.
2. ###### Coastal Zone Properties


      1. For housing located in the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), a request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under this Section shall be approved by the City if it is consistent with the requisite findings above, with [Chapter 3 (Coastal Resources Planning and Management Policies) of the California Coastal Act of 1976](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayexpandedbranch.xhtml?tocCode=PRC&division=20.&title=&part=&chapter=3.&article=), and with the interpretive Guidelines for Coastal Planning and Permits as established by the California Coastal Commission dated February 11, 1977 or the certified [Local Coastal Program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Land Use Plan for that area.

      2. Where a request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is not consistent with the regulations identified in Paragraph a. above, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may waive compliance with an otherwise applicable provision of these regulations and approve the request for [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds:

         1. That the requested [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is consistent, to the maximum extent [feasible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), with the regulations identified in this Subsection; and

         2. That there are no feasible alternative means for providing an accommodation at the property that would provide greater consistency with the regulations identified in this Subsection.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) grants the request, the request is granted to an individual and does not run with the land unless the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that:

      1. The modification is physically integrated into the residential structure and cannot easily be removed or altered to comply with this Code; or

      2. The accommodation is to be used by another [individual with a disability](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      Only the aggrieved applicant and abutting owners who received notice of the [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determination have a right to appeal the decision.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period or within any additional period mutually agreed upon by the applicant and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will render its decision by resolution. A decision to reverse or modify the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision, in whole or in part, shall only be adopted by at least a two-thirds vote of the whole Council.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


A [Reasonable Accommodation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be modified by following the same procedures established above for the original action.


### Div. 13B.6. Non-Compliance

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.6.1.png.webp?itok=hsGJYBPK)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.6.1.png?itok=sRt92KJK)

#### Sec. 13B.6.1. Evaluation of Non-Compliance

1. ##### Applicability


This Section establishes procedures to modify, discontinue, or revoke any discretionary zoning approval where needed to remedy non-compliance with the conditions of any conditional use or similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

2. ##### Initiation


The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (if the approval or conditional use was granted by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)) may initiate evaluation proceedings by notifying the business operator, property owner, or lessee(s) upon knowledge of the fact of non-compliance with the conditions of the discretionary zoning approval.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •Operator; and<br>•Owner and lessee(s) of the property involved. |
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •Operator;<br>•Owner and lessee(s) of the property involved;<br>•Owners of all property within and outside of the City that is within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved;<br>•Residential, commercial and industrial occupants of the property involved, and all property within 300 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The owner, lessee, or operator will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |

      2. If all property within the 300-foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the proceeding, then the owners of all property which adjoins that ownership are included in the notification area.

      3. If the mailed notice within the required radius does not result in notice to at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever was the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the original action, is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on an [Evaluation of Non-Compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may delegate its authority in this matter to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Notice to Appear


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may notify the record owner or lessee of the real property involved to appear at a time and place fixed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and show cause why the discretionary zoning approval should not be repealed or rescinded, as the case may be.

      2. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.
4. ###### Decision


      After the public hearing concludes, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may revoke, temporarily suspend, or impose further restrictions on the conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

5. ###### Fees


      1. A fee as set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), shall be paid to the City within 30 days of the effective date of the decision by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If an appeal is filed and the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is upheld by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, then the fee required by this Subsection shall be paid in full within 30 days of the effective date of the final decision. However, if the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) reverses the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) then no payment of fees other than the appeal fee specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall be required.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) may require modification, discontinuance, or revocation of any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon knowledge of the fact of a business operator, property owner, or lessee’s non-compliance with the conditions of any conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and make the required findings for any action taken.

6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. After corrective modification or imposition of new conditions, the property involved is allowed continuance of operation subject to compliance with all conditions.

2. After revocation, the property involved is subject to all the regulations of the zone in which the property is located, and as provided in this Code or as modified by the subject final revocation action.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      1. If the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) modifies conditions or imposes additional conditions as a part of the evaluation action, the appellate body is the appellate body on the original decision.
3. ###### Filing


      1. Any person aggrieved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Any person aggrieved by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the appellate body shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The appellate body shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period. Failure to timely act is deemed a denial of the appeal, and is not further appealable.

      3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate body, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will render its decision by resolution. A decision to reverse or modify the initial decision, in whole or in part, shall be adopted by at least a two-thirds (2/3) vote of the whole Council.

      4. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision on appeal shall be reviewable as an approval of a conditional use or other similar [Quasi-judicial approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the manner prescribed in [Sec. 13B.2.3.G. (Class 3 Conditional Use Permit; Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2.3).
8. ##### Modification of Action


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.6.2. Nuisance Abatement/Revocation

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.6.2.1.png.webp?itok=BSZYr0xZ)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.6.2.1.png?itok=oEYUMGKp)

Purpose. It is the intent of this Section to consolidate a number of existing Code provisions relating to the administrative abatement of public nuisances, and revocations, rescissions, discontinuances or modifications of discretionary zoning approvals. In addition, this Section also sets forth procedures allowing the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to modify or remove conditions imposed as a result of nuisance abatement proceedings; to enforce conditions imposed as part of any discretionary zoning approval; and to require that the cost of a proceeding instituted pursuant to this Section be paid by those responsible for the maintenance and operation of the subject use.

These provisions allow the City's zoning authorities to protect the public peace, health and safety from any land use which becomes a nuisance; adversely affects the health, peace or safety of persons residing or working in the surrounding area; or violates any land use related condition imposed pursuant to this Code or other provision of law, while protecting the constitutional rights of the parties involved.

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Zoning Administrator Authority


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require the modification, discontinuance, or revocation of any land use or discretionary zoning approval if it is found that the land use or discretionary zoning approval as operated or maintained:

      1. Jeopardizes or adversely affects the public health, peace, or safety of persons residing or working on the premises or in the surrounding area;

      2. Constitutes a public nuisance;

      3. Has resulted in repeated nuisance activities, including, but not limited to, disturbances of the peace, illegal drug activity, public drunkenness, drinking in public, harassment of passersby, gambling, prostitution, sale of stolen goods, public urination, theft, assaults, batteries, acts of vandalism, loitering, excessive littering, illegal [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), excessive loud noises (especially in the late night or early morning hours), traffic violations, curfew violations, lewd conduct, or police detentions and arrests;

      4. Adversely impacts nearby uses;

      5. Violates any provision of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, or any other city, state, or federal regulation, ordinance, or statute;

      6. Violates any condition imposed by a prior Legislative or discretionary land use approval; or

      7. Violates an approval initiated by [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of a property owner or owner’s representative related to the land use (including but not limited to a [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), Tentative [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or Coastal Development Permit).
2. ###### Relationship to Other Code Provisions


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s authority in Subdivision 1. (Zoning Administrator Authority) above supersedes any provision of this Code to the contrary.

3. ###### Continuation of Prior Decisions


      1. Prior administrative nuisance abatement decisions regarding land uses and discontinuances, revocations, rescissions or modifications of discretionary zoning approvals made by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the Council remain in full force and effect.

      2. It is unlawful to violate or fail to comply with any prior requirement or condition imposed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the former Board of Zoning Appeals, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. Violation or failure to comply violates this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code and is subject to the same penalties as any other violation of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code.

      4. To remedy a violation of an order of discontinuance or revocation, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall order the business operator, property owner or lessee(s) to vacate and secure all or any portion of the property, premises, or buildings - refer to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 91.9003 (Abatement Procedures)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-209398). The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall institute enforcement as provided in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 91.9003.4. (Enforcement)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-209398).
2. ##### Initiation


The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate a nuisance abatement proceeding by notifying the business operator, property owner, or lessee(s) as provided in this Section.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •Operator;<br>•Owner(s) and lessee(s) of the property involved;<br>•Owners of all property within and outside of the City that is within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved;<br>•Residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of the property involved, and all property within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •Operator must post in a conspicuous place on the property involved |

      2. If all property within the 500 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the proceeding, then the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership are included in the notification area.

      3. If the mailed notice does not include at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •Operator;<br>•Owner(s) and lessee(s) of the property involved;<br>•Owners of all property within and outside of the City that is within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved;<br>•Residential, commercial and industrial occupants of the property involved, and all property within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •Operator must post in a conspicuous place on the property involved |

      2. If all property within the 500 foot radius is under the same ownership as the property involved in the proceeding, then the owners of all property that adjoins that ownership are included in the notification area.

      3. If the mailed notice does not include at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of owners and lots are within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      There is no filing, as this process can only be initiated by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Public Hearing and Decision


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above. At this hearing the business operator, property, owner, or lessee(s) of the subject property shall be given an opportunity to show cause as to why the land use or discretionary zoning approval should not be modified, discontinued, or revoked.

      2. After the public hearing concludes, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require the modification, discontinuance, or revocation of the land use or discretionary zoning approval.

      3. Any determination shall be supported by written findings, including a finding that the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination does not impair the constitutional rights of any person. The written determination shall also state that failure to comply with any or all conditions imposed may result in the issuance of an order to discontinue or revoke the land use or discretionary zoning approval.
5. ###### Conditions


      1. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions of operation as needed to:

         1. Protect the best interests of the surrounding property or neighborhood;

         2. Eliminate, lessen, or prevent any detrimental effect on the surrounding property or neighborhood; or

         3. Assure compliance with other applicable provisions of law or conditions of an earlier discretionary approval.
      2. Conditions imposed may include, but are not limited to:

         1. The establishment of amortization schedules;

         2. The closure or removal of buildings or structures; or

         3. The establishment, maintenance, or operation of the subject use and related land uses, buildings, or structures.
      3. ###### Fee Condition


         1. Whenever the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) initiates an action pursuant to this Section, they shall impose a condition requiring payment of the fee (fee condition) set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) to cover the City's costs in processing the matter. A fee is not required if the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the operation of the land use does not create a nuisance or that the property owner, business operator or person in control, is in substantial compliance with the conditions of operation.

         2. The fee condition shall further provide that if the decision is not appealed, then the fee shall be paid in full to the City with confirmation of the payment being provided to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 30 days of the decision date. If an appeal is filed and the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is upheld on appeal, then the fee shall be paid in full with confirmation made to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 30 days of the effective date of the decision. If the Council reverses in total the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then no payment of fees other than the appeal fee specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) shall be required.
      4. ###### Compliance Review


         1. Upon any finding of nuisance or non-compliance with existing conditions imposed on the land use or discretionary zoning approval, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination shall impose a condition requiring the business operator or property owner to file a Compliance Review [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for Review of Compliance with Conditions within two years of the effective date, or the City may file an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on their behalf and a fee will be charged.

         2. At the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s discretion, the due date for the Compliance Review [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) can be set for 90 days, 180 days, one year, 18 months, or two years from the effective date of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination or the Council action on appeal.
6. ###### Cost of Abatement


      If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) discontinues or revokes any land use or discretionary zoning approval pursuant to this Section, the full cost of the abatement, including the cost of inspection, becomes the personal obligation of the business operator, property owner, or person in control. If confirmed by the Council, a lien may be placed against the property in accordance with the procedures described in [Sec. 7.35.3. (Procedures to Confirm a Proposed Lien for Nuisance Abatement Costs and Code Enforcement Costs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-60839) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In requiring the discontinuance or revocation of a land use or discretionary zoning approval, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that:

1. The determination does not impair the constitutional rights of any person;

2. Prior governmental efforts to cause the owner or operator to eliminate the problems associated with the land use or discretionary zoning approval have failed (examples include formal action, such as citations, orders, or hearings by the Police Department, [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or any other governmental agency); and

3. The owner or operator has failed to demonstrate, to the satisfaction of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the willingness or ability to eliminate the problems associated with the land use or discretionary zoning approval.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. ###### General


      After modification, discontinuance, or revocation, the property affected is subject to all the regulations of the zone in which the property is located, as provided in this Code or as modified by the subject final revocation action.

2. ###### Violations


      1. It is unlawful to violate or fail to comply with any requirement or condition imposed by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section.

      2. Violation or failure to comply violates this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code and is subject to the same penalties as any other violation of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code.

      3. If a violation of an order to discontinue or revoke a land use or discretionary zoning approval pursuant to this Section occurs, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall order the owner to vacate and secure the property, premises, buildings or portion of any property, premises or building pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 91.9003 (Abatement Procedures)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-209398). The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall institute enforcement as provided in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 91.9003.4. (Enforcement)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-209398). The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall cause the determination or revocation to be recorded.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      Any person aggrieved by the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may appeal the decision to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period. Failure to timely act is deemed a denial of the appeal.

      3. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will render its decision by resolution. A decision to reverse or modify the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision, in whole or in part, shall be adopted by at least a two-thirds vote of the whole [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision impairs the constitutional rights of any person, then it shall modify the action accordingly, or remand the matter back to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for further action.
8. ##### Modification of Decision


1. Any administrative nuisance abatement decision made pursuant to this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), any conditions imposed by that decision, or any decisions on a discretionary zoning approval pursuant to this Section may be modified pursuant to the provisions of this Subsection.

2. Upon [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the business operator, property owner, or lessee(s), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may add, modify, or eliminate the conditions of a prior decision.

3. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be considered if:

      1. A time period of at least one year has passed from the effective date the conditions were originally imposed; or

      2. There have been substantial changes in the nature and operation of the land use or discretionary zoning approval; or

      3. There has been a change in circumstances such that continued enforcement of the previously imposed conditions is no longer reasonable or necessary.
4. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be set for public hearing. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant or deny the requested [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or modify the prior decision, including imposing new or different substitute conditions as the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) deems appropriate.

5. No modification shall be approved pursuant to this Subsection unless the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) makes the following findings:

      1. That the requirements for consideration of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under this Subsection have been met; and

      2. That due consideration has been given to the effects of the modification on surrounding properties.
6. An appeal from the decision of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be taken to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the same manner as prescribed in Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section.

7. When the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) orders the discontinuance or revocation of a land use or discretionary zoning approval and the applicant files for re-instatement of the land use pursuant to this Subsection, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may re-instate the land use if all findings of this Subsection are met. The applicant will not be issued a new [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

8. Subsequent [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for consideration may be filed in accordance with this Subsection. If the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is denied with prejudice, a subsequent [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for consideration shall not be filed within one year from the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was considered, and then only if a property owner, business operator or lessee(s) shows that the circumstances involving the land use or discretionary zoning approval have substantially and materially changed since it was last considered.
9. ##### Revocations of Residential Uses


1. ###### Applicability


      This Subsection applies to all single-family and multi-family residential uses, including residential hotels as defined in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 47.73 T. (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-205208). This Subsection does not apply to hotels or motels that are not residential hotels. Nothing in this Section or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 91.9001 et seq. (General)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-209412) supersedes or abrogates the rights of tenants provided by State statute or by the Los Angeles Housing Code and Rent Stabilization ordinance, or by any other provision of this Code.

2. ###### Process


      The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, may ask the City Attorney to consider initiating the process of having the [residential use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) placed in receivership pursuant to the [California Civil Code, Sec. 3479](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=3479.&lawCode=CIV) and the [Code of Civil Procedure, Sec. 564(b)(9)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=564.&lawCode=CCP) upon finding that:

      1. Prior governmental efforts to cause the owner or operator to eliminate the problems associated with the land use or discretionary zoning approval have failed (examples include formal action, such as citations, orders, or hearings by the Police Department, [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), Los Angeles Housing Department, a [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or any other governmental agency); and

      2. That the owner or operator has failed to demonstrate, to the satisfaction of the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the willingness or ability to eliminate the problems associated with the land use or discretionary zoning approval.
3. ###### Remedies


      If the residential use is not placed in receivership and the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the Council on appeal, discontinues or revokes the land use or discretionary zoning approval, resulting in the displacement of tenants, the following provisions apply:

      1. The Los Angeles Housing Department shall identify each tenant who was displaced and is eligible for relocation assistance, and shall issue an order requiring the owner to pay relocation benefits in the amounts specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 151.09 G. (Evictions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195761).

      2. If the owner fails to pay relocation benefits to an eligible tenant as required by this Subsection:

         1. The Los Angeles Housing Department may advance relocation benefits to the tenant in the amount set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 151.09 G. (Evictions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195761); and

         2. The owner is liable to the City for any relocation payments advanced, and the Los Angeles Housing Department may obtain a lien upon the property pursuant to [Sec. 7.35.3 (Procedures to Confirm a Proposed Lien for Nuisance Abatement Costs and Code Enforcement Costs)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-60839) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to recover the amount advanced and associated costs.
      3. Relocation benefits are not payable to any tenant who has caused or substantially contributed to the condition giving rise to an order to vacate issued pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 91.9003 (Abatement Procedures)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-209398). The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall determine whether a tenant has caused or substantially contributed to the condition giving rise to the order to vacate.

      4. The Housing Department shall inform each eligible tenant of their right to re-rent the same unit, or comparable unit if the owner or subsequent owner, re-establishes the residential use. The Housing Department shall inform the eligible tenant that they must advise the owner in writing of their interest in re-renting and must provide the owner with an address to which the owner can direct an offer.

      5. When the residential use is re-established, the accommodations shall be offered, and rented or leased at the lawful rent in effect at the time the residential use was discontinued or revoked, plus annual adjustments available under [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 151.06. (Automatic Adjustments)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-195445).

      6. The [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action shall include the provisions of this Subsection and shall be recorded as a covenant with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

#### Sec. 13B.6.3. Building Permit Revocation

1. ##### Applicability


This Section (Building Permit Revocation) applies where this Code expressly authorizes [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) revocation, including when a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with a valid [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and/or a valid permit that violates any applicable [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) standards for an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including but not limited to [Sec. 4C.4.1.E.12. (Outdoor Dining Area Parking Exception)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.1), [Sec. 5C.2.4.B (Eating & Drinking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.2.4), [Sec. 5C.1.10. (Amplified Sound Restrictions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.10), [Sec. 5C.3.3.G.6. (Outdoor Dining Area Administrative Alcohol Authorization)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.3), or [Chapter XI. (Noise Regulation)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-193741) of this Code.

2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### Revocation Proceedings Resulting from Citations and Other Enforcement Mechanisms


      1. Regardless of any previous corrective actions or payments of fines and fees, any combination of four or more Notice to Appear Citations, Orders to Comply, Notices of Violation, or Administrative Citations issued by Los Angeles Police Department, [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) departments for any violation under the provisions noted above in Subsection A. (Applicability) may result in revocation proceedings for any issued [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or permits, or both.

      2. The revocation proceedings shall commence by issuance of a Notice of Intent to Revoke ("Notice"), which shall be sent to the owner of the property and the restaurant operator of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The Notice shall state the following:

         1. The date and place of the revocation hearing, which shall be scheduled at least 15 days and not more than 90 days from the date of issuance of the Notice.

         2. A list of all violations under the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provisions noted above in Subsection A. (Applicability) for which a Notice to Appear Citation, Order to Comply, Notice of Violation, or Administrative Citation was issued by Los Angeles Police Department, [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) department.

         3. Copies of all Notice to Appear Citations, Order to Comply, Notices of Violation, and Administrative Citations related to these violations, unless the copies were previously furnished to the owner or operator.

         4. The owner or operator is entitled to be represented by legal counsel at any revocation hearing.
3. ##### Notice of Public Hearing


The following notice is required for the public hearing held by the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners.




| Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mail | 5 days | •Operator;<br>•Owner(s) and lessee(s) of the property involved;<br>•Complainant;<br>•All interested parties |

4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      1. See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

      2. See [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 98.0601. (Purpose)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-190400) of this Code.
2. ###### Decision Maker


      The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners is the initial decision maker.

3. ###### Filing


      There is no filing as this process can only be initiated by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Public Hearing & Decision


      1. On the date specified in the Notice, a revocation hearing shall be held before the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners. The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners shall determine whether the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or permit, or both, shall be revoked. Revocation shall be ordered by the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners for multiple violations of the applicable [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations, four or more Notice to Appear Citations, Orders to Comply, Notice of Violation, or Administrative Citations issued to the property owner of record or restaurant operator by the Los Angeles Police Department, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) department.

      2. In making its determination, the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may hear from the owner, restaurant operator, or other interested party.

      3. The determination of the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners is final.
5. ###### Reversion of Uses


      1. Upon the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners’ determination to revoke any [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or permits issued to authorize an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may order the owner or restaurant operator to obtain all necessary permits to remove all improvements in the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may order the restaurant operator to obtain all necessary permits to restore the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and condition that existed prior to the development of the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or convert the [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to a conforming [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Scope of Decision


1. ###### Permit Suspension Period


      1. The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may determine that no new [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or permits authorizing an [outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be issued for a period of up to 12 consecutive months, as counted from the date the revocation determination is made by the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners.
