      2. Each violation of the Code and each day of operation without a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is a misdemeanor.
6. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.


### Div. 13B.7. Division of Land

#### Sec. 13B.7.1. General Provisions

1. ##### Purpose


1. The purpose of this Division (Division of Land) is to process requests for the division of land, within the City of Los Angeles, to provide for the dedication of land, the payment of fees in lieu thereof, or a combination of both, for the acquisition and development of park and recreation sites and facilities to serve the future inhabitants of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and to supplement the provisions of the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) concerning the design, improvement and survey data of [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and the form and content of [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

2. The established procedures to be followed in securing the official approval of the City of Los Angeles on such maps must be done pursuant to [Div. 13B.7. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7), in a manner that is consistent with the applicable [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s as well as state law and the public health, safety and welfare.

3. It is also the intention of this Division (Division of Land) that the subdividing of land in the City of Los Angeles be done in accordance with the grading regulations of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) contained and set forth in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Article 1. (Buildings \[Building Code\])](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172105) and to establish when possible beauty and attractiveness in the hills consistent with watershed drainage, erosion and fire control requirements, and good engineering practices.

4. Time limits expressed in this Division (Division of Land) shall be consistent with the state [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) where applicable and as the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may amended from time to time.
2. ##### Applicability


1. For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) the processes in this Division (Division of Land) are established by the regulations in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7. (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) of this Code. For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter the processes in this Division (Division of Land) are established by the regulations in [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11).

2. ###### Interpretation


      This Division, [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) shall not be interpreted or construed to invalidate any previous act on the part of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approving or authorizing [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or authorizing the issuance of [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s served by [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

3. ###### Subdivision Violation


      Any deed of conveyance, sale, or contract to sell made contrary to the provisions of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) review regulations of this Division is voidable to the extent and in the same manner as is provided for in [Subdivision Map Act, Sec. 66499.32 (Remedies)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66499.32.&lawCode=GOV).
3. ##### Advisory Agency


1. ###### Establishment


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) acts in the capacity of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the City pursuant to [Subdivision Map Act, Sec. 66415 (Definitions)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66415.&lawCode=GOV) and the [City Charter, Sec. 553 (Director of Planning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2457).The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is authorized to act in such capacity through one or more deputies who are appointed by him/her for that purpose. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), with the concurrence of the Chief [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), may designate an Associate [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to perform these additional functions.

2. ###### Authorities and Duties


      1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is charged with the duty of making investigations and reports on the design and improvement of proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, of requiring the dedication of land, the payment of fees in lieu thereof, or a combination of both, for the acquisition and development of park and recreation sites and facilities, and is hereby authorized to approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and such maps as are provided for herein, to prescribe the design, kinds, nature and extent of improvements required to be installed in connection therewith and to report directly to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the action taken on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. In taking any such action, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is authorized to include or omit in whole or in part the reports or recommendations of the other concerned officials or City departments, except that the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may not omit any mandatory requirements relating to public health or safety recommended by such other officials or departments in the exercise of their duties prescribed by law. Before approving the omission of any report or recommendation made by such officials or departments the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit the matter to the members of the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for consideration at a regular meeting.
4. ##### Subdivision Committee


1. ###### Establishment


      There is hereby created a [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Committee.

2. ###### Composition


      1. This committee is composed of the following officers of the City or their duly authorized representatives:

         1. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         2. The Superintendent of Building;

         3. The Chief Engineer of the Department of Fire;

         4. The Chief Engineer and General Manager of the Department of Water and Power;

         5. The General Manager of the Department of General Services;

         6. The General Manager of the Department of Recreation and Parks;

         7. The General Manager of the Department of Transportation; and

         8. The Director of the Bureau of Street Lighting of the Department of Public Works.
      2. For purposes of reviewing and submitting recommendations to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on [mobile home park](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) closure impact reports pursuant to [Chapter IV. (Public Welfare), Sec. 47.09 (Mobile home Park Closure Report)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-132944) of this Code only, the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also include a representative of the Rent Stabilization Division of the Los Angeles Housing Department, in addition to the above listed representatives.
3. ###### Authorities and Duties


      1. It shall be the duty of the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to meet with the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and make recommendations upon all [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) maps, and other matters that are presented to it by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The Committee shall hold regular meetings for this purpose. All such meetings shall be open to the public and any persons having an interest in pending maps may be heard.

      2. The General Manager of the Department of Recreation and Parks shall submit a report to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) respecting each [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for [subdivision approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Said report shall contain recommendations, approved by the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners, specifying the land to be dedicated, the payment of fees in lieu thereof, or a combination of both for the acquisition and development of park or recreational sites and facilities to serve the future inhabitants of such [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), all in accordance with the limitations specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Section 17.12 (Park and Recreation Site Acquisition and Development Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-14365) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 11.1.3.N. (Park and Recreation Sites)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter. To the extent possible, the report shall also specify when the development of the park or recreational facilities will be commenced.

#### Sec. 13B.7.2. Parcel Map Exemption/Lot Line Adjustment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.2.1.png.webp?itok=HEN1F4Ga)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.2.1.png?itok=UR-_bF8h)

Reference: [California Government Code, Sec. 66412](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66412.&lawCode=GOV).

1. ##### Applicability


This Section establishes a process to exempt [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations in two situations:

1. Land divisions that are exempt from [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) review by state law; and

2. Lot Line Adjustments.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Exemption/Lot Line Adjustment is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for the initial decision on a [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Exemption/ Lot Line Adjustment, and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and approve or deny or Lot Line Adjustment.

      2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the decision to the applicant and all persons to whom notification of the [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required by law.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


A Lot Line Adjustment is exempt from the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations if the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that all the following conditions exist:

1. A Lot Line Adjustment is made between four or fewer existing adjoining lots or parcels and the land taken from one lot or parcel is added to an adjoining lot or parcel;

2. The resulting number of lots or parcels remains the same or decreases; and

3. The parcels or lots resulting from the Lot Line Adjustment will conform to the local [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), any applicable coastal, specific, and community plans, and zoning and building ordinances.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


An approved Lot Line Adjustment does not expire. The approval is effective unless the applicant chooses to divide its property in a way that requires further [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) review.

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Subdivision Appeal


      The action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be appealed in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.8. (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8).
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.7.3. Tentative Tract Map

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.3.1.png.webp?itok=QvLa-zOY)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.3.1.png?itok=W7PIOf5d)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. A “ [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)” is a map made to show the design of a proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) creating five or more [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, five or more [condominium](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or five or more units in a [community apartment project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and showing the existing conditions in and around it and need not be based upon an accurate or detailed final survey of the property.

2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including all required materials, is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 10 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the city, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 10 days | •Owners of all property located within 500 feet of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); <br>•All residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of all property located within 500 feet of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing — Condominium and Stock Cooperative Notice


      1. The following provisions apply only to cases where property is proposed for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) into condominiums, [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or community apartments, whether by new construction or by conversion of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In these cases, notice of the public hearing shall also be given to tenants as provided in this Subdivision.

      2. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 15 days | •In addition to the notice provided in Subdivision 1. (Notice of Public Hearing) above, all names shown on a current list of tenants of the property proposed for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide the current list, which shall include the name and address of one tenant in each rental unit on the property. |

      3. In addition to the notice provisions for the public hearing, additional notice requirements may apply pursuant to: [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.95.2 (Conversion Projects: Residential)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-10386) and [Sec. 12.95.3 (Conversion Projects: Commercial/Industrial)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-118701); or [Div. 11.5. (Condominiums, Community Apartments, & Stock Cooperatives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.5) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), as applicable.

      4. ###### Notice of Subdivision Approval


         1. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall give written notice of any [subdivision approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to at least one tenant in each rental unit on the property within 30 days of the approval.

         2. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or record owner of the property for which a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is pending or approved shall give notice of that fact to any prospective tenant of the property before entering into any written or oral rental agreement with the prospective tenant.

         3. This Subdivision may be enforced through a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) condition or a covenant running with the land.
3. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal by the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | As required by state law | • [Subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>•Appellant;<br>• [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>• [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (only on appeal to the City Council); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Recommendation of Subdivision Committee


      1. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall forthwith furnish a copy of the certified list of names and addresses and a copy of the area map to the Bureau of Engineering and copies of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to each member of the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to any other departments or public agencies which the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) had determined may have an interest in the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall examine the map and property, and submit their reports and recommendations to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as follows:

         1. The reports must be submitted in writing.

         2. The reports shall be made within 39 calendar days after the map is filed. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may extend this time period.
      3. The [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Committee shall submit copies of their reports to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) when they are submitted to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). This requirement is complied with when the reports or recommendations are mailed. Failure of any member of the committee to submit a timely report in writing is construed as indicating that the member has no recommendation to submit concerning the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Action of Advisory Agency


      1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not act upon any [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) until 39 days’ time has elapsed from the filing of the map, unless reports have been received from each member of the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Where said reports have been mailed to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the 39-day period, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not act until five days’ time has elapsed from the date of mailing of a copy of all such reports to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Every Tentative [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be considered by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at a public meeting.

      2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall conduct a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section, and approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 50 calendar days after the map is filed with the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. When the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) takes action on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

         1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall report its action in writing directly to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and a copy of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) showing the action taken by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on it shall be returned to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         2. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Department of Transportation shall be notified of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action.
5. ###### Condition Consistency


      If the final [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) imposes a condition as part of an action on a related [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that differs from a condition of approval on a Tentative [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to make the Tentative [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conditions consistent with the final [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a Tentative [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that:

1. The proposed map will be/is consistent with applicable General and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

2. The design and improvement of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are consistent with applicable General and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

3. The site is physically suitable for the proposed type of development;

4. The site is physically suitable for the proposed density of development;

5. The design of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the proposed improvements are not likely to cause substantial environmental damage or substantially and avoidably injure fish or wildlife or their habitat;

6. The design of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the proposed improvements are not likely to cause serious public health problems;

7. The design of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the proposed improvements will not conflict with [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s acquired by the public at large for access through or use of property within the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

8. The design of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will provide, to the extent feasible, for future passive or natural heating or cooling opportunities in the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. ###### General


      See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. ###### Time Limit for Final Map Filing


      1. Within 36 months after the approval or conditional approval of the Tentative [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall cause the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to be accurately surveyed and a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d and filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The failure of a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to file a map with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within that period and to have the map submitted by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the City Clerk within the specified time limit shall automatically terminate and void the proceedings unless the time is extended by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), upon appeal from a denial of the extension by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The time limit for filing the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and submittal by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be extended for a period or periods not exceeding a total of 72 months.

      3. ###### Exception


         The term of a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval shall be automatically extended pursuant to the provisions of California Government Code, [Sec. 66452.21](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.21.&lawCode=GOV), [Sec. 66452.22](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.22.&lawCode=GOV), and [Sec. 66452.23](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.23.&lawCode=GOV).
3. ###### Disapproval and Subsequent Approval


      When the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has disapproved a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of a proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), it may subsequently approve a new [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the same property if it determines that arrangements are included to correct the conditions that caused the original disapproval, within the time limits specified in Subdivision 2. (Time Limit for Final Map Filing) above.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

3. ###### Appeal Board


      1. ###### Filing


         Appeals to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be filed in duplicate, in a public office of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on forms provided for that purpose within 10 days of the date of mailing of the written decision of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and shall be accompanied by the fee required in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter. No appeal shall be considered filed until the form has been properly completed and all information required by it has been submitted. The completed appeal form and file shall then immediately be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Secretary for a public hearing before the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. ###### Who May File


         The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), any member of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or any other interested person adversely affected by the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may appeal any action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with respect to the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the kind, nature or extent of the improvement required to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. ###### Hearing and Notice


         1. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), upon notice to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellant, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any other parties required to be noticed by Subsection C.3. (Notice; Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal) above, shall hear the appeal within 30 days after it is filed, unless the time to act is extended by mutual agreement.

         2. At the time established for the hearing, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear the testimony of the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellant, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any witnesses on their behalf. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may also hear the testimony of other persons with respect to the character of the neighborhood in which the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is to be located, the kind, nature and extent of improvements, the quality or kinds of development to which the area is best adapted or any other phase of the matter into which the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may desire to inquire.
      4. ###### Decision


         1. Upon conclusion of the hearing, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall within 10 days render its decision on the appeal based upon the testimony and documents produced before it.

         2. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may sustain, modify, reject, or overrule any recommendations or ruling of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and shall make findings consistent with the provisions of this Section and the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         3. Failure to timely act is deemed a denial of the appeal. The decision from which the appeal was taken shall be deemed affirmed and an appeal may be filed and taken to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### City Council


      1. ###### Who May File


         The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), any member of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or any other interested person adversely affected by the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may appeal any action of the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. ###### Filing


         Appeals to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be filed in duplicate, in a public office of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the forms provided for that purpose within 10 days of the date of mailing of the written decision of the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and shall be accompanied by the fee required in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter. No appeal shall be considered filed until the form has been properly completed and all information required by it has been submitted. The completed appeal form and file shall then immediately be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the City Clerk for a public hearing before the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. ###### Hearing and Notice


         1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear the appeal within 30 days after it is filed, unless the time to act is extended by mutual agreement. The Council shall give notice of the hearing to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellant, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any other parties required to be noticed by Subsection C.3 (Notice; Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal) above.

         2. At the time established for the hearing, the Council or its Committee shall hear the testimony of the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellant, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any witnesses on their behalf. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may also hear the testimony of other competent persons with respect to the character of the neighborhood in which the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is to be located, the kind, nature and extent of improvements, the quality or kinds of development to which the area is best adapted or any other phase of the matter into which the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may desire to inquire.
      4. ###### Decision


         1. Upon conclusion of the hearing, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall within 10 days render its decision on the appeal based upon the testimony and documents produced before it.

         2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may sustain, modify, reject, or overrule any recommendations or ruling of the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and shall make findings consistent with the provisions of this Section and the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         3. Failure to timely act is deemed a denial of the appeal. The decision from which the appeal was taken shall be deemed affirmed. It shall be the duty of the City Clerk to issue the decision. Note: See [California Government Code, Sec. 66452.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.5.&lawCode=GOV).
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant modifications to any of the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821), or [Article 11 (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) on its own initiative or upon recommendation of any member of the [Subdivision Committee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) whenever the property to be divided is of such size or shape, is subject to such title limitations of record, is affected by such topographical location or subsurface or topographical conditions, is to be devoted to such use, is subject to such regulation by the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1. (General Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107492) that it is impractical to conform to the strict [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the requirements of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, or [Article 11 (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.

2. Such modification may be made by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) prior to its action on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) without specific or written [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) therefore by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. After the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been acted upon by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), however, no such modification may be granted by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) except upon compliance with the following requirements:

      1. A request for modification shall be submitted by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in writing, setting forth the facts relied upon.

      2. Such request shall clearly indicate that the modification is reasonably necessary and is in conformity with the spirit and intent of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 11 (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, and the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. The actions of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a request for a modification after approval of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be appealed in the same manner and subject to the same restrictions which apply to appeals from the action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. However, in no event shall such appeals be construed as extending the time limit within which to record a [Final Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

5. ###### Modification of Conditions


      The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is authorized to approve or disapprove requests by a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for minor modifications in the Conditions of Approval for a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), but such action shall not extend the time for filing of a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Such decisions shall be made in accordance with the provisions of this Section and shall be subject to the same appeal as is provided for appeals from the decisions of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
9. ##### Vesting Tentative Map


1. ###### Applicability


      Whenever the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to be filed, the applicant may choose to file a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) instead. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not require the filing of a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as a prerequisite to any approval for any proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), permit for construction or work preparatory to construction.

2. ###### Filing an Application


      1. A [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be filed on the same form and have the same contents, accompanying data and reports and shall be processed in the same manner as set forth in this Section for a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) except as hereinafter provided. At the time a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed, it shall have printed conspicuously on its face the words “Vesting Tentative Map”. If it is known at the time of filing that an additional approval (such as a [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Coastal Development Permit) is necessary, the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for such additional approval shall be filed prior to or simultaneously with the [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. At the time a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed, a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide all information required in connection with the filing of a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by this Code, including the information required by [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.06 B. and C. (Tentative Map and Appeals)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122338).

      3. Where the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is in a designated Hillside Area, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall require the filing of a proposed grading plan pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.05 L. (Design Standards; Grading Plans)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122100) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Section 11.1.3.J. (Subdivision Design Standards; Grading Plans)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), and may not waive the requirement to file preliminary soils report pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.05 U. (Design Standards; Preliminary Soils Report)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122100) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Sec. 11.1.3.Q. (Subdivision Design Standards; Preliminary Soils Report)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

      4. A [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also indicate whether the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is in the vicinity of the Mulholland Scenic Parkway and the dedication of land for such purposes may be necessary. In addition, if design review of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required by the applicable community or district plan or by a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide the information necessary for such review. The plan of building envelope shall be submitted, showing the height, size, number of units and approximate location of buildings, driveways and any proposed exterior garden walls.
3. ###### Expiration


      The approval or conditional approval of a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) expires at the end of the same time period, and is subject to the same extensions established by Subsection F. (Scope of Decision) of this Section for the expiration and extension of the approval or conditional approval of a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Development Rights


      1. The approval or conditional approval of a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall confer:

         1. A vested right to proceed with development in substantial compliance with the ordinances, policies, and standards in effect on the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete; and

         2. With the conditions of approval imposed and specifically enumerated by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including the submittal of a detailed grading plan under an approved grading permit prior to recordation of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      2. These development rights do not include exemptions from subsequent changes in the Building and Safety and Fire regulations ( [Chapter V.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-135598) and [Chapter IX.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code) and policies and related standards.

      3. A permit, approval, extension, or entitlement of a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be conditioned or denied if the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, determines:

         1. A failure to do so would place the occupants of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the immediate community, or both, in a condition dangerous to their health or safety, or both; or

         2. The condition or denial is required in order to comply with state or federal law.
      4. The rights conferred by a map approved or conditionally approved pursuant to this Section expire if a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is not recorded prior to the expiration of the [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as provided in Subdivision 3. (Expiration) above. If the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is recorded, the rights conferred by this Section are effective for the following time period:

         1. An initial time period of two years beyond the recording of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Where several [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are recorded on various phases of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) covered by a single [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), this initial time period begins for each phase when the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the phase is recorded. Note: See [California Government Code, Sec. 66498.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66498.5.&lawCode=GOV).

         2. The initial time period set forth in Subparagraph i. above is automatically extended by any time used thereafter by the City to process a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a grading permit or for design or architectural review, if that time exceeds 30 days, from the date a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for that permit or review is filed.

         3. A [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may apply to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a one-year extension at any time before expiration of the initial time period set forth in Subparagraph i. above. Denial of the time extension may be appealed to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 15 days by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         4. If the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) submits a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) during the periods of time specified in Subparagraphs i.-iii. above, the rights conferred by this Section continue until that permit expires.
      5. Consistent with Paragraph a. and Paragraph b. above, an approved or conditionally approved [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not limit the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from imposing reasonable conditions on subsequently required approvals or permits necessary for the development and authorized by the ordinances, policies, and standards described in Paragraph a. and Paragraph b. above.

      6. If the ordinances, policies, or standards described in Paragraph a. and Paragraph b. above are changed subsequent to the approval or conditional approval of a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

         1. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or his or her assignee, at any time prior to the expiration of the [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), may apply for an amendment to the [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to secure a vested right to proceed with the changed ordinances, policies, or standards.

         2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall clearly specify the changed ordinances, policies, or standards for which the amendment is sought. In addition, such [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall conform to the provisions relating to modifications of [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s set forth in Subsection H. (Modification of Entitlement) above.
5. ###### Development inconsistent With Zoning – Conditional Approval


      1. Whenever a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) files a [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) whose intended development is inconsistent with this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code in existence at that time, that inconsistency shall be noted on the map.

      2. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may deny the [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or approve it conditioned on the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) obtaining the necessary change in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code to eliminate the inconsistency. If the change in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code is obtained, the approved or conditionally approved [vesting tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall confer the vested right to proceed with the development (superseding Paragraphs a. and b. above) in substantial compliance with the change in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, as approved.

      3. The rights conferred by this Subdivision continue for the time periods set forth in Subdivision 4.d. (Development Rights) above.

#### Sec. 13B.7.4. Final Tract Map

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.4.1.png.webp?itok=dbG5IJsy)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.4.1.png?itok=XXuZva_n)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to the approval of a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved.

2. ##### Initiation


1. A [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in compliance with the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 11 (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter. [Final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall conform substantially to the approved [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. When a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) covers only a portion of the property shown on the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), it shall be submitted to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for its approval prior to submission to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### City Engineer Certification


      1. In addition to the certificates required by the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall certify that the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the approved [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and the required public improvements have been installed or agreed to be installed.

      2. If any portion of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located in a [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), it shall not be certified by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) until the Superintendent of Building submits a report that the [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is or will be graded in accordance with approved plans as required by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Article 1. (Buildings \[Building Code\])](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172105) of this Code, and that the applicant has entered into an agreement to provide the necessary grading.
3. ###### City Council Acceptance


      After the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) certifies the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in any offers of dedication, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will approve or disapprove the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in accordance with [California Government Code, Sec. 66458](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66458.&lawCode=GOV).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. The [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be accepted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provided:

      1. The necessary improvements as set forth in the approval of the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) have been installed and approved by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or provided the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) submits satisfactory improvement plans together with the necessary guarantee that the improvements will be installed.

      2. The required map checking fees have been paid by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. All checking has been completed by the various departments and public agencies.

      4. Taxes, liens and special assessments have been paid, or such payment guaranteed.
2. ###### Park and Recreation Site Acquisition and Development Provisions


      No final [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) map shall be approved, nor shall it be recorded, unless land within the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been dedicated to the City of Los Angeles for park or recreational purposes or the park and recreation impact fee has been paid pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.33 (Park Fees and Land Dedication)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-9860) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 10.4. (Parks Fees & Dedications)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.4) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may refuse to approve the recording of any such map that does not by itself provide adequate or satisfactory access, design, or improvements.

2. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may refuse to approve the recording of a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) covering only a portion of a [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), when in the process of checking the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), he determines that it will not be feasible from an engineering standpoint to construct satisfactory improvements in the reduced area, unless additional street or [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) dedications and improvements beyond the boundaries of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are provided.

3. No [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be recorded until the required improvements are installed or suitably guaranteed to be installed.
7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Recorded Final Tract Map


1. In addition to amendments to [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s authorized by [California Government Code, Sec. 66469 (Correction and Amendment of Maps)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66469.&lawCode=GOV), after a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the Los Angeles County Recorder, such recorded map, including the conditions of approval thereof, may be modified pursuant to the provisions of this Section. The provisions of this Section are not applicable to certificates of correction or amending maps filed pursuant to [California Government Code, Sec. 66469 (Correction and Amendment of Maps)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66469.&lawCode=GOV).

2. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for certificates of correction or amending maps filed pursuant to this Section may be filed with the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The filing and processing of such [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, including appeals, shall conform to the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.3. (Tentative Tract Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3) relating to the filing and processing of modifications of [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

      1. In addition to such requirements, a public hearing shall be held by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and 10 days notice thereof shall be published in a newspaper of general circulation and mailed to the applicant and to the owners of all property located within 500 feet of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (as shown on records of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and on the records of the County Assessor for property located outside of the City of Los Angeles).

      2. Written notice shall also be mailed to residential, commercial and industrial occupants of all property, within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved. This requirement can be met by mailing such notice to “occupant”. This notice shall also conform to the requirements of [California Government Code, Sec. 66451.3](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66451.3.&lawCode=GOV).

      3. Notice of the public hearing shall be posted, by the applicant, in a conspicuous place on the property involved at least 10 days prior to the date of the public hearing.

      4. Consideration of and action on such [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be limited to the proposed modifications.
3. No such modification or amending map may be approved unless the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal finds each of the following:

      1. That there are changes in circumstances which make any or all of the conditions of such map no longer appropriate or necessary;

      2. That the modifications do not impose any additional burden on the present fee owner of the property;

      3. That the modifications do not alter any right, title or interest in the real property reflected on the recorded map;

      4. That the map and conditions as modified conform to the provisions of [California Government Code, Sec. 66474](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66474.&lawCode=GOV) and this Code; and

      5. That the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has given consideration, among other factors, to the effects of the modifications on surrounding properties.
4. Modifications and amending maps shall be governed by the following limitations.

      1. No modifications involving increases in density shall be allowed which would change the density of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as approved on appeal by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), where such density was the subject of the appeal to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Modifications involving increases in density over that originally approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in approving the [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be limited as follows:

         1. For [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of fewer than 10 [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, any density increase shall be limited to one [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

         2. For [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s containing 10 or more [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, any increase shall be limited to not more than 10 percent of that originally approved.
      3. Modifications involving either increase in the height of structures, or in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of building pads where the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of such pads has been specified by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), shall be limited as follows:

         1. An increase in the height of structures of not more than 10 percent above the approved height of such structures;

         2. An increase in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of building pads of not more than five feet above the approved [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of such pads; or

         3. Any such increase in height or [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not obstruct the view from surrounding properties. A greater increase in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of building pads may be approved if such increase has been determined to be necessary for health and safety reasons by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      4. No modifications shall be permitted which violate the intent of any of the original conditions of the [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval as that intent is expressed in the findings or otherwise by the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. An amending map or certificate of correction shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder in the manner specified in [California Government Code, Sec. 66472](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66472.&lawCode=GOV). If the modification of one or more conditions does not require an amending map or certificate of correction, the approval of the modification shall be evidenced in a letter mailed to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and made a part of the subject tract file.

#### Sec. 13B.7.5. Preliminary Parcel Map

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.5.1.png.webp?itok=ADtHRId2)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.5.1.png?itok=h0v6A-p1)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. No land shall be separated in ownership or otherwise divided into two, three, or four parcels or condominiums, and no such divided parcel or condominium shall be separately maintained unless the division conforms to that shown on a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) which has been approved by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder.

2. This Section does not apply to divisions of land that are exempt from the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Reference: See [California Government Code, Sec. 66412](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66412.&lawCode=GOV).

3. ###### Waiver of Parcel Map


      1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may waive [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s required by this Division if the proposed division of land complies with all applicable requirements established by the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [California Government Code, Sec. 66410 et seq.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?division=2.&chapter=1.&lawCode=GOV&title=7.&article=1.)) or this Code as to area, improvement and design, floodwater drainage control, appropriate improved public roads, sanitary disposal facilities, water supply availability, environmental protection, and other requirements of the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or this Code, provided that in waiving such a [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may receive a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. A request for a waiver of a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be submitted by the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in a form acceptable to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Notice of the action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon such a request shall be given to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to all persons to whom notification of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required by law. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action on a request for a waiver of a [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be appealed in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.8. (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8). Provided that in overruling an [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) denial of such a request for a waiver of a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make the findings required by Subdivision 3.a. (Waiver) above.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including all required materials, is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 10 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the city, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 10 days | •Owners of all property located within 500 feet of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); <br>•All residential, commercial, and industrial occupants of all property located within 500 feet of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property |
2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing — Condominium and Stock Cooperative Notice


      1. The following provisions apply only to cases where property is proposed for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) into condominiums, [stock cooperative](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or community apartments, whether by new construction or by conversion of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In these cases, notice of the public hearing shall also be given to tenants as provided in this Subdivision.

      2. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 15 days | •In addition to the notice provided in Subdivision 1. (Notice of Public Hearing) above, all names shown on a current list of tenants of the property proposed for [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide the current list, which shall include the name and address of one tenant in each rental unit on the property. |

      3. In addition to the notice provisions for the public hearing, additional notice requirements may apply pursuant to: [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.95.2 (Conversion Projects: Residential)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-10386) and [Sec. 12.95.3 (Conversion Projects: Commercial/Industrial)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-10593) of this Code; or [Div. 11.5. (Condominiums, Community Apartments, & Stock Cooperatives)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.5) of this Chapter, as applicable.

      4. ###### Notice of Subdivision Approval


         1. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall give written notice of any [subdivision approval](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to at least one tenant in each rental unit on the property within 30 days of the approval.

         2. The [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or record owner of the property for which a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is pending or approved shall give notice of that fact to any prospective tenant of the property before entering into any written or oral rental agreement with the prospective tenant.

         3. This Subdivision may be enforced through a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) condition or a covenant running with the land.
3. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal by the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | As required by state law | • [Subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>•Appellant;<br>• [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>• [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal to the City Council); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing at which evidence shall be taken, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

      2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may waive the public hearing required in this Section if the applicant submits with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the written approval of the owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, and/or having a common corner with the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Recommendation of Other Agencies


      1. Upon receipt and acceptance of a properly prepared map, together with sufficient copies for appropriate City agencies, the Planning Department shall immediately forward copies to the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and, if in a Hillside Area, the Superintendent of Building for a report and recommendation.

      2. The [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Superintendent of Building shall make their reports within 21 days after the map is [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to them. If a geologic and soils engineering report is required for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I. and as specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.51 C. (Additional Reports)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122962), they shall make their reports within 35 days after the subject geologic and soils report is received. [Sec. 11.4.4. (Preliminary Parcel Map Review Considerations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.4) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) applies to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.

      3. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not take final action on any [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) until:

         1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) receives the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report, and a report from the Superintendent of Building if the proposed [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is in a Hillside Grading Area; or

         2. Until the expiration of the applicable period.
      4. A copy of the [preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be forwarded to the Chief Engineer of the Fire Department for report and recommendation to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The Chief Engineer shall submit the report within seven days after the map is [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Said report shall indicate whether the designated areas in which buildings are to be erected on each proposed parcel or lot, as shown on said map are less than 1,000 feet from a Los Angeles City Fire Department fire hydrant, said distance to be measured along a route providing reasonable access for the laying of fire hoses in an emergency, or whether adequate alternative [fire protection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) exists or is in the process of being provided for said parcel or lots.
5. ###### Action of Advisory Agency


      1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review and either approve, conditionally approve or disapprove the map within 30 days after map is filed, or within additional time as mutually agreed upon in writing by the applicant and the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If geology and soils reports are required as specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.51 C. (Filing of Preliminary Parcel Maps; Additional Reports)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122962) on lots subject to Chapter I., the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 44 days after the subject geologic and soils reports are submitted by the applicant or within additional time as mutually agreed upon in writing by the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). [Sec. 11.4.4. (Preliminary Parcel Map Review Considerations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.4) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) applies to [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.

      3. If the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) refers a matter back to an agency as provided for in Subdivision 6.c.
