(Modification of Requirements) below, the time limits for action by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are automatically extended for seven days.

      4. ###### Dedication


         1. When the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that the proposed [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with all the provisions of the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 11 (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, and no dedication or improvement is required, it shall approve the map.

         2. When a dedication or improvement is required, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve the proposed [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) subject to the conditions for dedications as described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.53 C. (Approval of Preliminary Parcel Map Standards of Review; Conditions of Approval)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123048) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Sec. 11.4.4. (Preliminary Parcel Map Review Considerations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.4) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, being complied with to the satisfaction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      5. ###### Disapproval


         If the [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is disapproved, the disapproval shall be in writing, shall set forth the reasons and clearly indicate where the proposed [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) would contradict any of these regulations, and shall be [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ###### Modification of Requirements


      1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may modify or waive any dedication or improvement requirements, if it determines such action is in the public interest.

      2. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may modify or waive the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the Design Standards for Streets and Alleys and the improvements required by this Section and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.05 (Design Standards)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122100) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Sec. 11.1.3. (Subdivision Design Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, when it finds that their strict [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) would result in practical difficulties or unnecessary hardships inconsistent with the general purposes and intent of these regulations.

      3. Before approving the omission of any of the above requirements, the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall refer the matter back to the agency, which originally recommended the requirement, and to any other involved agency for further report, with a statement of the reasons for its omission.

      4. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may not waive any mandatory requirements relating to public health or safety recommended by other officials or departments in the exercise of their duties prescribed by law.

      5. Where the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) elects to modify or waive requirements it shall do so within the time limit established in Subdivision 5. (Action of Advisory Agency) above. The modification or waiver shall be consistent with the intent of these [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations.
7. ###### Condition Consistency


      If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) imposes a condition as part of an action on a related [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that differs from a condition of approval on a [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may make the [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conditions consistent with the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action.

8. ###### Transmittal


      A copy of the determination shall be mailed to the applicant, and to the owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property and/or to all persons who have filed written requests for notice with the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a Preliminary [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that:

1. The proposed map will be/is consistent with applicable General and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

2. The design and improvement of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are consistent with applicable General and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

3. The site is physically suitable for the proposed type of development;

4. The site is physically suitable for the proposed density of development;

5. The design of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the proposed improvements are not likely to cause substantial environmental damage or substantially and avoidably injure fish or wildlife or their habitat;

6. The design of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the proposed improvements are not likely to cause serious public health problems;

7. The design of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the proposed improvements will not conflict with [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s acquired by the public at large for access through or use of property within the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

8. The design of the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will provide, to the extent feasible, for future passive or natural heating or cooling opportunities in the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. ###### General


      1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7 (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

      2. No [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be issued, and no [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be constructed, altered or maintained on any land, which has been separated in ownership or otherwise divided into two to four parcels in violation of the provisions of this Section, unless a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder. All conditions of approval shall be completed prior to recording the [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. Neither the approval or conditional approval of any [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall constitute or waive compliance with any other applicable provision of this Code, nor shall any such approval authorize or be deemed to authorize a violation or failure to comply with other applicable provisions of this Code.
2. ###### Time Limit for Final Map Filing


      1. Within 36 months after the approval or conditional approval of the Preliminary [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall cause the proposed [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to be accurately surveyed and a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) prepared and filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The failure of a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to file a map with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within that period and to have the map submitted by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the City Clerk within the specified time limit shall automatically terminate and void the proceedings unless the time is extended by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), upon appeal from a denial of the extension by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The time limit for the submittal by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be extended for a period or periods not exceeding a total of 72 months.

      3. ###### Exception


         The term of a [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval shall be automatically extended pursuant to the provisions of California Government Code, [Sec. 66452.21](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.21.&lawCode=GOV), [66452.22](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.22.&lawCode=GOV), and [66452.23](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66452.23.&lawCode=GOV).
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Subdivision Appeal


      The action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be appealed in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.8. (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8).
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant slight modifications to a [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon its own initiative or upon a request from a [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The modifications may be granted where it is impractical to conform to the strict application of the requirements of this Article for one or more of the following reasons relating to the property:

      1. Its size or shape;

      2. Title limitations of record;

      3. Topographical location or conditions, or subsurface conditions;

      4. The specific intended use; or

      5. The application of provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 1. (General Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107492) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or the application of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
3. A request for slight modification shall be submitted in a form acceptable to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. Notice of the action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be given to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to all persons to whom notification of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required by law.

5. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action on a slight modification request may be appealed in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.8. (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8).

6. The action of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a slight modification or an appeal from that action shall not extend the time for recording a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the Los Angeles County Recorder.
9. ##### Vesting Parcel Map


A [vesting preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be filed pursuant to the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.3.I. (Tentative Tract Map; Vesting Tentative Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3).


#### Sec. 13B.7.6. Final Parcel Map

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.6.1.png.webp?itok=8FpiSicN)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.6.1.png?itok=ycwDWfZt)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to the approval of a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after a [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved.

2. ##### Initiation


A [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be prepared and filed with the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in compliance with the provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 7 (Division of Land Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-121821) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 11 (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter. Said map shall conform substantially to the approved [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the approved tentative map, which was filed pursuant to the requirements contained in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.50 (Parcel Maps - General Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122901) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 11.4 (Parcel Maps)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Certification by City Engineer


      Within 20 days after receiving the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall examine it for the survey information shown thereon, and if satisfied that it is technically correct, shall certify the map in accordance with the provisions of the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### City Council Acceptance


      After the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) certifies the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in any offers of dedication, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will approve or disapprove the [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in accordance with [California Government Code, Sec. 66458 (Final Maps)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66458.&lawCode=GOV).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. The final map shall be accepted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provided that:

      1. The necessary improvements and grading or retaining structure construction, as set forth in the approval of the [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), have been installed and approved by the City, or provided the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) executes an Improvement Agreement and submits or agrees to submit:

         1. Improvement plans;

         2. Satisfactory grading or construction plans, where grading or construction of an engineered retaining [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required in [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s; and

         3. Improvement Securities, warranty guarantees, and labor and material payment securities in accordance with provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 17.08 G. (Improvements)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-122524) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Sec. 11.3.3. (Subdivision Improvements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.3.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
      2. All approvals have been obtained from [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) departments and other public agencies; and

      3. Any special assessment or bond required to be paid or guaranteed pursuant to [Subdivision Map Act, Sec. 66493(c)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66493.&lawCode=GOV) has been paid in full, or such payment has been guaranteed.
2. ###### Park and Recreation Site Acquisition and Development Provisions


      No final [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) map shall be approved, nor shall it be recorded, unless land within the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been dedicated to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for park or recreational purposes or the park and recreation impact fee has been paid pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.33 (Park Fees and Land Dedication)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-9860) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 10.4 (Parks Fees and Dedications)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.4) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


Each approved [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder shall contain the following statement: “The approval of this Parcel Map shall not be construed as having been based upon geological investigation such as will authorize the issuance of building permits on the subject property. Such permits will be issued only at such time as the Department of Building and Safety has received such topographic maps and geological reports as it deems necessary to justify the issuance of such building permits.”

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Recorded Final Parcel Map


1. In addition to amendments to [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s authorized by [California Government Code, Sec. 66469 (Correction and Amendment of Maps)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66469.&lawCode=GOV), after a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the Los Angeles County Recorder, such recorded map, including the conditions of approval thereof, may be modified pursuant to the provisions of this Section. The provisions of this Section are not applicable to certificates of correction or amending maps filed pursuant to [California Government Code, Sec. 66469 (Correction and Amendment of Maps)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66469.&lawCode=GOV).

2. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for certificates of correction or amending maps filed pursuant to this Section may be filed with the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The submittal of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and processing of such [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall conform to the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.5. (Preliminary Parcel Maps)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.5) relating to the filing and processing of modifications of [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

      1. The public notice and hearing shall conform to the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.3. (Tentative Tract Maps)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3). The decision of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be appealed in accordance with the applicable provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.8 (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8) of this Code relating to the appeal of [preliminary parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

      2. Consideration of and action on such [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be limited to the proposed modifications.
3. No such modification or amending map may be approved unless the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, finds each of the following:

      1. That there are changes in circumstances which make any or all of the conditions of such map no longer appropriate or necessary;

      2. That the modifications do not impose any additional burden on the present fee owner of the property;

      3. That the modifications do not alter any right, title or interest in the real property reflected on the recorded map;

      4. That the map and conditions as modified conform to the provisions of [California Government Code, Sec. 66474](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66474.&lawCode=GOV) and of this Code; and

      5. That the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has given consideration, among other factors, to the effects of the modifications on surrounding properties.
4. Modifications and amending maps shall be governed by the following limitations.

      1. No modifications involving increases in density shall be allowed which would change the density of a [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as approved on appeal by the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), where such density was the subject of the appeal to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Modifications involving increases in density shall not exceed the following:

         1. For [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of fewer than 10 lots or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, any density increase shall be limited to one lot or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

         2. For [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s containing 10 or more lots or [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, any increase shall be limited to not more than 10 percent of that originally approved.
      3. Modifications involving either increase in the height of structures, or in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of building pads where the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of such pads has been specified by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), shall be limited as follows:

         1. An increase in the height of structures of not more than 10 percent above the approved height of such structures;

         2. An increase in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of building pads of not more than five feet above the approved [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of such pads; or

         3. Any such increase in height or [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not obstruct the view from surrounding properties. A greater increase in the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of building pads may be approved if such increase has been determined to be necessary for health and safety reasons by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
      4. No modifications shall be permitted which violate the intent of any of the original conditions of the [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval as that intent is expressed in the findings or otherwise by the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. An amending map or certificate of correction shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder in the manner specified in [California Government Code, Sec. 66472 (Correction and Amendment of Maps)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66472.&lawCode=GOV). If the modification of one or more conditions does not require an amending map or certificate of correction, the approval of the modification shall be evidenced in a letter mailed to the [subdivider](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and made a part of the subject [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) file.

#### Sec. 13B.7.7. Private Street Map

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.7.1.png.webp?itok=mqUefK-r)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.7.1.png?itok=x6Kg98SC)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to the platting and division of land as lots or building sites, which are contiguous or adjacent to [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

2. As to a lot or building site described in Subdivision 1. above, a [Private Street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Map must be approved before a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is issued.

3. This Section does not apply if the property is part of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to approve a [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Tract Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [Private Street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Map is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall give notice consistent with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.7.3.C. (Tentative Tract Map; Notice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.3).

4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. All [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) maps and all prints or copies of maps as required in this Section shall be submitted to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for approval.
3. ###### Referral


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not act on any [Private Street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Map until the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Fire Department and the Department of Water and Power file their reports on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Reports from the Departments shall be submitted to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 30 days of the date they receive a request for the reports.
4. ###### Public Hearing


      1. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for public hearing at which evidence shall be taken, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may waive the public hearing required in this Section if the applicant submits with the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the written approval of all owners of properties adjacent or gaining access from the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). No appeal hearing shall be waived.

      3. With respect to [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s not set for public hearing, a copy of the determination shall be mailed to the applicant, and to the owners of properties adjacent or gaining access from the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to all persons who file written requests for notice with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ###### Decision


      1. Within 40 days after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove the map.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) its decision on the [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the applicant in writing.

      3. Any of the time limits specified in this Section may be extended by mutual consent of the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as the case may be.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. ###### General


      The following standards apply to approval of a [Private Street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Map:

      1. The [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s comply with [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 8 (Private Street Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-14933) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 10.3. (Private Street Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter;

      2. Adequate and safe vehicular access to the property exists from a public street over a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for police, fire, sanitation and public service vehicles;

      3. An adequate water supply is available for domestic and firefighting purposes;

      4. An approved method of sewage disposal is available;

      5. The lot or building site is graded and engineered in accordance with the grading regulations of the City as set forth in [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Article 1. (Buildings \[Building Code\])](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172105) of this Code; and

      6. Any proposed name of a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved by the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The proposed street name shall not create confusion, be misleading, be unduly long, or carry connotations offensive to good taste and decency.
2. ###### Offer to Dedicate Easements


      1. Where it is necessary to acquire public [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) rights, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require an offer to dedicate [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The offer shall be properly executed by all parties having a record interest, including beneficiaries under deeds of trust, as shown by a current preliminary title report. The title report shall be prepared by a title company approved by the Bureau of Engineering for that purpose. The report shall be furnished by the applicant.

      3. The offer shall:

         1. Be on a form approved by the City Attorney and the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         2. Binding on the owner and its heirs, assigns or successors in interest;

         3. Continue until the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) accepts or rejects it;

         4. Shall provide that the dedication is complete upon the acceptance by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         5. The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve or disapprove the offer for recordation within 10 days after it is filed;

         6. The offer shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder upon its approval by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

         7. The recorded offer shall be promptly presented and processed by the City Departments concerned and submitted to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), in order to complete the dedication within the earliest possible time. If the offer is rejected by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Bureau of Right of Way and Land shall issue a release from such offer which shall be recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder. When said Bureau approves the offer to dedicate, it shall notify the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. No [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be issued for the erection of buildings on lots or building sites which are contiguous or adjacent to [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s unless the following requirements have been met:

      1. That the [Private Street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Map shall have been duly approved and written findings made as to the conditions of approval thereof.

      2. That the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall certify to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that the conditions, if any, required by said written findings have been fulfilled in a satisfactory manner and that a permit may be issued.
2. The [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval shall be void unless all conditions of approval are completed or fulfilled within six years from the date of approval, except that grading and improvement conditions are fulfilled if the required work is begun during that time limit and diligently carried on to completion.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. An applicant or any other person aggrieved by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s initial decision may file an appeal to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The appeal shall be filed within 15 days after [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision is mailed.
4. ###### Decision


      1. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider the appeal within 30 days after the 15-day appeal period expires.

      2. Within 14 days after the appeal is considered, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall affirm, modify, or reverse the action or determination. The action of the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be final.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the Board on appeal from a determination of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), after a recommendation from the Board of Public Works, or the Department of Water and Power, or in the exercise of sound, reasonable judgment, may grant modifications from the requirements of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 8 (Private Street Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-14933) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 10.3. (Private Street Regulations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, only if the modifications are necessary because of the size, use, physical or other conditions or [private road easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the property contiguous or adjacent thereto.


#### Sec. 13B.7.8. Subdivision Appeal

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.8.1.png.webp?itok=XTN88u5U)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.7.8.1.png?itok=BjnLmJWS)

1. ##### Applicability


1. Each Section of this Division either establishes an appeals process, or indicates that an appeal is not available. This Section supplements those Sections. The appeal processes established for an individual procedure supersede this Section to the extent that they are inconsistent.

2. An applicant or any other person claiming to be aggrieved by an action or determination of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with respect to a [Preliminary Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), certificate or conditional certificate of compliance pursuant to [California Government Code, Sec. 66499.35 (Remedies)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66499.35.&lawCode=GOV) or an exemption from the [Parcel Map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations pursuant to [Sec. 13B.7.2 (Parcel Map Exemption/Lot Line Adjustment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.2) may appeal to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a public hearing.
2. ##### Initiation


1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [Subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. Appeals must be filed within a period of 15 days after the date the initial decision was made.

3. The appeal is not considered filed unless and until the form is properly completed and all required information is submitted.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | As required by state law | •Applicant;<br>•The person claiming to be aggrieved, if any; <br>•The [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. The complete appeal form and file shall be immediately [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Secretary for hearing before the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear the appeal within 30 days after the expiration of the appeal period. Within 14 days after the appeal is considered, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall affirm, modify, or reverse the action or determination.

      3. At the time established for the hearing, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hear the testimony of the applicant and witnesses in his/her behalf, the testimony of any [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, if there are any, and the testimony of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any witnesses on its behalf. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may also hear the testimony of other competent persons respecting the character of the neighborhood in which the division of land is to be located, the kinds, nature and extent of improvements, the quality or kinds of development to which the area is best adapted or any other relevant phase of the matter into which the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may desire to inquire.

      4. Upon conclusion of the hearing, the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall within 14 days declare findings based upon the testimony and documents produced before it.

      5. The [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may sustain, modify, reject, or overrule any recommendation or ruling of the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and may make findings consistent with applicable provisions of this Division.

      6. Failure to timely act is deemed a denial of the appeal and the decision from which the appeal was taken shall be deemed affirmed.

      7. Any of the time limits specified in this Division may be extended by mutual consent of the applicant and the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Appeal Board](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

### Div. 13B.8. Historic Preservation

#### Sec. 13B.8.1. General Provisions

1. ##### Purpose


As a matter of public policy, the recognition, preservation, enhancement, and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and areas within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) having [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), architectural, [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or aesthetic significance are required in the interest of the health, economic prosperity, [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) enrichment and general welfare of the people. This Division (Historic Preservation) is designed to:

1. Protects and enhances the use of buildings, structures, [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and areas, which are reminders of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s history, or which are unique and irreplaceable assets to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and its neighborhoods, or which are worthy examples of past architectural styles;

2. Develops and maintains the appropriate settings and environment to preserve these buildings, structures, landscaping, [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and areas;

3. Enhances property values, stabilize neighborhoods and/or communities, render property eligible for financial benefits, and promote tourist trade and interest;

4. Fosters public appreciation of the beauty of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), of the accomplishments of its past as reflected through its buildings, structures, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and areas;

5. Promotes education by preserving and encouraging interest in [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), social, economic, political and architectural phases of its history;

6. Promotes the involvement of all aspects of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s diverse neighborhoods in the historic preservation process; and

7. Ensures that all procedures comply with the [California Environmental Quality Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)).
2. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      This Division (Historic Preservation) applies to any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)).

2. ###### Exemptions


      This Division (Historic Preservation) does not apply to the following:

      1. The correction of Emergency or Hazardous Conditions where the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Los Angeles Housing Department, or other enforcement agency has determined that emergency or hazardous conditions currently exist and the emergency or hazardous conditions must be corrected in the interest of the public health, safety and welfare. When feasible, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), Los Angeles Housing Department, or other enforcement agency should consult with the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on how to correct the hazardous condition, consistent with the goals of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). However, any other work shall comply with the provisions of this Division (Historic Preservation).

      2. Department of Public Works improvements located, in whole or in part, within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

         1. Where the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds:

            1. That the certified [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not identify any [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s located within the [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and/or where the [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is not specifically addressed in the approved Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

            2. Where the Department of Public Works has completed the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) review of the proposed improvement, and the review has determined that the improvement is exempt from [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or will have no potentially significant environmental impacts.
         2. The relevant Historic Preservation Board shall be notified of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), given a description of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and an opportunity to comment.
      3. Work authorized by an approved [Historical Property Contract](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. Where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been designated as a City [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), unless proposed for demolition. However, those properties with federal or state historic designation which are not designated as [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or do not have a [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [Historical Property Contract](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are not exempt from review under this Division (Historic Preservation).

      5. Where work consists of repair to existing structural elements and foundations with no physical change to the exterior of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      6. Where work consists of [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that do not result in a change to an exterior feature.

      7. Where the type of work has been specifically deemed exempt from review as set forth in the approved Preservation Plan for a specific [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ###### Authority of Cultural Heritage Commission Not Affected


      Nothing in this Division (Historic Preservation) supersedes or overrides the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s authority as provided in [Sec. 22.171, et seq.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-48551) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Publicly Owned Property


      The provisions of this Division (Historic Preservation) shall apply to any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which is owned or leased by a public entity to the extent permitted by law.
3. ##### Definitions


The following definitions apply to this Division (Historic Preservation):

Addition: An extension or increase in floor area or height of a building or structure.

Alteration: Any exterior change or modification of a building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or lot within a Historic Preservation Overlay Zone including but not limited to changing exterior paint color, removal of significant trees or [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), installation or removal of fencing, and similar [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and including street features, furniture or fixtures.

Building Coverage: The area of a parcel covered by buildings measured from the outside of the exterior perimeter of a building, including covered porches, patios, and any detached or attached accessory structures. Building Coverage does not include uncovered areas such as paved [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), driveways, walkways, steps, terraces, decks, and porches; or roof overhangs and architectural projections not intended for shelter or occupancy.

Certificate of Appropriateness: An approved certificate issued for the construction, [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s over established thresholds outlined in [Sec. 13B.8.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4), Demolition, [Reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), removal, or relocation of any publicly or privately owned building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or lot within a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that is identified as a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the zone, including street features, furniture or fixtures.

Certificate of Compatibility: An approved certificate issued for the construction of a new building or structure on a lot, Demolition, or building replacement of an element, identified as Non-Contributing, or not listed, in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the zone.

Contributing Element: Any building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) identified on the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as contributing to the Historic significance of the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including a building or structure which has been altered, where the nature and extent of the [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are determined reversible by the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Cultural: Anything pertaining to the concepts, skills, habits, arts, instruments or institutions of a given people at any given point in time.

Demolition: The removal of more than 50 percent of the perimeter wall framing, the removal of more than 50 percent of the roof framing, or the substantial removal of the exterior of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the Street-Visible Area.

Historic: Any building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or lot, including street features, furniture or fixtures, which depicts, represents or is associated with persons or phenomena which significantly affect or which have significantly affected the functional activities, heritage, growth or development of the City, State, or Nation.

Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ): Any area of the City containing buildings, structures, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or lots having Historic, architectural, [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or aesthetic significance and designated as a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under the provisions of this Division.

Historical Property Contract: A contract between an [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of a Historical-Cultural Monument or a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the City, which meets all requirements of California Government Code, [Sec. 50281](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50281.&lawCode=GOV) and [50282](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=50282.&lawCode=GOV) and [Sec. 19.140 et seq.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-45914) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Historic Resources Survey: A document, which identifies all contributing and non-contributing buildings, structures and all contributing [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and lots, individually or collectively, including street features, furniture or fixtures, and which is certified as to its accuracy and completeness by the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Landscaping: The design and organization of landforms, hardscape, and softscape, including individual groupings of trees, shrubs, groundcovers, vines, pathways, arbors, etc.

Maintenance & Repair: Any work done to correct the deterioration, decay of, or damage to a building, structure or lot, or any part thereof, including replacement in- kind where required, and which does not involve a change in the existing design, materials, or exterior paint color.

Monument: Any building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or lot designated as a City Historic- Cultural Monument.

Natural Feature: Any significant tree, plant life, geographical or geological feature identified individually or collectively on the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as contributing to the [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) significance of the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Non-Contributing Element: Any building, structure, [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), lot, or [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), that is identified in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as a Non-Contributing element, or not listed in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Owner: Any person, association, partnership, firm, corporation or public entity identified as the holder of title on any property as shown on the records of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or on the last assessment roll of the County of Los Angeles, as applicable. For purposes of this Division, “Owner” also refers to an appointed representative of an association, partnership, firm, corporation, or public entity which is a recorded owner.

Project: The [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), construction, Demolition, [Reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), relocation, removal, or [Restoration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the exterior of any building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or lot, within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except as provided under Subsection B.2. (Applicability; Exemptions) of this Section. A Project may or may not require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and may include but not be limited to changing exterior paint color, removal of significant trees or [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), installation or removal of fencing, replacement of windows and/or doors which are character-defining features of architectural styles, removal of features that may or may not have a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or changes to public spaces and similar activities.

Reconstruction: The act or process of reproducing by new construction the exact form, features and details of a vanished building, portion of a building, structure, landscape, [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or object as it appeared at a specific period of time, on its original or a substitute lot.

Rehabilitation: The act or process of returning a property to a state of utility, through repair or [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which makes possible an efficient contemporary use while preserving those portions or features of the property which are significant to its [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) al, architectural and [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) values.

Renter: Any person, association, partnership, firm, corporation, or public entity which has rented or leased a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or other structure within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a continuous time period of at least three years. For purposes of this Division, the “renter” also refers to an appointed representative of an association, partnership, firm, corporation, or public entity which is a renter.

Restoration: The act or process of accurately recovering the form, features and details of a property as it appeared at a particular period of time by means of the removal of later work or by the replacement of missing earlier work.

Right-of-Way: The dedicated area that includes [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, medians, and/or sidewalks.

Street Visible Area: Any portion of the front, side, and rear [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that can be seen from any adjacent street, alley, or sidewalk, or that would be visible but are currently obstructed by [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), fencing, or freestanding walls. It also includes undeveloped portions of the lot where new construction would be visible from the adjacent street or sidewalk; [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that are generally visible from non-adjacent streets due to steep topography; or second stories visible over adjacent one story structures.

4. ##### Historic Preservation Board Establishment and Duties


01. ###### Establishment


       A Historic Preservation Board is established by this Section for each [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). A Historic Preservation Board may serve two or more [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in joint name and administration. [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may have separate individual Preservation Plans administered under one Historic Preservation Board. Each Historic Preservation Board shall have, as part of its name, words linking it to its area(s) of administration and distinguishing it from all other boards.

02. ###### Composition


       A Historic Preservation Board shall be comprised of five members. Where a Historic Preservation Board serves two or more [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, the Historic Preservation Board shall be comprised of seven members. At least three members shall be [Renter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of property in the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s), with a [Renter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or property [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) representative from each [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the Historic Preservation Board. If an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is established for an area insufficient in size to provide for a Historic Preservation Board whose members meet the requirements of this Subsection, for appointment purposes only, the area may be expanded to include the community plan area in which the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located. If a Historic Preservation Board still cannot be comprised of members who meet the requirements of this Subsection, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall assume all the powers and duties otherwise assigned to the Historic Preservation Board for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s), until a Historic Preservation Board can be established.

03. ###### Term of Membership


       Members of the Historic Preservation Board serve for a term of four years. Members of the Historic Preservation Board whose terms have expired may continue to serve on the Historic Preservation Board until their replacements are appointed.

04. ###### Appointment of Members.


       1. All members shall have demonstrated a knowledge of, and interest in, the culture, buildings, structures, [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) architecture, history and features of the area encompassed by the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and, to the extent feasible, shall have experience in historic preservation. The appointing authorities are encouraged to consider the cultural diversity of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in making their appointments. Appointees serve at the pleasure of the appointing authority and the appointment may be rescinded at any time prior to the expiration of a member’s term. To the maximum extent practicable, members shall be appointed as follows:




          | Appointing Body | Qualifications |
          | --- | --- |
          | Mayor | •One member having extensive real estate or construction experience |
          | Councilmember | •One member who is a Renter or Owner of property in the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) shall be appointed by the Councilmember of the district in which the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located<br>•Where a Historic Preservation Board serves two or more [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, two Renters or Owners of property shall be appointed |
          | Cultural Heritage Commission | •One member who is an architect licensed by the State of California |
          | •One member who is a Renter or Owner of property in the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s)<br>•Where a Historic Preservation Board serves two or more [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, two Renters or Owners of property shall be appointed |
          | Historic Preservation Board | •One member who is a Renter or Owner of property in the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s), pursuant to the criteria set forth in Paragraph d. below |

       2. If a Historic Preservation Board serves two or more [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in joint name and administration, a [Renter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or property [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) representative shall be appointed for each [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the Historic Preservation Board serves.

       3. If the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) is/are located in more than one council district, the appointment shall be made by the Councilmember representing the greatest land area in the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

       4. The Historic Preservation Board shall consider appointee suggestions from the Certified Neighborhood Council representing the district in which the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) is/are located. In cases where the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) is/ are located in an area represented by more than one Neighborhood Council, the appointee suggestions shall be made by the Neighborhood Council representing the greatest land area in the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s). in those [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s containing no Certified Neighborhood Councils, or if, after notification of a vacancy by the Planning Department, the Certified Neighborhood Council fails to make suggestions within 45 days, or at least one Certified Neighborhood Council meeting has been held, whichever occurs first, the Historic Preservation Board may make its appointment without delay.
05. ###### Vacancies


       In the event of a vacancy occurring during the term of a member of the Historic Preservation Board, the same body or official, or their successors, who appointed the member shall make a new appointment. The new appointment shall serve a 4-year term beginning on the date of appointment. Where the member is required to have specified qualifications, the vacancy shall be filled with a person having these qualifications. If the appointing authority does not make an appointment within 60 days of the vacancy, the President of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a temporary appointment to serve until the appointing authority makes an appointment to occupy the seat or for a period of no more than one year.

06. ###### Expiration of Term


       Upon expiration of a term for any member of the Historic Preservation Board, the appointment for the next succeeding term shall be made by the same body or official, or their successors, which made the previous appointment. No member of a Historic Preservation Board shall serve more than two consecutive 4-year terms.

07. ###### Historic Preservation Board Member Performance


       Historic Preservation Board members are expected to regularly attend scheduled Historic Preservation Board meetings and fully participate in the powers and duties of the Historic Preservation Board. Appointees serve at the pleasure of the appointing authority and the appointment may be rescinded at any time prior to the expiration of a member’s term. A board member with more than three consecutive unexcused absences or eight unexcused absences in a year period from regularly scheduled meetings may be removed by the appointing authority. Excused absences may be granted by the Historic Preservation Board chair. If a board member accrues unexcused absences, the Historic Preservation Board shall notify the appointing authority.

08. ###### Organization and Administration.


       1. Each Historic Preservation Board shall schedule regular meetings at fixed times within the month with a minimum of two meetings a month. Meetings may be canceled if no deemed complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are received at least three working days prior to the next scheduled meeting.

       2. There shall be at least one meeting a year.

       3. The Historic Preservation Board shall establish rules, procedures and guidelines as it may deem necessary to properly exercise its function.

       4. The Historic Preservation Board shall elect a Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson who shall serve for a 1-year period. The Historic Preservation Board shall designate a Secretary who shall serve at the Historic Preservation Board’s pleasure.

       5. For a 5-member Historic Preservation Board, three members is a quorum. For a Seven-member Historic Preservation Board, four members is a quorum. Decisions shall be determined by [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote of the Historic Preservation Board.

       6. Public minutes and records shall be kept of all meetings and proceedings showing the attendance, resolutions, findings, determinations and decisions, including the vote of each member.

       7. To the extent possible, the staff of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may assist the Historic Preservation Board in performing its duties and functions.
09. ###### Power and Duties


       When considering any matter under its jurisdiction, the Historic Preservation Board has the following power and duties:

       01. To evaluate any proposed changes to the boundaries of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) it administers and make recommendations to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

       02. To evaluate any [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), resurvey, partial resurvey, or modification undertaken within the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) it administers and make recommendations to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

       03. To study, review and evaluate any proposals for the designation of [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) it administers and make recommendations to the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and to request that other City departments develop procedures to provide notice to the Historic Preservation Boards of actions relating to [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

       04. To evaluate [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for Certificates of Appropriateness or Certificates of Compatibility and make recommendations to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

       05. To encourage understanding of and participation in historic preservation by [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, visitors, private businesses, private organizations and governmental agencies.

       06. In pursuit of the purposes of this Division, to render guidance and advice to any [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or occupant on construction, Demolition, [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), removal or relocation of any [Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or any building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or lot within the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) it administers. This guidance and advice shall be consistent with approved procedures and guidelines, and the Preservation Plan, or in absence of a Plan, the guidance and advice shall be consistent with the Secretary of interior’s Standards for [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and Guidelines for Rehabilitating [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Buildings.

       07. To tour the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) it represents on a regular basis, to promote the purposes of this Division and to report to appropriate City agencies matters which may require enforcement action.

       08. To assist in the updating of the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) using the criteria in [Sec. 13B.8.2.B.3 (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone Designation; initiation; Historic Resources Survey)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.2).

       09. To make recommendations to [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s concerning [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, covenants, and the imposition of other conditions for the purposes of historic preservation.

       10. To make recommendations to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) concerning the utilization of grants and budget appropriations to promote historic preservation.

       11. To assist in the preparation of a Preservation Plan, which clarifies and elaborates upon these regulations as they apply to the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and which contains the elements listed in [Sec. 13B.8.3.B.2. (Preservation Plan Adoption/Amendment; initiation; Elements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.3).
10. ###### Conflict of Interest


       No Historic Preservation Board member shall discuss with anyone the merits of any matter pending before the Historic Preservation Board other than during a duly called meeting of the Historic Preservation Board or subcommittee of the Historic Preservation Board. No member shall accept professional employment on a case that has been acted upon by the Historic Preservation Board in the previous 12 months or is reasonably expected to be acted upon by the Historic Preservation Board in the next 12 months.
5. ##### Enforcement


1. ###### Inspections and Violations


      1. The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Housing Department, or any successor agencies, whichever has jurisdiction, shall make all inspections of properties which are in violation of this Division when apprised that work has been done or is required to be done pursuant to a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Violations, the correction of which do not require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), shall be investigated and resolved jointly by the Planning Department, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Los Angeles Housing Department, or any successor agencies, whichever has jurisdiction, and if a violation is found, the Planning Department may then request the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Los Angeles Housing Department or any successor agencies to issue appropriate orders for compliance.

      3. Any person who fails to comply with the provisions of this Division is subject to the provisions of [Sec. 11.00 (m) (Provisions Applicable to Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107510) of this Code. The [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the property in violation shall be assessed a minimum inspection fee, as specified in [Sec. 98.0412 (Inspection Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-190052) of this Code for each site inspection. No [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be cleared by the Planning Department while an outstanding violation exists, regardless of whether a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required or not for the violation.
2. ###### Demolition of Buildings Without a Permit


      If a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or a portion thereof, is Demolished or relocated without benefit of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.6.E. (Certificate of Appropriateness (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation); Standards for Review and Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6) and [Sec. 13B.8.7.D.4. (Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements; Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7), the matter shall be reviewed by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as provided in Subdivision 3.c. (Preliminary Evaluation of Demolition or Relocation Without Permit; Procedures) below.

3. ###### Preliminary Evaluation of Demolition or Relocation Without Permit


      1. ###### Purpose


         The purpose of this Subdivision is to require the documentation of the loss of [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) features as a result of unpermitted construction or Demolition activities, relocation, neglectful [owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ship, or man-made disaster.

      2. ###### Prohibition


         Where all or portions of a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) have been Demolished or relocated without the necessary approvals, the provisions of [Sec. 13B.8.6.E. (Certificate of Appropriateness (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation); Standards for Review and Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6) or [Sec. 13B.8.7.D.4. (Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements; Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7), shall not apply. Upon completion of a Preliminary Evaluation of Demolition or Relocation without Permit, and [Sec. 91.106.4.1(10)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) proceedings by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be reviewed in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.8.5. (Certificate of Appropriateness (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.5), [Sec. 13B.8.6. (Certificate of Appropriateness (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6), and [Sec. 13B.8.7. (Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7), whichever is applicable.

      3. ###### Procedures


         1. ###### Evaluation


            The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or his or her designee can initiate review on the Demolition or relocation of a structure, in whole or in part, commenced prior to the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). During the investigation, all work on the site shall cease and an order to comply shall be issued per Subsection E.1 (Enforcement; inspections and Violations) of this Section. Review by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall include, but is not limited to: documentation of the structure(s) as it(they) existed at the time of the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), permit history research, site visits, documentation of the loss of building features, identification of salvageable features, and evaluation of the demolition’s impact on the historic resource.

         2. ###### Evaluation Fees


            Fees for the preliminary evaluation will be assessed pursuant to [Chapter I.
