(General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
      4. ###### Notice


         A copy of the evaluation shall be mailed to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the applicant, the Historic Preservation Board, Council office, and any other interested parties.

      5. ###### Proceedings per LAMC Section 91.106.4.1(10)


         1. Upon completion of the evaluation, the matter shall be referred to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for investigation and enforcement pursuant to [Sec. 91.106.4.1(10)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code. The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be authorized to withhold development permits on said property for five years if it determines that demolition occurred in violation of the [Sec. 91.106.4.1(10)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code. Any person who has failed to comply with the provisions of [Sec. 13B.8.6.E. (Certificate of Appropriateness (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation); Standards of Review and Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6) or [Sec. 13B.8.7.D.6. (Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements; Decision; Certificates of Compatibility for the Demolition of Non-Contributing Elements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7) is subject to the provisions of [Sec. 11.00 (l) (Provisions Applicable to Code)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107510) of this Code.

         2. During the [Sec. 91.106.4.1(10)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code proceedings and the five year penalty period, the property [owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is responsible for protecting any features of the original structure, which remain intact, securing the property from vandalism and theft, and keeping the property free of other nuisances.
4. ###### Injunctive Relief


      Where it appears that the [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), occupant or person in charge of a building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), lot or area within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) threatens, permits, is about to do or is doing any work or activity in violation of this Division, the City Attorney may apply to an appropriate court for a temporary restraining order, preliminary or permanent injunction, or other or further relief as appears appropriate.
6. ##### Relation to Other Provisions of the Zoning Code


When the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) establishes, adds land to, eliminates land from or repeals in its entirety an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), this Division does not abrogate any other provision of this Code. Any portion of a street that is located within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) or shares a boundary with an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s), is not subject to the street dedication and/or improvement requirements as set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.37 A.-C. (Highway and Collector Street Dedication and Improvement)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-18023) and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 17.05 (Design Standards)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-13784) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication and Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1) and [Sec. 11.1.3. (Subdivision Design Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, unless requested by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). However, the existing sidewalk(s) shall comply with any accessibility guidelines within the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that are adopted to comply with Title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act. When it appears that there is a conflict, the most restrictive requirements of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code apply, except for a requirement in this Division that would compromise public safety if enforced.


#### Sec. 13B.8.2. Historic Preservation Overlay Zone Designation

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.2.1.png.webp?itok=_o454Aqm)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.2.1.png?itok=nJEx4VYF)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section applies to the establishment, boundary change, or repeal of a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)).

2. The processing of an initiation or an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to establish, change the boundaries of or repeal an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall conform to all the requirements of [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4) and the following additional requirements.
2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### By City Council, City Planning Commission, Director of Planning, or Cultural Heritage Commission


      In addition to the provisions of [Sec. 13B.1.4. (Zone Change)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4), the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate proceedings to establish, repeal, or change the boundaries of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Upon initiation by [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), a [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d, pursuant to Subdivision 3. (Historic Resources Survey) below.

2. ###### By Application


      1. [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [Renter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of property within the boundaries of the proposed or existing [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may initiate the establishment of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. A [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d for a proposed [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) until the Planning Department verifies that the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) contains the signatures of at least 75 percent of the [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or lessees of property within the proposed district.

      3. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s initiated by [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [Renter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are not complete until the requirements of Paragraph b. above are met and the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) certifies a [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the proposed [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to Subsection D. (Decision) of this Section.
3. ###### Historic Resources Survey


      1. ###### Purpose


         Each [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have a [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which identifies all [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and is certified as to its accuracy and completeness by the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. ###### Context Statement


         In addition to the requirements above, the Historic Resource Survey shall also include a context statement supporting a finding establishing the relation between the physical environment of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and its history, thereby allowing the identification of Historic features in the area as Contributing or Non-Contributing. The context statement shall represent the history of the area by theme, place, and time. It shall define the various [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) al factors which shaped the development of the area. It shall define a period of significance for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and relate [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) features to that period of significance. It may include, but not be limited to, [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) al activities or events, associations with [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) personages, architectural styles and movements, master architects, designers, building types, building materials, landscape design, or pattern of physical development that influenced the character of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at a particular time in history.

      3. ###### Finding of Contribution


         For the purposes of this Section, no building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be considered a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless it is identified as a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the Historic Resource Survey for the applicable [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Features designated as Contributing shall meet one or more of the following criteria:

         1. Adds to the [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) architectural qualities or [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) associations for which a property is significant because it was present during the period of significance, and possesses [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) integrity reflecting its character at that time;

         2. Owing to its unique location or singular physical characteristics, represents an established feature of the neighborhood, community or city; or

         3. Retaining the building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), would contribute to the preservation and protection of a [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) place or area of [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) interest in the City.
      4. ###### Modification of a Previously Certified Historic Resources Survey


         The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may find that a previously certified Historic Resource Survey needs to be modified, and may call for a revision, re-survey, or partial re-survey to a previously certified survey. Modifications, including boundary changes, re-surveys, partial re-surveys, and minor corrections of a previously certified [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be processed as follows:

         1. Revisions involving a boundary change, expansion, or contraction of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be certified by the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as to the accuracy of the survey, and shall be forwarded to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for recommendation and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for final action.

         2. Revisions involving a re-survey or partial re-survey of an existing [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be certified by the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as to the accuracy of the survey, and shall be forwarded to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for final action.

         3. The correction of technical errors and omissions in a previously certified Historic Resource Survey can be made by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) based on input from the Historic Preservation Board and the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or its designee.
      5. ###### Application Procedure for Redesignation of an individual Property in a Certified Historic Resources Survey (Technical Correction)


         1. ###### Application form and Contents


            To apply for a technical correction to a previously certified [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to Paragraph d.iii. above, an applicant shall file an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), on a form provided by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and include all information required by the instructions on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Prior to deeming the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complete, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall advise the applicant of the processes to be followed and fees to be paid. Upon receipt of a complete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review all documents submitted and may approve or deny a technical correction.

         2. ###### Application Fees


            The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fees for a Property Survey Redesignation are set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Publication | 24 days | •In a newspaper of general circulation in the city, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk<br>•If City initiated, in two newspapers of general circulation in the city, designated for that purpose by the City Clerk |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and occupants of all property within and outside the City within 500 feet of the area to be changed; <br>•Residential, commercial and industrial occupants of all properties within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the property involved (or the expanded area described below); and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
         | Posting (applicant initiated Zone Changes only) | 10 days | •If an applicant initiates the establishment of a new [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), notice will be posted at key entry points to the proposed [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with no less than three postings<br>•If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated to conduct the public hearing, then the applicant, in addition to posting notice of the public hearing, will also post notice of the initial meeting of the City Planning Commission on the matter |

      2. If the mailed notice does not result include at least 20 different owners of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, then the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of [owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and lots are within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Cultural Heritage Commission Determination


      1. The [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall certify each [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as to its accuracy and completeness, and the establishment of or change in boundaries of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon:

         1. A [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote; and

         2. A written finding that structures, [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) meet one or more of criteria in Subsection B.3.c. (Initiation; Historic Resources Survey) of this Section.
      2. The [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 45 days from the date of the submission to the Commission. This time limit may be extended for a specified further time period if the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requests an extension, in writing, from the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. Upon action, or failure to act, the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) their determination, comments, and any related files to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for recommendation.
3. ###### City Planning Commission Approval


      1. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make its report and recommendation to approve, approve with changes, or disapprove the establishment, repeal, or change to the boundaries of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.4.D. (Zone Change; Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.4).

      2. However, notice of a public hearing will be given in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      3. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may recommend conditions to be included in the initial Preservation Plan for a specific [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as appropriate to further the purpose of this Section.
4. ###### City Council


      1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve or disapprove the establishment, repeal, or change in the boundaries of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may require that a specific [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) not take effect until a Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designation, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that the proposed boundaries are appropriate and make the findings of contribution required in Subsection B.3.c. (Initiation; Historic Resources Survey) of this Section.

2. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also carefully consider the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the determination of the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. Once an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been adopted, all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must comply with the procedures in this Division.

2. All [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, except as exempted in [Sec. 13B.8.1.B.2. (General Provisions; Applicability; Exemptions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1), shall be submitted in conjunction with an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), if necessary, to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a form provided for that purpose.

3. Upon receipt of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review a request and find whether the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires:

      1. A [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.5.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.5) and [Sec. 13B.8.6.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6);

      2. A [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.7.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7);

      3. Is eligible for review under Conforming Work on [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4); or

      4. Conforming Work on [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.4.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4)
4. All questions of [Street Visible Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are determined by [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) staff.

5. If multiple [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are received resulting in a significant cumulative impact to a Structure or feature in the [Street Visible Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be required for additional work.
7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of HPOZ Designation


The establishment or boundary change of an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be modified or repealed by following the same procedures established above for the original action.


#### Sec. 13B.8.3. Preservation Plan Adoption/Amendment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.3.1.png.webp?itok=yNAPbamR)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.3.1.png?itok=QIZb60tN)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section applies to the adoption of Preservation Plans. A Preservation Plan clarifies and elaborates upon the “HP” [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) regulations as they apply to individual [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. A Preservation Plan is used by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), Historic Preservation Board, property [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of preservation principles within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### Preparation


      The Historic Preservation Board shall make a draft Preservation Plan available for review and comment to property [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [Renter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      1. If a Historic Preservation Board exists, it will [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the Preservation Plan with the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s assistance. Historic preservation groups may also assist in this effort.

      2. If no Historic Preservation Board exists, or has yet to be appointed, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may create a working committee of diverse neighborhood stakeholders to [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will consult with the Councilmember(s) representing the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). This committee does not have any duties beyond preparing the Preservation Plan.
2. ###### Elements


      A Preservation Plan shall contain the following elements:

      1. A mission statement;

      2. Goals and objectives;

      3. A function of the Plan Section, including the role and organization of a Preservation Plan, [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) process overview, and work exempted from review, if any, and delegation of Historic Preservation Board authority to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), if any;

      4. The [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      5. A brief context statement which identifies the [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), architectural and [cultural](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) significance of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      6. The Secretary of the interior’s Standards for [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      7. Design guidelines for [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Restoration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, infill and the form of single and multi-family residential, commercial and other non- [residential building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, structures, and public areas. The guidelines shall use the Secretary of the interior’s Standards for [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and Guidelines for Rehabilitating [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s; and

      8. Preservation incentives and adaptive reuse policies, including policies concerning adaptive reuse [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s permitted under the Class 1 Conditional Use Permit regulations (see [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.24 X.12](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-7378) for lots subject to Chapter I.).
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision:




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant (if initiated by property owners or residents);<br>•The owner(s) and occupants of the property involved;<br>•The owners of all property within and outside the City within 500 feet of the exterior boundaries of the area subject to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or the expanded area described below); <br>•Residential, commercial and industrial occupants of all property within 500 feet of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |

      2. If the mailed notice does not include at least 20 different [owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s of at least 20 different lots other than the subject property, the notification radius will increase in increments of 50 feet until that number of [owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and lots are encompassed within the expanded area.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      1. A draft Preservation Plan shall be set for a public hearing before the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designated by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), with notice given in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      2. If a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is designated, the [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit a written report with conclusions and recommendations to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after the hearing concludes. The report shall be submitted within a period of time fixed by the Commission.
4. ###### Cultural Heritage Commission Recommendation


      The [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall submit its recommendation regarding a proposed Preservation Plan within 45 days of its submission to the Commission. Upon action, or failure to act, the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) its recommendation, if any, comments, and any related files to the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

5. ###### Decision


      The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the Preservation Plan being submitted.
5. ##### Standards for Review


In approving a Preservation Plan Adoption or Amendment, the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider whether the Preservation Plan is reasonable, including:

1. Whether the policies, guidelines and standards are consistent with the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), community plan, or any [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

2. Whether the document is internally consistent;

3. Whether the document is consistent with sound planning principles;

4. Whether the document is consistent with state and federal law; and

5. Any other factors the Commission deems appropriate.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


The Preservation Plan, Guidelines and Standards are in addition to those set forth in this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, and any other relevant ordinances and do not convey any rights not otherwise granted under the provisions and procedures contained in those Chapters and other relevant ordinances, except as specifically provided in this Section.

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Preservation Plan


1. ###### Review


      After approval by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Historic Preservation Board shall review a Preservation Plan at least every five years, or as needed.

2. ###### Modifications


      Any modifications to a Preservation Plan resulting from the review shall be processed pursuant to the provisions of Subsections B. (Initiation) - F. (Scope of Decision) of this Section.

#### Sec. 13B.8.4. Review of Conforming Work

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.4.1.png.webp?itok=xRsz89tx)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.4.1.png?itok=0Rq5cI-G)

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      1. This Section applies to the review of Conforming Work on [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

      2. Conforming Work may fall into two categories: Major Conforming Work and Minor Conforming Work.

      3. This Section requires Conforming Work on [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for some [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s which may, or may not, require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including, but not limited to, changing exterior paint color, removal of significant trees (for [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s), removal of trees (for [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s), removal of [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), installation or removal of fencing, [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and door replacement, changes to public spaces, and similar [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
2. ###### Conforming Work on Contributing Elements


      1. Conforming Work meeting the criteria and thresholds set forth in this Subsection does not require Certificates of Appropriateness set forth in [Sec. 13B.8.5. (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.5) and [Sec. 13B.8.6. (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6).

      2. Where the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) consists of the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of a detached garage, porte cochere, carport, storage [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), tool or garden shed, or [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

         1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the request and determine whether it qualifies for review under Conforming Work, based on at least one of the following considerations:

            1. It can be demonstrated that the structure was built outside of the Period of Significance for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) through [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or where [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s do not exist, through Sanborn Fire insurance Maps or [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) records or photographs.

            2. The [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will not degrade the status of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as a [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

            3. The [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will not affect the integrity and development pattern of the district as a whole.
         2. Any request for the Demolition of a detached garage, porte cochere, carport, storage building, tool or garden shed, or animal-keeping use structure that does not meet one or more of the above criteria is reviewed pursuant to [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provisions (see [Sec. 13B.8.5. (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.5) and [Sec. 13B.8.6. (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6)).
3. ###### Conforming Work on Non-Contributing Elements


      Conforming Work meeting the criteria and thresholds set forth in this Subsection does not require Certificates of Compatibility set forth in [Sec. 13B.8.7. (Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7).

4. ###### Failure to Meet Conforming Elements Criteria


      1. If an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to conform to the criteria of Conforming Work on [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, an applicant may elect to file for review under the [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) procedure pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.5. (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.5) and [Sec. 13B.8.6. (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6)).

      2. If an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to conform to the criteria of Conforming Work on [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, an applicant may elect to file for review under the [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) procedure pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.7. (Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.7).
2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### Application, form and Contents


      To apply for Conforming Work, an [owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall file an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and include all information required by the instructions on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Prior to deeming the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complete, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall determine and, if necessary, advise the applicant of the processes to be followed and fees to be paid.

2. ###### Application Fees


      The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fees for Major Conforming are set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter. Minor Conforming Work does not require an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fee.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for a Review of Conforming Work, and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      Pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.2.F.3. (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone Designation; Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.2), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall forward [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for Conforming Work to the Historic Preservation Board for conformance review and sign off. The Historic Preservation Board may delegate its review authority to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as specified in the Preservation Plan approved for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Meeting and Decision


      1. ###### Time to Act


         The Historic Preservation Board shall act on a request for Conforming Work at its next agendized Historic Preservation Board meeting within 21 days of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) deeming an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complete, unless the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) mutually agree in writing to an extension of time. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s reviewed under Conforming Work shall be agendized by the Historic Preservation Board.

      2. ###### Certification


         The Historic Preservation Board shall review and sign off a request for Conforming Work if it finds that the work meets the criteria as set forth in Subsection A.2.b. (Applicability; Conforming Work on Contributing Elements) of this Section and Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section. The Historic Preservation Board does not have the authority to impose conditions on Conforming Work. If the Historic Preservation Board finds that the work does not meet the criteria, it shall specify in writing as to why.

      3. ###### Failure to Act


         The applicant may request a transfer of jurisdiction to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if the Historic Preservation Board fails to act within 21 days.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. ###### Conforming Work on Contributing Elements


      A request for Conforming Work on [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be reviewed for conformity with the Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or if none exists, the Secretary of interior’s Standards for [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and Guidelines for Rehabilitating [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and at least one of following conditions:




      | Review Criteria for Contributing Elements |
      | --- |
      | Project Scope |
      | --- |
      | a. Minor Conforming Work | i. | Restoration work, Rehabilitation, Maintenance, and/or Repair of architectural features on any Contributing Building, structure, Landscaping, Natural Feature, or lot |
      | ii. | Projects that do not require the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) but affect the building or site, pursuant to [Sec. 91.106.2](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code |
      | b. Major Conforming Work | i. | Addition(s) to any and all structures on a lot or new Building(s) that satisfy all of the following:<br>•The Addition(s) or new Building(s) result(s) in an increase of less than 20 percent of the Building Coverage legally existing on the effective date of the HPOZ;<br>•The Addition(s) or new Building(s) is/are located outside of a Street Visible Area;<br>•No increase in height is proposed; and<br>•The Addition(s) and/or new Building does/do not involve two or more structures |
      | ii. | Construction of detached garage, porte cochere, carport, storage building, tool or garden shed, or animal-keeping use structure in a Street Visible Area in which the proposed square footage is equal to less than 10 percent of the lot area |
      | iii. | Demolition of a detached garage, porte cochere, carport, storage building, tool or garden shed, or animal-keeping use structure pursuant to the criteria set forth in Subsection A.2.b. (Applicability; Conforming Work on Contributing Elements) of this Section |
      | iv. | Demolition and Reconstruction taken in response to natural disaster or to correct a hazardous condition (subject to the provisions of [Sec. 5028 of the California Public Resources Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=5028.&lawCode=PRC), where applicable) |
      | v. | Correction of Code Enforcement Conditions |

2. ###### Conforming Work on Non-Contributing Elements


      A request for Conforming Work on [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be reviewed for conformity with the Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and at least one of following conditions:




      | Review Criteria for Contributing Elements |
      | --- |
      | Project Scope |
      | --- |
      | a. Minor Conforming Work | i. | Rehabilitation, Maintenance, or Repair of architectural features on any Non- Contributing building, structure, Landscaping, Natural Feature or lot |
      | ii. | Relocation of buildings or structures dating from the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s Period of Significance onto a lot designated as a Non-Contributing element in an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) |
      | iii. | Projects that do not require the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) but affect the building or site, pursuant to [Sec. 91.106.2](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code |
      | b. Major Conforming Work | i. | Addition(s) to any and all structures on a lot |
      | ii. | Construction or Demolition of a structure located outside of a Street Visible Area |
      | iii. | Construction of a detached garage, porte cochere, carport, storage building, tool or garden shed, or animal-keeping use structure located in a Street Visible Area in which the proposed square footage is equal to less than 10 percent of the lot area |
      | iv. | Relocation or Demolition of a detached garage, porte cochere, carport, storage building, tool or garden shed, or animal-keeping use structure located in a Street Visible Area |
      | v. | Correction of Code Enforcement Conditions |
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.8.5. Certificate of Appropriateness (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction)

1. ##### Applicability

    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.5.1.png.webp?itok=qYQGbYre)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.5.1.png?itok=ROXUnhyR)
1. ###### General


      This Section requires the issuance of a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) for:

      1. Any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) affecting a [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except as set forth in Paragraph 3. (Conforming Work) below.

      2. A [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) is required for some [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, which may, or may not, require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Examples include changing exterior paint color, removing [significant tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), installing or removing fencing, [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and door replacement which are character-defining features of architectural styles, changes to public spaces, and similar [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. However, an applicant not approved under [Sec. 13B.8.4. (Review of Conforming Work)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4) may elect to file for a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ###### Prohibition


      1. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall construct, add to, alter, or reconstruct any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designated as contributing in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) is approved for that action pursuant to this Section, with the exception of Conforming Work on [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s (which shall not require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)).

      2. In the event that [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), removal, or relocation has occurred without a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) having been approved for such action pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.6.](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.6), a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be based on the existing conditions of the Historic Resource prior to the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), removal, or relocation.

      3. No [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) shall be approved unless the plans for the construction, [alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conform to the provisions of this Section.
3. ###### Conforming Work


      1. This Section does not require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) for the ordinary Maintenance & Repair of any exterior architectural feature of a property within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which does not involve a change in design, material, color, or outward appearance.

      2. Work meeting the criteria for Conforming Work on [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall not require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Other City Approvals


      The activities listed in Paragraph 1. (General) above require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) in addition to other City approvals ( [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, etc.) or other legal requirements, such as [California Public Resources Code, Sec. 5028](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=5028.&lawCode=PRC), which may be required.
2. ##### Initiation

      2. Any combination of the above designated as Contributing in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fees for a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction) shall be as set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.

5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In making a determination on a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall consider the following:

1. If no Preservation Plan exists, whether the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with Standards for rehabilitation approved by the United States Secretary of the interior considering the following factors:

      01. Architectural design;

      02. Height, bulk, and massing of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

      03. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) coverage and orientation of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

      04. Color and texture of surface materials;

      05. [Grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) development;

      06. [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      07. Changes to [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s;

      08. Antennas, satellite dishes and solar collectors;

      09. Off-street [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      10. Light fixtures and street furniture;

      11. Steps, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, fencing, doors, [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, screens and security grills;

      12. [Yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and setbacks;

      13. [Sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s; and

      14. Whether the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) protects and preserves the [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and architectural qualities and the physical characteristics, which make the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a [contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the Preservation Zone.
2. If a Preservation Plan exists, whether the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with the approved Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. An appeal may be filed by the applicant, any aggrieved party, the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or a member of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Unless a Historic Preservation Board member is an applicant, they may not appeal any initial decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as it pertains to this Section.

      2. An appeal shall be filed in triplicate, and the Planning Department shall forward a copy of the appeal to the Historic Preservation Board and the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Public Hearing


      Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Paragraph C. (Notice) above.

5. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant, conditionally grant, or deny the appeal.

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render its decision within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period or within an additional period as may be agreed upon by the applicant and the appellate body.

      3. The failure of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to submit a timely decision shall be deemed a denial of the appeal, and the original action on the matter shall become final.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. ###### Modification of an Approved Certificate of Appropriateness


      Once a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) becomes effective, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review any subsequent proposed modification to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve the modification if he or she finds the modification to be substantially in conformance with the original approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the proposed modification does not substantially conform to the original approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then the applicant shall resubmit the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a new [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Modification Procedure


      To modify an approved [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), an applicant shall submit to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) plans, [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or details of the proposed modification and any additional information determined necessary for conformance review. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may forward proposed modifications to the Historic Preservation Board and/or the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s designee for consultation.

#### Sec. 13B.8.6. Certificate of Appropriateness (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation)

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.6.1.png.webp?itok=BuOrXIrP)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.6.1.png?itok=zzcDlClR)

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      This Section requires the issuance of a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) for:

      1. The Demolition, relocation or removal of any contributing building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except as set forth in Paragraph 3. (Conforming Work) below; or

      2. Any combination of the above designated as Contributing in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ###### Prohibition


      1. No person shall cause the Demolition, relocation or removal of any building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designated as contributing in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) is approved for that action pursuant to this Section, with the exception of Conforming Work on [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s (which shall not require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)).

      2. If the event that Demolition, removal, or relocation occurs without a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) having been approved for that action pursuant to this Section, a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be based on the existing conditions of the Historic Resource prior to the Demolition, removal, or relocation.

      3. No [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) shall be approved unless the plans for the Demolition, relocation, or removal conform to the provisions of this Section.
3. ###### Conforming Work

This Section does not require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) for the ordinary Maintenance & Repair of any exterior architectural feature of a property within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which does not involve a change in design, material, color, or outward appearance.

      2. Work meeting the criteria for Conforming Work on [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s does not require a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. No [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) shall be issued for Demolition, removal, or relocation of any contributing building, structure, [Landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Natural Feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Lot within an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that is designated as a [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless the [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) can demonstrate to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that the [Owner](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) would be deprived of all economically viable use of the property.

2. In making a determination on a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation), the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall consider any evidence presented concerning the following:

      1. An opinion regarding the structural soundness of the structure and its suitability for continued use, renovation, [Restoration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from a licensed engineer or architect who meets the Secretary of the interior’s Professional Qualification Standards as established by the Code of Federal Regulation, 36 CFR Part 61. This opinion shall be based on the Secretary of the interior’s Standards for Architectural and Engineering Documentation with Guidelines;

      2. An estimate of the cost of the proposed [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), construction, Demolition, or removal and an estimate of any additional cost that would be incurred to comply with the recommendation of the Historic Preservation Board for changes necessary for it to be approved;

      3. An estimate of the market value of the property in its current condition; after completion of the proposed [Alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), construction, Demolition, or removal; after any expenditure necessary to comply with the recommendation of the Historic Preservation Board for changes necessary to approve a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and, in the case of a proposed Demolition, after renovation of the existing structure for continued use; and

      4. In the case of a proposed Demolition, an estimate from architects, developers, real estate consultants, appraisers, or other real estate professionals experienced in [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as to the economic feasibility of [Restoration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), renovation, or [Rehabilitation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of any existing structure or objects. This includes tax incentives and any special funding sources, or government incentives, which may be available.
3. In a case where Demolition, removal, or relocation of any [Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), without a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (Demolition, Removal, or Relocation) has occurred, this Subsection does not apply. Procedures in [Sec. 13B.8.5. (Certificate of Appropriateness (Construction, Addition, Alteration, or Reconstruction))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.5) and/or [Sec. 13B.8.1.E. (General Provisions; Enforcement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1) apply.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      1. An appeal may be filed by the applicant, any aggrieved party, the [Mayor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or a member of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Unless a Historic Preservation Board member is an applicant, he or she may not appeal any initial decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as it pertains to this Section.

      2. An appeal shall be filed in triplicate, and the Planning Department shall forward a copy of the appeal to the Historic Preservation Board and the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Public Hearing


      Before acting on any appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

5. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant, conditionally grant, or deny the appeal.

      2. The City Council shall render its decision within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period or within an additional period as may be agreed upon by the applicant and the appellate body.

      3. The failure of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to submit a timely decision shall be deemed a denial of the appeal, and the original action on the matter shall become final.
8. ##### Modification of Entitlement


1. ###### Modification of an Approved Certificate of Appropriateness


      Once a [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) becomes effective, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review any subsequent proposed modification to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve the modification if he or she finds the modification to be substantially in conformance to the original approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the proposed modification does not substantially conform to the original approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), then the applicant shall resubmit the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a new [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Modification Procedure


      To modify an approved [Certificate of Appropriateness](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), an applicant shall submit to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) plans, [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, or details of the proposed modification and any additional information determined necessary for conformance review. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may forward proposed modifications to the Historic Preservation Board and/or the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s designee for consultation.

#### Sec. 13B.8.7. Certificate of Compatibility for Non-Contributing Elements

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.7.1.png.webp?itok=l1H3V8TY)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.8.7.1.png?itok=yudDFro9)

Purpose. The intent of this Section is to ensure compatibility of [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s with the character of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to ensure that any construction or [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) work is undertaken in a manner that does not impair the essential form and integrity of the [historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) character of its environment.

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      A request for a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be reviewed for conformity with the Preservation Plan for the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and shall consist of at least one of following [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) types:

      1. Where the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not qualify as Conforming Work;

      2. Where a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is constructed or demolished in a [street visible area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designated as a [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); or

      3. Where [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s not dating from the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s period of significance are replaced or relocated onto a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designated as a [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ###### Prohibition


      1. No [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall construct, add to, alter, cause the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), relocation, or removal of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [landscaping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) designated as a [non-contributing element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or not listed in the [Historic Resources Survey](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been approved for that action pursuant to this Section.

      2. [Addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s and [alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may be exempt from this Section provided they meet the criteria in [Sec. 13B.8.4. (Review of Conforming Work)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4).

      3. No [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be approved unless the plans for the construction, [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [alteration](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), relocation, or removal conform to the provisions of this Section. Any approval, conditional approval, or denial shall include written justification pursuant to Subsection E. (Standards for Issuance of a Certificate of Compatibility for New Building Construction or Replacement, and the Relocation of Buildings or Structures Not Dating from the Preservation Zone’s Period of Significance Onto a Lot Designated as a Non-Contributing Element) of this Section.
3. ###### Conforming Work


      1. Other types of work solely involving [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, including the relocation of buildings or structures dating from the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s period of significance onto a lot designated as a Non- Contributing Element, are eligible for review under Conforming Work on Non-Contributors as set forth in [Sec. 13B.8.4. (Review of Conforming Work)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4).

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review a request, pursuant to [Sec. 13B.8.2.F. (Historic Preservation Overlay Zone Designation; Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.2) and find whether the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is eligible for Conforming Work on Non-Contributors as outlined in [Sec. 13B.8.4. (Review of Conforming Work)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4) or requires a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. An applicant not approved under [Sec. 13B.8.4. (Review of Conforming Work)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.4) may elect to file for a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Other City Approvals


      The requirements for a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are in addition to other City approvals ( [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, etc.) and other legal requirements, such as [Public Resources Code, Sec. 5028](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=5028.&lawCode=PRC), which may be required. The time periods specified above may be extended, if necessary, with the written mutual consent of the applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Initiation


1. Plans shall be submitted, in conjunction with an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon a form provided for that purpose.

2. Upon an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) being deemed complete by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), one copy of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and relevant documents shall be mailed by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to each Historic Preservation Board member of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for evaluation.

3. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fees for a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are set forth in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public hearing held prior to a recommendation:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 10 days | •Owners and occupants of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located |
      | Posting | 10 days | •The applicant will post notice in a conspicuous place on the property\` |

2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •Applicant;<br>•Appellant;<br>•Cultural Heritage Commission;<br>•The relevant Historic Preservation Board; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Any other interested parties of record |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Referral


      Upon an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) being deemed complete by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), one copy each of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and relevant documents shall be mailed by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to both the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to each Historic Preservation Board member of the [HPOZ](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for evaluation.

4. ###### Public Hearing


      Before making its recommendation to approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section for a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Historic Preservation Board shall hold a public hearing on the matter, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

5. ###### Cultural Heritage Commission & Historic Preservation Board Recommendations


      1. The [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (or its designee) and the Historic Preservation Board shall submit their recommendation to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as to whether the [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) should be approved, conditionally approved, or disapproved.

      2. In the event the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the Historic Preservation Board does not submit its recommendations within 30 days of the postmarked date of mailing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from the City Planning Department, the [Cultural Heritage Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the Historic Preservation Board shall forfeit all jurisdiction. The applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may mutually agree in writing to a longer period of time for the Historic Preservation Board to act.
6. ###### Certificates of Compatibility for the Demolition of Non-Contributing Elements


      1. After notice pursuant to Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section and a hearing, the Historic Preservation Board shall submit its comments on a request to Demolish a [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), considering the impact(s) of the Demolition of the [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the essential form and integrity of the [Historic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) character of its surrounding built environment within 30 days of the postmarked date of mailing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from the City Planning Department. In the event the Historic Preservation Board does not submit its comment within 30 days, the Historic Preservation Board shall forfeit all jurisdiction. The applicant and the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may mutually agree in writing to a longer period of time for the Historic Preservation Board to comment.

      2. In a case where Demolition of any [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), without a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the Demolition of [Non-Contributing Element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or permit has occurred, Paragraph 5.a. (Cultural Heritage Commission and Historic Preservation Board Recommendations) above does not apply. Procedures in Subsections A. (Applicability) \- G. (Appeals) of this Section and/or [Sec. 13B.8.1.E. (General Provisions; Enforcement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8.1) apply.
7. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve, conditionally approve, or disapprove a [Certificate of Compatibility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Any approval, conditional approval, or denial shall include written findings in support.
8. ###### Time to Act
