The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall maintain a record of all notices issued for exempt [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, including [Categorically Excluded Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, which shall be made available to the Coastal Commission or any interested person upon request. This record may be in the form of a list of issued permits or approvals currently maintained by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), provided that the record includes the Applicant’s name, the location of the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and a brief description of the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Coastal Development Permit Application


      1. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), at the Applicant’s expense, shall provide a Notice of Coastal Development Permit [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by first class mail, pursuant to the requirements of this Subdivision.




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days before the initial decision | •Applicant;<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council;<br>•All persons who have requested to be on the mailing list for the particular Coastal Development or for all coastal decisions within the Coastal Zone;<br>•All property owners and residents within 300 feet of the perimeter of the parcel on which the Coastal Development is proposed exclusive of streets; and<br>•The Coastal Commission |
         | Posting | At the time the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is submitted for filing | •In a conspicuous place, and as close as possible to the proposed Coastal Development |

      2. The notice shall contain the following information:

         1. A statement that the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is within the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         2. The date of filing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the name of the Applicant;

         3. The case number assigned to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

         4. A description of the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and its proposed location.
2. ###### Notice of Waiver of Public Hearing


      1. For [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the [Appealable Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) where the requirement for a public hearing is proposed to be waived, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide the following statement in the manner provided in Subdivision 1. (Notice of Coastal Development Permit Application) above: “The public hearing will be waived unless a hearing is requested by any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within ten working days of the date of this notice. The failure to request a public hearing may result in the loss of that person’s ability to appeal to the Coastal Commission the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action on the Coastal Development Permit.”

      2. For a [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that does not require a public hearing pursuant to this Section, the notice shall contain the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will be acted upon by the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the general procedure for submitting public comments in writing to the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) prior to the decision date.
3. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      1. For a [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that requires a public hearing pursuant to this Section, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), at the Applicant’s expense, shall provide a Notice of Public Hearing by first class mail pursuant to the requirements of this Subdivision. This notice may be combined with the Notice of Coastal Development Permit [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that require a public hearing.




         | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
         | --- | --- | --- |
         | Mail | 24 days before the first public hearing | •Applicant;<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council;<br>•All persons who have requested to be on the mailing list for the particular Coastal Development or for all coastal decisions within the Coastal Zone;<br>•All property owners and residents within 300 feet of the perimeter of the parcel on which the Coastal Development is proposed, exclusive of streets; and<br>•The Coastal Commission |
         | Posting | At the time the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is submitted for filing | •In a conspicuous place, and as close as possible to the proposed Coastal Development |

      2. The notice shall contain the following information:

         1. A statement that the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is within the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         2. The date of filing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the name of the Applicant;

         3. The case number assigned to the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

         4. A description of the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and its proposed location;

         5. The date, time, and place at which the public hearing on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will be heard;

         6. A brief description of the general procedure concerning the conduct of the public hearing and [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) actions;

         7. The procedure for [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and Coastal Commission appeals, if any, including any required fees;

         8. If applicable, the criteria for eligibility to appeal to the Coastal Commission; and

         9. A statement that an interested person must request to be on the mailing list for the particular [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in order to receive notice of the written determination and in order to appeal to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### Continuation of Public Hearing – Notice


      If a decision on a Coastal Development Permit is continued to a time which is neither previously stated in the notice of public hearing provided pursuant to this Subsection, nor announced at the hearing as being continued to a time certain, notice of the further hearings or action on the proposed [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be provided in the same manner, and within the same time limits, as established in this Subsection.

5. ###### Posted Notice


      The Applicant must post, in a conspicuous place, and as close as possible to the proposed [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s notice that an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been filed for a Coastal Development Permit. The notice shall contain specific information as to the nature of the proposed [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and be in a form as required by the approving department for that purpose.

6. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal.




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •Applicant;<br>•Appellant(s);<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council;<br>•All persons who have requested to be on the mailing list for the particular Coastal Development or for all coastal decisions within the Coastal Zone;<br>•All property owners and residents within 300 feet of the parcel on which the Coastal Development is proposed, exclusive of streets; and<br>•The Coastal Commission |

7. ###### Notification of Failure to Act and Approval by Operation of Law


      1. ###### Notification by Applicant


         If the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to act on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within the time limits set forth in [Sec. 65950 - 65957.1 of the California Government Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65950.&nodeTreePath=11.1.15.5&lawCode=GOV), the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) claiming a right to proceed pursuant to those Code sections shall notify, in writing, the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Coastal Commission and all persons entitled to receive notice of an appeal pursuant to Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section that the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been approved by operation of law. The notice shall specify the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), which is claimed to have been approved.

      2. ###### Notification by Approving Authority


         When the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines that the time limits established pursuant to [Sec. 65950 - 65957.1 of the California Government Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65950.&nodeTreePath=11.1.15.5&lawCode=GOV) have expired, and that the notice required to all persons entitled to receive notice of an appeal pursuant to Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section has occurred, the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall, within seven calendar days of its determination, notify any person entitled to receive notice of an appeal pursuant to Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section that it has taken final action by operation of law pursuant to [Sec. 65950 - 65957.1 of the California Government Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=65950.&nodeTreePath=11.1.15.5&lawCode=GOV), and that the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), if it is for an [Appealable Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), may be appealed to the Coastal Commission pursuant to [Sec. 13110, et seq. of Title14 of the California Code of Regulations](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Document/I7E815FAC5B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3?viewType=FullText&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=CategoryPageItem&contextData=(sc.Default)&bhcp=1).
4. ##### Decision


01. ###### General Procedures


       01. Decisions must be made within the time period specified in this Article, or as otherwise required by law. Unless otherwise provided in the regulations governing the particular [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), this time limit may be extended by mutual consent of the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the applicant. The extension of time to act also applies to [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or initiations under the multiple approval provisions in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10).

       02. Where extensions on the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s time to act on a matter may be granted by mutual consent of an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Council President or the Council President’s councilmember designee may consent to a time extension on behalf of the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

       03. Each decision is subject to all applicable standards of this Code, including the applicable zone.

       04. Each process described in Part B. (Processes & Procedures) of this Article includes standards and/or findings for approval. In approving an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) substantially conforms to the standards and/or findings for approval.

       05. The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall adopt written findings of fact supporting the decision based upon evidence in the record.

       06. Unless otherwise provided, an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be approved or disapproved in whole or in part.

       07. Unless otherwise provided, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may impose conditions that it determines are needed to ensure substantial compliance with the standards or findings for approval.

       08. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s a letter of determination that notifies the applicant, owner, and interested parties, as applicable, of the decision. The notification will indicate whether the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved, approved with conditions, or denied.

       09. An initial decision or decision of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that is appealable to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is final and effective upon the close of the appeal period if no appeal is filed.

       10. An appellate agency’s decision or decision of the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that is not appealable to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is final as provided in [Charter Section 245](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-663).
02. ###### Decision Maker


       The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a Coastal Development Permit is the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), pursuant to Subsections B.1. (Initiation; General) and 2\. (Initiation; Jurisdiction) above.

03. ###### Public Hearing


       1. ###### General


          The [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold a public hearing on any [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Coastal Development Permit for an [Appealable Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) except as waived in Paragraph b. below. It shall hold the hearing at least 24 calendar days following the mailing of the notice required in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section and shall consolidate the hearing with any other public hearing required for any other approvals required by this Code or other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ordinance.

       2. ###### Waiver of Public Hearing


          The [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may waive the public hearing for [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the non-appealable area and may propose to waive the requirement for a public hearing for [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the [Appealable Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) if it determines that the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) meets the following criteria:

          1. The [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is consistent with the certified [Local Coastal Program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

          2. The [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires no discretionary approvals other than a Coastal Development Permit; and

          3. The [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has no adverse effect either individually or cumulatively on coastal resources or public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the shoreline or along the coast.
04. ###### Initial Decision


       1. If an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Coastal Development Permit is submitted to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and there is no [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for another Quasi-judicial or Legislative approval, the initial decision shall be made by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has jurisdiction.

       2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve, conditionally approve, or deny a Coastal Development Permit.

       3. The [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), in approving an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Coastal Development Permit, shall impose any conditions considered necessary to ensure that the proposed use will be consistent with the findings in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section.

       4. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Coastal Development Permit shall be denied when the evidence submitted by the Applicant and/or presented at a public hearing fails to support the findings in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section to the satisfaction of the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)).
05. ###### Concurrent Processing with Other Permits or Approvals


       1. When a proposed [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required to obtain a Coastal Development Permit and is also required to obtain other Quasi-judicial or Legislative approvals, the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Coastal Development Permit shall be filed and processed concurrently with the other permits or approvals. The action of the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is considered one consolidated action.

       2. If a condition of the Coastal Development Permit varies from a condition contained in the other permits and approvals, the more restrictive condition controls.

       3. No additional fees shall be charged for appeal of a Coastal Development Permit that is combined with an appeal for the other permits and approvals.
06. ###### Time Limit for Initial Decision


       1. The initial [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make an initial decision within 75 days after:

          1. The date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete; or

          2. When an environmental impact report (EIR) is required, the date preparation of the EIR is complete consistent with State law.
       2. The time limit may be extended by mutual consent of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Applicant.
07. ###### Transmittal of Written Decision


       Upon making a written decision, the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy by First Class Mail to each Applicant, to all persons who have requested to be on the mailing list for the particular [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or for all coastal decisions within the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), to all property owners and [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within 300 feet of the perimeter of the parcel on which the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is proposed, exclusive of streets, and to the Coastal Commission.

08. ###### Effective Date of City Action


       The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall issue a Coastal Development Permit only:

       1. For a non-appealable development, 15 days after the final [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action if no appeal is filed or if the Coastal Commission does not assert jurisdiction.

       2. For an [Appealable Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

          1. Only after receiving the final [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action and notification that the 10 working day appeal period to the Coastal Commission established by California Code of Regulations has ended and no appeal was filed; or

          2. An appeal was filed and the Coastal Commission made a determination of no substantial issue with the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision.
       3. If a decision on a Coastal Development Permit is appealed to the Coastal Commission and the Coastal Commission determines that a substantial issue exists, the issuance of the permit will be regulated by the Coastal Commission.
09. ###### Recordation of the Coastal Development Permit


       Within 14 days of the issuance of the Coastal Development Permit for a [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) subject to the jurisdiction of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Applicant shall record the Permit with the Los Angeles County Recorder’s office and provide a certified copy to the City Planning Department.

10. ###### Notice of Final City Action


       Within seven calendar days of a final decision on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for any [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide notice of its action, at the expense of the Applicant, by first class mail to the Coastal Commission and to any persons who specifically requested notice of the final action by submitting a self-addressed, stamped envelope to the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The notice shall include conditions of approval, written findings, and, if applicable, the procedures for appeal to the Coastal Commission.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Coastal Development Permit shall be approved if the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), based on information obtained during an investigation and/or public hearing, if applicable, makes specific written findings justifying the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s action, including any conditions imposed in order to bring the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) into conformity with the certified [Local Coastal Program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). These findings shall include the following:

1. That the proposed [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conforms to the certified [Local Coastal Program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

2. That the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conforms to all applicable provisions of any adopted community plan and [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the area; and

3. Where applicable, that any [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) located between the [First Public Road Paralleling the Sea](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [sea](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or shoreline of any body of water located within the [Coastal Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conforms to the public access and public recreation policies of [Chapter 3 of Division 20 of the California Public Resources Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&division=20.&title=&part=&chapter=3.&article=1.).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) undertaken pursuant to a Coastal Development Permit shall conform to the plans, specifications, terms, and conditions approved in the Permit.

2. ###### Duration of Permits


      1. ###### Validity


         A Coastal Development Permit that was granted pursuant to this Section runs with the land and continues to be valid upon any changes of ownership of the land or any changes to the [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or structure on the land.

      2. ###### Termination


         1. A permit, which is not used within the time, specified in the permit, or, if no time is specified, within two years after the permit is granted, becomes void.

         2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has jurisdiction, may grant extensions of time for the using the permit, if the extension is requested prior to the expiration date, under the provisions of Subdivision 4. (Extensions of Time) below.

         3. Where other approvals are granted concurrent with the Coastal Development Permit, the time limits and extensions shall be the same as those for the other approvals. However, the Coastal Development Permit shall become void after six years.
      3. ###### Use of Permit


         1. A Coastal Development Permit shall be considered used when construction or other [development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) authorized by that permit, which would be prohibited in that location if no Coastal Development Permit had been issued, has commenced.

         2. A Coastal Development Permit shall automatically cease to be in effect if the use for which the permit was granted has ceased or has been suspended for a consecutive period of two or more years.
3. ###### Revocation


      1. ###### Failure to Comply with Conditions


         If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has jurisdiction, determines that the conditions of any Coastal Development Permit granted pursuant to this Section have not been complied with, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may give notice to the record owner or lessee of the real property to appear at a time and place fixed by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and show cause why the determination of the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) granting the Coastal Development Permit should not be rescinded. An appeal from a revocation action may be taken in the same manner prescribed in Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section.

      2. ###### Request by Aggrieved Person


         Any [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may request revocation of a permit by [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has jurisdiction, specifying with particularity the grounds for revocation. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall review the stated grounds for revocation and shall determine whether to initiate revocation proceedings. An appeal from a revocation action may be taken in the same manner prescribed in Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section below.
4. ###### Extensions of Time


      1. ###### Application


         1. Prior to the expiration of a Coastal Development Permit, an Applicant may apply for a one-year extension of the permit. Prior to the expiration of any extension, the Applicant may apply for another one-year extension of the permit.

         2. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an extension of time shall automatically keep the permit in effect until the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has acted upon the request. However, if construction has not commenced at the time the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is made, construction may not commence after the initial expiration date until the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has acted upon the request.

         3. The [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall state the reasons for the request and shall be accompanied by evidence of a valid, unexpired permit and of the Applicant’s continued property interest.
      2. ###### Procedures


         The procedures for applying for an extension of time shall be in accordance with Subsections B. (Initiation) \- E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section.

      3. ###### Findings


         The [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall only grant an extension if the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) can make the same findings as were required for the original permit, with no new conditions, and must make an additional finding that there are no changed circumstances, which would affect the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s consistency with the [Local Coastal Program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. ###### Appeal


         An extension of time for a Coastal Development Permit may be appealed in accordance with Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section. However, in addition to the notice provisions required for appeals in the table in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section, the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall also notify any persons who objected to the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s approval of an extension.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      01. Appeals shall be in writing and filed on forms maintained by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      02. An appeal shall specifically state the points at issue and the reasons why the decision should be overturned.

      03. An appeal not properly or timely filed shall not be accepted, and will not be considered by the appellate body.

      04. Unless otherwise required by a specific process, appeals must be filed within 15 days after the date on the letter of determination to the applicant.

      05. Despite any provisions of this Chapter, whenever the final day for filing an appeal from any action, decision or determination of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday, the time for filing an appeal shall be extended to the close of business on the next succeeding working day, and the effective or final date of any action, decision, or determination shall be extended to the close of that appeal period.

      06. If in any individual case involving a 15-day appeal period, that appeal period fails to include at least 10 working days, then the appeal period shall be extended as many days as the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines are necessary to include 10 working days.

      07. An appeal stays the processing of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and entitlement, and any [development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at issue until the appellate body makes a decision.

      08. After an appeal is filed, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the appeal and the file to the appellate body, together with any report if one was [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) d by staff responding to the points raised made in the appeal. The [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will make investigations and furnish any reports requested by the body to which the matter is transferred.

      09. When the appellate body receives the appeal, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) loses jurisdiction.

      10. Upon the date set for the hearing, the appellate body shall either hear the appeal, or continue the matter by mutual agreement to another date if there is cause to do so. No additional notice of continuance need be given if the continuance to a date certain is announced at the time of the original hearing. If no date for the continued hearing is provided publicly at the original hearing, then notice of the continued hearing shall be provided in the same manner as the original notice for the appellate hearing.

      11. The appellate body will conduct a public hearing. After the public hearing, the appellate body will render a decision:

          1. Affirming the initial decision in whole or in part; or

          2. Reversing the initial decision in whole or in part, after which it may render its own decision or remand the decision to the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for further proceedings.
      12. The appellate body may impose conditions that it determines are needed to ensure substantial compliance with the standards or findings for approval.

      13. Appellant(s) may withdraw an appeal of an initial determination if the withdrawal is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at least 15 days prior to the public hearing by the appellate body on the appeal.

      14. Withdrawal of an appeal shall be in writing and does not require the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to concur. The withdrawal shall be filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      15. If the withdrawal of the appeal is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after the close of the original appeal period, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall notify the same persons who received notice of the decision that was appealed, that an appeal had been filed and was now withdrawn. The notice shall state that the appeal period is being reopened. The reopened appeal period shall run for 10 days from the date the notice of withdrawal of the appeal is mailed. If more than one appeal was filed, the appeal period is only reopened if the withdrawal of the appeal would result in no other appeal going forward. The appeal period shall only be reopened once.

      16. If the withdrawal is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) before any required public hearing notice is mailed, then the time for the appellate body to act is extended for 10 days.

      17. If the withdrawal is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after the public hearing notice is mailed, then any appeal filed during the reopened appeal period shall be heard on the same date and time as set forth in the previously mailed public hearing notice. No further notice of the appeal hearing is required.

      18. If the withdrawal of the appeal, and the subsequent reopening of the appeal period, results in no appeal going forward:

          1. The withdrawal of the appeal is permanent; and

          2. The decision from which the appeal was taken automatically becomes final at the end of the appeal period or reopened appeal period.
      19. The appellate body shall hear the matter de novo, considering the whole of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with no deference given to the decision of the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The appellate body shall make its decision based on the record before the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any other evidence or testimony presented at or before the appellate body’s hearing.

      20. Unless required otherwise by this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408), in making a decision to grant a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval, the appellate body shall make the same findings as required to be made by the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), supported by substantial evidence.

      21. Unless otherwise required by a specific process, the appellate body shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period or within any additional period mutually agreed upon by the applicant and the appellate body.

          1. Failure of the appellate body to render a timely decision shall result in the denial of the appeal.
2. ###### Filing


      1. An Applicant or any other person aggrieved by the initial decision on a Coastal Development Permit may appeal the decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or to the Board of Public Works for a [public project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or for a private [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) where the approval of the underlying permit is within the jurisdiction of the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The appeal on an [Appealable Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and non-appealable development shall be filed within 15 days of the date of mailing of the decision.

      2. The appeal shall set forth specifically the points at issue and the reasons for the appeal. Any appeal not filed within the 15-day filing period shall not be considered by the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Board of Public Works. The filing of an appeal stays proceedings in the matter until the Commission or Board has made a decision. Once an appeal is filed, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) the appeal and the file to the Commission or Board, together with any reports responding to the allegations made in the appeal.
3. ###### Public Hearing on Appellate Decision


      Before acting on any appeal of a Coastal Development Permit, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Board of Public Works shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

4. ###### Time for Appellate Decision


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Board of Public Works shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period or within any additional period mutually agreed upon by the Applicant and the Commission or Board.

5. ###### Appellate Decision


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Board of Public Works may reverse or modify the initial decision, in whole or in part. In reversing or modifying the initial decision, the Commission or Board shall make the same findings required to be made by the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

6. ###### Appeal Procedures for Multiple Applications including a Coastal Development Permit


      1. If a Coastal Development Permit is combined with another Quasi-judicial or Legislative approval, an appeal of the initial decision on a Coastal Development Permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall automatically constitute an appeal of the decision on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the other discretionary permits and approvals. Any appeal of the other permits and approvals also constitute an appeal of the Coastal Development Permit unless the appeal of the Coastal Development Permit would violate [Sec. 563 (Conditional Use Permits and Other Approvals) of the City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2586). The time for appeal of the Coastal Development Permit to the Coastal Commission shall commence after action on the other permits and approvals becomes final.

      2. The [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for multiple [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for a Coastal Development Permit and other Quasi-judicial or Legislative approvals shall be as established in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10). However, the appeal procedures for the consolidated action shall follow the procedural requirements for notice, public hearing, and final action of an initial decision on a Coastal Development Permit in accordance with Subsections C. (Notice) \- E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section.
8. ##### Amendments to Permits


1. ###### Immaterial Changes to a Coastal Development Permit


      1. ###### Application


         An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an immaterial change to a Coastal Development Permit shall be filed with the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that approved the existing permit.

      2. ###### Approval


         If the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the proposed change conforms to the original findings and conditions required for the Coastal Development Permit and is in substantial conformance with that Permit, then the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may approve the proposed change.
2. ###### Permit Amendments


      1. ###### Application


         If the [Approving Authority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that originally granted the Coastal Development Permit finds that a proposed change does not substantially conform to the original Coastal Development Permit, the holder of the Permit may apply for an amendment to the Permit in the same manner as an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a new Coastal Development Permit. This [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall contain a description of the proposed amendment, the reason for the amendment, together with maps, plans or other material appropriate to the request, and shall be accompanied by evidence of a valid, unexpired permit and of the Applicant’s continued legal ownership or interest in the property.

      2. ###### Procedures


         The procedures for an amendment are the same as would be required of a new [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) at the same location in accordance with Subsections B. (Initiation) \- E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section.

      3. ###### Appeals


         Decisions on amendment [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are appealable as provided in Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section.
9. ##### Emergency Permits


An emergency permit shall only be issued in cases where an [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) necessitates immediate action that would normally require a Coastal Development Permit, and where the worth of any permanent structures erected does not exceed $25,000.

1. ###### Applications


      An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for an Emergency Coastal Development Permit shall be made to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), whichever has jurisdiction, within three days of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or discovery of the danger. The following information shall be included in the request:

      1. Nature of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      2. Cause of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), if this can be determined;

      3. Location of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

      4. The remedial, protective or preventive work required to deal with the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      5. The circumstances during the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that justify the proposed course of action, including the probable consequences of failing to take action.
2. ###### Verification of Emergency


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall verify the facts, including the existence and the nature of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), insofar as time permits.

3. ###### Procedure


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall provide public notice of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) work, with the extent and type of notice determined on the basis of the nature of the [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not issue an emergency permit for any work that falls within the provisions of [Sec. 30519(b)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=30519.) and [30601 of the Public Resources Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=30601.&lawCode=PRC). The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant an emergency permit upon reasonable terms and conditions, if the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that:

      1. An emergency exists that requires action more quickly than the regular permit process would allow, and the work can or will be completed within 30 days, unless otherwise specified by the terms of the permit;

      2. Public comment on the proposed [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action has been reviewed, if time allows; and

      3. The work proposed would be consistent with the certified [Local Coastal Program](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any adopted, relevant community or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
4. ###### Compliance


      An emergency permit shall be valid for not more than 60 days from the date of issuance. Prior to expiration of the emergency permit, the permittee must submit a Coastal Development Permit [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the Coastal Development or else remove the [Coastal Development](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) undertaken pursuant to the emergency permit in its entirety and restore the site to its previous condition. Failure to comply with the provisions of this Subsection or failure by the permittee to properly notice and report any [emergency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) actions may result in the revocation of the emergency permit.

5. ###### Reporting


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall notify the Coastal Commission of the issuance of an emergency permit by phone or letter as soon as possible, but in any event within three days of the issuance of the emergency permit.

### Div. 13B.10. Department of Building and Safety

[faq](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)

#### Sec. 13B.10.1. General Provisions

1. ##### Purpose


This Division describes the powers, duties, and processes of the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as they relate to this Chapter and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code.

2. ##### Permits and Vesting of Development Plan


1. ###### Permits


      No permit pertaining to the use of land or buildings shall be issued by any department, officer, or employee of this [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), vested with such duty, unless the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the permit has been approved by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as to conformance of said use with the provisions of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code. Any permit or [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) issued in conflict with the provisions of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code shall be null and void.

2. ###### Vesting of Development Plan


      1. Whenever plans sufficient for a complete plan check are accepted by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and a fee is paid, a vested right is granted to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to proceed with its development in substantial compliance with the zoning, and development rules, regulations, ordinances and adopted policies of the City of Los Angeles in force on the date that the plan check fee is paid as indicated on a valid [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). These rights shall not include exemption from other [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or approvals that may be necessary to entitle the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to proceed (i.e., [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), zone [variance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), design review board review, etc.) and from subsequent changes in the Building and Safety and Fire regulations found necessary by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to protect the public health and safety and which are applicable on a citywide basis, contained in [Chapter V, (Public Safety and Protection)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-135598) and [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code and policies and standards relating to those Chapters or from citywide programs enacted after the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete to implement State or Federal mandates.

      2. These rights shall end:

         1. 18 months after the plan check fee is paid, or if a permit is issued during that time, when the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) terminates pursuant to [Sec. 98.0602 (Expiration of Permits)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-190414) of this Code;

         2. When subsequent changes are made to those plans that increase by more than five percent or decrease by more than 10 percent the height, floor area, or occupant load of the proposed-structure;

         3. When the use of the property is changed;

         4. When changes exceed or violate the regulations of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code in force on the date the plan check fee was paid; or

         5. When the discretionary land use approval for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) terminates under the provisions of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code or any ordinance adopted pursuant to this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code.
      3. In the case that a discretionary land use approval is required, the vesting rights in plan check will be extended for the time period during which the discretionary land use approval is being processed. However, in no case will the extension of vesting rights exceed more than 18 months beyond the original vesting expiration timeline.
3. ##### Yard Area Modifications


The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the authority to hear and determine requests for yard area modifications pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 98.0403.1(a)11. (Powers of the Department and the Board)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189800) of this Code.



Parking Facility Modifications

1. The Superintendent of Building or the Superintendent's designee may grant slight modifications in the requirements of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.21 A.5.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-5183) and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) Sec. 12.21 A.16.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-5183) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [4C.4.3. (Parking Area Design)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.3) and [Div. 4C.3. (Bicycle Parking)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, if it is impractical to apply the design criteria set forth therein due to the unusual topography, peculiar shape of location of the lot, or where parking angles are less than 40 degrees. The Superintendent of Building may also grant slight modifications in such requirements where such modifications will improve the design or functioning of the [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) area or garage, or where attendant [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is ensured to his or her satisfaction.

2. The power to grant such modifications shall be exercised in accordance with the procedure established in [Section 98.0403](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189800) of this Code.
4. ##### Inspection of Premises


1. Whenever it is necessary to make an inspection to enforce any of the provisions or to perform any duty imposed by this Code or other applicable law, or whenever the Superintendent of Building or his/ her authorized representative has reasonable cause to believe that there exists in any building or upon any premises any violation of the provisions of this Article or other applicable law, the Superintendent of Building or his/her authorized representative is hereby authorized to enter such property at any reasonable time and to inspect the same and perform any duty imposed upon the General Manager by this Code or other applicable law, provided that:

      1. If such property be occupied, he/she shall first present proper credentials to the occupant and request entry explaining his/her reasons therefor; and

      2. If such property be unoccupied, he/she shall first make a reasonable effort to locate the owner or other persons having charge or control of the property and request entry, explaining his reasons therefor. If such entry is refused or cannot be obtained because the owner or other person having charge or control of the property cannot be found after due diligence, the Superintendent of Building or his/her authorized representative shall have recourse to every remedy provided by law to secure lawful entry and inspect the property.

#### Sec. 13B.10.2. Appeals From LADBS Determinations

1. ##### Applicability

    [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.10.2.1.png.webp?itok=MzLVL_OY)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.10.2.1.png?itok=9OVFIXY5)
1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may investigate and make a decision upon appeals from determinations of the Los Angeles [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)) where it is alleged there is error or abuse of discretion in any order, interpretation, requirement, determination or action made by [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the enforcement or administration of this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code and other land use ordinances in site specific cases.

2. This Section does not apply to requests for extensions of time to comply with any order issued by [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. An appeal to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may only be made after the [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has rendered a decision in writing and provided written justification and findings on an appeal made pursuant to [Sec. 98.0403.2(a) (Procedures for Appeals to the Department and to the Board)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189882) of this Code.
2. ##### Initiation


1. Any [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may file an appeal at a public counter of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). For the purposes of this process, the person filing an appeal on the [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determination will be considered the applicant.

2. The appeal shall be filed within 15 days after the [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) renders a decision in writing with justification and findings on the issues set forth in the appeal made pursuant to [Sec. 98.0403.2(a) (Procedures for Appeals to the Department and to the Board)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189882) of this Code.

3. The appeal to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must be accompanied by a written copy of the decision of [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and any written copy of the underlying order, interpretation, requirement, determination or action taken on the matter by [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The applicant shall set forth specifically how there was error or abuse of discretion in the action of [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Each appeal shall be accompanied by a filing fee as specified in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.

4. Filing an appeal stays, with respect to that site, all enforcement proceedings and actions pertaining to this Chapter or [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, and other land use ordinances pending the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision. However, filing an appeal will not prevent the issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or performance of work authorized by the permit when all Code and other land use requirements are met to the satisfaction of the [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and only after consideration of the issues set forth in the appeal to the [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) made pursuant to [Sec. 98.0403.2(a) (Procedures for Appeals to the Department and to the Board)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189882) of this Code. Filing an appeal does not delay enforcement proceedings or actions related to the abatement of imminent life safety hazards.
3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Appeal Filing


      Upon receipt of the Appeal from [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Determination, the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall notify the owner of the subject property if an appeal is filed by a third party.

2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the initial decision, if held:




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •Appellee and property owner;<br>•Applicant;<br>•Department of Building and Safety;<br>•Owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |

3. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal to the Area or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •Appellee and property owner;<br>•Applicant;<br>•Department of Building and Safety;<br>•Owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Public Hearing


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing if it is likely to be controversial, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) above.

4. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall investigate the matter.

      2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render a decision within 75 days after the appeal period expires. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
5. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [transmit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) a copy of the decision to the applicant, property owner, appellant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), owners of all properties abutting, across the street or alley from, or having a common corner with the subject property, and to all persons who requested notification in writing.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In making a determination on an Appeal from [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Determination, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider whether there was an error or abuse of discretion by [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make a finding regarding whether the matter may have a citywide impact.

3. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall find that there is no citywide impact if the matter concerns only the use of the specific property, or circumstances or issues connected with other zoning matters which are unique to the affected site and would not generally apply to other sites in the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or would not result in changes in the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of this Chapter and [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code and other land use ordinances to other sites.

4. In making a determination on an appeal of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s initial decision on an Appeal from [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Determination, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall consider whether there was an error or abuse of discretion by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a matter that the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) found did not have a citywide impact. The [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on a matter that the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) found does have a citywide impact.

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other person aggrieved by a decision of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may appeal that decision to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the appellate body will set the matter for a public hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section.

      2. The appellate body shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification of the Action


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.10.3. Annual Inspection Monitoring (Type 1)

1. ##### Applicability


1. The provisions of this Section shall apply to every [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or yard operating pursuant to a valid [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and to every [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) operating pursuant to a valid [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In addition, these provisions shall be applicable to every [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or yard operating with [nonconforming](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) status pursuant to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.23 (Nonconforming Building and Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-7194) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, and any rights otherwise granted by [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.23 (Nonconforming Building and Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-7194) or [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), may be revoked pursuant to this Section.

2. ###### Definitions


      For the purpose of this Section the following words and phrases are defined:

      Collection Bins: Any box, canister, receptacle, or other container that can be opened and closed, and is used for collecting salvageable personal property, including, but not limited to, clothing, shoes, books, and household items for periodic off-site processing and/or redistribution. For purposes of this definition, salvageable personal property shall not include recyclable materials not intended for re-use, including, but not limited to, newspapers, plastic, glass, aluminum, electronics, toxic or hazardous materials, and solid waste; nor any personal property that, because of its size, does not fit inside the collection bin.

      Department: The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      Recycling Center: Any recycling collection or buyback site, recycling sorting facility, or other recycling oriented site which does not do any processing other than mechanical compaction to reduce the volume of recyclable containers for economy of storage.

      Superintendent: The Superintendent of Building or his or her authorized representative.

      Yard: Any automobile or truck dismantling yard, junk yard, scrap metal or recycling materials processing yard or cargo container storage yard or any open storage location where used materials and equipment of any kind, including vehicles, boats, or airplanes, which are inoperable, wrecked, damaged, or unlicensed, i.e., not currently licensed by the Department of Motor Vehicles, are stored or processed.
2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### Inspections


      1. Each [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), yard, or collection bin shall be available for inspection by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to verify compliance with all applicable provisions of this Code.

      2. An inspection fee as specified in [Sec. 98.0402(e) (Annual inspection Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769) of this Code shall be paid by each business operator or property owner to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The business operator and the property owner of every site under the jurisdiction of this Section shall be notified of all fees, fines, penalties, costs, or other assessments resulting from enforcement of this Section and are jointly and severally responsible to ensure that code compliance is maintained, at all times, and that payment of all fees, fines, penalties, costs, or other assessments due for each qualifying business as specified by this Section, is made to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If all fees, fines, penalties, costs or other assessments due pursuant to this Section are not paid, a lien may be placed upon the property as provided in [Sec. 98.0402(g)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769) of this Code and [Sec. 7.35.1 et seq.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-60793) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In addition, failure to pay all fees, fines, penalties, costs or other assessments is sufficient cause to institute a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) revocation hearing.

      3. An inspection may also be made whenever a complaint is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) concerning a violation of this Code or as needed to verify continued compliance with applicable Code requirements. Accessory storage-only yards, where no business is conducted and which are nearby but not contiguous with a main yard, may be subject to an inspection and an additional fee of one half of the annual inspection fee for each primary yard.
2. ###### Order to Comply


      1. If a [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), yard, or [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that is inspected is found to be in violation of any provision of this Code, the [Superintendent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall send an order to comply (“Order”) to the owner of the property and the operator of the [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), yard, or [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. The violation must be corrected by the compliance date specified in the Order, which shall be no more than 30 days from the date the Order is mailed.

      3. The compliance date as specified in the Order may be extended for an additional period not to exceed 45 days if the owner or operator of the [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), yard, or [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) presents evidence of unusual hardship to the satisfaction of the [Superintendent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. Failure to comply with the Order may result in a revocation of [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). A revocation hearing may be canceled upon correction of violation and payment of a fine based on the fine schedule in Subsection H. (Additional Standards and Provisions) of this Section. If a [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is found in violation of this Section after the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has issued and resolved an order to comply for a previous [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) violation on the same property, then revocation proceedings shall commence on the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall issue no further [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) permits for [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s on that property.
3. ###### Re-Inspection


      The [Superintendent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall re-inspect a [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), yard, or [collection bin](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for which an Order was issued pursuant to this Section subsequent to the compliance date or any authorized extension thereof.

4. ###### Enforcement Authority Prior to Revocation Notice


      The [Superintendent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may commence enforcement pursuant to [Sec. 98.0408 (Issuance of Citations by Designated Employees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189978) of this Code if the violations noted in an Order are not corrected on or before the due date noted upon such notice.
3. ##### Notice of Intent to Revoke and Revocation Hearing


1. If any violation specified in an Order or citation is not corrected prior to the compliance date or any extension thereof, or if the annual inspection fee has not been paid within 60 days of assessment, then [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) revocation proceedings shall be commenced by issuance of a Notice of intent to Revoke (“Notice”), which shall be sent to the owner of the property and the operator of the [recycling center](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or yard subsequent to any re-inspection pursuant to Subsection A (Applicability) of this Section.

2. The Notice shall state the following:

      1. The date and place of the revocation hearing, which shall be scheduled at least 15 days and not more than 90 days from the date of issuance of the Notice.

      2. A list of all uncorrected violations as of the compliance date.
3. Owner and operator may obtain copies of all inspection reports related to these violations.

4. ###### Revocation Hearing


      1. The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may appoint a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to conduct the hearing, which [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be any individual who participated in the issuance of any of the Notices required by this Section. Subpoenas may be issued pursuant to [Sec. 98.0307 (Subpoenas)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189649) of this Code. The hearing shall be conducted pursuant to the provisions of [Sec. 98.0308 (Evidence)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189660) and [98.0309 (Official Notices)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189693) of this Code.

      2. Revocation proceedings may only be terminated if each violation noted in the Notice is corrected before the date of the revocation hearing and if a specified fine is paid, which fine shall be fixed in accordance with the fine schedule in Subsection I. (Additional Standards and Provisions) of this Section.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13\#)’s Report


      Within 30 days of the conclusion of the revocation hearing, the [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall report its findings and recommendations in writing to the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners.

2. ###### Board of Building and Safety Commissioners Determination


      1. Revocation may be ordered by the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners if it finds that any required fees, fines, penalties, costs or other assessments have not been paid or any of the violations specified in the Order have not been corrected, except for the circumstances stated in Subsection E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings) of this Section.

      2. In making its determination, the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may hear from the owner, operator, or other interested party.

      3. The determination of the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners is final.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may, in its discretion, determine that a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) should not be revoked if it makes both of the following findings:

1. Taken together, the remaining uncorrected violations specified in the Order do not have an adverse effect on neighboring properties or on the general public; and

2. The owner or operator of the yard has paid the fine specified in Subsection I. (Additional Standards and Provisions) of this Section with respect to all violations listed in the Notice of Revocation.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. ###### Termination of Revocation Proceedings


      The [Superintendent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall terminate [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) revocation proceedings upon a finding that each violation of this Code specified in the Notice has been corrected and the fine specified in such Notice has been paid. Termination may only occur on or before the date of the revocation hearing.

2. ###### Loss of Non-Conforming Rights


      Notwithstanding any provision of this Code to the contrary, where a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is revoked pursuant to this Section, a new [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the property may only be issued if all requirements of the Code in effect, at the time of issuance of the new certificate, are satisfied. A site which has no valid [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and seeks a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall retain no rights under [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.23 (Nonconforming Building and Uses)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-7194) nor under [Article 12. (Nonconformities)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/12) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Additional Standards and Provisions


1. ###### Fine Schedule


      The fine for each violation listed in the Notice shall be as specified in [Sec. 98.0402(f)2. (Code Enforcement Costs incurred; investigation Costs, Fees and Fines)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769) of this Code.

2. ###### Parking of Vehicles in Custody of Any Yard
