      No vehicle or any part of any vehicle in the custody or possession, for any reason, of a yard, as defined in this Section, shall be parked, left standing, placed, or stored outside of the approved [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the lot where the yard is located, except that vehicles and parts may be stored within an approved auxiliary storage yard. In addition, all [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s on the lot and any access driveways leading to the parking spaces that are required by this Code must remain clear and available for [parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of operative vehicles.
9. ##### Further Action


1. ###### Repeat Violations


      Despite any provision of this Section to the contrary, if a business or property owner is issued a subsequent notice for a code violation within one year of the initial notice of an Order for the same code violation then all of the following apply:

      1. Each violation cited in a subsequent Order shall carry a fine as specified in [Sec. 98.0402(f)1. (Code Enforcement Costs incurred; investigation Costs, Fees and Fines)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769) of this Code and shall be paid within 15 days of the compliance date of any subsequent Order.

      2. The compliance date for any subsequent order to comply shall be no more than 10 days from the date of mailing of notice for repeat violations.

      3. No extension of the compliance date may be granted for repeat violations.

#### Sec. 13B.10.4. Annual Inspection Monitoring (Type 2)

1. ##### Applicability


1. The provisions of this Section shall apply to every [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) use in the City of Los Angeles, including those in existence prior to May 27, 1990 and every [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Exception


      Used car sales areas operated in conjunction with and on the same lot or on contiguous lots with a new car dealer are exempted from the annual inspections required by this Section.

3. ###### Definitions


      For the purpose of this Section the following words and phrases are defined:

      Department: The [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      Used Vehicle Sales Area: An area or lot where any type of used motor vehicle or trailer is displayed for sale.

      Automotive Repair Garage: For lots subject to [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-107408) of this Code, this term means: All retail or wholesale uses which are enumerated in the definition for “Automotive Repair” in [Section 12.03 (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-886) of this Code, and all testing, installation of vehicle equipment or accessories, and the application of paint, sprayed coloring, or other types of covering or the recovering of any part of a vehicle interior or exterior. Included in this definition are smog testing shops whether for test only or for repairs, window tinting or replacement shops, application of vinyl or similar covering materials, installation of parts or accessories on the site of a parts store, and all other similar uses.

      For lots subject to this Chapter, this term means any use described by the definition of: 1) [motor vehicle services: light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) 2) [motor vehicle services: heavy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) 3) or [motor vehicle services: large vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) per [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D).
2. ##### Initiation


1. ###### Inspections


      1. The physical facilities of each [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be open to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for inspections.

      2. An inspection fee as specified in [Sec. 98.0402(e) (Annual inspection Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769#JD_98.0402.) of this Code shall be paid by each business operator or property owner to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) upon notice. The business operator and the property owner of every site under the jurisdiction of this Section shall be notified of all fees, fines, penalties, costs, or other assessments resulting from enforcement of this Section and are jointly and severally responsible to ensure that code compliance is maintained, at all times, and that payment of all fees, fines, penalties, costs, or other assessments due for each qualifying business as specified by this Section, is made to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If all fees, fines, penalties, costs or other assessments due pursuant to this Section are not paid, a lien may be placed upon the property as provided for in [Sec. 98.0402(g) (Code Enforcement Costs incurred: investigation Costs, Fees and Fines)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769#JD_98.0402.) of this Code and [Sec. 7.35.1 et seq.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-60793#JD_7.35.1.) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). In addition, failure to pay all fees, fines, penalties, costs or other assessments is sufficient cause to institute a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) revocation hearing.

      3. An inspection may also be made whenever a complaint is received by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) concerning a violation of this Code by an [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or as needed to verify continued compliance with applicable Code requirements. Accessory storage only yards, where no business is conducted, which are nearby but not contiguous with a main [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), may also be subject to inspection and an additional fee of one half of the annual inspection fee for the yard or building.
2. ###### Order to Comply


      1. If the physical facilities of an [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are found to be in violation of any provision of this Code, the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall send an order to comply (“Order”) to the owner of the property and the operator of the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). The Order shall state the following:

         1. The nature of the violation and the Code section violated;

         2. The compliance date by which the violation must be corrected.
      2. Failure to correct the violation on or before the compliance date or any authorized extension may result in commencement of proceedings to revoke the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). These proceedings may involve a revocation hearing. A personal appearance at the hearing may only be avoided if the violation is corrected and a fine paid according to the fine schedule in Subsection H. (Additional Standards and Provisions) of this Section;

      3. An appeal may be filed from the Order in the manner provided by Subsection G. (Appeals) of this Section.
3. ###### Re-Inspection


      The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may re-inspect an [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for which an Order was issued pursuant to this Section subsequent to the compliance date or any authorized extension.

4. ###### Enforcement Authority Prior to Revocation Notice


      The [Superintendent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may commence enforcement pursuant to [Sec. 98.0408 (Issuance of Citations by Designated Employees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189978) of this Code if the violations noted in an Order are not corrected on or before the due date noted upon such notice.
3. ##### Notice of intent to Revoke and Revocation Hearing


1. If any violation specified in the Order is not corrected prior to the compliance date or any extensions, or if the annual inspection fee has not been paid within 60 days of assessment, pursuant to [Sec. 98.0402(e) (Annual inspection Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769#JD_98.0402.) of this Code, then the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may commence [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) revocation proceedings by issuance of a Notice of intent to Revoke (“Notice”). This Notice shall be sent to the owner of the property and the operator of the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. The Notice shall state the following:

      1. The date and place of the revocation hearing, which shall be scheduled at least 15 days and not more than 90 days from the date of issuance of the Notice.

      2. A list of all violations uncorrected as of the compliance date.
3. Copies of all inspection reports related to such violations are available for inspection by the owner or operator.

4. ###### Revocation Hearing


      1. The Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may appoint a [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to conduct the hearing, which [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be any individual who participated in the issuance of any of the Notices required by this Section. Subpoenas may be issued pursuant to [Sec. 98.0307 (Subpoenas)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189649) of this Code. The hearing shall be conducted pursuant to the provisions of [Sec. 98.0308 (Evidence)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189660) and [98.0309 (official Notices)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189693) of this Code.

      2. Revocation proceedings may be terminated if each violation noted in the Notice is corrected before the date of the revocation hearing and if a specified fine is paid, which fine shall be fixed in accordance with the fine schedule in Subsection I. (Additional Standards and Provisions) of this Section.
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13\#)’s Report


      Within 30 days of the last day of the revocation hearing, the [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall report its findings and recommendations in writing to the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners.

2. ###### Board of Building and Safety Commissioners Determination


      1. Within 30 days of receipt of the [Hearing Officer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s report, the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners shall determine whether the [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be revoked.

      2. In making its determination, the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may hear from the owner, operator, or other interested party.

      3. The determination of the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners is final.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In ordering a revocation, the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners shall find that:

1. Any of the violations specified in the Order have not been corrected, or that the fines specified in Subsection H. (Additional Standards and Provisions) have not been paid;

2. That, taken together, the remaining uncorrected violations have significant adverse effects on surrounding properties or the health, peace, or safety of persons residing or working in the surrounding area; and

3. The owner or operator of the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has failed to demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners the ability or willingness to eliminate problems associated with the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) operation.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. ###### Loss of Non-Conforming Rights


      Notwithstanding any provision of this Code to the contrary, if a [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is revoked pursuant to this Subsection, then a new [Certificate of Occupancy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the property may only be issued if all requirements of the Code in effect at the time of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for such new Certificate are satisfied.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Except for extensions of time granted by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as authorized in Subsection H. (Additional Standards and Provisions) and despite any provisions of this Code to the contrary, there shall be no appeal to the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners from any notice issued or determination made by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to this Section.

      2. Appeals may be made from [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determinations of violations of Paragraph 3. (Parking of Cars in Custody of Automotive Repair Garage or Used Vehicle Sales Area) and Paragraph 4. (Minimum Standards) of Subsection H. (Additional Standards and Provisions) of this Section.
8. ##### Additional Standards and Provisions


1. ###### Fine Schedule


      1. The fine for each violation listed in the Notice shall be as specified in [Sec. 98.0402(f)2. (Code Enforcement Costs incurred: investigation Costs, Fees and Fines)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769) of this Code.

      2. ###### Fines Distinct from Other Penalties and Fees


         The above fines are separate and distinct from both misdemeanor or infraction fee penalties provided in the Code and the noncompliance fees authorized in [Sec. 98.0411 (Non-Compliance Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189997) of this Code.
2. ###### Time Limits for Compliance With Order


      1. The [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall comply with the Order described in Subsection B.2 (Initiation; order to comply) of this Section on or before the compliance date specified in the Order, or any authorized extension. The compliance date shall be not more than 30 days from the date of the Order.

      2. The [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may grant an extension of the compliance date specified in the Order for an additional period not to exceed 45 days if the owner or operator of the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) presents satisfactory evidence to the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that unusual difficulties would prevent substantial compliance without such extension.

      3. Upon an appeal, the Board of Building and Safety Commissioners may grant an extension of the compliance date for an additional period not to exceed 180 days if it finds that the correction of Code violations requiring extensive building alterations would create a hardship without such extension.
3. ###### Parking of Cars in Custody of Automotive Repair Garage or Used Vehicle Sales Area


      No vehicle left in the custody or possession, for any reason, of an [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be parked, left standing or stored outside the lot on which the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [used vehicle sales area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is located, except that such vehicles may be stored within an approved storage yard. A responsible person shall be on the premises of each [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or used vehicle sales lot during hours of operation. This person shall maintain current records, in a manner that can be immediately supplied to any enforcement agency upon request (subject to applicable state or federal laws), including the license plate number, vehicle identification number and registered owner of each vehicle currently in the custody or possession of the [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or used vehicle sales lot for purposes of repair, sales, trade, shipment or other disposition. This Subdivision shall not apply to employees’ vehicles used for commuting.

4. ###### Minimum Standards


      All [automotive repair garage](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall comply with the minimum standards described in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.26 F. (Automotive Repair Garage and Used Vehicle Sales Area; Minimum Standards)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-8786) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or all Use Standards that pertain to the subject use per the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)'s applied pursuant to [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
9. ##### Further Action


1. ###### Repeat Violations


      Notwithstanding any provision of this Section to the contrary, if a business or property owner is issued a subsequent notice for a code violation within one year of the initial notice of an Order for the same code violation then all of the following apply:

      1. Each violation cited in a subsequent Order shall carry a fine as specified in [Sec. 98.0402(f)1.](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-189769) of this Code and shall be paid within 15 days of the compliance date of any subsequent Order.

      2. The compliance date for any subsequent order to comply shall be no more than 10 days from the date of mailing of notice for repeat violations.

      3. No extension of the compliance date may be granted for repeat violations.

### Div. 13B.11. California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Provisions

#### Sec. 13B.11.1. Environmental Review Procedures

1. ##### Applicability of CEQA


1. This purpose of this Section is to comply with the requirements of the [California Environmental Quality Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)) and the Guidelines for Implementation of the [California Environmental Quality Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ( [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s) to adopt local procedures that implement [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. This Section (Environmental Review Procedures) applies to [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) compliance for all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to approval under the authority of this Article (Administration). Additionally, any [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal from an approval made pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code shall be subject to and comply with Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) below.

3. This Section (Environmental Review Procedures) supersedes any contradicting provision in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) or any other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) ordinance, regulation, guideline, or policy, including [Sec. 197.01 (CEQA Appeals)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-322456) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, as applicable, are incorporated and made a part of this Section (Environmental Review Procedures) as though fully set forth herein. In the review and approval of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s under this Article (Administration), all officers and employees of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall comply with each and every applicable provision of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

5. ###### Prohibition


      No permit shall be issued or entitlement approved by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that would violate [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including by approving a discretionary [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) without making the necessary findings under [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). Discretionary [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s include [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that require only discretionary actions or both discretionary and [ministerial action](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
2. ##### CEQA Review Responsibility


1. ###### Director of Planning Responsibilities


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) all environmental documents necessary to comply with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and assist the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in approving [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

2. ###### Director of Planning Authority


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may:

      1. Issue administrative guidelines to implement [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and this Section (Environmental Review Procedures), consistent with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, this Section (Environmental Review Procedures), and any [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) policy; and

      2. Determine significance of environmental effects based on applicable administrative guidelines, [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
3. ##### Notice Rules for CEQA


1. All notice is provided pursuant to the requirements of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

2. If [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does not provide notice requirements, then notice shall be given pursuant to [California Government Code, Sec. 54950 et seq.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=54950)

3. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on CEQA Appeal


      The following notice is required for the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal hearings held pursuant to Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decision) of this Section (Environmental Review Procedures):




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The Project applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property subject to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>•Appellant; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Any interested parties who have requested in writing to receive notices related to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or any action on the Project. |

4. ###### Notice of Hearing on Sustainable Communities Project


      The following minimum notice is required for a hearing held pursuant to Paragraph a. of Subdivision D.3. (CEQA Decisions; Sustainable Communities Project Exemption) of this Section, or a hearing by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or an [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a Sustainable Communities Environmental Assessment, pursuant to [Sec. 21155.2 (Transit Project Review) of the Public Resources Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=21155.2#:~:text=(a)%20A%20transit%20priority%20project,b)%20or%20(c).).




      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Mail | 10 days | •The Project applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property subject to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>•The owner(s) and occupant(s) of properties within 500 feet of the property subject to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);<br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Any interested parties who have requested in writing to receive notices related to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or any action on the Project. |
4. ##### CEQA Decisions


1. ###### Lead Agency


      The City of Los Angeles is the lead agency for all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s reviewed and approved under this Article, except where the City of Los Angeles is a responsible agency under [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

2. ###### Decision Maker


      Any entity authorized to decide a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval or appeal of an approval under this Article is the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for purposes of compliance with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). When a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has more than one approval, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the initial approval, or the appeal of the initial approval, determines the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), subject to any available [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) of this Section and all other requirements of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

3. ###### Sustainable Communities Project Exemption


      1. The hearing and determination of the use of the Sustainable Communities Project Exemption (SCP Exemption) shall be determined by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) after it holds a public hearing and adopts findings consistent with [Public Resources Code, Sec. 21155.1. (Transit Project; applicability requirements)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=21155.1.). This hearing and the determination on the use of the SCP Exemption may be completed before or after the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval.

      2. Where the only [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) proposed for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is a SCP Exemption, no [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval is final and effective until the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is exempt as a Sustainable Communities Project. No actions shall be taken and no permits issued in reliance on a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval prior to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination that the SCP Exemption applies, absent the approval of an alternative [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      3. If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) holds a hearing on the SCP Exemption and determines that it does not apply to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and no other [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), any prior [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval shall be void.

      4. If the only [CEQA clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) proposed for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is a SCP Exemption and there are no [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) related approvals or appeals subject to [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action, and there are no further appeals available for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold the public hearing on the SCP Exemption within 75 days of the issuance of the letter of determination.
4. ###### Finality of Project Approvals


      For purposes of filing a Notice of Determination or a Notice of Exemption or the filing of a [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) of this Section, a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval is final pursuant to the provisions of [Subsection 13A.2.5.E. (Decisions; Effective Date)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5), or if finality for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval is not provided for in [Sec. 13A.2.5.E. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5), approval is effective immediately unless otherwise provided by the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2), the Code, or [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
5. ##### Standards for CEQA Review and Required Findings


1. ###### CEQA Clearances


      In approving [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may rely on any [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) consistent with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

      1. Where an Environmental Impact Report (EIR), Mitigated Negative Declaration (MND), Negative Declaration (ND), or Sustainable Communities Environmental Assessment (SCEA) has been adopted or certified for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), no subsequent EIR, MND, ND, or SCEA shall be adopted or certified, except as required by [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including [Public Resources Code, Sec. 21166. (Lead agency prohibition to require subsequent reports for a certified project unless specific events.)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=21166).

      2. To the extent applicable and supported by substantial evidence, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may rely on multiple [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, including [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s approved in the alternative.

      3. This Section is not intended to expand the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s discretion to approve or condition [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. Subject to the requirements of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the environmental analysis of a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is limited to the extent the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has discretion to mitigate or avoid environmental impacts in the approval of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ###### Appeals


      A [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) decision on an appeal filed under Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) of this Section shall be based on the requirements of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
6. ##### Appeals of CEQA Decisions


01. ###### General Procedures


       See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

02. ###### Appeal of CEQA Clearances


       The following [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s may be appealed to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by any interested party, when the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was not the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and no further appeals on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval are available:

       1. Certification of an Environmental Impact Report.

       2. Adoption of a Negative Declaration or a Mitigated Negative Declaration.

       3. Adoption of a Sustainable Communities Environmental Assessment.

       4. A determination that an approval under this Article is not subject to [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) either because it is not a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as defined by [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s or because it is exempt.
03. ###### Exhaustion


       No appeal of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be accepted by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless all [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval appeals were previously exhausted.

04. ###### CEQA Appeal Filing Requirements


       No appeal of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be considered by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless the appellant does all of the following:

       1. Files a [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 15 days of the date the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval is final.

       2. Pays the applicable fee, if any.

       3. Fills out the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) form required by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and provides the following information:

          1. The name, address, and telephone number of the appellant and the person filing the appeal if different from the appellant;

          2. A statement that the appeal is made pursuant to this Section;

          3. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) subject to the appeal;

          4. The [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to which the appeal is filed, including applicable case number(s), and the date of the certification, adoption or determination of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

          5. A written statement setting forth all of the reasons for the appeal, and specifying in detail why the appellant believes the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to comply with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

          6. Any other information required by the office of the City Clerk or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
       4. At any time, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may reject an appeal that does not comply with all the requirements of Subdivisions 2, 3, or 4 of this Subsection.
05. ###### Effect of Filing an Appeal of the CEQA Clearance


       1. The filing of an appeal of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) stays:

          1. The [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

          2. Any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals that rely upon the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#);

          3. Any action or approval by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals that will rely on the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

          4. Any action or approvals by other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) departments in reliance upon the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval that relied upon the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
       2. Upon the filing of a [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal, the applicant’s time to act under any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval or permit shall be tolled until the appeal is decided.

       3. Upon the filing of a [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s time to act on any related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval shall be tolled until the appeal is decided.

       4. Nothing in this Subdivision F.5., is intended to affect the finality of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals for purposes of an applicable statutes of limitations.
06. ###### Withdrawal of Appeal


       1. An appeal filed under this Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) may be withdrawn at any time by the Appellant prior to the date and time scheduled for the hearing. Upon withdrawal of the appeal, no further action on the appeal shall be taken by the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the timeline to file an appeal under this Subsection I. shall not be extended or restarted.

       2. All stays and tolling under Subdivision 5. (Effect of Filing an Appeal of the CEQA Clearance) of this Subsection F. shall terminate upon the withdrawal of the appeal.
07. ###### Hearing on Appeal


       1. ###### Timeline for City Council Hearing


          The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold a public hearing before deciding the appeal, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice Rules for CEQA) of this Section. The appeal shall be decided by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 75 days of the appeal being filed. The timeline to decide the appeal may be extended by the mutual consent of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) applicant and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

       2. ###### Joint Hearings on the CEQA Clearance and Project Approvals


          1. ###### Applicability


             If there are related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals or appeals for which the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or appellate body and have been [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for its action at any time after the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal is filed and before the hearing on the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall hold a joint hearing on the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) appeal and the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals or appeals.

          2. ###### Time Limits Extended


             Any Code required time limits to hear or act on any appeal of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the approval or appeal of any related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals shall automatically be extended as necessary to comply with this Subsection.

          3. ###### CEQA Clearance is Considered Before Project Entitlements


             After the joint hearing concludes, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall decide the appeal on the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) before taking action on the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals.
08. ###### Time to File Documents for the Hearing


       All appeal-related documents filed by or on behalf of the appellant must be filed with the City Clerk no later than five business days prior to the date set for the hearing. Appeal-related documents filed by any other party, must be filed with the City Clerk no later than two business days prior to the date of the hearing. Documents submitted after these deadlines shall be accepted for filing, but shall not be considered by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in its review and decision on the appeal. The City Clerk shall mark late-filed documents to indicate that they were filed after the deadline provided in this Subdivision.

09. ###### Council Authority on Appeal


       1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall conduct a de novo review of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and shall consider the whole of the administrative record, including any documents timely filed on the appeal, and affirm, reverse, or modify the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

       2. After conducting a public hearing, the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall do one of the following:

          1. Affirm the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s approval of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

          2. Reverse the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s approval of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and remand the environmental review of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) who last approved the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with direction to correct the substantive or procedural error.

          3. Reverse the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s approval of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) without remand.

          4. Approve a modified or alternative [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provided no new mitigation or change to the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required.
10. ###### Findings


       The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall adopt findings based upon substantial evidence to support its decision as to why the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) does or does not comply with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including adopting the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s findings or findings recommended by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the appellant, the applicant, or any other interested party. In affirming any [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s approval of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall make all necessary findings and take all necessary actions required by [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the approval of that [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

11. ###### Exhaustion of Administrative Remedies


       No person entitled to file a [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Appeal pursuant to this Section may initiate action in a court of law challenging the Environmental Determination unless and until such person files the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Appeal and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has taken final action on the [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Appeal.
7. ##### Scope of CEQA Appeal Action


The following procedures apply to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action on a [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Appeal under Subsection F. (Appeals of the CEQA Decisions) of this Section.

1. ###### Affirmed


      If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) affirms the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or any one [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) when multiple [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are appealed, the stays in Subdivision F.5. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions; Effect of Filing an Appeal of the CEQA Clearance) above are lifted.

2. ###### Reversed Without Remand


      If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) should be reversed without remand, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval(s) subject to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s), as well as any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) action taken or approval granted in reliance upon the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval(s), are void.

3. ###### Reversed With Remand


      If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) reverses and remands the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)(s) to the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for further action:

      1. ###### Project Approvals Void


         All [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals subject to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as well as any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) actions taken or approvals granted in reliance upon the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals, are void. All stays on actions or approvals pursuant to Subdivision F.5. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions; Effect of Filing an Appeal of the CEQA Clearance) above, shall remain in place until the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on remand under Paragraph b. (Decision Maker Responsibility on Remand) below, approves a [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). All times to act on related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals shall be extended to comply with this Subsection.

      2. ###### Decision Maker Responsibility on Remand


         After approving a [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) consistent with Council direction, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall reconsider the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals.

      3. ###### Planning Director Responsibility on Remand


         The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall [prepare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) all necessary analysis, reports, studies, findings, and notices to assist the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in its compliance with Council direction on remand.

      4. ###### Applicant Fees


         Applicants shall pay applicable fees in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter, if any, for additional environmental review on remand.

      5. ###### Project Timelines


         All Code required timelines to act on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals shall automatically be extended to the extent reasonably necessary for the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to complete the necessary environmental review on remand.

      6. ###### Applicable Project and CEQA Requirements


         On remand, the review and approval of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals shall comply with the Code requirements and all review and approval of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall comply with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.

      7. ###### Appeal of CEQA Clearance on Remand


         An action to approve a [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on remand may be appealed to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) of this Section, provided the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s review is limited to modifications to the original [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
4. ###### City Council Action on Joint Hearings on CEQA Appeals and Project Approvals


      In addition to the above provisions in Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) of this Section and this Subsection (Scope of CEQA Appeal Action), the following rules apply when the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is required to hold a joint hearing under Paragraph F.7.b. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions; Joint Hearings on the CEQA Clearance and Project Approvals) of this Section:

      1. ###### City Council Decision to Affirm the CEQA Clearance


         If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) affirms the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall comply with Paragraph E.1.a (Standard for CEQA Review and Required Findings; CEQA Clearances) of this Section and review the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval or appeal as a subsequent approval of the affirmed [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), if applicable.

      2. ###### City Council Decision to Reverse the CEQA Clearance


         If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determines the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) should be reversed, the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals subject to the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are void. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall approve or remand the decision on a new [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the decision on the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approvals pursuant to the following provisions:

         1. ###### Remand to the Lower Decision Maker


            If any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval is voided or stayed by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s reversal of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall use one of the following procedures.

            1. ###### Remand the CEQA Clearance


               The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may continue its decision on the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval or appeal and remand the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the lower [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for further action under the procedures in Paragraph G.3 (Reversed with Remand) of this Section. The action on the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval subject to [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval shall be continued until the lower [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) adopts a new [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and a new hearing before the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is scheduled.

            2. ###### Approve a New or Modified CEQA Clearance and Remand Project Approvals


               The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may adopt a new [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), decide the related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval or appeal, and remand action on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval subject to the lower decision-making body for the sole purpose of taking an action on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval considering the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approved by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including but not limited to, modifying the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval to incorporate mitigation measures as conditions of approval. The lower decision-making body shall comply with Paragraph E.1.a (Standard for CEQA Review and Required Findings; CEQA Clearances) of this Section, if applicable, and review the remanded [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval as a subsequent approval of the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approved by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
         2. ###### Project Approval and Finality


            If the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approves the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under the procedures in this Subdivision, the date the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is approved and final for purposes of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s is the day the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approves the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and acts on any [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval.

         3. ###### Time Limits


            All Code required time limits to act or hold hearings on [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)-related approvals or appeals are stayed to comply with this Section.
5. ###### Housing Projects


      1. Notwithstanding Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) and Subsection G. (Scope of CEQA Appeal Action) in this Section, if a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, and the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) reverses all [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Council does not have the option to reverse the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) without Remand in Sub-subparagraph b.iii. (Council Authority on Appeal) of this Section.

      2. While the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that includes [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s is on remand to the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) all of the following requirements shall be met:

         1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), subject to the Applicant’s payment of fees and cooperation, shall work diligently to complete all [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) analysis in an expeditious manner.

         2. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act on the [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval within thirty (30) days of the revised or new [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) being completed.

         3. The [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s discretion to modify the previously approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be limited to the mitigation or avoidance of significant environmental impacts, and any necessary findings under [California Government Code, Sec. 65589.5 (Findings to assure the approval of adequate housing)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=65589.5.) shall be made.
8. ##### Modification of Project or Mitigation Measure


1. ###### Modification of Project


      The applicant may modify the approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under the applicable provisions of this Article, provided all requirements of [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are met.

2. ###### Modification to Mitigation Measures after Project Approval


      1. The deletion of an adopted mitigation measure imposed as a condition of approval on an approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the modification of such a condition where the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) cannot otherwise find substantial conformance, shall require the approval of a Modification to Mitigation Measure pursuant to the procedures in this Subdivision.

      2. A Modification to Mitigation Measure is approved upon the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) doing the following:

         1. Complying with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s; including if necessary preparing a new [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), such as an addendum or supplemental or subsequent EIR.

         2. Preparing written findings that support the need for the modification or deletion of the mitigation measure.
      3. [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval of a Modification to Mitigation Measure is final and not appealable. A [CEQA Clearance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approved in support of the Modification to Mitigation Measure, may be appealed under Subsection F. (Appeals of CEQA Decisions) of this Section, if applicable.

      4. Modifying a condition of approval imposing an adopted mitigation measure does not require the approval of any other [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) approval or [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) modification in this Article (Administration).
9. ##### Prohibition and Enforcement of Improper Segmentation of Projects


1. ###### Prohibition


      No person or entity, including without limitation, the applicant, the property owner, or a representative of the applicant or the property owner, shall take any action to avoid [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) review of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including through the misrepresentation of the whole of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in any [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ###### Loss of Historical Resources from Improper Segmentation


      If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, finds a violation of Paragraph 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection under the process in Paragraph 3. (Zoning Administrator Determination) or Paragraph 4. (Appeal) of this Subsection, and finds the violation resulted in the material impairment in the significance of a [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall issue the maximum penalties in Paragraph 5.a. (Penalties) of this Subdivision, unless the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) adopts written findings showing that the maximum penalty is excessive in light of the criteria in Paragraph 5.b. (Penalties) of this Subdivision.

      For purposes of this Subsection, “ [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)” means those resources that meet the definition of a [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in [Public Resources Code, Sec. 21084.1 (Historical resources)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=21084.1.#:~:text=A%20project%20that%20may%20cause,significant%20effect%20on%20the%20environment.) and [Sec. 15064.5(a) (Determining the Significance of Impacts to Archaeological and Historical Resources) of the CEQA Guidelines](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Document/I87D9F3AA5B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3?viewType=FullText&listSource=Search&originationContext=Search+Result&transitionType=SearchItem&contextData=(sc.Search)&navigationPath=Search%2fv1%2fresults%2fnavigation%2fi0a8983d200000193f985e3f0fc428801%3fppcid%3dd24a63e69de449c8a6cf2373c5b49f80%26Nav%3dREGULATION_PUBLICVIEW%26fragmentIdentifier%3dI87D9F3AA5B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3%26startIndex%3d1%26transitionType%3dSearchItem%26contextData%3d%2528sc.Default%2529%26originationContext%3dSearch%2520Result&list=REGULATION_PUBLICVIEW&rank=1&t_T2=15064.5&t_S1=CA+ADC+s). For purposes of meeting the definition above, the [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be presumed to retain its integrity unless proven otherwise by a preponderance of the evidence.

3. ###### Zoning Administrator Determination


      The following procedures shall be followed to enforce a violation of Paragraph 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection:

      1. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) reasonably believes that there has been a violation of Paragraph 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may refer the matter to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for investigation pursuant to the procedures in this Subdivision. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) refers the matter for investigation to the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall request the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to issue a Notice of intent to Revoke Permits and a Stop Work order for the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. Within 45 days of the issuance of a Notice of Intent to Revoke Permits or a Stop Work order, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall either issue a letter of determination finding a violation of Subdivision 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection, or request the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to rescind the Notice of intent to Revoke Permits and the Stop Work order.

      3. For the purpose of deciding the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s determination, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall have the power of subpoena to obtain documents from the Applicant.

      4. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds a violation under Subdivision 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection, the letter of determination shall include written findings supporting the determination and the penalty, if imposed and the letter of determination shall be forwarded to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      5. The letter of determination shall be noticed to the applicant and the property owner by certified mail or personal service, and posted on the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds a violation, the notice shall include the timeline and manner in which an appeal may be filed under this Subsection.
4. ###### Appeal


      1. A [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) determination of a violation under this Subsection is appealable by the applicant or the property owner to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) within 15 days of the notice of the letter of determination being issued. If no appeal is filed, the determination is final.

      2. Any appeal filed to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be decided after a public hearing where the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the appellant have an opportunity to present evidence in support of its case. Notice of the hearing shall be given at least 24 days before the hearing to the appellant and property owner (if the property owner is not the appellant) by mail.

      3. At the hearing, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Appellant shall have the opportunity to testify, cross-examine witnesses, and present witnesses and evidence in support of its case. Written and oral evidence submitted at the hearing shall be submitted under penalty of perjury. Documentary and other tangible evidence must be authenticated to the satisfaction of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall decide the appeal within 75 days of the appeal being filed. The time to act may be continued upon agreement of the appellant and the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). No reasonable request of the appellant for additional time shall be denied.

      5. On appeal, the standard of review shall be de novo, the standard of proof shall be preponderance of the evidence, and except as otherwise provided in this Subsection I. (Prohibition and Enforcement of Improper Segmentation of Projects), the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has the burden of proof.

      6. Within 15 days of the conclusion of the hearing, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render a written decision that shall include a determination of whether a violation occurred, a penalty, if any, written findings as well as a summary of the evidence supporting its decision and any penalty.

      7. The decision of the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be issued in writing and [transmitted](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by mail to the property owner and the applicant, and forwarded to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ###### Penalties


      1. The following penalties may be imposed for the violation of Paragraph 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection:

         1. No entitlements, permits, or approvals under this Article may be issued for the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for up to five years from issuance of the Letter of Determination.

         2. No permits may be issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for new development on the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for up to five years from issuance of the Letter of Determination. The above notwithstanding, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may issue any permits necessary to address a threat to the public health and safety. In imposing this penalty, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, may take into account any action taken by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Section 91.106.4.1.10 (Permits Issuance; Issuance; Exceptions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464).

         3. An administrative penalty of up to $100,000.
      2. In determining penalties, the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on appeal, shall consider any aggravating or mitigating factors, including the following:

         1. the culpability of the violating party;

         2. efforts, if any, to correct the violation;

         3. the benefit to the violating party conferred by the violation;

         4. the seriousness of the violation, including any damage to the physical environment;

         5. the financial status of the violating party; and

         6. any other factors that justice may require.
      3. If the [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds a violation of Paragraph 1. (Prohibition) of this Subsection has occurred, the violator shall pay any cost recovery fee established in [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-123503) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I., or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A)..

      4. Administrative penalties collected under this Subsection (Prohibition and Enforcement of Improper Segmentation of Projects) shall be placed into a special fund for the purpose and promotion of [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) preservation to be administered by the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      5. If the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) imposes a penalty under this Subsection I. (Prohibition and Enforcement of Improper Segmentation of Projects) staying the issuance of permits, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), as applicable, shall record an affidavit with the Los Angeles County Recorder providing notice that no permits for any new development shall be issued on the property for the period of time imposed. If penalties or costs are imposed, the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may record a lien against the property subject to the requirements of State law and the City Code and Charter.
6. ###### CEQA Review of Improperly Segmented Projects


      The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may use a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) description that includes the whole of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including those activities that have already occurred on the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and analyze the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) against a baseline of the physical conditions prior to an improper segmentation if the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds all of the following:

      1. Improper segmentation of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) occurred as a result of misrepresentations of the applicant or the property owner or a representative of the applicant or the property owner;

      2. Permitted or unpermitted activities occurred on the [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) prior to completion of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s review of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) under [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      3. Such analysis is reasonably necessary to adequately analyze and mitigate all potential significant impacts to the environment from the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), such as, a circumstance where the loss of a [historical resource](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or a protected tree through site clearance activities could be feasibly mitigated, even if not to a less than significant level, by site rehabilitation or [reconstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
7. ###### No New Rights


      Nothing in this Subsection I. (Prohibition and Enforcement of Improper Segmentation of Projects) is intended to provide any right or remedy to any third party that does not already exist at law.

### Div. 13B.12. Redevelopment Procedures

#### Sec. 13B.12.1. General Provisions

1. ##### Purpose


The objectives of this Section (General Provisions) are to establish uniform citywide procedures, standards, and criteria for reviewing and processing redevelopment plan projects, including Administrative Review, Project Compliance, Project Modification, Project Adjustments, and Project Amendments in accordance with applicable provisions of the Charter, this Code, City ordinances, state law, and any applicable specific plan, supplemental use district, or other land use regulation adopted by the City.

1. This Division applies to the following redevelopment plans:

      01. The Adelante Eastside Redevelopment Project Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 172,514, and as amended;

      02. The Broadway/Manchester Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 170,175, and as amended;

      03. The Central Industrial Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 174,978, and as amended;

      04. The City Center Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 174,593, and as amended;

      05. The Council District 9 Corridors Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 170,807, and as amended;

      06. The Crenshaw Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 158,933, and as amended;

      07. The Crenshaw/Slauson Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 170,734, and as amended;

      08. The Exposition/University Park Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 131,730, and as amended;

      09. The Hollywood Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 175,236, and as amended;

      10. The Laurel Canyon Commercial Corridor Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 180,695, and as amended;

      11. The Mid-City Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 171,064, and as amended;

      12. The Pacific Corridors Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 174,549, and as amended;

      13. The Vermont/Manchester Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 171,065, and as amended;

      14. The Watts Corridor Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 170,769 and as amended;

      15. The Western/Slauson Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 171,063, and as amended;

      16. The Westlake Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 172,597, and as amended; and

      17. The Wilshire Center/Koreatown Redevelopment Plan, as adopted by Ordinance No. 170,806, and as amended.
2. ###### Applicability to Community Plans with Zoning Classifications under Chapter 1A:


      Whenever a Community Plan is updated and the parcels in the Community Plan boundaries have been zoned with Chapter 1A zoning classifications, the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be of no further force and effect in the Community Plan area unless expressly provided otherwise in the Community Plan or an ordinance adopted to implement the Community Plan.
2. ##### Relationship of the Redevelopment Regulations to City Ordinances


1. The [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are in addition to the provisions of Chapter I and, where applicable, Chapter 1A of this Code and any other relevant City ordinances.

2. Whenever the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) conflict with provisions contained in Chapter I or,

      where applicable, Chapter 1A of this Code or any other relevant City ordinances, the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall supersede those provisions, except in the following circumstances:

      1. If the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) provide for the relationship between the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Code, Community Plan, or other City ordinance or regulation when there is a conflict (for example, Section 502 within certain Redevelopment Plans), then the relationship established in the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall control.

      2. If a Community Plan expressly provides for the relationship between the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the Code, Community Plan, or other City ordinance or regulation, then the relationship established in the Community Plan shall control.

      3. If the conflict is between the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and any incentive program that is intended to provide incentives for restricted affordable units, the Code or City ordinance that established the incentive program shall supersede the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      4. If the conflict is between the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and an ordinance adopted subsequent to the effective date of Ordinance No, 186,325, such ordinance shall supersede the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) unless such ordinance makes itself subject to the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         “Conflict” as used in this Section shall mean if the redevelopment regulation is more permissive or more restrictive than the regulation in the Code or any other relevant City ordinance.Conflict does not mean where [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) are silent.
3. ##### Definitions


The following words and phrases are defined for the purposes of this Division (Redevelopment Plan Procedures). Words and phrases contained in this Division (Redevelopment Plan Procedures) and not defined below shall have the meanings set forth in the applicable Redevelopment Plan, or Sec. 12.03 of Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) for areas of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) subject to Chapter I of this Code, or [Article 14. (General Rules)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14) of Chapter 1A for areas of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) subject to Chapter 1A of this Code, with priority given to definitions in the applicable Redevelopment Plan where there is a conflict between the Redevelopment Plan and Chapter I or Chapter 1A:

Community Redevelopment Agency: Community Redevelopment Agency is defined as the former Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Los Angeles, which was dissolved on February 1, 2012.

Community Redevelopment Law: Community redevelopment law is defined as the Community Redevelopment Law of the State of California (California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 33000 et seq.).

Community Redevelopment Agency - Designated Local Authority: Community Redevelopment Agency - Designated Local Authority is defined as the public body formed pursuant to California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 34173(c)(3) to serve as the successor agency to the former CRA.

Historic Resource: For the purposes of [Div. 13B.12. (Redevelopment Plan Procedures)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12), historic resource is defined as designated or surveyed resources including properties listed in or formally determined eligible for listing in the National Register of Historic Places, the California Register of Historical Resources, locally designated [Historic-Cultural Monument](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s (HCMs) and Historic Preservation Overlay Zones (HPOZs); and properties identified as significant per eligibility criteria in SurveyLA and the [Community Redevelopment Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) surveys or any subsequent City sanctioned or accepted surveys.
