Lower Income Household: For the purposes of [Div. 13B.12. (Redevelopment Plan Procedures)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12), lower income household is defined as the meaning ascribed thereto in the Development Guidelines and Controls for Residential Hotels in the City Center and Central Industrial redevelopment project areas, adopted by the former [CRA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on June 15, 2006.

Redevelopment Plan Amendment: Redevelopment plan amendment is defined as an amendment to a Redevelopment Plan adopted by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by ordinance after the effective date of Ordinance No. 186,325.

Redevelopment Plan Area: See [redevelopment project area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Redevelopment Plan Project: Redevelopment plan project is defined as any proposed development activity within a [redevelopment project area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) with an [unexpired](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) Redevelopment Plan that includes the issuance of a building, grading, demolition, sign or change of use permit. A [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not include activity that consists solely of [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) remodeling, [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) rehabilitation or [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) repair work. Regardless of the foregoing, the following types of projects shall be considered a redevelopment plan project: (i) development activity involving a Historic Resource, including any [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) remodeling, [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) rehabilitation, or [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) repair work that affects the exterior; and/or (ii) development activity involving a Residential Hotel/Single Room Occupancy Hotel (SRO), vacant dwelling unit, or a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) housing [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in the City Center Project Area and the Central Industrial Project Area, including any [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) remodeling, [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) rehabilitation or [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) repair work that may result in the loss of a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Redevelopment Plan Project Adjustment: Redevelopment plan project adjustment is defined as a “minor variation” or “variation” as these terms are used in each Redevelopment Plan and is a decision by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that a redevelopment plan project substantially complies with the relevant [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) except for a minor deviation therefrom, either as submitted or with conditions imposed to achieve substantial compliance with the applicable [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Redevelopment Plan Project Administrative Review: Redevelopment plan project administrative review is defined as the issuance of a ministerial approval by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that complies with the applicable [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Redevelopment Plan Project Compliance: Redevelopment plan project compliance is defined as a decision by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) complies with the applicable [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), either as submitted or with conditions imposed to achieve compliance with the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

Redevelopment Project Area: Redevelopment project area is defined as the area included within the specific geographic boundaries identified as a project area in a Redevelopment Plan and shall be referred to as “Redevelopment Plan Area.”

Redevelopment Regulations: Redevelopment regulations are defined as all the land use provisions of the Redevelopment Plans and design for development guidelines adopted pursuant to such Redevelopment Plans that govern land use or development that were transferred to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 34173(i).

Residential Hotel/Single Room Occupancy Hotel: Residential hotel/single room occupancy hotel is defined as the meaning ascribed thereto in the Development Guidelines and Controls for Residential Hotels in the City Center and Central Industrial redevelopment project areas, adopted by the former [CRA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on June 15, 2006, and/or the Residential Hotel Ordinance (Ordinance No. 179,868) of the City of Los Angeles.

Unexpired: Unexpired is defined as the applicable [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) still in effect on the date of approval of a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [redevelopment plan amendment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

4. ##### Decision Makers & Appellate Bodies for Other Redevelopment Plan Provisions


1. The individual Sections in this Division (Redevelopment Plan Procedures) assign initial decision-making authority for a redevelopment plan project, [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) administrative review, [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), modification of entitlement for a redevelopment plan project, [redevelopment plan project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and [redevelopment plan amendment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). For Redevelopment Plan provisions that are not addressed in this Division (Redevelopment Plan Procedures), the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and appellate bodies responsible for implementing those provisions are the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and City Council, respectively, unless otherwise stated in a Redevelopment Plan.

2. The level of appeal for a specific [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is determined by the project type as defined in this Division (Redevelopment Plan Procedures).
5. ##### Administration of Redevelopment Plan Projects


Applications for the approval of redevelopment plan projects, including applications for [redevelopment plan project administrative review](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), [redevelopment plan project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), redevelopment plan project compliance, and modification of entitlement for a redevelopment plan project shall be filed and processed as follows:

1. ###### Applications


      1. ###### General Requirements


         1. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s filed under this Article must include all the information required by the Department of City Planning. All [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall be made on forms prepared by the Department of City Planning.

         2. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s shall include all fees required by Chapter I (General Provisions and Zoning), Article 9 (Fees) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to Chapter I, or [Article 15. (Fees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s subject to this Chapter.
      2. ###### Application Completeness


         1. An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is not complete until all required items are submitted and all required application fees are paid.

         2. The [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) will not process incomplete [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s. [Application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s will be reviewed for completeness in accordance with the Permit Streamlining Act (California Government Code Title 7, Division 1, Chapter 4.5).
      3. ###### Multiple Entitlement Requests


         1. In order to facilitate the development process, applications for multiple entitlements for the same project shall be submitted and processed concurrently as provided in [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) of this Code.
      4. ###### Withdrawal of Application


         1. At any time before the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or appellate body on appeal makes a final decision on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [applicant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may withdraw the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

         2. The withdrawal of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) must be in writing and does not require the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to concur. The withdrawal of the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be permanent and any associated authorizations shall be void.
2. Nothing herein shall be construed to prohibit the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s designee from promulgating administrative guidelines to interpret and implement the [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

#### Sec. 13B.12.2. Redevelopment Plan Project Administrative Review

1. ##### Applicability


[Redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s are eligible for [redevelopment plan project administrative review](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), except for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s involving the following components or activities. The following [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s that do not qualify for a [redevelopment plan project administrative review](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may apply for a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or a [redevelopment plan project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

1. A residential hotel/SRO, including any vacant [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) housing [lower income household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s in the City Center Project Area and the Central Industrial Project Area; or

2. A residential hotel/SRO involving construction that consists of interior remodeling, interior rehabilitation or interior repair work that results in the loss of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s.
2. ##### Initiation


See [Sec. 13B.3.1.B. (Initiation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) of this Code.

3. ##### Notice


See [Sec. 13B.3.1.C. (Notice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) of this Code.

4. ##### Review


See [Sec. 13B.3.1.D. (Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) of this Code.

5. ##### Criteria for Compliance Review


See [Sec. 13B.3.1.E. (Criteria for Compliance Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) of this Code.

6. ##### Scope of Action


Once a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s administrative review is complete, any subsequent development activity (including but not limited to erection, enlargement or maintenance of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s, development or construction work, and issuance of a grading, building or change of use permit) shall comply with the approval of the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in the administrative review for the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), including any plans approved.

7. ##### Appeals


See [Sec. 13B.3.1.G. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) of this Code.

8. ##### Modification Procedures


Any change to the scope of the application requires review by the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) as provided in [Sec. 13B.12.2. (Redevelopment Plan Project Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12.2) of this Code.


#### Sec. 13B.12.3. Redevelopment Plan Project Compliance

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.3.1.png.webp?itok=cOLw6t27)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.3.1.png?itok=F1XG6DLq)

1. ##### Applicability


1. This Section (Redevelopment Plan Project Compliance) applies to the review of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s within redevelopment plan areas in accordance with applicable Redevelopment Plan requirements and the City Charter.

2. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may determine the type of [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) s exempt from this Section (Redevelopment Plan Project Compliance) based on exemption provisions and other regulations contained in individual Redevelopment Plans.
2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for the initial decision on a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.

2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:



      |     |     |     |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and occupants of all properties [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from, or having a common corner with the subject property;<br>•The Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the Redevelopment Plan area in which the property is located;<br>•The Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5) of this Code.

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete or, when an Environmental Impact Report (EIR) or other [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) document is required, the date the EIR or other [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) document is certified or adopted.

      2. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in accordance with the procedures set forth in [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
4. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall transmit a copy of the decision to: the applicant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [redevelopment plan area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in which the property is located, the Department of Transportation (where appropriate), owners of all properties [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and interested parties who have filed written requests with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


In approving a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find that the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

1. Substantially complies with the relevant [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), findings, standards, and provisions of the Redevelopment Plan; and

2. Is subject to all conditions required by the relevant [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

3. Complies with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

2. ###### Limitations


      The granting of a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not imply compliance with any other applicable provisions of this Code. Any corrections and/or modifications to project plans made subsequent to a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that are deemed necessary by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for Building Code compliance, and which involve a change in [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), automobile parking, building height, yards or setbacks, building separation or lot coverage, shall require a referral of the revised plans back to the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (and the Department of Transportation in cases where there are corrections and/or modifications that may affect the ingress, egress, circulation, calculation of vehicle trips generated, project floor area or automobile parking) for additional review and sign-off prior to the issuance of any permit in connection with those plans.

3. ###### Applicant’s Compliance with Project Compliance Terms & Conditions


      Once a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is utilized, the applicant shall comply with the terms and conditions of the [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) that affect the construction and/or operational phases of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). For purposes of this Subsection (Scope of Decision), utilization of a [redevelopment plan project compliance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall mean that a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) has been issued and construction work has begun and been carried on diligently.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may file an appeal of the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section (Redevelopment Plan Project Compliance).

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.
8. ##### Modification Procedures


See [Sec. 13B.12.4. (Modification of Entitlement for a Redevelopment Plan Project)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.12.4) of this Code.


#### Sec. 13B.12.4. Modification of Entitlement for a Redevelopment Plan Project

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.4.1.png.webp?itok=sFgt7e6A)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.4.1.png?itok=fztglNLF)

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### Original Action


      This Section (Modification of Entitlement for a Redevelopment Plan Project) applies to the modification of a previously approved entitlement (referred to in this Section as the “original action”) that substantially conforms to the original approval.

2. ###### Modification


      1. For the purposes of this Section (Modification of Entitlement for a Redevelopment Plan Project), a “modification” means any changes in the proposed physical development, planned operation, or conditions of approval.

      2. In no event can any modification or series of modifications allow a use, single deviation, or series of deviations (including but not limited to “minor deviations” and “variations” as those terms are used in the Redevelopment Plans) to exceed the maximum deviation allowed by the relevant Redevelopment Plan or [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
3. ###### Maximum Deviation


      1. A [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), single deviation, or series of deviations from the [LAMC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or Redevelopment Plan which was not approved as part of the original action; or

      2. Any modification that would result in an increase or reduction of the physical development, planned operation, or conditions of approval on the original action by more than 20 percent.
4. ###### New Application


      Any deviation that does not substantially conform to the original action, or exceeds the maximum deviation prescribed in Paragraph 3. (Maximum Deviation) above, requires a new [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
2. ##### Initiation


See [Sec. 13B.5.4.B. (Initiation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4).

3. ##### Notice


See [Sec. 13B.5.4.C. (Notice)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4).

4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      1. The initial decision maker on a modification of entitlement for a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) on the original action. In the event that the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) was the [CRA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Director of Planning shall be the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

      2. If the original action was subject to multiple approvals, the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) assigned pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.10. (Multiple Approvals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.10) of this Code, unless otherwise delegated.
3. ###### Public Hearing


      The initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may conduct a public hearing after providing the notice in the same manner as required on the appeal of the original action. A hearing need not be held if the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) makes a written finding that the requested modification of entitlement for a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#):

      1. Will not have a significant effect on [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) properties or on the immediate neighborhood; or

      2. Is not likely to evoke public controversy.
4. ###### Decision


      See [Sec. 13B.5.4.D.4. (Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.

5. ###### Conditions


      See [Sec. 13B.5.4.D.5. (Conditions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.

6. ###### Transmittal


      See [Sec. 13B.5.4.D.6. (Transmittal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. A modification of entitlement for a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall not be granted unless the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) finds that the modification complies with all of the findings that apply to the original action.

2. If the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for modification of entitlement for a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is for only a portion of a development project, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s review and decision shall be limited to only that portion of the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). However, the [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may consider the entire [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) to the extent that the approved [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) and the portion for which the modification of entitlement for a [redevelopment plan project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is requested are indistinct.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


1. See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7) of this Code.

2. See [Sec. 13B.5.4.F.2. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.
7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8) of this Code.

2. ###### Appealable in Same Manner as Original Action


      See [Sec. 13B.5.4.G.2. (Appealable in Same Manner as Original Action)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.

3. ###### Scope of Appeal


      See [Sec. 13B.5.4.G.3. (Scope of Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.
8. ##### Modification Procedures


See [Sec. 13B.5.4.H. (Modification Procedures)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.4) of this Code.


#### Sec. 13B.12.5. Redevelopment Plan Project Adjustment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.5.1.png.webp?itok=Usbl74gK)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.5.1.png?itok=B-2K_prb)

1. ##### Applicability


This Section (Redevelopment Plan Project Adjustment) applies to requests for minor variations from certain [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

2. ##### Initiation


An [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) for a [redevelopment plan project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is filed with the [Department](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      There is no public hearing required for the initial decision on a [redevelopment plan project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), and therefore no notice of a public hearing is required.

2. ###### Notice of Public Hearing on Appeal


      The following notice is required for the public hearing on the appeal:



      |     |     |     |
      | --- | --- | --- |
      | Type of Notice | When | Where / To Whom / Additional Requirements |
      | Mail | 24 days | •The applicant;<br>•The owner(s) of the property involved;<br>•The owners and occupants of all properties [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from, or having a common corner with the subject property;<br>•The Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the Redevelopment Plan area in which the property is located;<br>•The Department of Neighborhood Empowerment; <br>•The Certified Neighborhood Council representing the area in which the property is located; and<br>•Interested parties who have requested in writing to be notified |
4. ##### Decision


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.5. (Decisions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.5) of this Code.

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the initial [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Decision


      1. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall render the initial decision within 75 days of the date the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is deemed complete.

      2. If the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) fails to make a timely decision, the applicant may file a request for transfer of jurisdiction to the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.6. (Transfer of Jurisdiction)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.6).
4. ###### Transmittal


      The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall transmit a copy of the decision by email, electronic transmission, or mail to the applicant, the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the Councilmember(s) having jurisdiction over the [redevelopment plan area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) in which the property is located, the Department of Transportation (where appropriate), owners of all properties abutting, across the street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) from, or having a common corner with the subject property; and interested parties who have filed written requests with the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).
5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


1. In approving a [redevelopment plan project adjustment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or approving it with conditions, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) (on appeal) shall find in writing that the approval:

      1. Substantially complies with the applicable [redevelopment regulations](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      2. Complies with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#); and

      3. All findings for variations and minor variations, as required by the applicable Redevelopment Plan, are met.
6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7).

7. ##### Appeals


1. ###### General Procedures


      See [Sec. 13A.2.8. (Appeals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.8).

2. ###### Decision Maker


      The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) is the appellate [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#).

3. ###### Filing


      An applicant or any other [aggrieved person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#)’s decision may file an appeal.

4. ###### Appellate Decision


      1. Before acting on any appeal, the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall set the matter for hearing, giving notice in the manner specified in Subsection C. (Notice) of this Section (Redevelopment Plan Project Adjustment).

      2. The [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall act within 75 days after the expiration of the appeal period.

      3. The decision to approve or deny an appeal must contain the same findings required by the original [decision maker](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), supported by substantial evidence.

      4. The decision of the appellate body is final.
8. ##### Modification Procedures


No modification is available.


#### Sec. 13B.12.6. Redevelopment Plan Amendment

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.6.1.png.webp?itok=JvEAuwn3)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/13B.12.6.1.png?itok=VhRCk3H6)

1. ##### Applicability


1. ###### General


      This Section (Redevelopment Plan Amendment) applies to any amendment to any Redevelopment Plan, subject to the requirements and limitations of the Charter and state law.

2. ###### Fee


      The fee for a [redevelopment plan amendment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) shall be set forth in Sec. 19.01 G. of Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning) and [Sec. 15.2.2. (Fees for Establishment or Change of Zones, & Other Related Actions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.2.2) of Chapter 1A of this Code.
2. ##### Initiation


Only the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#), or the Director of Planning may initiate a [redevelopment plan amendment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#). An action to initiate a [redevelopment plan amendment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) by the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) or the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) requires a [majority](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) vote.

3. ##### Notice


1. ###### Notice of Public Hearing


      See [Sec. 13B.1.3.C.1. (Notice of Public Hearing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3) of this Code.
4. ##### Decision


See [Sec. 13B.1.3.D. (Zoning Code Amendment; Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3) of this Code.

5. ##### Standards for Review and Required Findings


See [Sec. 13B.1.3.E. (Standards for Review and Required Findings)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.3) of this Code.

6. ##### Scope of Decision


See [Sec. 13A.2.7. (Scope of Decision)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.7) of this Code.

7. ##### Appeals


There is no appeal.

8. ##### Modification of Redevelopment Plan Amendment


A [redevelopment plan amendment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#) may be modified by following the same procedures established above for the original action.

# Article 14. General Rules

## Div. 14.1. Introduction

### Sec. 14.1.1. Opening Provisions

1. ##### General


1. This Article (General Rules) contains [Div. 14.2. (General Standards & Measurements)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2) which includes definitions, measurements, and standards related to rules in this Chapter.

2. This Article (General Rules) also contains [Div. 14.3. (Glossary)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.3), which contains all defined terms, abbreviations, and symbols used throughout this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

3. Where a definition contains a list of examples, the examples listed are provided as illustrative examples to guide users, and not an exhaustive list.

4. The provisions of [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 11.01.(b) (Grammatical Interpretation)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-144) and [Sec. 11.01.(c) (Civil Code Provisions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-144) shall apply to the interpretation of this Article (General Rules).
2. ##### Definitions & Standards


Text in italics below a heading provides a definition of that heading. A definition may be supported by development standards and/or measurement instructions specific to that defined heading.

3. ##### Illustrations & Graphics


Illustrations and graphics are included in this Article (General Rules) only to assist users in understanding the intent and requirement of the text. In the event that a conflict occurs between the text of this Article (General Rules) and any illustrations or graphics, the text shall prevail.


## Div. 14.2. General Standards & Measurement

The following definitions and standards apply to this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

### Sec. 14.2.1. Building Footprint

Building footprint is defined as the area of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) occupied by a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured horizontally. Also referred to as "structure footprint".

1. ##### Definitions & Standards


The following definitions and standards apply to [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s:

1. [Building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes those portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) covered by [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s. [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.1.2.png.webp?itok=TLYi1cAn)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.1.2.png?itok=kgUn13Xl)

2. [Building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) covered by architectural projections (including roof overhangs, and [projecting balcony](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)) that meet both of the following criteria:

      1. The architectural projection does not include [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); and

      2. The architectural projection projects less than five feet from the nearest wall, column, spanning beam, or other structural element carrying gravity loads to the ground. [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.1.4.png.webp?itok=HnbAjfma)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.1.4.png?itok=hXCEeHCM)

### Sec. 14.2.2. Covered Area (%)

Covered area is defined as the measurement of how open an [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is to the sky.

1. ##### Definitions & Standards


The following definitions and standards apply to a [covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

1. ###### Covered


      A space or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is considered covered if less than 25 percent of its area is [open to the sky](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. ###### Uncovered


      A space or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is considered uncovered if 25 percent of more of its area is [open to the sky](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Areas containing overhead, non-solid structures, such as lattice and pergolas, may be considered uncovered provided that 25 percent or more of their area is [open to the sky](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

3. ###### Sheltered


      A space or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is considered sheltered if no portion of its area is [open to the sky](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
2. ##### Measurement


[Covered area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is a percentage, measured as the cumulative area that is not [open to the sky](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) divided by the total area of the subject space or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).


### Sec. 14.2.3. Distance

1. ##### Definitions & Standards


The following definitions and standards apply to [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

1. ###### Distance


      Distance is defined as the amount of space between two points.

      1. ###### Measurement


         1. When [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is specified as being measured horizontally or vertically between two points, a line shall be projected from each of the points along the same plane until the projected lines can be connected by a perpendicular line. The [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between the two points is measured along the perpendicular line.

         2. When [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is not specified as being measured horizontally or vertically, it shall be measured in the shortest straight line from one point to another.
2. ###### Walking Distance


      Walking distance is the [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) measured as the most direct path of travel for a pedestrian.

      1. ###### Measurement


         [Walking distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured horizontally along the most direct route of travel on the ground in the following manner:

         1. Starting at the nearest [street-facing entrance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) accessible to the majority of tenants or [resident](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

         2. In a straight line to the nearest [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), walkway, street, or road;

         3. Along a [public sidewalk](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), walkway, street, or road; and

         4. In a straight line ending at the nearest [pedestrian access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) point to the destination [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.4. Enclosure

Enclosure is defined as the measurement of how closed off an [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is to its surroundings.

1. ##### Definitions & Standards


The following definitions and standards apply to an [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

1. ###### Enclosed


      A space is considered to be enclosed when the perimeter of the space has an [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of at least 66.7 percent.

2. ###### Unenclosed


      A space is considered to be unenclosed when the perimeter of the space has an [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of less than 66.7 percent.

3. ###### Perimeter Plane


      A perimeter plane is defined as an imaginary vertical plane along the perimeter of a space used to measure the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a space. A perimeter plane shall be projected for a height of eight feet measured from the floor or [ground surface](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the space.

4. ###### Solid Area


      A solid area is defined as the portions of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that have a permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or component physically obstructing the space from its surroundings. For the purpose of measuring the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a space, portions of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are considered solid area where a permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or component is located within five feet of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured perpendicular to the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and away from the subject space.

5. ###### Non-Solid Area


      A non-solid area is defined as the portions of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s along the perimeter of a space that have no permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or component obstructing the space from its surroundings. For the purpose of measuring the [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a space, portions of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are considered non-solid area where no permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or component is located within five feet of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured perpendicular to the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and away from the subject space.

6. ###### Solid Perimeter


      A solid perimeter is defined as the length of a perimeter of a space that consists of [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for the entire height of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

7. ###### Weighted Solid Perimeter


      Where [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s consist of a mix of [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [non-solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the weighted solid perimeter for each [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is the length of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) weighted by the percent of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area that is composed of [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
2. ##### Measurement


[Enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured as a percentage, calculated by dividing the cumulative length of the perimeter of a space that is [solid perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by the total perimeter of the space.

1. ###### Solid Perimeter Method


      For spaces with [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that do not contain a mixture of [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [non-solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for the full height of the [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be calculated as the length of the solid portion of the perimeter divided by the total perimeter.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.4.1.png.webp?itok=wX2dgDPn)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.4.1.png?itok=krdIteA7)

2. ###### Weighted Solid Perimeter Method


      For spaces with [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that contain a mixture of [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [non-solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) across their height, [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be calculated as the sum of the [weighted solid perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of all [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s divided by the total perimeter of the space.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.4.3.png.webp?itok=JlgS0kQ2)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.4.3.png?itok=AVYfy_gh)
3. ##### Exceptions


1. [Safety barrier](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s 45 inches in height or less, measured from [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), having an [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of no more than 40 percent do not count toward [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [solid perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. [Safety barrier](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s 45 inches in height or less, measured from [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), that are transparent with a minimum [visual light transmittance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of 60 percent and maximum external reflectance of 20 percent do not count toward [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [solid perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.5. Encroachments

1. ##### Horizontal Encroachments


A horizontal encroachment is defined as a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or assembly that extends horizontally into a space where [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are typically prohibited.

1. ###### Definitions & Standards


      The following definitions and standards apply to a [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

      01. ###### Architectural Details


          Architectural details are defined as building elements attached to or integrated into the structure of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), not intended for human occupation. Types of architectural details include, but are not limited to: cornices, [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [sill](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, lintels, pilasters, pediments, or chimneys.

      02. ###### Roof Projections


          Roof projections are defined as roof elements that overhang or cantilever beyond the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and do not include posts or columns. Types of roof projections include, but are not limited to: eaves, roof overhangs, gutters, awnings, or canopies.

      03. ###### Unenclosed Structures: Ground Story


          To be eligible as a [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Unenclosed Structures: Ground Story, an [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) on the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have all finished floors and [ground surface](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s at or below the maximum [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as specified in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) and shall have a total [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) height of 15 feet or less, measured from surrounding [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Types of eligible [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s include, but are not limited to: porches, decks, stoops, landing platforms, gazebos, trellises, arbors, pergolas, basketball hoops, or volleyball nets.

      04. ###### Unenclosed Structures: Above Ground Story


          To be eligible as a [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Unenclosed Structures: Above Ground Story, an [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have finished floors or [ground surface](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s above the maximum [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as specified in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) or shall have a total [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) height of 15 feet or greater, measured from surrounding [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Types of eligible [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s include, but are not limited to: balconies, upper-story light shelves, or exterior stairways.

      05. ###### Enclosed Structures: Projecting


          To be eligible as a [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Enclosed Structures: Projecting, a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall; project, overhang, or cantilever beyond the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); meet the definition of [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); and shall have a cumulative length less than 25 percent of the length of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Types of eligible [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s include, but are not limited to: bay windows, oriel windows, sleeping porches, overhanging volumes, or [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) balconies.

      06. ###### Mechanical/Electrical Equipment: Ground Mounted


          To be eligible as a [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Mechanical/Electrical Equipment: Ground Mounted, the weight of the [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or electrical equipment including the equipment's related wires, conduits, and pipes shall be primarily supported by the ground. Examples of eligible equipment include, but are not limited to: gas meter, water softener, pool equipment, HVAC equipment, gas tank, cistern, wind turbine, or solar panel.

      07. ###### Mechanical/Electrical Equipment: Wall Mounted


          To be eligible as a [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Mechanical/Electrical Equipment: Wall Mounted, the [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or electrical equipment including the equipment's related wires, conduits, and pipes shall be attached to and primarily supported by a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Examples of eligible equipment include, but are not limited to: gas meter, electric meter, electrical panel, water heater, HVAC equipment, or gas tank.

      08. ###### Waste Enclosure


          Waste enclosure is defined as waste areas and their required [screening structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s. Examples of waste enclosures include, but are not limited to enclosures for: trash compactors, garbage, recycling, or food waste.

      09. ###### Utility Equipment


          Utility equipment is defined as equipment related to publicly-operated or utility-operated systems, including their related wires, conduits and pipes. Examples of utility equipment include, but are not limited to: hydrants, transformers, utility cabinets, water utility devices, cable television boxes, Internet boxes, or phone boxes.

      10. ###### Underground Structures


          Underground structures are defined as [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s located entirely below [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Examples of underground structures include, but are not limited to: cellars, [basement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [underground parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, stormwater storages, or cisterns.

      11. ###### Flatwork


          Flatwork is defined as constructed objects 30 inches in height or less, measured from [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Examples of flatwork may include, but are not limited to: pavement, sidewalk, multi-use path, patio, a low deck, or stairs or ramps 30 inches in height or less.

      12. ###### Fences, Walls, Hedges, & Screening


          [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, or hedges used for the purposes of [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or any required [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may encroach into any required setback up to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided that [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s in any [frontage yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are allowed by the frontage yard fence & wall standards specified in the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

      13. ###### Vegetation


          To be eligible as a horizontal encroachment for Vegetation, the [vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall meet the definition of [vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [Vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s also include planters that meet the requirements of [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      14. ###### Outdoor Furniture


          Outdoor furniture is defined as permanent or movable furniture not located within an [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) space. Examples of outdoor furniture may include, but are not limited to: benches, tables, or bike or scooter parking racks.

          1. Outdoor furniture may encroach into any required setback up to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
      15. ###### Signs


          For standards on [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 4C.11. (Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11).
2. ###### Measurement


      1. ###### Encroachment


         [Horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured as the horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the edge of the area where [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are restricted.

      2. ###### Distance from Lot Line


         For purposes of measuring [horizontal encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured as the horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and toward the interior of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) along the full perimeter of the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
2. ##### Vertical Encroachments


A vertical encroachment is defined as a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or assembly that extends vertically into a space where [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are typically prohibited.

1. ###### Definitions & Standards


      The following definitions and standards apply to [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s:

      1. ###### General


         No [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that contribute to [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are allowed.

      2. ###### Mechanical/Electrical Equipment: Roof Mounted


         To be eligible as a vertical encroachment for Mechanical/Electrical Equipment: Roof Mounted, [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or electrical equipment including the equipment's related wires, conduits, pipes and visual screens shall be supported by a roof. Eligible equipment also include the required [screening](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 4C.12.1. (Roof-Mounted Equipment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.12.1). Examples of eligible equipment include, but are not limited to: HVAC equipment, cisterns, water tanks, wind turbines, solar panels, solar water heaters, exhaust ducts, smokestacks, wireless masts, communication equipment, satellite dishes, ventilation fans, chimney, flues, vent stacks, or generators.

      3. ###### Architectural Elements


         Architectural elements are defined as building elements attached to or integrated onto the roof of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), not intended for human occupation. Examples of architectural elements may include, but are not limited to: skylights, steeples, spires, belfries, cupolas, domes, flagpoles, or lighting.

      4. ###### Vertical Circulation


         Vertical circulation is defined as [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s used for building circulation and rooftop [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Examples of vertical circulation may include, but are not limited to: elevator rooms and associated equipment, and stair accesses to a roof.

      5. ###### Safety Barriers


         Safety barriers are defined as vertical barriers that are 45 inches in height or less and required for safety and protection by [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172082) of this Code to protect occupants from falling from walking surfaces. Examples of safety barriers may include, but are not limited to: parapets, railings, or banisters.

      6. ###### Unenclosed Structures


         To be eligible as a [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Unenclosed Structures, [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall meet the definition of unenclosed, be attached to or integrated onto the roof of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and be intended for human shelter or activity. Examples of eligible [unenclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s may include, but are not limited to: shade structures, cabanas, pergolas, rooftop bars, outdoor dining, permanent seating, beehives, sports courts, or cooking facilities.

      7. ###### Flatwork


         Flatwork is defined as constructed objects 30 inches in height or less. Examples of flatwork may include, but are not limited to: decking, walkways, patios, or planters.

      8. ###### Vegetation


         To be eligible as a [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for Vegetation, the [vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall meet the definition of [vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [Vegetation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s also include planters that meet the requirements of [Sec. 4C.6.4.C.2. (Planting Areas)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

      9. ###### Signs


         For standards on [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 4C.11. (Signs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11).
2. ###### Measurement


      1. ###### Encroachment


         1. ###### Height in Feet


            For any [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) with a maximum [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) standard, [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured as the vertical [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the maximum allowed [height in feet](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the topmost point of the encroaching object.

         2. ###### Height in Stories Only


            For [Form Districts (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) where height is regulated only in stories, [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured as the vertical [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the top of the [roof structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the topmost point of the encroaching object.
      2. ###### Setback from Roof Edge


         For the purposes of measuring [vertical encroachment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), setback from roof edge is measured as the horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the outermost edge of the [roof structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and inward along the full perimeter of the [roof structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.6. Facing

Facing is defined as the exterior portions of a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that are exposed to a specified object or site element.

1. ##### Standards


1. ###### Measurement


      For the purposes of measuring [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the following standards apply:

      1. Where the exterior portions of a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are specified as exposed to a linear (or one dimensional) site element, those exterior portions are considered to be [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) where they are visible from a [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) projected parallel to the specified object or site element, such as a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). For example see Subsection B. (Lot Line-Facing Facade) below. To determine [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s projected along curved or complex [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or other linear site elements, see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).

      2. Where the exterior portions of a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are specified as exposed to an area or an object/site element (such as a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)) all portions of a subject [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) visible from any of the four [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s projected parallel to each side of and oriented away from the smallest rectangle that circumscribes the footprint of the object or site element, are considered to be [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the specified object or site element. [Building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s projected that include no visible portions of the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) do not need to be included. See Subsection C. (Pedestrian Amenity & Public Amenity-Facing Facade) below, for an example.
2. ###### Exceptions


      Portions of a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that would otherwise be considered to be [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a specified object or site element which are located more than 50 feet from the specified object or site element, are not included, provided they are less than 50 percent of the total width of the specified object or site element measured parallel to the [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s required in Subsection A. (Standards) above.
2. ##### Lot Line-Facing Facade


The portions of any frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2) having no permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (not including [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s) located between the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

1. ###### Measurement


      1. All [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s visible from a [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) projected parallel to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are considered [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall not be considered as affecting visibility.


          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.6.1.png.webp?itok=fKZzBubi)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.6.1.png?itok=gkZFdbYB)
      2. To measure [lot line-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s along curved or complex [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).
2. ###### Exceptions


      1. Portions of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that would otherwise be considered to be [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the following conditions are exempt from any requirements of [lot line-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s:

         1. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s set back 50 feet greater than the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) nearest to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided they are less than 50 percent of the total [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         2. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that are located entirely above the sixth [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and are stepped-back more than 25 feet from the exterior perimeter of the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) below.
      2. Portions of a frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.2. Frontage Applicable Portions of a Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2), having an allowable [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), per the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B), located between the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are still considered [lot line-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s. [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall not be considered as affecting visibility for purposes of determining if a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
3. ##### Pedestrian Amenity & Public Amenity-Facing Facade


The portions of any frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facade)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2) having no permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (not including [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s) located between the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

1. ###### Measurement


      1. All portions of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) visible from the required [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s below are considered pedestrian amenity [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or public amenity [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall not be considered as affecting visibility. [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.6.4.png.webp?itok=hx1KW4E8)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.6.4.png?itok=1Zw3D8Hx)

         1. A [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) projected parallel to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); and

         2. A [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) projected perpendicular to the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
      2. For purposes of measuring pedestrian amenity & public amenity-facing facade for [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s along curved or complex [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).
2. ###### Exceptions


      Portions of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that would otherwise be considered to be [pedestrian amenity-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [public amenity-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the following conditions are exempt from any requirements of pedestrian amenity & public amenity-facing facades:

      1. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s set back 50 feet greater than the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) nearest to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided they are less than 50 percent of the total width of the [pedestrian amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [public amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that are located entirely above the sixth [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and are stepped-back more than 25 feet from the exterior perimeter of the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) below.
4. ##### Street-Facing Facade


Street-facing facade is defined as the portions of any frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2), having no permanent [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (not including [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s) located between the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

1. ###### Measurement


      1. All [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s visible from a [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) projected parallel to the [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are considered street- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [Fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall not be considered as affecting visibility. [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.6.6.png.webp?itok=nMWnpsjK)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.6.6.png?itok=jY5ueMqs)

      2. For purposes of measuring [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), for [building elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s along curved or complex [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, see [Sec. 14.2.14. (Irregular Lot lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).
2. ###### Exceptions


      Portions of a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that would otherwise be considered to be street- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the following conditions are exempt from any requirements of [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s:

      1. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s more than 50 feet from the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided they are less than 50 percent of the total [building width](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. [Facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that are located entirely above the sixth [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and are stepped-back more than 25 feet from the exterior perimeter of the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) below.

### Sec. 14.2.7. Floor Area

Floor area is defined as the cumulative amount of [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) floor space on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), within a room, or within a [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) space.

1. ##### Measurement


1. ###### General


      1. [Floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is calculated as the sum of all [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) floor space for each [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. The following areas are included in the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

         1. All areas within the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); or

         2. All areas within the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of any [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that is both [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
      3. ###### Exceptions


         The following areas and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall not be considered in determining [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

         1. [Exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s;

         2. Bicycle parking areas;

         3. All [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) floor space dedicated to automobile parking, except as specified in Paragraph 2. (House Form Districts) below and Paragraph 3. (Development Standards District 5) below;

         4. Spaces with ceiling heights less than seven feet measured from finished floor, including floored [attic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) space;

         5. [Basement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s including [underground parking](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and cellars, with the exception of [storage, indoor: self-service](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) areas;

         6. Stairways and elevator shafts;

         7. Areas dedicated to housing [mechanical equipment](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or machinery utilized for the operation of on-site [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, provided that the equipment does not serve any off-site [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s;

         8. [Waste enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s dedicated to waste receptacles that are integral or incidental to the operation of on-site [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, provided that the waste receptacles do not serve any off-site [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s; and

         9. [Outdoor dining area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that have not been subject of a wage claim under [Chapter XVIII. (Employee Wages and Protections), Article 8. (Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards Ordinance)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-287786#JD_C18A8) of this Code.
2. ###### House Form Districts


      In a lot with an applied [House Form District (Div. 2B.3.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B.3), the following rules apply:

      1. Any floor or portion of a floor with a ceiling height greater than 14 feet counts as twice the square footage of that area.

      2. Up to 400 square feet of a detached garage is exempt from the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is:

         1. Separated from the primary [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a minimum of 10 feet; and

         2. Located a minimum of 40 feet from a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
      3. Up to 200 square feet of an attached garage is exempt from the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      4. No more than 400 square feet of garage [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be exempt.

      5.
