Detached [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that do not exceed 18 feet in height and 200 square feet in floor area are exempt from the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided that the total combined area exempted of all the detached [accessory building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not exceed 400 square feet in floor area.
3. ###### Development Standards District 5


      In a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with an applied [Development Standards District 5 (Sec. 4B.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5), the following rules apply:

      1. All [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [above-grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s located on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) zoned with [Development Standards District 5 (Sec. 4B.2.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5) are included in the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. [Active space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s with a minimum depth of 30 feet measured from the [street-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and located on the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are exempt from the calculation of [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.8. Frequency

Frequency is defined as the rate at which something occurs or is repeated over a given [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)

1. ##### Measurement


1. Spacing [frequency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is a ratio measured as the number of required occurrences of an object over a specified [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (displayed as occurrences: [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or occurrences per [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)).

      1. Occurrences of an object are measured as the total quantity of a required object located within the specified [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. Specified [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured horizontally.
2. To calculate the number of required objects over a provided [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), divide the required occurrence of an object by the specified [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in the frequency ratio, then multiply this quotient by the applicable [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

3. When calculating the number of required objects results in the requirement of a fractional occurrence, any fraction greater than 0.5 shall be rounded up to the nearest whole occurrence and any fraction of 0.5 or less may be may be rounded down to the nearest whole occurrence so long as at least one occurrence is provided.

4. [Frequency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) standards do not preclude irregular spacing.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.8.1.png.webp?itok=wgknR9xY)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.8.1.png?itok=VTSN4V-T)

### Sec. 14.2.9. Grade Plane Elevation

Grade plane elevation is defined as a reference plane, representing the average [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the existing ground level adjoining a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and its [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, from which the height of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be measured.

1. ##### General


1. ###### Average Grade Elevation


      For all [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that have no applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to Subsection B. (Applicable Building Perimeter) below or for [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that contain an [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of less than 15 percent slope, except [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s located within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)'s [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) per [Sec. 1.5.6. (Hillside Area Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.6), the [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be established in accordance with Subsection E. (Average Grade Method) below.

2. ###### Full Building Method & Building Module Method


      For [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s located within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)'s [Hillside Area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be established for either an entire [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in accordance with Subsection C. (Full Building Method) below or separately for different [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s in accordance with Subsection D. (Building Module Method) below. Using the Full Building Method, in accordance with [Sec. 14.1.9.C. (Full Building Method)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.1.9) or for separate [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s using the Building Module Method in accordance with [Sec. 14.1.9.D. (Building Module Method)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.1.9).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.1.png.webp?itok=vHTgig00)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.1.png?itok=wZrK6vdi)
2. ##### Applicable Building Perimeter


1. Only [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s located within 50 feet of the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that the [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are considered applicable perimeters when calculating [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) using the Subsection C. (Full Building Method) below or Subsection D. (Building Module Method) below.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.3.png.webp?itok=-Q13r0Fg)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.3.png?itok=fY-usncT)

2. Applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s associated with the same [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the same [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are considered a singular or part of the same [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) even where they are not contiguous.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.5.png.webp?itok=H7S_PMWy)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.5.png?itok=YvfL1ibV)

3. Where a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) has no [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) perimeter within 50 feet of a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be established according to Subsection E. (Average Grade Method) below.
3. ##### Full Building Method


1. When using the full building method, the entirety of each [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be governed by a uniform weighted average [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) reference.

2. Where there are multiple [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, each [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall independently establish its own weighted average [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

3. Establishing the weighted average [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) using the full building method is determined by following the steps below:

      1. ###### Step 1


         For each applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.9.B. (Applicable Building Perimeter)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.9), calculate the [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by averaging the highest and lowest [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of on-site [existing grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located within six feet of the subject applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.7.png.webp?itok=5-QJK_Kl)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.7.png?itok=Js1njp7J)

      2. ###### Step 2


         For each applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.9.B. (Applicable Building Perimeter)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.9), calculate the weighted [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [existing grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by multiplying the [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [existing grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by the width of the applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured parallel to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that it [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.9.png.webp?itok=VOa4Ua50)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.9.png?itok=v5X3BzcG)

      3. ###### Step 3


         Sum the weighted [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [existing grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (for all applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s) and divide the sum by the cumulative total length of all applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s associated with the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.11.png.webp?itok=nhAKl0ot)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.11.png?itok=FjuXC2o0)
4. ##### Building Module Method


1. When using the [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) method, a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be broken up into multiple [module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, each possessing its independently established weighted average [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. [Building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall be delineated according to the following steps:

      1. All portions of a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated to a [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. Each [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not encompass any area external to the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      3. Each [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have an individual [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and shall not overlap with another [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)'s [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      4. All components of a [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area shall be contiguous.

      5. All [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall have at least one [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) qualifying as an applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to Subsection B. (Applicable Building Perimeter) above.

      6. [Building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) perimeters internal to a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not include any interior angles greater than 180 degrees.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.13.png.webp?itok=S-X-CvxL)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.13.png?itok=L0CGtJFZ)

      7. [Building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall not include a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that extends beyond the width of its applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured parallel to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that the applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.15.png.webp?itok=kgMqHYFv)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.15.png?itok=Z24JZR2L)
3. Using the [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) method, [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be established independently for each [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) following the steps below:

      1. Step 1

         For each applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to Subsection B. (Applicable Building Perimeter) above, calculate the [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by averaging the highest and lowest [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s within six feet of the applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the [existing grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.17.png.webp?itok=IPlczU4D)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.17.png?itok=2tBPlPYl)

      2. ###### Step 2


         For each applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to Subsection B. (Applicable Building Perimeter) above, calculate the weighted [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by multiplying the [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by the width of the applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured parallel to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that it [faces](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.19.png.webp?itok=N3sL80w1)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.19.png?itok=9Eb3uy6v)

      3. Step 3

         Sum the weighted [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) average [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from all applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s associated with the [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and divide this sum by the total cumulative length of all applicable perimeters associated with the [building module](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.21.png.webp?itok=19E7sH-l)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.21.png?itok=iw9JIi_w)
5. ##### Average Grade Method


When using the average [grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) method the [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be established by averaging the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) measured from the lowest and highest [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) points of the [existing grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), within six feet of the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), whichever is less.

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.23.png.webp?itok=vO3I79YU)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.9.23.png?itok=JyArKiLP)


### Sec. 14.2.10. Story

Story is defined as the portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) included between the upper surface of a floor and the upper surface of the floor next above, except that the topmost story is that portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) included between the upper surface of a floor and the upper surface of the ceiling structure above.

1. ##### Ground Story


The [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meets the criteria of either of the Paragraph 1. (Continuous Ground Story (Typical) or Paragraph 2. (Ground Story Modules) below:

1. ###### Continuous Ground Story (Typical)


      1. A [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated for all portions of a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is the lowest [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) meeting the following standards:

         1. The [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be exposed a minimum of six feet above [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) along the full width of each frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

         2. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) structural floor shall be no more than six feet above [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for at least 75 percent of its applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.9.B. (Applicable Building Perimeter)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.9), measured cumulatively.

         3. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall comply with the [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.1.png.webp?itok=OCro2AGY)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.1.png?itok=_QsR9ZG_)
2. ###### Ground Story Modules


      [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s with very large [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and those developed on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s with significant topographic variation may be required to designate a higher or lower [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for different portions of the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Where the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) changes across the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall meet the following standards:

      1. A [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated for all portions of a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is the lowest [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) meeting the following standards:

         1. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall meet the following standards for a minimum depth of 15 feet measured perpendicular to the specified [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s:

            1. The [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be exposed a minimum of six feet above [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) along the full width of each frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2).

            2. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) finished floor shall be no more than six feet above [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for at least 75 percent of its applicable [building perimeter](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.9.B. (Applicable Building Perimeter)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.9), measured cumulatively.

            3. The [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall comply with the [ground story height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [ground floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) standards specified by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B).

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.3.png.webp?itok=PIB9Omxd)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.3.png?itok=3hRWHEc_)

               [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.5.png.webp?itok=56hofs4T)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.5.png?itok=E1MB2KwS)
         2. For portions of a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located 15 feet or greater from a frontage applicable [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 3A.2.2.B.3. (Frontage Applicable Facades)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3A.2.2), the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) having its structural floor surface nearest to the [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.7.png.webp?itok=MKVQNSM4)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.7.png?itok=p2rKlL90)

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.9.png.webp?itok=Avox9Tr2)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.9.png?itok=dHzOldFE)
2. ##### Ground Story Facade


The ground story facade is defined as the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for the full height of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

3. ##### Ground Floor


The ground floor is defined as the [finished floor elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

4. ##### Upper Story


The upper story is defined as any [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located above the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

5. ##### Upper Story Facade


The upper story facade is defined as the portions of the exterior building envelope at the perimeter of each [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for the full height of the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

6. ##### Attic


Attic is defined as the [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between the underside of the finished ceiling or exposed framing, whichever is lower, and the finished floor.

1. An [attic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes an [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) less than 50 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located on the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) immediately below is not considered a [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. An [attic](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes an [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) greater than or equal to 50 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located on the [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) immediately below is considered a [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and shall comply with all standards applicable to [upper story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [upper story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.
7. ##### Basement


Basement is defined as an [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located below the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

8. ##### Mezzanine


Mezzanine is defined as an intermediate level within a [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

1. A [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is not considered a [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) provided it meets the following standards:

      1. The [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not be greater than 1/3 of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the room or [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) space it is included within.

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.11.png.webp?itok=5Qg3mWvL)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.11.png?itok=LJ4SfWKW)

      2. The [perimeter plane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of the [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall consist of [non-solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), with the following exceptions:

         1. Those portions of the [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) perimeter that are formed by the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s enclosing the larger room or space the [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is included within;

         2. [Safety barrier](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that meet the standards outlined in [Sec. 14.2.4. (Enclosure)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.4).

            [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.13.png.webp?itok=quH2lQur)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.13.png?itok=KvPAwE3y)
      3. Regardless of [enclosure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) rules in Subparagraph b., above, within the [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), a maximum of 15 percent of the [mezzanine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.15.png.webp?itok=yeBSZn87)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.10.15.png?itok=_6g9ipM2)
2. A mezzanine that does not meet the standards in Paragraph 1., above, is considered an additional [story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.11. Lot

A lot is defined as one or more [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of land identified for the purpose of development and meeting the standards below:

1. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be composed of one or more contiguous [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

2. All [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s composing a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be owned by the same [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or entity.

3. For the purposes of [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11) all [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s composing a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be identified on a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder with a separate and distinct letter or number, or otherwise be on a recorded instrument that meet the requirement of the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

4. For the purpose of meeting standards associated with the applied [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) composed of multiple [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s grouped together as a single [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) through a [lot tie](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) affidavit filed and approved with the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be considered a single [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). When the involved [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s have different and conflicting applied [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, each individual [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) must meet the standards associated with the applied [zoning district](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) on each [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

5. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) required for [dedication of land](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (for example, proposed [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)), including [dedication of land](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) required by or included as part of the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) process, with the following exceptions:

1. As otherwise stated in [Sec. 10.1.8. (Lots Affected by Street Widening)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1.8).

2. In the case of new developments taking place on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with an existing, recorded dedication, or on [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s with old permits where the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) was never constructed, measurements of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be taken from the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that existed prior to the [dedication of land](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), provided that clearance is obtained from the Department of Public Works indicating that the improvements or street widening associated with the recorded dedication have not taken place. If the associated improvements or street widening have already been completed, measurements of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) do not include the portions of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) required for [dedication of land](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
6. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall include all portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) allocated to [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or utility [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

7. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or a [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) contiguously for a minimum of 12 feet.

8. [Access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be provided from the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) through:

1. An [access lane](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with a minimum width as specified in [Div. 4C.2. (Automobile Access)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2); or

2. A [pedestrian accessway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with a minimum width in accordance with [Div. 4C.1. (Pedestrian Access)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.1); or

3. A [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with a minimum width as determined by the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)

### Sec. 14.2.12. Lot Line Determination

1. ##### General


1. Each [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have one of the following designations as determined by the definitions in this Section (Lot Line Determination), and each [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not have more than one of the following designations:

      1. [Primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

      2. [Side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

      3. [Special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

      4. [Rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

      5. [Side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); or

      6. [Alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
          [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.12.1.png.webp?itok=vkqoO2gV)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.12.1.png?itok=KpAPh1ZM)
2. In addition to these required designations, [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s may also be included into one of the following [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) categories:

      1. [Frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

      2. [Street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); and

      3. [Common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
3. For [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s with curved or irregular lines which makes the dividing point between two types of [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designations unclear, see [Sec. 14.2.14.B. (Lot Line Determination for Curved Corner Lot Lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14).
2. ##### Lot Line Categories


1. ###### Frontage Lot Line


      A frontage lot line is any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that triggers [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) requirements. Frontage lot lines include all [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

2. ###### Street Lot Line


      A street lot line is any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s a street [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Street lot lines include all [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, and [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

3. ###### Common Lot Line


      A common lot line is any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shared by multiple [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s. Common lot lines include all [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and may include [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s in [Dual Frontage Districts (Div. 3B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.8).
3. ##### Lot Line Designations


1. ###### Primary Street Lot Line


      A primary street lot line is a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that has been designated as a primary street lot line by following the criteria and standards listed below.

      1. Each [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have at least one [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). However, if all [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are mapped as [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, then no [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is required.

      2. When there is only one [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), it shall be designated as the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), unless it is mapped as a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      3. When there is more than one [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be determined according to Subparagraph d. (Special Scenario Lots Abutting More Than One Street) and Subparagraph e. (Other Lots Abutting More Than One Street) below, except that:

         1. Any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that has been mapped as a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be considered a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         2. If all [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be determined pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) using the established orientation of the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) criteria pursuant to Subparagraph f. (Relief) below.

         3. When the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) crosses the boundary of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), its [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be determined pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) using the established orientation of the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) criteria pursuant to Subparagraph f. (Relief) below.
      4. ###### Special Scenario Lots Abutting More Than One Street


         In the following special scenarios, there may be more than one [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#):

         1. Any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a street that is mapped as a primary street pursuant to [Sec. 1.5.3. (Primary Street Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.3), shall always be designated a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), even if this results in more than one [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

         2. On a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with an applied [Commercial-Mixed Use District (Div. 5B.5.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B.5), any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) an [avenue](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [boulevard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), even if this results in more than one [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) per [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
      5. ###### Other Lots Abutting More Than One Street


         For [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) multiple streets where none of the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are designated as a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) per the provisions in Subparagraph d. (Special Scenario Lots Abutting More Than One Street) above, the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is designated using the following criteria, listed in order of priority:

         1. The shortest [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a street, with the exception of:

            1. [Through lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, in which case the longest [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a street shall be the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

            2. [Lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s under 20 feet, in which case the next shortest [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

            3. [Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of 30,000 square feet or greater, for which the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be determined using the subsequent criteria in this Subparagraph e. (Other Lots Abutting More Than One Street);
         2. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the street or streets with the highest [street designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

         3. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the longest face of the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) which the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) touches;

         4. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) parallel to an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) within the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

         5. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a street that faces a [publicly accessible](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) open space;

         6. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the street that the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) takes its address from, as confirmed by the Bureau of Engineering;
      6. ###### Relief


         Rather than designating a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to Subparagraph a. (Primary Street Lot Line) through Subparagraph e. (Other Lots Abutting More Than One Street) above, the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be determined pursuant to [Sec. 13B.3.1. (Administrative Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.3.1) using the established orientation of the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) criteria below:

         1. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the street the majority of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s along the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) accommodate [pedestrian access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from;

         2. The [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation of the majority of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s along the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), either existing or approved;

         3. The [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the street the majority of [wall sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on the [block](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) are oriented toward.
2. ###### Side Street Lot Line


      A side street lot line is a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) separating a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from a side street [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Any [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) not determined to be a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is considered a side street lot line.

3. ###### Special Lot Line


      A special lot line is any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) mapped as a special lot line on the Special Lot Line map, pursuant to [Sec. 1.5.8. (Special Lot Line Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.8) and designated within an applied [Form District (Part 2B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2B) or [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) that specifies standards for a special lot line.

      1. [Special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are intended to identify [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that face, [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or otherwise interact with active spaces such as pedestrian paths, open spaces, equine trails, or active pedestrian [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

      2. Regardless of whether a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) qualifies as any other [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.12.C. (Lot Line Designations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12), all [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that are mapped as a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated as a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
4. ###### Rear Lot Line


      A rear lot line is a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that does not [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and is opposite and most distant from a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and meets the following criteria:

      1. A [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have no more than one [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designated as a [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. In the case of a [through lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may have no [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      3. Where no [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is clearly opposite to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), such as triangular [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [gore-shaped lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is determined based on an imaginary line 10 feet wide, parallel to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that intersects two [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s at its endpoints.

      4. Where the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is not straight, the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be the opposite and most distant [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that is parallel to an imaginary line connecting the end points of the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      5. Where there are multiple [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) having the highest portion of its length serving as the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s is the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
5. ###### Side Lot Line


      A side lot line is any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) not determined to be a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

6. ###### Alley Lot Line


      An alley lot line is any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Even when a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) qualifies as a [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall be designated an alley lot line, except when the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) qualifies as a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.13. Opacity (%)

Opacity is defined as the degree to which an object or material is impervious to rays of light or obstructs visibility.

1. ##### Measurement


1. [Opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is measured as a percentage, calculated by dividing the solid portion of the object area by the total area of the object.

2. The total area of the object is measured as the smallest convex polygon containing all elements of the object or assembly.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.13.1.png.webp?itok=ru9TB-NG)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.13.1.png?itok=FUFd01cN)
2. ##### Standards


1. ###### Equivalent Transparency


      Where an assembly includes materials or objects that are solid but transparent (including glass), the transparent portion of the [solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be weighted by multiplying it by the [visual light transmittance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the material specified by the manufacturer.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.13.3.png.webp?itok=hdYg5_4d)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.13.3.png?itok=SgIh1fiK)

2. ###### Visual Obstructions


      Any permanent [visual obstruction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s within a distance of five feet of the subject object, measured horizontal and perpendicular to the object area, renders otherwise [non-solid area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s solid for the purpose of measuring [opacity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

### Sec. 14.2.14. Irregular Lot lines

1. ##### Parallel or Perpendicular to Irregular Lot Line


Where a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is curved, standards measured parallel or perpendicular to that [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) assume the angle of the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to be the same as an imaginary straight line connecting the endpoints of the curved [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) segment.

[![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.1.png.webp?itok=Gu-TmK4A)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.1.png?itok=M_bPSMPT)

2. ##### Lot Line Determination For Curved Lot Lines


1. ###### Street Lot Lines


      Where a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) has a curved [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to which it makes the dividing point between two types of [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s unclear for the purposes of [Sec. 14.2.12. (Lot Line Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12), that dividing point shall be identified as the nearest point on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) perimeter to the intersection of the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [street centerline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.3.png.webp?itok=JWWRpVvf)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.3.png?itok=D5gg774j)

2. ###### Common Lot Lines


      Where a [common lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is curved to which it makes the dividing point between two types of [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s unclear for the purposes of [Sec. 14.2.12. (Lot Line Determination)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12), the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation from the [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall be utilized to assign a designation for the length of the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) segment in question.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.5.png.webp?itok=AiEHmGPH)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.5.png?itok=Ee_JJBTi)
3. ##### Building Setback Determination For Curved Lot Lines


Where a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) has a curved [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) which makes the dividing line between two types of [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s unclear for the purposes of [Sec. 2C.2.2. (Building Setbacks)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2), that dividing line shall be identified by the following:

1. Taking the dividing point established in [Sec. 14.2.14.B.1. (Street Lot Lines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.14), above, and drawing a line into the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) perpendicular to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) at the dividing point for the depth of the [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. The setbacks shall connect along the dividing line for the depth of the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.7.png.webp?itok=C0qOJHnx)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.7.png?itok=zlzVQI-d)

3. Where the depth of a [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and side street [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) differ at the dividing line established in Paragraph 1., above, the side street [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be increased linearly for 25 percent of the [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) until it meets the [primary street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.9.png.webp?itok=FdR0OOHm)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.14.9.png?itok=IlUIE4RF)
4. ##### Parking Setback Determination For Curved Lot Lines


Where a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) has a curved [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) which makes the dividing line between two types of [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designations unclear for the purposes of [Sec. 3C.2.1. (Parking Setback)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.2.1), that dividing line shall be the same as established in Subsection C. (Building Setback Determination For Curved Lot Lines) above.

5. ##### Yard Determination For Curved Lot Lines


Where a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) has a curved [street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) which makes the dividing line between two types of [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designations unclear for the purposes of [Sec. 14.2.6. (Yards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.6), that dividing line shall be the same as established in Subsection C. (Building Setback Determination For Curved Lot Lines) above.


### Sec. 14.2.15. Project Activities

1. ##### Project


A project is defined as work involving any of the [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) listed in Subsection B. (Project Activities) below. A project may or may not require a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and may or may not be one [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in a series of [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s (such as [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) followed by [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)). A Community Plan Implementation Overlay or [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may have its own definition for a project. Typically, more than one [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) will apply to a proposed project (for example, a street-facing [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) concealing a portion of an existing [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes both [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)).

2. ##### Project Activities


A project activity describes the type of work composing a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may be composed of one or more project activity. The following are types of project activities for the purposes of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A):

01. ###### New Construction


       New construction is defined as work that includes the construction of a new [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), whether structurally detached or attached from other existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). New construction includes an [addition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to or relocation of an existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or the relocation of existing [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), to another location on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or to any other [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Relocation of existing [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s includes any activity that lifts any portion of the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) off of its foundation. New construction does not include ground mounted [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) mounted [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

       1. For ground mounted [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, see Paragraph 4. (Site Modification) below.

       2. For [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) mounted [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, see Paragraph 5. (Exterior Modification) below.
02. ###### Major Remodel


       Major remodel is defined as work that includes significant removal, disassembly, or replacement of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or portions of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that does not add to or change the [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and meets the standards below:

       1. [Major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes the removal or replacement of any of the following:

          1. More than 50 percent of the perimeter [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) framing; or

          2. More than 50 percent of the roof framing; or

          3. More than 50 percent of the structural members.
       2. [Major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may affect the exterior of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), in which case it would also be considered an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

       3. Remodeling that does not meet the thresholds within this Paragraph (Major Remodel) or another [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) would be considered maintenance & repair.
03. ###### Lot Modification


       Lot modification is defined as the modification of the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of any existing [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) through the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [Article 11. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11), including the division of land as defined in [California Government Code, Title 7. (Planning and Land Use), Sec. 66424.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&sectionNum=66424.#:~:text=%E2%80%9CSubdivision%E2%80%9D%20means%20the%20division%2C,financing%2C%20whether%20immediate%20or%20future.)

04. ###### Site Modification


       Site modification is defined as work including modifications to existing, or the addition of, new horizontal [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) improvements and landscaping, including trees, [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, street furniture, lighting fixtures, [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [flatwork](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), ground mounted [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, and [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) resurfacing or the reconfiguration of existing [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

       1. [Site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, such as [grading](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), that expose additional [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are considered to be both a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

       2. Any work whose principal aim is the provision of handicap accessibility for compliance with the [Americans with Disabilities Act](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/ada/) is not considered a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
05. ###### Exterior Modification


       Exterior modification is defined as work to the exterior of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

       1. ###### Facade Modification


          Facade modification is an [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes a change to a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) involving a modification of its existing design or outward appearance.

          [Facade modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s include changes to any of the following:

          1. The [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

          2. [Wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) mounted [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s beyond the maintenance & repair required pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.1.C.4. (Maintenance)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.1);

          3. The amount of exterior [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that is exposed above [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

          4. An [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [architectural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) attached to the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#);

          5. [Exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) finish materials on an applicable [facade area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in a [Character Frontage District (Div. 3B.9.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B.9); or

          6. In an [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [facade modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes change of the exterior paint color.
       2. ###### General


          Any [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) work that does not meet the definition and standards of [facade modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
06. ###### Use Modification


       Use modification is a [change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or an [intensification of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

       1. ###### Change of Use


          Change of use is defined as work that includes a change or expansion in the permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of any portion of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from one [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) defined in [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D) to any other [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) defined in [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D). Change of use does not include any [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s. For [temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, see Paragraph 7. (Temporary Use) below.

       2. ###### Intensification of Use


          Intensification of use is defined as work that increases the intensity of a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), such as an increase in [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, seating capacity, or the number of people in care.
07. ###### Temporary Use


       Temporary use is defined as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) defined in [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D) that does not exceed 180 days and meets the requirements of [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.106.1.3. (Temporary Permits)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code.

08. ###### Demolition


       Demolition is defined as the removal of an entire [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

       1. Proposed [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that results in a reduction of compliance of other [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with the requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) is required to be accompanied by [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or another [project activity](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that maintains the level of compliance with the requirements of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) in place prior to the issuance of the [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) permit, except as described in Subparagraph b. below.

       2. Regardless of the general rule in Subparagraph a. above, [demolition](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) permits may be issued for [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s without accompanying [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or other [project activities](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) when said [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) has been determined by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to be a present, imminent, extreme and immediate hazard or danger to life or limb, health or safety pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.8905. (Special Provisions for Vacating, Barricading, Removing or Demolishing Buildings or Structures Without Notice)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-181297).
09. ###### Renovation


       Renovation is defined as a modification to the interior of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), including the [basement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), that does not expand the [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Renovation includes interior remodels or tenant improvements.

10. ###### Maintenance & Repair


       Maintenance & repair is defined as work that does not qualify as a [site modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [major remodel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [exterior modification](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [new construction](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and does not impact the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)'s ability to meet any applicable zoning requirements. Replacement of deteriorated or damaged parts of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is considered maintenance & repair; however, in a Character Frontage District, [CPIO](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), Conservation District, or [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), direct replacement may have additional requirements and processes. Maintenance & repair includes repair of [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) components such as restriping existing parking stripes, resealing [parking lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, pothole repair, or replanting plants.
