### Sec. 14.2.16. Yards

1. ##### General


1. All portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a property line shall be designated as one of the following [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designations, and no portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall have more than one of the following designations, as established in Subsection B. (Yard Designations) below:

      1. [Front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)

      2. [Special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)

      3. [Side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)

      4. [Side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)

      5. [Rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)
2. Individual [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designations may fall into one or more [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) categories as provided in Subsection C. (Yard Categories) below.
2. ##### Yard Designations


1. ###### Front Yard


      A front yard is the area between a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and an imaginary line running parallel to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). The imaginary line shall be drawn 15 feet back from the portion of the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) nearest to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured perpendicularly to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.1.png.webp?itok=LAhJ63cb)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.1.png?itok=bI8WEbTf)

      1. Only [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated as [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

      2. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall not be designated as any other [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), including portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for any other [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation.
2. ###### Special Yard


      A special yard is the area between a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and an imaginary line running parallel to the [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). The imaginary line shall be drawn 15 feet back from the portion of the [special lot line-facing facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) nearest to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured perpendicularly to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.3.png.webp?itok=FSBc_Frc)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.3.png?itok=7eu_aDKt)

      1. [Special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s include [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) including but not limited to special river and special alley lot lines.

      2. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall not be designated as a [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), including portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      3. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall be designated as [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
3. ###### Side Street Yard


      A side street yard is the area between a [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and an imaginary line running parallel to the [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). The imaginary line shall be drawn 15 feet back from the portion of the [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)- [facing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) nearest to the [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured perpendicularly to the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.5.png.webp?itok=0ae3Z42_)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.5.png?itok=11GbGHh_)

      1. Only [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a [side street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated as [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

      2. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall not be designated as a [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), including portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      3. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall be designated as [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      4. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated as [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      5. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meets all three criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation, [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation, and [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall be designated as a [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
4. ###### Rear Yard


      A rear yard is the portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between a [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a [principal structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). When there is more than one [principal structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), rear yard includes the portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between the [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and the [principal structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that is located closest to the [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      1. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall not be designated as a [side yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      2. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meet the criteria for [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation but also meet the criteria for [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated as [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

      3. Portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meets all three criteria for [rear yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation, [side street yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation, and [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation shall be designated as a [special yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.8.png.webp?itok=FV3BJqW1)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.8.png?itok=Y3MoTb8B)
5. ###### Side Yard


      A side yard is the portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between a [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a [principal structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). All portions of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that do not meet the [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designation criteria for any other [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be designated as a side yard.

      [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.9.png.webp?itok=RYO_29oO)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.16.9.png?itok=eiRGNImA)

3. ##### Yard Categories

      Frontage yard is a category of [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s referring to all [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) a [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) including:

### Sec. 14.2.17. Public Access Easements

A public access easement is an [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), established between a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) owner or owners and the City of Los Angeles, as found on the [Public Access Easement Map (Sec. 1.5.11.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.11), affecting a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s for the purpose of ensuring public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the portions of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) covered by the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

1. ##### Standards


1. [Public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s affecting a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be considered a part of the whole [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for the purposes of any standard or calculation which pertains to [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) dimensions, unless stated otherwise as a condition of the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. No [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s may be constructed within a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

3. When determining [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area, the [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area shall be measured from the interior edge of the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) rather than [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).
2. ##### Measurements


1. ###### Building Setback


      [Building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s to be constructed on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) affected by a mapped [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall measure the nearest required [yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback from the interior edge of the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. ###### Lot Amenity Space


      All portions of the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s may be calculated as part of the [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). When the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is counted as [lot amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), an accessway from the development on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) must be ensured to the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area. The required accessway must meet the minimum standards as established in [Sec. 4C.1.1.C.2.A.i. (Linked)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.1.1).

3. ###### Build-to depth


      Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be measured to the [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback. The [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback is measured from the interior edge of the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as established in Paragraph 1. (Building Setback) above.

4. ###### Pedestrian Amenity Allowance


      Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the pedestrian amenity shall be measured to the [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback. The [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback is measured from the interior edge of the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as established in Paragraph 1. (Building Setback) above.

5. ###### Parking Setback


      Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [parking setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be measured to the [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback. The [front yard](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) setback is measured from the interior edge of the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as established in Subsection A. (Standards) above.

6. ###### Frontage Planting Area


      Area within the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not be used to meet [planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) required by a [frontage planting area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

7. ###### Frontage Yard Fence & Wall


      Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s allowed by the applied [Frontage District (Part 3B.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3B) may be constructed and maintained on the interior edge of the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), but shall not be constructed within the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area nor on any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or portion of a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) affected by the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) unless provided in the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). A [fence](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not be constructed in a manner which obstructs public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area.

8. ###### Frontage Screens and Transition Screens


      Where a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes a [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), any required [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s may be constructed and maintained on the interior edge of the [public access easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), but shall not be constructed within the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area nor on any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or portion of a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) affected by the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) unless provided in the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). A [frontage screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [transition screen](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall not be constructed in a manner which obstructs public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area.

### Sec. 14.2.18. Slope

1. ##### Average Natural Slope


Average natural slope is defined as the average of the ungraded slopes at selected contours within a given [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of land divided by its area as computed from either the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)’s topographic maps or a topographic map prepared by a [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or land [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and meets all the following standards:

1. Regardless of which map is used, calculations cannot be derived or interpolated from a map that originally had contour intervals of greater than 25 feet for subdivisions or greater than five feet for [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

2. [Average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be computed by the following formula:
       [![](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/large/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.18.1.png.webp?itok=bYEZtDq_)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/sites/default/files/styles/larger/public/zcode_images/2025.4.0/14.2.18.1.png?itok=F-RCT1QP)
      Where:

      S = [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in percent.

      C = contour interval in feet, at no greater than 25-foot intervals for subdivisions or five-foot intervals for [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, resulting in at least five contour lines.

      L = total accumulated length of all contours of interval “C” in feet.

      A = the area being considered in square feet.

3. [Average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s may be computed only by the entire [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) area. The calculation “L” (contour lengths) and “A” (area in square feet) can be computed by 500-foot grid increments, as shown on the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)’s topographic maps. The “L” for each grid increment shall be added to the “L” for every other grid increment and the “A” for each grid increment shall be added to the “A” for every other grid increment to determine the “L” and the “A” for the entire [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), prior to calculating the [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for that [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

4. In any matter where the [average natural slope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is used to calculate density pursuant to [Sec. 11.1.3. (Subdivision Design Standards)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.3) or [Sec. 11.4.1.D. (Slope Density)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.4.1), the [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) file shall contain copies of all maps and all calculations so that the figures can be verified. All maps and all calculations are required to be submitted at the time of the filing of a [subdivision](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is deemed incomplete.

### Sec. 14.2.19. Maximum Allowable Residential Density

Maximum allowable residential density is defined as the greatest number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s allowed on a [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as defined in California Government Code Sec. 65915(o)(6).

1. ##### Measurement


1. Pursuant to Government Code Sec. 65915(o)(6), a [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall calculate its [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), before the application of a density bonus granted through participation in an incentive program, using the maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s allowed under a [project site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)’s applied [Zoning District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [General Plan land use designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

2. If a range is permitted, the maximum number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s allowed by the specific zoning range, [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [General Plan Land Use designation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be applicable when determining a [site](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)’s density prior to the application of a density bonus granted through participation in an incentive program. [Dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s added using an incentive program contained in a [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [Zoning District](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [Special Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or other [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) program granting development bonuses, shall not count toward the calculation of [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

3. When calculating a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)’s [maximum allowable residential density](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), any number resulting in a fraction shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

### A

Abandoned Shopping Cart: Abandoned shopping cart is defined as a shopping cart located outside of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) where the establishment that furnishes shopping carts for use by its patrons is located.

Abatement Radius: Abatement radius is defined as the area around a permitted [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designated by the Office of Community Beautification for the removal of graffiti, posters/handbills and any other illegal postings, as well as trash, debris, rubbish, and weeds from public property and [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Above-Grade: Above-grade is defined as located higher in elevation than the surrounding finished grade.

Abut: See [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Abutting: Abutting is defined as to touch or have a common boundary with.

Access: Access is defined as a means of approaching or entering a place.

Access Lane: Access lane is defined as the lane accommodating automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) onto a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in accordance with [Div. 4C.2. (Automobile Access)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2).

Accessory Building: Accessory building is defined as a detached, subordinate [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and scale of which is supplementary to other [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Accessory Dwelling Unit: See [Chapter I. (General Provisions and Zoning), Sec. 12.03. (Definitions)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lapz/0-0-0-886) of this Code.

Accessory Material Coverage: Pursuant to [Sec. 3D.10.2. (Accessory Material Coverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.10.2), accessory material coverage is defined as the building products used as an [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) finish material to accent or support the principal material.

Accessory Roof Form: Accessory roof form is defined as a portion of a [roof structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that deviates from the principal roof form in either shape, color, or shape and color.

Accessory Structure: Accessory structure is defined as a detached, subordinate [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and scale of which is supplementary to other [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Accessory Use: Pursuant to [Sec. 5C.1.1. (Accessory To)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.1), accessory use is defined as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that meets all standards in [Sec. 5C.1.1 (Accessory To)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.1.1).

Active Space: Active space is defined as indoor [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s designed and intended for [general commercial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, public & institutional uses, or [common indoor amenity space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Active Wall Spacing: Pursuant to [Sec. 3C.4.2. (Active Wall Spacing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.4.2), active wall spacing is defined as the horizontal [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between widths of [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [foundation wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or door openings.

Acts: Pursuant to [Sec. 13B.5.5. (Reasonable Accommodation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.5.5), acts is defined as the [Federal Fair Housing Amendments Act of 1988](https://www.congress.gov/bill/100th-congress/house-bill/1158) and [California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?lawCode=GOV&division=3.&title=2.&part=2.8.&chapter=1.&article).

Acutely Low Income Household: An acutely low income household is a [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) whose annual income, adjusted for family size, does not exceed 15 percent of the area median income as designated for this category in [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 50063.5](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=50063.5.#:~:text=%E2%80%9CAcutely%20low%20income%20households%E2%80%9D%20means,family%20size%20and%20revised%20annually.).

Adaptive Reuse Project: Adaptive reuse project is defined as any [change of use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to [dwelling](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or household business: joint living & work quarters, or any change in commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to another commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), in all or any portion of any eligible [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) according to [Sec. 9.4.5. (Downtown Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.5) or [Sec. 9.4.6. (Citywide Adaptive Reuse Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.6), as long as the commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) is allowed in the zone.

Addition: Addition is defined as any work that increases the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or the volume of [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) space of an [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and is structurally attached to the [existing building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). The definition of addition is modified for the purposes of [Historic Preservation (Div. 13B.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8), for which addition is defined as an extension or increase in [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or height of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Additional Housing Units: Pursuant to [15.4.3.A. (Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), a net increase in the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or guest rooms to be added on a [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of land by issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), after subtracting the number of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or guest rooms legally removed from the same [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of real property during the year preceding the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Additional Non-Residential Floor Area: For the purposes of [Sec. 15.4.3.A. (Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), additional non-residential floor area is defined as the net increase in the amount of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to be added on a [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of land by issuance of a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), less the amount of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) legally removed from the same [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of real property during the year preceding the issuance of the [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Adjacent: See [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Adjoining: See [adjoining Lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Adjoining Lot: Adjoining lot is defined as [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s separated from the subject [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by a street or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s having a common corner with the subject property.

Administrative Guidelines: For the purposes of [5C.3.2.B.1. (Administrative Guidelines)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2), the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or Office of Finance may promulgate regulations, which may include, but are not limited to, [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) requirements, interpretations, conditions, reporting requirements, enforcement procedures, and disclosure requirements, to implement the provisions, and consistent with the intent, of [Sec. 5C.3.2. (Home-Sharing Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2).

Advisory Agency: Advisory Agency is defined as the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of Planning, who acts in the capacity of the Advisory Agency for the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to the [Subdivision Map Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) established in accordance with [Sec. 13B.7.1.C. (Advisory Agency)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.1). The Advisory Agency is granted additional authority pursuant to [Sec. 11.1.2. (Division of Land)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/11#11.1.2).

Affordable Housing Incentive Program: Affordable housing incentive program is defined as an incentive program established in [Div. 9.2. (Affordable Housing Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2) to increase the production of affordable housing, consistent with [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) policies.

Affordable Housing Incentives Guidelines: Affordable housing incentives guidelines is defined as the guidelines approved by the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.1.5. (Guidelines or Standards Adoption/Amendment)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.1.5), under which [housing development project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s for which a density bonus above 35 percent has been requested are evaluated for compliance with [Div. 9.2. (Affordable Housing Incentive Programs)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.2).

Aggrieved Person: Aggrieved person is defined as any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or entity with standing to appeal an action on an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) filed under this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) under California law, or as provided in the provisions of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) relating to a particular appeal.

For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.9.1. (Coastal Development Permit (Pre-Certification))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.9.1), aggrieved person is defined as any [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) who, in person or through a representative, appeared at a hearing on the [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for a Coastal Development Permit, or appeal hearing in connection with the decision or action appealed, or who, by other appropriate means prior to a hearing, informed the permit issuing authority, or appeal body of the nature of his or her concerns or who for good cause was unable to do either. "Aggrieved person" includes the [applicant](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for a Coastal Development Permit.

Agricultural Use: Pursuant to [Div. 5D.10. (Agricultural Uses)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10), agricultural uses are defined as [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s dedicated to the cultivation of plants or the keeping of animals.

Air Space Lot: Air space lot is defined as a division of the space above or below a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with a finite width, length, and upper and lower [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) occupied or to be occupied by a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [accessory use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or unit group of [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, or portion of a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). An air space lot shall be identified on a [final map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) recorded with the Los Angeles County Recorder with a separate and distinct number or letter. An air space lot shall have such [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to a street or [private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by means of one or more [easement](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or other entitlements to use in a form satisfactory to the [Advisory Agency](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Airport: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.5.1. (Airport)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.5.1), an airport is defined as a runway landing area or other facility used for the landing and taking off of aircraft including all the necessary taxiways, aircraft storage and tie-down areas, hangars, passenger terminals, and warehousing facilities.

Alley: Alley is defined as a [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designated as an alley by the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and displayed on [Zoning Information and Map Access System (ZIMAS)](https://zimas.lacity.org/) or [NavigateLA](https://navigatela.lacity.org/navigatela/).

Alley Lot Line: Pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.12.C.6. (Alley Lot Line)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.12), alley lot line is defined as any [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [abut](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s an [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Even when a [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) qualifies as a [rear lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or [side lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s shall be designated an alley lot line, except when the [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) qualifies as a [special lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Alley Lot Line-Facing Facade: Alley lot line-facing facade is defined as all portions of a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that are parallel to an [alley lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and meet the criteria outlined in [Sec. 14.2.6.B. (Lot Line-Facing Facade)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.6).

Alteration: For the purposes of [Div. 13B.8. (Historic Preservation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.8), alteration is defined as any exterior change or modification of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), landscaping, [natural feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) within a [Historic Preservation Overlay Zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) including but not limited to changing exterior paint color, removal of [significant tree](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or landscaping, installation or removal of fencing, and similar projects, and including street features, furniture or fixtures.

Alternative Parking Strategy: Alternative parking strategy is defined as an alternative method of meeting parking requirements that meet the standards outlined in [Sec. 4C.4.2. (Alternative Parking Strategies)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.2).

American Standard for Nursery Stock: American standard for nursery stock is defined as a publication by the American Horticulture Industry Association intended to provide buyers and sellers of nursery stock with a common terminology in order to facilitate commercial transactions involving nursery stock.

Amphitheater or Stadium: Amphitheater or stadium is defined as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) meeting the definition of either [amphitheater or stadium: local](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [amphitheater or stadium: regional](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Amphitheater or Stadium: Local: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.4.1. (Amphitheater or Stadium: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1), amphitheater or stadium: local is defined as any outdoor or semi-outdoor assembly facility intended to accommodate a large number of spectators for performances or sporting events and having an associated seating capacity of less than 3,000 seats. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include facilities with seating capacity of 3,000 seats or more, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D.4.1.B. (Amphitheater or Stadium: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1).

Amphitheater or Stadium: Regional: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.4.1. (Amphitheater or Stadium: Regional)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1), amphitheater or stadium: regional is defined as any outdoor or semi-outdoor assembly facility intended to accommodate a large number of spectators for performances or sporting events and having an associated seating capacity of 3,000 seats or more. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes an amphitheater or stadium associated with a [school](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include facilities with seating capacity of less than 3,000 seats, for such uses see [Sec. 5D.4.1.A. (Amphitheater or Stadium: Local)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.4.1).

Angle of Elevation: Angle of elevation is defined as the angle of an elevation view, zero degrees (horizontal) being the angle of an [elevation projection](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and 90 degrees being vertical.

Animal Keeping: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1. (Animal Keeping)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping is defined as any [agricultural use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes the breeding, boarding, training, or raising of animals.

Animal Keeping: Bees: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1. (Animal Keeping: Bees)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: bees is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes the keeping of [bee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Animal Keeping: Dairy: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1. (Animal Keeping: Dairy)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: dairy is defined as an [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes the storage, processing, or distribution of milk or milk products.

Animal Keeping: Equine, Commercial: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1C. (Animal Keeping: Equine, Commercial)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: equine, commercial is defined as the keeping, breeding, raising, training, or boarding of more than two [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s not owned by and registered to residents on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as the [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). [Equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes mules and donkeys.

Animal Keeping: Equine, Non-commercial: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1.D. (Animal Keeping: Equine, Non-Commercial)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: equine, non-commercial is defined as the keeping, breeding, raising, training, or boarding of [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s owned by and registered to residents on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as the [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). No more than two [equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s owned by or registered to [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s not residing on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) shall be allowed. [Equine](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) includes mules and donkeys.

Animal Keeping: Livestock: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1.E. (Animal Keeping: Livestock)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: livestock is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes the breeding, raising, training, boarding, or keeping of animals such as alpacas, cattle, donkeys, goats, mules, sheep, swine, or similar livestock, typically for fiber, meat, milk, or other products. This use includes day-to-day care, selective breeding, raising, and selling of livestock.

Animal Keeping: Pets: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1.F. (Animal Keeping: Pets)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: pets is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that includes the keeping of domestic pets that are readily classifiable as being incidental to another [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) such as dogs, cats, rabbits, rodents, birds, poultry, fish, amphibians, and small reptiles. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Small Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include those [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.6.1.B. (Animal Services: Kennel)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1).

Animal Keeping: Small Animals: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Small Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: small animals is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) licensed by the Department of Animal Services for the breeding, raising, training, or boarding of small domestic animals such as dogs, cats, rabbits, rodents, birds, poultry fish, amphibians, and reptiles. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include the [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s defined in [Sec. 5D.10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Wild Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1).

Animal Keeping: Wild Animals: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.10.1.H. (Animal Keeping: Wild Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.10.1), animal keeping: wild animals is defined as any [animal keeping](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) licensed by the Department of Animal Services pursuant to [Chapter V. (Public Safety and Protection), Sec. 53.38. (Wild Animals - Keeping - Permit)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-137173) for the keeping of wild, exotic, dangerous, or non-domestic animals.

Animal Products Processing: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.9.1. (Animal Products Processing)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.9.1), animal products processing is defined as a [heavy industrial use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) involving one or more of the following: dressing or dyeing furs; preparing processed meat and meat byproducts; preparing, tanning, and finishing hides and skins; refining or rendering animal fat, bones, and meat scraps; and slaughtering animals.

Animal Services: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.6.1. (Animal Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1), animal services is defined as a [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) involving the provision of services related primarily to domestic animal care and keeping.

Animal Services: General: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.6.1.A. (Animal Services: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1), animal services: general is defined as animal services in which domestic dogs or cats are provided non-medical care, such as, grooming, training, supervision, or boarding. This does not include [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s where the overnight boarding of dogs or cats exceeds 30 percent of the [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a facility, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.1.B. (Animal Services: Kennel)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include medical care of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.1.C. (Animal Services: Veterinary Care)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1).

Animal Services: Kennel: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.6.1.B. (Animal Services: Kennel)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1), animal services: kennel is defined as [animal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in which four or more dogs or cats, at least four months of age, are sheltered for periods beyond 24 hours per day. This definition does not include retail establishments dedicated to the commercial sale of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.12.H. (Retail: Pet Shop)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.12). This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include the breeding and raising of animals, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D. 10.1.G. (Animal Keeping: Small Animals)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D).

Animal Services: Veterinary Care: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.6.1.C. (Animal Services: Veterinary Care)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1), animal services: veterinary care is defined as [animal services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in which animals or pets are given medical or surgical treatment and care. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include the non-medical treatment and care of dogs and cats, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.1.A. (Animal Services: General)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.1).

Apartment: Apartment is defined as a type of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Appeal Board: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.7.8. (Subdivision Appeal)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8), the Appeal Board is the [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) where the map is located for any [parcel map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or [tentative tract map](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that: (a) creates or results in less than 50,000 gross square feet of non-residential [floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); or (b) creates or results in fewer than 50 [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, guest rooms, or combination of [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s and guest rooms; or (c) involves a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with fewer than 65,000 square feet of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#); or (d) where specifically provided by this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A). In all other cases, the Appeal Board for [Subdivision Appeals (Sec. 13B.7.8.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.7.8) is the [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Appealable Area: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.9.2. (Coastal Development Permit (Post-Certification))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.9.2), appealable area is defined as the area identified in [Sec. 30603 of the Public Resources Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=30603.#:~:text=(1)%20Developments%20approved%20by%20the,whichever%20is%20the%20greater%20distance.). the area that meets this criteria includes, but is not limited to, the area shown on the “Post-LCP certification Permit and Appeals Jurisdiction Map” certified by the Coastal Commission in accordance with the provisions of [Sec. 13576 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Document/I840BD4A55B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3?viewType=FullText&listSource=Search&originationContext=Search+Result&transitionType=SearchItem&contextData=(sc.Search)&navigationPath=Search%2fv1%2fresults%2fnavigation%2fi0a89c5da00000193f9896d69e12f2cc3%3fppcid%3dbc1b2dd9311343a996f9f0fff4b61414%26Nav%3dREGULATION_PUBLICVIEW%26fragmentIdentifier%3dI840BD4A55B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3%26startIndex%3d1%26transitionType%3dSearchItem%26contextData%3d%2528sc.Default%2529%26originationContext%3dSearch%2520Result&list=REGULATION_PUBLICVIEW&rank=1&t_T2=13576&t_S1=CA+ADC+s) and attached as an exhibit in each certified coastal specific plan.

Appealable Development: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.9.2. (Coastal Development Permit (Post-Certification))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.9.2), appealable development is defined in accordance with [Sec. 30603(a) of the Public Resources Code](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=PRC&sectionNum=30603.#:~:text=(1)%20Developments%20approved%20by%20the,whichever%20is%20the%20greater%20distance.), as any development that constitutes a major public works project or a major energy facility, or any development located in the Appealable Area.

Applicable Stories: Pursuant to [Sec. 3C1.1. (Applicable Stories)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C1.1), applicable stories is defined as the number of [stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that are required to meet build-to standards.

Applicable Story: See [applicable stories](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Applicant: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.9.2. (Coastal Development Permit (Post-Certification))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.9.2), applicant is defined as the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), partnership, corporation, or other entity or state or local government agency applying for the Coastal Development Permit.

For the purposes of [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), applicant is defined as any individual, [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), firm, partnership, association, joint venture, corporation, limited liability company, entity, combination of entities or authorized representative thereof, who undertakes, proposes or applies to the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for a planning or zoning entitlement approval or [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) related to a development [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Application: Application is defined as an application filed pursuant to [Sec. 13A.2.3. (Applications)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13A.2.3) of this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).

Approving Authority: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.9.2. (Coastal Development Permit (Post-Certification))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.9.2), approving authority is defined as the initial decision maker and appeal body, including the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [Zoning Administrator](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [City Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), [Area Planning Commission](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), Board of Public Works, [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or other applicable decision-making person or body within the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), which has the authority to approve a Coastal Development Permit pursuant to this Section or by reason of jurisdiction over other permits and approvals sought in conjunction with an [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) for a Coastal Development Permit.

Architectural Detail: Pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.5.A.1.a. (Architectural Details)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.5), architectural detail is defined as building elements attached to or integrated into the [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), not intended for human occupation. Types of architectural details include, but are not limited to: cornices, [belt course](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, sills, lintels, pilasters, pediments, or chimneys.

Architectural Element: Architectural element is defined as any building component, either decorative or structural, which is outside of or comprises the [building envelope](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Examples include [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, cornices, and parapets. For the purposes of [Sec. 14.2.5.B. (Vertical Encroachments)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.5), architectural elements is defined as building elements attached to or integrated onto the roof of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), not intended for human occupation. Examples of architectural elements may include, but are not limited to: skylights, steeples, spires, belfries, cupolas, domes, flagpoles, or lighting.

Architectural Feature: Architectural feature is defined as a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or assembly of [architectural element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s attached to or integrated with a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Often architectural features include [occupiable space](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Examples include: bay windows, balconies, and [entry feature](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Area Median Income: Area median income is defined as the median income in Los Angeles County as determined annually by the California Department of Housing and Community Development, adjusted for [household](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) size.

Area of Overlap: Area of overlap is defined as the portion of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)'s area where the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of two intersecting [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s overlap. See Sec. 3C.1.2. (Build-To Depth). For an illustration of the area of overlap, see Sec. 3C.1.2.C.4. (Standards).

Area Planning Commission: Area Planning Commission is defined pursuant to [Sec. 552. (Area Planning Commission)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2440) of the [City Charter](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-2).

Articulating Element: Pursuant to [Sec. 3D.6.5. (Articulating Element)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5), articulating element is defined as permanent architectural details used to embellish a [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) design to accentuate an articulation technique or [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) composition.

At-Grade: At-grade is defined as a descriptor ascribed to something, such as a floor or entry, which is at the [elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of the ground where the ground meets the foundation of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Attended Bicycle Parking Service: Attended bicycle parking service is defined as a service by which a bicycle is left in the care of an attendant(s) with provision for identifying the bicycle's owner. See [Sec. 4C.3.2.C.7. (Attended Bicycle Parking Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3.2) and [Sec. 4C.3.3.C.5. (Attended Bicycle Parking Service)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.3.3).

Attic: Pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.10.F. (Attic)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.10), attic is defined as the [clear height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between the underside of the finished ceiling or exposed framing, whichever is lower, and the finished floor.

Automobile Access Package: Pursuant to [Sec. 4C.2.1.C.1. (Automobile Access Packages)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.2.1), automobile access packages are defined as a combination of standards regulating automobile [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) between the public roadway and a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Automobile Parking Stall: Pursuant to [Sec. 4C.4.1. (Automobile Parking Stalls)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.4.1), automobile parking stalls are defined as a space within a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), or a private or public [parking area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), exclusive of [driveway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, ramps, columns, [office](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and work areas, for the parking of one automobile. Automobile parking stalls do not include bicycle parking.

Automotive Repair Garage: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.10.4. (Annual Inspection Monitoring (Type 2))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.4), automotive repair garage is defined pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.4.A.3. (Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.4) as any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) described by the definition of: 1) [motor vehicle services: light](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) 2) [motor vehicle services: heavy](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) 3) or [motor vehicle services: large vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) per [Part 5D. (Use Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D).

Avenue: Avenue is defined as any [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designated as an Avenue I, II, or III on the Citywide General Plan Circulation System maps of the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Average Natural Slope: Average natural slope is defined as the average of the ungraded slopes at selected contours within a given [parcel](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of land divided by its area as computed from either the [City Engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)’s topographic maps or a topographic map prepared by a [registered civil engineer](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or land [surveyor](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and meets all the standards in [Sec. 14.2.18.A. (Average Natural Slope)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.18).

Awning Sign: Pursuant to [Sec. 4C.11.6.C.1. (Awning Sign)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.6), awning sign is defined as a [sign](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) painted, sewn, or otherwise adhered to the material of an awning as an integrated part of the awning itself.

### B

Base-Top Articulation: Pursuant to [Sec. 3D.6.2. (Base-Top Articulation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.2), base-top articulation is defined as a requirement composed of two separate and coordinated [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s designed to visually break a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) up into two separately legible layers.

Base, Middle & Top Articulation: Pursuant to [Sec. 3D.6.1. (Base, Middle & Top Articulation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.1), base, middle & top articulation is defined as a requirement composed of three separate and coordinated [articulating element](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s designed to visually break a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) up into three separately legible layers.

Basement: Pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.10.G. (Basement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.10), basement is defined as an [occupiable](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) portion of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located below the [ground story](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Bee: Bee is defined as any stage of life of the common domestic honey bee (Apis Mellifera).

Beehive: Beehive is defined as a [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that houses a [bee](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) colony.

Belt Course: Pursuant to [Sec. 3D.6.5.C.2. (Belt Course)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.6.5), belt course is defined as a horizontal course projecting beyond the face of the surrounding [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) often shaped to mark a division in the [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Bicycle Cage: Bicycle cage is defined as a locked bicycle parking area that has been fenced off to prohibit access by the general public, and contain bicycle racks that provide a means of securing the bicycle frame at two points to a securely anchored rack.

Bicycle Corral: Bicycle corral is defined as any on-street public bicycle parking space in which multiple short-term bicycle parking racks have been installed.

Bicycle Room: Bicycle room is defined as a locked bicycle parking area that has been walled off to prohibit [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) by the general public, and which, contain bicycle racks that provide a means of securing the bicycle frame at two points to a securely anchored rack.

Bicycle Share Dock: Bicycle share dock is defined as a device designed to receive a bicycle for locked storage as part of a system that directly rents bicycles on a short-term basis.

Bicycle Share Service Provider: Bicycle share service provider is defined as an entity operating a system that directly provides bicycles for rent on a short-term basis.

Bicycle Share Station: Bicycle share station is defined as a combination of multiple [bicycle share dock](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, automated payment equipment, and related equipment associated with bicycle rentals on a short-term basis.

Bisecting Line: Bisecting line is defined as a line that equally divides the angle created by the projection of intersecting [lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [adjoining](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) the street of a [corner lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) as illustrated in [Sec. 4C.11.3.D. (Measurement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.11.3).

Block: Block is defined as a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or grouping of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s with [public way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on all sides.

Block Face: Block face is defined as any number of [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that have a [primary street lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [adjacent](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to one side of a segment of private or a public street that lies between two other streets or [alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Bollard: Bollard is defined a an upright post consisting of a piece of timber, concrete, metal or similar material fixed firmly in an upright position intended to impede various forms of traffic or circulation.

Bonus Building Width: Bonus building width is defined as the bonus building width granted pursuant to [Sec. 2C.6.1.C.2. (Bonus Building Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.6.1).

Bonus FAR: See [bonus floor area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Bonus Floor Area: Bonus floor area is defined as having the same meaning as [tier 2 bonus floor area ratio](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Bonus Height: Bonus height is defined as having the same meaning as [tier 2 bonus height](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Booking Service: For the purposes of the [Home-Sharing Program (Sec. 5C.3.2.)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2), booking service is defined pursuant to [Sec. 5C.3.2.B. (Definitions)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2) as any reservation or payment service provided by a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that facilitates a short-term rental transaction between a [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and a prospective guest or transient user, and for which the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) collects or receives, directly or indirectly through an agent or intermediary, a fee in connection with the reservation or payment of services provided for the transaction.

Boulevard: Boulevard is defined as any [public right-of-way](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designated as a Boulevard I or II on the Citywide General Plan Circulation System maps of the [Circulation Element](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf) of the [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Build-To Depth: Pursuant to [Sec. 3C.1.2. (Build-To Depth)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.2), build-to depth is defined as the depth of the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) starting at the minimum [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and continuing inward for the maximum build-to depth for the full width of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Build-To Width: Pursuant to [Sec. 3C.1.3. (Build-To Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3C.1.3), build-to width is defined as the cumulative building width that shall occupy the [build-to zone](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), relative to the width of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) at the [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Build-To Zone: Build-to zone is defined as the area on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located behind the minimum [frontage lot line](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [building setback](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and continuing inward to the maximum [build-to depth](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), and extending the full width of the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Building: Building is defined as a [covered](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and [enclosed](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) intended for human occupancy.

Building Break: Building break is defined as the minimum [distance](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s are required to be separated in order to establish them as separate [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Building Coverage: Pursuant to [Sec. 2C.2.1. (Building Coverage)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.1), building coverage is defined as the percentage of [lot area](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) covered by [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

Building Elevation: Building elevation is defined as an orthographic projection of the [exterior face](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), represented as a two-dimensional drawing of the [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). Building elevations have an [angle of elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of zero degrees (horizontal).

Building Entrance: Building entrance is defined as a door providing [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from the public realm to the [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) of a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Building Envelope: Building envelope is defined as the physical barrier (including [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, roof, foundation, [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, and doors) that separates a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#)'s [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) from its exterior environment.

Building Facade: See [facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Building Face: Building face is defined as the outer surface of a [building facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), which would not include recesses or encroachments.

Building Footprint: Pursuant to [Sec. 14.2.1. (Building Footprint)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.1), building footprint building is defined as the area of a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) occupied by a [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), measured horizontally. Also referred to as "structure footprint".

Building Frontage: Building frontage is defined as the projection of the [exterior wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s upon the street used for street frontage, as measured perpendicular to the edge of the street. For [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s that are not parallel to the street, the building frontage shall include the [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that, other than open [parking stall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s, has direct and unimpeded [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to the street.

Building Module: Building module is defined as sub-areas of a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) used in the building module method to determine [grade plane elevation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). See [Sec. 14.2.9.D. (Grade Plane Elevation)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.9).

Building Perimeter: Building perimeter is defined as the perimeter of a [building footprint](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), See [Sec. 14.2.1. (Building Footprint)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#14.2.1).

Building Permit: Building permit is defined as a permit obtained pursuant to [Chapter IX. (Building Regulations), Sec. 91.106.1.1. (Building Permit)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-172464) of this Code.

Building Permit Application: For the purposes of [Sec. 15.4.3. (Affordable Housing Linkage Fee)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.4.3), building permit application is defined as plans submitted to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2. (Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1).

Building Setback: Pursuant to [Sec. 2C.2.2. (Building Setback)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.2.2), building setback is defined as the area between a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) boundary and the minimum required setback, represented with a dotted white line and bounded by the buildable area.

Building Site: See [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Building Width: Pursuant to [Sec. 2C.5.1. (Building Width)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/2#2C.5.1), building width is defined as the horizontal dimension of any [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) or collection of [abutting](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s on a [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Bulkhead: Pursuant to [Sec. 3D.9.1.4.C.4. (Bulkhead)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/3#3D.9.1), bulkhead is defined as a [wall](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) located beneath a display [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) on the [ground story facade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) that elevates a [window](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) above the exterior [finished grade](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) and the [interior](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) finished floor surface.

### C

California Coastal Act: California Coastal Act is defined by [California Public Resources Code, Div. 20. (California Coastal Act), Sec. 30000.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayexpandedbranch.xhtml?tocCode=PRC&division=20.&title=&part=&chapter=&article=&nodetreepath=43), et seq.

California Environmental Quality Act: The [California Environmental Quality Act](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) (CEQA), is defined pursuant to the [California Public Resources Code, Sec. 21000.](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displayText.xhtml?division=13.&chapter=1.&lawCode=PRC) et seq. and the [CEQA Guideline](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s.

California Native Plant Library: California native plant library is defined as a library of native plants maintained by the [Theodore Payne Foundation](https://www.theodorepayne.org/).

California State Accessibility Standards: California state accessibility standards is defined by the provisions established in the [California Building Standards Code, Title 24. (Physical Access Regulations)](https://www.dgs.ca.gov/BSC).

Caliper: Caliper is defined as the diameter measurement of the stem or trunk of nursery stock. For the measurement of caliper, see [Sec. 4C.6.4.D.10. (Caliper)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/4#4C.6.4).

Calvo Exclusion Area: Calvo exclusion area is defined as the [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s identified as being in a Calvo Exclusion Area, as established in [Sec. 1.5.7. (Coastal Zone Map)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/1#1.5.7).

Canes: Canes is defined as a primary stem which starts at a point not higher than 1⁄4 the height of the plant.

Caretaker Unit: Caretaker unit is defined as a [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) designed for use solely by a watchman, manager, or caretaker (including their family) of a permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) which requires 24-hour supervision and is located on the same [lot](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) with the permitted [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#).

Carpool: Carpool is defined as a [vehicle](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) carrying two to five persons to and from work on a regular schedule.

Categorically Excluded Development: For the purposes of [Sec. 13B.9.2 (Coastal Development Permit (Post-Certification))](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.9.2), categorically excluded development is defined as a development, which is excluded from the Coastal Development Permit requirements pursuant to a categorical exclusion order adopted by the Coastal Commission that sets forth the specific categories of development that qualify for the exclusion within a specific geographic area, and which establishes that those categories of development in the specified geographic areas will have no potential for significant adverse effects, either individually or cumulatively on coastal resources or on public [access](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to or along the coastline.

Cemetery: Pursuant to [Sec. 5D.3.1. (Cemetery)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.3.1), cemetery is defined by [California Health and Safety Code, Sec. 7003. (Definitions)](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=HSC&sectionNum=7003.). A cemetery includes columbarium, crypt, and mausoleum facilities integrated within a burial ground. This [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) does not include crematoriums, for such [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) s see [Sec. 5D.6.10. (Postmortem Services)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5D.6.10).

CEQA Clearance: CEQA clearance is defined as any determination, finding or certification authorized or required under [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) to approve a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) in compliance with [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#). CEQA Clearances include, but are not limited to, (i) a determination that an approval does not require [CEQA](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) review, in whole or in part, either due to the applicability of an exemption or because the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) action is not a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#), (ii) a finding that the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) may adopt a Negative Declaration or a Mitigated Negative Declaration, (iii) the certification of an Environmental Impact Report, or (iv) a finding that a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/14#) was adequately assessed in a prior adopted Negative Declaration or certified Environmental Impact Report, including through the use of an addendum.

CEQA Guideline: CEQA guideline is defined by [California Code of Regulations, Title 14, Chapter 3, Sec. 15000, et seq.](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Browse/Home/California/CaliforniaCodeofRegulations?guid=I86C9BC205B4D11EC976B000D3A7C4BC3&originationContext=documenttoc&transitionType=Default&contextData=(sc.Default))
