2. ###### Effective Date


      The TIA Fee became effective on June 28, 2019.

3. ###### Phased Implementation of the Residential TIA Fee


      The TIA Fee for Residential Land Uses (as those uses are defined in the TIA Fee Table), shall be phased based on when the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) plans are submitted to the Los Angeles [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2. (Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1):

      1. For projects with plans submitted within the first 120 days following the effective date of the ordinance, no TIA Fee for Residential Land Uses shall be paid.

      2. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s with plans submitted between 121 and 305 days following the effective date of the ordinance, 1/3 of the TIA Fee for Residential Land Uses (based on the fee schedule in effect at the time the plans are submitted) shall be imposed.

      3. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s with plans submitted between 306 and 484 days following the effective date of the ordinance, 2/3 of the TIA Fee for Residential Land Uses (based on the fee schedule in effect at the time the plans are submitted) shall be paid.

      4. For [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s with plans submitted 485 or more days following the effective date of the ordinance, the full TIA Fee for Residential Land Uses (based on the fee schedule in effect at the time the plans are submitted) shall be paid.
4. ###### Annual Indexing


      The TIA Fees shall be increased (or decreased) annually as follows: The Annual Index upon adoption of this ordinance shall be 1.000. The TIA Fee shall be increased (or decreased) as of January 1 of each year by the amount of the percent increase (or decrease) in the most recently available Construction Cost Index for the Los Angeles region, or equivalent index, as determined by [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#). The revised Annual Index shall be published by [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) in a newspaper of Citywide circulation or on the [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) website before January 31 of each year.

5. ###### Appeal Filing Fee


      An appeal filed pursuant to Section 11.A. or B. of the WLA TIMP or the CTCSP shall be accompanied by a filing fee of $500 payable to [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) or the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), as applicable.
4. ##### Fee Exemptions, Calculations, & Credits


1. ###### TIA Fee Exemptions


      The following [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s shall be exempt from payment of a TIA Fee:

      01. Any project exempt from the requirements of the CTCSP or WLA TIMP pursuant to Section 5.B. in the applicable [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#);

      02. Affordable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s, if they meet the criteria in Subsection 8.B.2.b. of the CTCSP and the WLA TIMP;

      03. One hundred percent affordable housing projects. For the purposes of this Section (Westside Mobility Transportation Fees), a "one hundred percent affordable housing project" means a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) in which each [residential](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) unit in the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), exclusive of a [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) or [manager unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s, is an affordable dwelling unit. A one hundred percent affordable housing project may include on-site services or mixed commercial [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s;

      04. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s providing housing or services for persons experiencing homelessness, including but not limited to [permanent supportive housing](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) or temporary supportive housing projects, transitional housing projects, and [supportive services](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#);

      05. [Accessory dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s to single-unit homes, commonly referred to as "granny flats;"

      06. [School](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s, public and private;

      07. [Household business: family child care](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) or [school: preschool/daycare](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#);

      08. [Community assembly](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), and other [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s used for assembly, whether for religious or secular purposes;

      09. Any [hospital: local](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) or [hospital: regional](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) healthcare facility;

      10. [Supportive housing: general](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#). For the purposes of this Section (Westside Mobility Transportation Fees), the fee exemption shall only apply to [senior care facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) as enumerated in [Sec. 9.4.3. (Senior Care Facilities Incentive Program)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/9#9.4.3);

      11. Park and Ride Facilities;

      12. [Temporary use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s of less than six months in duration based on a [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) where no extension of time is permitted;

      13. Governmental or public facilities defined as capital improvements and/or [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s or structures used for the operation of [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), county, state or federal governments including, but not limited to, police and fire stations, government offices, government equipment yards, sanitation facilities, schools, parks, United States Federal Aviation Authority or Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) administrative facilities, and other similar administrative facilities in which general government operations are conducted. Governmental or public facility does not include the use of publicly owned land, [building](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s, improvements or [structure](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s for private activities pursuant to lease agreements; and

      14. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s on property owned by LAWA and used for aircraft operations (commercial or noncommercial) or airport operation facilities (such as, terminals and other passenger processing related facilities such as gate areas and non-commercial spaces of passenger transportation such as the Intermodal Transportation Facility), not including cargo facilities or maintenance facilities.
2. ###### TIA Fee Calculation


      The TIA Fee shall be calculated as follows:

      1. Total TIA Fee = (number of Units) x (TIA Fee per Unit)

      2. The type of Unit and the TIA Fee per Unit for the land use are identified in the TIA Fee Table in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.a. (TIA Fee Amounts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above.

      3. For special generators, pursuant to [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.b. (Special Generators)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above, the fee shall be calculated as provided in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.b. (Special Generators)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above.
3. ###### TIA Fee Credits


      1. Existing Land Use Credit

         The Fee Credit for existing uses, as provided in Section 8.A of the WLA TIMP and the CTCSP, shall be determined and calculated as follows:

         1. Existing land uses on a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) site for which a TIA Fee was paid pursuant to Ordinance Nos. [160,394](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/1983/83-1859_ORD_160394_10-04-1985.pdf), [168,999](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/1988/88-1984-S1_ORD_168999_09-22-1993.pdf), or [171,492](https://clkrep.lacity.org/onlinedocs/1996/96-0156_ORD_171492_03-08-1997.pdf) shall receive a Fee Credit based on the existing land [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s for which a fee was previously paid; and

         2. For existing land uses that are not eligible for a credit under Sub-subparagraph i. above, a Fee Credit shall be given when requested by the applicant subject to all of the following:

            1. Applicants for [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s seeking credits for existing uses must provide [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) with documentation supporting the existence and duration of the use (such as, lease agreements, utility bills, or previous environmental reviews). [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) will validate credits for existing uses based on the provided documentation.

            2. Fee Credits shall not be given for existing affordable [dwelling unit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s.
         3. If the existing [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) was active for at least six consecutive months during the past two years prior to submittal of plans to [LADBS](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2. (Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1), a 100 percent credit will be granted for the existing use pursuant to the calculation below. The 100 percent credit is calculated as follows:

            1. Credit = (number of existing Units) x (TIA Fee per Unit)

            2. The type of Unit and the TIA Fee per Unit for each land use are identified in the TIA Fee Table in Paragraph C.1.a. (TIA Fee Amounts) above.

            3. For special generators, pursuant to Paragraph C.1.b. (Special Generators) above, the fee shall be calculated as provided in Paragraph C.1.b. (Special Generators) above.
         4. If the existing use was active for at least six consecutive months during the past four years prior to submittal of plans to LADBS pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.1.B.2. (Vesting of Development Plan)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.1), a 50 percent credit will be granted for the previous use. The 50 percent credit is calculated as follows:

            1. Credit = (number of existing Units) x (TIA Fee per Unit) x (.50)

            2. The type of Unit and the TIA Fee per Unit for the land use are identified in the TIA Fee Table in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.a. (TIA Fee Amounts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above.

            3. For special generators, pursuant to [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.b. (Special Generators)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above, the fee shall be calculated as provided in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.b. (Special Generators)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above.
      2. Affordable Housing Credit

         The Affordable Housing Fee Credit pursuant to Section 8.B.2. of the WLA TIMP and the CTCSP shall be calculated as follows:

         1. ###### Calculation


            Credits shall be granted for each Affordable Dwelling Unit in an amount equal to the fee for two Apartment units, as shown in the TIA Fee Table in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.a. (TIA Fee Amounts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above, as follows:

            1. Credit = (Affordable Dwelling Units) x (2 x \[TIA Fee per Apartment Unit\])

            2. The type of Unit and the TIA Fee per Unit for the land use are identified in the TIA Fee Table in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.a. (TIA Fee Amounts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above.

            3. For special generators, pursuant to [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.b. (Special Generators)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above, the fee shall be calculated as provided in [Sec. 15.6.1.C.1.b. (Special Generators)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#15.6.1) above.
         2. ###### Maximum Credits


            In no case shall the Affordable Housing Fee Credit exceed 50 percent of the TIA Fee for a [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#).
      3. ###### Transit Oriented Development Credit


         The Transit Oriented Development Fee Credit pursuant to Section 8.B.3. of the WLA TIMP and the CTCSP shall be calculated as follows:

         1. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) on a parcel within 1/2 mile of a transit station or stop serving a Dedicated Transit Line is eligible for a five percent Fee Credit; or

         2. A [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) with a pedestrian entrance within 1/4 mile walking distance to a transit station or stop serving a Dedicated Transit Line is eligible for a 10 percent fee credit.

            The applicant is required to submit a map subject to [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) review and approval, showing the [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) is eligible for a Transit Oriented Development Fee Credit.
      4. ###### No Credit for Administrative Costs


         Notwithstanding the above, no credit shall be granted for that portion of the TIA Fee for the administrative costs of the TIA Fee program (five percent of total fee).
5. ##### Transportation Improvement Project List


1. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) shall adopt by resolution a list of TIA Fee Improvements as described in Section 6.B. of the WLA TIMP and the CTCSP that meet the purposes identified in Section 3 of the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s and are consistent with the most recently adopted fee study. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) may amend the resolution from time to time or approve the use of TIA Fee monies for transportation improvements not on the list of TIA Fee Improvements subject to the procedures in this Subsection (Transportation Improvement Project List).

2. The list of TIA Fee Improvements shall include improvements in all of the following four categories:

      1. ###### Transit


         A transit improvement is an improvement that encourages or supports the use of transit.

      2. ###### Active Transportation


         An active transportation improvement is an improvement that encourages or supports the use of biking and walking, and other forms of active transportation.

      3. ###### Roadway


         A [roadway](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) improvement is an improvement that improves or maintains vehicular movement in the circulation system.

      4. ###### Trip Reduction


         A trip reduction improvement is an improvement that decreases vehicle miles traveled.
3. Updating the List of TIA Fee Improvements. Upon recommendation of [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) or the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) may amend the resolution and list of TIA Fee Improvements adopted pursuant to Paragraph 1. above, provided the following criteria are met:

      1. The improvement achieves the purposes described in Section 3 of the CTCSP or the WLA TIMP; and

      2. The improvement fulfills the transportation objectives of the improvement which it is to replace, including falling within the same category of improvement as identified in Paragraph 2. above and at least one of the same type of project improvements existing in that category; and

      3. The improvement meets at least one of the following:

         1. The improvement implements one or more goals, objectives and policies of the [Mobility Plan 2035](https://planning.lacity.gov/odocument/523f2a95-9d72-41d7-aba5-1972f84c1d36/Mobility_Plan_2035.pdf); and/or

         2. The improvement is feasible and the planning and engineering is advanced enough that with sufficient funding or funds to meet a funding gap, construction can begin in the near future, (i.e., "shovel ready"); and/or

         3. The improvement does not hinder equitable geographic distribution of transportation projects within the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) geographies.
4. Funding Transportation Improvements that are not on the Approved List of TIA Fee Improvements. The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) may by resolution allocate TIA Fee funds for an improvement [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) that is not included on the approved list of TIA Fee Improvements without amending the resolution adopted under Paragraph 1. above, provided the improvement meets the relevant criteria in Paragraph 3. above.
6. ##### Administration


1. ###### Guidelines


      The General Manager of the [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) may adopt guidelines to implement the WLA TIMP and CTCSP TIA Fee programs consistent with the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s and this Section (Westside Mobility Transportation Fees).

2. ###### Reporting Template


      [LADOT](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) may develop a reporting template for the fee monitoring report. The template may include, but is not limited to, TIA Fee revenues, interest revenues, trust fund administration, encumbered monies, and expended monies.
7. ##### Use of TIA Fees


1. ###### Administrative Costs


      Up to five percent of TIA Fees may be used for administrative costs each year.

2. ###### Prohibited Use of TIA Fee Monies


      TIA Fee monies shall not be used for any of the following:

      1. Improvements which do not provide a regional or sub-regional transportation benefit;

      2. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) Serving Improvements;

      3. Financing of any transportation improvement which is not of direct benefit to the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) area from which the TIA Fee was collected;

      4. Substituting for other transportation monies which have been allocated to the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) area;

      5. Operation and maintenance costs;

      6. Curb, driveway, gutter, trees, street lights/power poles and sidewalk construction or repair, except as part of a transportation improvement pursuant to the [Specific Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#);

      7. Off-street parking facilities, except in conjunction with a TDM program;

      8. [Alley](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) improvements; and

      9. [Private street](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s.
8. ##### Severability


If any portion, Subsection, sentence, clause or phrase of this Division (Transportation Improvement & Mitigation Program Fees) is for any reason held by a court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, such a decision shall not affect the validity of the remaining portions of this Division (Transportation Improvement & Mitigation Program Fees). The [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) hereby declares that it would have passed this Section and each portion or Subsection, sentence, clause and phrase herein, irrespective of the fact that any one or more portions, Subsections, sentences, clauses or phrases be declared invalid.


## Div. 15.7. Surcharges

### Sec. 15.7.1. Surcharge For Development Services Centers

1. ##### Surcharge


There shall be added to each fee imposed for any permit, license, or [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) provided for in this Article (Fees), a surcharge in an amount equal to the greater of three percent of the fee or $1.00.

2. ##### BuildLA Increase


The previous surcharge amount of two percent is increased solely to pay for the $21.76 million cost of developing and implementing BuildLA, a comprehensive enterprise-wide development services system, and shall not be used to pay for ongoing BuildLA costs, such as maintenance or system hosting services.

3. ##### BuildLA Increase Reversion


The surcharge shall be returned to the greater of two percent or $1.00 when the City Administrative Officer determines the surcharge increase has recovered the $21.76 million cost of BuildLA.


### Sec. 15.7.2. Automated Systems Surcharge For The Department

1. ##### Operating Surcharge


There shall be added to each fee imposed for any permit, plan check, license or [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) provided for in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) a surcharge in an amount equal to the greater of seven percent of the fee or $1.00, except that any other surcharge shall be excluded from the computation of this surcharge. Moneys received from this surcharge shall be deposited and maintained in the City Planning Systems Development Fund pursuant to [Sec. 5.457. (Creation and Administration of the Fund)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-25318) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) for the maintenance and operation of automated systems. Exempted from this surcharge are all fees and costs imposed pursuant to [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1).

2. ##### Development Surcharge


There shall be added to each fee imposed for any permit, plan check, license or [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) provided for in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A) an automated systems development surcharge in an amount equal to the greater of six percent of the fee or $1.00, except that any other surcharge shall be excluded from the computation of this surcharge. Moneys received from this surcharge shall be deposited into the City Planning Systems Development Fund pursuant to [Sec. 5.457. (Creation and Administration of the Fund)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/laac/0-0-0-25318) of the [LAAC](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#). Exempted from this surcharge are all fees and costs imposed pursuant to [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1).


### Sec. 15.7.3. General Plan Maintenance Surcharge For The Department

There shall be added to each fee imposed for any permit, plan check, license or [application](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), provided in this Zoning Code (Chapter 1A), a surcharge in an amount equal to the greater of seven percent of the fee or $1.00, except that any other surcharge shall be excluded from the computation of this surcharge. Monies received from this surcharge shall be deposited into the [Department of City Planning](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) Long-Range Planning Special Revenue Trust Fund. The monies received pursuant to this Section (General Plan Maintenance Surcharge For The Department) shall be used for maintenance of the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#)'s [General Plan](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) and all associated underlying plans or elements, ordinances, and other associated planning initiatives. 50 percent of the monies received, after the effective date of this ordinance, shall be used for costs directly related to updating the [City](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#)'s 34 Community Plans. Exempted from this surcharge are all fees and costs imposed pursuant to [Div. 10.1. (Street Dedication & Improvement)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/10#10.1).

## Div. 15.8. Fines

### Sec. 15.8.1. Home Occupation Fines

An administrative fine of $250.00 may be collected by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) for any violation of the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) standards as established in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) and administrative fines of $500.00 may be collected for repeated violations pursuant to the following provisions. These administrative fine provisions are in addition to any other fines and penalties authorized by law.

1. ##### Order to Comply


For any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) found to be in violation of the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) standards as established in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), the Superintendent of the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) shall send an Order to Comply to the operator of the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) use. The Order to Comply shall clearly state the following:

1. The violation must be corrected by a Compliance Date specified in the Order, which date shall be no more than 15 days from the date the Order is mailed.

2. Failure to correct the violation on or before the Compliance Date may result in the imposition of an administrative fine in the amount of $250.00.
2. ##### Reinspection


The Superintendent shall reinspect a property for which an Order to Comply was issued pursuant to this Section (Home Occupation Fines) subsequent to the Compliance Date.

3. ##### Failure to Correct Violation


1. If any violation specified in the Order to Comply is not corrected prior to the Compliance Date as specified in the Order to Comply, an administrative fine of $250.00 may be collected by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#).

2. If the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) determines that a fine is due, then it shall notify the person cited by United States Postal Service mail in a sealed envelope, with postage paid. If the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited is the owner of the property, the notice shall be addressed to the last known address of the owner as that address appears in the last equalized assessment roll. If the person to be cited is a tenant, the notice shall be addressed to the location where the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) is being conducted. Service of the notice shall be deemed to have been completed at the time of deposit with the United States Postal Service.

3. The [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited shall remit the fine to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) within 30 days after the date of mailing of the notice. If the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited fails to do so, then the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), by sending a second notification by certified mail, may demand payment of the fine from the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited and may prohibit the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), license or approval to the cited [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s until such fees are paid.
4. ##### Repeated Violations


Regardless of any provision of this Section (Home Occupation Fines) to the contrary, if an Order to Comply is issued for a violation of the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) standards as established in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), and after compliance with it a subsequent Order to Comply is issued for a violation of the same Section of [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) occurring within one year of the date of the initial Order, an administrative fine of $500.00 may be collected by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#).

5. ##### Discontinuance of Use


1. Three violations of any [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) standards as established in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B) which has resulted in an Order to Comply being issued under Subsection A. (Order to Comply) above may result in the imposition of proceedings to discontinue the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) use. The [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) shall have jurisdiction to discontinue a [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) use by giving notice to the record owner of the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) by issuing A Notice of Intention to Discontinue the Home Occupation (Notice). The Notice shall provide an opportunity for the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) user to either:

      1. Submit information to the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) by a date certain to show cause why the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) should not be discontinued; or

      2. Appear at a time and place before the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) pursuant to the procedures prescribed in [Div. 13B.2. (Quasi-Judicial Review)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.2) to show cause why the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) use should not be discontinued.
2. Upon the expiration of the time periods set forth in the Notice, the [Director](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) may discontinue the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) use.

### Sec. 15.8.2. Recycling Facilities Fines

An administrative fine of $250.00 may be collected by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) for any violation of the provisions of this Section (Recycling Facilities Fines) pursuant to the following provisions.

1. ##### Order to Comply


For any [use](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) found to be in violation of the [recycling facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) standards as established in [Part 5B. (Use Districts)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5B), the Superintendent of the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) shall send an Order to Comply to the operator of the [recycling facility](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) use. The Order to Comply shall clearly state the following:

1. The violation must be corrected by a Compliance Date specified in the Order, which date shall be no more than 15 days from the date the Order is mailed.

2. Failure to correct the violation on or before the Compliance Date may result in the imposition of an administrative fine in the amount of $250.00.

3. Repeated violations can result in nuisance abatement procedures under the provisions of the Zoning Code (Chapter 1A).
2. ##### Reinspection


The Superintendent shall reinspect a property for which an Order to Comply was issued pursuant to this Section (Recycling Facilities Fines) subsequent to the Compliance Date.

3. ##### Failure to Correct Violation


1. If any violation specified in the Order to Comply is not corrected prior to the Compliance Date as specified in the Order to Comply, an administrative fine of $250.00 may be collected by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#).

2. If the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) determines that a fine is due, then it shall notify the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited by United States mail in a sealed envelope, with postage paid. If the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited is the owner of the property, the notice shall be addressed to the last known address of the owner as that address appears in the last equalized assessment roll. If the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) to be cited is a tenant, the notice shall be addressed to the location where the [household business: home occupation](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) is being conducted. Service of the notice shall be deemed to have been completed at the time of deposit with the United States Postal Service.

3. The [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited shall remit the fine to the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) within 30 days after the date of mailing of the notice. If the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited fails to do so, then the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), by sending a second notification by certified mail, may demand payment of the fine from the [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) cited and may prohibit the issuance of any [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#), license or approval to the cited [person](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s until such fees are paid.
4. ##### Appeals


Appeals may be made from a Notice to Comply issued by the [Department of Building and Safety](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) pursuant to this subdivision pursuant to [Sec. 13B.10.2. (Appeals from LADBS Determinations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/13#13B.10.2).


### Sec. 15.8.3. Home-Sharing Fines

Fines as established in [Sec. 5C.3.2.H. (Enforcement of Violations)](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/5#5C.3.2) shall be imposed for any of the violations established in that Subsection.

## Div. 15.9. Other City Agency Fees

### Sec. 15.9.1. Fees For Flood Hazard Reports & Compliance Checks

1. ##### Basic Review Fee


Except for services subject to the provisions of Subsection B. (Reviews or Services Requiring Additional Staff Time of 16 or Fewer Hours) or Subsection C. (Reviews or Services Requiring Additional Staff Time of More than 16 Hours) below, the Bureau of Engineering shall charge and collect a fee of $273 to perform each of the following services pertaining to Flood Hazard compliance:

1. ###### Flood Hazard Compliance Check Fee


      Review to verify that a permitted [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) would or does comply with the requirements of the [Los Angeles Specific Plan for the Management of Flood Hazards](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-222901) and the National Flood Insurance Program.

2. ###### Elevation Certificate Processing Fee


      Process an Elevation Certificate for [building permit](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) s located in floodplain zones, in compliance with the requirements of the [Los Angeles Specific Plan for the Management of Flood Hazards](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-222901) and the National Flood Insurance Program.

3. ###### Floodproofing Certificate Processing


      Process a Floodproofing Certificate for a commercial project or a non-single-family development proposed in a floodplain zone, in compliance with the requirements of the [Los Angeles Specific Plan for the Management of Flood Hazards](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-222901) and the National Flood Insurance Program.

4. ###### Letter of Map Change/Conditional Letter of Map Change Processing


      Process a Conditional Letter of Map Revision, Conditional Letter of Map Amendment, Letter of Map Revisions, or Letter of Map Amendment.
2. ##### Reviews or Services Requiring Additional Staff Time of 16 or Fewer Hours


For all Bureau of Engineering services identified in Subsection A. (Basic Review Fee) above, for which a fee of $273 is charged, and which will require Bureau staff to review plans or surveys, or take other action in addition to that normally required to accomplish the task for which the $273 fee is charged, the Bureau shall charge and collect a fee pursuant to the provisions of [Chapter VI. (Public works and Property), Sec. 61.14. (Special Engineering Fee)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-222901) of this Code, except for reviews or services provided pursuant to the provisions of Subsection C. (Reviews or Services Requiring Additional Staff Time of More than 16 Hours) below.

3. ##### Reviews or Services Requiring Additional Staff Time of More than 16 Hours


For all Bureau of Engineering services identified in Subsection A. (Basic Review Fee) above for which a fee of $273 is charged, and which will require Bureau staff to review plans or surveys, or take other action, and where Bureau staff will be required to provide more than 16 hours of staff time in addition to that normally required to accomplish the task for which the $273 fee is charged, the Bureau shall charge and collect actual Bureau of Engineering costs and a deposit for such costs as determined and collected pursuant to the provisions of [Chapter VI. (Public Works and Property), Sec. 61.15. (Actual Cost Special Engineering Services)](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/los_angeles/latest/lamc/0-0-0-222901).

4. ##### All Fees To Be Paid Prior Issuance of any to Bureau of Engineering Action


The Bureau of Engineering shall not issue any approval or decision with respect to any matter for which this section requires payment to the Bureau until all monies owed pursuant to the provisions of this Section (Fees For Flood Hazard Reports & Compliance Checks) are paid.

1. ##### Transportation Review Fee Fund


Each fee collected pursuant to this Section (Department of Transportation Development Fees) shall include a flat technology support fee to be deposited into “Transportation Review Fee Fund No. 50Y.” This fund shall be used exclusively by the Department of Transportation to provide funding for the continual enhancement of development review-related information technology systems and for the procurement costs associated with equipment, software, materials, staff training, and, if needed, consultant services. With the exception of the flat technology support fee deposited into Transportation Fee Fund No. 50Y, the remaining fees collected shall be credited to the General Fund. The technology support fee, which is included in the fees listed above, is applied as follows: $100 for Department of Transportation review services that cost under $1,000; $300 for services between $1,000 and $3,000; and $500 for services that are $3,000 or more.

2. ##### Engineering Services


The Department of Transportation shall offer engineering services for unique services that take under 10 hours to complete. These engineering services include, but are not limited to, providing access to signal timing charts, gathering related [project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) lists, performing field engineering work related to a Traffic Control Plan, conducting Short Term Worksite Traffic Control Plan Review (72 hours or less), inspecting sites, etc. A charge of $155 shall be assessed for each hour of services, or a proportional fee for each fractional hour.

3. ##### Planning Services


The Department of Transportation shall offer planning services for unique services that take under 10 hours to complete. These planning services include, but are not limited to, providing access to forecasted and empirical travel data and travel diagnostics for a specific defined area. A charge of $145 shall be assessed for each hour of services, or a proportional fee for each fractional hour.

4. ##### Expedited Services


The Department of Transportation shall offer expedited services in the review of any of the processes listed above, including transportation assessments, TDM Plans, and B-permit design plans. [Project](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#) applicants can choose to pay a higher review fee to allow Department of Transportation staff to work overtime hours to expedite their review. The actual review fee to process a transportation assessment, which will be greater than the standard transportation assessment review fee, will be determined by the Department of Transportation during the preparation of the Transportation Assessment MOU executed between the Department of Transportation and the applicant’s representative. The fee shall be based on the applicant’s desired completion date, the availability of staff to work overtime, and the affected division’s workload. During times of peak workloads, the expedited review fee may be utilized by the Department of Transportation to procure an outside firm from the Department of Transportation’s pre-screened list of consultants to conduct the review of the assessment. Similarly, the actual fee to process Long-Term Worksite Traffic Control Plans (over 72 hours) or B-permit design plans shall be established by the Department of Transportation at the predesign meeting with the applicant’s representative.

5. ##### Fee Revisions


The Department of Transportation shall provide an annual review of the fees established pursuant to this Section (Department of Transportation Development Fees), and shall submit recommendations for changes in these fees to the [City Council](https://zoning.lacity.gov/browse/15#). The fees shall be revised by the Department of Transportation to account for any staff salary cost of living adjustments. Notice of any increased fees shall be in accordance with [California Government Code Sec. 66018](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=66018.&lawCode=GOV) and [6062a](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?sectionNum=6062a.&lawCode=GOV).
